6:27.latin_iast: tumi yadi dekhate pete yakhana tāderake agnira pārśve dā~r̤a karāna have evaṃ tārā valave, ‘hāẏa! yadi āmāderake āvāra (pṛthivīte) phiriẏe deẏā hata tave āmarā āmādera pratipālakera nidarśanake asvīkāra karatāma nā evaṃ āmarā mu’minadera antarbhukta hatāma.
6:27.latin_ascii: tumi yadi dekhate pete yakhana taderake agnira parsve da~ra karana have evam tara valave, ‘haya! yadi amaderake avara (prthivite) phiriye deya hata tave amara amadera pratipalakera nidarsanake asvikara karatama na evam amara mu’minadera antarbhukta hatama.

6:28.latin_iast: (viṣaẏaṭi emana naẏa) varaṃ pūrve tārā yā gopana kareche tā ekhana tādera nikaṭa prakāśa peẏeche evaṃ tārā pratyāvartita haleo yā karate tāderake niṣedha karā haẏechila punarāẏa tārā tāi karave evaṃ niścaẏa tārā mithyāvādī.
6:28.latin_ascii: (visayati emana naya) varam purve tara ya gopana kareche ta ekhana tadera nikata prakasa peyeche evam tara pratyavartita haleo ya karate taderake nisedha kara hayechila punaraya tara tai karave evam niscaya tara mithyavadi.

6:29.latin_iast: tārā vale, ‘āmādera pārthiva jīvanai ekamātra jīvana evaṃ āmarā punarutthitao hava nā.’
6:29.latin_ascii: tara vale, ‘amadera parthiva jivanai ekamatra jivana evam amara punarutthitao hava na.’

6:30.latin_iast: tumi yadi dekhate pete tāderake yakhana tādera pratipālakera sammukhe dā~r̤a karāno have evaṃ tini valavena, ‘eṭā ki prakṛta satya naẏa?’ tārā valave, ‘hyā~, āmādera pratipālakera śapatha! niścaẏai satya’. tini valavena, ‘tave tomarā ye kupharī karecha tāra janya tomarā ekhana śāsti bhoga kara.’
6:30.latin_ascii: tumi yadi dekhate pete taderake yakhana tadera pratipalakera sammukhe da~ra karano have evam tini valavena, ‘eta ki prakrta satya nayay’ tara valave, ‘hya~, amadera pratipalakera sapatha! niscayai satya’. tini valavena, ‘tave tomara ye kuphari karecha tara janya tomara ekhana sasti bhoga kara.’

6:31.latin_iast: yārā āllāhara sammukhīna haoẏāke (punarutthānake) mithyā valeche tārā avaśyai kṣatigrasta haẏeche, emanaki akasmāt tādera nikaṭa yakhana kiẏāmata upasthita have takhana tārā valave, ‘hāẏa āphasosa! eke āmarā ye avahelā karechi.” tārā tādera piṭhe nijedera pāpa vahana karave; dekha, tārā yā vahana karave tā ati nikṛṣṭa!
6:31.latin_ascii: yara allahara sammukhina haoyake (punarutthanake) mithya valeche tara avasyai ksatigrasta hayeche, emanaki akasmat tadera nikata yakhana kiyamata upasthita have takhana tara valave, ‘haya aphasosa! eke amara ye avahela karechi.” tara tadera pithe nijedera papa vahana karave; dekha, tara ya vahana karave ta ati nikrsta!

6:32.latin_iast: pārthiva jīvana to krīr̤ā-kautuka vyatīta āra kichui naẏa evaṃ yārā tākvaoẏā avalamvana kare tādera janya ākhirātera āvāsai śreẏa; tomarā ki anudhāvana kara nā?
6:32.latin_ascii: parthiva jivana to krira-kautuka vyatita ara kichui naya evam yara takvaoya avalamvana kare tadera janya akhiratera avasai sreya; tomara ki anudhavana kara nay

6:33.latin_iast: avaśyai āmi jāni ye, tārā yā vale niściẏai tā tomāke kaṣṭa deẏa; kintu tārā tomāke to (antara theke) mithyāvādī mane kare nā, varaṃ jālimarā āllāhara āẏātake asvīkāra kare.
6:33.latin_ascii: avasyai ami jani ye, tara ya vale nisciyai ta tomake kasta deya; kintu tara tomake to (antara theke) mithyavadi mane kare na, varam jalimara allahara ayatake asvikara kare.

6:34.latin_iast: tomāra pūrveo aneka rāsūlake avaśyai mithyā pratipanna karā haẏechila; kintu tāderake mithyā pratipanna karā o kaṣṭa deẏā sattveo tārā dhairya dhāraṇa karechila ye paryanta nā āmāra sāhāyya tādera nikaṭa eseche. āllāhara ādeśa keu parivartana karate pāre nā, rāsūlagaṇera samvandhe kichu saṃvāda to tomāra nikaṭa esechei.
6:34.latin_ascii: tomara purveo aneka rasulake avasyai mithya pratipanna kara hayechila; kintu taderake mithya pratipanna kara o kasta deya sattveo tara dhairya dharana karechila ye paryanta na amara sahayya tadera nikata eseche. allahara adesa keu parivartana karate pare na, rasulaganera samvandhe kichu samvada to tomara nikata esechei.

6:35.latin_iast: yadi tādera mukha phiriẏe neẏā tomāra nikaṭa kaṣṭakara haẏa tave pārale bhūgarbhe sur̤aṅga athavā ākāśe sopāna anveṣaṇa kara evaṃ tādera nikaṭa kona nidarśana āna. āllāha icchā karale tādera sakalake avaśyai sat pathe ekatra karatena. sutarāṃ tumi murkhadera antarbhukta haẏo nā.
6:35.latin_ascii: yadi tadera mukha phiriye neya tomara nikata kastakara haya tave parale bhugarbhe suranga athava akase sopana anvesana kara evam tadera nikata kona nidarsana ana. allaha iccha karale tadera sakalake avasyai sat pathe ekatra karatena. sutaram tumi murkhadera antarbhukta hayo na.

6:36.latin_iast: yārā śravaṇa kare śudhu tārāi ḍāke sār̤ā deẏa. āra mṛtake āllāha punarjīvita karavena; ataḥpara tā~ra dikei tāderake phiriẏe deẏā have.
6:36.latin_ascii: yara sravana kare sudhu tarai dake sara deya. ara mrtake allaha punarjivita karavena; atahpara ta~ra dikei taderake phiriye deya have.

6:37.latin_iast: tārā vale, ‘tāra pratipālakera pakṣa hate tāra nikaṭa kona nidarśana nāyila haẏa nā kena?’ vala: avaśyai āllāha nidarśana nāyila karate sakṣama, kintu tādera adhikāṃśai jāne nā.
6:37.latin_ascii: tara vale, ‘tara pratipalakera paksa hate tara nikata kona nidarsana nayila haya na kenay’ vala: avasyai allaha nidarsana nayila karate saksama, kintu tadera adhikamsai jane na.

6:38.latin_iast: bhū-pṛṣṭhe vicaraṇaśīla jīva evaṃ ubhaẏa ḍānāra sāhāyye yata uḍḍaẏanaśīla pākhī āche savai tomādera mata ekaṭi jāti. kitāve (lāohe māhaphūje) kona kichui āmi vāda deini. ataḥpara svīẏa pratipālakera dike tāderake ekatra karā have.
6:38.latin_ascii: bhu-prsthe vicaranasila jiva evam ubhaya danara sahayye yata uddayanasila pakhi ache savai tomadera mata ekati jati. kitave (laohe mahaphuje) kona kichui ami vada deini. atahpara sviya pratipalakera dike taderake ekatra kara have.

6:39.latin_iast: yārā āmāra āẏātasamūhake asvīkāra kare tārā vadhira o vovā, tārā andhakāre raẏeche. yāke icchā āllāha vipathagāmī karena evaṃ yāke icchā tini sarala pathe sthāpana karena.
6:39.latin_ascii: yara amara ayatasamuhake asvikara kare tara vadhira o vova, tara andhakare rayeche. yake iccha allaha vipathagami karena evam yake iccha tini sarala pathe sthapana karena.

6:40.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā bheve dekha ye, yadi āllāhara śāsti tomādera opara āse athavā tomādera nikaṭa kiẏāmata upasthita haẏa tomarā ki āllāha vyatīta anya kāuke ḍākave, yadi tomarā satyavādī hao?
6:40.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara bheve dekha ye, yadi allahara sasti tomadera opara ase athava tomadera nikata kiyamata upasthita haya tomara ki allaha vyatita anya kauke dakave, yadi tomara satyavadi haoy

6:41.latin_iast: varaṃ, tomarā śudhu tā~kei ḍākave, tomarā ye duḥkha (lāghavera) janya tāke ḍākacha tini icchā karale tomādera se duḥkha dūra karavena evaṃ yāke tomarā tā~ra śarīka karate tā tomarā bhule yāve.
6:41.latin_ascii: varam, tomara sudhu ta~kei dakave, tomara ye duhkha (laghavera) janya take dakacha tini iccha karale tomadera se duhkha dura karavena evam yake tomara ta~ra sarika karate ta tomara bhule yave.

6:42.latin_iast: tomāra pūrveo āmi vahu jātira nikaṭa rāsūla preraṇa karechi; ataḥpara tāderake arthasaṃkaṭa o duḥkha-kaṣṭa dvārā pākar̤āo karechi, yāte tārā vinīta haẏa.
6:42.latin_ascii: tomara purveo ami vahu jatira nikata rasula prerana karechi; atahpara taderake arthasamkata o duhkha-kasta dvara pakarao karechi, yate tara vinita haya.

6:43.latin_iast: āmāra śāsti yakhana tādera opara āsala takhana tārā kena vinīta hala nā? adhikantu tādera hṛdaẏa kaṭhina haẏe gela evaṃ tārā yā karachila śaẏatāna tā tādera dṛṣṭite śobhanīẏa karechila.
6:43.latin_ascii: amara sasti yakhana tadera opara asala takhana tara kena vinita hala nay adhikantu tadera hrdaya kathina haye gela evam tara ya karachila sayatana ta tadera drstite sobhaniya karechila.

6:44.latin_iast: tāderake ye upadeśa deẏā haẏechila tārā yakhana tā vismṛta hala takhana āmi tādera janya samasta kichura (neẏāmatera) dvāra unmukta kare dilāma; aveśeṣe tāderake yā deẏā hala evaṃ tārā tāte ullasita hala takhana akasmāt tāderake pākar̤āo karalāma; phale takhani tārā nirāśa hala.
6:44.latin_ascii: taderake ye upadesa deya hayechila tara yakhana ta vismrta hala takhana ami tadera janya samasta kichura (neyamatera) dvara unmukta kare dilama; avesese taderake ya deya hala evam tara tate ullasita hala takhana akasmat taderake pakarao karalama; phale takhani tara nirasa hala.

6:45.latin_iast: ataḥpara jālima sampradāẏera mūloccheda karā hala evaṃ samasta praśaṃsā ekamātra āllāhara janya yini jagatasamūhera pratipālaka.
6:45.latin_ascii: atahpara jalima sampradayera muloccheda kara hala evam samasta prasamsa ekamatra allahara janya yini jagatasamuhera pratipalaka.

6:46.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā ki bheve dekhecha? āllāha yadi tomādera śravaṇaśakti o dṛṣṭiśakti ker̤e nena evaṃ tomādera hṛdaẏe mohara mere dena tave āllāha vyatīta kon ilāha āche, ye tomāderake egulo phiriẏe deve? dekha, āmi kirūpe āẏātasamūha viśadabhāve varṇanā kari; etadasattveo tārā mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
6:46.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara ki bheve dekhechay allaha yadi tomadera sravanasakti o drstisakti kere nena evam tomadera hrdaye mohara mere dena tave allaha vyatita kon ilaha ache, ye tomaderake egulo phiriye devey dekha, ami kirupe ayatasamuha visadabhave varnana kari; etadasattveo tara mukha phiriye neya.

6:47.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā ki bheve dekhecha, āllāhara śāsti akasmāt athavā prakāśye tomādera opara āsale jālima sampradāẏa vyatīta āra keu dhvaṃsa have ki?
6:47.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara ki bheve dekhecha, allahara sasti akasmat athava prakasye tomadera opara asale jalima sampradaya vyatita ara keu dhvamsa have kiy

6:48.latin_iast: āmi rāsūlagaṇake to śudhu susaṃvādavāhī o satarkakārīrūpei preraṇa kari. keu īmāna ānale o nijake saṃśodhana karale tāra kona bhaẏa nei evaṃ se duḥkhitao have nā.
6:48.latin_ascii: ami rasulaganake to sudhu susamvadavahi o satarkakarirupei prerana kari. keu imana anale o nijake samsodhana karale tara kona bhaya nei evam se duhkhitao have na.

6:49.latin_iast: yārā āmāra nidarśanasamūhake mithyā valeche satya tyāgera kāraṇe tādera opara śāsti āsave.
6:49.latin_ascii: yara amara nidarsanasamuhake mithya valeche satya tyagera karane tadera opara sasti asave.

6:50.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmi tomāderake eṭā vali nā ye, āmāra nikaṭa āllāhara dhanabhāṇḍāra āche, gāẏeva samvandheo āmi jāni nā; evaṃ tomāderake eṭāo vali nā ye, āmi phereśatā, āmāra prati yā oẏāhī haẏa āmi śudhu tārai anusaraṇa kari. vala: ‘andha o cakṣuṣmāna ki samāna? tomarā ki cintā kare dekha nā?
6:50.latin_ascii: vala: ‘ami tomaderake eta vali na ye, amara nikata allahara dhanabhandara ache, gayeva samvandheo ami jani na; evam tomaderake etao vali na ye, ami pheresata, amara prati ya oyahi haya ami sudhu tarai anusarana kari. vala: ‘andha o caksusmana ki samanay tomara ki cinta kare dekha nay

6:51.latin_iast: tumi eṭā (kuraāna) dvārā tāderake satarka kare dāo yārā bhaẏa kare ye, tāderake tādera pratipālakera nikaṭa samaveta karā have emana avasthāẏa ye, tini vyatīta tādera kona abhibhāvaka o supāriśakārī thākave nā; haẏata tārā sāvadhāna have.
6:51.latin_ascii: tumi eta (kuraana) dvara taderake satarka kare dao yara bhaya kare ye, taderake tadera pratipalakera nikata samaveta kara have emana avasthaya ye, tini vyatita tadera kona abhibhavaka o suparisakari thakave na; hayata tara savadhana have.

6:52.latin_iast: yārā tādera pratipālakake sakāle o sandhyāẏa tā~ra santuṣṭi lābhera uddeśye ḍāke tāderake tumi vitār̤ita kara nā. tādera karmera javāvadihira dāẏitva tomāra naẏa evaṃ tomārao kona karmera javāvadihira dāẏitva tādera naẏa ye, tumi tāderake vitār̤ita karave; karale tumi jālimadera antarbhukta have.
6:52.latin_ascii: yara tadera pratipalakake sakale o sandhyaya ta~ra santusti labhera uddesye dake taderake tumi vitarita kara na. tadera karmera javavadihira dayitva tomara naya evam tomarao kona karmera javavadihira dayitva tadera naya ye, tumi taderake vitarita karave; karale tumi jalimadera antarbhukta have.

6:53.latin_iast: āmi ebhāve tādera ekadalake anyadala dvārā parīkṣā karechi yena tārā vale, ‘āmādera madhye ki edera pratii āllāha anugraha karalena? āllāha ki kṛtajña lokedera samvandhe saviśeṣa avahita nana?
6:53.latin_ascii: ami ebhave tadera ekadalake anyadala dvara pariksa karechi yena tara vale, ‘amadera madhye ki edera pratii allaha anugraha karalenay allaha ki krtajna lokedera samvandhe savisesa avahita nanay

6:54.latin_iast: yārā āmāra āẏātasamūhe īmāna āne tārā yakhana tomāra nikaṭa āse takhana tāderake tumi vala: ‘tomādera prati śānti varṣita hoka’, tomādera pratipālaka daẏā karā nijera janya āvaśyaka kare niẏechena. (āra tā hacche) tomādera madhye keu ajñatāvaśata yadi manda kāja kare, ataḥpara tāovāha kare evaṃ saṃśodhana kare neẏa tave to āllāha kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
6:54.latin_ascii: yara amara ayatasamuhe imana ane tara yakhana tomara nikata ase takhana taderake tumi vala: ‘tomadera prati santi varsita hoka’, tomadera pratipalaka daya kara nijera janya avasyaka kare niyechena. (ara ta hacche) tomadera madhye keu ajnatavasata yadi manda kaja kare, atahpara taovaha kare evam samsodhana kare neya tave to allaha ksamasila, parama dayalu.

6:55.latin_iast: ebhāve āmi āẏātasamūha viśadabhāve varṇanā kari; āra ete aparādhīdera patha spaṣṭabhāve prakāśa pāẏa.
6:55.latin_ascii: ebhave ami ayatasamuha visadabhave varnana kari; ara ete aparadhidera patha spastabhave prakasa paya.

6:56.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā āllāha vyatīta yāderake āhvāna kara tādera ‘ivādata karate āmāke niṣedha karā haẏeche. vala: ‘āmi tomādera kheẏāla-khuśīra anusaraṇa kari nā; karale āmi vipathagāmī hava evaṃ sat pathaprāptadera antarbhukta thākava nā.’
6:56.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara allaha vyatita yaderake ahvana kara tadera ‘ivadata karate amake nisedha kara hayeche. vala: ‘ami tomadera kheyala-khusira anusarana kari na; karale ami vipathagami hava evam sat pathapraptadera antarbhukta thakava na.’

6:57.latin_iast: vala: ‘avaśyai āmi āmāra pratipālakera spaṣṭa pramāṇera opara pratiṣṭhita; athaca tomarā tāke pratyākhyāna karecha. tomarā yā satvara cāicha tā āmāra nikaṭa nei. vidhāna deẏāra adhikāra ekamātra āllāharai, tini satya vivṛta karena evaṃ phaẏasālākārīdera madhye tinii śreṣṭha.’
6:57.latin_ascii: vala: ‘avasyai ami amara pratipalakera spasta pramanera opara pratisthita; athaca tomara take pratyakhyana karecha. tomara ya satvara caicha ta amara nikata nei. vidhana deyara adhikara ekamatra allaharai, tini satya vivrta karena evam phayasalakaridera madhye tinii srestha.’

6:58.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā yā satvara cāicha tā yadi āmāra nikaṭa thākata tave āmāra o tomādera madhyakāra vyāpāre to phāẏasālāi haẏe yete evaṃ āllāha jālimadera samvandhe saviśeṣa avahita.’
6:58.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara ya satvara caicha ta yadi amara nikata thakata tave amara o tomadera madhyakara vyapare to phayasalai haye yete evam allaha jalimadera samvandhe savisesa avahita.’

6:59.latin_iast: gāẏevera sakala cāvikāṭhi tā~rai nikaṭa raẏeche, tini vyatīta anya keu tā jāne nā. jale o sthale yā kichu āche tā tinii avagata, tā~ra ajñātasāre ekaṭi pātāo par̤e nā. māṭira andhakāre emana kona śasyakaṇāo aṅkurita haẏa nā athavā rasayukta kiṃvā śuṣka emana kona vastu nei yā suspaṣṭa kitāve (lāohe māhaphūje) nei.
6:59.latin_ascii: gayevera sakala cavikathi ta~rai nikata rayeche, tini vyatita anya keu ta jane na. jale o sthale ya kichu ache ta tinii avagata, ta~ra ajnatasare ekati patao pare na. matira andhakare emana kona sasyakanao ankurita haya na athava rasayukta kimva suska emana kona vastu nei ya suspasta kitave (laohe mahaphuje) nei.

6:60.latin_iast: tinii rāte tomādera mṛtyu (ghuma) dena evaṃ divase tomarā yā kara tā tini jānena. ataḥpara divase tomāderake tini punarjāgarita karena yāte nirdhārita kāla pūrṇa haẏa. ataḥpara tā~ra dikei tomādera pratyāvartana. anantara tomarā yā kara se samvandhe tomāderake tini avahita karavena.
6:60.latin_ascii: tinii rate tomadera mrtyu (ghuma) dena evam divase tomara ya kara ta tini janena. atahpara divase tomaderake tini punarjagarita karena yate nirdharita kala purna haya. atahpara ta~ra dikei tomadera pratyavartana. anantara tomara ya kara se samvandhe tomaderake tini avahita karavena.

6:61.latin_iast: tinii svīẏa vāndādera opara parākramaśālī evaṃ tinii tomādera rakṣaka (kirāmāna kātevina) preraṇa karena. avaśeṣe yakhana tomādera kāro mṛtyura samaẏa upasthita haẏa takhana āmāra preritarā tāra mṛtyu ghaṭāẏa evaṃ tārā kona tra“ṭi kare nā.
6:61.latin_ascii: tinii sviya vandadera opara parakramasali evam tinii tomadera raksaka (kiramana katevina) prerana karena. avasese yakhana tomadera karo mrtyura samaya upasthita haya takhana amara preritara tara mrtyu ghataya evam tara kona tra“ti kare na.

6:62.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā tādera prakṛta pratipālaka āllāhara dike phirave. dekha, kartṛtva to tā~rai evaṃ hisāva grahaṇe tinii sarvāpekṣā tatpara.
6:62.latin_ascii: atahpara tara tadera prakrta pratipalaka allahara dike phirave. dekha, kartrtva to ta~rai evam hisava grahane tinii sarvapeksa tatpara.

6:63.latin_iast: vala: sthala o jalera gabhīra andhakāra theke tomāderake ke nājāta dena? yakhana tomarā tā~ke vinītabhāve o gopane āhvāna kara āmāderake e theke nājāta dile āmarā avaśyai kṛtajñadera antarbhukta hava.’
6:63.latin_ascii: vala: sthala o jalera gabhira andhakara theke tomaderake ke najata denay yakhana tomara ta~ke vinitabhave o gopane ahvana kara amaderake e theke najata dile amara avasyai krtajnadera antarbhukta hava.’

6:64.latin_iast: vala: āllāhai tomāderake tā hate evaṃ samasta duḥkha-kaṣṭa hate nājāta dena. etadasattveo tomarā tā~ra sāthe śarīka kara.’
6:64.latin_ascii: vala: allahai tomaderake ta hate evam samasta duhkha-kasta hate najata dena. etadasattveo tomara ta~ra sathe sarika kara.’

6:65.latin_iast: vala:‘tini tomādera ūrdhvadeśa athavā pādadeśa hate śāsti preraṇa karate, athavā tomāderake vibhinna dale vibhakta karate athavā eka dalake apara dalera hiṃsā-hānāhānira svāda grahaṇa karāte sakṣama.’ dekha, āmi kirūpe āẏātasamūha varṇanā kari yāte tārā anudhāvana kare.
6:65.latin_ascii: vala:‘tini tomadera urdhvadesa athava padadesa hate sasti prerana karate, athava tomaderake vibhinna dale vibhakta karate athava eka dalake apara dalera himsa-hanahanira svada grahana karate saksama.’ dekha, ami kirupe ayatasamuha varnana kari yate tara anudhavana kare.

6:66.latin_iast: tomāra sampradāẏa to tāke (kuraānake) mithyā valeche athaca tā satya. vala: ‘āmi tomādera kāryanirvāhaka nai.’
6:66.latin_ascii: tomara sampradaya to take (kuraanake) mithya valeche athaca ta satya. vala: ‘ami tomadera karyanirvahaka nai.’

6:67.latin_iast: pratyeka vārtāra janya nirdhārita kāla raẏeche evaṃ śīghrai tomarā avahita have.
6:67.latin_ascii: pratyeka vartara janya nirdharita kala rayeche evam sighrai tomara avahita have.

6:68.latin_iast: tumi yakhana dekha, tārā āmāra āẏātasamūhake niẏe upahāsamūlaka ālocanāẏa magna takhana tumi tādera hate sare par̤a, ye paryanta nā tārā anya prasaṅge ālocanā kare evaṃ śaẏatāna yadi tomāke (e nirdeśa) bhuliẏe deẏa tave smaraṇa havāra pare jālima sampradāẏera sāthe āra vase thākave nā.
6:68.latin_ascii: tumi yakhana dekha, tara amara ayatasamuhake niye upahasamulaka alocanaya magna takhana tumi tadera hate sare para, ye paryanta na tara anya prasange alocana kare evam sayatana yadi tomake (e nirdesa) bhuliye deya tave smarana havara pare jalima sampradayera sathe ara vase thakave na.

6:69.latin_iast: tādera kona karmera javāvadihira dāẏitva muttākidera opara naẏa. tave upadeśa deẏā tādera kartavya yāte tārāo tākvaoẏā avalamvana kare.
6:69.latin_ascii: tadera kona karmera javavadihira dayitva muttakidera opara naya. tave upadesa deya tadera kartavya yate tarao takvaoya avalamvana kare.

6:70.latin_iast: yārā tādera dīnake khela-tāmāśārūpe grahaṇa kare evaṃ pārthiva jīvana yāderake pratārita kareche tumi tādera saṅga varjana kara evaṃ eṭā dvārā tāderake upadeśa dāo, yāte keu nija kṛtakarmera janya dhvaṃsa nā haẏa, yakhana āllāha vyatīta tāra kona abhibhāvaka o supāriśakārī thākave nā evaṃ (muktira) vinimaẏe savakichu dileo tā gṛhīta have nā. erāi nijedera kṛtakarmera janya dhvaṃsa have; kupharīra kāraṇe edera janya raẏeche phuṭanta pānīẏa o yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
6:70.latin_ascii: yara tadera dinake khela-tamasarupe grahana kare evam parthiva jivana yaderake pratarita kareche tumi tadera sanga varjana kara evam eta dvara taderake upadesa dao, yate keu nija krtakarmera janya dhvamsa na haya, yakhana allaha vyatita tara kona abhibhavaka o suparisakari thakave na evam (muktira) vinimaye savakichu dileo ta grhita have na. erai nijedera krtakarmera janya dhvamsa have; kupharira karane edera janya rayeche phutanta paniya o yantranadayaka sasti.

6:71.latin_iast: vala: ‘āllāha vyatīta āmarā ki emana kichuke ḍākava yā āmādera kona upakāra kiṃvā apakāra karate pāre nā? āllāha āmāderake sat patha pradarśanera para āmarā ki sei vyaktira nyāẏa pūrvāvasthāẏa phire yāva yāke śaẏatāna duniẏāẏa patha bhuliẏe haẏarāna kareche. yadio tāra sahacaragaṇa tāke ṭhika pathe āhvāna kare vale, ‘āmādera kāche āsa? vala: ‘āllāhara hidāẏātai hacche satyikāra hidāẏāta evaṃ āmarā ādiṣṭa haẏechi jagatasamūhera pratipālakera nikaṭa ātmasamarpaṇa karate.
6:71.latin_ascii: vala: ‘allaha vyatita amara ki emana kichuke dakava ya amadera kona upakara kimva apakara karate pare nay allaha amaderake sat patha pradarsanera para amara ki sei vyaktira nyaya purvavasthaya phire yava yake sayatana duniyaya patha bhuliye hayarana kareche. yadio tara sahacaragana take thika pathe ahvana kare vale, ‘amadera kache asay vala: ‘allahara hidayatai hacche satyikara hidayata evam amara adista hayechi jagatasamuhera pratipalakera nikata atmasamarpana karate.

6:72.latin_iast: evaṃ sālāta kāẏema karate o tā~ke bhaẏa karate; āra tā~rai nikaṭa tomāderake samaveta karā have.’
6:72.latin_ascii: evam salata kayema karate o ta~ke bhaya karate; ara ta~rai nikata tomaderake samaveta kara have.’

6:73.latin_iast: tinii yathāvidhi ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena. yakhana tini valena, ‘hao’, takhanai haẏe yāẏa. tā~ra kathāi satya. yedina śiṅgāẏa phu~tkāra deẏā have sedinakāra kartṛtva to tā~rai. adṛśya o dṛśya savakichu samvandhe tini parijñāta; āra tinii prajñāmaẏa, saviśeṣa avahita.
6:73.latin_ascii: tinii yathavidhi akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena. yakhana tini valena, ‘hao’, takhanai haye yaya. ta~ra kathai satya. yedina singaya phu~tkara deya have sedinakara kartrtva to ta~rai. adrsya o drsya savakichu samvandhe tini parijnata; ara tinii prajnamaya, savisesa avahita.

6:74.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana ivarāhīma tāra pitā āyarake valechila, ‘tumi ki mūrtike ilāharūpe grahaṇa karecha? āmi to tomāke o tomāra sampradāẏake spaṣṭa bhrāntite dekhachi.’
6:74.latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana ivarahima tara pita ayarake valechila, ‘tumi ki murtike ilaharupe grahana karechay ami to tomake o tomara sampradayake spasta bhrantite dekhachi.’

6:75.latin_iast: ebhāve āmi ivarāhīmake ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra paricālanā vyavasthā dekhāi, yāte se niścita viśvāsīdera antarbhukta haẏa.
6:75.latin_ascii: ebhave ami ivarahimake akasamandali o prthivira paricalana vyavastha dekhai, yate se niscita visvasidera antarbhukta haya.

6:76.latin_iast: ataḥpara rātera andhakāra yakhana tāke ācchanna kare takhana se nakṣatra dekhe valala: ‘eṭā āmāra pratipālaka.’ ataḥpara yakhana tā astamita hala takhana se valala: ‘yā astamita haẏa tā āmi pachanda kari nā.’
6:76.latin_ascii: atahpara ratera andhakara yakhana take acchanna kare takhana se naksatra dekhe valala: ‘eta amara pratipalaka.’ atahpara yakhana ta astamita hala takhana se valala: ‘ya astamita haya ta ami pachanda kari na.’

6:77.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana se cā~dake ujjvalarūpe udaẏa hate dekhala takhana valala: ‘eṭā āmāra pratipālaka.’ yakhana tāo astamita hala takhana valala: ‘āmāke āmāra pratipālaka sat patha pradarśana nā karale āmi avaśyai pathabhraṣṭadera antarbhukta hava.’
6:77.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana se ca~dake ujjvalarupe udaya hate dekhala takhana valala: ‘eta amara pratipalaka.’ yakhana tao astamita hala takhana valala: ‘amake amara pratipalaka sat patha pradarsana na karale ami avasyai pathabhrastadera antarbhukta hava.’

6:78.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana se sūryake dīptimaẏarūpe udaẏa hate dekhala takhana valala: ‘eṭā āmāra pratipālaka, eṭā savaceẏe var̤a.’ yakhana eṭāo astamita hala, takhana se valala: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā yāke pratipālakera sāthe śarīka kara tāra sāthe āmāra kona samparka nei.
6:78.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana se suryake diptimayarupe udaya hate dekhala takhana valala: ‘eta amara pratipalaka, eta savaceye vara.’ yakhana etao astamita hala, takhana se valala: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara yake pratipalakera sathe sarika kara tara sathe amara kona samparka nei.

6:79.latin_iast: ‘āmi ekaniṣṭhabhāve tā~ra dike mukha phirācchi yini ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ āmi muśarikadera antarbhukta nai.’
6:79.latin_ascii: ‘ami ekanisthabhave ta~ra dike mukha phiracchi yini akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena evam ami musarikadera antarbhukta nai.’

6:80.latin_iast: tāra sampradāẏa tāra sāthe vitarke lipta hala. se valala: ‘tomarā ki āllāha samvandhe āmāra sāthe tarke lipta have? tini to āmāke sat pathe paricālita karechena. āmāra pratipālaka icchā nā karale tomarā yāke tā~ra śarīka kara tāke āmi bhaẏa kari nā, savakichui āmāra pratipālakera jñānāẏattva, tave ki tomarā anudhāvana karave nā?
6:80.latin_ascii: tara sampradaya tara sathe vitarke lipta hala. se valala: ‘tomara ki allaha samvandhe amara sathe tarke lipta havey tini to amake sat pathe paricalita karechena. amara pratipalaka iccha na karale tomara yake ta~ra sarika kara take ami bhaya kari na, savakichui amara pratipalakera jnanayattva, tave ki tomara anudhavana karave nay

6:81.latin_iast: tomarā yāke āllāhara sāthe śarīka kara āmi tāke kibhāve bhaẏa karava? athaca tomarā āllāhara sāthe śarīka karate bhaẏa kara nā, ye viṣaẏe tini tomāderake kona sanada denani. sutarāṃ yadi tomarā jāna tave vala: du’ dalera madhye kona dala nirāpattā lābhera veśi hakadāra.’
6:81.latin_ascii: tomara yake allahara sathe sarika kara ami take kibhave bhaya karavay athaca tomara allahara sathe sarika karate bhaya kara na, ye visaye tini tomaderake kona sanada denani. sutaram yadi tomara jana tave vala: du’ dalera madhye kona dala nirapatta labhera vesi hakadara.’

6:82.latin_iast: yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ tādera īmānake juluma (śirka) dvārā kaluṣita kareni, nirāpattā tāderai janya evaṃ tārāi sat pathaprāpta.
6:82.latin_ascii: yara imana eneche evam tadera imanake juluma (sirka) dvara kalusita kareni, nirapatta taderai janya evam tarai sat pathaprapta.

6:83.latin_iast: āra eṭā āmāra yukti-pramāṇa yā ivarāhīmake tāra sampradāẏera mokāvelāẏa diẏechilāma; yāke icchā āmi maryādāẏa unnīta kari. niścaẏai tomāra pratipālaka prajñāmaẏa, sarvajña.
6:83.latin_ascii: ara eta amara yukti-pramana ya ivarahimake tara sampradayera mokavelaya diyechilama; yake iccha ami maryadaya unnita kari. niscayai tomara pratipalaka prajnamaya, sarvajna.

6:84.latin_iast: āra āmi tāke (ivarāhīmake) dāna karechilāma isahāka o iẏā‘kūva, edera pratyekake sat pathe paricālita karechilāma; pūrve nūhakeo sat pathe paricālita karechilāma evaṃ tāra vaṃśadhara dāūda, sulāimāna o āiẏūva, iusupha, mūsā o hārūnakeo. āra ebhāvei sat karmaśīladerake puraskṛta kari;
6:84.latin_ascii: ara ami take (ivarahimake) dana karechilama isahaka o iya‘kuva, edera pratyekake sat pathe paricalita karechilama; purve nuhakeo sat pathe paricalita karechilama evam tara vamsadhara dauda, sulaimana o aiyuva, iusupha, musa o harunakeo. ara ebhavei sat karmasiladerake puraskrta kari;

6:85.latin_iast: evaṃ yākāriẏā, iẏāhaiẏā, ‘īsā evaṃ iliẏāsakeo sat pathe paricālita karechilāma. erā sakale nekakāradera antarbhukta;
6:85.latin_ascii: evam yakariya, iyahaiya, ‘isa evam iliyasakeo sat pathe paricalita karechilama. era sakale nekakaradera antarbhukta;

6:86.latin_iast: ārao sat pathe paricālita karechilāma isamā‘īla, āla-iẏāsā‘, iunusa o lūtake; evaṃ pratyekake śreṣṭhatva dāna karechilāma viśvajagatera opara.
6:86.latin_ascii: arao sat pathe paricalita karechilama isama‘ila, ala-iyasa‘, iunusa o lutake; evam pratyekake sresthatva dana karechilama visvajagatera opara.

6:87.latin_iast: edera pitṛpuruṣa, vaṃśadhara o bhrātṛvṛndera katakake (hidāẏāta o tāophīka diẏechi). āmi tāderake manonīta karechilāma evaṃ sarala pathe paricālita karechilāma.
6:87.latin_ascii: edera pitrpurusa, vamsadhara o bhratrvrndera katakake (hidayata o taophika diyechi). ami taderake manonita karechilama evam sarala pathe paricalita karechilama.

6:88.latin_iast: eṭā āllāhara hidāẏāta, svīẏa vāndādera madhye yāke icchā tini hidāẏāta dvārā sat pathe paricālita karena. tārā yadi śirka karata tave tādera kṛtakarma niṣphala hata.
6:88.latin_ascii: eta allahara hidayata, sviya vandadera madhye yake iccha tini hidayata dvara sat pathe paricalita karena. tara yadi sirka karata tave tadera krtakarma nisphala hata.

6:89.latin_iast: āmi tāderakei kitāva, kartṛtva o navuoẏāta dāna karechi, ataḥpara yadi erā eguloke pratyākhyānao kare tave āmi to emana eka sampradāẏera prati egulora bhāra arpaṇa karechi yārā egulo pratyākhyāna karave nā.
6:89.latin_ascii: ami taderakei kitava, kartrtva o navuoyata dana karechi, atahpara yadi era eguloke pratyakhyanao kare tave ami to emana eka sampradayera prati egulora bhara arpana karechi yara egulo pratyakhyana karave na.

6:90.latin_iast: tāderake āllāha sat pathe paricālita karechena, sutarāṃ tumi tādera hidāẏātera anusaraṇa kara. vala: ‘e janya āmi tomādera nikaṭa pāriśramika cāi nā, eṭā to śudhu viśvajagatera janya upadeśa.’
6:90.latin_ascii: taderake allaha sat pathe paricalita karechena, sutaram tumi tadera hidayatera anusarana kara. vala: ‘e janya ami tomadera nikata parisramika cai na, eta to sudhu visvajagatera janya upadesa.’

6:91.latin_iast: tārā āllāhake yathārtha maryādā deẏani yakhana tārā valala: ‘āllāha mānuṣera nikaṭa kichui nāyila karenani.’ vala: ‘tāhale ke nāyila karechena mūsāra ānita kitāva yā mānuṣera janya ālo o pathanirdeśa chila, tā tomarā vibhinna pṛṣṭhāẏa lipivaddha kare kichu prakāśa kara evaṃ yāra adhikāṃśai gopana rākha, evaṃ yā tomādera pitṛpuruṣagaṇa o tomarā jānate nā tāo śikṣā deẏā haẏechila? vala: ‘āllāhai’ (nāyila karechena); ataḥpara tāderake tādera nirarthaka ālocanāra khelāẏa magna hate dāo.
6:91.latin_ascii: tara allahake yathartha maryada deyani yakhana tara valala: ‘allaha manusera nikata kichui nayila karenani.’ vala: ‘tahale ke nayila karechena musara anita kitava ya manusera janya alo o pathanirdesa chila, ta tomara vibhinna prsthaya lipivaddha kare kichu prakasa kara evam yara adhikamsai gopana rakha, evam ya tomadera pitrpurusagana o tomara janate na tao siksa deya hayechilay vala: ‘allahai’ (nayila karechena); atahpara taderake tadera nirarthaka alocanara khelaya magna hate dao.

6:92.latin_iast: āmi e varakatamaẏa kitāva (kuraāna) nāyila karechi yā tāra pūrvekāra kitāvera samarthaka evaṃ yāra dvārā tumi makkā o tāra catuṣpārśvera lokederake satarka karate pāra. yārā ākhirāte viśvāsa kare tārāi tā~ra (kitāvera) prati viśvāsa kare evaṃ tārā tādera sālātera hephāyata kare.
6:92.latin_ascii: ami e varakatamaya kitava (kuraana) nayila karechi ya tara purvekara kitavera samarthaka evam yara dvara tumi makka o tara catusparsvera lokederake satarka karate para. yara akhirate visvasa kare tarai ta~ra (kitavera) prati visvasa kare evam tara tadera salatera hephayata kare.

6:93.latin_iast: tāra ceẏe var̤a jālima āra ke ye āllāhara samvandhe mithyā racanā kare kiṃvā vale, ‘āmāra nikaṭa oẏāhī haẏa’, yadio tāra prati kichui nāyila haẏa nā evaṃ ye vale, ‘āllāha yā nāyila karechena āmio tāra anurūpa nāyila karava? yadi tumi dekhate pete yakhana jālimagaṇa mṛtyura yantraṇāẏa chaṭaphaṭa kare. āra yakhana phiriśatāgaṇa hāta vār̤iẏe vale, ‘tomādera prāṇa vera kara. tomarā āllāhara samvandhe anyāẏa valate o tā~ra nidarśana samvandhe auddhatya prakāśa karate, sejanya āja tomādera apamānajanaka śāsti deẏā have.’
6:93.latin_ascii: tara ceye vara jalima ara ke ye allahara samvandhe mithya racana kare kimva vale, ‘amara nikata oyahi haya’, yadio tara prati kichui nayila haya na evam ye vale, ‘allaha ya nayila karechena amio tara anurupa nayila karavay yadi tumi dekhate pete yakhana jalimagana mrtyura yantranaya chataphata kare. ara yakhana phirisatagana hata variye vale, ‘tomadera prana vera kara. tomara allahara samvandhe anyaya valate o ta~ra nidarsana samvandhe auddhatya prakasa karate, sejanya aja tomadera apamanajanaka sasti deya have.’

6:94.latin_iast: tomarā avaśyai āmāra nikaṭa niḥsaṅga avasthāẏa esecha yemana āmi prathame tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechilāma, tomāderake yā diẏechilāma tā tomarā pechane phele esecha, tomarā yāderake tomādera vyāpāre śarīka mane karate tomādera sei supāriśakārigaṇakeo tomādera sāthe dekhachi nā; tomādera mājhera samparka avaśyai chinna haẏeche evaṃ tomarā yā dhāraṇā karechile tāo niṣphala haẏeche.
6:94.latin_ascii: tomara avasyai amara nikata nihsanga avasthaya esecha yemana ami prathame tomaderake srsti karechilama, tomaderake ya diyechilama ta tomara pechane phele esecha, tomara yaderake tomadera vyapare sarika mane karate tomadera sei suparisakariganakeo tomadera sathe dekhachi na; tomadera majhera samparka avasyai chinna hayeche evam tomara ya dharana karechile tao nisphala hayeche.

6:95.latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha śasyavīja o ā~ṭi aṅkurita karena, tinii prāṇahīna hate jīvantake vera karena evaṃ jīvanta hate prāṇahīnake vera karena. tinii to āllāha, sutarāṃ tomarā kothāẏa phire yāve?
6:95.latin_ascii: niscayai allaha sasyavija o a~ti ankurita karena, tinii pranahina hate jivantake vera karena evam jivanta hate pranahinake vera karena. tinii to allaha, sutaram tomara kothaya phire yavey

6:96.latin_iast: tinii sakālake prakāśa karena, tinii viśrāmera janya rātake sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ gaṇanāra janya sūrya o cā~da sṛṣṭi karechena; esavai parākramaśālī sarvajñera nirūpaṇa.
6:96.latin_ascii: tinii sakalake prakasa karena, tinii visramera janya ratake srsti karechena evam gananara janya surya o ca~da srsti karechena; esavai parakramasali sarvajnera nirupana.

6:97.latin_iast: tinii tomādera janya nakṣatra sṛṣṭi karechena yena tāra dvārā sthalera o samudrera andhakāre tomarā patha pāo. jñānī sampradāẏera janya āmi to nidarśana viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi.
6:97.latin_ascii: tinii tomadera janya naksatra srsti karechena yena tara dvara sthalera o samudrera andhakare tomara patha pao. jnani sampradayera janya ami to nidarsana visadabhave varnana karechi.

6:98.latin_iast: tinii tomāderake ekai vyakti hate sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ pratyekera janya ekaṭi āvāsa sthala āche āra ekaṭi āche gacchita rākhāra jāẏagā. anudhāvanakārī sampradāẏera janya āmi to nidarśanasamūha viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi.
6:98.latin_ascii: tinii tomaderake ekai vyakti hate srsti karechena evam pratyekera janya ekati avasa sthala ache ara ekati ache gacchita rakhara jayaga. anudhavanakari sampradayera janya ami to nidarsanasamuha visadabhave varnana karechi.

6:99.latin_iast: tinii ākāśa hate pāni varṣaṇa karena, ataḥpara tā dvārā āmi sarvaprakāra udbhidera cārā udgama kari’ ataḥpara tā hate savuja pātā udgata kari, pare tā hate ghana sanniviṣṭa śasyadānā utpādana kari, āra khejura vṛkṣera māthā hate jhulanta kā~di nirgata kari āra āṅgurera vāgāna evaṃ yāẏatūna o ḍālima sṛṣṭi kari . erā eke anyera sadṛśa evaṃ asadṛśao. lakṣa kara tāra phalera prati yakhana tā phalavāna haẏa evaṃ tāra paripakkatā prāptira prati. mu’mina sampradāẏera janya tāte avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche.
6:99.latin_ascii: tinii akasa hate pani varsana karena, atahpara ta dvara ami sarvaprakara udbhidera cara udgama kari’ atahpara ta hate savuja pata udgata kari, pare ta hate ghana sannivista sasyadana utpadana kari, ara khejura vrksera matha hate jhulanta ka~di nirgata kari ara angurera vagana evam yayatuna o dalima srsti kari . era eke anyera sadrsa evam asadrsao. laksa kara tara phalera prati yakhana ta phalavana haya evam tara paripakkata praptira prati. mu’mina sampradayera janya tate avasyai nidarsana rayeche.

6:100.latin_iast: tārā jinake āllāhara sāthe śarīka kare, athaca tinii ederake sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tārā ajñatāvaśata āllāhara janya putra-kanyā āropa kare; tini pavitra- mahimānvita! evaṃ tārā yā vale tini tāra ūrdhve.
6:100.latin_ascii: tara jinake allahara sathe sarika kare, athaca tinii ederake srsti karechena evam tara ajnatavasata allahara janya putra-kanya aropa kare; tini pavitra- mahimanvita! evam tara ya vale tini tara urdhve.

6:101.latin_iast: tini āsamāna o jaminera sraṣṭā, tā~ra santāna have kirūpe? athaca tā~ra to kona strī nei. tinii to samasta kichu sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ pratyeka vastu samvandhe tinii saviśeṣa avahita.
6:101.latin_ascii: tini asamana o jaminera srasta, ta~ra santana have kirupey athaca ta~ra to kona stri nei. tinii to samasta kichu srsti karechena evam pratyeka vastu samvandhe tinii savisesa avahita.

6:102.latin_iast: tinii to āllāha; tomādera pratipālaka; tini vyatīta satyikārera kona ilāha nei. tinii savakichura sraṣṭā; sutarāṃ tomarā tā~rai ivādata kara; tini savakichura tattvāvadhāẏaka.
6:102.latin_ascii: tinii to allaha; tomadera pratipalaka; tini vyatita satyikarera kona ilaha nei. tinii savakichura srasta; sutaram tomara ta~rai ivadata kara; tini savakichura tattvavadhayaka.

6:103.latin_iast: kona dṛṣṭi tā~ke veṣṭana karate pārave nā kintu tini sakala dṛṣṭike veṣṭana kare āchena evaṃ tinii sūkṣmadarśī, sava jānaneoẏālā.
6:103.latin_ascii: kona drsti ta~ke vestana karate parave na kintu tini sakala drstike vestana kare achena evam tinii suksmadarsi, sava jananeoyala.

6:104.latin_iast: tomādera pratipālakera nikaṭa hate tomādera nikaṭa spaṣṭa pramāṇa avaśyai eseche. sutarāṃ keu tā dekhale tā dvārā se nijei lābhavāna have, āra keu nā dekhale tāte se nijei kṣatigrasta have. āmi tomādera saṃrakṣaka nai.
6:104.latin_ascii: tomadera pratipalakera nikata hate tomadera nikata spasta pramana avasyai eseche. sutaram keu ta dekhale ta dvara se nijei labhavana have, ara keu na dekhale tate se nijei ksatigrasta have. ami tomadera samraksaka nai.

6:105.latin_iast: āmi ebhāve nidarśanāvalī vibhinna prakāre varṇanā kari. yāte, tārā vale, ‘tumi par̤e niẏecha?’ kintu āmi to suspaṣṭabhāve varṇanā kari jñānī sampradāẏera janya.
6:105.latin_ascii: ami ebhave nidarsanavali vibhinna prakare varnana kari. yate, tara vale, ‘tumi pare niyechay’ kintu ami to suspastabhave varnana kari jnani sampradayera janya.

6:106.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa hate tomāra prati yā oẏāhī karā haẏa tumi tārai anusaraṇa kara, tini vyatīta anya kona satyikāra ilāha nei evaṃ muśarikadera hate mukha phiriẏe nāo.
6:106.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalakera nikata hate tomara prati ya oyahi kara haya tumi tarai anusarana kara, tini vyatita anya kona satyikara ilaha nei evam musarikadera hate mukha phiriye nao.

6:107.latin_iast: āllāha yadi icchā karatena tave tārā śirka karata nā āra āmi tomāke tādera janya rakṣaka niyukta karini; āra tumi tādera abhibhāvakao nao.
6:107.latin_ascii: allaha yadi iccha karatena tave tara sirka karata na ara ami tomake tadera janya raksaka niyukta karini; ara tumi tadera abhibhavakao nao.

6:108.latin_iast: āllāhake cher̤e yāderake tārā ḍāke tāderake tomarā gāli dio nā. kenanā tārā sīmālaṅghana kare ajñatāvaśata āllāhakeo gāli deve; ebhāve āmi pratyeka jātira dṛṣṭite tādera kāryakalāpa śobhana karechi; ataḥpara tādera pratipālakera nikaṭai tādera pratyāvartana. ataḥpara tini tāderake tādera kṛtakārya samvandhe avahita karavena.
6:108.latin_ascii: allahake chere yaderake tara dake taderake tomara gali dio na. kenana tara simalanghana kare ajnatavasata allahakeo gali deve; ebhave ami pratyeka jatira drstite tadera karyakalapa sobhana karechi; atahpara tadera pratipalakera nikatai tadera pratyavartana. atahpara tini taderake tadera krtakarya samvandhe avahita karavena.

6:109.latin_iast: tārā āllāhara nāme kaṭhina śapatha kare vale, tādera nikaṭa yadi kona nidarśana āsata tave avaśyai tārā tāte īmāna ānata. vala: ‘nidarśana to (āse ekamātra) āllāhara pakṣa theke. tādera nikaṭa nidarśana āsaleo tārā ye īmāna ānave nā eṭā kibhāve tomādera vodhagamya karāna yāve?
6:109.latin_ascii: tara allahara name kathina sapatha kare vale, tadera nikata yadi kona nidarsana asata tave avasyai tara tate imana anata. vala: ‘nidarsana to (ase ekamatra) allahara paksa theke. tadera nikata nidarsana asaleo tara ye imana anave na eta kibhave tomadera vodhagamya karana yavey

6:110.latin_iast: tārā yemana prathamavāre tāte īmāna āneni āmio tādera manobhāvera o dṛṣṭibhaṅgira parivartana kare deva evaṃ tāderake tādera avādhyatāẏa udabhrāntera mata ghure ver̤āte deva.
6:110.latin_ascii: tara yemana prathamavare tate imana aneni amio tadera manobhavera o drstibhangira parivartana kare deva evam taderake tadera avadhyataya udabhrantera mata ghure verate deva.

6:111.latin_iast: āmi tādera nikaṭa phereśatā preraṇa karale evaṃ mṛtarā tādera sāthe kathā valale evaṃ sakala vastuke tādera sammukhe hājira karaleo yadi āllāha icchā nā karena tave tārā īmāna ānave nā; kintu tādera adhikāṃśai ajña.
6:111.latin_ascii: ami tadera nikata pheresata prerana karale evam mrtara tadera sathe katha valale evam sakala vastuke tadera sammukhe hajira karaleo yadi allaha iccha na karena tave tara imana anave na; kintu tadera adhikamsai ajna.

6:112.latin_iast: anurūpabhāve āmi mānava o jinera madhye yārā śaẏatāna tāderake pratyeka nāvīra śatra“ karechi, pratāraṇāra uddeśye tādera eke anyake camakaprada kathā oẏāhī kare (ati gopanīẏabhāve jāniẏe deẏa). yadi tomāra pratipālaka icchā karatena tave tārā eṭā karata nā; sutarāṃ tumi tāderake o tārā yā mithyā racanā kare tāke varjana kara.
6:112.latin_ascii: anurupabhave ami manava o jinera madhye yara sayatana taderake pratyeka navira satra“ karechi, prataranara uddesye tadera eke anyake camakaprada katha oyahi kare (ati gopaniyabhave janiye deya). yadi tomara pratipalaka iccha karatena tave tara eta karata na; sutaram tumi taderake o tara ya mithya racana kare take varjana kara.

6:113.latin_iast: āra tārā e uddeśye prarocita kare ye, yārā ākhirāte viśvāsa karenā tādera mana yena tāra prati anurāgī haẏa evaṃ tāte yena tārā parituṣṭa haẏa āra tārā ye apakarma kare tārāo yena sesava apakarma karate thāke.
6:113.latin_ascii: ara tara e uddesye prarocita kare ye, yara akhirate visvasa karena tadera mana yena tara prati anuragi haya evam tate yena tara paritusta haya ara tara ye apakarma kare tarao yena sesava apakarma karate thake.

6:114.latin_iast: tave ki āmi āllāha vyatīta anyake vicāraka anusandhāna karava athaca tinii tomādera prati suvistārita kitāva avatīrṇa karechena!’ āmi yāderake kitāva diẏechi tārā jāne ye, tā tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa hate satyasaha avatīrṇa haẏeche. sutarāṃ tumi sandihānadera antarbhukta haẏo nā.
6:114.latin_ascii: tave ki ami allaha vyatita anyake vicaraka anusandhana karava athaca tinii tomadera prati suvistarita kitava avatirna karechena!’ ami yaderake kitava diyechi tara jane ye, ta tomara pratipalakera nikata hate satyasaha avatirna hayeche. sutaram tumi sandihanadera antarbhukta hayo na.

6:115.latin_iast: satya o nyāẏera dika diẏe tomāra pratipālakera vāṇī paripūrṇa. tā~ra vākya parivartana karāra keu nei. āra tini sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
6:115.latin_ascii: satya o nyayera dika diye tomara pratipalakera vani paripurna. ta~ra vakya parivartana karara keu nei. ara tini sarvasrota, sarvajna.

6:116.latin_iast: yadi tumi duniẏāra adhikāṃśa lokera kathāmata cala tave tārā tomāke āllāhara patha hate vicyuta karave. tārā to śudhu anumānera anusaraṇa kare; āra tārā śudhu anumānabhittika kathā vale.
6:116.latin_ascii: yadi tumi duniyara adhikamsa lokera kathamata cala tave tara tomake allahara patha hate vicyuta karave. tara to sudhu anumanera anusarana kare; ara tara sudhu anumanabhittika katha vale.

6:117.latin_iast: tā~ra patha cher̤e ke vipathagāmī haẏa se samvandhe tomāra pratipālaka adhika jānena evaṃ sat pathe yārā āche tāo tini adhika jānena.
6:117.latin_ascii: ta~ra patha chere ke vipathagami haya se samvandhe tomara pratipalaka adhika janena evam sat pathe yara ache tao tini adhika janena.

6:118.latin_iast: tomarā tā~ra nidarśane viśvāsī hale yā āllāhara nāma niẏe (javeha karā) haẏeche tā hate khāo.
6:118.latin_ascii: tomara ta~ra nidarsane visvasi hale ya allahara nama niye (javeha kara) hayeche ta hate khao.

6:119.latin_iast: tomādera kī haẏeche ye, yāte āllāhara nāma neẏā haẏeche, tomarā tā hate āhāra karave nā? yā tomādera janya tini hārāma karechena tā tini viśadabhāvei tomādera nikaṭa varṇanā karechena, tave tomarā nirupāẏa hale tā ālādā kathā. aneke ajñatāvaśata nijedera kheẏāla-khuśī dvārā avaśyai anyake vipathagāmī kare; niścaẏai tomāra pratipālaka sīmālaṅghanakārīdera samvandhe khuva bhāla jānena.
6:119.latin_ascii: tomadera ki hayeche ye, yate allahara nama neya hayeche, tomara ta hate ahara karave nay ya tomadera janya tini harama karechena ta tini visadabhavei tomadera nikata varnana karechena, tave tomara nirupaya hale ta alada katha. aneke ajnatavasata nijedera kheyala-khusi dvara avasyai anyake vipathagami kare; niscayai tomara pratipalaka simalanghanakaridera samvandhe khuva bhala janena.

6:120.latin_iast: tomarā prakāśya evaṃ aprakāśya pāpa varjana kara; niścaẏai yārā pāpa kare tāderake acirei tādera pāpera samucita śāsti deẏā have.
6:120.latin_ascii: tomara prakasya evam aprakasya papa varjana kara; niscayai yara papa kare taderake acirei tadera papera samucita sasti deya have.

6:121.latin_iast: yā āllāhara nāma niẏe (javeha karā) haẏani tomarā tāra kichui kheo nā; tā avaśyai pāpa. niścaẏai śaẏatānerā tādera vandhuderake tomādera sāthe vivāda karate oẏāhī preraṇa kare (gopanīẏabhāve jāniẏe deẏa) yadi tomarā tādera kathāmata cala, tave tomarā avaśyai muśarika have.
6:121.latin_ascii: ya allahara nama niye (javeha kara) hayani tomara tara kichui kheo na; ta avasyai papa. niscayai sayatanera tadera vandhuderake tomadera sathe vivada karate oyahi prerana kare (gopaniyabhave janiye deya) yadi tomara tadera kathamata cala, tave tomara avasyai musarika have.

6:122.latin_iast: ye vyakti mṛta chila, yāke āmi pare jīvita karechi evaṃ yāke mānuṣera madhye calāra janya ālo diẏechi, se vyakti ki ai vyaktira mata ye andhakāre raẏeche evaṃ se sthāna hate vera havāra naẏa? ebhāve kāphidera dṛṣṭite tādera kṛtakarma śobhana kare deẏā haẏeche.
6:122.latin_ascii: ye vyakti mrta chila, yake ami pare jivita karechi evam yake manusera madhye calara janya alo diyechi, se vyakti ki ai vyaktira mata ye andhakare rayeche evam se sthana hate vera havara nayay ebhave kaphidera drstite tadera krtakarma sobhana kare deya hayeche.

6:123.latin_iast: anurūpabhāve āmi pratyeka janapadera śīrṣasthānīẏa lokederake pāpācārī karechi. yāte sekhāne ṣar̤ayantrera jāla vistāra kare; kintu tārā śudhu tādera nijedera viruddhei ṣar̤ayantra kare, athaca tārā upalavdhi kare nā.
6:123.latin_ascii: anurupabhave ami pratyeka janapadera sirsasthaniya lokederake papacari karechi. yate sekhane sarayantrera jala vistara kare; kintu tara sudhu tadera nijedera viruddhei sarayantra kare, athaca tara upalavdhi kare na.

6:124.latin_iast: yakhana tādera nikaṭa kona nidarśana āse tārā takhana vale, ‘āllāhara rāsūladerake yā deẏā haẏechila āmāderakeo tā nā deẏā paryanta āmarā kakhanao viśvāsa karava nā.’ āllāha tā~ra risālātera bhāra kāra opara arpaṇa karavena tā tinii bhāla jānena. yārā aparādha kareche, tādera cakrāntera kāraṇe āllāhara nikaṭa hate lāñchanā o kaṭhora śāsti tādera oparai patita have.
6:124.latin_ascii: yakhana tadera nikata kona nidarsana ase tara takhana vale, ‘allahara rasuladerake ya deya hayechila amaderakeo ta na deya paryanta amara kakhanao visvasa karava na.’ allaha ta~ra risalatera bhara kara opara arpana karavena ta tinii bhala janena. yara aparadha kareche, tadera cakrantera karane allahara nikata hate lanchana o kathora sasti tadera oparai patita have.

6:125.latin_iast: āllāha kāuke sat pathe paricālita karate cāile tini tāra vakṣa isalāmera janya praśasta kare dena evaṃ kāuke vipathagāmī karate cāile tini tāra vakṣa atiśaẏa saṃkīrṇa kare dena, tāra kāche isalāmera anusaraṇa ākāśe ārohaṇera matai duḥsādhya haẏe par̤e. yārā viśvāsa kare nā āllāha tāderake ebhāve lāñchita karena.
6:125.latin_ascii: allaha kauke sat pathe paricalita karate caile tini tara vaksa isalamera janya prasasta kare dena evam kauke vipathagami karate caile tini tara vaksa atisaya samkirna kare dena, tara kache isalamera anusarana akase arohanera matai duhsadhya haye pare. yara visvasa kare na allaha taderake ebhave lanchita karena.

6:126.latin_iast: eṭā tomāra pratipālakera sahaja-sarala patha. ye sampradāẏa upadeśa grahaṇa kare āmi tādera janya nidarśanasamūha viśadabhāve varṇanā kari.
6:126.latin_ascii: eta tomara pratipalakera sahaja-sarala patha. ye sampradaya upadesa grahana kare ami tadera janya nidarsanasamuha visadabhave varnana kari.

6:127.latin_iast: tādera pratipālakera nikaṭa tādera janya raẏeche śāntira ālaẏa evaṃ tārā yā karata tāra janya tinii tādera abhibhāvaka.
6:127.latin_ascii: tadera pratipalakera nikata tadera janya rayeche santira alaya evam tara ya karata tara janya tinii tadera abhibhavaka.

6:128.latin_iast: yedina tini tādera sakalake ekatrita karavena evaṃ valavena, ‘he jina sampradāẏa! tomarā to aneka lokake tomādera anugāmī (pathabhraṣṭa) karechile; evaṃ mānava samājera madhye tādera vandhugaṇa valave, ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! āmādera madhye kataka aparera dvārā lābhavāna haẏechi evaṃ tumi āmādera janya ye samaẏa nirdhārita karechile ekhana āmarā tāte upanīta haẏechi.’ āllāha valavena, jāhānnāmai tomādera vāsasthāna, tomarā sethāẏa sthāẏī have, ’ yadi nā āllāha anya rakama icchā karena. tomāra pratipālaka avaśyai prajñamāẏa, saviśeṣa avahita.
6:128.latin_ascii: yedina tini tadera sakalake ekatrita karavena evam valavena, ‘he jina sampradaya! tomara to aneka lokake tomadera anugami (pathabhrasta) karechile; evam manava samajera madhye tadera vandhugana valave, ‘he amadera pratipalaka! amadera madhye kataka aparera dvara labhavana hayechi evam tumi amadera janya ye samaya nirdharita karechile ekhana amara tate upanita hayechi.’ allaha valavena, jahannamai tomadera vasasthana, tomara sethaya sthayi have, ’ yadi na allaha anya rakama iccha karena. tomara pratipalaka avasyai prajnamaya, savisesa avahita.

6:129.latin_iast: ebhāve tādera kṛtakarmera janya āmi jālimadera ekadalake anyadalera vandhu kare thāki.
6:129.latin_ascii: ebhave tadera krtakarmera janya ami jalimadera ekadalake anyadalera vandhu kare thaki.

6:130.latin_iast: he jina o mānava sampradāẏa! tomādera madhya hate ki rāsūlagaṇa tomādera kāche āseni yārā āmāra nidarśana tomādera nikaṭa varṇanā karata evaṃ tomāderake edinera sammukhīna haoẏā samvandhe satarka karata?’ tārā valave, ‘āmarā āmādera viruddhe sākṣya dilāma.’ vastuta pārthiva jīvana tāderake pratārita karechila, āra tārā nijedera viruddhe e sākṣyao deve ye, tārā kāphira chila.
6:130.latin_ascii: he jina o manava sampradaya! tomadera madhya hate ki rasulagana tomadera kache aseni yara amara nidarsana tomadera nikata varnana karata evam tomaderake edinera sammukhina haoya samvandhe satarka karatay’ tara valave, ‘amara amadera viruddhe saksya dilama.’ vastuta parthiva jivana taderake pratarita karechila, ara tara nijedera viruddhe e saksyao deve ye, tara kaphira chila.

6:131.latin_iast: eṭā ejanya ye, tomāra pratipālaka kona janapadera adhivāsīke tādera julumera kāraṇe gāphela avasthāẏa tāderake dhvaṃsa karena nā.
6:131.latin_ascii: eta ejanya ye, tomara pratipalaka kona janapadera adhivasike tadera julumera karane gaphela avasthaya taderake dhvamsa karena na.

6:132.latin_iast: pratyeke yā kare tadanusāre tāra maryādā raẏeche evaṃ tārā yā kare se samvandhe tomāra pratipālaka vekhavara nana.
6:132.latin_ascii: pratyeke ya kare tadanusare tara maryada rayeche evam tara ya kare se samvandhe tomara pratipalaka vekhavara nana.

6:133.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālaka abhāvamukta, daẏāśīla. tini icchā karale tomāderake apasārita karate evaṃ tomādera pare yāke icchā tomādera sthalābhiṣikta karate pārena, yemana tomāderake tini anya eka sampradāẏera vaṃśa hate sṛṣṭi karechena.
6:133.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalaka abhavamukta, dayasila. tini iccha karale tomaderake apasarita karate evam tomadera pare yake iccha tomadera sthalabhisikta karate parena, yemana tomaderake tini anya eka sampradayera vamsa hate srsti karechena.

6:134.latin_iast: tomādera sāthe yā oẏādā karā haẏeche tā vāstavāẏana havei, tomarā tā vyartha karate pārave nā.
6:134.latin_ascii: tomadera sathe ya oyada kara hayeche ta vastavayana havei, tomara ta vyartha karate parave na.

6:135.latin_iast: vala: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā yekhāne yā karacha, karate thāka; āmio āmāra kāja karachi. tomarā śīghrai jānate pārave, kāra pariṇāma maṅgalamaẏa. jālimarā kakhanao saphalakāma have nā.’
6:135.latin_ascii: vala: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara yekhane ya karacha, karate thaka; amio amara kaja karachi. tomara sighrai janate parave, kara parinama mangalamaya. jalimara kakhanao saphalakama have na.’

6:136.latin_iast: āllāha ye śasya o gavādi paśu sṛṣṭi karechena tanmadhya hate tārā āllāhara janya ekaṭi aṃśa nirdiṣṭa kare evaṃ nijedera dhāraṇā anuyāẏī vale, ‘eṭā āllāhara janya āra eṭā āmādera devatādera janya’. yā tādera devatādera aṃśa tā āllāhara kāche pau~chāẏa nā varaṃ yā āllāhara aṃśa tā tādera devatādera kāche pau~chāẏa, tārā yā mīmāṃsā kare tā katai nā nikṛṣṭa!
6:136.latin_ascii: allaha ye sasya o gavadi pasu srsti karechena tanmadhya hate tara allahara janya ekati amsa nirdista kare evam nijedera dharana anuyayi vale, ‘eta allahara janya ara eta amadera devatadera janya’. ya tadera devatadera amsa ta allahara kache pau~chaya na varam ya allahara amsa ta tadera devatadera kache pau~chaya, tara ya mimamsa kare ta katai na nikrsta!

6:137.latin_iast: ebhāve tādera devatāgaṇa vahu muśarikadera dṛṣṭite tādera santānadera hatyāke śobhana kareche tādera dhvaṃsa sādhanera janya evaṃ tādera dharma samvandhe tādera mājhe vibhrānti sṛṣṭi karāra janya; āllāha icchā karale tārā tā karata nā. sutarāṃ tāderake tādera mithyā niẏe thākate dāo.
6:137.latin_ascii: ebhave tadera devatagana vahu musarikadera drstite tadera santanadera hatyake sobhana kareche tadera dhvamsa sadhanera janya evam tadera dharma samvandhe tadera majhe vibhranti srsti karara janya; allaha iccha karale tara ta karata na. sutaram taderake tadera mithya niye thakate dao.

6:138.latin_iast: āra tārā (nijedera vātila dhāraṇā mate) eo vale thāke ye, e sava viśeṣita paśu o viśeṣita kṣetera phasala surakṣita, keui tā bhakṣaṇa karate pārave nā, tave yāderake āmarā anumati deva (tārāi bhakṣaṇa karate pārave), āra (tārā vale) e viśeṣa paśugulora opara ārohaṇa karā o bhāra vahana hārāma karā haẏeche, āra katakagulo viśeṣa paśu raẏeche yeguloke javāi karāra samaẏa tārā āllāhara nāma uccāraṇa kare nā, (esava kathā) śudhu āllāhara prati mithyāropa karāra uddeśye (vale), esava mithyā āropera pratiphala ati satvarai tini tāderake dāna karavena.
6:138.latin_ascii: ara tara (nijedera vatila dharana mate) eo vale thake ye, e sava visesita pasu o visesita ksetera phasala suraksita, keui ta bhaksana karate parave na, tave yaderake amara anumati deva (tarai bhaksana karate parave), ara (tara vale) e visesa pasugulora opara arohana kara o bhara vahana harama kara hayeche, ara katakagulo visesa pasu rayeche yeguloke javai karara samaya tara allahara nama uccarana kare na, (esava katha) sudhu allahara prati mithyaropa karara uddesye (vale), esava mithya aropera pratiphala ati satvarai tini taderake dana karavena.

6:139.latin_iast: tārā ārao vale, ‘esava gavādi paśura garbhe yā āche tā ekamātra āmādera puruṣadera janya nirdiṣṭa evaṃ eṭā āmādera strīdera janya avaidha, āra tā yadi mṛta haẏa tave sakale ete aṃśīdāra. tini tādera erūpa valāra pratiphala acirei tāderake devena; niścaẏai tini prajñāmaẏa, sarvajña.
6:139.latin_ascii: tara arao vale, ‘esava gavadi pasura garbhe ya ache ta ekamatra amadera purusadera janya nirdista evam eta amadera stridera janya avaidha, ara ta yadi mrta haya tave sakale ete amsidara. tini tadera erupa valara pratiphala acirei taderake devena; niscayai tini prajnamaya, sarvajna.

6:140.latin_iast: yārā nirvuddhitāra daruna o ajñatāvaśata nijedera santānaderake hatyā kare evaṃ āllāha pradatta jīvikāke āllāhara samvandhe mithyā racanā karāra uddeśye niṣiddha kare tārā to kṣatigrasta haẏeche. tārā avaśyai vipathagāmī haẏeche evaṃ tārā sat pathaprāpta chila nā.
6:140.latin_ascii: yara nirvuddhitara daruna o ajnatavasata nijedera santanaderake hatya kare evam allaha pradatta jivikake allahara samvandhe mithya racana karara uddesye nisiddha kare tara to ksatigrasta hayeche. tara avasyai vipathagami hayeche evam tara sat pathaprapta chila na.

6:141.latin_iast: tini se sattā yini vāgānasamūha sṛṣṭi karechena, yāra kataka mācā avalamvī evaṃ kataka mācā avalamvī naẏa evaṃ khejura vṛkṣa, vibhinna svādaviśiṣṭa khādyaśasya, yāẏatuna o ḍālima sṛṣṭi karechena; egulo eke anyera sadṛśa evaṃ visadṛśa. yakhana tā phalavāna haẏa takhana tāra phala khāve āra phasala tolāra dine tāra haka pradāna karave evaṃ apacaẏa karave nā; niścaẏai tini apacaẏakārīderake pachanda karena nā.
6:141.latin_ascii: tini se satta yini vaganasamuha srsti karechena, yara kataka maca avalamvi evam kataka maca avalamvi naya evam khejura vrksa, vibhinna svadavisista khadyasasya, yayatuna o dalima srsti karechena; egulo eke anyera sadrsa evam visadrsa. yakhana ta phalavana haya takhana tara phala khave ara phasala tolara dine tara haka pradana karave evam apacaya karave na; niscayai tini apacayakariderake pachanda karena na.

6:142.latin_iast: gavādi paśura madhye kataka bhāravāhī o kataka kṣudrākāra paśu sṛṣṭi karechena. āllāha yā riyikarūpe tomāderake diẏechena tā hate khāo evaṃ śaẏatānera padāṅka anusaraṇa karo nā; se to tomādera prakāśya śatra“;
6:142.latin_ascii: gavadi pasura madhye kataka bharavahi o kataka ksudrakara pasu srsti karechena. allaha ya riyikarupe tomaderake diyechena ta hate khao evam sayatanera padanka anusarana karo na; se to tomadera prakasya satra“;

6:143.latin_iast: nara o mādī āṭaṭi: meṣera du’ṭi o chāgalera duiṭi; vala: ‘nara du’ṭii ki tini niṣiddha karechena kiṃvā mādī du’ṭii athavā mādī du’ṭira garbhe yā āche tā? tomarā satyavādī hale pramāṇasaha āmāke jānāo’;
6:143.latin_ascii: nara o madi atati: mesera du’ti o chagalera duiti; vala: ‘nara du’tii ki tini nisiddha karechena kimva madi du’tii athava madi du’tira garbhe ya ache tay tomara satyavadi hale pramanasaha amake janao’;

6:144.latin_iast: evaṃ uṭera du’ṭi o garura du’ṭi. vala: ‘nara du’ṭii ki tini niṣiddha karechena kiṃvā mādī du’ṭii athavā mādī du’ṭira garbhe yā āche tā? evaṃ āllāha yakhana tomāderake esava nirdeśa dāna karena takhana ki tomarā upasthita chile?’ sutarāṃ ye vyakti ajñatāvaśata mānuṣake vibhrānta karāra janya āllāha samvandhe mithyā racanā kare tāra ceẏe adhika jālima āra ke? āllāha to jālima sampradāẏake sat pathe paricālita karena nā.
6:144.latin_ascii: evam utera du’ti o garura du’ti. vala: ‘nara du’tii ki tini nisiddha karechena kimva madi du’tii athava madi du’tira garbhe ya ache tay evam allaha yakhana tomaderake esava nirdesa dana karena takhana ki tomara upasthita chiley’ sutaram ye vyakti ajnatavasata manusake vibhranta karara janya allaha samvandhe mithya racana kare tara ceye adhika jalima ara key allaha to jalima sampradayake sat pathe paricalita karena na.

6:145.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmāra prati ye oẏāhī haẏeche tāte loke yā khāẏa tāra madhye āmi kichui hārāma pāini mṛta jantu, pravāhamāna rakta o śūkarera māṃsa vyatīta. kenanā egulo avaśyai apavitra athavā avaidha, āllāha chār̤ā anyera nāme javeha karāra kāraṇe.’ tave keu avādhya nā haẏe evaṃ sīmālaṅghana nā kare nirupāẏa haẏe tā khele tomāra pratipālaka to kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
6:145.latin_ascii: vala: ‘amara prati ye oyahi hayeche tate loke ya khaya tara madhye ami kichui harama paini mrta jantu, pravahamana rakta o sukarera mamsa vyatita. kenana egulo avasyai apavitra athava avaidha, allaha chara anyera name javeha karara karane.’ tave keu avadhya na haye evam simalanghana na kare nirupaya haye ta khele tomara pratipalaka to ksamasila, parama dayalu.

6:146.latin_iast: iẏāhūdīdera prati āmi sarvaprakāra nakhaviśiṣṭa jīva hārāma karechilāma; āra garu o chāgala hate tādera janya ubhaẏera carvi hārāma karechilāma; kintu pṛṣṭhadeśera carvi, nār̤i-bhu~r̤ira carvi o hār̤era sāthe miśrita carvi e hārāmera antarbhukta chila nā. tādera vidrohamūlaka ācaraṇera janya āmi tāderake e śāsti diẏechilāma, āra āmi niḥsandehe satyavādī.
6:146.latin_ascii: iyahudidera prati ami sarvaprakara nakhavisista jiva harama karechilama; ara garu o chagala hate tadera janya ubhayera carvi harama karechilama; kintu prsthadesera carvi, nari-bhu~rira carvi o harera sathe misrita carvi e haramera antarbhukta chila na. tadera vidrohamulaka acaranera janya ami taderake e sasti diyechilama, ara ami nihsandehe satyavadi.

6:147.latin_iast: ataḥpara yadi tārā tomāke mithyā pratipanna kare tave vala: ‘tomādera pratipālaka sarvavyāpī daẏāra mālika evaṃ aparādhī sampradāẏera opara hate tā~ra śāsti rada karā yāve nā.’
6:147.latin_ascii: atahpara yadi tara tomake mithya pratipanna kare tave vala: ‘tomadera pratipalaka sarvavyapi dayara malika evam aparadhi sampradayera opara hate ta~ra sasti rada kara yave na.’

6:148.latin_iast: yārā śirka kareche tārā acirei valave, ‘āllāha yadi icchā karatena tave āmarā o āmādera pūrvapuruṣagaṇa śirka karatāma nā evaṃ kona kichui hārāma karatāma nā.’ ebhāve tādera pūrvavartīgaṇao mithyā pratipanna karechila aveśeṣe tārā āmāra śāsti bhoga karechila. vala: ‘tomādera nikaṭa ki prakṛta jñāna āche? thākale āmāra nikaṭa tā peśa kara; tomarā śudhu kalpanārai anusaraṇa kara evaṃ tomarā to mithyācārai karacha.
6:148.latin_ascii: yara sirka kareche tara acirei valave, ‘allaha yadi iccha karatena tave amara o amadera purvapurusagana sirka karatama na evam kona kichui harama karatama na.’ ebhave tadera purvavartiganao mithya pratipanna karechila avesese tara amara sasti bhoga karechila. vala: ‘tomadera nikata ki prakrta jnana achey thakale amara nikata ta pesa kara; tomara sudhu kalpanarai anusarana kara evam tomara to mithyacarai karacha.

6:149.latin_iast: vala: ‘cūr̤ānta pramāṇa to āllāharai; tini yadi icchā karatena tave tomādera sakalake avaśyai sat pathe paricālita karatena.
6:149.latin_ascii: vala: ‘curanta pramana to allaharai; tini yadi iccha karatena tave tomadera sakalake avasyai sat pathe paricalita karatena.

6:150.latin_iast: vala: ‘āllāha yā hārāma karechena e samvandhe yārā sākṣya deve tāderake hājira kara.’ tārā sākṣya dileo tumi tādera sāthe eṭā svīkāra kara nā. yārā āmāra āẏātasamūhake mithyā mane kareche, yārā parakālera viśvāsa kare nā evaṃ pratipālakera samakakṣa dā~r̤a karāẏa, tumi tādera kheẏāla-khuśīra anusaraṇa kara nā.
6:150.latin_ascii: vala: ‘allaha ya harama karechena e samvandhe yara saksya deve taderake hajira kara.’ tara saksya dileo tumi tadera sathe eta svikara kara na. yara amara ayatasamuhake mithya mane kareche, yara parakalera visvasa kare na evam pratipalakera samakaksa da~ra karaya, tumi tadera kheyala-khusira anusarana kara na.

6:151.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā āsa, tomādera pratipālaka tomādera janya yā hārāma karechena tomāderake tā par̤e śunāi. tā hala ‘tomarā tā~ra sāthe kona kichu śarīka karave nā, pitā-mātāra prati sadvyavahāra karave, dāridrera bhaẏe tomarā tomādera santānaderake hatyā karave nā, āmii tomāderake o tāderake riyika diẏe thāki. prakāśye hoka kiṃvā gopane hoka aślīla kājera nikaṭeo yāve nā. āllāha yāke hatyā karā hārāma karechena yathārtha kāraṇa vyatīreke tomarā tāke hatyā karave nā.’ tomāderake tini e nirdeśa dilena yena tomarā anudhāvana kara.
6:151.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara asa, tomadera pratipalaka tomadera janya ya harama karechena tomaderake ta pare sunai. ta hala ‘tomara ta~ra sathe kona kichu sarika karave na, pita-matara prati sadvyavahara karave, daridrera bhaye tomara tomadera santanaderake hatya karave na, amii tomaderake o taderake riyika diye thaki. prakasye hoka kimva gopane hoka aslila kajera nikateo yave na. allaha yake hatya kara harama karechena yathartha karana vyatireke tomara take hatya karave na.’ tomaderake tini e nirdesa dilena yena tomara anudhavana kara.

6:152.latin_iast: iẏātīma vaẏaḥprāpta nā haoẏā paryanta uttama panthā vyatīta tomarā tāra sampattira nikaṭavartī have nā evaṃ parimāṇa o ojana nyāyyabhāve puropuri deve. āmi kāukeo tāra sādhyātīta bhāra arpaṇa kari nā. yakhana tomarā kathā valave takhana nyāyya valave svajanera samparke haleo evaṃ āllāhake pradatta aṅgīkāra pūrṇa karave. ebhāve āllāha tomāderake nirdeśa dilena yena tomarā upadeśa grahaṇa kara.
6:152.latin_ascii: iyatima vayahprapta na haoya paryanta uttama pantha vyatita tomara tara sampattira nikatavarti have na evam parimana o ojana nyayyabhave puropuri deve. ami kaukeo tara sadhyatita bhara arpana kari na. yakhana tomara katha valave takhana nyayya valave svajanera samparke haleo evam allahake pradatta angikara purna karave. ebhave allaha tomaderake nirdesa dilena yena tomara upadesa grahana kara.

6:153.latin_iast: āra niścaẏai e pathai āmāra sahaja-sarala patha. sutarāṃ tomarā erai anusaraṇa karave evaṃ vibhinna patha anusaraṇa karave nā, karale tā tomāderake tā~ra patha hate vicchinna karave. ebhāve āllāha tomāderake nirdeśa dilena yena tomarā tā~ke bhaẏa kara.
6:153.latin_ascii: ara niscayai e pathai amara sahaja-sarala patha. sutaram tomara erai anusarana karave evam vibhinna patha anusarana karave na, karale ta tomaderake ta~ra patha hate vicchinna karave. ebhave allaha tomaderake nirdesa dilena yena tomara ta~ke bhaya kara.

6:154.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi mūsāke diẏechilāma kitāva yā satkarmaparāẏaṇadera janya neẏāmate sampūrṇa, yā samasta kichura viśada vivaraṇa, pathanirdeśa evaṃ daẏāsvarūpa yāte tārā tādera pratipālakera sākṣāta samvandhe īmāna āne.
6:154.latin_ascii: atahpara ami musake diyechilama kitava ya satkarmaparayanadera janya neyamate sampurna, ya samasta kichura visada vivarana, pathanirdesa evam dayasvarupa yate tara tadera pratipalakera saksata samvandhe imana ane.

6:155.latin_iast: e kitāva āmi nāyila karechi yā varakatamaẏa. sutarāṃ tāra anusaraṇa kara evaṃ tākvaoẏā avalamvana kara, haẏato tomādera prati daẏā pradarśana karā have;
6:155.latin_ascii: e kitava ami nayila karechi ya varakatamaya. sutaram tara anusarana kara evam takvaoya avalamvana kara, hayato tomadera prati daya pradarsana kara have;

6:156.latin_iast: yāte tomarā valate nā pāra, kitāva to śudhu āmādera pūrve du’ sampradāẏera (iẏāhūdī o khrisṭānera) pratii avatīrṇa haẏechila; āmarā tādera paṭhana-pāṭhana samvandhe to gāphila chilāma’,
6:156.latin_ascii: yate tomara valate na para, kitava to sudhu amadera purve du’ sampradayera (iyahudi o khristanera) pratii avatirna hayechila; amara tadera pathana-pathana samvandhe to gaphila chilama’,

6:157.latin_iast: athavā yāte e kathā valate nā pāra, ‘yadi āmādera prati kitāva avatīrṇa hata tave āmarā to tādera apekṣā adhika hidāẏātaprāpta hatāma.’ ekhana to tomādera nikaṭa tomādera pratipālakera pakṣa hate spaṣṭa pramāṇa, hidāẏāta o rahamata eseche. ataeva ye keu āllāhara nidarśanake pratyākhyāna karave evaṃ tā hate mukha phiriẏe neve tāra ceẏe var̤a jālima āra ke? yārā āmāra nidarśanasamūha hate mukha phiriẏe neẏa satyavimukhitāra janya āmi tāderake nikṛṣṭa śāsti deva.
6:157.latin_ascii: athava yate e katha valate na para, ‘yadi amadera prati kitava avatirna hata tave amara to tadera apeksa adhika hidayataprapta hatama.’ ekhana to tomadera nikata tomadera pratipalakera paksa hate spasta pramana, hidayata o rahamata eseche. ataeva ye keu allahara nidarsanake pratyakhyana karave evam ta hate mukha phiriye neve tara ceye vara jalima ara key yara amara nidarsanasamuha hate mukha phiriye neya satyavimukhitara janya ami taderake nikrsta sasti deva.

6:158.latin_iast: tārā śudhu e pratīkṣāi kare ye, tādera nikaṭa phereśatā āsave, athavā tomāra pratipālaka āsave, kiṃvā tomāra pratipālakera kona nidarśana āsave. yedina tomāra pratipālakera kona nidarśana āsave sedina tāra īmāna kāje āsave nā, ye vyakti pūrve īmāna āneni kiṃvā ye vyakti īmānera mādhyame kalyāṇa arjana kareni. vala: ‘tomarā pratīkṣā kara, āmarāo pratīkṣāẏa railāma.’
6:158.latin_ascii: tara sudhu e pratiksai kare ye, tadera nikata pheresata asave, athava tomara pratipalaka asave, kimva tomara pratipalakera kona nidarsana asave. yedina tomara pratipalakera kona nidarsana asave sedina tara imana kaje asave na, ye vyakti purve imana aneni kimva ye vyakti imanera madhyame kalyana arjana kareni. vala: ‘tomara pratiksa kara, amarao pratiksaya railama.’

6:159.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā nijedera dīnake (vibhinna mate) khaṇḍa vikhaṇḍa kareche evaṃ vibhinna dale vibhakta haẏeche tādera kona dāẏitva tomāra naẏa; tādera viṣaẏa āllāhara ekhatiẏārabhukta. āllāha tāderake tādera kṛtakarma samvandhe avahita karavena.
6:159.latin_ascii: niscayai yara nijedera dinake (vibhinna mate) khanda vikhanda kareche evam vibhinna dale vibhakta hayeche tadera kona dayitva tomara naya; tadera visaya allahara ekhatiyarabhukta. allaha taderake tadera krtakarma samvandhe avahita karavena.

6:160.latin_iast: keu kona sat kāja karale se tāra daśa guṇa pāve evaṃ keu kona asat kāja karale tāke śudhu tārai pratiphala deẏā have, āra tādera prati juluma karā have nā.
6:160.latin_ascii: keu kona sat kaja karale se tara dasa guna pave evam keu kona asat kaja karale take sudhu tarai pratiphala deya have, ara tadera prati juluma kara have na.

6:161.latin_iast: vala: niścaẏai ‘āmāra pratipālaka āmāke sat pathe paricālita karechena, tā supratiṣṭhita dīna, ivarāhīmera dharmādarśa, se chila ekaniṣṭha evaṃ se muśarikadera antarbhukta chila nā.’
6:161.latin_ascii: vala: niscayai ‘amara pratipalaka amake sat pathe paricalita karechena, ta supratisthita dina, ivarahimera dharmadarsa, se chila ekanistha evam se musarikadera antarbhukta chila na.’

6:162.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmāra sālāta, āmāra kuravānī, āmāra jīvana o āmāra maraṇa śudhu jagatasamūhera pratipālaka āllāharai uddeśye.’
6:162.latin_ascii: vala: ‘amara salata, amara kuravani, amara jivana o amara marana sudhu jagatasamuhera pratipalaka allaharai uddesye.’

6:163.latin_iast: ‘tā~ra kona śarīka nei evaṃ āmi erai janya ādiṣṭa haẏechi evaṃ āmii prathama musalima.
6:163.latin_ascii: ‘ta~ra kona sarika nei evam ami erai janya adista hayechi evam amii prathama musalima.

6:164.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmi ki āllāhake cher̤e anya kāuke pratipālaka hiseve khu~java? athaca tinii savakichura pratipālaka.‘ pratyeke svīẏa kṛtakarmera janya dāẏī evaṃ keu anya kāro (pāpera) bhāra vahana karave nā. ataḥpara tomādera pratyāvartana tomādera pratipālakera nikaṭei, takhana ye viṣaẏe tomarā matabheda karate tā tini tomāderake avahita karavena.
6:164.latin_ascii: vala: ‘ami ki allahake chere anya kauke pratipalaka hiseve khu~javay athaca tinii savakichura pratipalaka.‘ pratyeke sviya krtakarmera janya dayi evam keu anya karo (papera) bhara vahana karave na. atahpara tomadera pratyavartana tomadera pratipalakera nikatei, takhana ye visaye tomara matabheda karate ta tini tomaderake avahita karavena.

6:165.latin_iast: tinii tomāderake duniẏāra pratinidhi karechena evaṃ yā tini tomāderake diẏechena se samvandhe parīkṣāra uddeśye tomādera katakake katakera opara maryādāẏa unnīta karechena. tomāra pratipālaka to śāsti pradāne tatpara āra tini avaśyai kṣamāśīla, daẏāmaẏa.
6:165.latin_ascii: tinii tomaderake duniyara pratinidhi karechena evam ya tini tomaderake diyechena se samvandhe pariksara uddesye tomadera katakake katakera opara maryadaya unnita karechena. tomara pratipalaka to sasti pradane tatpara ara tini avasyai ksamasila, dayamaya.

7:2.latin_iast: tomāra nikaṭa kitāva avatīrṇa karā haẏeche, ataeva tomāra mane yena e samparke kona saṅkoca nā thāke era dvārā satarkīkaraṇera vyāpāre evaṃ mu’minadera janya eṭā upadeśa.
7:2.latin_ascii: tomara nikata kitava avatirna kara hayeche, ataeva tomara mane yena e samparke kona sankoca na thake era dvara satarkikaranera vyapare evam mu’minadera janya eta upadesa.

7:3.latin_iast: tomādera pratipālakera nikaṭa hate tomādera nikaṭa yā avatīrṇa karā haẏeche tomarā tāra anusaraṇa kara evaṃ tā~ke chār̤ā anya abhibhāvakera anusaraṇa kara nā. tomarā khuva alpai upadeśa grahaṇa kara.
7:3.latin_ascii: tomadera pratipalakera nikata hate tomadera nikata ya avatirna kara hayeche tomara tara anusarana kara evam ta~ke chara anya abhibhavakera anusarana kara na. tomara khuva alpai upadesa grahana kara.

7:4.latin_iast: kata janapadake āmi dhvaṃsa karechi! āmāra śāsti tādera opara patita haẏechila rāte athavā dvi-prahare yakhana tārā viśrāmarata chila.
7:4.latin_ascii: kata janapadake ami dhvamsa karechi! amara sasti tadera opara patita hayechila rate athava dvi-prahare yakhana tara visramarata chila.

7:5.latin_iast: yakhana āmāra śāsti tādera opara patita haẏechila takhana tādera kathā śudhu eṭāi chila ye, ‘niścaẏa āmarā jālima chilāma.’
7:5.latin_ascii: yakhana amara sasti tadera opara patita hayechila takhana tadera katha sudhu etai chila ye, ‘niscaya amara jalima chilama.’

7:6.latin_iast: ataḥpara yādera nikaṭa rāsūla preraṇa karā haẏechila tāderake āmi avaśyai jijñāsā karava evaṃ rāsūlagaṇakeo jijñāsā karava.
7:6.latin_ascii: atahpara yadera nikata rasula prerana kara hayechila taderake ami avasyai jijnasa karava evam rasulaganakeo jijnasa karava.

7:7.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera nikaṭa pūrṇa jñānera sāthe tādera kāryāvalī avaśyai varṇanā karava, āra āmi to anupasthita chilāma nā.
7:7.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera nikata purna jnanera sathe tadera karyavali avasyai varnana karava, ara ami to anupasthita chilama na.

7:8.latin_iast: sedina saṭhika ojana karā have. yādera pāllā bhārī have tārāi saphalakāma have.
7:8.latin_ascii: sedina sathika ojana kara have. yadera palla bhari have tarai saphalakama have.

7:9.latin_iast: āra yādera pāllā hālakā have tārāi tādera nijedera kṣati kareche, yehetu tārā āmāra nidarśanasamūhake pratyākhyāna karata.
7:9.latin_ascii: ara yadera palla halaka have tarai tadera nijedera ksati kareche, yehetu tara amara nidarsanasamuhake pratyakhyana karata.

7:10.latin_iast: āmi to tomāderake duniẏāẏa pratiṣṭhita karechi evaṃ tāte tomādera jīvikāra vyavasthāo karechi; tomarā khuva alpai kṛtajñatā jñāpana kara.
7:10.latin_ascii: ami to tomaderake duniyaya pratisthita karechi evam tate tomadera jivikara vyavasthao karechi; tomara khuva alpai krtajnata jnapana kara.

7:11.latin_iast: āmii tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechi, ataḥpara tomādera ākṛti dāna karechi, evaṃ tārapara phereśatādera ādamake sijadāha karate valechi; ivalīsa vyatīta sakalei sijadāha karala. se sijadāhakārīdera antarbhukta hala nā.
7:11.latin_ascii: amii tomaderake srsti karechi, atahpara tomadera akrti dana karechi, evam tarapara pheresatadera adamake sijadaha karate valechi; ivalisa vyatita sakalei sijadaha karala. se sijadahakaridera antarbhukta hala na.

7:12.latin_iast: tini (āllāha) valalena: ‘āmi yakhana tomāke ādeśa dilāma takhana kise tomāke sijadāha dite vāraṇa karala?’ se valala: ‘āmi tāra apekṣā uttama; āpani āmāke agni dvārā sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tāke kardama dvārā sṛṣṭi karechena.
7:12.latin_ascii: tini (allaha) valalena: ‘ami yakhana tomake adesa dilama takhana kise tomake sijadaha dite varana karalay’ se valala: ‘ami tara apeksa uttama; apani amake agni dvara srsti karechena evam take kardama dvara srsti karechena.

7:13.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘e sthāna hate neme yāo, ekhāna theke ahaṅkāra karave- eṭā hate pāre nā. sutarāṃ vera haẏe yāo, tumi adhamadera antarbhukta.’
7:13.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘e sthana hate neme yao, ekhana theke ahankara karave- eta hate pare na. sutaram vera haye yao, tumi adhamadera antarbhukta.’

7:14.latin_iast: se valala ‘punarutthāna divasa paryanta āmāke avakāśa dina.’
7:14.latin_ascii: se valala ‘punarutthana divasa paryanta amake avakasa dina.’

7:15.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘yāderake avakāśa deẏā haẏeche tumi avaśyai tādera antarbhukta hale.’
7:15.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘yaderake avakasa deya hayeche tumi avasyai tadera antarbhukta hale.’

7:16.latin_iast: se valala: ye kāraṇe āpani āmāke pathabhraṣṭa karalena, ejanya āmi avaśyai āpanāra sarala pathe mānuṣera janya oṃta pete thākava.
7:16.latin_ascii: se valala: ye karane apani amake pathabhrasta karalena, ejanya ami avasyai apanara sarala pathe manusera janya omta pete thakava.

7:17.latin_iast: ‘ataḥpara āmi tādera nikaṭa āsava tādera sammukha, paścāt, ḍāna o vāma dika hate evaṃ āpani tādera adhikāṃśake kṛtajña pāvena nā.’
7:17.latin_ascii: ‘atahpara ami tadera nikata asava tadera sammukha, pascat, dana o vama dika hate evam apani tadera adhikamsake krtajna pavena na.’

7:18.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘e sthāna hate dhikṛta o vitār̤ita avasthāẏa vera haẏe yāo. mānuṣera madhye yārā tomāra anusaraṇa karave niścaẏa āmi tomādera sakalera dvārā jāhānnāma pūrṇa karava.’
7:18.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘e sthana hate dhikrta o vitarita avasthaya vera haye yao. manusera madhye yara tomara anusarana karave niscaya ami tomadera sakalera dvara jahannama purna karava.’

7:19.latin_iast: he ādama! tumi o tomāra strī jānnāte vasavāsa kara evaṃ yekhāna theke icchā khāo, kintu e vṛkṣera nikaṭavartī haẏo nā, hale tomarā jālimadera antarbhukta have.
7:19.latin_ascii: he adama! tumi o tomara stri jannate vasavasa kara evam yekhana theke iccha khao, kintu e vrksera nikatavarti hayo na, hale tomara jalimadera antarbhukta have.

7:20.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera lajjāsthāna, yā tādera kāche gopana rākhā haẏechila tā tādera kāche prakāśa karāra janya śaẏatāna tāderake kumantraṇā dila evaṃ valala: ‘tomarā ubhaẏe phereśatā haẏe yāo athavā tomarā sthāẏī hao ejanyai tomādera pratipālaka e vṛkṣa samvandhe tomāderake niṣedha karechena.’
7:20.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera lajjasthana, ya tadera kache gopana rakha hayechila ta tadera kache prakasa karara janya sayatana taderake kumantrana dila evam valala: ‘tomara ubhaye pheresata haye yao athava tomara sthayi hao ejanyai tomadera pratipalaka e vrksa samvandhe tomaderake nisedha karechena.’

7:21.latin_iast: se tādera ubhaẏera nikaṭa śapatha kare valala: āmi to tomādera kalyāṇakāmīdera ekajana.
7:21.latin_ascii: se tadera ubhayera nikata sapatha kare valala: ami to tomadera kalyanakamidera ekajana.

7:22.latin_iast: ebhāve se tādera ubhaẏake pravañcanāra dvārā adhaḥpatita karala. tārapara yakhana tārā se vṛkṣa-phalera svāda grahaṇa karala, takhana tādera lajjāsthāna tādera nikaṭa prakāśa haẏe gela evaṃ tārā jānnātera pātā dvārā nijaderake āvṛta karate lāgala. takhana tādera pratipālaka tāderake samvodhana kare valalena: ‘āmi ki tomāderake e vṛkṣera nikaṭavartī hate vāraṇa karini evaṃ āmi ki tomāderake valini ye, śaẏatāna tomādera prakāśya śatru?’
7:22.latin_ascii: ebhave se tadera ubhayake pravancanara dvara adhahpatita karala. tarapara yakhana tara se vrksa-phalera svada grahana karala, takhana tadera lajjasthana tadera nikata prakasa haye gela evam tara jannatera pata dvara nijaderake avrta karate lagala. takhana tadera pratipalaka taderake samvodhana kare valalena: ‘ami ki tomaderake e vrksera nikatavarti hate varana karini evam ami ki tomaderake valini ye, sayatana tomadera prakasya satruy’

7:23.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! āmarā nijedera prati juluma karechi, yadi tumi āmāderake kṣamā nā kara evaṃ daẏā nā kara tave to āmarā avaśyai kṣatigrastadera antarbhukta hava.’
7:23.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he amadera pratipalaka! amara nijedera prati juluma karechi, yadi tumi amaderake ksama na kara evam daya na kara tave to amara avasyai ksatigrastadera antarbhukta hava.’

7:24.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘tomarā neme yāo, tomarā eke anyera śatru evaṃ pṛthivīte kichu kālera janya tomādera vasavāsa o jīvikā raila.’
7:24.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘tomara neme yao, tomara eke anyera satru evam prthivite kichu kalera janya tomadera vasavasa o jivika raila.’

7:25.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘sekhānei tomarā jīvana yāpana karave, sekhānei tomādera mṛtyu have evaṃ tathā hate tomādera punarutthāna have.’
7:25.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘sekhanei tomara jivana yapana karave, sekhanei tomadera mrtyu have evam tatha hate tomadera punarutthana have.’

7:26.latin_iast: he vānī ādama! tomādera lajjāsthāna ḍhākāra o veśa-bhūṣāra janya āmi tomāderake pośāka diẏechi āra tākvaoẏāra poṣāka, eṭāi sarveāttama. eṭā āllāhara nidarśanasamūhera anyatama, yāte tārā upadeśa grahaṇa kare.
