10:98.latin_ascii: ataeva kona janapadavasi kena emana hala na ye, tara emana samaya imana anata yakhana imana anale tadera upakare asatay tave iunusera sampradaya vyatita. tara yakhana imana anala takhana ami tadera hate parthiva jivanera apamanajanaka sasti tule nilama evam taderake kichu kalera janya jivanopakarana bhoga karate dilama.

10:99.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālaka icchā karale pṛthivīte yārā āche tārā sakalei īmāna ānata; tave ki tumi mu’mina havāra janya mānuṣera opara javaradasti karave?
10:99.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalaka iccha karale prthivite yara ache tara sakalei imana anata; tave ki tumi mu’mina havara janya manusera opara javaradasti karavey

10:100.latin_iast: āllāhara anumati vyatīta īmāna ānā kārao sādhya naẏa evaṃ yārā anudhāvana kare nā āllāha tāderake kaluṣe lipta karena.
10:100.latin_ascii: allahara anumati vyatita imana ana karao sadhya naya evam yara anudhavana kare na allaha taderake kaluse lipta karena.

10:101.latin_iast: vala: ‘ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche tāra prati tomarā lakṣya kara.’ nidarśanāvalī o bhīti pradarśana aviśvāsī sampradāẏera kona upakāre āse nā.
10:101.latin_ascii: vala: ‘akasamandali o prthivite ya kichu ache tara prati tomara laksya kara.’ nidarsanavali o bhiti pradarsana avisvasi sampradayera kona upakare ase na.

10:102.latin_iast: erā ki edera pūrve yesava dina ghaṭe geche tāra anurūpa ghaṭanārai pratīkṣā kare? vala: ‘tomarā pratīkṣā kara, āmio tomādera sāthe pratīkṣā karachi.’
10:102.latin_ascii: era ki edera purve yesava dina ghate geche tara anurupa ghatanarai pratiksa karey vala: ‘tomara pratiksa kara, amio tomadera sathe pratiksa karachi.’

10:103.latin_iast: pariśeṣe āmi āmāra rāsūladerake evaṃ mu’minaderakeo uddhāra kari. ebhāve āmāra dāẏitva mu’minaderake uddhāra karā.
10:103.latin_ascii: parisese ami amara rasuladerake evam mu’minaderakeo uddhara kari. ebhave amara dayitva mu’minaderake uddhara kara.

10:104.latin_iast: vala: ‘he mānuṣa! tomarā yadi āmāra dīnera vyāpāre sandeha poṣaṇa kara tave jene rākha, tomarā āllāha vyatīta yādera ‘ivādata kara āmi tādera ‘ivādata kari nā. varaṃ āmi ‘ivādata kari āllāhara yini tomādera mṛtyu ghaṭāna evaṃ āmi mu’minadera antarbhukta havāra janya ādiṣṭa haẏechi,
10:104.latin_ascii: vala: ‘he manusa! tomara yadi amara dinera vyapare sandeha posana kara tave jene rakha, tomara allaha vyatita yadera ‘ivadata kara ami tadera ‘ivadata kari na. varam ami ‘ivadata kari allahara yini tomadera mrtyu ghatana evam ami mu’minadera antarbhukta havara janya adista hayechi,

10:105.latin_iast: āra tomāke eo nirdeśa deẏā haẏeche ye, ‘tumi ekaniṣṭhabhāve dīnera opara pratiṣṭhita hao evaṃ kakhanai muśarikadera antarbhukta haẏo nā,
10:105.latin_ascii: ara tomake eo nirdesa deya hayeche ye, ‘tumi ekanisthabhave dinera opara pratisthita hao evam kakhanai musarikadera antarbhukta hayo na,

10:106.latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha vyatīta anya kāukeo ḍeko nā, yārā tomāra kona upakāra kare nā, apakārao karate pārave nā, yadi tumi erūpa kara tāhale avaśyai jālimadera antarbhukta have.’
10:106.latin_ascii: evam allaha vyatita anya kaukeo deko na, yara tomara kona upakara kare na, apakarao karate parave na, yadi tumi erupa kara tahale avasyai jalimadera antarbhukta have.’

10:107.latin_iast: yadi āllāha tomāke kaṣṭa dite cāna tāhale tini vyatīta tā mocanakārī āra keu nei evaṃ āllāha yadi tomāra maṅgala cāna tave tā~ra anugraha rada karāra keu nei. tā~ra vāndādera madhye yāke icchā tini maṅgala dāna karena. tini kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.’
10:107.latin_ascii: yadi allaha tomake kasta dite cana tahale tini vyatita ta mocanakari ara keu nei evam allaha yadi tomara mangala cana tave ta~ra anugraha rada karara keu nei. ta~ra vandadera madhye yake iccha tini mangala dana karena. tini ksamasila, parama dayalu.’

10:108.latin_iast: vala: ‘he mānavamaṇḍalī! tomādera pratipālakera pakṣa hate tomādera nikaṭa satya eseche. sutarāṃ yārā satpatha avalamvana karave tārā to nijederai maṅgalera janya satpatha avalamvana karave evaṃ yārā pathabhraṣṭa have tārā to pathabhraṣṭa have nijederai dhvaṃsera janya evaṃ āmi tomādera karmavidhāẏaka nai.’
10:108.latin_ascii: vala: ‘he manavamandali! tomadera pratipalakera paksa hate tomadera nikata satya eseche. sutaram yara satpatha avalamvana karave tara to nijederai mangalera janya satpatha avalamvana karave evam yara pathabhrasta have tara to pathabhrasta have nijederai dhvamsera janya evam ami tomadera karmavidhayaka nai.’

10:109.latin_iast: tomāra prati ye oẏāhī avatīrṇa haẏeche tumi tāra anusaraṇa kara evaṃ tumi dhairya dhāraṇa kara ye paryanta nā āllāha phāẏasālā karena evaṃ āllāha tā‘ālāi sarveāttama phāẏasālākārī.
10:109.latin_ascii: tomara prati ye oyahi avatirna hayeche tumi tara anusarana kara evam tumi dhairya dharana kara ye paryanta na allaha phayasala karena evam allaha ta‘alai sarveattama phayasalakari.

11:1.latin_iast: ālipha-lāma-rā, eṭā emana grantha yāra āẏātagulo sudṛr̤ha, ataḥpara vistāritabhāve varṇita haẏeche prajñāmaẏa, sarvajñera pakṣa theke.
11:1.latin_ascii: alipha-lama-ra, eta emana grantha yara ayatagulo sudrrha, atahpara vistaritabhave varnita hayeche prajnamaya, sarvajnera paksa theke.

11:2.latin_iast: tomarā āllāha vyatīta anyera ‘ivādata karave nā, avaśyai āmi tā~ra pakṣa hate tomādera janya satarkakārī o susaṃvādadātā.
11:2.latin_ascii: tomara allaha vyatita anyera ‘ivadata karave na, avasyai ami ta~ra paksa hate tomadera janya satarkakari o susamvadadata.

11:3.latin_iast: tave, tomarā tomādera pratipālakera nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā kara o anuśocanā bhare tā~ra dike pratyāvartana kara, tini tomāderake eka nirdiṣṭakālera janya uttama jīvana upabhoga karate devena evaṃ tini pratyeka guṇījanake tāra prāpya maryādā dāna karavena. yadi tomarā mukha phiriẏe nāo tave āmi tomādera janya āśaṃkā kari mahādivasera śāstira.
11:3.latin_ascii: tave, tomara tomadera pratipalakera nikata ksama prarthana kara o anusocana bhare ta~ra dike pratyavartana kara, tini tomaderake eka nirdistakalera janya uttama jivana upabhoga karate devena evam tini pratyeka gunijanake tara prapya maryada dana karavena. yadi tomara mukha phiriye nao tave ami tomadera janya asamka kari mahadivasera sastira.

11:4.latin_iast: āllāharai nikaṭa tomādera pratyāvartana evaṃ tini sarvaviṣaẏe sarvaśaktimāna.
11:4.latin_ascii: allaharai nikata tomadera pratyavartana evam tini sarvavisaye sarvasaktimana.

11:5.latin_iast: sāvadhāna! niścaẏai tārā āllāhara nikaṭa gopana rākhāra janya tādera vakṣa dvibhā~ja kare. sāvadhāna! tārā yakhana nijederake vastre ācchādita kare takhana tārā yā gopana kare o prakāśa kare, tini tā jānena. antare yā āche, niścaẏai tini tā saviśeṣa avahita.
11:5.latin_ascii: savadhana! niscayai tara allahara nikata gopana rakhara janya tadera vaksa dvibha~ja kare. savadhana! tara yakhana nijederake vastre acchadita kare takhana tara ya gopana kare o prakasa kare, tini ta janena. antare ya ache, niscayai tini ta savisesa avahita.

11:6.latin_iast: bhū-pṛṣṭhe vicaraṇakārī sakalera jīvikāra dāẏitva ekamātra āllāharai. tini tādera sthāẏī o asthāẏī avasthiti samvandhe avahita; suspaṣṭa kitāve (lāohe māhaphuja) sava kichui āche.
11:6.latin_ascii: bhu-prsthe vicaranakari sakalera jivikara dayitva ekamatra allaharai. tini tadera sthayi o asthayi avasthiti samvandhe avahita; suspasta kitave (laohe mahaphuja) sava kichui ache.

11:7.latin_iast: āra tinii ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī chaẏa dine sṛṣṭi karena, takhana tā~ra ‘rāśa chila pānira opara, (sṛṣṭi karechena) tomādera madhye ke kārye śreṣṭha tā parīkṣā karāra janya. tumi yadi vala: ‘mṛtyura para tomarā avaśyai utthita have’, kāphiragaṇa niścaẏai valave, ‘eṭā to suspaṣṭa jādu.’
11:7.latin_ascii: ara tinii akasamandali o prthivi chaya dine srsti karena, takhana ta~ra ‘rasa chila panira opara, (srsti karechena) tomadera madhye ke karye srestha ta pariksa karara janya. tumi yadi vala: ‘mrtyura para tomara avasyai utthita have’, kaphiragana niscayai valave, ‘eta to suspasta jadu.’

11:8.latin_iast: nirdiṣṭa kālera janya āmi yadi tādera hate śāsti sthagita rākhi tave tārā niścaẏai valave, ‘kise seṭā nivāraṇa karache?’ sāvadhāna! ye dina tādera nikaṭa śāsti āsave sedina tādera nikaṭa hate tā nivṛtta karā have nā evaṃ yā niẏe tārā ṭhāṭṭā-vidraƒpa kare tā tāderake pariveṣṭana karave.
11:8.latin_ascii: nirdista kalera janya ami yadi tadera hate sasti sthagita rakhi tave tara niscayai valave, ‘kise seta nivarana karachey’ savadhana! ye dina tadera nikata sasti asave sedina tadera nikata hate ta nivrtta kara have na evam ya niye tara thatta-vidraƒpa kare ta taderake parivestana karave.

11:9.latin_iast: āra yadi āmi mānuṣake āmāra pakṣa theke anugraha āsvādana karāi o pare tāra nikaṭa hate tā chiniẏe nei takhana se avaśyai hatāśa o akṛtajña have.
11:9.latin_ascii: ara yadi ami manusake amara paksa theke anugraha asvadana karai o pare tara nikata hate ta chiniye nei takhana se avasyai hatasa o akrtajna have.

11:10.latin_iast: āra yadi duḥkha-kaṣṭa sparśa karāra para āmi tāke sukha-sampada āsvādana karāi takhana se avaśyai valave, ‘āmāra vipada-āpada keṭe geche’, āra se haẏa utphula− o ahaṃkārī.
11:10.latin_ascii: ara yadi duhkha-kasta sparsa karara para ami take sukha-sampada asvadana karai takhana se avasyai valave, ‘amara vipada-apada kete geche’, ara se haya utphula− o ahamkari.

11:11.latin_iast: kintu yārā dhairyyaśīla o sat karmaparāẏaṇa tāderai janya āche kṣamā o mahā puraskāra.
11:11.latin_ascii: kintu yara dhairyyasila o sat karmaparayana taderai janya ache ksama o maha puraskara.

11:12.latin_iast: tave ki tomāra prati yā oẏāhī karā haẏeche tāra kichu tumi varjana karave evaṃ ete tomāra mana saṃkucita have ejanya ye, tārā vale, ‘tāra nikaṭa dhana-bhāṇḍāra prerita haẏa nā kena athavā tāra sāthe phereśtā āse nā kena?’ tumi kevala satarkakārī evaṃ āllāha sarva viṣaẏera karmavidhāẏaka.
11:12.latin_ascii: tave ki tomara prati ya oyahi kara hayeche tara kichu tumi varjana karave evam ete tomara mana samkucita have ejanya ye, tara vale, ‘tara nikata dhana-bhandara prerita haya na kena athava tara sathe pheresta ase na kenay’ tumi kevala satarkakari evam allaha sarva visayera karmavidhayaka.

11:13.latin_iast: tārā ki vale: ‘se eṭā nije racanā kareche?’ vala: ‘tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave tomarā era anurūpa daśaṭi svaracita sūrā ānaẏana kara evaṃ āllāha vyatīta apara yāke pāra ḍeke nāo.’
11:13.latin_ascii: tara ki vale: ‘se eta nije racana karechey’ vala: ‘tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave tomara era anurupa dasati svaracita sura anayana kara evam allaha vyatita apara yake para deke nao.’

11:14.latin_iast: tārā yadi tomādera āhvāne sār̤ā nā deẏa tave jene rākha, eṭā āllāhara ‘ilma motāveka avatīrṇa evaṃ tini vyatīta anya kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei. tāhale tomarā ātmasamarpaṇakārī have ki?
11:14.latin_ascii: tara yadi tomadera ahvane sara na deya tave jene rakha, eta allahara ‘ilma motaveka avatirna evam tini vyatita anya kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei. tahale tomara atmasamarpanakari have kiy

11:15.latin_iast: ye vyakti pārthiva jīvana o tāra saundarya kāmanā kare, duniẏāte āmi tādera karmera pūrṇa phala dāna kari evaṃ sethāẏa tāderake kama deẏā have nā.
11:15.latin_ascii: ye vyakti parthiva jivana o tara saundarya kamana kare, duniyate ami tadera karmera purna phala dana kari evam sethaya taderake kama deya have na.

11:16.latin_iast: tādera janya ākhirāte agni vyatīta anya kichui nei evaṃ tārā yā kare ākhirāte tā niṣphala have evaṃ tārā yā kare thāke tā nirarthaka.
11:16.latin_ascii: tadera janya akhirate agni vyatita anya kichui nei evam tara ya kare akhirate ta nisphala have evam tara ya kare thake ta nirarthaka.

11:17.latin_iast: tārā ki tādera samatulya yārā pratiṣṭhita tādera pratipālaka prerita spaṣṭa pramāṇera opara, yāra anusaraṇa kare tā~ra prerita sākṣī evaṃ yāra pūrve chila mūsāra kitāva ādarśa o anugrahasvarūpa? tārāi ete viśvāsī. anyānya dalera yārā eke asvīkāra kare, agnii tādera pratiśra“ta sthāna. sutarāṃ tumi ete sandehe nipatita haẏo nā. eṭā to tomāra pratipālaka prerita satya, kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa viśvāsa kare nā.
11:17.latin_ascii: tara ki tadera samatulya yara pratisthita tadera pratipalaka prerita spasta pramanera opara, yara anusarana kare ta~ra prerita saksi evam yara purve chila musara kitava adarsa o anugrahasvarupay tarai ete visvasi. anyanya dalera yara eke asvikara kare, agnii tadera pratisra“ta sthana. sutaram tumi ete sandehe nipatita hayo na. eta to tomara pratipalaka prerita satya, kintu adhikamsa manusa visvasa kare na.

11:18.latin_iast: yārā āllāha samvandhe mithyā racanā kare tādera apekṣā adhika jālima āra ke? tāderake upasthita karā have tādera pratipālakera sammukhe evaṃ sākṣīgaṇa valave, ‘erāi edera pratipālakera viruddhe mithyā āropa karechila.’ sāvadhāna! āllāhara lā‘nata jālimadera opara,
11:18.latin_ascii: yara allaha samvandhe mithya racana kare tadera apeksa adhika jalima ara key taderake upasthita kara have tadera pratipalakera sammukhe evam saksigana valave, ‘erai edera pratipalakera viruddhe mithya aropa karechila.’ savadhana! allahara la‘nata jalimadera opara,

11:19.latin_iast: yārā āllāhara pathe vādhā deẏa evaṃ ete vakratā anusandhāna kare; āra erāi ākhirātake asvīkāra kare.
11:19.latin_ascii: yara allahara pathe vadha deya evam ete vakrata anusandhana kare; ara erai akhiratake asvikara kare.

11:20.latin_iast: tārā pṛthivīte āllāhake apāraga karate pārata nā evaṃ āllāha vyatīta tādera apara kona abhibhāvaka chila nā; tādera śāsti dviguṇa karā have; tādera śonāra sāmarthyao chila nā evaṃ tārā dekhateo pārata nā.
11:20.latin_ascii: tara prthivite allahake aparaga karate parata na evam allaha vyatita tadera apara kona abhibhavaka chila na; tadera sasti dviguna kara have; tadera sonara samarthyao chila na evam tara dekhateo parata na.

11:21.latin_iast: tārā nijerāi nijedera kṣati karala evaṃ tārā ye alīka kalpanā karata tā tādera nikaṭa hate udhāo haẏe gela.
11:21.latin_ascii: tara nijerai nijedera ksati karala evam tara ye alika kalpana karata ta tadera nikata hate udhao haye gela.

11:23.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā mu’mina, satkarmaparāẏaṇa evaṃ tādera pratipālakera prati vinaẏāvanata, tārāi jānnātera adhivāsī, sekhāne tārā sthāẏī have.
11:23.latin_ascii: niscayai yara mu’mina, satkarmaparayana evam tadera pratipalakera prati vinayavanata, tarai jannatera adhivasi, sekhane tara sthayi have.

11:24.latin_iast: du’ śreṇira lokera upamā yemana ekajana andha o vadhira evaṃ aparajana cakṣusmāna o śravaṇaśaktisampanna, tulanāẏa e du’ṭi ki samāna?
11:24.latin_ascii: du’ srenira lokera upama yemana ekajana andha o vadhira evam aparajana caksusmana o sravanasaktisampanna, tulanaya e du’ti ki samanay

11:25.latin_iast: āmi nūhke tāra sampradāẏera nikaṭa pāṭhiẏechilāma. se valechila, ‘āmi avaśyai tomādera janya prakāśya satarkakārī,
11:25.latin_ascii: ami nuhke tara sampradayera nikata pathiyechilama. se valechila, ‘ami avasyai tomadera janya prakasya satarkakari,

11:26.latin_iast: tomarā āllāha vyatīta anya kichura ‘ivādata kara nā; āmi tomādera janya eka yantraṇādāẏaka divasera śāstira āśaṅkā kari.’
11:26.latin_ascii: tomara allaha vyatita anya kichura ‘ivadata kara na; ami tomadera janya eka yantranadayaka divasera sastira asanka kari.’

11:27.latin_iast: tāra sampradāẏera pradhānerā yārā chila kāphira tārā valala: ‘āmarā tomāke āmādera mata mānuṣa vyatīta kichu dekhachi nā; āmarā dekhachi, tomāra anusaraṇa karache kevala tārāi, yārā āmādera madhye vāhya dṛṣṭitei adhama evaṃ āmādera opara tomādera kona śreṣṭhatva dekhachi nā, varaṃ āmarā tomāderake mithyāvādī mane kari.’
11:27.latin_ascii: tara sampradayera pradhanera yara chila kaphira tara valala: ‘amara tomake amadera mata manusa vyatita kichu dekhachi na; amara dekhachi, tomara anusarana karache kevala tarai, yara amadera madhye vahya drstitei adhama evam amadera opara tomadera kona sresthatva dekhachi na, varam amara tomaderake mithyavadi mane kari.’

11:28.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā ki bheve dekhacha, āmi yadi āmāra pratipālaka prerita spaṣṭa nidarśane pratiṣṭhita thāki evaṃ tini āmāke tā~ra nija anugraha hate dāna kare thākena, yā tomādera nikaṭa gopana rākhā haẏeche, āmi ki e avasthāẏa tomāderake vādhya karate pāri, athaca tomarā eṭā apachanda kara?
11:28.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara ki bheve dekhacha, ami yadi amara pratipalaka prerita spasta nidarsane pratisthita thaki evam tini amake ta~ra nija anugraha hate dana kare thakena, ya tomadera nikata gopana rakha hayeche, ami ki e avasthaya tomaderake vadhya karate pari, athaca tomara eta apachanda karay

11:29.latin_iast: he āmāra sampradāẏa! era vinimaẏe āmi tomādera nikaṭa dhana-sampada cāi nā. āmāra pāriśramika āllāharai nikaṭa evaṃ mu’minaderake tār̤iẏe deẏā āmāra kāja naẏa; tārā niścitabhāve tādera pratipālakera sākṣāta lābha karave. kintu āmi dekhachi, tomarā eka ajña sampradāẏa.
11:29.latin_ascii: he amara sampradaya! era vinimaye ami tomadera nikata dhana-sampada cai na. amara parisramika allaharai nikata evam mu’minaderake tariye deya amara kaja naya; tara niscitabhave tadera pratipalakera saksata labha karave. kintu ami dekhachi, tomara eka ajna sampradaya.

11:30.latin_iast: he āmāra sampradāẏa! āmi yadi tāderake tār̤iẏe dei, tave āllāhara pākar̤āo hate āmāke ke rakṣā karave? tavuo ki tomarā upadeśa grahaṇa karave nā?
11:30.latin_ascii: he amara sampradaya! ami yadi taderake tariye dei, tave allahara pakarao hate amake ke raksa karavey tavuo ki tomara upadesa grahana karave nay

11:31.latin_iast: āmi tomāderake vali nā ye, ‘āmāra nikaṭa āllāhara dhana-bhāṇḍāra āche’, āra nā adṛśya samvandhe āmi avagata evaṃ āmi eṭāo vali nā ye, āmi phereśtā. tomādera dṛṣṭite yārā heẏa tādera samvandhe āmi ekathāo vali nā ye, āllāha tāderake kakhanai maṅgala dāna karavena nā; tādera antare yā āche tā āllāha samyaka avagata. (erakama kathā valale) āmi avaśyai jālimadera antarbhukta hava.’
11:31.latin_ascii: ami tomaderake vali na ye, ‘amara nikata allahara dhana-bhandara ache’, ara na adrsya samvandhe ami avagata evam ami etao vali na ye, ami pheresta. tomadera drstite yara heya tadera samvandhe ami ekathao vali na ye, allaha taderake kakhanai mangala dana karavena na; tadera antare ya ache ta allaha samyaka avagata. (erakama katha valale) ami avasyai jalimadera antarbhukta hava.’

11:32.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he nūh! tumi to āmādera sāthe jhagar̤ā karecha tumi jhagar̤ā karecha āmādera sāthe ati mātrāẏa; sutarāṃ tumi satyavādī hale āmāderake yāra bhaẏa dekhāccha tā ānaẏana kara.’
11:32.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he nuh! tumi to amadera sathe jhagara karecha tumi jhagara karecha amadera sathe ati matraya; sutaram tumi satyavadi hale amaderake yara bhaya dekhaccha ta anayana kara.’

11:33.latin_iast: se valala: ‘icchā karale āllāhai tā tomādera nikaṭa upasthita karavena evaṃ tomarā tā vyartha karate pārave nā.
11:33.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘iccha karale allahai ta tomadera nikata upasthita karavena evam tomara ta vyartha karate parave na.

11:34.latin_iast: āmi tomāderake upadeśa dite cāileo āmāra upadeśa tomādera upakāre āsave nā, yadi āllāha tomāderake vibhrānta karate cāna. tinii tomādera pratipālaka evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa tomādera pratyāvartana have.
11:34.latin_ascii: ami tomaderake upadesa dite caileo amara upadesa tomadera upakare asave na, yadi allaha tomaderake vibhranta karate cana. tinii tomadera pratipalaka evam ta~rai nikata tomadera pratyavartana have.

11:35.latin_iast: tārā ki vale ye, se eṭā racanā kareche? vala: ‘āmi yadi eṭā racanā kare thāki, tave āmii āmāra aparādhera janya dāẏī hava. tomarā ye aparādha karacha tā hate āmi dāẏamukta.’
11:35.latin_ascii: tara ki vale ye, se eta racana karechey vala: ‘ami yadi eta racana kare thaki, tave amii amara aparadhera janya dayi hava. tomara ye aparadha karacha ta hate ami dayamukta.’

11:36.latin_iast: nūhera prati oẏāhī karā haẏechila, ‘yārā īmāna eneche tārā vyatīta tomāra sampradāẏera anya keu kakhanao īmāna ānave nā. sutarāṃ tārā yā kare tajjanye tumi duḥkhita haio nā.
11:36.latin_ascii: nuhera prati oyahi kara hayechila, ‘yara imana eneche tara vyatita tomara sampradayera anya keu kakhanao imana anave na. sutaram tara ya kare tajjanye tumi duhkhita haio na.

11:37.latin_iast: tumi āmāra cokhera sāmane o āmāra oẏāhī anuyāẏī naukā nirmāṇa kara evaṃ yārā sīmā laṅghana kareche tādera samparke tumi āmāke kichu valo nā; niścaẏai tārā to nimajjita have.’
11:37.latin_ascii: tumi amara cokhera samane o amara oyahi anuyayi nauka nirmana kara evam yara sima langhana kareche tadera samparke tumi amake kichu valo na; niscayai tara to nimajjita have.’

11:38.latin_iast: se naukā nirmāṇa karate lāgala evaṃ yakhanai tāra sampradāẏera pradhānerā tāra nikaṭa diẏe yeta, tāke upahāsa karata; se valala: ‘tomarā yadi āmāderake upahāsa kara tave āmarāo tomāderake upahāsa karava, yemana tomarā upahāsa karacha;
11:38.latin_ascii: se nauka nirmana karate lagala evam yakhanai tara sampradayera pradhanera tara nikata diye yeta, take upahasa karata; se valala: ‘tomara yadi amaderake upahasa kara tave amarao tomaderake upahasa karava, yemana tomara upahasa karacha;

11:39.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tomarā acirei jānate pārave, kāra opara āsave lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti āra kāra opara patita have sthāẏī śāsti.’
11:39.latin_ascii: sutaram tomara acirei janate parave, kara opara asave lanchanadayaka sasti ara kara opara patita have sthayi sasti.’

11:40.latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana āmāra ādeśa āsala evaṃ unāna uthaliẏe uṭhala; āmi valalāma, ‘ete uṭhiẏe nāo pratyeka śreṇira yugalera du’ṭi, yādera viruddhe pūrva-siddhānta haẏeche tārā vyatīta tomāra parivāra-parijanake evaṃ yārā īmāna eneche tāderakeo (tule nāo).’ tāra saṅge īmāna enechila alpa kaẏekajana.
11:40.latin_ascii: avasese yakhana amara adesa asala evam unana uthaliye uthala; ami valalama, ‘ete uthiye nao pratyeka srenira yugalera du’ti, yadera viruddhe purva-siddhanta hayeche tara vyatita tomara parivara-parijanake evam yara imana eneche taderakeo (tule nao).’ tara sange imana enechila alpa kayekajana.

11:41.latin_iast: se valala: ‘ete ārohaṇa kara, āllāhara nāme era gati o sthiti, āmāra pratipālaka avaśyai kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.’
11:41.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ete arohana kara, allahara name era gati o sthiti, amara pratipalaka avasyai ksamasila, parama dayalu.’

11:42.latin_iast: parvata sadṛśa taraṅgera madhye tā tāderake niẏe veẏe calala; nūh tāra putrake, ye tādera theke pṛthaka chila tāke āhvāna kare valala: ‘he āmāra putra! āmādera saṅge ārohaṇa kara evaṃ kāphiradera saṅgī haẏo nā.’
11:42.latin_ascii: parvata sadrsa tarangera madhye ta taderake niye veye calala; nuh tara putrake, ye tadera theke prthaka chila take ahvana kare valala: ‘he amara putra! amadera sange arohana kara evam kaphiradera sangi hayo na.’

11:43.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmi emana eka parvate āśraẏa niva yā āmāke plāvana hate rakṣā karave.’ se valala: ‘āja āllāhara hukuma hate rakṣā karāra keu nei, tave yāke āllāha daẏā karavena se vyatīta. erapara taraṅga tādera ubhaẏera mājhe ār̤āla kare dila evaṃ se nimajjitadera
11:43.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ami emana eka parvate asraya niva ya amake plavana hate raksa karave.’ se valala: ‘aja allahara hukuma hate raksa karara keu nei, tave yake allaha daya karavena se vyatita. erapara taranga tadera ubhayera majhe arala kare dila evam se nimajjitadera

11:44.latin_iast: erapara valā hala, ‘he pṛthivī! tumi tomāra pāni grāsa kare nāo evaṃ he ākāśa! kṣānta hao.’ erapara vanyā praśamita hala evaṃ kārya samāpta hala, naukā judī parvatera opara sthira hala evaṃ valā hala, jālima sampradāẏa dhvaṃsa hoka.
11:44.latin_ascii: erapara vala hala, ‘he prthivi! tumi tomara pani grasa kare nao evam he akasa! ksanta hao.’ erapara vanya prasamita hala evam karya samapta hala, nauka judi parvatera opara sthira hala evam vala hala, jalima sampradaya dhvamsa hoka.

11:45.latin_iast: nūh tāra pratipālakake samvodhana kare valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāra putra āmāra parivārabhukta evaṃ āpanāra pratiśruti satya, āra āpani to vicārakadera madhye śreṣṭha vicāraka.’
11:45.latin_ascii: nuh tara pratipalakake samvodhana kare valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! amara putra amara parivarabhukta evam apanara pratisruti satya, ara apani to vicarakadera madhye srestha vicaraka.’

11:46.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘he nūh! se tomāra parivārabhukta naẏa. se avaśyai asatkarmaparāẏaṇa. sutarāṃ ye viṣaẏe tomāra jñāna nei se viṣaẏe āmāke anurodha karo nā. āmi tomāke upadeśa dicchi, tumi yena ajñadera antarbhukta nā hao.’
11:46.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘he nuh! se tomara parivarabhukta naya. se avasyai asatkarmaparayana. sutaram ye visaye tomara jnana nei se visaye amake anurodha karo na. ami tomake upadesa dicchi, tumi yena ajnadera antarbhukta na hao.’

11:47.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! ye viṣaẏe āmāra jñāna nei, se viṣaẏe āpanāra kāche cāoẏā theke āśraẏa cācchi. āpani yadi āmāke kṣamā nā karena evaṃ āmāke daẏā nā karena, tave āmi kṣatigrastadera antarbhukta hava.’
11:47.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! ye visaye amara jnana nei, se visaye apanara kache caoya theke asraya cacchi. apani yadi amake ksama na karena evam amake daya na karena, tave ami ksatigrastadera antarbhukta hava.’

11:48.latin_iast: valā hala, ‘he nūh! avataraṇa kara āmāra pakṣa hate śānti o kalyāṇasaha evaṃ tomāra prati o ye samasta sampradāẏa tomāra saṅge āche tādera prati; apara sampradāẏasamūhake āmi jīvana upabhoga karate deva, pare āmāra pakṣa hate yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti tāderake sparśa karave;
11:48.latin_ascii: vala hala, ‘he nuh! avatarana kara amara paksa hate santi o kalyanasaha evam tomara prati o ye samasta sampradaya tomara sange ache tadera prati; apara sampradayasamuhake ami jivana upabhoga karate deva, pare amara paksa hate yantranadayaka sasti taderake sparsa karave;

11:49.latin_iast: e samasta adṛśyalokera saṃvāda āmi tomāke oẏāhī dvārā avahita karachi, yā era pūrve tumi jānate nā evaṃ tomāra sampradāẏao jānata nā. sutarāṃ dhairya dhāraṇa kara, śubha pariṇāma muttākīderai janya.’
11:49.latin_ascii: e samasta adrsyalokera samvada ami tomake oyahi dvara avahita karachi, ya era purve tumi janate na evam tomara sampradayao janata na. sutaram dhairya dharana kara, subha parinama muttakiderai janya.’

11:50.latin_iast: ‘āda jātira nikaṭa tādera bhrātā hūdake pāṭhiẏechilāma se valechila: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā āllāhara ‘ivādata kara. tini vyatīta tomādera anya kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei. tomarā kevala mithyā racanākārī.
11:50.latin_ascii: ‘ada jatira nikata tadera bhrata hudake pathiyechilama se valechila: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara allahara ‘ivadata kara. tini vyatita tomadera anya kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei. tomara kevala mithya racanakari.

11:51.latin_iast: he āmāra sampradāẏa! āmi era vinimaẏe tomādera nikaṭa kona pāriśramika cāi nā. āmāra pāriśramika āche tā~rai nikaṭa, yini āmāke sṛṣṭi karechena. tomarā ki tavuo anudhāvana karave nā?
11:51.latin_ascii: he amara sampradaya! ami era vinimaye tomadera nikata kona parisramika cai na. amara parisramika ache ta~rai nikata, yini amake srsti karechena. tomara ki tavuo anudhavana karave nay

11:52.latin_iast: he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā tomādera pratipālakera nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā kara, ataḥpara anuśocanā bhare tā~ra dikei phire āsa. tini tomādera janya pracura vāri varṣāvena. tini tomāderake ārao śakti diẏe tomādera śakti vṛddhi karavena āra tomarā aparādhī haẏe mukha phiriẏe nio nā.’
11:52.latin_ascii: he amara sampradaya! tomara tomadera pratipalakera nikata ksama prarthana kara, atahpara anusocana bhare ta~ra dikei phire asa. tini tomadera janya pracura vari varsavena. tini tomaderake arao sakti diye tomadera sakti vrddhi karavena ara tomara aparadhi haye mukha phiriye nio na.’

11:53.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he hūda! tumi āmādera nikaṭa kona spaṣṭa pramāṇa ānaẏana karani, tomāra kathāẏa āmarā āmādera upāsyaderake parityāga karava nā evaṃ āmarā tomāke viśvāsa kari nā.
11:53.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he huda! tumi amadera nikata kona spasta pramana anayana karani, tomara kathaya amara amadera upasyaderake parityaga karava na evam amara tomake visvasa kari na.

11:54.latin_iast: āmarā eṭāi vali: āmādera upāsyadera madhye keu tomāke aśubha dvārā āviṣṭa kareche.’ se valala: ‘āmi āllāhake sākṣī karachi evaṃ tomarāo sākṣī hao ye, niścaẏai āmi tā hate mukta yāke tomarā āllāhara sāthe śarīka kara.
11:54.latin_ascii: amara etai vali: amadera upasyadera madhye keu tomake asubha dvara avista kareche.’ se valala: ‘ami allahake saksi karachi evam tomarao saksi hao ye, niscayai ami ta hate mukta yake tomara allahara sathe sarika kara.

11:55.latin_iast: āllāha vyatīta. tomarā sakale āmāra viruddhe ṣar̤ayantra kara; āra āmāke avakāśa dio nā.
11:55.latin_ascii: allaha vyatita. tomara sakale amara viruddhe sarayantra kara; ara amake avakasa dio na.

11:56.latin_iast: ‘āmi nirbhara kari āmāra o tomādera pratipālaka āllāhara opara; emana kona jīvajantu nei, ye tā~ra pūrṇa āẏattādhīna naẏa; niścaẏai āmāra pratipālaka āchena sarala pathe.
11:56.latin_ascii: ‘ami nirbhara kari amara o tomadera pratipalaka allahara opara; emana kona jivajantu nei, ye ta~ra purna ayattadhina naya; niscayai amara pratipalaka achena sarala pathe.

11:57.latin_iast: erapareo yadi tomarā mukha phiriẏe nāo āmi yā niẏe tomādera nikaṭa prerita haẏechi, (tave jene rekha) avaśyai tā tomādera nikaṭa pau~che diẏechi; evaṃ āmāra pratipālaka tomādera parivarte kona sampradāẏake tomādera sthalābhiṣikta karavena evaṃ tomarā tā~ra kona kṣati sādhana karate pārave nā. niścaẏai āmāra pratipālaka samasta kichura rakṣaṇāvekṣaṇakārī.’
11:57.latin_ascii: erapareo yadi tomara mukha phiriye nao ami ya niye tomadera nikata prerita hayechi, (tave jene rekha) avasyai ta tomadera nikata pau~che diyechi; evam amara pratipalaka tomadera parivarte kona sampradayake tomadera sthalabhisikta karavena evam tomara ta~ra kona ksati sadhana karate parave na. niscayai amara pratipalaka samasta kichura raksanaveksanakari.’

11:58.latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmāra nirdeśa āsala takhana āmi hūda o tāra saṅge yārā īmāna enechila tāderake āmāra anugrahe rakṣā karalāma evaṃ rakṣā karalāma tāderake kaṭhina śāsti hate.
11:58.latin_ascii: evam yakhana amara nirdesa asala takhana ami huda o tara sange yara imana enechila taderake amara anugrahe raksa karalama evam raksa karalama taderake kathina sasti hate.

11:59.latin_iast: e ‘āda jāti tādera pratipālakera nidarśana asvīkāra karechila evaṃ amānya karechila tā~ra rāsūlagaṇake evaṃ tārā pratyeka uddhata svairācārīra nirdeśa anusaraṇa karechila.
11:59.latin_ascii: e ‘ada jati tadera pratipalakera nidarsana asvikara karechila evam amanya karechila ta~ra rasulaganake evam tara pratyeka uddhata svairacarira nirdesa anusarana karechila.

11:60.latin_iast: e duniẏāẏa tāderake karā haẏechila lā‘natagrasta evaṃ tārā kiẏāmatera dineo lā‘natagrasta have jene rekha! ‘āda sampradāẏa tādera pratipālakake asvīkāra karechila. jene rekha! hūdera sampradāẏa ‘ādera śeṣa pariṇāma dhvaṃsa.
11:60.latin_ascii: e duniyaya taderake kara hayechila la‘natagrasta evam tara kiyamatera dineo la‘natagrasta have jene rekha! ‘ada sampradaya tadera pratipalakake asvikara karechila. jene rekha! hudera sampradaya ‘adera sesa parinama dhvamsa.

11:61.latin_iast: āmi sāmūda jātira nikaṭa tādera bhrātā sālihke pāṭhiẏechilāma. se valechila: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! ‘tomarā āllāhara ‘ivādata kara, tini vyatīta tomādera anya kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei. tini tomāderake mṛttikā hate sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tātei tini tomāderake vasavāsa kariẏechena. sutarāṃ tomarā tā~ra nikaṭe kṣamā prārthanā kara āra tā~ra dikei pratyāvartana kara. niścaẏai āmāra pratipālaka nikaṭe, tini āhvāne sār̤ā dena.’
11:61.latin_ascii: ami samuda jatira nikata tadera bhrata salihke pathiyechilama. se valechila: ‘he amara sampradaya! ‘tomara allahara ‘ivadata kara, tini vyatita tomadera anya kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei. tini tomaderake mrttika hate srsti karechena evam tatei tini tomaderake vasavasa kariyechena. sutaram tomara ta~ra nikate ksama prarthana kara ara ta~ra dikei pratyavartana kara. niscayai amara pratipalaka nikate, tini ahvane sara dena.’

11:62.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he sāleh! era pūrve tumi chile āmādera āśā bharasāra pātra. tumi ki āmāderake niṣedha karacha ‘ivādata karate tādera, yādera ‘ivādata karata āmādera pitṛ-puruṣerā? āmarā avaśyai vibhrāntikara sandehe raẏechi se viṣaẏe, yāra prati tumi āmāderake āhvāna karacha.’
11:62.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he saleh! era purve tumi chile amadera asa bharasara patra. tumi ki amaderake nisedha karacha ‘ivadata karate tadera, yadera ‘ivadata karata amadera pitr-puruseray amara avasyai vibhrantikara sandehe rayechi se visaye, yara prati tumi amaderake ahvana karacha.’

11:63.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā ki bheve dekhecha, āmi yadi āmāra pratipālaka prerita spaṣṭa pramāṇe pratiṣṭhita haẏe thāki evaṃ tini yadi āmāke tā~ra nija anugraha dāna kare thākena, tave āllāhara śāsti hate āmāke ke rakṣā karave, āmi yadi tā~ra avādhyatā kari? sutarāṃ tomarā to kevala āmāra kṣatii vār̤iẏe diccha.
11:63.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara ki bheve dekhecha, ami yadi amara pratipalaka prerita spasta pramane pratisthita haye thaki evam tini yadi amake ta~ra nija anugraha dana kare thakena, tave allahara sasti hate amake ke raksa karave, ami yadi ta~ra avadhyata kariy sutaram tomara to kevala amara ksatii variye diccha.

11:64.latin_iast: he āmāra sampradāẏa! eṭā āllāhara uṣṭrī tomādera janya nidarśanasvarūpa; eke āllāhara jamite care khete dāo. eke kona kaṣṭa dio nā, kaṣṭa dile āśu śāsti tomādera opara āpatita have.’
11:64.latin_ascii: he amara sampradaya! eta allahara ustri tomadera janya nidarsanasvarupa; eke allahara jamite care khete dao. eke kona kasta dio na, kasta dile asu sasti tomadera opara apatita have.’

11:65.latin_iast: kintu tārā tāke javeha karala. ataḥpara se valala: ‘tomarā tomādera gṛhe tina dina jīvana upabhoga kare nāo. eṭā ekaṭi pratiśruti yā mithyā haoẏāra naẏa.’
11:65.latin_ascii: kintu tara take javeha karala. atahpara se valala: ‘tomara tomadera grhe tina dina jivana upabhoga kare nao. eta ekati pratisruti ya mithya haoyara naya.’

11:66.latin_iast: yakhana āmāra nirdeśa āsala takhana āmi sālih o tā~ra saṅge yārā īmāna enechila tāderake āmāra anugrahe rakṣā karalāma evaṃ rakṣā karalāma se dinera lāñchanā hate. niścaẏai tomāra pratipālaka śaktimāna, parākramaśālī.
11:66.latin_ascii: yakhana amara nirdesa asala takhana ami salih o ta~ra sange yara imana enechila taderake amara anugrahe raksa karalama evam raksa karalama se dinera lanchana hate. niscayai tomara pratipalaka saktimana, parakramasali.

11:67.latin_iast: āra yārā sīmālaṅghana karechila tāderake eka pracaṇḍa dhvani ese āghāta karala; phale tārā nija nija gṛhe natajānu avasthāẏa śeṣa haẏe gela;
11:67.latin_ascii: ara yara simalanghana karechila taderake eka pracanda dhvani ese aghata karala; phale tara nija nija grhe natajanu avasthaya sesa haye gela;

11:68.latin_iast: yena tārā sethāẏa kakhanao vasavāsa kareni. jene rekha! sāmūda sampradāẏa tādera pratipālakake asvīkāra karechila. jene rekha! dhvaṃsai hala sāmūda sampradāẏera pariṇāma.
11:68.latin_ascii: yena tara sethaya kakhanao vasavasa kareni. jene rekha! samuda sampradaya tadera pratipalakake asvikara karechila. jene rekha! dhvamsai hala samuda sampradayera parinama.

11:69.latin_iast: āmāra phereśtāgaṇa to susaṃvāda niẏe ivrāhīmera nikaṭa āsala. tārā valala: ‘sālāma.’ seo valala: ‘sālāma.’ se avilamve eka kāvāvakṛta go-vatsa niẏe āsala.
11:69.latin_ascii: amara pherestagana to susamvada niye ivrahimera nikata asala. tara valala: ‘salama.’ seo valala: ‘salama.’ se avilamve eka kavavakrta go-vatsa niye asala.

11:70.latin_iast: se yakhana dekhala tādera hāta tāra dike prasārita hacche nā, takhana tāderake avāñchita mane karala evaṃ tādera samvandhe tāra mane bhīti sañcāra hala. tārā valala: ‘bhaẏa kara nā, āmarā lūtera sampradāẏera prati prerita haẏechi.’
11:70.latin_ascii: se yakhana dekhala tadera hata tara dike prasarita hacche na, takhana taderake avanchita mane karala evam tadera samvandhe tara mane bhiti sancara hala. tara valala: ‘bhaya kara na, amara lutera sampradayera prati prerita hayechi.’

11:71.latin_iast: āra tāra strī daṇḍāẏamāna chila evaṃ se hese phelala. ataḥpara āmi tāke ishākera o ishākera paravartī iẏā‘kūvera susaṃvāda dilāma.
11:71.latin_ascii: ara tara stri dandayamana chila evam se hese phelala. atahpara ami take ishakera o ishakera paravarti iya‘kuvera susamvada dilama.

11:72.latin_iast: se valala: ‘kī āścarya! santānera jananī hava āmi, ekhana āmi vṛddhā evaṃ e āmāra svāmī vṛddha! eṭā avaśyai eka adbhuta vyāpāra!’
11:72.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ki ascarya! santanera janani hava ami, ekhana ami vrddha evam e amara svami vrddha! eta avasyai eka adbhuta vyapara!’

11:73.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āllāhara kāje tumi āścaryavodha karacha? he parivāravarga! tomādera prati raẏeche āllāhara anugraha o kalyāṇa. tini praśaṃsita o sammānita.’
11:73.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘allahara kaje tumi ascaryavodha karachay he parivaravarga! tomadera prati rayeche allahara anugraha o kalyana. tini prasamsita o sammanita.’

11:74.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana ivrāhīmera bhīti dūrībhūta hala evaṃ tāra nikaṭa susaṃvāda āsala takhana se lūtera sampradāẏera samvandhe āmāra sāthe vādānuvāda karate lāgala.
11:74.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana ivrahimera bhiti duribhuta hala evam tara nikata susamvada asala takhana se lutera sampradayera samvandhe amara sathe vadanuvada karate lagala.

11:75.latin_iast: ivrāhīma avaśyai sahanaśīla, komala hṛdaẏa, āllāha abhimukhī.
11:75.latin_ascii: ivrahima avasyai sahanasila, komala hrdaya, allaha abhimukhi.

11:76.latin_iast: he ivrāhīma! eṭā hate virata hao; tomāra pratipālakera vidhāna ese par̤eche; tādera prati śāsti āsavei yā anivārya.
11:76.latin_ascii: he ivrahima! eta hate virata hao; tomara pratipalakera vidhana ese pareche; tadera prati sasti asavei ya anivarya.

11:77.latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmāra prerita phereśtāgaṇa lūtera nikaṭa āsala takhana tādera āgamane se viṣaṇatna hala evaṃ nijake tādera rakṣāẏa asamartha mane karala evaṃ valala: ‘eṭā vipadera dina!’
11:77.latin_ascii: evam yakhana amara prerita pherestagana lutera nikata asala takhana tadera agamane se visanatna hala evam nijake tadera raksaya asamartha mane karala evam valala: ‘eta vipadera dina!’

11:78.latin_iast: tā~ra sampradāẏa tā~ra nikaṭa udbhrānta haẏe chuṭe āsala evaṃ pūrva hate tārā kukarme lipta chila. se valala: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! erā āmāra kanyā, tomādera janya erā pavitra. sutarāṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara evaṃ āmāra mehamānadera vyāpāre āmāke heẏa kara nā. tomādera madhye ki kona bhāla mānuṣa nei?’
11:78.latin_ascii: ta~ra sampradaya ta~ra nikata udbhranta haye chute asala evam purva hate tara kukarme lipta chila. se valala: ‘he amara sampradaya! era amara kanya, tomadera janya era pavitra. sutaram allahake bhaya kara evam amara mehamanadera vyapare amake heya kara na. tomadera madhye ki kona bhala manusa neiy’

11:79.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘tumi to jāna, tomāra kanyāderake āmādera kona praẏojana nei; āmarā kī cāi tā to tumi jānai.’
11:79.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘tumi to jana, tomara kanyaderake amadera kona prayojana nei; amara ki cai ta to tumi janai.’

11:80.latin_iast: se valala: ‘tomādera opara yadi āmāra śakti thākata athavā yadi āmi āśraẏa nite pāratāma kona sudṛr̤ha stambhera!
11:80.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘tomadera opara yadi amara sakti thakata athava yadi ami asraya nite paratama kona sudrrha stambhera!

11:81.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he lūta! niścaẏai āmarā tomāra pratipālakera pakṣa theke prerita phereśatā. tārā kakhanai tomāra nikaṭa pau~chate pārave nā. sutarāṃ tumi rātera kona eka samaẏe tomāra parivāravargasaha vera haẏe par̤a evaṃ tomādera madhye keu pichana dike tākāve nā, tomāra strī vyatīta (se tomādera saṅgī have nā). tādera yā ghaṭave tārao tāi ghaṭave. niścaẏai prabhāta tādera janya nirdhārita samaẏa. prabhāta ki nikaṭavartī naẏa?
11:81.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he luta! niscayai amara tomara pratipalakera paksa theke prerita pheresata. tara kakhanai tomara nikata pau~chate parave na. sutaram tumi ratera kona eka samaye tomara parivaravargasaha vera haye para evam tomadera madhye keu pichana dike takave na, tomara stri vyatita (se tomadera sangi have na). tadera ya ghatave tarao tai ghatave. niscayai prabhata tadera janya nirdharita samaya. prabhata ki nikatavarti nayay

11:82.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana āmāra ādeśa āsala takhana āmi janapadake opara-nīca kare ulṭiẏe dilāma evaṃ tādera opara kramāgata varṣaṇa karalāma prastara kaṅkara,
11:82.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana amara adesa asala takhana ami janapadake opara-nica kare ultiye dilama evam tadera opara kramagata varsana karalama prastara kankara,

11:83.latin_iast: yā tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa cihi“ta chila. eṭā yālimadera hate dūre naẏa.
11:83.latin_ascii: ya tomara pratipalakera nikata cihi“ta chila. eta yalimadera hate dure naya.

11:84.latin_iast: āmi mādiẏānavāsīdera nikaṭa tādera bhrātā śu‘āẏavake pāṭhiẏechilāma. se valechila, ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā āllāhara ‘ivādata kara, tini vyatīta tomādera anya kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei, māpe o ojane kama dio nā; āmi tomāderake samṛddhiśālī dekhachi, kintu āmi tomādera janya āśaṅkā karachi eka sarvagrāsī divasera śāstira.
11:84.latin_ascii: ami madiyanavasidera nikata tadera bhrata su‘ayavake pathiyechilama. se valechila, ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara allahara ‘ivadata kara, tini vyatita tomadera anya kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei, mape o ojane kama dio na; ami tomaderake samrddhisali dekhachi, kintu ami tomadera janya asanka karachi eka sarvagrasi divasera sastira.

11:85.latin_iast: he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā nyāẏasaṅgatabhāve māpa o ojana paripūrṇa kara, lokaderake tādera prāpya vastu kama dio nā evaṃ pṛthivīte viparyaẏa sṛṣṭi kare ver̤io nā.
11:85.latin_ascii: he amara sampradaya! tomara nyayasangatabhave mapa o ojana paripurna kara, lokaderake tadera prapya vastu kama dio na evam prthivite viparyaya srsti kare verio na.

11:86.latin_iast: yadi tomarā mu’mina hao tave āllāha anumodita yā vākī labhyāṃśa thākave tomādera janya tā uttama; āmi tomādera tattvāvadhāẏaka nai.’
11:86.latin_ascii: yadi tomara mu’mina hao tave allaha anumodita ya vaki labhyamsa thakave tomadera janya ta uttama; ami tomadera tattvavadhayaka nai.’

11:87.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he śu‘āẏava! tomāra sālāta ki tomāke nirdeśa deẏa ye, āmādera pitṛ-puruṣerā yāra ‘ivādata karata āmarā tā varjana kari athavā āmarā āmādera dhana-sampada samparke yā kari tāo? tumi to avaśyai sahiṣṇu, bhāla mānuṣa.’
11:87.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he su‘ayava! tomara salata ki tomake nirdesa deya ye, amadera pitr-purusera yara ‘ivadata karata amara ta varjana kari athava amara amadera dhana-sampada samparke ya kari taoy tumi to avasyai sahisnu, bhala manusa.’

11:88.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā bheve dekhecha ki, āmi yadi āmāra pratipālaka prerita spaṣṭa pramāṇe pratiṣṭhita haẏe thāki evaṃ tini yadi tā~ra nikaṭa hate āmāke utkṛṣṭa jīvanopakaraṇa dāna kare thākena tave ki kare āmi āmāra kartavya hate virata thākava? āmi tomāderake yā niṣedha kari āmi nije tā karate icchā kari nā. āmi āmāra sādhyamata saṃskāra karate cāi. āmāra kāryasādhana āllāharai sāhāyye; āmi tā~rai opara nirbhara kari evaṃ āmi tā~rai abhimukhī.
11:88.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara bheve dekhecha ki, ami yadi amara pratipalaka prerita spasta pramane pratisthita haye thaki evam tini yadi ta~ra nikata hate amake utkrsta jivanopakarana dana kare thakena tave ki kare ami amara kartavya hate virata thakavay ami tomaderake ya nisedha kari ami nije ta karate iccha kari na. ami amara sadhyamata samskara karate cai. amara karyasadhana allaharai sahayye; ami ta~rai opara nirbhara kari evam ami ta~rai abhimukhi.

11:89.latin_iast: he āmāra sampradāẏa. āmāra sāthe virodha yena kichutei tomāderake emana aparādha nā karāẏa yāte tomādera opara tāra anurūpa vipada patita haẏa yā patita haẏechila nūhera sampradāẏera opara athavā hūdera sampradāẏera opara kiṃvā sālihera sampradāẏera opara; āra lūtera sampradāẏa tomādera hate dūre naẏa.
11:89.latin_ascii: he amara sampradaya. amara sathe virodha yena kichutei tomaderake emana aparadha na karaya yate tomadera opara tara anurupa vipada patita haya ya patita hayechila nuhera sampradayera opara athava hudera sampradayera opara kimva salihera sampradayera opara; ara lutera sampradaya tomadera hate dure naya.

11:90.latin_iast: tomarā tomādera pratipālakera nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā kara o tā~ra dike pratyāvartana kara; āmāra pratipālaka parama daẏālu, bhālavāsā poṣaṇakārī.’
11:90.latin_ascii: tomara tomadera pratipalakera nikata ksama prarthana kara o ta~ra dike pratyavartana kara; amara pratipalaka parama dayalu, bhalavasa posanakari.’

11:91.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he śu‘āẏava! tumi yā vala tāra aneka kathā āmarā vujhi nā evaṃ āmarā āmādera madhye tomāke durvalai dekhachi. tomāra svajanavarga nā thākale āmarā tomāke prastara nikṣepa kare mere phelatāma, āra āmādera opara tumi śaktiśālī nao.’
11:91.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he su‘ayava! tumi ya vala tara aneka katha amara vujhi na evam amara amadera madhye tomake durvalai dekhachi. tomara svajanavarga na thakale amara tomake prastara niksepa kare mere phelatama, ara amadera opara tumi saktisali nao.’

11:92.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomādera nikaṭa ki āmāra svajanavarga āllāha apekṣā adhika śaktiśālī? tomarā tā~ke sampūrṇa paścāte phele rekhecha. tomarā yā kara āmāra pratipālaka avaśyai tā pariveṣṭana kare āchena.
11:92.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomadera nikata ki amara svajanavarga allaha apeksa adhika saktisaliy tomara ta~ke sampurna pascate phele rekhecha. tomara ya kara amara pratipalaka avasyai ta parivestana kare achena.

11:93.latin_iast: (se valala:) ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā sva sva avasthāẏa kāja karate thāka, āmio āmāra kāja karachi. tomarā śīghrai jānate pārave kāra opara āsave lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti evaṃ ke mithyāvādī? sutarāṃ tomarā pratīkṣā kara, āmio tomādera sāthe pratīkṣā karachi.’
11:93.latin_ascii: (se valala:) ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara sva sva avasthaya kaja karate thaka, amio amara kaja karachi. tomara sighrai janate parave kara opara asave lanchanadayaka sasti evam ke mithyavadiy sutaram tomara pratiksa kara, amio tomadera sathe pratiksa karachi.’

11:94.latin_iast: yakhana āmāra nirdeśa āsala takhana āmi śu‘āẏava o tāra saṅge yārā īmāna enechila tāderake āmāra anugrahe rakṣā karechilāma. ataḥpara yārā sīmālaṅghana karechila tāderake eka vikaṭa garjana āghāta karala, phale tārā nija nija gṛhe natajānu avasthāẏa par̤e raila,
11:94.latin_ascii: yakhana amara nirdesa asala takhana ami su‘ayava o tara sange yara imana enechila taderake amara anugrahe raksa karechilama. atahpara yara simalanghana karechila taderake eka vikata garjana aghata karala, phale tara nija nija grhe natajanu avasthaya pare raila,

11:95.latin_iast: yena tārā sethāẏa kakhanao vasavāsa kareni. jene rekha! dhvaṃsai chila mādiẏānavāsīdera pariṇāma, yebhāve dhvaṃsa haẏechila sāmūda sampradāẏa.
11:95.latin_ascii: yena tara sethaya kakhanao vasavasa kareni. jene rekha! dhvamsai chila madiyanavasidera parinama, yebhave dhvamsa hayechila samuda sampradaya.

11:96.latin_iast: āmi mūsāke āmāra nidarśanāvalī o spaṣṭa pramāṇasaha pāṭhiẏechilāma,
11:96.latin_ascii: ami musake amara nidarsanavali o spasta pramanasaha pathiyechilama,

11:97.latin_iast: phira‘āuna o tāra pradhānadera nikaṭa. kintu tārā phira‘āunera kāryakalāpera anusaraṇa karata āra phira‘āunera kāryakalāpa bhāla chila nā.
11:97.latin_ascii: phira‘auna o tara pradhanadera nikata. kintu tara phira‘aunera karyakalapera anusarana karata ara phira‘aunera karyakalapa bhala chila na.

11:98.latin_iast: se kiẏāmatera dine tāra sampradāẏera agrabhāge thākave evaṃ se tāderake niẏe agnite praveśa karave. yekhāne praveśa karāno have tā katai nā nikṛṣṭa sthāna!
11:98.latin_ascii: se kiyamatera dine tara sampradayera agrabhage thakave evam se taderake niye agnite pravesa karave. yekhane pravesa karano have ta katai na nikrsta sthana!

11:99.latin_iast: e duniẏāẏa tāderake karā haẏechila abhiśāpagrasta evaṃ abhiśāpagrasta have tārā kiẏāmatera dineo. katai nā nikṛṣṭa se puraskāra yā tāderake deẏā have!
11:99.latin_ascii: e duniyaya taderake kara hayechila abhisapagrasta evam abhisapagrasta have tara kiyamatera dineo. katai na nikrsta se puraskara ya taderake deya have!

11:100.latin_iast: eṭā janapadasamūhera kataka saṃvāda yā āmi tomāra nikaṭa varṇanā karachi. tādera madhye kataka ekhanao vidyamāna evaṃ kataka nirmūla haẏeche.
11:100.latin_ascii: eta janapadasamuhera kataka samvada ya ami tomara nikata varnana karachi. tadera madhye kataka ekhanao vidyamana evam kataka nirmula hayeche.

11:101.latin_iast: āmi tādera prati juluma karini kintu tārāi nijedera prati juluma karechila. yakhana tomāra pratipālakera vidhāna āsala takhana āllāha vyatīta ye ilāhsamūhera tārā ‘ivādata karata tārā tādera kona kāje āsala nā. tārā dhvaṃsa vyatīta tādera anya kichu vṛddhi karala nā.
11:101.latin_ascii: ami tadera prati juluma karini kintu tarai nijedera prati juluma karechila. yakhana tomara pratipalakera vidhana asala takhana allaha vyatita ye ilahsamuhera tara ‘ivadata karata tara tadera kona kaje asala na. tara dhvamsa vyatita tadera anya kichu vrddhi karala na.

11:102.latin_iast: erūpai tomāra pratipālakera śāsti! tini śāsti dāna karena janapadasamūhake yakhana tārā juluma kare thāke. niścaẏai tā~ra śāsti kaṭhina yantraṇādāẏaka.
11:102.latin_ascii: erupai tomara pratipalakera sasti! tini sasti dana karena janapadasamuhake yakhana tara juluma kare thake. niscayai ta~ra sasti kathina yantranadayaka.

11:103.latin_iast: ye ākhirātera śāstike bhaẏa kare ete to tāra janya nidarśana āche. eṭā se dina, yedina samasta mānuṣake ekatra karā have; eṭā sedina yedina sakalake upasthita karā have;
11:103.latin_ascii: ye akhiratera sastike bhaya kare ete to tara janya nidarsana ache. eta se dina, yedina samasta manusake ekatra kara have; eta sedina yedina sakalake upasthita kara have;

11:104.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi nirdiṣṭa kichu kālera janya seṭā sthagita rākhi mātra.
11:104.latin_ascii: evam ami nirdista kichu kalera janya seta sthagita rakhi matra.

11:105.latin_iast: yakhana sedina āsave takhana āllāhara anumati vyatīta keu kathā valate pārave nā; tādera madhye keu have hatabhāgya o keu bhāgyavāna.
11:105.latin_ascii: yakhana sedina asave takhana allahara anumati vyatita keu katha valate parave na; tadera madhye keu have hatabhagya o keu bhagyavana.

11:106.latin_iast: ataḥpara yārā hatabhāgya tārā thākave agnite evaṃ sethāẏa tādera janya thākave cītkāra o ārtanāda,
11:106.latin_ascii: atahpara yara hatabhagya tara thakave agnite evam sethaya tadera janya thakave citkara o artanada,

11:107.latin_iast: sethāẏa tārā sthāẏī have yatadina ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī vidyamāna thākave yadi nā tomāra pratipālaka anyarūpa icchā karena; niścaẏai tomāra pratipālaka tāi karena yā tini icchā karena.
11:107.latin_ascii: sethaya tara sthayi have yatadina akasamandali o prthivi vidyamana thakave yadi na tomara pratipalaka anyarupa iccha karena; niscayai tomara pratipalaka tai karena ya tini iccha karena.

11:108.latin_iast: pakṣāntare yārā bhāgyavāna tārā thākave jānnāte sethāẏa tārā sthāẏī have, yata dina ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī vidyamāna thākave, yadi nā tomāra pratipālaka anyarūpa icchā karena; eṭā eka niravacchinna puraskāra.
11:108.latin_ascii: paksantare yara bhagyavana tara thakave jannate sethaya tara sthayi have, yata dina akasamandali o prthivi vidyamana thakave, yadi na tomara pratipalaka anyarupa iccha karena; eta eka niravacchinna puraskara.

11:109.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tārā yādera ‘ivādata kare tādera samvandhe saṃśaẏe patita haẏo nā, pūrve tādera pitṛpuruṣerā yādera ‘ivādata karata tārā tāderai ‘ivādata kare. avaśyai āmi tāderake tādera prāpya puropuri deva kichumātra kama karava nā.
11:109.latin_ascii: sutaram tara yadera ‘ivadata kare tadera samvandhe samsaye patita hayo na, purve tadera pitrpurusera yadera ‘ivadata karata tara taderai ‘ivadata kare. avasyai ami taderake tadera prapya puropuri deva kichumatra kama karava na.

11:110.latin_iast: niścaẏai āmi mūsāke kitāva diẏechilāma, ataḥpara ete matabheda ghaṭechila. tomāra pratipālakera pūrva siddhānta nā thākale tādera mīmāṃsā haẏe yeta. tārā avaśyai era samvandhe vibhrāntikara sandehe chila.
11:110.latin_ascii: niscayai ami musake kitava diyechilama, atahpara ete matabheda ghatechila. tomara pratipalakera purva siddhanta na thakale tadera mimamsa haye yeta. tara avasyai era samvandhe vibhrantikara sandehe chila.

11:111.latin_iast: yakhana samaẏa āsave takhana avaśyai tomāra pratipālaka tādera pratyekake tāra karmaphala puropuri devena. tārā yā kare tini se viṣaẏe saviśeṣa avahita;
11:111.latin_ascii: yakhana samaya asave takhana avasyai tomara pratipalaka tadera pratyekake tara karmaphala puropuri devena. tara ya kare tini se visaye savisesa avahita;

11:112.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi yebhāve ādiṣṭa haẏecha tāte sthira thāka āra tomāra sāthe yārā īmāna eneche tārāo sthira thākuka; evaṃ sīmālaṅghana kara nā. tomarā yā kara niścaẏai tini tāra samyaka draṣṭā.
11:112.latin_ascii: sutaram tumi yebhave adista hayecha tate sthira thaka ara tomara sathe yara imana eneche tarao sthira thakuka; evam simalanghana kara na. tomara ya kara niscayai tini tara samyaka drasta.

11:113.latin_iast: yārā sīmālaṅghana kareche tomarā tādera prati jhu~ke par̤a nā; par̤ale agni tomāderake sparśa karave. e avasthāẏa āllāha vyatīta tomādera kona abhibhāvaka thākave nā evaṃ tomādera sāhāyya karā have nā.
11:113.latin_ascii: yara simalanghana kareche tomara tadera prati jhu~ke para na; parale agni tomaderake sparsa karave. e avasthaya allaha vyatita tomadera kona abhibhavaka thakave na evam tomadera sahayya kara have na.

11:114.latin_iast: tumi sālāta kāẏema kara divasera du’ prāntabhāge o rajanīra kichu aṃśa ativāhita haoẏāra para. satkarma avaśyai asatkarma miṭiẏe deẏa. upadeśa grahaṇakārīdera janya eṭā eka upadeśa.
11:114.latin_ascii: tumi salata kayema kara divasera du’ prantabhage o rajanira kichu amsa ativahita haoyara para. satkarma avasyai asatkarma mitiye deya. upadesa grahanakaridera janya eta eka upadesa.

11:115.latin_iast: tumi dhairya dhāraṇa kara, kāraṇa niścaẏai āllāha satkarmaparāẏaṇadera śramaphala naṣṭa karena nā.
11:115.latin_ascii: tumi dhairya dharana kara, karana niscayai allaha satkarmaparayanadera sramaphala nasta karena na.

11:116.latin_iast: yesava sampradāẏa tomādera pūrve gata haẏeche tādera madhye emana satloka hala nā kena yārā duniẏāte aśānti sṛṣṭi karate vādhā dita? tave alpa saṃkhyaka loka vyatīta, yāderake āmi tādera madhya theke vā~ciẏechilāma. āra atyācārīrā se ārāma āẏeśera madhye par̤e raila yā tāderake deẏā haẏechila; tārā chila āsalei aparādhī.
11:116.latin_ascii: yesava sampradaya tomadera purve gata hayeche tadera madhye emana satloka hala na kena yara duniyate asanti srsti karate vadha ditay tave alpa samkhyaka loka vyatita, yaderake ami tadera madhya theke va~ciyechilama. ara atyacarira se arama ayesera madhye pare raila ya taderake deya hayechila; tara chila asalei aparadhi.

11:117.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālaka erūpa nana ye, tini anyāẏabhāve janapada dhvaṃsa karavena athaca tāra adhivāsīrā saṃśodhanakārī.
11:117.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalaka erupa nana ye, tini anyayabhave janapada dhvamsa karavena athaca tara adhivasira samsodhanakari.

11:118.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālaka icchā karale samasta mānuṣake eka jāti karate pāratena, kintu tārā matabheda karatei thākave
11:118.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalaka iccha karale samasta manusake eka jati karate paratena, kintu tara matabheda karatei thakave

11:119.latin_iast: tave tārā naẏa, yāderake tomāra pratipālaka daẏā karena evaṃ tini tāderake ejanyai sṛṣṭi karechena. ‘āmi jina o mānuṣa ubhaẏa dvārā jāhānnāma pūrṇa karavai;, tomāra pratipālakera e kathā pūrṇa havei.
11:119.latin_ascii: tave tara naya, yaderake tomara pratipalaka daya karena evam tini taderake ejanyai srsti karechena. ‘ami jina o manusa ubhaya dvara jahannama purna karavai;, tomara pratipalakera e katha purna havei.

11:120.latin_iast: rāsūladera ye sakala vṛttānta āmi tomāra nikaṭa varṇanā karachi, yā dvārā āmi tomāra hṛdaẏake dṛr̤ha kari, era mādhyame tomāra nikaṭa eseche satya evaṃ mu’minadera janya eseche upadeśa o sāvadhāna vāṇī.
11:120.latin_ascii: rasuladera ye sakala vrttanta ami tomara nikata varnana karachi, ya dvara ami tomara hrdayake drrha kari, era madhyame tomara nikata eseche satya evam mu’minadera janya eseche upadesa o savadhana vani.

11:121.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne nā tāderake vala ‘tomarā sva sva avasthāne kāja karate thāka, āmarāo āmādera kāja karachi.
11:121.latin_ascii: yara imana ane na taderake vala ‘tomara sva sva avasthane kaja karate thaka, amarao amadera kaja karachi.

11:122.latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā pratīkṣā kara, āmarāo pratīkṣā karachi.’
11:122.latin_ascii: evam tomara pratiksa kara, amarao pratiksa karachi.’

11:123.latin_iast: ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra adṛśya viṣaẏera jñāna āllāharai evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa samasta kichu pratyāvartita have. sutarāṃ tumi tā~ra ‘ivādata kara evaṃ tā~ra opara nirbhara kara. tomarā yā kara se samvandhe tomāra pratipālaka anavahita nana.
11:123.latin_ascii: akasamandali o prthivira adrsya visayera jnana allaharai evam ta~rai nikata samasta kichu pratyavartita have. sutaram tumi ta~ra ‘ivadata kara evam ta~ra opara nirbhara kara. tomara ya kara se samvandhe tomara pratipalaka anavahita nana.

12:2.latin_iast: eṭā āmii avatīrṇa karechi kuraāna rūpe āravi bhāṣāẏa, yāte tomarā vujhate pāra.
12:2.latin_ascii: eta amii avatirna karechi kuraana rupe aravi bhasaya, yate tomara vujhate para.

12:3.latin_iast: āmi tomāra nikaṭa uttama kāhinī varṇanā karachi, oẏāhīra mādhyame tomāra nikaṭa e kuraāna preraṇa kare; yadio era pūrve tumi chile anavahitadera antarbhukta.
12:3.latin_ascii: ami tomara nikata uttama kahini varnana karachi, oyahira madhyame tomara nikata e kuraana prerana kare; yadio era purve tumi chile anavahitadera antarbhukta.

12:4.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara yakhana iusupha tāra pitāke valechila, ‘he āmāra pitā! āmi dekhechi egāraṭi nakṣatra evaṃ sūrya o candrake, āmi tāderake dekhechi āmāra prati sijdāvanata avasthāẏa.’
12:4.latin_ascii: smarana kara yakhana iusupha tara pitake valechila, ‘he amara pita! ami dekhechi egarati naksatra evam surya o candrake, ami taderake dekhechi amara prati sijdavanata avasthaya.’

12:5.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra vatsa! tomāra svapna vṛttānta tomāra bhrātādera nikaṭa varṇanā kara nā; karale tārā tomāra viruddhe ṣar̤ayantra karave. niścaẏai śaẏatāna mānuṣera prakāśya śatra“.’
12:5.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara vatsa! tomara svapna vrttanta tomara bhratadera nikata varnana kara na; karale tara tomara viruddhe sarayantra karave. niscayai sayatana manusera prakasya satra“.’

12:6.latin_iast: ebhāve tomāra pratipālaka tomāke manonīta karavena evaṃ tomāke svapnera vyākhyā śikṣā devena evaṃ tomāra prati o iẏā‘kūvera parivāra-parijanera prati tā~ra anugraha pūrṇa karavena, yebhāve tini eṭā pūrve pūrṇa karechilena tomāra pitṛ-puruṣa ivrāhīma o ishākera prati. niścaẏai tomāra pratipālaka sarvajña, prajñāmaẏa.
12:6.latin_ascii: ebhave tomara pratipalaka tomake manonita karavena evam tomake svapnera vyakhya siksa devena evam tomara prati o iya‘kuvera parivara-parijanera prati ta~ra anugraha purna karavena, yebhave tini eta purve purna karechilena tomara pitr-purusa ivrahima o ishakera prati. niscayai tomara pratipalaka sarvajna, prajnamaya.

12:7.latin_iast: iusupha evaṃ tāra bhrātādera ghaṭanāẏa jijñāsudera janya avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche.
12:7.latin_ascii: iusupha evam tara bhratadera ghatanaya jijnasudera janya avasyai nidarsana rayeche.

12:8.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana tārā valechila, ‘āmādera pitāra nikaṭa iusupha evaṃ tāra bhrātāi āmādera apekṣā adhika priẏa, athaca āmarā ekaṭi saṃhata dala; āmādera pitā to spaṣṭa vibhrāntitei āche.
12:8.latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana tara valechila, ‘amadera pitara nikata iusupha evam tara bhratai amadera apeksa adhika priya, athaca amara ekati samhata dala; amadera pita to spasta vibhrantitei ache.

12:9.latin_iast: tomarā iusuphake hatyā kara athavā tāke ajñāta kona sthāne phele āsa, phale tomādera pitāra dṛṣṭi śudhu tomādera pratii niviṣṭa have evaṃ tārapara tomarā bhāla loka haẏe yāve.’
12:9.latin_ascii: tomara iusuphake hatya kara athava take ajnata kona sthane phele asa, phale tomadera pitara drsti sudhu tomadera pratii nivista have evam tarapara tomara bhala loka haye yave.’

12:10.latin_iast: tādera madhye ekajana valala: tomarā ‘iusuphake hatyā kara nā varaṃ yadi kichu karatei cāo tave tāke kona kūpera gabhīre nikṣepa kara, yātrīdalera keu tāke tule niẏe yāve.’
12:10.latin_ascii: tadera madhye ekajana valala: tomara ‘iusuphake hatya kara na varam yadi kichu karatei cao tave take kona kupera gabhire niksepa kara, yatridalera keu take tule niye yave.’

12:11.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he āmādera pitā! iusuphera vyāpāre āpani āmāderake viśvāsa karachena nā kena, athaca āmarā to tāra kalyāṇakāmī?
12:11.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he amadera pita! iusuphera vyapare apani amaderake visvasa karachena na kena, athaca amara to tara kalyanakamiy

12:12.latin_iast: āpani āgāmī kāla tāke āmādera saṅge preraṇa karuna, se tṛptisahakāre ānanda vā āmoda karave o khelādhulā karave. āmarā avaśyai tāra rakṣaṇāvekṣaṇa karava.’
12:12.latin_ascii: apani agami kala take amadera sange prerana karuna, se trptisahakare ananda va amoda karave o kheladhula karave. amara avasyai tara raksanaveksana karava.’

12:13.latin_iast: se valala: ‘eṭā āmāke avaśyai cintita karache ye, tomarā tāke niẏe yāve evaṃ āmi āśaṃkā karachi tāke nekar̤e vāgha kheẏe phelave, āra tomarā tāra prati amanoyogī thākave.’
12:13.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘eta amake avasyai cintita karache ye, tomara take niye yave evam ami asamka karachi take nekare vagha kheye phelave, ara tomara tara prati amanoyogi thakave.’

12:14.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āmarā ekaṭi saṃhata dala haoẏā sattveo yadi nekar̤e vāgha tāke kheẏe phele, tave āmarā avaśyai kṣatigrasta hava.’
12:14.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘amara ekati samhata dala haoya sattveo yadi nekare vagha take kheye phele, tave amara avasyai ksatigrasta hava.’

12:15.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā yakhana tāke niẏe gela evaṃ tāke kūpera andhakāre nikṣepa karate ekamata hala, ematāvasthāẏa āmi tāke oẏāhī karalāma, ‘tumi tāderake tādera e karmera kathā avaśyai vale deve emanabhāve ye tārā vujhate pārave nā.
12:15.latin_ascii: atahpara tara yakhana take niye gela evam take kupera andhakare niksepa karate ekamata hala, ematavasthaya ami take oyahi karalama, ‘tumi taderake tadera e karmera katha avasyai vale deve emanabhave ye tara vujhate parave na.

12:16.latin_iast: tārā rātrira prathama prahare kā~date kā~date tādera pitāra nikaṭa āsala.
12:16.latin_ascii: tara ratrira prathama prahare ka~date ka~date tadera pitara nikata asala.

12:17.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he āmādera pitā! āmarā daur̤era pratiyogitā karachilāma evaṃ iusuphake āmādera mālapatrera nikaṭa rekhe giẏechilāma, ataḥpara nekar̤e vāgha tāke kheẏe pheleche; kintu āpani to āmāderake viśvāsa karavena nā yadio āmarā satyavādī.’
12:17.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he amadera pita! amara daurera pratiyogita karachilama evam iusuphake amadera malapatrera nikata rekhe giyechilama, atahpara nekare vagha take kheye pheleche; kintu apani to amaderake visvasa karavena na yadio amara satyavadi.’

12:18.latin_iast: tārā tāra jāmāẏa mithyā rakta lepana kare enechila. se valala: ‘nā, tomādera mana tomādera janya ekaṭi kāhinī sājiẏe diẏeche. sutarāṃ pūrṇa dhairyai śreẏa, tomarā yā valacha se viṣaẏe ekamātra āllāhai āmāra sāhāyyasthala.’
12:18.latin_ascii: tara tara jamaya mithya rakta lepana kare enechila. se valala: ‘na, tomadera mana tomadera janya ekati kahini sajiye diyeche. sutaram purna dhairyai sreya, tomara ya valacha se visaye ekamatra allahai amara sahayyasthala.’

12:19.latin_iast: eka yātrīdala āsala, tārā tādera pāni saṃgrāhakake preraṇa karala. se tāra pānira vālati nāmiẏe dila. se vale uṭhala: ‘kī sukhavara! e ye eka kiśora!’ ataḥpara tārā tā~ke paṇyarūpa lukiẏe rākhala. tārā yā karachila se viṣaẏe āllāha sarvajña.
12:19.latin_ascii: eka yatridala asala, tara tadera pani samgrahakake prerana karala. se tara panira valati namiye dila. se vale uthala: ‘ki sukhavara! e ye eka kisora!’ atahpara tara ta~ke panyarupa lukiye rakhala. tara ya karachila se visaye allaha sarvajna.

12:20.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā tā~ke vikraẏa karala svalpa mūlye mātra kaẏeka dirahāmera vinimaẏe, tārā chila tā~ra vyāpāre nirleābha.
12:20.latin_ascii: evam tara ta~ke vikraya karala svalpa mulye matra kayeka dirahamera vinimaye, tara chila ta~ra vyapare nirleabha.

12:21.latin_iast: misarera ye vyakti tāke kraẏa karechila, se tāra strīke valala: ‘tāra thākāra sammānajanaka vyavasthā kara, sambhavata se āmādera upakāre āsave athavā āmarā tāke putrarūpe grahaṇa kare neva.’ evaṃ ebhāve āmi iusuphake se deśe pratiṣṭhita karalāma tā~ke svapnera vyākhyā śikṣā devāra janya. āllāha tā~ra kārya sampādane apratihata; kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa eṭā avagata naẏa.
12:21.latin_ascii: misarera ye vyakti take kraya karechila, se tara strike valala: ‘tara thakara sammanajanaka vyavastha kara, sambhavata se amadera upakare asave athava amara take putrarupe grahana kare neva.’ evam ebhave ami iusuphake se dese pratisthita karalama ta~ke svapnera vyakhya siksa devara janya. allaha ta~ra karya sampadane apratihata; kintu adhikamsa manusa eta avagata naya.

12:22.latin_iast: se yakhana pūrṇa yauvane upanīta hala takhana āmi tāke hikamāta o jñāna dāna karalāma evaṃ ebhāvei āmi satkarmaparāẏaṇaderake puraskṛta kari.
12:22.latin_ascii: se yakhana purna yauvane upanita hala takhana ami take hikamata o jnana dana karalama evam ebhavei ami satkarmaparayanaderake puraskrta kari.

12:23.latin_iast: se ye strīlokera gṛhe chila se tā hate asatkarma karāra janya prarocita karala evaṃ darajāgulo vandha kare dila o valala: ‘(tomāke valachi) edike āsa.’ se valala: ‘āmi āllāhara āśraẏa nicchi, kāraṇa āmāra prabhu; tini āmāra thākāra sundara vyavasthā karechena. niścaẏai sīmālaṅghanakārīgaṇa saphalakāma haẏa nā.’
12:23.latin_ascii: se ye strilokera grhe chila se ta hate asatkarma karara janya prarocita karala evam darajagulo vandha kare dila o valala: ‘(tomake valachi) edike asa.’ se valala: ‘ami allahara asraya nicchi, karana amara prabhu; tini amara thakara sundara vyavastha karechena. niscayai simalanghanakarigana saphalakama haya na.’

12:24.latin_iast: se ramaṇī tāra prati āsakta haẏechila evaṃ seo tāra prati āsakta haẏe par̤ata yadi nā se tāra pratipālakera nidarśana pratyakṣa karata. āmi tāke manda karma o aśa−īlatā hate virata rākhāra janya ebhāve nidarśana dekhiẏechilāma. se to chila āmāra viśuddhacitta vāndādera antarbhukta.
12:24.latin_ascii: se ramani tara prati asakta hayechila evam seo tara prati asakta haye parata yadi na se tara pratipalakera nidarsana pratyaksa karata. ami take manda karma o asa−ilata hate virata rakhara janya ebhave nidarsana dekhiyechilama. se to chila amara visuddhacitta vandadera antarbhukta.

12:25.latin_iast: tārā ubhaẏe dau~r̤iẏe darajāra dike gela evaṃ strīlokaṭi pechana hate tāra jāmā chi~r̤e phelala, tārā ubhaẏe strīlokaṭira svāmīke darajāra nikaṭa pela. strīlokaṭi valala: ‘ye tomāra parivārera sāthe kukarma kāmanā kare tāra janya kārāgāre preraṇa athavā anya kona yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti vyatīta āra kī daṇḍa hate pāre?’
12:25.latin_ascii: tara ubhaye dau~riye darajara dike gela evam strilokati pechana hate tara jama chi~re phelala, tara ubhaye strilokatira svamike darajara nikata pela. strilokati valala: ‘ye tomara parivarera sathe kukarma kamana kare tara janya karagare prerana athava anya kona yantranadayaka sasti vyatita ara ki danda hate parey’

12:26.latin_iast: iusupha valala: ‘se-i āmāra hate asatkarmera janya prarocita karechila.’ strīlokaṭira parivārera ekajana sākṣī sākṣya dila, ‘yadi tā~ra jāmāra sammukha dika chinna karā haẏe thāke tave strīlokaṭi satya kathā valeche evaṃ puruṣaṭi mithyāvādī,
12:26.latin_ascii: iusupha valala: ‘se-i amara hate asatkarmera janya prarocita karechila.’ strilokatira parivarera ekajana saksi saksya dila, ‘yadi ta~ra jamara sammukha dika chinna kara haye thake tave strilokati satya katha valeche evam purusati mithyavadi,

12:27.latin_iast: kintu tā~ra jāmā yadi pechana dika hate chinna karā haẏe thāke tave strīlokaṭi mithyā valeche evaṃ puruṣaṭi satyavādī.’
12:27.latin_ascii: kintu ta~ra jama yadi pechana dika hate chinna kara haye thake tave strilokati mithya valeche evam purusati satyavadi.’

12:28.latin_iast: gṛhasvāmī yakhana dekhala ye, tāra jāmā pechana dika hate chinna karā haẏeche takhana se valala: ‘niścaẏai eṭā tomādera (nārīdera) cakrānta, tomādera cakrānta bhīṣaṇa kaṭhina.’
12:28.latin_ascii: grhasvami yakhana dekhala ye, tara jama pechana dika hate chinna kara hayeche takhana se valala: ‘niscayai eta tomadera (naridera) cakranta, tomadera cakranta bhisana kathina.’

12:29.latin_iast: ‘he iusupha! tumi e prasaṅga vāda dāo evaṃ he nārī! tumi tomāra aparādhera janya kṣamā prārthanā kara; tumii to aparādhī.’
12:29.latin_ascii: ‘he iusupha! tumi e prasanga vada dao evam he nari! tumi tomara aparadhera janya ksama prarthana kara; tumii to aparadhi.’

12:30.latin_iast: śaharera mahilāgaṇa valāvali karate lāgala: ‘āyīyera strī tāra yuvaka dāsake asatkarmera janya prarocita kareche, prema tāke unmatta kareche, āmarā to tāke dekhachi spaṣṭa vibhrāntite.’
12:30.latin_ascii: saharera mahilagana valavali karate lagala: ‘ayiyera stri tara yuvaka dasake asatkarmera janya prarocita kareche, prema take unmatta kareche, amara to take dekhachi spasta vibhrantite.’

12:31.latin_iast: strīlokaṭi yakhana tādera ṣar̤ayantrera kathā śunala, takhana se tāderake ḍeke pāṭhāla, tādera janya āsana prastuta karala, tādera pratyekake ekaṭi kare churi dila evaṃ iusuphake valala: ‘tādera sammukhe vera hao.’ ataḥpara tārā yakhana tāke dekhala takhana tārā tāra rūpa-saundarye abhibhūta hala evaṃ nijedera hāta keṭe phelala. tārā valala: ‘adbhūta āllāhara māhātmya! e to mānuṣa naẏa, e to eka mahimānvita phereśtā.’
12:31.latin_ascii: strilokati yakhana tadera sarayantrera katha sunala, takhana se taderake deke pathala, tadera janya asana prastuta karala, tadera pratyekake ekati kare churi dila evam iusuphake valala: ‘tadera sammukhe vera hao.’ atahpara tara yakhana take dekhala takhana tara tara rupa-saundarye abhibhuta hala evam nijedera hata kete phelala. tara valala: ‘adbhuta allahara mahatmya! e to manusa naya, e to eka mahimanvita pheresta.’

12:32.latin_iast: se valala: ‘e-i se yāra samvandhe tomarā āmāra nindā karecha. āmi satyii tā~ke asatkarmera janya prarocita karechi. kintu se nijeke pavitra rekheche; āmi tāke yā ādeśa karechi se yadi tā nā kare, tave se kārāruddha havei evaṃ hīnadera antarbhukta have.’
12:32.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘e-i se yara samvandhe tomara amara ninda karecha. ami satyii ta~ke asatkarmera janya prarocita karechi. kintu se nijeke pavitra rekheche; ami take ya adesa karechi se yadi ta na kare, tave se kararuddha havei evam hinadera antarbhukta have.’

12:33.latin_iast: iusupha valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! e nārīgaṇa āmāke yāra prati āhvāna karache tā apekṣā kārāgāra āmāra nikaṭa adhika priẏa. tumi yadi tādera cakrānta hate āmāke rakṣā nā kara tave āmi tādera prati ākṛṣṭa haẏe par̤ava evaṃ ajñadera antarbhukta haẏe yāva.’
12:33.latin_ascii: iusupha valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! e narigana amake yara prati ahvana karache ta apeksa karagara amara nikata adhika priya. tumi yadi tadera cakranta hate amake raksa na kara tave ami tadera prati akrsta haye parava evam ajnadera antarbhukta haye yava.’

12:34.latin_iast: ataḥpara tā~ra pratipālaka tāra āhvāne sār̤ā dilena evaṃ tāke tādera cakrānta hate rakṣā karalena. tini to sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
12:34.latin_ascii: atahpara ta~ra pratipalaka tara ahvane sara dilena evam take tadera cakranta hate raksa karalena. tini to sarvasrota, sarvajna.

12:35.latin_iast: nidarśanāvalī dekhāra para tādera mane hala ye, tāke kichu kālera janya kārāruddha karatei have.
12:35.latin_ascii: nidarsanavali dekhara para tadera mane hala ye, take kichu kalera janya kararuddha karatei have.

12:36.latin_iast: tāra sāthe du’jana yuvaka kārāgāre praveśa karala. tādera ekajana valala: ‘āmi svapne dekhalāma, āmi āṅgura niṃr̤iẏe rasa vera karachi’, evaṃ aparajana valala: ‘āmi svapne dekhalāma, āmi āmāra māthāẏa ruṭi vahana karachi evaṃ pākhī seṭā hate khācche. āmāderake tumi era vyākhyā jāniẏe dāo, āmarā to tomāke satkarmaparāẏaṇa dekhachi.’
12:36.latin_ascii: tara sathe du’jana yuvaka karagare pravesa karala. tadera ekajana valala: ‘ami svapne dekhalama, ami angura nimriye rasa vera karachi’, evam aparajana valala: ‘ami svapne dekhalama, ami amara mathaya ruti vahana karachi evam pakhi seta hate khacche. amaderake tumi era vyakhya janiye dao, amara to tomake satkarmaparayana dekhachi.’

12:37.latin_iast: iusupha valala: ‘tomāderake ye khādya deẏā haẏa tā āsāra pūrve āmi tomāderake svapnera vyākhyā jāniẏe deva. āmi yā tomāderake valava tā āmāra pratipālaka āmāke yā śikṣā diẏechena tā hate. ye sampradāẏa āllāhate viśvāsa kare nā o ākhirāte aviśvāsī āmi tādera matavāda varjana karechi.
12:37.latin_ascii: iusupha valala: ‘tomaderake ye khadya deya haya ta asara purve ami tomaderake svapnera vyakhya janiye deva. ami ya tomaderake valava ta amara pratipalaka amake ya siksa diyechena ta hate. ye sampradaya allahate visvasa kare na o akhirate avisvasi ami tadera matavada varjana karechi.

12:38.latin_iast: āmi āmāra pitṛpuruṣa ivrāhīma, ishāka evaṃ iẏā‘kūvera dharma anusaraṇa kari. āllāhara sāthe kona vastuke śarīka karā āmādera kāja naẏa. eṭā āmādera o samasta mānuṣera prati āllāhara anugraha; kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣai kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare nā.
12:38.latin_ascii: ami amara pitrpurusa ivrahima, ishaka evam iya‘kuvera dharma anusarana kari. allahara sathe kona vastuke sarika kara amadera kaja naya. eta amadera o samasta manusera prati allahara anugraha; kintu adhikamsa manusai krtajnata prakasa kare na.

12:39.latin_iast: he kārā-saṅgīdvaẏa! bhinna bhinna vahu pratipālaka śreẏa nā parākramaśālī eka āllāha?
12:39.latin_ascii: he kara-sangidvaya! bhinna bhinna vahu pratipalaka sreya na parakramasali eka allahay

12:40.latin_iast: ‘tā~ke (āllāhake) cher̤e tomarā kevala katakagulo nāmera ‘ivādata karacha, ye nāmagulo tomādera pitṛpuruṣa o tomarā rekhecha; egulora kona pramāṇa āllāha pāṭhānani. vidhāna devāra adhikāra kevala āllāharai. tini ādeśa diẏechena tomarā ekamātra tā~rai ivādata karave; eṭāi saṭhika dīna kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa eṭā avagata naẏa.
12:40.latin_ascii: ‘ta~ke (allahake) chere tomara kevala katakagulo namera ‘ivadata karacha, ye namagulo tomadera pitrpurusa o tomara rekhecha; egulora kona pramana allaha pathanani. vidhana devara adhikara kevala allaharai. tini adesa diyechena tomara ekamatra ta~rai ivadata karave; etai sathika dina kintu adhikamsa manusa eta avagata naya.

12:41.latin_iast: he kārā-saṅgīdvaẏa! tomādera du’janera ekajana tāra prabhuke (vādaśāke) madya pāna karāve evaṃ aparajana śūlaviddha have; ataḥpara tāra mastaka hate pākhī āhāra karave. ye viṣaẏe tomarā jānate ceẏecha tāra siddhānta haẏe giẏeche.’
12:41.latin_ascii: he kara-sangidvaya! tomadera du’janera ekajana tara prabhuke (vadasake) madya pana karave evam aparajana sulaviddha have; atahpara tara mastaka hate pakhi ahara karave. ye visaye tomara janate ceyecha tara siddhanta haye giyeche.’

12:42.latin_iast: iusupha tādera madhye ye mukti pāve mane karala, tāke valala: ‘tomāra prabhura nikaṭa āmāra kathā jāniẏe dio’, kintu śaẏatāna tāke prabhura nikaṭa tāra viṣaẏa valāra kathā bhuliẏe dila; sutarāṃ iusupha kaẏeka vatsara kārāgāre raila.
12:42.latin_ascii: iusupha tadera madhye ye mukti pave mane karala, take valala: ‘tomara prabhura nikata amara katha janiye dio’, kintu sayatana take prabhura nikata tara visaya valara katha bhuliye dila; sutaram iusupha kayeka vatsara karagare raila.

12:43.latin_iast: rājā valala: ‘āmi svapne dekhalāma, sātaṭi moṭātājā gābhī, tāderake sātaṭi śīrṇakāẏa gābhī bhakṣaṇa karache evaṃ dekhalāma sātaṭi savuja śīṣa o apara sātaṭi śuṣka. he pradhānagaṇa! yadi tomarā svapnera vyākhyā karate pāra tave āmāra svapna samvandhe abhimata dāo.’
12:43.latin_ascii: raja valala: ‘ami svapne dekhalama, satati motataja gabhi, taderake satati sirnakaya gabhi bhaksana karache evam dekhalama satati savuja sisa o apara satati suska. he pradhanagana! yadi tomara svapnera vyakhya karate para tave amara svapna samvandhe abhimata dao.’

12:44.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘eṭā arthahīna svapna evaṃ āmarā erūpa svapna vyākhyāẏa abhijña nai.’
12:44.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘eta arthahina svapna evam amara erupa svapna vyakhyaya abhijna nai.’

12:45.latin_iast: du’jana kārāruddhera madhye ye mukti peẏechila evaṃ dīrghakāla pare yāra (iusuphera kathā) smaraṇa hala se valala: ‘āmi tāra vyākhyā tomāderake ene deva. sutarāṃ tomarā āmāke pāṭhāo.’
12:45.latin_ascii: du’jana kararuddhera madhye ye mukti peyechila evam dirghakala pare yara (iusuphera katha) smarana hala se valala: ‘ami tara vyakhya tomaderake ene deva. sutaram tomara amake pathao.’

12:46.latin_iast: se (kārāgāre iusuphera) kāche giẏe valala: ‘he iusupha! he satyavādī! sātaṭi moṭātājā gābhī, tāderake sātaṭi śīrṇakāẏa gābhī bhakṣaṇa karache evaṃ sātaṭi savuja śīṣa o apara sātaṭi śuṣka śīṣa samvandhe tumi āmāderake vyākhyā dāo, yāte āmi lokedera nikaṭa phire yete pāri o yāte tārā avagata hate pāre.’
12:46.latin_ascii: se (karagare iusuphera) kache giye valala: ‘he iusupha! he satyavadi! satati motataja gabhi, taderake satati sirnakaya gabhi bhaksana karache evam satati savuja sisa o apara satati suska sisa samvandhe tumi amaderake vyakhya dao, yate ami lokedera nikata phire yete pari o yate tara avagata hate pare.’

12:47.latin_iast: iusupha valala: ‘tomarā sāta vatsara ekādhāre cāṣa karave, ataḥpara tomarā ye śasya kartana karave tāra madhye ye sāmānya parimāṇa tomarā bhakṣaṇa karave, tā vyatīta samasta śaṣya śīṣa sameta rekhe deve;
12:47.latin_ascii: iusupha valala: ‘tomara sata vatsara ekadhare casa karave, atahpara tomara ye sasya kartana karave tara madhye ye samanya parimana tomara bhaksana karave, ta vyatita samasta sasya sisa sameta rekhe deve;

12:48.latin_iast: erapara āsave sātaṭi kaṭhina (durbhikṣera) vatsara, e sāta vatsara yā pūrve sañcaẏa kare rekhechile, loke tā khāve; kevala sāmānya kichu yā tomarā saṃrakṣaṇa karave, tā vyatīta.
12:48.latin_ascii: erapara asave satati kathina (durbhiksera) vatsara, e sata vatsara ya purve sancaya kare rekhechile, loke ta khave; kevala samanya kichu ya tomara samraksana karave, ta vyatita.

12:49.latin_iast: ataḥpara āsave emana ekaṭi vatsara, yāte mānuṣera janya pracura vṛṣṭipāta have evaṃ se vatsara mānuṣa pracura phalera rasa niṃr̤āve.’
12:49.latin_ascii: atahpara asave emana ekati vatsara, yate manusera janya pracura vrstipata have evam se vatsara manusa pracura phalera rasa nimrave.’

12:50.latin_iast: rājā valala: ‘tomarā tā~ke (iusuphake) āmāra nikaṭa niẏe eso.’ yakhana dūta tāra nikaṭa upasthita hala takhana se valala: ‘tumi tomāra mālikera nikaṭa phire yāo evaṃ tāke jijñesa kara, ye nārīgaṇa hāta keṭe phelechila tādera avasthā kī! niścaẏai āmāra pratipālaka tādera cakrānta samyaka avagata.’
12:50.latin_ascii: raja valala: ‘tomara ta~ke (iusuphake) amara nikata niye eso.’ yakhana duta tara nikata upasthita hala takhana se valala: ‘tumi tomara malikera nikata phire yao evam take jijnesa kara, ye narigana hata kete phelechila tadera avastha ki! niscayai amara pratipalaka tadera cakranta samyaka avagata.’

12:51.latin_iast: rājā nārīgaṇake valala: ‘yakhana tomarā iusupha hate asatkarma kāmanā karechile, takhana tomādera kī haẏechila?’ tārā valala: ‘adbhuta āllāhara māhātmya! āmarā tā~ra madhye kona doṣa dekhini.’ ‘āyīyera strī valala: ‘ekṣaṇe satya prakāśa hala, āmii tāke prarocita karechilāma, niścaẏai se hala satyavādīdera antarbhukta.’
12:51.latin_ascii: raja nariganake valala: ‘yakhana tomara iusupha hate asatkarma kamana karechile, takhana tomadera ki hayechilay’ tara valala: ‘adbhuta allahara mahatmya! amara ta~ra madhye kona dosa dekhini.’ ‘ayiyera stri valala: ‘eksane satya prakasa hala, amii take prarocita karechilama, niscayai se hala satyavadidera antarbhukta.’

12:52.latin_iast: eṭā ejanya, yāte se jānate pāre ye, tāra anupasthitite āmi tāra prati viśvāsaghātakatā karini evaṃ niścaẏai āllāha viśvāsaghātakadera ṣar̤ayantra saphala karena nā.’
12:52.latin_ascii: eta ejanya, yate se janate pare ye, tara anupasthitite ami tara prati visvasaghatakata karini evam niscayai allaha visvasaghatakadera sarayantra saphala karena na.’
