12:53.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmi nijeke nirdeāṣa mane kari nā, mānuṣera mana avaśyai manda karma pravaṇa, kintu se naẏa, yāra prati āmāra pratipālaka daẏā karena. āmāra pratipālaka ati kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.’
12:53.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ami nijeke nirdeasa mane kari na, manusera mana avasyai manda karma pravana, kintu se naya, yara prati amara pratipalaka daya karena. amara pratipalaka ati ksamasila, parama dayalu.’

12:54.latin_iast: rājā valala: ‘iusuphake āmāra nikaṭa niẏe eso; āmi tāke āmāra ekānta sahacara niyukta karava.’ ataḥpara rājā yakhana tāra sāthe kathā valala: takhana rājā valala: ‘niścaẏai āja tumi āmādera nikaṭa maryādāśīla, viśvāsabhājana.’
12:54.latin_ascii: raja valala: ‘iusuphake amara nikata niye eso; ami take amara ekanta sahacara niyukta karava.’ atahpara raja yakhana tara sathe katha valala: takhana raja valala: ‘niscayai aja tumi amadera nikata maryadasila, visvasabhajana.’

12:55.latin_iast: iusupha valala: ‘āmāke deśera dhanabhāṇḍārera opara kartṛtva pradāna kara; āmi to uttama rakṣaka, suvijña.’
12:55.latin_ascii: iusupha valala: ‘amake desera dhanabhandarera opara kartrtva pradana kara; ami to uttama raksaka, suvijna.’

12:56.latin_iast: ebhāve iusuphake āmi se deśe pratiṣṭhita karalāma; se sei deśe yathā icchā avasthāna karate pārata. āmi yāke icchā tāra prati daẏā kari; āmi satkarmaparāẏaṇadera śramaphala naṣṭa kari nā.
12:56.latin_ascii: ebhave iusuphake ami se dese pratisthita karalama; se sei dese yatha iccha avasthana karate parata. ami yake iccha tara prati daya kari; ami satkarmaparayanadera sramaphala nasta kari na.

12:57.latin_iast: yārā mu’mina evaṃ muttākī tādera ākhirātera puraskārai uttama.
12:57.latin_ascii: yara mu’mina evam muttaki tadera akhiratera puraskarai uttama.

12:58.latin_iast: iusuphera bhrātāgaṇa āsala evaṃ tā~ra nikaṭa upasthita hala. se tāderake cinala, kintu tārā tāke cinate pārala nā.
12:58.latin_ascii: iusuphera bhratagana asala evam ta~ra nikata upasthita hala. se taderake cinala, kintu tara take cinate parala na.

12:59.latin_iast: āra se yakhana tādera dravya sāmagrīra vyavasthā kare dila takhana se valala: ‘tomarā āmāra nikaṭa tomādera vaimātreẏa bhrātāke niẏe eso. tomarā ki dekhacha nā ye, āmi māpe pūrṇa mātrāẏa dei evaṃ āmi uttama atithiparāẏaṇa?
12:59.latin_ascii: ara se yakhana tadera dravya samagrira vyavastha kare dila takhana se valala: ‘tomara amara nikata tomadera vaimatreya bhratake niye eso. tomara ki dekhacha na ye, ami mape purna matraya dei evam ami uttama atithiparayanay

12:60.latin_iast: āra tomarā yadi tāke āmāra nikaṭa niẏe nā eso tave āmāra nikaṭa tomādera janya kona varādda thākave nā evaṃ tomarā āmāra nikaṭavartī hate pārave nā.
12:60.latin_ascii: ara tomara yadi take amara nikata niye na eso tave amara nikata tomadera janya kona varadda thakave na evam tomara amara nikatavarti hate parave na.

12:61.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘tā~ra viṣaẏe āmarā tā~ra pitāke sammata karāra ceṣṭā karava evaṃ āmarā niścaẏai eṭā karava.
12:61.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘ta~ra visaye amara ta~ra pitake sammata karara cesta karava evam amara niscayai eta karava.

12:62.latin_iast: iusupha tāra sevakaderake valala: tārā ye paṇyamūlya diẏeche tā tādera mālapatrera madhye (gopane) rekhe dāo-yāte svajanagaṇera nikaṭa pratyāvartanera para tārā tā cinate pāre, tāhale tārā punarāẏa āsave.’
12:62.latin_ascii: iusupha tara sevakaderake valala: tara ye panyamulya diyeche ta tadera malapatrera madhye (gopane) rekhe dao-yate svajanaganera nikata pratyavartanera para tara ta cinate pare, tahale tara punaraya asave.’

12:63.latin_iast: tārapara tārā yakhana tādera pitāra nikaṭa phire āsala, takhana tārā valala: ‘he āmādera pitā! āmādera janya varādda niṣiddha karā haẏeche. sutarāṃ āmādera bhrātāke āmādera sāthe pāṭhiẏe dina yāte āmarā rasada pete pāri. āmarā avaśyai tāra rakṣaṇāvekṣaṇa karava.’
12:63.latin_ascii: tarapara tara yakhana tadera pitara nikata phire asala, takhana tara valala: ‘he amadera pita! amadera janya varadda nisiddha kara hayeche. sutaram amadera bhratake amadera sathe pathiye dina yate amara rasada pete pari. amara avasyai tara raksanaveksana karava.’

12:64.latin_iast: se (pitā) valala: ‘āmi kibhāve tomāderake tāra samvandhe serūpa viśvāsa karava, yerūpa viśvāsa pūrve tomāderake karechilāma tāra bhrātā samvandhe? āllāhai rakṣaṇāvekṣaṇe śreṣṭha evaṃ tini sarvaśreṣṭha daẏālu.’
12:64.latin_ascii: se (pita) valala: ‘ami kibhave tomaderake tara samvandhe serupa visvasa karava, yerupa visvasa purve tomaderake karechilama tara bhrata samvandhey allahai raksanaveksane srestha evam tini sarvasrestha dayalu.’

12:65.latin_iast: yakhana tārā tādera mālapatra khulala takhana tārā dekhate pela tādera paṇyamūlya tāderake pherata deẏā haẏeche. tārā valala: ‘he āmādera pitā! āmarā āra ki pratyāśā karate pāri? eṭā āmādera pradatta paṇyamūlya, āmāderake phiriẏe deẏā haẏeche. punarāẏa āmarā āmādera parivāravargake khādya-sāmagrī ene deva evaṃ āmarā āmādera bhrātāra rakṣaṇāvekṣaṇa karava evaṃ āmarā atirikta āra eka uṣṭra-vojhāi paṇya ānava; yā enechi tā parimāṇe alpa.’
12:65.latin_ascii: yakhana tara tadera malapatra khulala takhana tara dekhate pela tadera panyamulya taderake pherata deya hayeche. tara valala: ‘he amadera pita! amara ara ki pratyasa karate pariy eta amadera pradatta panyamulya, amaderake phiriye deya hayeche. punaraya amara amadera parivaravargake khadya-samagri ene deva evam amara amadera bhratara raksanaveksana karava evam amara atirikta ara eka ustra-vojhai panya anava; ya enechi ta parimane alpa.’

12:66.latin_iast: se (pitā) valala: ‘āmi tāke kakhanai tomādera sāthe pāṭhāva nā yatakṣaṇa nā tomarā āllāhara nāme aṅgīkāra kara ye, tomarā tāke āmāra nikaṭa niẏe āsavei, avaśya yadi tomarā ekānta asahāẏa haẏe nā par̤a.’ ataḥpara yakhana tārā tāra nikaṭa pratijñā karala takhana se valala: ‘āmarā ye viṣaẏe kathā valachi, āllāha tāra vidhāẏaka.’
12:66.latin_ascii: se (pita) valala: ‘ami take kakhanai tomadera sathe pathava na yataksana na tomara allahara name angikara kara ye, tomara take amara nikata niye asavei, avasya yadi tomara ekanta asahaya haye na para.’ atahpara yakhana tara tara nikata pratijna karala takhana se valala: ‘amara ye visaye katha valachi, allaha tara vidhayaka.’

12:67.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra putragaṇa! tomarā sakale eka dvāra diẏe praveśa kara nā, bhinna bhinna dvāra diẏe praveśa karave. āllāhara vidhānera viruddhe āmi tomādera janya kichui karate pāri nā. vidhāna ekamātra āllāharai. āmi tā~ra opara nirbhara kari evaṃ bharasākārīrā yena ekamātra āllāhara opara bharasā kare.’
12:67.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara putragana! tomara sakale eka dvara diye pravesa kara na, bhinna bhinna dvara diye pravesa karave. allahara vidhanera viruddhe ami tomadera janya kichui karate pari na. vidhana ekamatra allaharai. ami ta~ra opara nirbhara kari evam bharasakarira yena ekamatra allahara opara bharasa kare.’

12:68.latin_iast: yakhana tārā tādera pitāra nirdeśamata praveśa karala, takhana āllāhara vidhānera viruddhe tā tādera kona kāje āsala nā; iẏā‘kūva kevala tāra manera ekaṭi abhiprāẏa pūrṇa karechila evaṃ se avaśyai jñānī chila, kāraṇa āmi tāke śikṣā diẏechilāma. kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa avagata naẏa.
12:68.latin_ascii: yakhana tara tadera pitara nirdesamata pravesa karala, takhana allahara vidhanera viruddhe ta tadera kona kaje asala na; iya‘kuva kevala tara manera ekati abhipraya purna karechila evam se avasyai jnani chila, karana ami take siksa diyechilama. kintu adhikamsa manusa avagata naya.

12:69.latin_iast: tārā yakhana iusuphera nikaṭa praveśa karala, takhana iusupha tāra sahodara bhāike nijera kāche rākhala evaṃ valala: ‘niścaẏai āmii tomāra sahodara bhāi sutarāṃ tārā yā karata se janya duḥkha kara nā.’
12:69.latin_ascii: tara yakhana iusuphera nikata pravesa karala, takhana iusupha tara sahodara bhaike nijera kache rakhala evam valala: ‘niscayai amii tomara sahodara bhai sutaram tara ya karata se janya duhkha kara na.’

12:70.latin_iast: ataḥpara se yakhana tādera dravya sāmagrīra vyavasthā kare dila, takhana se tāra sahodara bhāiẏera mālapatrera madhye pāna-pātra rekhe dila. ataḥpara eka āhvāẏaka cītkāra kare valala: ‘he yātrīdala! tomarā niścaẏai cora.’
12:70.latin_ascii: atahpara se yakhana tadera dravya samagrira vyavastha kare dila, takhana se tara sahodara bhaiyera malapatrera madhye pana-patra rekhe dila. atahpara eka ahvayaka citkara kare valala: ‘he yatridala! tomara niscayai cora.’

12:71.latin_iast: tārā tādera dike ceẏe valala: ‘tomarā kī hāriẏecha?’
12:71.latin_ascii: tara tadera dike ceye valala: ‘tomara ki hariyechay’

12:72.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āmarā rājāra pānapātra hāriẏechi; ye tā ene deve se eka uṣṭra vojhāi māla pāve evaṃ āmi tāra jāmina.’
12:72.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘amara rajara panapatra hariyechi; ye ta ene deve se eka ustra vojhai mala pave evam ami tara jamina.’

12:73.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āllāhara śapatha! tomarā to jāna āmarā e deśe duṣkṛti karate āsini evaṃ āmarā corao nai.’
12:73.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘allahara sapatha! tomara to jana amara e dese duskrti karate asini evam amara corao nai.’

12:74.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘yadi tomarā mithyāvādī hao tave tāra śāsti kī?
12:74.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘yadi tomara mithyavadi hao tave tara sasti kiy

12:75.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘era śāsti yāra mālapatrera madhye pātraṭi pāoẏā yāve, se-i tāra vinimaẏa.’ ebhāve āmarā sīmālaṅghanakārīderake śāsti diẏe thāki.
12:75.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘era sasti yara malapatrera madhye patrati paoya yave, se-i tara vinimaya.’ ebhave amara simalanghanakariderake sasti diye thaki.

12:76.latin_iast: ataḥpara se tāra sahodara bhāiẏera mālapatra tala−āśira pūrve tādera mālapatra tala−āśi karate lāgala, pare tāra sahodara bhāiẏera mālapatrera madhya hate pātraṭi vera karala. ebhāve āmi iusuphera janya kauśala karechilāma. rājāra āine tāra sahodara bhāike se āṭaka karate pārata nā, āllāha icchā nā karale. āmi yāke icchā maryādāẏa unnīta kari. pratyeka jñānavāna vyaktira opara āche ekajana sarvajñānī.
12:76.latin_ascii: atahpara se tara sahodara bhaiyera malapatra tala−asira purve tadera malapatra tala−asi karate lagala, pare tara sahodara bhaiyera malapatrera madhya hate patrati vera karala. ebhave ami iusuphera janya kausala karechilama. rajara aine tara sahodara bhaike se ataka karate parata na, allaha iccha na karale. ami yake iccha maryadaya unnita kari. pratyeka jnanavana vyaktira opara ache ekajana sarvajnani.

12:77.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘se yadi curi kare thāke tave tāra sahodara bhāio to pūrve curi karechila.’ kintu iusupha (prakṛta vyāpāra) nijera mane gopana rākhala evaṃ tādera nikaṭa prakāśa karala nā; se (mane mane) valala: ‘tomādera avasthāna āro nikṛṣṭatama evaṃ tomarā yā valacha, se samvandhe āllāha saviśeṣa avahita.’
12:77.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘se yadi curi kare thake tave tara sahodara bhaio to purve curi karechila.’ kintu iusupha (prakrta vyapara) nijera mane gopana rakhala evam tadera nikata prakasa karala na; se (mane mane) valala: ‘tomadera avasthana aro nikrstatama evam tomara ya valacha, se samvandhe allaha savisesa avahita.’

12:78.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he ‘āyīya, tāra pitā atiśaẏa vṛddha; sutarāṃ era sthale āpani āmādera ekajanake rākhuna. āmarā āpanāke dekhachi mahānubhava vyaktidera ekajana.’
12:78.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he ‘ayiya, tara pita atisaya vrddha; sutaram era sthale apani amadera ekajanake rakhuna. amara apanake dekhachi mahanubhava vyaktidera ekajana.’

12:79.latin_iast: se (iusupha) valala: ‘yāra nikaṭa āmarā āmādera māla peẏechi, tāke chār̤ā anyake rākhāra aparādha hate āmarā āllāhara āśraẏa nicchi. erūpa karale āmarā avaśyai sīmālaṅghanakārī hava.’
12:79.latin_ascii: se (iusupha) valala: ‘yara nikata amara amadera mala peyechi, take chara anyake rakhara aparadha hate amara allahara asraya nicchi. erupa karale amara avasyai simalanghanakari hava.’

12:80.latin_iast: yakhana tārā tāra nikaṭa hate sampūrṇa nirāśa hala, takhana tārā nirjane giẏe parāmarśa karate lāgala. tādera vaẏojyeṣṭha vyakti valala: ‘tomarā ki jāna nā ye, tomādera pitā tomādera nikaṭa hate āllāhara nāme aṅgīkāra niẏechena evaṃ pūrveo tomarā iusuphera vyāpāre tra“ṭi karechile. sutarāṃ āmi kichutei e deśa tyāga karava nā yatakṣaṇa nā āmāra pitā āmāke anumati dena athavā āllāha āmāra janya kona vyavasthā karena evaṃ tinii śreṣṭha vicāraka.
12:80.latin_ascii: yakhana tara tara nikata hate sampurna nirasa hala, takhana tara nirjane giye paramarsa karate lagala. tadera vayojyestha vyakti valala: ‘tomara ki jana na ye, tomadera pita tomadera nikata hate allahara name angikara niyechena evam purveo tomara iusuphera vyapare tra“ti karechile. sutaram ami kichutei e desa tyaga karava na yataksana na amara pita amake anumati dena athava allaha amara janya kona vyavastha karena evam tinii srestha vicaraka.

12:81.latin_iast: tomarā tomādera pitāra nikaṭa phire yāo evaṃ vala: ‘he āmādera pitā! āpanāra putra curi kareche evaṃ āmarā yā jāni tārai pratyakṣa vivaraṇa dilāma āra ajānā vyāpāre āmarā saṃrakṣaṇakārī nai.
12:81.latin_ascii: tomara tomadera pitara nikata phire yao evam vala: ‘he amadera pita! apanara putra curi kareche evam amara ya jani tarai pratyaksa vivarana dilama ara ajana vyapare amara samraksanakari nai.

12:82.latin_iast: ye janapade āmarā chilāma tāra adhivāsīgaṇake jijñesa kara evaṃ ye yātrīdalera sāthe āmarā esechi tāderakeo. āmarā avaśyai satya valachi.’
12:82.latin_ascii: ye janapade amara chilama tara adhivasiganake jijnesa kara evam ye yatridalera sathe amara esechi taderakeo. amara avasyai satya valachi.’

12:83.latin_iast: iẏā‘kūva valala: ‘nā, tomādera mana tomādera janya ekaṭi kāhinī sājiẏe diẏeche, sutarāṃ pūrṇa dhairyai śreẏa; haẏato āllāha tāderake ekasaṅge āmāra nikaṭa ene devena. avaśya tinii sarvajña, prajñāmaẏa.’
12:83.latin_ascii: iya‘kuva valala: ‘na, tomadera mana tomadera janya ekati kahini sajiye diyeche, sutaram purna dhairyai sreya; hayato allaha taderake ekasange amara nikata ene devena. avasya tinii sarvajna, prajnamaya.’

12:84.latin_iast: se tādera hate mukha phiriẏe nila evaṃ valala: ‘āphasosa iusuphera janya.’ śoke tāra cakṣudvaẏa sādā haẏe giẏechila evaṃ se chila asahanīẏa manastāpe kliṣṭa.
12:84.latin_ascii: se tadera hate mukha phiriye nila evam valala: ‘aphasosa iusuphera janya.’ soke tara caksudvaya sada haye giyechila evam se chila asahaniya manastape klista.

12:85.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āllāhara śapatha! āpani to iusuphera kathā sadā smaraṇa karate thākavena yatakṣaṇa nā āpani mumūrṣu havena, athavā mṛtyu varaṇa karavena.’
12:85.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘allahara sapatha! apani to iusuphera katha sada smarana karate thakavena yataksana na apani mumursu havena, athava mrtyu varana karavena.’

12:86.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmi āmāra asahanīẏa vedanā, āmāra duḥkha śudhu āllāhara nikaṭa nivedana karachi evaṃ āmi āllāhara nikaṭa hate yā jāni tomarā tā jāna nā.
12:86.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ami amara asahaniya vedana, amara duhkha sudhu allahara nikata nivedana karachi evam ami allahara nikata hate ya jani tomara ta jana na.

12:87.latin_iast: he āmāra putragaṇa! tomarā yāo, iusupha o tāra sahodara bhāiẏera anusandhāna kara evaṃ āllāhara rahamata hate tomarā nirāśa haio nā. kāraṇa āllāhara rahamata hate keui nirāśa haẏa nā, kāphira sampradāẏa vyatīta.’
12:87.latin_ascii: he amara putragana! tomara yao, iusupha o tara sahodara bhaiyera anusandhana kara evam allahara rahamata hate tomara nirasa haio na. karana allahara rahamata hate keui nirasa haya na, kaphira sampradaya vyatita.’

12:88.latin_iast: yakhana tārā tāra nikaṭa upasthita hala takhana valala: ‘he ‘āyīya! āmarā o āmādera parivāra-parijana (durbhikṣe) vipanna haẏe par̤echi evaṃ āmarā tuccha pu~ji niẏe esechi; āpani āmādera rasada pūrṇa mātrāẏa dina evaṃ āmāderake dāna karuna; niścaẏai āllāha dātāgaṇake puraskṛta
12:88.latin_ascii: yakhana tara tara nikata upasthita hala takhana valala: ‘he ‘ayiya! amara o amadera parivara-parijana (durbhikse) vipanna haye parechi evam amara tuccha pu~ji niye esechi; apani amadera rasada purna matraya dina evam amaderake dana karuna; niscayai allaha dataganake puraskrta

12:89.latin_iast: se valala: ‘tomarā ki jāna, tomarā iusupha o tāra sahodara bhāiẏera prati kirūpa ācaraṇa karechile, yakhana tomarā chile ajña?’
12:89.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘tomara ki jana, tomara iusupha o tara sahodara bhaiyera prati kirupa acarana karechile, yakhana tomara chile ajnay’

12:90.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘tave ki tumii iusupha?’ se valala: ‘āmii iusupha evaṃ e āmāra sahodara bhāi; āllāha āmādera prati anugraha karechena. niścaẏai ye vyakti muttākī evaṃ dhairyaśīla, āllāha (serūpa) satkarmaparāẏaṇadera śramaphala naṣṭa karena nā.’
12:90.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘tave ki tumii iusuphay’ se valala: ‘amii iusupha evam e amara sahodara bhai; allaha amadera prati anugraha karechena. niscayai ye vyakti muttaki evam dhairyasila, allaha (serupa) satkarmaparayanadera sramaphala nasta karena na.’

12:91.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āllāhara śapatha! āllāha niścaẏai tomāke āmādera opara prādhānya diẏechena evaṃ āmarā to aparādhī chilāma.’
12:91.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘allahara sapatha! allaha niscayai tomake amadera opara pradhanya diyechena evam amara to aparadhi chilama.’

12:92.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āja tomādera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei. āllāha tomāderake kṣamā karuna evaṃ tinii śreṣṭha daẏālu.’
12:92.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘aja tomadera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei. allaha tomaderake ksama karuna evam tinii srestha dayalu.’

12:93.latin_iast: tomarā āmāra e jāmāṭi niẏe yāo evaṃ eṭā āmāra pitāra mukhamaṇḍalera opara rekho; tini dṛṣṭiśakti phire pāvena. āra tomādera parivārera sakalakei āmāra nikaṭa niẏe eso.’
12:93.latin_ascii: tomara amara e jamati niye yao evam eta amara pitara mukhamandalera opara rekho; tini drstisakti phire pavena. ara tomadera parivarera sakalakei amara nikata niye eso.’

12:94.latin_iast: ataḥpara yātrīdala yakhana vera haẏe par̤ala takhana tādera pitā valala: ‘tomarā yadi āmāke vokā mane nā kara tave vali, niścaẏai āmi iusuphera ghrāṇa pācchi.’
12:94.latin_ascii: atahpara yatridala yakhana vera haye parala takhana tadera pita valala: ‘tomara yadi amake voka mane na kara tave vali, niscayai ami iusuphera ghrana pacchi.’

12:95.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āllāhara śapatha! āpani to āpanāra pūrva vibhrāntitei raẏechena.
12:95.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘allahara sapatha! apani to apanara purva vibhrantitei rayechena.

12:96.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana susaṃvādavāhaka upasthita hala evaṃ tāra mukhamaṇḍalera opara jāmāṭi rākhala takhana se dṛṣṭiśakti phire pela. se valala: ‘āmi ki tomāderake valini ye, āmi āllāhara nikaṭa hate yā jāni tomarā tā jāna nā?’
12:96.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana susamvadavahaka upasthita hala evam tara mukhamandalera opara jamati rakhala takhana se drstisakti phire pela. se valala: ‘ami ki tomaderake valini ye, ami allahara nikata hate ya jani tomara ta jana nay’

12:97.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he āmādera pitā! āmādera pāpera janya kṣamā prārthanā karuna; āmarā niścaẏai aparādhī.’
12:97.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he amadera pita! amadera papera janya ksama prarthana karuna; amara niscayai aparadhi.’

12:98.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmi āmāra pratipālakera nikaṭa tomādera janya kṣamā prārthanā karava. tini ati kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.’
12:98.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ami amara pratipalakera nikata tomadera janya ksama prarthana karava. tini ati ksamasila, parama dayalu.’

12:99.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā yakhana iusuphera nikaṭa upasthita hala, takhana se tāra pitā-mātāke nijera kāche sthāna dila evaṃ valala: ‘āpanārā āllāhara icchāẏa nirāpade misare praveśa karuna.’
12:99.latin_ascii: atahpara tara yakhana iusuphera nikata upasthita hala, takhana se tara pita-matake nijera kache sthana dila evam valala: ‘apanara allahara icchaya nirapade misare pravesa karuna.’

12:100.latin_iast: evaṃ (iusupha) tāra mātā-pitāke siṃhāsane vasāla evaṃ tārā sakale tāra sammāne sijadāẏa luṭiẏe par̤ala. se valala: ‘he āmāra pitā! eṭāi āmāra pūrvekāra svapnera vyākhyā; āmāra pratipālaka seṭā satye pariṇata karechena evaṃ tini āmāke kārāgāra hate mukta karechena evaṃ śaẏatāna āmāra o āmāra bhrātādera samparka naṣṭa karāra parao āpanāderake maru añcala hate ekhāne ene diẏe āmāra prati anugraha karechena. āmāra pratipālaka yā icchā tā nipūṇatāra sāthe karena. tini to sarvajña, prajñāmaẏa.’
12:100.latin_ascii: evam (iusupha) tara mata-pitake simhasane vasala evam tara sakale tara sammane sijadaya lutiye parala. se valala: ‘he amara pita! etai amara purvekara svapnera vyakhya; amara pratipalaka seta satye parinata karechena evam tini amake karagara hate mukta karechena evam sayatana amara o amara bhratadera samparka nasta karara parao apanaderake maru ancala hate ekhane ene diye amara prati anugraha karechena. amara pratipalaka ya iccha ta nipunatara sathe karena. tini to sarvajna, prajnamaya.’

12:101.latin_iast: he āmāra pratipālaka! tumi āmāke rājya dāna karecha evaṃ svapnera vyākhyā śikṣā diẏecha. he ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra sraṣṭā! tumii duniẏā o ākhirāte āmāra abhibhāvaka. tumi āmāke musalima avasthāẏa mṛtyu dāo evaṃ āmāke satkarmaparāẏaṇadera antarbhukta kara.’
12:101.latin_ascii: he amara pratipalaka! tumi amake rajya dana karecha evam svapnera vyakhya siksa diyecha. he akasamandali o prthivira srasta! tumii duniya o akhirate amara abhibhavaka. tumi amake musalima avasthaya mrtyu dao evam amake satkarmaparayanadera antarbhukta kara.’

12:102.latin_iast: eṭā adṛśyera saṃvāda yā tomāke āmi oẏāhī dvārā avahita karechi; ṣar̤ayantrakāle yakhana tārā matānaikye pau~chechila, takhana tumi tādera saṅge chile nā.
12:102.latin_ascii: eta adrsyera samvada ya tomake ami oyahi dvara avahita karechi; sarayantrakale yakhana tara matanaikye pau~chechila, takhana tumi tadera sange chile na.

12:103.latin_iast: tumi yatai ākāksakṣā kara nā kena, adhikāṃśa lokai viśvāsī naẏa.
12:103.latin_ascii: tumi yatai akaksaksa kara na kena, adhikamsa lokai visvasi naya.

12:104.latin_iast: evaṃ tumi tāra janya tādera nikaṭa kona pāriśramika cāo nā. eṭā viśvavāsīra janya upadeśa vyatīta kichu naẏa.
12:104.latin_ascii: evam tumi tara janya tadera nikata kona parisramika cao na. eta visvavasira janya upadesa vyatita kichu naya.

12:105.latin_iast: ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte aneka nidarśana raẏeche; tārā e samasta pratyakṣa kare, kintu tārā esava theke vimukha.
12:105.latin_ascii: akasamandali o prthivite aneka nidarsana rayeche; tara e samasta pratyaksa kare, kintu tara esava theke vimukha.

12:106.latin_iast: adhikāṃśa mānuṣa āllāhara prati īmāna ānā sattveo muśarika.
12:106.latin_ascii: adhikamsa manusa allahara prati imana ana sattveo musarika.

12:107.latin_iast: tave ki tārā āllāhara sarvagrāsī śāsti hate athavā tādera ajñātasāre kiẏāmatera ākasmika upasthiti hate nirāpada?
12:107.latin_ascii: tave ki tara allahara sarvagrasi sasti hate athava tadera ajnatasare kiyamatera akasmika upasthiti hate nirapaday

12:108.latin_iast: vala: ‘eṭāi āmāra patha ḥ āllāhara prati mānuṣake āmi āhvāna kari sajñāne o dalīla-pramāṇera sāthe āmi evaṃ āmāra anusārīgaṇao. āllāhara pavitratā varṇanā karachi evaṃ yārā āllāhara sāthe śarīka kare āmi tādera antarbhukta nai.’
12:108.latin_ascii: vala: ‘etai amara patha h allahara prati manusake ami ahvana kari sajnane o dalila-pramanera sathe ami evam amara anusariganao. allahara pavitrata varnana karachi evam yara allahara sathe sarika kare ami tadera antarbhukta nai.’

12:109.latin_iast: tomāra pūrveo janapadavāsīdera madhya hate puruṣagaṇakei preraṇa karechilāma, yādera nikaṭa oẏāhī pāṭhātāma. tārā ki pṛthivīte bhramaṇa kareni evaṃ tādera pūrvavartīdera kī pariṇāma haẏechila tā dekheni? yārā muttākī tādera janya ākhirātai śreẏa; tomarā ki vujha nā?
12:109.latin_ascii: tomara purveo janapadavasidera madhya hate purusaganakei prerana karechilama, yadera nikata oyahi pathatama. tara ki prthivite bhramana kareni evam tadera purvavartidera ki parinama hayechila ta dekheniy yara muttaki tadera janya akhiratai sreya; tomara ki vujha nay

12:110.latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana rāsūlagaṇa nirāśa hala evaṃ dhāraṇā karala ye, tāderake mithyā pratipanna karā have takhana tādera nikaṭa āmāra sāhāyya āsala. ebhāve āmi yāke icchā kari se uddhāra pāẏa. aparādhī sampradāẏa hate āmāra śāsti rada karā yāẏa nā.
12:110.latin_ascii: avasese yakhana rasulagana nirasa hala evam dharana karala ye, taderake mithya pratipanna kara have takhana tadera nikata amara sahayya asala. ebhave ami yake iccha kari se uddhara paya. aparadhi sampradaya hate amara sasti rada kara yaya na.

12:111.latin_iast: tādera vṛttānte vodhaśaktisampanna vyaktidera janya āche śikṣā. eṭā emana vāṇī yā mithyā racanā naẏa. kintu mu’minadera janya eṭāra pūrvagranthe yā āche tāra samarthana evaṃ samasta kichura viśada vivaraṇa, hidāẏāta o rahmata.
12:111.latin_ascii: tadera vrttante vodhasaktisampanna vyaktidera janya ache siksa. eta emana vani ya mithya racana naya. kintu mu’minadera janya etara purvagranthe ya ache tara samarthana evam samasta kichura visada vivarana, hidayata o rahmata.

13:1.latin_iast: āliph-lāma-mīm-rā, egulo kitāvera (kuraānera) āẏāta, tomāra pratipālaka hate tomāra prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche tāi satya; kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa ete īmāna āne nā.
13:1.latin_ascii: aliph-lama-mim-ra, egulo kitavera (kuraanera) ayata, tomara pratipalaka hate tomara prati ya avatirna hayeche tai satya; kintu adhikamsa manusa ete imana ane na.

13:2.latin_iast: āllāha-i ūrdhvadeśe ākāśamaṇḍalī sthāpana karechena stambha vyatīta yā tomarā dekhacha. ataḥpara tini ‘āraśe samunnata halena evaṃ sūrya o candrake (tomādera kalyāṇe) niẏojita karechena; pratyeke nirdiṣṭa kāla paryanta āvartana kare. tini sakala viṣaẏa niẏantraṇa karena evaṃ nidarśanasamūha viśadabhāve varṇanā karena, yāte tomarā tomādera pratipālakera saṅge sākṣāta samvandhe niścita viśvāsa karate pāra.
13:2.latin_ascii: allaha-i urdhvadese akasamandali sthapana karechena stambha vyatita ya tomara dekhacha. atahpara tini ‘arase samunnata halena evam surya o candrake (tomadera kalyane) niyojita karechena; pratyeke nirdista kala paryanta avartana kare. tini sakala visaya niyantrana karena evam nidarsanasamuha visadabhave varnana karena, yate tomara tomadera pratipalakera sange saksata samvandhe niscita visvasa karate para.

13:3.latin_iast: tinii bhū-talake vistṛta karechena evaṃ ete parvata o nadī sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ pratyeka prakārera phala sṛṣṭi karechena jor̤āẏa jor̤āẏa. tini divasake rātri dvārā ācchādita karena. ete avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche cintāśīla sampradāẏera janya.
13:3.latin_ascii: tinii bhu-talake vistrta karechena evam ete parvata o nadi srsti karechena evam pratyeka prakarera phala srsti karechena joraya joraya. tini divasake ratri dvara acchadita karena. ete avasyai nidarsana rayeche cintasila sampradayera janya.

13:4.latin_iast: pṛthivīte raẏeche paraspara saṃlagna bhūkhaṇḍa, ete (pṛthivīte) āche vibhinna āṅgura kānana, śasyakṣetra, ekādhika śīṣaviśiṣṭa athavā eka śīṣaviśiṣṭa khejura vṛkṣa, siñcita ekai pānite, evaṃ phala hiseve tādera katakake katakera upara āmi śreṣṭhatva diẏe thāki. avaśyai vodhaśaktisampanna sampradāẏera janya ete raẏeche nidarśana.
13:4.latin_ascii: prthivite rayeche paraspara samlagna bhukhanda, ete (prthivite) ache vibhinna angura kanana, sasyaksetra, ekadhika sisavisista athava eka sisavisista khejura vrksa, sincita ekai panite, evam phala hiseve tadera katakake katakera upara ami sresthatva diye thaki. avasyai vodhasaktisampanna sampradayera janya ete rayeche nidarsana.

13:5.latin_iast: yadi tumi vismita hao, tave vismaẏera viṣaẏa tādera kathā: ‘māṭite pariṇata haoẏāra parao ki āmarā nūtana jīvana lābha karava?’ tārāi tādera pratipālakake asvīkāra kare evaṃ tāderai galadeśe thākave lauhaśṛṅkhala. tārāi agnivāsī o sekhāne tārā sthāẏī have.
13:5.latin_ascii: yadi tumi vismita hao, tave vismayera visaya tadera katha: ‘matite parinata haoyara parao ki amara nutana jivana labha karavay’ tarai tadera pratipalakake asvikara kare evam taderai galadese thakave lauhasrnkhala. tarai agnivasi o sekhane tara sthayi have.

13:6.latin_iast: kalyāṇera pūrve tārā tomāke śāsti tvarānvita karate vale, yadio tādera pūrve era vahu dṛṣṭānta gata haẏeche. mānuṣera sīmālaṅghana sattveo tomāra pratipālaka to mānuṣera prati kṣamāśīla evaṃ tomāra pratipālaka śāsti dāne to kaṭhora.
13:6.latin_ascii: kalyanera purve tara tomake sasti tvaranvita karate vale, yadio tadera purve era vahu drstanta gata hayeche. manusera simalanghana sattveo tomara pratipalaka to manusera prati ksamasila evam tomara pratipalaka sasti dane to kathora.

13:7.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā vale, ‘tāra pratipālakera pakṣa theke tāra nikaṭa kona nidarśana avatīrṇa haẏa nā kena?’ tumi to kevala satarkakārī. evaṃ pratyeka sampradāẏera janya āche patha pradarśaka.
13:7.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara vale, ‘tara pratipalakera paksa theke tara nikata kona nidarsana avatirna haya na kenay’ tumi to kevala satarkakari. evam pratyeka sampradayera janya ache patha pradarsaka.

13:8.latin_iast: pratyeka nārī yā garbhe dhāraṇa kare evaṃ jarāẏute yā kichu kame o vār̤e āllāha tā jānena evaṃ tā~ra kāche pratyeka vasturai eka nirdiṣṭa parimāṇa āche.
13:8.latin_ascii: pratyeka nari ya garbhe dharana kare evam jarayute ya kichu kame o vare allaha ta janena evam ta~ra kache pratyeka vasturai eka nirdista parimana ache.

13:9.latin_iast: yā adṛśya o dṛśyamāna tini tā avagata; tini mahāna, sarveācca maryādāvāna.
13:9.latin_ascii: ya adrsya o drsyamana tini ta avagata; tini mahana, sarveacca maryadavana.

13:10.latin_iast: tomādera madhye ye kathā gopana rākhe evaṃ ye prakāśa kare, rātre ye ātmagopana kare evaṃ divase ye prakāśye vicaraṇa kare, tārā samabhāve āllāhara jñānagocara (raẏeche).
13:10.latin_ascii: tomadera madhye ye katha gopana rakhe evam ye prakasa kare, ratre ye atmagopana kare evam divase ye prakasye vicarana kare, tara samabhave allahara jnanagocara (rayeche).

13:11.latin_iast: mānuṣera janya tāra sammukhe o paścāte ekera para eka praharī phereśatā thāke; tārā āllāhara ādeśe tāra rakṣaṇāvekṣaṇa kare. evaṃ āllāha kona sampradāẏera avasthā parivartana karena nā yatakṣaṇa nā tārā nija avasthā nije parivartana kare. kona sampradāẏera samparke yadi āllāha aśubha kichu icchā karena tave tā mokāvelā karāra naẏa evaṃ tini vyatīta tādera kona abhibhāvakao nei.
13:11.latin_ascii: manusera janya tara sammukhe o pascate ekera para eka prahari pheresata thake; tara allahara adese tara raksanaveksana kare. evam allaha kona sampradayera avastha parivartana karena na yataksana na tara nija avastha nije parivartana kare. kona sampradayera samparke yadi allaha asubha kichu iccha karena tave ta mokavela karara naya evam tini vyatita tadera kona abhibhavakao nei.

13:12.latin_iast: tinii tomāderake dekhāna vijalī bhaẏa dekhāno o āśā sañcāra karāra janya evaṃ tinii sṛṣṭi karena bhārī megha;
13:12.latin_ascii: tinii tomaderake dekhana vijali bhaya dekhano o asa sancara karara janya evam tinii srsti karena bhari megha;

13:13.latin_iast: vajradhvani tā~ra sapraśaṃsā mahimā o pavitratā ghoṣaṇā kare, phereśtāgaṇao kare tā~ra bhaẏe. tini vajrapāta karena evaṃ yāke icchā tāra dvārā āghāta karena. āra tārā āllāha samvandhe vāga-vitaṇḍā kare, athaca tini mahāśaktiśālī.
13:13.latin_ascii: vajradhvani ta~ra saprasamsa mahima o pavitrata ghosana kare, pherestaganao kare ta~ra bhaye. tini vajrapata karena evam yake iccha tara dvara aghata karena. ara tara allaha samvandhe vaga-vitanda kare, athaca tini mahasaktisali.

13:14.latin_iast: satyera āhvāna tā~rai prāpta. yārā tā~ke vyatīta aparake āhvāna kare, tārā tāderake konai sār̤ā deẏa nā; tādera dṛṣṭānta se vyaktira mato, ye tāra mukhe pāni pau~chāve e āśāẏa tāra du‘hāta prasārita kare pānira dike, athaca seṭā tāra mukhe pau~chāvāra naẏa, kāphiradera āhvāna niṣphala.
13:14.latin_ascii: satyera ahvana ta~rai prapta. yara ta~ke vyatita aparake ahvana kare, tara taderake konai sara deya na; tadera drstanta se vyaktira mato, ye tara mukhe pani pau~chave e asaya tara du‘hata prasarita kare panira dike, athaca seta tara mukhe pau~chavara naya, kaphiradera ahvana nisphala.

13:15.latin_iast: āllāhara prati sijdāvanata haẏa ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche icchāẏa vā anicchāẏa evaṃ tādera chāẏāguloo sakāla o sandhyāẏa.
13:15.latin_ascii: allahara prati sijdavanata haya akasamandali o prthivite ya kichu ache icchaya va anicchaya evam tadera chayaguloo sakala o sandhyaya.

13:16.latin_iast: vala: ‘ke ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra pratipālaka?’ vala: ‘āllāha.’ vala: ‘tave ki tomarā abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa karecha āllāhara parivarte aparake yārā nijedera lābha vā kṣati sādhaneo sakṣama naẏa?’ vala: ‘andha o cakṣuṣmāna ki samāna athavā andhakāra o ālo ki eka?’ tave kī tārā āllāhara emana śarīka sthāpana kareche yārā sṛṣṭi kareche āllāhara sṛṣṭira nyāẏa, ye kāraṇe sṛṣṭi tādera nikaṭa sādṛśya mane haẏeche? vala: ‘āllāha sakala vastura sraṣṭā; tini eka, parākramaśālī.’
13:16.latin_ascii: vala: ‘ke akasamandali o prthivira pratipalakay’ vala: ‘allaha.’ vala: ‘tave ki tomara abhibhavakarupe grahana karecha allahara parivarte aparake yara nijedera labha va ksati sadhaneo saksama nayay’ vala: ‘andha o caksusmana ki samana athava andhakara o alo ki ekay’ tave ki tara allahara emana sarika sthapana kareche yara srsti kareche allahara srstira nyaya, ye karane srsti tadera nikata sadrsya mane hayechey vala: ‘allaha sakala vastura srasta; tini eka, parakramasali.’

13:17.latin_iast: tini ākāśa hate vṛṣṭipāta karena, phale upatyakāsamūha tādera parimāṇa anuyāẏī pa−āvita haẏa evaṃ pa−āvana tāra uparisthita āvarjanā bhāsiẏe niẏe yāẏa, ebhāve āvarjanā uparibhāge āse yakhana alaṃkāra athavā taijasapatra nirmāṇera uddeśye agnite (padārthake) uttapta karā haẏa. ebhāve āllāha satya o asatyera dṛṣṭānta diẏe thākena. yā āvarjanā tā khar̤akuṭāra mata cale yāẏa evaṃ yā mānuṣera upakāre āse tā jamite theke yāẏa. ebhāve āllāha upamā diẏe thākena.
13:17.latin_ascii: tini akasa hate vrstipata karena, phale upatyakasamuha tadera parimana anuyayi pa−avita haya evam pa−avana tara uparisthita avarjana bhasiye niye yaya, ebhave avarjana uparibhage ase yakhana alamkara athava taijasapatra nirmanera uddesye agnite (padarthake) uttapta kara haya. ebhave allaha satya o asatyera drstanta diye thakena. ya avarjana ta kharakutara mata cale yaya evam ya manusera upakare ase ta jamite theke yaya. ebhave allaha upama diye thakena.

13:18.latin_iast: kalyāṇa tādera janya yārā tādera pratipālakera āhvāne sār̤ā deẏa. evaṃ yārā tā~ra ḍāke sār̤ā deẏa nā, tādera yadi pṛthivīte yā kichu āche tā samastai thākata evaṃ tāra sāthe āro samaparimāṇa thākata tārā (śāsti theke vā~cāra janya) muktipaṇasvarūpa tā dita (kintu tā grahaṇa karā hata nā). tādera hiseva have kaṭhora evaṃ jāhānnāma have tādera āvāsa, seṭā katai nā nikṛṣṭa āśraẏasthala!
13:18.latin_ascii: kalyana tadera janya yara tadera pratipalakera ahvane sara deya. evam yara ta~ra dake sara deya na, tadera yadi prthivite ya kichu ache ta samastai thakata evam tara sathe aro samaparimana thakata tara (sasti theke va~cara janya) muktipanasvarupa ta dita (kintu ta grahana kara hata na). tadera hiseva have kathora evam jahannama have tadera avasa, seta katai na nikrsta asrayasthala!

13:19.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālaka hate tomāra prati yā avatīrṇa haẏeche tā ye vyakti satya vale jāne se āra andha ki samāna? upadeśa grahaṇa kare śudhu vivekasampanna vyaktigaṇai.
13:19.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalaka hate tomara prati ya avatirna hayeche ta ye vyakti satya vale jane se ara andha ki samanay upadesa grahana kare sudhu vivekasampanna vyaktiganai.

13:20.latin_iast: yārā āllāha pradatta aṅgīkāra rakṣā kare evaṃ pratijñā bhaṅga kare nā.
13:20.latin_ascii: yara allaha pradatta angikara raksa kare evam pratijna bhanga kare na.

13:21.latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha ye samparka akṣuṇatna rākhate ādeśa karechena yārā tā akṣuṇatna rākhe, bhaẏa kare tādera pratipālakake evaṃ bhaẏa kare kaṭhora hisāvake,
13:21.latin_ascii: evam allaha ye samparka aksunatna rakhate adesa karechena yara ta aksunatna rakhe, bhaya kare tadera pratipalakake evam bhaya kare kathora hisavake,

13:22.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā tādera pratipālakera (mukhamaṇḍala daśarnera vā) santuṣṭi lābhera janya dhairya dhāraṇa kare, sālāta kāẏema kare āmi tāderake ye jīvanopakaraṇa diẏechi tā hate gopane o prakāśye vyaẏa kare evaṃ yārā bhāla dvārā manda dūrībhūta kare, edera janya śubha pariṇāma
13:22.latin_ascii: evam yara tadera pratipalakera (mukhamandala dasarnera va) santusti labhera janya dhairya dharana kare, salata kayema kare ami taderake ye jivanopakarana diyechi ta hate gopane o prakasye vyaya kare evam yara bhala dvara manda duribhuta kare, edera janya subha parinama

13:23.latin_iast: tā hala) sthāẏī jānnāta, ete tārā praveśa karave evaṃ tādera pitā-mātā, pati-patatnī o santāna-santatidera madhye yārā satkarma kareche tārāo, evaṃ phereśtāgaṇa tādera nikaṭa upasthita have pratyeka dvāra diẏe,
13:23.latin_ascii: ta hala) sthayi jannata, ete tara pravesa karave evam tadera pita-mata, pati-patatni o santana-santatidera madhye yara satkarma kareche tarao, evam pherestagana tadera nikata upasthita have pratyeka dvara diye,

13:24.latin_iast: (evaṃ valave): ‘tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa karecha vale tomādera prati (sālāma) śānti; kata bhāla e pariṇāma!’
13:24.latin_ascii: (evam valave): ‘tomara dhairya dharana karecha vale tomadera prati (salama) santi; kata bhala e parinama!’

13:25.latin_iast: yārā āllāhara sāthe dṛr̤ha aṅgīkāre āvaddha havāra para seṭā bhaṅga kare, ye samparka akṣuṇatna rākhate āllāha ādeśa karechena tā chinna kare evaṃ pṛthivīte aśānti sṛṣṭi kare ver̤āẏa tādera janya lā‘nata evaṃ tādera janya āche manda āvāsa.
13:25.latin_ascii: yara allahara sathe drrha angikare avaddha havara para seta bhanga kare, ye samparka aksunatna rakhate allaha adesa karechena ta chinna kare evam prthivite asanti srsti kare veraya tadera janya la‘nata evam tadera janya ache manda avasa.

13:26.latin_iast: āllāha yāra janya icchā tāra jīvanopakaraṇa vardhita karena evaṃ saṃkucita karena; kintu erā pārthiva jīvane ula−āsita, athaca duniẏāra jīvana ākhirātera tulanāẏa kṣaṇasthāẏī bhogamātra.
13:26.latin_ascii: allaha yara janya iccha tara jivanopakarana vardhita karena evam samkucita karena; kintu era parthiva jivane ula−asita, athaca duniyara jivana akhiratera tulanaya ksanasthayi bhogamatra.

13:27.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā vale, ‘tāra pratipālakera nikaṭa hate tāra nikaṭa kona nidarśana avatīrṇa haẏa nā kena?’ vala: ‘niścaẏai āllāha yāke icchā pathabhraṣṭa karena evaṃ tini tāderake tā~ra patha dekhāna yārā tā~ra abhimukhī,
13:27.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara vale, ‘tara pratipalakera nikata hate tara nikata kona nidarsana avatirna haya na kenay’ vala: ‘niscayai allaha yake iccha pathabhrasta karena evam tini taderake ta~ra patha dekhana yara ta~ra abhimukhi,

13:28.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne evaṃ āllāhara smaraṇe yādera antara praśānta haẏa; jene rekha! āllāhara smaraṇei antara praśānta haẏa.
13:28.latin_ascii: yara imana ane evam allahara smarane yadera antara prasanta haya; jene rekha! allahara smaranei antara prasanta haya.

13:29.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o satkarma kare, sukhavara evaṃ śubha pariṇāma tāderai.’
13:29.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o satkarma kare, sukhavara evam subha parinama taderai.’

13:30.latin_iast: ebhāve āmi tomāke pāṭhiẏechi eka jātira prati yāra pūrve vahu jāti gata haẏeche, tādera nikaṭa tilāoẏāta karāra janya, yā āmi tomāra prati pratyādeśa karechi. tathāpi tārā daẏāmaẏake asvīkāra kare. vala: ‘tinii āmāra pratipālaka; tini vyatīta anya kona satyikāra ilāha nei. tā~rai upara āmi nirbhara kari evaṃ āmāra pratyāvartana tā~rai nikaṭa.’
13:30.latin_ascii: ebhave ami tomake pathiyechi eka jatira prati yara purve vahu jati gata hayeche, tadera nikata tilaoyata karara janya, ya ami tomara prati pratyadesa karechi. tathapi tara dayamayake asvikara kare. vala: ‘tinii amara pratipalaka; tini vyatita anya kona satyikara ilaha nei. ta~rai upara ami nirbhara kari evam amara pratyavartana ta~rai nikata.’

13:31.latin_iast: āra yadi kona kuraāna emana hata yāra dvārā parvatake gatiśīla karā yeta athavā pṛthivīke vidīrṇa karā yeta athavā mṛtera sāthe kathā valā yeta, tavuo tārā tāte viśvāsa karata nā. kintu samasta viṣaẏai ekamātra āllāhara ikhatiẏārabhukta. tave ki yārā īmāna eneche tārā avagata haẏani ye, āllāha icchā karale niścaẏa sakalake satpathe paricālita karate pāratena? yārā kupharī kareche tādera karmaphalera janya tādera viparyaẏa ghaṭatei thākave, athavā viparyaẏa tādera āśepāśe āpatita hatei thākave yatakṣaṇa paryanta nā āllāhara pratiśruti ese par̤ave. niścaẏai āllāha pratiśrutira vyatikrama karena nā.
13:31.latin_ascii: ara yadi kona kuraana emana hata yara dvara parvatake gatisila kara yeta athava prthivike vidirna kara yeta athava mrtera sathe katha vala yeta, tavuo tara tate visvasa karata na. kintu samasta visayai ekamatra allahara ikhatiyarabhukta. tave ki yara imana eneche tara avagata hayani ye, allaha iccha karale niscaya sakalake satpathe paricalita karate paratenay yara kuphari kareche tadera karmaphalera janya tadera viparyaya ghatatei thakave, athava viparyaya tadera asepase apatita hatei thakave yataksana paryanta na allahara pratisruti ese parave. niscayai allaha pratisrutira vyatikrama karena na.

13:32.latin_iast: tomāra pūrveo aneka rāsūlake ṭhāṭṭā-vidraƒpa karā haẏeche evaṃ yārā kupharī kareche tāderake āmi kichu avakāśa diẏechilāma, tārapara tāderake śāsti diẏechilāma. kemana chila āmāra śāsti!
13:32.latin_ascii: tomara purveo aneka rasulake thatta-vidraƒpa kara hayeche evam yara kuphari kareche taderake ami kichu avakasa diyechilama, tarapara taderake sasti diyechilama. kemana chila amara sasti!

13:33.latin_iast: pratyeka mānuṣa yā kare tāra yini paryavekṣaka (tini ki edera akṣama ilāhgulora mato?) athaca tārā āllāhara sāthe vahu śarīka kareche. vala: ‘tādera paricaẏa dāo.’ tomarā ki pṛthivīra madhye emana kichura saṃvāda dite cāo yā tini jānena nā? athavā eṭā vāhyika kathā mātra? nā, kāphiradera nikaṭa tādera cakrānta śobhana kare deẏā haẏeche evaṃ tāderake satpatha hate nivṛta karā haẏeche, āra āllāha yāke vibhrānta karena tāra kona pathapradarśaka nei.
13:33.latin_ascii: pratyeka manusa ya kare tara yini paryaveksaka (tini ki edera aksama ilahgulora matoy) athaca tara allahara sathe vahu sarika kareche. vala: ‘tadera paricaya dao.’ tomara ki prthivira madhye emana kichura samvada dite cao ya tini janena nay athava eta vahyika katha matray na, kaphiradera nikata tadera cakranta sobhana kare deya hayeche evam taderake satpatha hate nivrta kara hayeche, ara allaha yake vibhranta karena tara kona pathapradarsaka nei.

13:34.latin_iast: tādera janya duniẏāra jīvane āche śāsti evaṃ ākhirātera śāsti to āro kaṭhora! evaṃ āllāhara śāsti hate rakṣā karāra tādera keu nei.
13:34.latin_ascii: tadera janya duniyara jivane ache sasti evam akhiratera sasti to aro kathora! evam allahara sasti hate raksa karara tadera keu nei.

13:35.latin_iast: muttākīderake ye jānnātera pratiśruti deẏā haẏeche tāra upamā erūpa: tāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita, tāra phalasamūha o chāẏā cirasthāẏī. yārā muttākī eṭā tādera karmaphala evaṃ kāphiradera karmaphala agni.
13:35.latin_ascii: muttakiderake ye jannatera pratisruti deya hayeche tara upama erupa: tara padadese nadi pravahita, tara phalasamuha o chaya cirasthayi. yara muttaki eta tadera karmaphala evam kaphiradera karmaphala agni.

13:36.latin_iast: āmi yāderake kitāva diẏechi tārā yā tomāra prati avatīrṇa haẏeche tāte ānanda pāẏa, kintu kona kona dala tāra kataka aṃśa asvīkāra kare. vala: ‘āmi to āllāhara ‘ivādāta karate o tā~ra kona śarīka sthira nā karate ādiṣṭa haẏechi. āmi tā~rai prati āhvāna kari evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa āmāra pratyāvartana.’
13:36.latin_ascii: ami yaderake kitava diyechi tara ya tomara prati avatirna hayeche tate ananda paya, kintu kona kona dala tara kataka amsa asvikara kare. vala: ‘ami to allahara ‘ivadata karate o ta~ra kona sarika sthira na karate adista hayechi. ami ta~rai prati ahvana kari evam ta~rai nikata amara pratyavartana.’

13:37.latin_iast: ebhāve āmi (kuraāna) avatīrṇa karechi vidhānarūpe āravī bhāṣāẏa. jñāna prāptira para tumi yadi tādera kheẏāla-khuśīra anusaraṇa kara tave āllāhara viruddhe tomāra kona abhibhāvaka o rakṣaka thākave nā.
13:37.latin_ascii: ebhave ami (kuraana) avatirna karechi vidhanarupe aravi bhasaya. jnana praptira para tumi yadi tadera kheyala-khusira anusarana kara tave allahara viruddhe tomara kona abhibhavaka o raksaka thakave na.

13:38.latin_iast: tomāra pūrve āmi aneka rāsūla preraṇa karechilāma evaṃ tāderake strī o santāna-santati diẏechilāma. āllāhara anumati vyatīta kona nidarśana upasthita karā kona rāsūlera kāja naẏa. pratyeka viṣaẏera nirdhārita kāla lipivaddha.
13:38.latin_ascii: tomara purve ami aneka rasula prerana karechilama evam taderake stri o santana-santati diyechilama. allahara anumati vyatita kona nidarsana upasthita kara kona rasulera kaja naya. pratyeka visayera nirdharita kala lipivaddha.

13:39.latin_iast: āllāha yā icchā tā niściha“ karena evaṃ yā icchā tā pratiṣṭhita rākhena evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa āche ummula kitāva (lāohe māhaphuja).
13:39.latin_ascii: allaha ya iccha ta nisciha“ karena evam ya iccha ta pratisthita rakhena evam ta~rai nikata ache ummula kitava (laohe mahaphuja).

13:40.latin_iast: tāderake ye śāstira pratiśruti diẏechi tāra kichu yadi tomāke dekhāi athavā yadi era pūrve tomāra mṛtyu ghaṭāi (ubhaẏa avasthātei) tomāra kartavya to kevala pracāra karā evaṃ hisāva-nikāśa ekamātra āmāra kāja.
13:40.latin_ascii: taderake ye sastira pratisruti diyechi tara kichu yadi tomake dekhai athava yadi era purve tomara mrtyu ghatai (ubhaya avasthatei) tomara kartavya to kevala pracara kara evam hisava-nikasa ekamatra amara kaja.

13:41.latin_iast: tārā ki dekhe nā ye, āmi tādera deśake caturdika hate saṃkucita kare enechi? āllāha ādeśa karena, tā~ra ādeśa rada karāra keu nei evaṃ tini hiseva grahaṇe tatpara.
13:41.latin_ascii: tara ki dekhe na ye, ami tadera desake caturdika hate samkucita kare enechiy allaha adesa karena, ta~ra adesa rada karara keu nei evam tini hiseva grahane tatpara.

13:42.latin_iast: tādera pūrve yārā chila tārāo cakrānta karechila; kintu samasta kauśala āllāhara ikhatiẏāre. pratyeka vyakti yā kare tini tā jānena evaṃ kāphiragaṇa śīghrai jānave śubha pariṇāma kādera janya.
13:42.latin_ascii: tadera purve yara chila tarao cakranta karechila; kintu samasta kausala allahara ikhatiyare. pratyeka vyakti ya kare tini ta janena evam kaphiragana sighrai janave subha parinama kadera janya.

13:43.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā vale, ‘tumi āllāhara prerita rāsūla nao.’ vala: ‘ āllāha evaṃ yādera nikaṭa kitāvera jñāna āche, tārā āmāra o tomādera madhye sākṣī hiseve yatheṣṭa.’
13:43.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara vale, ‘tumi allahara prerita rasula nao.’ vala: ‘ allaha evam yadera nikata kitavera jnana ache, tara amara o tomadera madhye saksi hiseve yathesta.’

14:1.latin_iast: ālipha-lām-rā, ekaṭi kitāva yā tomāra prati avatīrṇa karechi yāte tumi mānava jātike tādera pratipālakera nirdeśatra“me andhakāra hate ālora dike vera kare ānate pāra, tā~ra pathe yini parākramaśālī, praśaṃsita.
14:1.latin_ascii: alipha-lam-ra, ekati kitava ya tomara prati avatirna karechi yate tumi manava jatike tadera pratipalakera nirdesatra“me andhakara hate alora dike vera kare anate para, ta~ra pathe yini parakramasali, prasamsita.

14:2.latin_iast: tini āllāha ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche tā tā~rai. kaṭhina śāstira durbheāga kāphiradera janya.
14:2.latin_ascii: tini allaha akasamandali o prthivite ya kichu ache ta ta~rai. kathina sastira durbheaga kaphiradera janya.

14:3.latin_iast: yārā duniẏāra jīvanake ākhirātera ceẏe (adhika) bhālavāse, mānuṣake āllāhara patha hate vādhā deẏa evaṃ āllāhara patha vakra karate cāẏa; tārāi to ghora vibhrāntite raẏeche.
14:3.latin_ascii: yara duniyara jivanake akhiratera ceye (adhika) bhalavase, manusake allahara patha hate vadha deya evam allahara patha vakra karate caya; tarai to ghora vibhrantite rayeche.

14:4.latin_iast: āmi pratyeka rāsūlakei tāra svajātira bhāṣābhāṣī kare pāṭhiẏechi yāte tādera nikaṭa pariṣkārabhāve vyākhyā karate pāre, āllāha yāke icchā pathabhraṣṭa karena evaṃ yāke icchā satpathe paricālita karena evaṃ tini parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa.
14:4.latin_ascii: ami pratyeka rasulakei tara svajatira bhasabhasi kare pathiyechi yate tadera nikata pariskarabhave vyakhya karate pare, allaha yake iccha pathabhrasta karena evam yake iccha satpathe paricalita karena evam tini parakramasali, prajnamaya.

14:5.latin_iast: mūsāke āmi āmāra nidarśanasaha preraṇa karechilāma ye, ‘tomāra sampradāẏake andhakāra hate ālote ānaẏana kara, evaṃ tāderake āllāhara (neẏāmata o śāstira) divasagulora dvārā upadeśa dāo.’ ete to nidarśana raẏeche pratyeka parama dhairyaśīla o parama kṛtajña vyaktira janya.
14:5.latin_ascii: musake ami amara nidarsanasaha prerana karechilama ye, ‘tomara sampradayake andhakara hate alote anayana kara, evam taderake allahara (neyamata o sastira) divasagulora dvara upadesa dao.’ ete to nidarsana rayeche pratyeka parama dhairyasila o parama krtajna vyaktira janya.

14:6.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! yakhana mūsā tāra sampradāẏake valechila, ‘tomarā āllāhara anugraha’ smaraṇa kara yakhana tini tomāderake rakṣā karechilena phira‘āuna sampradāẏera kavala hate, yārā tomāderake nikṛṣṭa śāsti dita, tomādera putragaṇake yaveh karata o tomādera nārīgaṇake jīvita rākhata; evaṃ ete chila tomādera pratipālakera pakṣa hate eka mahāparīkṣā.’
14:6.latin_ascii: smarana kara! yakhana musa tara sampradayake valechila, ‘tomara allahara anugraha’ smarana kara yakhana tini tomaderake raksa karechilena phira‘auna sampradayera kavala hate, yara tomaderake nikrsta sasti dita, tomadera putraganake yaveh karata o tomadera nariganake jivita rakhata; evam ete chila tomadera pratipalakera paksa hate eka mahapariksa.’

14:7.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! yakhana tomādera pratipālaka ghoṣaṇā karalena, ‘yadi tomarā kṛtajña hao tāhale tomāderake avaśyai (āmāra neẏāmata) vṛddhi kare deva āra yadi akṛtajña hao tāhale (jene rekha) avaśyai āmāra śāsti kaṭhora.’
14:7.latin_ascii: smarana kara! yakhana tomadera pratipalaka ghosana karalena, ‘yadi tomara krtajna hao tahale tomaderake avasyai (amara neyamata) vrddhi kare deva ara yadi akrtajna hao tahale (jene rekha) avasyai amara sasti kathora.’

14:8.latin_iast: mūsā valechila, ‘tomarā evaṃ pṛthivīra sakalei yadi akṛtajña hao (tāte āllāhara kichui kṣati karate pārave nā) tathāpi āllāha abhāvamukta evaṃ praśaṃsita.
14:8.latin_ascii: musa valechila, ‘tomara evam prthivira sakalei yadi akrtajna hao (tate allahara kichui ksati karate parave na) tathapi allaha abhavamukta evam prasamsita.

14:9.latin_iast: tomādera nikaṭa ki saṃvāda āseni tomādera pūrvavartīdera, nūhera sampradāẏera, ‘āda o sāmūda jātira evaṃ tādera pūrvavartīdera? tādera viṣaẏe āllāha vyatīta anya keu jāne nā. tādera nikaṭa spaṣṭa nidarśanasaha tādera rāsūla esechila, tārā tādera hāta tādera mukhe sthāpana karata evaṃ valata, ‘yā niẏe tomarā prerita haẏecha tā āmarā avaśyai asvīkāra kari evaṃ āmarā avaśyai vibhrāntikara sandehe raẏechi se viṣaẏe yāra prati tomarā āmāderake āhvāna karacha.’
14:9.latin_ascii: tomadera nikata ki samvada aseni tomadera purvavartidera, nuhera sampradayera, ‘ada o samuda jatira evam tadera purvavartideray tadera visaye allaha vyatita anya keu jane na. tadera nikata spasta nidarsanasaha tadera rasula esechila, tara tadera hata tadera mukhe sthapana karata evam valata, ‘ya niye tomara prerita hayecha ta amara avasyai asvikara kari evam amara avasyai vibhrantikara sandehe rayechi se visaye yara prati tomara amaderake ahvana karacha.’

14:10.latin_iast: tādera rāsūlagaṇa valechila, ‘āllāha samvandhe ki kona sandeha āche, yini ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra sṛṣṭikartā? tini tomāderake āhvāna karena tomādera pāpa mārjanā karāra janya evaṃ nirdiṣṭa kāla paryanta tomāderake avakāśa devāra janya.’ tārā valata, ‘tomarā to āmāderai mata mānuṣa. āmādera pitṛpuruṣagaṇa yādera ivādata karata tomarā tādera ivādata hate āmāderake virata rākhate cāo. ataeva tomarā āmādera nikaṭa kona akāṭya pramāṇa upasthita kara.’
14:10.latin_ascii: tadera rasulagana valechila, ‘allaha samvandhe ki kona sandeha ache, yini akasamandali o prthivira srstikartay tini tomaderake ahvana karena tomadera papa marjana karara janya evam nirdista kala paryanta tomaderake avakasa devara janya.’ tara valata, ‘tomara to amaderai mata manusa. amadera pitrpurusagana yadera ivadata karata tomara tadera ivadata hate amaderake virata rakhate cao. ataeva tomara amadera nikata kona akatya pramana upasthita kara.’

14:11.latin_iast: tādera rāsūlagaṇa tāderake valechila, ‘(satya vaṭe) āmarā tomādera mata mānuṣai kintu āllāha tā~ra vāndādera madhye yāke icchā anugraha karena. āllāhara anumati vyatīta tomādera nikaṭa kona pramāṇa niẏe āsā āmādera kāja naẏa. ekamātra āllāhara oparai mu’minagaṇera nirbhara karā ucita.
14:11.latin_ascii: tadera rasulagana taderake valechila, ‘(satya vate) amara tomadera mata manusai kintu allaha ta~ra vandadera madhye yake iccha anugraha karena. allahara anumati vyatita tomadera nikata kona pramana niye asa amadera kaja naya. ekamatra allahara oparai mu’minaganera nirbhara kara ucita.

14:12.latin_iast: āmādera kī haẏeche ye, ‘āmarā āllāhara opara nirbhara karava nā? tinii to āmāderake patha pradarśana karechena. tomarā āmāderake ye kaṣṭa diccha, āmarā tāte avaśyai dhairya dhāraṇa karava evaṃ āllāharai opara nirbharakārīgaṇa nirbhara karuka.’
14:12.latin_ascii: amadera ki hayeche ye, ‘amara allahara opara nirbhara karava nay tinii to amaderake patha pradarsana karechena. tomara amaderake ye kasta diccha, amara tate avasyai dhairya dharana karava evam allaharai opara nirbharakarigana nirbhara karuka.’

14:13.latin_iast: kāphiragaṇa tādera rāsūlagaṇake valechila, ‘āmarā tomāderake āmādera deśa hate avaśyai vahiṣkāra karava athavā tomāderake āmādera dharme dharmāntarita hatei have.’ ataḥpara rāsūlagaṇake tādera pratipālaka oẏāhī karalena ye, jālimaderake āmi avaśyai vināśa karava;
14:13.latin_ascii: kaphiragana tadera rasulaganake valechila, ‘amara tomaderake amadera desa hate avasyai vahiskara karava athava tomaderake amadera dharme dharmantarita hatei have.’ atahpara rasulaganake tadera pratipalaka oyahi karalena ye, jalimaderake ami avasyai vinasa karava;

14:14.latin_iast: tādera pare āmi tomāderake pṛthivīte pratiṣṭhita karavai; eṭā tādera janya yārā bhaẏa rākhe āmāra sammukhe upasthita haoẏāra evaṃ bhaẏa rākhe āmāra śāstira.’
14:14.latin_ascii: tadera pare ami tomaderake prthivite pratisthita karavai; eta tadera janya yara bhaya rakhe amara sammukhe upasthita haoyara evam bhaya rakhe amara sastira.’

14:15.latin_iast: tārā (rāsūlagaṇa) vijaẏa kāmanā karala evaṃ pratyeka uddhata svairācārī vyartha kṣatigrasta hala.
14:15.latin_ascii: tara (rasulagana) vijaya kamana karala evam pratyeka uddhata svairacari vyartha ksatigrasta hala.

14:16.latin_iast: tādera sāmane pariṇāme raẏeche jāhānnāma evaṃ pāna karāno have galita pu~ja;
14:16.latin_ascii: tadera samane pariname rayeche jahannama evam pana karano have galita pu~ja;

14:17.latin_iast: yā se ati kaṣṭe eka eka ḍhoka kare pāna karave kintu galādhaḥkaraṇa karā prāẏa sahaja have nā. sarvadika hate tāra nikaṭa āsave mṛtyu yantraṇā kintu tāra mṛtyu ghaṭave nā evaṃ erapara kaṭhora śāsti (bhoga karatei) thākave.
14:17.latin_ascii: ya se ati kaste eka eka dhoka kare pana karave kintu galadhahkarana kara praya sahaja have na. sarvadika hate tara nikata asave mrtyu yantrana kintu tara mrtyu ghatave na evam erapara kathora sasti (bhoga karatei) thakave.

14:18.latin_iast: yārā tādera pratipālakake asvīkāra kare tādera upamā hacche tādera karmasamūha chāiẏera mata yā pracaṇḍa vege vaẏe yāoẏā jhar̤era vātāsa ur̤iẏe niẏe yāẏa. tārā yā upārjana kare tāra kichui tādera kāje lāgāte pāre nā. eṭā to carama gomarāhī.
14:18.latin_ascii: yara tadera pratipalakake asvikara kare tadera upama hacche tadera karmasamuha chaiyera mata ya pracanda vege vaye yaoya jharera vatasa uriye niye yaya. tara ya uparjana kare tara kichui tadera kaje lagate pare na. eta to carama gomarahi.

14:19.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya kara nā ye, āllāha ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī yathāvidhi sṛṣṭi karechena? tini icchā karale tomādera vilopa karate pārena evaṃ eka nūtana sṛṣṭi astitve niẏe āsate pārena.
14:19.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya kara na ye, allaha akasamandali o prthivi yathavidhi srsti karechenay tini iccha karale tomadera vilopa karate parena evam eka nutana srsti astitve niye asate parena.

14:20.latin_iast: āra eṭā āllāhara janya ādau kaṭhina naẏa.
14:20.latin_ascii: ara eta allahara janya adau kathina naya.

14:21.latin_iast: sakale āllāhara nikaṭa upasthita have. yārā ahaṃkāra karata takhana durvalerā tāderake valave, ‘āmarā to tomādera anusārī chilāma; ekhana tomarā āllāhara śāsti hate āmāderake kichumātra rakṣā karate pārave?’ tārā valave, ‘āllāha āmāderake satpathe paricālita karale āmarāo tomāderake satpathe paricālita karatāma. āmarā dhairyacyuta hai athavā dhairyaśīla hai ubhaẏai āmādera janya samāna. āmādera kona niṣkṛti nei.’
14:21.latin_ascii: sakale allahara nikata upasthita have. yara ahamkara karata takhana durvalera taderake valave, ‘amara to tomadera anusari chilama; ekhana tomara allahara sasti hate amaderake kichumatra raksa karate paravey’ tara valave, ‘allaha amaderake satpathe paricalita karale amarao tomaderake satpathe paricalita karatama. amara dhairyacyuta hai athava dhairyasila hai ubhayai amadera janya samana. amadera kona niskrti nei.’

14:22.latin_iast: yakhana vicārakārya sampanna have takhana śaẏatāna valave, ‘niścaẏai āllāha tomāderake pratiśruti diẏechilena satya pratiśruti, āmio tomāderake pratiśruti diẏechilāma, kintu āmi tomāderake pradatta pratiśruti bhaṅga karechi. āmāra to tomādera opara kona ādhipatya chila nā, āmi kevala tomāderake āhvāna karechilāma evaṃ tomarā āmāra āhvāne sār̤ā diẏechile. sutarāṃ tomarā āmāra prati doṣāropa kara nā, tomarā nijederai prati doṣāropa kara. āmi tomādera uddhāre sāhāyya karate sakṣama nai evaṃ tomarāo āmāke uddhāre sāhāyya karate sakṣama nao. tomarā ye pūrve āmāke āllāhara śarīka karechile āmi tā asvīkāra karachi, niścaẏai jālimadera janya raẏeche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
14:22.latin_ascii: yakhana vicarakarya sampanna have takhana sayatana valave, ‘niscayai allaha tomaderake pratisruti diyechilena satya pratisruti, amio tomaderake pratisruti diyechilama, kintu ami tomaderake pradatta pratisruti bhanga karechi. amara to tomadera opara kona adhipatya chila na, ami kevala tomaderake ahvana karechilama evam tomara amara ahvane sara diyechile. sutaram tomara amara prati dosaropa kara na, tomara nijederai prati dosaropa kara. ami tomadera uddhare sahayya karate saksama nai evam tomarao amake uddhare sahayya karate saksama nao. tomara ye purve amake allahara sarika karechile ami ta asvikara karachi, niscayai jalimadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

14:23.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o satkarma kare tāderake dākhila karā have jānnāte yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita. sethāẏa tārā sthāẏī have tādera pratipālakera anumatikrame, sethāẏa tādera abhivādana have ‘sālāma’.
14:23.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o satkarma kare taderake dakhila kara have jannate yara padadese nadi pravahita. sethaya tara sthayi have tadera pratipalakera anumatikrame, sethaya tadera abhivadana have ‘salama’.

14:24.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya kara nā, āllāha kibhāve upamā peśa kare thākena? sat vākyera tulanā utkṛṣṭa vṛkṣera nyāẏa yāra mūla sudṛr̤ha o yāra śākhā-praśākhā ākāśapāne vistṛta,
14:24.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya kara na, allaha kibhave upama pesa kare thakenay sat vakyera tulana utkrsta vrksera nyaya yara mula sudrrha o yara sakha-prasakha akasapane vistrta,

14:25.latin_iast: yā sava samaẏa phaladāna kare tāra pratipālakera anumatikrame. evaṃ āllāha mānuṣera janya upamā peśa kare thākena, yāte tārā śikṣā grahaṇa kare.
14:25.latin_ascii: ya sava samaya phaladana kare tara pratipalakera anumatikrame. evam allaha manusera janya upama pesa kare thakena, yate tara siksa grahana kare.

14:26.latin_iast: kuvākyera tulanā eka manda vṛkṣera nyāẏa yāra mūla bhūpṛṣṭha hate vicchinna, yāra kona sthāẏitva nei.
14:26.latin_ascii: kuvakyera tulana eka manda vrksera nyaya yara mula bhuprstha hate vicchinna, yara kona sthayitva nei.

14:27.latin_iast: yārā śāśvata vāṇīte (kālimā tāẏyivāẏa) īmāna eneche tāderake duniẏāra jīvane o ākhirāte āllāha supratiṣṭhita rākhavena evaṃ yārā jālima āllāha tāderake vibhrāntite rākhavena. āllāha yā icchā tāi karena.
14:27.latin_ascii: yara sasvata vanite (kalima tayyivaya) imana eneche taderake duniyara jivane o akhirate allaha supratisthita rakhavena evam yara jalima allaha taderake vibhrantite rakhavena. allaha ya iccha tai karena.

14:28.latin_iast: tumi ki tāderake lakṣya kara nā yārā āllāhara anugrahera vadale akṛtajñatā prakāśa kare evaṃ tārā tādera sampradāẏake nāmiẏe āne dhvaṃsera dvāre
14:28.latin_ascii: tumi ki taderake laksya kara na yara allahara anugrahera vadale akrtajnata prakasa kare evam tara tadera sampradayake namiye ane dhvamsera dvare

14:29.latin_iast: tāhala jāhānnāme, yāra madhye tārā praveśa karave, katai nā nikṛṣṭa e āvāsasthala!
14:29.latin_ascii: tahala jahanname, yara madhye tara pravesa karave, katai na nikrsta e avasasthala!

14:30.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā āllāhara samakakṣa nirdhāraṇa kare tā~ra patha hate vibhrānta karāra janya. vala: ‘bhoga kare nāo, niścaẏai tomādera pratyāvartanasthala jāhānnāma.’
14:30.latin_ascii: evam tara allahara samakaksa nirdharana kare ta~ra patha hate vibhranta karara janya. vala: ‘bhoga kare nao, niscayai tomadera pratyavartanasthala jahannama.’

14:31.latin_iast: āmāra vāndādera madhye yārā mu’mina tāderake tumi vala ‘sālāta kāẏema karate evaṃ āmi tāderake yā diẏechi tā hate gopane o prakāśye vyaẏa karate sedinera pūrve yedina kraẏa-vikraẏa o vandhutva thākave nā.’
14:31.latin_ascii: amara vandadera madhye yara mu’mina taderake tumi vala ‘salata kayema karate evam ami taderake ya diyechi ta hate gopane o prakasye vyaya karate sedinera purve yedina kraya-vikraya o vandhutva thakave na.’

14:32.latin_iast: tinii āllāha yini ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena, yini ākāśa hate pāni varṣaṇa kare tāra dvārā tomādera jīvikāra janya phalamūla utpādana karena, yini nauyānake tomādera adhīna kare diẏechena yāte tā~ra nirdeśe samudre vicaraṇa kare evaṃ yini tomādera (kalyāṇe) niẏojita karechena nadīsamūhake.
14:32.latin_ascii: tinii allaha yini akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena, yini akasa hate pani varsana kare tara dvara tomadera jivikara janya phalamula utpadana karena, yini nauyanake tomadera adhina kare diyechena yate ta~ra nirdese samudre vicarana kare evam yini tomadera (kalyane) niyojita karechena nadisamuhake.

14:33.latin_iast: tini tomādera (kalyāṇe) niẏojita karechena sūrya o candrake, yārā avirāma ekai niẏamera anuvartī evaṃ tomādera (kalyāṇe) niẏojita karechena rātri o divasake.
14:33.latin_ascii: tini tomadera (kalyane) niyojita karechena surya o candrake, yara avirama ekai niyamera anuvarti evam tomadera (kalyane) niyojita karechena ratri o divasake.

14:34.latin_iast: evaṃ tini tomāderake diẏechena tomarā tā~ra nikaṭa yā ceẏecha, tomarā āllāhara anugraha gaṇanā karale tāra saṃkhyā nirṇaẏa karate pārave nā. mānuṣa avaśyai ati mātrāẏa jālima, akṛtajña.
14:34.latin_ascii: evam tini tomaderake diyechena tomara ta~ra nikata ya ceyecha, tomara allahara anugraha ganana karale tara samkhya nirnaya karate parave na. manusa avasyai ati matraya jalima, akrtajna.

14:35.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana ivrāhīma (tāra du‘āte) valechila, ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! e nagarīke nirāpada kara evaṃ āmāke o āmāra putragaṇake pratimā pūjā hate dūre rākha.
14:35.latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana ivrahima (tara du‘ate) valechila, ‘he amara pratipalaka! e nagarike nirapada kara evam amake o amara putraganake pratima puja hate dure rakha.

14:36.latin_iast: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! e sakala pratimā to vahu mānuṣake vibhrānta kareche. sutarāṃ ye āmāra anusaraṇa karave se āmāra dalabhukta, āra ye āmāra avādhya have niścaẏai tumi kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
14:36.latin_ascii: ‘he amara pratipalaka! e sakala pratima to vahu manusake vibhranta kareche. sutaram ye amara anusarana karave se amara dalabhukta, ara ye amara avadhya have niscayai tumi ksamasila, parama dayalu.

14:37.latin_iast: he āmādera pratipālaka! āmi āmāra vaṃśadharadera katakake vasati karālāma anurvara (cāṣāvādahīna) upatyakāẏa tomāra pavitra gṛhera nikaṭa, he āmādera pratipālaka! tārā yena sālāta kāẏema kare. ataeva tumi mānuṣera hṛdaẏake tādera prati anurāgī kare dāo evaṃ phala-phalādi dvārā tādera riyikera vyavasthā kara, yāte tārā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare.
14:37.latin_ascii: he amadera pratipalaka! ami amara vamsadharadera katakake vasati karalama anurvara (casavadahina) upatyakaya tomara pavitra grhera nikata, he amadera pratipalaka! tara yena salata kayema kare. ataeva tumi manusera hrdayake tadera prati anuragi kare dao evam phala-phaladi dvara tadera riyikera vyavastha kara, yate tara krtajnata prakasa kare.

14:38.latin_iast: ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! niścaẏai tumi jāna yā āmarā gopana kari o yā āmarā prakāśa kari; ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra kona kichui āllāhara nikaṭa gopana thāke nā.
14:38.latin_ascii: ‘he amadera pratipalaka! niscayai tumi jana ya amara gopana kari o ya amara prakasa kari; akasamandali o prthivira kona kichui allahara nikata gopana thake na.

14:39.latin_iast: samasta praśaṃsā āllāharai, yini āmāke āmāra vārdhakye ismā‘īla o ishākake dāna karechena. āmāra pratipālaka avaśyai prārthanā śune thākena.
14:39.latin_ascii: samasta prasamsa allaharai, yini amake amara vardhakye isma‘ila o ishakake dana karechena. amara pratipalaka avasyai prarthana sune thakena.

14:40.latin_iast: he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke sālāta kāẏemakārī kara evaṃ āmāra vaṃśadharadera madhya hateo. he āmādera pratipālaka! āmāra prārthanā kavūla kara.
14:40.latin_ascii: he amara pratipalaka! amake salata kayemakari kara evam amara vamsadharadera madhya hateo. he amadera pratipalaka! amara prarthana kavula kara.

14:41.latin_iast: he āmādera pratipālaka! yedina hiseva anuṣṭhita have sedina āmāke, āmāra pitā-mātāke evaṃ mu’minagaṇake kṣamā kare dio.’
14:41.latin_ascii: he amadera pratipalaka! yedina hiseva anusthita have sedina amake, amara pita-matake evam mu’minaganake ksama kare dio.’

14:42.latin_iast: tumi kakhanao mane kara nā ye, jālimarā yā kare se viṣaẏe āllāha gāphila, niścaẏai tini tāderake sedina paryanta avakāśa dena yedina cakṣusamūha visphorita have.
14:42.latin_ascii: tumi kakhanao mane kara na ye, jalimara ya kare se visaye allaha gaphila, niscayai tini taderake sedina paryanta avakasa dena yedina caksusamuha visphorita have.

14:43.latin_iast: khuva druta bhīta-vihvala citte ākāśera dike ceẏe tārā chuṭāchuṭi karave, nijedera prati tādera dṛṣṭi phirave nā evaṃ tādera antara have udāsa.
14:43.latin_ascii: khuva druta bhita-vihvala citte akasera dike ceye tara chutachuti karave, nijedera prati tadera drsti phirave na evam tadera antara have udasa.

14:44.latin_iast: yedina tādera opara śāsti āsave sedina samparke tumi mānuṣake satarka kara, takhana jālimarā valave, ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! āmāderake kichu kālera janya avakāśa dāo, āmarā tomāra āhvāne sār̤ā deva evaṃ rāsūlagaṇera anusaraṇa karava.’ tomarā ki pūrve śapatha kare valate nā ye, tomādera patana nei?
14:44.latin_ascii: yedina tadera opara sasti asave sedina samparke tumi manusake satarka kara, takhana jalimara valave, ‘he amadera pratipalaka! amaderake kichu kalera janya avakasa dao, amara tomara ahvane sara deva evam rasulaganera anusarana karava.’ tomara ki purve sapatha kare valate na ye, tomadera patana neiy

14:45.latin_iast: athaca tomarā vāsa karate tādera vāsabhūmite, yārā nijedera sāthe juluma karechila evaṃ tādera prati āmi kī vyavahāra karechilāma tāo tomādera nikaṭa suvidita chila evaṃ tomādera nikaṭa āmi (tādera) dṛṣṭāntao upasthita karechilāma.
14:45.latin_ascii: athaca tomara vasa karate tadera vasabhumite, yara nijedera sathe juluma karechila evam tadera prati ami ki vyavahara karechilama tao tomadera nikata suvidita chila evam tomadera nikata ami (tadera) drstantao upasthita karechilama.

14:46.latin_iast: tārā bhīṣaṇa cakrānta karechila, kintu tādera cakrānta āllāhara sāmanei chila yadio tādera cakrānta emana chila, yāte parvata ṭale yeta.
14:46.latin_ascii: tara bhisana cakranta karechila, kintu tadera cakranta allahara samanei chila yadio tadera cakranta emana chila, yate parvata tale yeta.

14:47.latin_iast: tumi kakhanao mane kara nā ye, āllāha tā~ra rāsūlagaṇera prati pradatta pratiśruti bhaṅga karavena. niścaẏai āllāha parākramaśālī, daṇḍa-vidhāẏaka.
14:47.latin_ascii: tumi kakhanao mane kara na ye, allaha ta~ra rasulaganera prati pradatta pratisruti bhanga karavena. niscayai allaha parakramasali, danda-vidhayaka.

14:48.latin_iast: yedina e pṛthivī parivartita haẏe anya pṛthivī have evaṃ ākāśamaṇḍalīo; evaṃ mānuṣa upasthita have āllāhara sammukhe yini eka, parākramaśālī.
14:48.latin_ascii: yedina e prthivi parivartita haye anya prthivi have evam akasamandalio; evam manusa upasthita have allahara sammukhe yini eka, parakramasali.

14:49.latin_iast: sedina tumi aparādhīderake (hāta pā) dekhave śṛṅkhalita avasthāẏa,
14:49.latin_ascii: sedina tumi aparadhiderake (hata pa) dekhave srnkhalita avasthaya,

14:50.latin_iast: tādera jāmā have ālakātarāra evaṃ agni ācchanna karave tādera mukhamaṇḍala;
14:50.latin_ascii: tadera jama have alakatarara evam agni acchanna karave tadera mukhamandala;

14:51.latin_iast: (eṭā ejanya ye) yāte āllāha pratyekera kṛtakarmera pratiphala dite pārena. niścaẏai āllāha hisāva grahaṇe tatpara.
14:51.latin_ascii: (eta ejanya ye) yate allaha pratyekera krtakarmera pratiphala dite parena. niscayai allaha hisava grahane tatpara.

14:52.latin_iast: eṭā mānuṣera janya ekaṭā vārtā, yāte era dvārā tārā satarka haẏa evaṃ jānate pāre ye, tini ekamātra satyikāra mā‘vūda evaṃ yāte vodhaśaktisampanna lokerā upadeśa grahaṇa kare.
14:52.latin_ascii: eta manusera janya ekata varta, yate era dvara tara satarka haya evam janate pare ye, tini ekamatra satyikara ma‘vuda evam yate vodhasaktisampanna lokera upadesa grahana kare.

15:1.latin_iast: ālipha-lāma-rā, egulo mahāgrantha o suspaṣṭa kuraānera āẏāta.
15:1.latin_ascii: alipha-lama-ra, egulo mahagrantha o suspasta kuraanera ayata.

15:2.latin_iast: kakhanao kakhanao kāphiragaṇa ākāksakṣā karave ye, tārā yadi musalima hata!
15:2.latin_ascii: kakhanao kakhanao kaphiragana akaksaksa karave ye, tara yadi musalima hata!

15:3.latin_iast: tumi tāderake chār̤a dāo, tārā khete thākuka, bhoga karate thākuka evaṃ āśā ākāksakṣā oderake mohācchanna rākhuka, acirei tārā jānate pārave.
15:3.latin_ascii: tumi taderake chara dao, tara khete thakuka, bhoga karate thakuka evam asa akaksaksa oderake mohacchanna rakhuka, acirei tara janate parave.

15:4.latin_iast: āmi yekona janapadake dhvaṃsa karechi tāra janya chila ekaṭi nirdiṣṭa lipivaddha samaẏa.
15:4.latin_ascii: ami yekona janapadake dhvamsa karechi tara janya chila ekati nirdista lipivaddha samaya.

15:5.latin_iast: kona jāti tāra nirdiṣṭa samaẏake atikrama karate pāre nā, vilamvitao karate pāre nā.
15:5.latin_ascii: kona jati tara nirdista samayake atikrama karate pare na, vilamvitao karate pare na.

15:6.latin_iast: tārā vale ‘ohe yāra prati kuraāna avatīrṇa haẏeche! tumi niścaẏa unmāda.
15:6.latin_ascii: tara vale ‘ohe yara prati kuraana avatirna hayeche! tumi niscaya unmada.

15:7.latin_iast: tumi satyavādī hale āmādera nikaṭa phereśtāgaṇake upasthita karacha nā kena?’
15:7.latin_ascii: tumi satyavadi hale amadera nikata pherestaganake upasthita karacha na kenay’

15:8.latin_iast: āmi phereśtāgaṇake preraṇa kari nā yathārtha kāraṇa vyatīta; phereśtāgaṇa upasthita hale tārā avakāśa pāve nā.
15:8.latin_ascii: ami pherestaganake prerana kari na yathartha karana vyatita; pherestagana upasthita hale tara avakasa pave na.

15:9.latin_iast: niścaẏai āmii e kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi evaṃ avaśyai āmii tāra saṃrakṣaka.
15:9.latin_ascii: niscayai amii e kuraana avatirna karechi evam avasyai amii tara samraksaka.

15:10.latin_iast: tomāra pūrve āmi āgekāra aneka sampradāẏera nikaṭa rāsūla pāṭhiẏechilāma.
15:10.latin_ascii: tomara purve ami agekara aneka sampradayera nikata rasula pathiyechilama.

15:11.latin_iast: tādera nikaṭa emana kona rāsūla āseni yāke tārā ṭhāṭṭā-vidraƒpa kareni.
15:11.latin_ascii: tadera nikata emana kona rasula aseni yake tara thatta-vidraƒpa kareni.

15:12.latin_iast: ebhāve āmi e rakama ācaraṇa aparādhīdera antare vaddhamūla kare dei.
15:12.latin_ascii: ebhave ami e rakama acarana aparadhidera antare vaddhamula kare dei.

15:13.latin_iast: erā kuraānera prati īmāna ānave nā evaṃ atīte pūrvavartīgaṇerao e ācaraṇa chila.
15:13.latin_ascii: era kuraanera prati imana anave na evam atite purvavartiganerao e acarana chila.

15:14.latin_iast: āmi yadi tādera janya ākāśera duẏāra khule dei evaṃ tārā sārādina tāte ārohaṇa karate thāke,
15:14.latin_ascii: ami yadi tadera janya akasera duyara khule dei evam tara saradina tate arohana karate thake,

15:15.latin_iast: avaśyai tārā valave, ‘āmādera dṛṣṭi sammohita karā haẏeche; varaṃ āmarā eka jādugrasta sampradāẏa.’
15:15.latin_ascii: avasyai tara valave, ‘amadera drsti sammohita kara hayeche; varam amara eka jadugrasta sampradaya.’

15:16.latin_iast: āmi ākāśe graha-nakṣatra sṛṣṭi karechi evaṃ tā suśobhita karechi darśakadera janya;
15:16.latin_ascii: ami akase graha-naksatra srsti karechi evam ta susobhita karechi darsakadera janya;

15:17.latin_iast: evaṃ pratyeka abhiśapta śaẏatāna hate āmi tā rakṣā kare thāki;
15:17.latin_ascii: evam pratyeka abhisapta sayatana hate ami ta raksa kare thaki;

15:18.latin_iast: kintu keu curi kare saṃvāda śunate cāile tāra paścāddhāvana kare pradīpta śikhā
15:18.latin_ascii: kintu keu curi kare samvada sunate caile tara pascaddhavana kare pradipta sikha

15:19.latin_iast: āra pṛthivī, seṭāke āmi vistṛta karechi, āra tāte parvatamālā sthāpana karechi; evaṃ āmi tāte pratyeka vastu udgata karechi suparimitabhāve,
15:19.latin_ascii: ara prthivi, setake ami vistrta karechi, ara tate parvatamala sthapana karechi; evam ami tate pratyeka vastu udgata karechi suparimitabhave,

15:20.latin_iast: evaṃ tāte jīvikāra vyavasthā karechi tomādera janya, āra tomarā yādera jīvikādātā nao tādera janyao.
15:20.latin_ascii: evam tate jivikara vyavastha karechi tomadera janya, ara tomara yadera jivikadata nao tadera janyao.

15:21.latin_iast: āmārai nikaṭa āche pratyeka vastura bhāṇḍāra evaṃ āmi tā nirdhārita parimāṇei saravarāha kare thāki.
15:21.latin_ascii: amarai nikata ache pratyeka vastura bhandara evam ami ta nirdharita parimanei saravaraha kare thaki.

15:22.latin_iast: āmi vṛṣṭi-sañcārī vāẏu preraṇa kari, ataḥpara ākāśa hate vāri varṣaṇa kari evaṃ tā tomāderake pāna karate dei; āra tomarā tāra bhāṇḍāra rakṣaka nao.
15:22.latin_ascii: ami vrsti-sancari vayu prerana kari, atahpara akasa hate vari varsana kari evam ta tomaderake pana karate dei; ara tomara tara bhandara raksaka nao.

15:23.latin_iast: āmii jīvana dāna kari o mṛtyu ghaṭāi evaṃ āmii cūr̤ānta mālikānāra adhikārī.
15:23.latin_ascii: amii jivana dana kari o mrtyu ghatai evam amii curanta malikanara adhikari.

15:24.latin_iast: tomādera madhya hate pūrve yārā gata haẏeche āmi tāderake jāni evaṃ pare yārā āsave tāderakeo jāni.
15:24.latin_ascii: tomadera madhya hate purve yara gata hayeche ami taderake jani evam pare yara asave taderakeo jani.

15:25.latin_iast: niścaẏai tomāra pratipālaka tāderake samaveta karavena; tini prajñāmaẏa, sarvajña.
15:25.latin_ascii: niscayai tomara pratipalaka taderake samaveta karavena; tini prajnamaya, sarvajna.

15:26.latin_iast: āmi mānuṣa sṛṣṭi karechi gandhayukta kardamāra śuṣka ṭhanaṭhanā mṛttikā hate,
15:26.latin_ascii: ami manusa srsti karechi gandhayukta kardamara suska thanathana mrttika hate,

15:27.latin_iast: era pūrve āmi jīnake sṛṣṭi karechi dheā~ẏāhīna āguna hate.
15:27.latin_ascii: era purve ami jinake srsti karechi dhea~yahina aguna hate.

15:28.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana tomāra pratipālaka phereśtāgaṇake valalena: ‘āmi gandhayukta kardamāra śuṣka ṭhanaṭhanā mṛttikā hate mānuṣa sṛṣṭi karechi;
15:28.latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana tomara pratipalaka pherestaganake valalena: ‘ami gandhayukta kardamara suska thanathana mrttika hate manusa srsti karechi;

15:29.latin_iast: yakhana āmi tāke pūrṇa mātrāẏa vāniẏe deva evaṃ tāte āmāra pakṣa hate rūha sañcāra karava takhana tomarā tāra prati sijdāvanata hao’,
15:29.latin_ascii: yakhana ami take purna matraya vaniye deva evam tate amara paksa hate ruha sancara karava takhana tomara tara prati sijdavanata hao’,

15:31.latin_iast: ivalīsa vyatīta, se sijdākārīdera antarbhukta hate asvīkāra karala.
15:31.latin_ascii: ivalisa vyatita, se sijdakaridera antarbhukta hate asvikara karala.

15:32.latin_iast: āllāha valalena: ‘he ivalīsa! tomāra kī hala ye, tumi sijdākārīdera antarbhukta hale nā?’
15:32.latin_ascii: allaha valalena: ‘he ivalisa! tomara ki hala ye, tumi sijdakaridera antarbhukta hale nay’

15:33.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āpani gandhayukta kardamāra śuṣka ṭhanaṭhanā mṛttikā hate ye mānuṣa sṛṣṭi karechena āmi tāke sijdā karāra nai.’
15:33.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘apani gandhayukta kardamara suska thanathana mrttika hate ye manusa srsti karechena ami take sijda karara nai.’

15:34.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘ tumi ekhāna theke vera haẏe yāo, kāraṇa tumi to abhiśapta;
15:34.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘ tumi ekhana theke vera haye yao, karana tumi to abhisapta;

15:35.latin_iast: karmaphala divasa paryanta avaśyai tomāra prati raila lā‘nata.’
15:35.latin_ascii: karmaphala divasa paryanta avasyai tomara prati raila la‘nata.’

15:36.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! punarutthāna divasa paryanta āmāke (ve~ce thākāra) avakāśa dina.’
15:36.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! punarutthana divasa paryanta amake (ve~ce thakara) avakasa dina.’

15:37.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘yāderake avakāśa deẏā haẏeche tumi tādera antarbhukta hale,
15:37.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘yaderake avakasa deya hayeche tumi tadera antarbhukta hale,

15:38.latin_iast: avadhārita samaẏa upasthita haoẏāra dina paryanta.’
15:38.latin_ascii: avadharita samaya upasthita haoyara dina paryanta.’

15:39.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āpani ye janya āmāke vipathagāmī karechena sejanya āmi pṛthivīte mānuṣera nikaṭa pāpakarmake avaśyai śobhana kare tulava evaṃ āmi tādera sakalakei vipathagāmī karava,
15:39.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! apani ye janya amake vipathagami karechena sejanya ami prthivite manusera nikata papakarmake avasyai sobhana kare tulava evam ami tadera sakalakei vipathagami karava,

15:40.latin_iast: tave tādera madhye āpanāra nirvācita vāndāgaṇa vyatīta.’
15:40.latin_ascii: tave tadera madhye apanara nirvacita vandagana vyatita.’

15:41.latin_iast: āllāha valalena: ‘eṭāi āmāra nikaṭa pau~chāra sarala patha,
15:41.latin_ascii: allaha valalena: ‘etai amara nikata pau~chara sarala patha,

15:42.latin_iast: vibhrāntadera madhye yārā tomāra anusaraṇa karave tārā vyatīta āmāra vāndādera opara tomāra konai kṣamatā thākave nā;
15:42.latin_ascii: vibhrantadera madhye yara tomara anusarana karave tara vyatita amara vandadera opara tomara konai ksamata thakave na;

15:43.latin_iast: avaśyai jāhānnāma tādera sakalerai pratiśra“ta sthāna,
15:43.latin_ascii: avasyai jahannama tadera sakalerai pratisra“ta sthana,

15:44.latin_iast: tāra sātaṭi darajā āche, pratyeka darajāra janya pṛthaka pṛthaka śreṇi āche.’
15:44.latin_ascii: tara satati daraja ache, pratyeka darajara janya prthaka prthaka sreni ache.’

15:45.latin_iast: muttākīrā thākave jānnāte o prasravaṇasamūhera madhye.
15:45.latin_ascii: muttakira thakave jannate o prasravanasamuhera madhye.

15:46.latin_iast: tāderake valā have, ‘tomarā śānti o nirāpattāra sāthe tāte praveśa kara.’
15:46.latin_ascii: taderake vala have, ‘tomara santi o nirapattara sathe tate pravesa kara.’

15:47.latin_iast: āmi tādera antara hate vidveṣa dūra karava; tārā bhrātṛtva vandhane āvaddha haẏe paraspara mukhomukhi haẏe āsane avasthāna karave
15:47.latin_ascii: ami tadera antara hate vidvesa dura karava; tara bhratrtva vandhane avaddha haye paraspara mukhomukhi haye asane avasthana karave

15:48.latin_iast: sethāẏa tāderake kona kaṣṭa sparśa karave nā evaṃ tārā sethā hate vahiṣkṛtao have nā.
15:48.latin_ascii: sethaya taderake kona kasta sparsa karave na evam tara setha hate vahiskrtao have na.

15:49.latin_iast: āmāra vāndāderake vale dāo ye, āmi parama kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu,
15:49.latin_ascii: amara vandaderake vale dao ye, ami parama ksamasila, parama dayalu,
