17:88.latin_ascii: vala: ‘yadi kuraanera anurupa kuraana anayanera janya manusa o jina samaveta haya evam yadi tara parasparake sahayya kare tavuo tara etara anurupa kuraana anayana karate parave na.

17:89.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmi mānuṣera janya e kuraāne vibhinna upamā viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi; kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa kuphrī karā vyatīta kṣānta hala nā.’
17:89.latin_ascii: ara avasyai ami manusera janya e kuraane vibhinna upama visadabhave varnana karechi; kintu adhikamsa manusa kuphri kara vyatita ksanta hala na.’

17:90.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā vale: ‘āmarā kakhanai tomāte īmāna ānava nā, yatakṣaṇa nā tumi āmādera janya bhūmi hate ekaṭi prasravaṇa utsārita kara,
17:90.latin_ascii: evam tara vale: ‘amara kakhanai tomate imana anava na, yataksana na tumi amadera janya bhumi hate ekati prasravana utsarita kara,

17:91.latin_iast: athavā tomāra khejurera o āṅgurera eka vāgāna thākave yāra phā~ke phā~ke tumi ajasra dhārāẏa pravāhita kare deve nadī-nālā.
17:91.latin_ascii: athava tomara khejurera o angurera eka vagana thakave yara pha~ke pha~ke tumi ajasra dharaya pravahita kare deve nadi-nala.

17:92.latin_iast: athavā tumi yemana vale thāka, tadanuyāẏī ākāśake khaṇḍa-vikhaṇḍa kare āmādera opara phelave, athavā āllāha o phereśatāgaṇake āmādera sammukhe upasthita karave,
17:92.latin_ascii: athava tumi yemana vale thaka, tadanuyayi akasake khanda-vikhanda kare amadera opara phelave, athava allaha o pheresataganake amadera sammukhe upasthita karave,

17:93.latin_iast: athavā tomāra ekaṭi ¯¦rṇa nirmita gṛha thākave, athavā tumi ākāśe ārohaṇa karave, kintu tomāra ākāśa ārohaṇe āmarā kakhanao īmāna ānava nā yatakṣaṇa tumi āmādera prati eka kitāva avatīrṇa nā karave yā āmarā pāṭha karava.’ vala: ‘pavitra mahāna āmāra pratipālaka! āmi to hacchi kevala ekajana mānuṣa, ekajana rāsūla.’
17:93.latin_ascii: athava tomara ekati  ¦rna nirmita grha thakave, athava tumi akase arohana karave, kintu tomara akasa arohane amara kakhanao imana anava na yataksana tumi amadera prati eka kitava avatirna na karave ya amara patha karava.’ vala: ‘pavitra mahana amara pratipalaka! ami to hacchi kevala ekajana manusa, ekajana rasula.’

17:94.latin_iast: yakhana tādera nikaṭa āse pathanirdeśa takhana lokaderake īmāna ānā hate virata rākhe tādera e ukti, ‘āllāha ki mānuṣake rāsūla kare pāṭhiẏechena?’
17:94.latin_ascii: yakhana tadera nikata ase pathanirdesa takhana lokaderake imana ana hate virata rakhe tadera e ukti, ‘allaha ki manusake rasula kare pathiyechenay’

17:95.latin_iast: vala: ‘phereśatāgaṇa yadi niścinta haẏe pṛthivīte vicaraṇa karata tave āmi ākāśa hate tādera nikaṭa avaśyai phereśtā rāsūla kare pāṭhātāma.’
17:95.latin_ascii: vala: ‘pheresatagana yadi niscinta haye prthivite vicarana karata tave ami akasa hate tadera nikata avasyai pheresta rasula kare pathatama.’

17:96.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmāra o tomādera madhye sākṣī hiseve āllāhai yatheṣṭa; niścaẏai tini tā~ra vāndāderake saviśeṣa jānena o dekhena.’
17:96.latin_ascii: vala: ‘amara o tomadera madhye saksi hiseve allahai yathesta; niscayai tini ta~ra vandaderake savisesa janena o dekhena.’

17:97.latin_iast: āllāha yāke pathanirdeśa karena se to pathaprāpta evaṃ yāke tini pathabhraṣṭa karena tumi kakhanai tā~ke vyatīta anya kāuke tādera abhibhāvaka pāve nā. kiẏāmatera dina āmi tāderake samaveta karava tādera mukhe bhara diẏe calā avasthāẏa andha, vovā o vadhira kare. tādera āvāsasthala jāhānnāma; yakhanai tā sti—mita havāra upakrama have āmi takhanai tādera janya agniśikhā vṛddhi kare deva.
17:97.latin_ascii: allaha yake pathanirdesa karena se to pathaprapta evam yake tini pathabhrasta karena tumi kakhanai ta~ke vyatita anya kauke tadera abhibhavaka pave na. kiyamatera dina ami taderake samaveta karava tadera mukhe bhara diye cala avasthaya andha, vova o vadhira kare. tadera avasasthala jahannama; yakhanai ta sti—mita havara upakrama have ami takhanai tadera janya agnisikha vrddhi kare deva.

17:98.latin_iast: eṭāi tādera pratiphala, kāraṇa tārā āmāra nidarśana asvīkāra karechila o valechila, ‘hār̤e pariṇata o cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haleo ki āmarā natuna sṛṣṭirūpe punarutthita hava?’
17:98.latin_ascii: etai tadera pratiphala, karana tara amara nidarsana asvikara karechila o valechila, ‘hare parinata o curna-vicurna haleo ki amara natuna srstirupe punarutthita havay’

17:99.latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya kare nā ye, āllāha, yini ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena tini tādera anurūpa sṛṣṭi karate kṣamatāvāna? tini tādera janya sthira karechena eka nirdiṣṭa kāla, yāte kona sandeha nei. tathāpi sīmālaṅghanakārīrā kupharī karā vyatīta kichutei kṣānta hala nā.
17:99.latin_ascii: tara ki laksya kare na ye, allaha, yini akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena tini tadera anurupa srsti karate ksamatavanay tini tadera janya sthira karechena eka nirdista kala, yate kona sandeha nei. tathapi simalanghanakarira kuphari kara vyatita kichutei ksanta hala na.

17:100.latin_iast: vala: ‘yadi tomarā āmāra pratipālakera daẏāra bhāṇḍārera adhikārī hate, tavuo ‘vyaẏa haẏe yāve’ e āśaṃkāẏa tomarā tā dhare rākhate; mānuṣa to atiśaẏa kṛpaṇa.’
17:100.latin_ascii: vala: ‘yadi tomara amara pratipalakera dayara bhandarera adhikari hate, tavuo ‘vyaya haye yave’ e asamkaya tomara ta dhare rakhate; manusa to atisaya krpana.’

17:101.latin_iast: tumi vānī isrāīlake jijñesa kare dekha, āmi mūsāke naẏaṭi spaṣṭa nidarśana diẏechilāma; yakhana se tādera nikaṭa esechila, phira‘āuna tāke valechila, ‘he mūsā! āmi mane kari tumi jādugrasta.’
17:101.latin_ascii: tumi vani israilake jijnesa kare dekha, ami musake nayati spasta nidarsana diyechilama; yakhana se tadera nikata esechila, phira‘auna take valechila, ‘he musa! ami mane kari tumi jadugrasta.’

17:102.latin_iast: mūsā valechila, ‘tumi avaśyai avagata ācha ye, e samasta spaṣṭa nidarśana ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra pratipālakai avatīrṇa karechena pratyakṣa pramāṇasvarūpa. he phira‘āuna! āmi dekhachi tomāra dhvaṃsa āsanna!’
17:102.latin_ascii: musa valechila, ‘tumi avasyai avagata acha ye, e samasta spasta nidarsana akasamandali o prthivira pratipalakai avatirna karechena pratyaksa pramanasvarupa. he phira‘auna! ami dekhachi tomara dhvamsa asanna!’

17:103.latin_iast: ataḥpara phira‘āuna tāderake deśa hate uccheda karāra saṃkalpa karala; takhana āmi phira‘āuna o tāra saṅgidera sakalake nimajjita karalāma.
17:103.latin_ascii: atahpara phira‘auna taderake desa hate uccheda karara samkalpa karala; takhana ami phira‘auna o tara sangidera sakalake nimajjita karalama.

17:104.latin_iast: erapara āmi vānī isrāīlake valalāma, ‘tomarā bhūpṛṣṭhe vasavāsa kara evaṃ yakhana kiẏāmatera pratiśruti vāstavāẏita have takhana tomādera sakalake āmi ekatra kare upasthita karava.
17:104.latin_ascii: erapara ami vani israilake valalama, ‘tomara bhuprsthe vasavasa kara evam yakhana kiyamatera pratisruti vastavayita have takhana tomadera sakalake ami ekatra kare upasthita karava.

17:105.latin_iast: āmi satya-sahai kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi evaṃ seṭā satya-sahai avatīrṇa haẏeche. āmi to tomāke kevala susaṃvādadātā o satarkakārīrūpe preraṇa karechi.
17:105.latin_ascii: ami satya-sahai kuraana avatirna karechi evam seta satya-sahai avatirna hayeche. ami to tomake kevala susamvadadata o satarkakarirupe prerana karechi.

17:106.latin_iast: āmi kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi khaṇḍa khaṇḍabhāve yāte tumi seṭā mānuṣera nikaṭa pāṭha karate pāra krame krame evaṃ āmi seṭā kramaśa avatīrṇa karechi.
17:106.latin_ascii: ami kuraana avatirna karechi khanda khandabhave yate tumi seta manusera nikata patha karate para krame krame evam ami seta kramasa avatirna karechi.

17:107.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā kuraāne viśvāsa kara vā viśvāsa nā kara, yāderake era pūrve jñāna deẏā haẏeche tādera nikaṭa yakhana eṭā pāṭha karā haẏa takhanai tārā sijdāẏa luṭe par̤e.
17:107.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara kuraane visvasa kara va visvasa na kara, yaderake era purve jnana deya hayeche tadera nikata yakhana eta patha kara haya takhanai tara sijdaya lute pare.

17:108.latin_iast: tārā vale, ‘āmādera pratipālaka pavitra, mahāna. niścaẏai āmādera pratipālakera pratiśruti kāryakarī haẏei āche.
17:108.latin_ascii: tara vale, ‘amadera pratipalaka pavitra, mahana. niscayai amadera pratipalakera pratisruti karyakari hayei ache.

17:109.latin_iast: ‘āra tārā kā~date kā~date bhūmite luṭe par̤e evaṃ eṭā tādera vinaẏa vṛddhi kare.’
17:109.latin_ascii: ‘ara tara ka~date ka~date bhumite lute pare evam eta tadera vinaya vrddhi kare.’

17:110.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā ‘āllāha’ nāme āhvāna kara vā ‘rāhmāna’ nāme āhvāna kara, tomarā ye nāmei āhvāna kara sakala sundara nāmai to tā~ra. tomarā sālāte svara ucca kara nā evaṃ atiśaẏa kṣīṇao kara nā; duẏera madhyama patha avalamvana kara.
17:110.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara ‘allaha’ name ahvana kara va ‘rahmana’ name ahvana kara, tomara ye namei ahvana kara sakala sundara namai to ta~ra. tomara salate svara ucca kara na evam atisaya ksinao kara na; duyera madhyama patha avalamvana kara.

17:111.latin_iast: vala: ‘praśaṃsā āllāharai yini kona santāna grahaṇa karenani, tā~ra sārvabhaumatve kona aṃśīdāra nei evaṃ yini durdaśāgrasta hana nā ye kāraṇe tā~ra abhibhāvakera praẏojana hate pāre. sutarāṃ sasambhrame tā~ra māhātma ghoṣaṇā kara.
17:111.latin_ascii: vala: ‘prasamsa allaharai yini kona santana grahana karenani, ta~ra sarvabhaumatve kona amsidara nei evam yini durdasagrasta hana na ye karane ta~ra abhibhavakera prayojana hate pare. sutaram sasambhrame ta~ra mahatma ghosana kara.

18:1.latin_iast: samasta praśaṃsā ekamātra āllāhara yini tā~ra vāndāra prati e kitāva avatīrṇa karechena evaṃ tāte tini vakratā rākhenani;
18:1.latin_ascii: samasta prasamsa ekamatra allahara yini ta~ra vandara prati e kitava avatirna karechena evam tate tini vakrata rakhenani;

18:2.latin_iast: eke karechena supratiṣṭhita tā~ra kaṭhina śāsti samparke satarka karāra janya āra mu’minagaṇa, yārā satkarma kare tāderake e susaṃvāda deẏāra janya ye, tādera janya āche uttama puraskāra,
18:2.latin_ascii: eke karechena supratisthita ta~ra kathina sasti samparke satarka karara janya ara mu’minagana, yara satkarma kare taderake e susamvada deyara janya ye, tadera janya ache uttama puraskara,

18:4.latin_iast: evaṃ satarka karāra janya tāderake yārā vale ye, āllāha santāna grahaṇa karechena,
18:4.latin_ascii: evam satarka karara janya taderake yara vale ye, allaha santana grahana karechena,

18:5.latin_iast: e viṣaẏe tādera kona jñāna nei evaṃ tādera pitṛpuruṣaderao chila nā. tādera mukhaniḥsṛta vākya kī sāṃghātika! tārā kevala mithyāi vale.
18:5.latin_ascii: e visaye tadera kona jnana nei evam tadera pitrpurusaderao chila na. tadera mukhanihsrta vakya ki samghatika! tara kevala mithyai vale.

18:6.latin_iast: tārā e hādīsake (kuraānake) viśvāsa nā karale sambhavata tādera pechane ghure tumi duḥkhe nijeke dhvaṃsa kare deve.
18:6.latin_ascii: tara e hadisake (kuraanake) visvasa na karale sambhavata tadera pechane ghure tumi duhkhe nijeke dhvamsa kare deve.

18:7.latin_iast: pṛthivīra opara yā kichu āche āmi seguloke tāra śobhā saundarya karechi, mānuṣera madhye karmera dika theke ke sarveāttama tā parīkṣā kare dekhāra janya.
18:7.latin_ascii: prthivira opara ya kichu ache ami seguloke tara sobha saundarya karechi, manusera madhye karmera dika theke ke sarveattama ta pariksa kare dekhara janya.

18:8.latin_iast: tāra upara yā kichu āche tā avaśyai āmi udbhidaśūnya maẏadāne pariṇata karava.
18:8.latin_ascii: tara upara ya kichu ache ta avasyai ami udbhidasunya mayadane parinata karava.

18:9.latin_iast: tumi ki mane kara ye, guhā o rākīmera adhivāsīrā āmāra nidarśanāvalīra madhye vismaẏakara?
18:9.latin_ascii: tumi ki mane kara ye, guha o rakimera adhivasira amara nidarsanavalira madhye vismayakaray

18:10.latin_iast: yakhana yuvakarā guhāẏa āśraẏa nila takhana tārā valala: ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! āpani nija hate āmāderake anugraha dāna karuna evaṃ āmādera janya āmādera kājakarma saṭhikabhāve paricālanāra vyavasthā karuna.’
18:10.latin_ascii: yakhana yuvakara guhaya asraya nila takhana tara valala: ‘he amadera pratipalaka! apani nija hate amaderake anugraha dana karuna evam amadera janya amadera kajakarma sathikabhave paricalanara vyavastha karuna.’

18:11.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāderake guhāẏa kaẏeka vatsara ghumanta avasthāẏa rākhalāma,
18:11.latin_ascii: atahpara ami taderake guhaya kayeka vatsara ghumanta avasthaya rakhalama,

18:12.latin_iast: pare āmi tāderake jāgrata karalāma jānāra janya ye, du’ dalera madhye konṭi tādera avasthitikāla saṭhikabhāve nirṇaẏa karate pāre.
18:12.latin_ascii: pare ami taderake jagrata karalama janara janya ye, du’ dalera madhye konti tadera avasthitikala sathikabhave nirnaya karate pare.

18:13.latin_iast: āmi tomāra nikaṭa tādera vṛttānta saṭhikabhāve varṇanā karachi: tārā chila kaẏekajana yuvaka, tārā tādera pratipālakera prati īmāna enechila evaṃ āmi tādera hidāẏāta (īmāna) vṛddhi karechilāma,
18:13.latin_ascii: ami tomara nikata tadera vrttanta sathikabhave varnana karachi: tara chila kayekajana yuvaka, tara tadera pratipalakera prati imana enechila evam ami tadera hidayata (imana) vrddhi karechilama,

18:14.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tādera antara dṛr̤ha kare dilāma; tārā yakhana uṭhe dā~r̤āla takhana valala: ‘āmādera pratipālaka! ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra pratipālaka! āmarā kakhanai tā~ra parivarte anya kona ilāhke āhvāna karava nā; yadi kare vasi, tave tā atiśaẏa garhita have.
18:14.latin_ascii: evam ami tadera antara drrha kare dilama; tara yakhana uthe da~rala takhana valala: ‘amadera pratipalaka! akasamandali o prthivira pratipalaka! amara kakhanai ta~ra parivarte anya kona ilahke ahvana karava na; yadi kare vasi, tave ta atisaya garhita have.

18:15.latin_iast: āmāderai e svajātigaṇa, tā~ra parivarte aneka ilāh grahaṇa kareche. erā e samasta ilāh samvandhe spaṣṭa pramāṇa upasthita kare nā kena? ye āllāha samvandhe mithyā udbhāvana kare tāra apekṣā adhika jālima āra ke?’
18:15.latin_ascii: amaderai e svajatigana, ta~ra parivarte aneka ilah grahana kareche. era e samasta ilah samvandhe spasta pramana upasthita kare na kenay ye allaha samvandhe mithya udbhavana kare tara apeksa adhika jalima ara key’

18:16.latin_iast: tomarā yakhana vicchinna hale tādera hate o tārā āllāhara parivarte yādera ‘ivādata kare tādera hate tāhale tomarā guhāẏa āśraẏa grahaṇa kara. tomādera pratipālaka tomādera janya tā~ra daẏā vistāra karavena evaṃ tini tomādera janya tomādera kājakarmake phalaprasū karāra vyavasthā karavena.
18:16.latin_ascii: tomara yakhana vicchinna hale tadera hate o tara allahara parivarte yadera ‘ivadata kare tadera hate tahale tomara guhaya asraya grahana kara. tomadera pratipalaka tomadera janya ta~ra daya vistara karavena evam tini tomadera janya tomadera kajakarmake phalaprasu karara vyavastha karavena.

18:17.latin_iast: āra tumi sūryake dekhave, yakhana udita haẏa, tādera guhā theke ḍānadike sare yāẏa; evaṃ yakhana asta yāẏa takhana tāderake vāmadike rekhe egiẏe yāẏa athaca tārā se guhāra praśasta catvare chila. e samasta āllāhara nidarśana. āllāha yāke satpathe paricālita karena, se satpathaprāpta evaṃ tini yāke pathabhraṣṭa karena, tumi kakhanao tāra kona pathapradarśanakārī abhibhāvaka pāve nā.
18:17.latin_ascii: ara tumi suryake dekhave, yakhana udita haya, tadera guha theke danadike sare yaya; evam yakhana asta yaya takhana taderake vamadike rekhe egiye yaya athaca tara se guhara prasasta catvare chila. e samasta allahara nidarsana. allaha yake satpathe paricalita karena, se satpathaprapta evam tini yake pathabhrasta karena, tumi kakhanao tara kona pathapradarsanakari abhibhavaka pave na.

18:18.latin_iast: tumi mane karate tārā jāgrata, kintu tārā chila nidrita. āmi tāderake pārśva parivartana karātāma ḍāna dike o vāma dike evaṃ tādera kukura chila sammukhera pā du’ṭi guhādvāre prasārita kare tākiẏe; tāderake dekhale tumi pechana phire palāẏana karate o tādera bhaẏe ātaṃkagrasta haẏe par̤ate;
18:18.latin_ascii: tumi mane karate tara jagrata, kintu tara chila nidrita. ami taderake parsva parivartana karatama dana dike o vama dike evam tadera kukura chila sammukhera pa du’ti guhadvare prasarita kare takiye; taderake dekhale tumi pechana phire palayana karate o tadera bhaye atamkagrasta haye parate;

18:19.latin_iast: evaṃ ebhāvei āmi tāderake jāgrata karalāma yāte tārā parasparera madhye jijñesavāda kare. tādera ekajana valala: ‘tomarā kata kāla avasthāna karecha?’ keu keu valala: ‘āmarā avasthāna karechi eka dina athavā eka dinera kichu aṃśa.’ keu valala: ‘tomarā kata kāla avasthāna karecha tā tomādera pratipālakai bhāla jānena. ekhana tomādera ekajanake tomādera e mudrāsaha nagare preraṇa kara. se yena dekhe kon khādya uttama evaṃ tā hate yena kichu khādya niẏe āse tomādera janya. se yena vicakṣaṇatāra sāthe kāja kare o kichutei yena tomādera samvandhe kāuke kichu jānate nā deẏa.

18:28.latin_iast: tumi nijake dhairyasahakāre rākhave tāderai sāthe yārā sakāla o sandhyāẏa āhvāna kare tādera pratipālakake tā~ra santuṣṭi lābhera uddeśye evaṃ tumi pārthiva jīvanera śobhā saundarya kāmanā kare tādera hate tomāra dṛṣṭi phiriẏe nio nā. tumi tāra ānugatya kara nā yāra antarake āmi āmāra smaraṇe amanoyogī kare diẏechi, ye tāra kheẏāla-khuśīra anusaraṇa kare o yāra kāryakalāpa sīmā atikrama kare.

18:29.latin_iast: vala: ‘satya tomādera pratipālakera nikaṭa hate eseche; sutarāṃ yāra icchā īmāna ānuka o yāra icchā kupharī karuka.’ āmi jālimadera janya prastuta rekhechi agni, yāra veṣṭanī tāderake pariveṣṭana kare thākave. tārā pānīẏa cāile tāderake deẏā have galita dhātura nyāẏa pānīẏa, yā tādera mukhamaṇḍala dagdha karave; eṭā nikṛṣṭa pānīẏa! āra jāhānnāma katai nā nikṛṣṭa āśraẏa!
18:29.latin_ascii: vala: ‘satya tomadera pratipalakera nikata hate eseche; sutaram yara iccha imana anuka o yara iccha kuphari karuka.’ ami jalimadera janya prastuta rekhechi agni, yara vestani taderake parivestana kare thakave. tara paniya caile taderake deya have galita dhatura nyaya paniya, ya tadera mukhamandala dagdha karave; eta nikrsta paniya! ara jahannama katai na nikrsta asraya!

18:30.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o satkarma kare ami tara sramaphala nasta kari na ye uttamarupe karya sampadana kare.

18:48.latin_iast: evaṃ tāderake tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa upasthita karā have sārivaddhabhāve evaṃ valā have, ‘tomāderake prathamavāra yebhāve sṛṣṭi karechilāma sebhāvei tomarā āmāra nikaṭa upasthita haẏecha, athaca tomarā mane karate ye, tomādera janya pratiśra“ta kāla āmi kakhanao upasthita karava nā.’
18:48.latin_ascii: evam taderake tomara pratipalakera nikata upasthita kara have sarivaddhabhave evam vala have, ‘tomaderake prathamavara yebhave srsti karechilama sebhavei tomara amara nikata upasthita hayecha, athaca tomara mane karate ye, tomadera janya pratisra“ta kala ami kakhanao upasthita karava na.’

18:49.latin_iast: evaṃ upasthita karā have ‘āmalanāmā evaṃ tāte yā lipivaddha āche tāra kāraṇe tumi aparādhīgaṇake dekhave ātaṅkagrasta evaṃ tārā valave, ‘hāẏa, durbhāgya āmādera! eṭā kemana grantha! ye choṭa var̤a kichui vāda deẏā haẏani; varaṃ samasta hiseva rekheche.’ tārā tādera kṛtakarma sammukhe upasthita pāve; tomāra pratipālaka kāro prati juluma karena nā.

18:50.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa kara, āmi yakhana phereśtāgaṇake valechilāma, ‘ādamake sijdā kara’, takhana tārā sakalei sijadā karala ivalīsa vyatīta; se jinadera ekajana, se tāra pratipālakera ādeśa amānya karala. tave ki tomarā āmāra parivarte tāke evaṃ tāra vaṃśadharake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa karacha? tārā tomādera śatra“. jālimadera e vinimaẏa katai nā nikṛṣṭa.
18:50.latin_ascii: evam smarana kara, ami yakhana pherestaganake valechilama, ‘adamake sijda kara’, takhana tara sakalei sijada karala ivalisa vyatita; se jinadera ekajana, se tara pratipalakera adesa amanya karala. tave ki tomara amara parivarte take evam tara vamsadharake abhibhavakarupe grahana karachay tara tomadera satra“. jalimadera e vinimaya katai na nikrsta.
