18:52.latin_ascii: evam se dinera katha smarana kara, yedina tini valavena, ‘tomara yaderake amara sarika mane karate taderake ahvana kara.’ tara takhana taderake ahvana karave kintu tara tadera ahvane sara deve na evam tadera ubhayera madhyasthale rekhe deva eka dhvamsa-gahvara.

18:53.latin_iast: aparādhīrā āguna dekhe vujhave ye, tārā tathāẏa patita have evaṃ tārā sekhāna hate kona paritrāṇasthala pāve nā.
18:53.latin_ascii: aparadhira aguna dekhe vujhave ye, tara tathaya patita have evam tara sekhana hate kona paritranasthala pave na.

18:54.latin_iast: āmi mānuṣera janya e kuraāne vibhinna upamā viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi. mānuṣa adhikāṃśa vyāpārei vitarkapriẏa.
18:54.latin_ascii: ami manusera janya e kuraane vibhinna upama visadabhave varnana karechi. manusa adhikamsa vyaparei vitarkapriya.

18:55.latin_iast: yakhana mānuṣera nikaṭa pathanirdeśa āse takhana tāderake īmāna ānā evaṃ tādera pratipālakera nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā karā hate virata rākhe kevala eṭā ye, tādera nikaṭa pūrvavartīdera anusṛta rīti āsuka athavā āsuka tādera nikaṭa sarāsari ‘āyāva.
18:55.latin_ascii: yakhana manusera nikata pathanirdesa ase takhana taderake imana ana evam tadera pratipalakera nikata ksama prarthana kara hate virata rakhe kevala eta ye, tadera nikata purvavartidera anusrta riti asuka athava asuka tadera nikata sarasari ‘ayava.

18:56.latin_iast: āmi kevalamātra susaṃvādadātā o satarkakārīrūpei rāsūlagaṇake pāṭhiẏe thāki, kintu kāphiragaṇa mithyā avalamvaṇe vitaṇḍā kare seṭā dvārā satyake vyartha kare devāra janya āra tārā āmāra nidarśanāvalī o yāra dvārā tāderake satarka karā haẏeche se samastake vidraƒpera viṣaẏarūpe grahaṇa kare thāke.
18:56.latin_ascii: ami kevalamatra susamvadadata o satarkakarirupei rasulaganake pathiye thaki, kintu kaphiragana mithya avalamvane vitanda kare seta dvara satyake vyartha kare devara janya ara tara amara nidarsanavali o yara dvara taderake satarka kara hayeche se samastake vidraƒpera visayarupe grahana kare thake.

18:57.latin_iast: kona vyaktike tāra pratipālakera nidarśanāvalī smaraṇa kariẏe deẏāra para se yadi tā hate mukha phiriẏe neẏa evaṃ tāra kṛtakarmasamūha bhule yāẏa tave tāra apekṣā adhika jālima āra ke? āmi tādera antarera opara āvaraṇa diẏechi yena tārā kuraāna vujhate nā pāre evaṃ tādera kāne vadhiratā vaddhamūla kare diẏechi. tumi tāderake satpathe āhvāna karaleo tārā kakhanao satpathe āsave nā.
18:57.latin_ascii: kona vyaktike tara pratipalakera nidarsanavali smarana kariye deyara para se yadi ta hate mukha phiriye neya evam tara krtakarmasamuha bhule yaya tave tara apeksa adhika jalima ara key ami tadera antarera opara avarana diyechi yena tara kuraana vujhate na pare evam tadera kane vadhirata vaddhamula kare diyechi. tumi taderake satpathe ahvana karaleo tara kakhanao satpathe asave na.

18:58.latin_iast: āra tomāra pratipālaka parama kṣamāśīla, daẏāvāna, tādera kṛtakarmera janya yadi tini tāderake pākar̤āo karate cāitena, tave tini avaśyai tādera śāsti tvarānvita karatena; kintu tādera janya raẏeche eka pratiśra“ta muhūrta, yā hate tārā kakhanai kona āśraẏasthala pāve nā.
18:58.latin_ascii: ara tomara pratipalaka parama ksamasila, dayavana, tadera krtakarmera janya yadi tini taderake pakarao karate caitena, tave tini avasyai tadera sasti tvaranvita karatena; kintu tadera janya rayeche eka pratisra“ta muhurta, ya hate tara kakhanai kona asrayasthala pave na.

18:59.latin_iast: aisava janapada tādera adhivāsīvṛndake āmi dhvaṃsa karechilāma yakhana tārā sīmālaṃghana karechila evaṃ tādera dhvaṃsera janya āmi sthira karechilāma eka nirdiṣṭa samaẏa.
18:59.latin_ascii: aisava janapada tadera adhivasivrndake ami dhvamsa karechilama yakhana tara simalamghana karechila evam tadera dhvamsera janya ami sthira karechilama eka nirdista samaya.

18:60.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana mūsā tāra saṅgīke valechila, ‘du’ samudrera milanasthale nā pau~chiẏe āmi thāmava nā athavā āmi dīrgha samaẏa dhare calate thākava.’
18:60.latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana musa tara sangike valechila, ‘du’ samudrera milanasthale na pau~chiye ami thamava na athava ami dirgha samaya dhare calate thakava.’

18:61.latin_iast: tārā ubhaẏe yakhana du’ samudrera milanasthale pau~chala tārā nijedera matsyera kathā bhule gela; seṭā sur̤aṅgera mata nijera patha kare samudre neme gela.
18:61.latin_ascii: tara ubhaye yakhana du’ samudrera milanasthale pau~chala tara nijedera matsyera katha bhule gela; seta surangera mata nijera patha kare samudre neme gela.

18:62.latin_iast: yakhana tārā āro agrasara hala mūsā tāra saṅgīke valala: ‘āmādera sakālera khāvāra āna, āmarā āmādera e saphare klānta haẏe par̤echi.’
18:62.latin_ascii: yakhana tara aro agrasara hala musa tara sangike valala: ‘amadera sakalera khavara ana, amara amadera e saphare klanta haye parechi.’

18:63.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āpani ki lakṣya karechena? āmarā yakhana śilākhaṇḍe viśrāma karachilāma takhana āmi matsyera kathā bhule giẏechilāma, śaẏatānai seṭāra kathā valate āmāke bhuliẏe diẏechila; matsyaṭi āścaryajanakabhāve nijera patha kare samudre neme gela.’
18:63.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘apani ki laksya karechenay amara yakhana silakhande visrama karachilama takhana ami matsyera katha bhule giyechilama, sayatanai setara katha valate amake bhuliye diyechila; matsyati ascaryajanakabhave nijera patha kare samudre neme gela.’

18:64.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘āmarā se sthānaṭirai anusandhāna karachilāma.’ ataḥpara tārā nijedera padaciha“ dhare phire calala.
18:64.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘amara se sthanatirai anusandhana karachilama.’ atahpara tara nijedera padaciha“ dhare phire calala.

18:65.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā sākṣāta pela āmāra vāndādera madhye ekajanera, yāke āmi āmāra nikaṭa hate anugraha dāna karechilāma o āmāra nikaṭa hate śikṣā diẏechilāma eka viśeṣa jñāna.
18:65.latin_ascii: atahpara tara saksata pela amara vandadera madhye ekajanera, yake ami amara nikata hate anugraha dana karechilama o amara nikata hate siksa diyechilama eka visesa jnana.

18:66.latin_iast: mūsā tāke valala: ‘satya pathera ye jñāna āpanāke dāna karā haẏeche tā hate āmāke śikṣā devena, e śarte āmi āpanāra anusaraṇa karava ki?’
18:66.latin_ascii: musa take valala: ‘satya pathera ye jnana apanake dana kara hayeche ta hate amake siksa devena, e sarte ami apanara anusarana karava kiy’

18:67.latin_iast: se valala: āpani kichutei āmāra saṅge dhairya dhāraṇa kare thākate pāravena nā,
18:67.latin_ascii: se valala: apani kichutei amara sange dhairya dharana kare thakate paravena na,

18:68.latin_iast: ye viṣaẏa āpanāra jñānāẏatta naẏa se viṣaẏe āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karavena kemana kare?’
18:68.latin_ascii: ye visaya apanara jnanayatta naya se visaye apani dhairya dharana karavena kemana karey’

18:69.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘āllāha cāile āpani āmāke dhairyaśīla pāvena evaṃ āpanāra kona ādeśa āmi amānya karava nā.’
18:69.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘allaha caile apani amake dhairyasila pavena evam apanara kona adesa ami amanya karava na.’

18:70.latin_iast: se valala: ‘ācchā, āpani yadi āmāra anusaraṇa karatei cāna tave kona viṣaẏe āmāke praśna karavena nā, yatakṣaṇa nā āmi se samvandhe āpanāke kichu vali.’
18:70.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘accha, apani yadi amara anusarana karatei cana tave kona visaye amake prasna karavena na, yataksana na ami se samvandhe apanake kichu vali.’

18:71.latin_iast: ataḥpara ubhaẏe calate lāgala, pare yakhana tārā naukāẏa ārohaṇa karala takhana se (khājira) naukāṭā vidīrṇa kare dila. mūsā valala: ‘āpani ki ārohīderake nimajjita kare devāra janya vidīrṇa karalena? āpani to eka gurutara anyāẏa kāja karalena!’
18:71.latin_ascii: atahpara ubhaye calate lagala, pare yakhana tara naukaya arohana karala takhana se (khajira) naukata vidirna kare dila. musa valala: ‘apani ki arohiderake nimajjita kare devara janya vidirna karalenay apani to eka gurutara anyaya kaja karalena!’

18:72.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmi ki valini ye, āpani āmāra saṅge kichutei dhairya dhāraṇa karate pāravena nā?’
18:72.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ami ki valini ye, apani amara sange kichutei dhairya dharana karate paravena nay’

18:73.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘āmāra bhulera janya āmāke pākar̤āo karavena nā o āmāra vyāpāre adhika kaṭhoratā avalamvana karavena nā.’
18:73.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘amara bhulera janya amake pakarao karavena na o amara vyapare adhika kathorata avalamvana karavena na.’

18:74.latin_iast: ataḥpara ubhaẏe calate lāgala, calate calate tādera sāthe eka vālakera sākṣāta hale se tāke hatyā karala. takhana mūsā valala: ‘āpani ki eka niṣpāpa jīvana nāśa karalena, hatyāra aparādha chār̤āi? āpani eka gurutara anyāẏa kāja karalena.’
18:74.latin_ascii: atahpara ubhaye calate lagala, calate calate tadera sathe eka valakera saksata hale se take hatya karala. takhana musa valala: ‘apani ki eka nispapa jivana nasa karalena, hatyara aparadha charaiy apani eka gurutara anyaya kaja karalena.’

18:75.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmi ki āpanāke valini ye, āpani āmāra saṅge kichutei dhairya dhāraṇa karate pāravena nā?
18:75.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ami ki apanake valini ye, apani amara sange kichutei dhairya dharana karate paravena nay

18:76.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘erapara, yadi āmi āpanāke kona viṣaẏe jijñesa kari tave āpani āmāke saṅge rākhavena nā; āmāra ‘oyara-āpattira śeṣa sīmāẏa pau~che gechi.
18:76.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘erapara, yadi ami apanake kona visaye jijnesa kari tave apani amake sange rakhavena na; amara ‘oyara-apattira sesa simaya pau~che gechi.

18:77.latin_iast: ataḥpara ubhaẏe calate lāgala; calate calate tārā eka janapadera adhivāsīdera nikaṭa pau~che tādera nikaṭa khādya cāila; kintu tārā tādera mehamānadārī karate asvīkāra karala. ataḥpara tathāẏa tārā eka par̤e yāoẏāra upakrama prācīra dekhate pela evaṃ se tāke sudṛr̤ha kare dila. mūsā valala: ‘āpani icchā karale eṭāra janya pāriśramika grahaṇa karate pāratena.’
18:77.latin_ascii: atahpara ubhaye calate lagala; calate calate tara eka janapadera adhivasidera nikata pau~che tadera nikata khadya caila; kintu tara tadera mehamanadari karate asvikara karala. atahpara tathaya tara eka pare yaoyara upakrama pracira dekhate pela evam se take sudrrha kare dila. musa valala: ‘apani iccha karale etara janya parisramika grahana karate paratena.’

18:78.latin_iast: se valala: ‘ekhānei āpanāra evaṃ āmāra madhye samparkaccheda hala; ye viṣaẏe āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karate pārenani āmi tāra tātparya vyākhyā karachi.
18:78.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ekhanei apanara evam amara madhye samparkaccheda hala; ye visaye apani dhairya dharana karate parenani ami tara tatparya vyakhya karachi.

18:79.latin_iast: naukāṭira vyāpāra eṭā chila katipaẏa daridra vyaktira, tārā samudre jīvikā anveṣaṇa karata; āmi icchā karalāma naukāṭike truṭiyukta karate; kāraṇa tādera sammukhe chila eka rājā, ye valapraẏoge naukāsakala chiniẏe nita.
18:79.latin_ascii: naukatira vyapara eta chila katipaya daridra vyaktira, tara samudre jivika anvesana karata; ami iccha karalama naukatike trutiyukta karate; karana tadera sammukhe chila eka raja, ye valaprayoge naukasakala chiniye nita.

18:80.latin_iast: āra kiśoraṭi, tāra pitā-mātā chila mu’mina. āmi āśaṃkā karalāma ye, se vidrohācaraṇa o kupharīra dvārā tāderake vivrata karave.
18:80.latin_ascii: ara kisorati, tara pita-mata chila mu’mina. ami asamka karalama ye, se vidrohacarana o kupharira dvara taderake vivrata karave.

18:81.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi cāilāma ye, tādera pratipālaka yena tāderake era parivarte eka santāna dāna karena, ye have pavitratāẏa mahattara o bhakti-bhālavāsāẏa ghaniṣṭhatara.
18:81.latin_ascii: atahpara ami cailama ye, tadera pratipalaka yena taderake era parivarte eka santana dana karena, ye have pavitrataya mahattara o bhakti-bhalavasaya ghanisthatara.

18:82.latin_iast: āra ai prācīraṭi, eṭā chila nagaravāsī du’ pitṛhīna kiśorera, eṭāra nimna deśe āche tādera guptadhana evaṃ tādera pitā chila satkarmaparāẏaṇa. sutarāṃ āpanāra pratipālaka daẏāparavaśa haẏe icchā karalena ye, tārā vaẏaḥprāpta hoka evaṃ tārā tādera dhanabhāṇḍāra uddhāra karuka. āmi nija hate kichuu karini; āpani ye viṣaẏe dhairya dhāraṇe apāraga haẏechilena, eṭāi tāra vyākhyā.’
18:82.latin_ascii: ara ai pracirati, eta chila nagaravasi du’ pitrhina kisorera, etara nimna dese ache tadera guptadhana evam tadera pita chila satkarmaparayana. sutaram apanara pratipalaka dayaparavasa haye iccha karalena ye, tara vayahprapta hoka evam tara tadera dhanabhandara uddhara karuka. ami nija hate kichuu karini; apani ye visaye dhairya dharane aparaga hayechilena, etai tara vyakhya.’

18:83.latin_iast: tārā tomāke yula-kāranāina samvandhe jijñesa kare. vala: āmi tomādera nikaṭa tāra viṣaẏa varṇanā karava.
18:83.latin_ascii: tara tomake yula-karanaina samvandhe jijnesa kare. vala: ami tomadera nikata tara visaya varnana karava.

18:84.latin_iast: āmi to tāke pṛthivīte kartṛtva diẏechilāma evaṃ pratyeka viṣaẏera upāẏa-upakaraṇa dāna karechilāma.
18:84.latin_ascii: ami to take prthivite kartrtva diyechilama evam pratyeka visayera upaya-upakarana dana karechilama.

18:85.latin_iast: ataḥpara se eka patha avalamvana karala.
18:85.latin_ascii: atahpara se eka patha avalamvana karala.

18:86.latin_iast: calate calate se yakhana sūryera astagamana sthāne pau~chala takhana se sūryake eka paṃkila jalāśaẏe astagamana karate dekhala evaṃ se tathāẏa eka sampradāẏake dekhate pela. āmi valalāma, ‘he yula-kāranāina! tumi ederake śāsti dite pāra athavā edera vyāpāra sadaẏabhāve grahaṇa karate pāra.’
18:86.latin_ascii: calate calate se yakhana suryera astagamana sthane pau~chala takhana se suryake eka pamkila jalasaye astagamana karate dekhala evam se tathaya eka sampradayake dekhate pela. ami valalama, ‘he yula-karanaina! tumi ederake sasti dite para athava edera vyapara sadayabhave grahana karate para.’

18:87.latin_iast: se valala: ‘ye keu sīmālaṅghana karave āmi tāke śāsti deva, ataḥpara se tāra pratipālakera nikaṭa pratyāvartita have evaṃ tini tāke kaṭhina śāsti devena.
18:87.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ye keu simalanghana karave ami take sasti deva, atahpara se tara pratipalakera nikata pratyavartita have evam tini take kathina sasti devena.

18:88.latin_iast: tave ye īmāna āne evaṃ satkarma kare tāra janya pratidānasvarūpa āche kalyāṇa evaṃ tāra prati vyavahāre āmi namra kathā valava.’
18:88.latin_ascii: tave ye imana ane evam satkarma kare tara janya pratidanasvarupa ache kalyana evam tara prati vyavahare ami namra katha valava.’

18:90.latin_iast: calate calate yakhana se sūryeādaẏa sthale pau~chala takhana se dekhala seṭā emana eka sampradāẏera opara udaẏa hacche yādera janya sūryatāpa hate kona antarāla āmi sṛṣṭi karini;
18:90.latin_ascii: calate calate yakhana se suryeadaya sthale pau~chala takhana se dekhala seta emana eka sampradayera opara udaya hacche yadera janya suryatapa hate kona antarala ami srsti karini;

18:91.latin_iast: prakṛta ghaṭanā eṭāi, tāra nikaṭa yā kichu chila āmi samyaka avagata āchi.
18:91.latin_ascii: prakrta ghatana etai, tara nikata ya kichu chila ami samyaka avagata achi.

18:93.latin_iast: calate calate se yakhana du’ parvata madhyavartī sthale pau~chala takhana tathāẏa se eka sampradāẏake pela yārā kona kathā vujhāra mata chila nā.
18:93.latin_ascii: calate calate se yakhana du’ parvata madhyavarti sthale pau~chala takhana tathaya se eka sampradayake pela yara kona katha vujhara mata chila na.

18:94.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he yula-kāranāina! iẏā’jūja o mā’jūja pṛthivīte aśānti sṛṣṭi karache. āmarā ki āpanāke kharaca deva ye, āpani āmādera o tādera madhye eka prācīra gar̤e devena’?
18:94.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he yula-karanaina! iya’juja o ma’juja prthivite asanti srsti karache. amara ki apanake kharaca deva ye, apani amadera o tadera madhye eka pracira gare devena’y

18:95.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmāra pratipālaka āmāke ye kṣamatā diẏechena, tāi utkṛṣṭa. sutarāṃ tomarā āmāke śrama dvārā sāhāyya kara, āmi tomādera o tādera madhyasthale eka majavuta prācīra gar̤e deva.
18:95.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘amara pratipalaka amake ye ksamata diyechena, tai utkrsta. sutaram tomara amake srama dvara sahayya kara, ami tomadera o tadera madhyasthale eka majavuta pracira gare deva.

18:96.latin_iast: tomarā āmāra nikaṭa lauhapiṇḍasamūha ānaẏana kara’, ataḥpara madhyavartī phā~kā sthāna pūrṇa haẏe yakhana lauhastūpa du’ parvatera samāna hala takhana se valala: ‘tomarā hā~pare dama dite thāko.’ yakhana seṭā agnivat uttapta hala, takhana se valala: ‘tomarā galita tāmā ānaẏana kara, āmi tā ḍhele dei tāra opara.’
18:96.latin_ascii: tomara amara nikata lauhapindasamuha anayana kara’, atahpara madhyavarti pha~ka sthana purna haye yakhana lauhastupa du’ parvatera samana hala takhana se valala: ‘tomara ha~pare dama dite thako.’ yakhana seta agnivat uttapta hala, takhana se valala: ‘tomara galita tama anayana kara, ami ta dhele dei tara opara.’

18:97.latin_iast: erapara tārā (iẏā’jūja-mā’jūja) tā atikrama karate pārala nā evaṃ seṭā bhedao karate pārala nā.
18:97.latin_ascii: erapara tara (iya’juja-ma’juja) ta atikrama karate parala na evam seta bhedao karate parala na.

18:98.latin_iast: se valala: ‘eṭā āmāra pratipālakera anugraha. yakhana āmāra pratipālakera pratiśruti pūrṇa have takhana tini tāke cūrṇa-vicūrṇa kare devena evaṃ āmāra pratipālakera pratiśruti satya.’
18:98.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘eta amara pratipalakera anugraha. yakhana amara pratipalakera pratisruti purna have takhana tini take curna-vicurna kare devena evam amara pratipalakera pratisruti satya.’

18:99.latin_iast: sedina āmi tāderake cher̤e deva e avasthāẏa ye, ekadala anya ekadalera opara taraṅgera nyāẏa patita have evaṃ śiṅgāẏa phutkāra deẏā have. ataḥpara āmi tādera sakalakei ekatra karava.
18:99.latin_ascii: sedina ami taderake chere deva e avasthaya ye, ekadala anya ekadalera opara tarangera nyaya patita have evam singaya phutkara deya have. atahpara ami tadera sakalakei ekatra karava.

18:100.latin_iast: evaṃ sedina āmi jāhānnāmake pratyakṣabhāve upasthita karava kāphiradera nikaṭa,
18:100.latin_ascii: evam sedina ami jahannamake pratyaksabhave upasthita karava kaphiradera nikata,

18:101.latin_iast: yādera cakṣu chila andha āmāra nidarśanera prati evaṃ yārā śunateo chila akṣama.
18:101.latin_ascii: yadera caksu chila andha amara nidarsanera prati evam yara sunateo chila aksama.

18:102.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā ki mane kare ye, tārā āmāra parivarte āmāra vāndāderake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa karave? āmi kāphiradera āpyāẏanera janya prastuta rekhechi jāhānnāma.
18:102.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara ki mane kare ye, tara amara parivarte amara vandaderake abhibhavakarupe grahana karavey ami kaphiradera apyayanera janya prastuta rekhechi jahannama.

18:103.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmi ki tomāderake saṃvāda deva kārā karme savaceẏe veśī kṣatigrasta?’
18:103.latin_ascii: vala: ‘ami ki tomaderake samvada deva kara karme savaceye vesi ksatigrastay’

18:104.latin_iast: tārā hala sesava loka, ‘pārthiva jīvane yādera praceṣṭā vyartha haẏe geche, yadio tārā mane kare ye, tārā satkarmai karache,
18:104.latin_ascii: tara hala sesava loka, ‘parthiva jivane yadera pracesta vyartha haye geche, yadio tara mane kare ye, tara satkarmai karache,

18:105.latin_iast: tārāi asvīkāra kare tādera pratipālakera nidarśanāvalī o tā~ra sāthe tādera sākṣātera viṣaẏa. phale tādera karma niṣphala haẏe geche; sutarāṃ kiẏāmatera dina tādera janya ojanera kona vyavasthā rākhava nā.’
18:105.latin_ascii: tarai asvikara kare tadera pratipalakera nidarsanavali o ta~ra sathe tadera saksatera visaya. phale tadera karma nisphala haye geche; sutaram kiyamatera dina tadera janya ojanera kona vyavastha rakhava na.’

18:106.latin_iast: jāhānnāma eṭāi tādera pratiphala, yehetu tārā kupharī kareche evaṃ āmāra nidarśanāvalī o rāsūlagaṇake grahaṇa kareche vidraƒpera pātrarūpe.’
18:106.latin_ascii: jahannama etai tadera pratiphala, yehetu tara kuphari kareche evam amara nidarsanavali o rasulaganake grahana kareche vidraƒpera patrarupe.’

18:107.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā īmāna āne o satkarma kare tādera āpyāẏanera janya āche phiradāusera udyāna,
18:107.latin_ascii: niscayai yara imana ane o satkarma kare tadera apyayanera janya ache phiradausera udyana,

18:108.latin_iast: sethāẏa tārā sthāẏī have, tā hate sthānāntara kāmanā karave nā.
18:108.latin_ascii: sethaya tara sthayi have, ta hate sthanantara kamana karave na.

18:109.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmāra pratipālakera kathā lipivaddha karāra janya samudra yadi kāli haẏa, tave āmāra pratipālakera kathā śeṣa havāra pūrvei samudra niḥśeṣa haẏe yāve āmarā eṭāra sāhāyyārthe anurūpa ārao samudra ānaleo.’
18:109.latin_ascii: vala: ‘amara pratipalakera katha lipivaddha karara janya samudra yadi kali haya, tave amara pratipalakera katha sesa havara purvei samudra nihsesa haye yave amara etara sahayyarthe anurupa arao samudra analeo.’

18:110.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmi to tomādera mata ekajana mānuṣai, āmāra prati pratyādeśa haẏa ye, tomādera mā‘vūda kevalamātra eka mā‘vūda sutarāṃ ye tāra pratipālakera sākṣāta kāmanā kare, se yena satkarma kare o tāra pratipālakera ivādate kāukeo śarīka nā kare.’
18:110.latin_ascii: vala: ‘ami to tomadera mata ekajana manusai, amara prati pratyadesa haya ye, tomadera ma‘vuda kevalamatra eka ma‘vuda sutaram ye tara pratipalakera saksata kamana kare, se yena satkarma kare o tara pratipalakera ivadate kaukeo sarika na kare.’

19:2.latin_iast: eṭā tomāra pratipālakera anugrahera vivaraṇa tā~ra vāndā yākāriẏāra prati,
19:2.latin_ascii: eta tomara pratipalakera anugrahera vivarana ta~ra vanda yakariyara prati,

19:3.latin_iast: yakhana se tāra pratipālakake āhvāna karechila cupisāre,
19:3.latin_ascii: yakhana se tara pratipalakake ahvana karechila cupisare,

19:4.latin_iast: se valechila, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāra asthi durvala haẏeche, vārdhakye āmāra māthāra cula sādā haẏeche; he āmāra pratipālaka! tomāke āhvāna kare āmi kakhano vyarthakāma haini.
19:4.latin_ascii: se valechila, ‘he amara rava! amara asthi durvala hayeche, vardhakye amara mathara cula sada hayeche; he amara pratipalaka! tomake ahvana kare ami kakhano vyarthakama haini.

19:5.latin_iast: āmi āśaṃkā kari āmāra para āmāra paravartī vaṃśadharera, athaca āmāra strī vandhyā. sutarāṃ tumi tomāra nikaṭa hate āmāke dāna kara uttarādhikārī,
19:5.latin_ascii: ami asamka kari amara para amara paravarti vamsadharera, athaca amara stri vandhya. sutaram tumi tomara nikata hate amake dana kara uttaradhikari,

19:6.latin_iast: ye āmāra uttarādhikārī have evaṃ uttarādhikārī have iẏā‘kūvera vaṃśera evaṃ he āmāra pratipālaka! tāke kara santoṣabhājana’.
19:6.latin_ascii: ye amara uttaradhikari have evam uttaradhikari have iya‘kuvera vamsera evam he amara pratipalaka! take kara santosabhajana’.

19:7.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘he yākāriẏā! āmi tomāke eka putrera susaṃvāda dicchi, tāra nāma have iẏāhaiẏā; e nāme pūrve āmi kārao nāmakaraṇa karini.’
19:7.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘he yakariya! ami tomake eka putrera susamvada dicchi, tara nama have iyahaiya; e name purve ami karao namakarana karini.’

19:8.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! kemana kare āmāra putra have yakhana āmāra strī vandhyā o āmi vārdhakyera śeṣa sīmāẏa upanīta.’
19:8.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! kemana kare amara putra have yakhana amara stri vandhya o ami vardhakyera sesa simaya upanita.’

19:9.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘erūpai have.’ tomāra pratipālaka valechena, ‘eṭā āmāra janya sahajasādhya; āmi pūrve tomāke sṛṣṭi karechi yakhana tumi kichui chile nā.’
19:9.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘erupai have.’ tomara pratipalaka valechena, ‘eta amara janya sahajasadhya; ami purve tomake srsti karechi yakhana tumi kichui chile na.’

19:10.latin_iast: yākāriẏā valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke ekaṭi nidarśana dāo.’ tini valalena: ‘tomāra nidarśana ei ye, tumi sustha thākā sattveo kārao sāthe tina rāta vākyālāpa karave nā.’
19:10.latin_ascii: yakariya valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! amake ekati nidarsana dao.’ tini valalena: ‘tomara nidarsana ei ye, tumi sustha thaka sattveo karao sathe tina rata vakyalapa karave na.’

19:11.latin_iast: ataḥpara se kakṣa hate vera haẏe tāra sampradāẏera nikaṭa āsala evaṃ iṅgite tāderake sakāla-sandhyāẏa āllāhara pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karate valala.
19:11.latin_ascii: atahpara se kaksa hate vera haye tara sampradayera nikata asala evam ingite taderake sakala-sandhyaya allahara pavitrata o mahima ghosana karate valala.

19:12.latin_iast: he iẏāhaiẏā! e kitāva (tāorāta) dṛr̤hatāra sāthe grahaṇa kara.’ āmi tāke śaiśavei dāna karechilāma jñāna,
19:12.latin_ascii: he iyahaiya! e kitava (taorata) drrhatara sathe grahana kara.’ ami take saisavei dana karechilama jnana,

19:13.latin_iast: evaṃ āmāra nikaṭa hate hṛdaẏera komalatā o pavitratā (diẏechilāma); se chila muttākī,
19:13.latin_ascii: evam amara nikata hate hrdayera komalata o pavitrata (diyechilama); se chila muttaki,

19:14.latin_iast: pitā-mātāra anugata evaṃ se chila nā uddhata o avādhya.
19:14.latin_ascii: pita-matara anugata evam se chila na uddhata o avadhya.

19:15.latin_iast: tāra prati śānti yedina se janma lābha kareche, yedina tāra mṛtyu have evaṃ yedina se jīvita avasthāẏa utthita have.
19:15.latin_ascii: tara prati santi yedina se janma labha kareche, yedina tara mrtyu have evam yedina se jivita avasthaya utthita have.

19:16.latin_iast: varṇanā kara e kitāve māraiẏāmera kathā, yakhana se tāra parivāravarga hate pṛthaka haẏe nirālāẏa pūrva dike eka sthāne āśraẏa nila,
19:16.latin_ascii: varnana kara e kitave maraiyamera katha, yakhana se tara parivaravarga hate prthaka haye niralaya purva dike eka sthane asraya nila,

19:17.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera hate se pardā karala. āra āmi tāra nikaṭa āmāra rūhake pāṭhālāma, se tāra nikaṭa pūrṇa mānavākṛtite ātmaprakāśa karala.
19:17.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera hate se parda karala. ara ami tara nikata amara ruhake pathalama, se tara nikata purna manavakrtite atmaprakasa karala.

19:18.latin_iast: māraiẏāma valala: yadi tumi āllāhake bhaẏa kara, āmi tomāra (apakarma) hate daẏāmaẏera āśraẏa prārthanā karachi.
19:18.latin_ascii: maraiyama valala: yadi tumi allahake bhaya kara, ami tomara (apakarma) hate dayamayera asraya prarthana karachi.

19:19.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmi tomāra pratipālaka kartṛka prerita, vārtāvāhaka tomāke eka pavitra putra dāna karāra janya.’
19:19.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ami tomara pratipalaka kartrka prerita, vartavahaka tomake eka pavitra putra dana karara janya.’

19:20.latin_iast: māraiẏāma valala: ‘kemana kare āmāra putra have yakhana āmāke kona puruṣa sparśa kareni evaṃ āmi vyabhicāriṇīo nai?’
19:20.latin_ascii: maraiyama valala: ‘kemana kare amara putra have yakhana amake kona purusa sparsa kareni evam ami vyabhicarinio naiy’

19:21.latin_iast: se valala: ‘erūpai have.’ tomāra pratipālaka valechena, ‘eṭā āmāra janya sahajasādhya evaṃ āmi tāke ejanya sṛṣṭi karava yena se haẏa mānuṣera janya nidarśana o āmāra pakṣa theke eka anugraha; e vyāpāre sindhānta haẏe geche.’
19:21.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘erupai have.’ tomara pratipalaka valechena, ‘eta amara janya sahajasadhya evam ami take ejanya srsti karava yena se haya manusera janya nidarsana o amara paksa theke eka anugraha; e vyapare sindhanta haye geche.’

19:22.latin_iast: ataḥpara se garbhe tāke dhāraṇa karala; evaṃ eka dūravartī sthāne cale gela;
19:22.latin_ascii: atahpara se garbhe take dharana karala; evam eka duravarti sthane cale gela;

19:23.latin_iast: prasava-vedanā tāke eka khejura-vṛkṣa tale āśraẏa nite vādhya karala. se valala: ‘hāẏa, era pūrve āmi yadi mare yetāma o lokera smṛti hate sampūrṇa vilupta hatāma!’
19:23.latin_ascii: prasava-vedana take eka khejura-vrksa tale asraya nite vadhya karala. se valala: ‘haya, era purve ami yadi mare yetama o lokera smrti hate sampurna vilupta hatama!’

19:24.latin_iast: phereśtā tāra nimna pārśva hate āhvāna kare tāke valala: ‘tumi duḥkha kara nā, tomāra pādadeśe tomāra pratipālaka eka nahara sṛṣṭi karechena;
19:24.latin_ascii: pheresta tara nimna parsva hate ahvana kare take valala: ‘tumi duhkha kara na, tomara padadese tomara pratipalaka eka nahara srsti karechena;

19:25.latin_iast: tumi tomāra dike khejura-vṛkṣera kāṇḍe nār̤ā dāo, tā tomāke supakva tājā khejura dāna karave.
19:25.latin_ascii: tumi tomara dike khejura-vrksera kande nara dao, ta tomake supakva taja khejura dana karave.

19:26.latin_iast: sutarāṃ āhāra kara, pāna kara o cakṣu jur̤āo. mānuṣera madhye kāukeo yadi tumi dekha takhana vala: ‘āmi daẏāmaẏera uddeśye sāoma avalamvanera mānata karechi. sutarāṃ āja āmi kichutei kona mānuṣera sāthe vākyālāpa karava nā.’
19:26.latin_ascii: sutaram ahara kara, pana kara o caksu jurao. manusera madhye kaukeo yadi tumi dekha takhana vala: ‘ami dayamayera uddesye saoma avalamvanera manata karechi. sutaram aja ami kichutei kona manusera sathe vakyalapa karava na.’

19:27.latin_iast: ataḥpara se santānake niẏe tāra sampradāẏera nikaṭa upasthita hala; tārā valala: ‘he māraiẏāma! tumi to eka adbhūta kāṇḍa kare vasecha.
19:27.latin_ascii: atahpara se santanake niye tara sampradayera nikata upasthita hala; tara valala: ‘he maraiyama! tumi to eka adbhuta kanda kare vasecha.

19:28.latin_iast: ‘he hārūnera vona. tomāra pitā asat vyakti chila nā evaṃ tomāra mātāo chila nā vyabhicāriṇī.’
19:28.latin_ascii: ‘he harunera vona. tomara pita asat vyakti chila na evam tomara matao chila na vyabhicarini.’

19:29.latin_iast: ataḥpara māraiẏāma santānera prati iṅgita karala. tārā valala: ‘ye kolera śiśu tāra sāthe āmarā kemana kare kathā valava?’
19:29.latin_ascii: atahpara maraiyama santanera prati ingita karala. tara valala: ‘ye kolera sisu tara sathe amara kemana kare katha valavay’

19:30.latin_iast: se valala: ‘āmi āllāhara vāndā. tini āmāke kitāva diẏechena, āmāke nāvī karechena,
19:30.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘ami allahara vanda. tini amake kitava diyechena, amake navi karechena,

19:31.latin_iast: yekhānei āmi thāki nā kena tini āmāke varakatamaẏa karechena, tini āmāke nirdeśa diẏechena yatadina jīvita thāki tatadina sālāta o yākāta ādāẏa karate
19:31.latin_ascii: yekhanei ami thaki na kena tini amake varakatamaya karechena, tini amake nirdesa diyechena yatadina jivita thaki tatadina salata o yakata adaya karate

19:32.latin_iast: āra āmāke āmāra mātāra prati anugata karechena evaṃ tini āmāke karenani uddhata o hatabhāgya;
19:32.latin_ascii: ara amake amara matara prati anugata karechena evam tini amake karenani uddhata o hatabhagya;

19:33.latin_iast: āmāra prati śānti yedina āmi janmalābha karechi, yedina āmāra mṛtyu have evaṃ yedina jīvita avasthāẏa āmi utthita hava.’
19:33.latin_ascii: amara prati santi yedina ami janmalabha karechi, yedina amara mrtyu have evam yedina jivita avasthaya ami utthita hava.’

19:34.latin_iast: e hacche māriẏāma putra ‘īsā. āmi valalāma satya kathā, ye viṣaẏe tārā sandeha kare.
19:34.latin_ascii: e hacche mariyama putra ‘isa. ami valalama satya katha, ye visaye tara sandeha kare.

19:35.latin_iast: santāna grahaṇa karā āllāhara janya samīcīna naẏa, tini pavitra mahimāmaẏa. tini yakhana kichu sthira karena takhana valena, ‘hao’ āra tā haẏe yāẏa.
19:35.latin_ascii: santana grahana kara allahara janya samicina naya, tini pavitra mahimamaya. tini yakhana kichu sthira karena takhana valena, ‘hao’ ara ta haye yaya.

19:36.latin_iast: āllāhai āmāra pratipālaka o tomādera pratipālaka; sutarāṃ tomarā tā~ra ivādata kara, eṭāi sarala patha.
19:36.latin_ascii: allahai amara pratipalaka o tomadera pratipalaka; sutaram tomara ta~ra ivadata kara, etai sarala patha.

19:37.latin_iast: ataḥpara dalagulo nijedera madhye matānaikya sṛṣṭi karala, sutarāṃ durbheāga kāphiradera janya mahādivasa upasthita kāle.
19:37.latin_ascii: atahpara dalagulo nijedera madhye matanaikya srsti karala, sutaram durbheaga kaphiradera janya mahadivasa upasthita kale.

19:38.latin_iast: tārā yedina āmāra nikaṭa āsave sedina tārā kata spaṣṭa śunave o dekhave! kintu jālimarā āja spaṣṭa vibhrāntite āche.
19:38.latin_ascii: tara yedina amara nikata asave sedina tara kata spasta sunave o dekhave! kintu jalimara aja spasta vibhrantite ache.

19:39.latin_iast: tāderake satarka kare dāo paritāpera divasa samvandhe, yakhana sakala siddhānta haẏe yāve. ekhana tārā gāphila evaṃ tārā viśvāsa kare nā.
19:39.latin_ascii: taderake satarka kare dao paritapera divasa samvandhe, yakhana sakala siddhanta haye yave. ekhana tara gaphila evam tara visvasa kare na.

19:40.latin_iast: niścaẏai pṛthivīra o tāra opare yārā āche tādera cūr̤ānta mālikānā āmārai raive evaṃ tādera āmārai nikaṭa pratyāvartana.
19:40.latin_ascii: niscayai prthivira o tara opare yara ache tadera curanta malikana amarai raive evam tadera amarai nikata pratyavartana.

19:41.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, e kitāve ullekhita ivrāhīmera kathā; se chila satyaniṣṭha ekajana nāvī.
19:41.latin_ascii: smarana kara, e kitave ullekhita ivrahimera katha; se chila satyanistha ekajana navi.

19:42.latin_iast: yakhana se tāra pitāke valechila: he āmāra pitā! āpani kena emana vastura ivādata karena yā śone nā, dekhe nā āra āpanāra kona kāje āse nā.
19:42.latin_ascii: yakhana se tara pitake valechila: he amara pita! apani kena emana vastura ivadata karena ya sone na, dekhe na ara apanara kona kaje ase na.

19:43.latin_iast: yakhana se tāra pitāke valala: ‘he āmāra pitā! āmāra nikaṭa eseche jñāna yā āpanāra nikaṭa āseni; sutarāṃ āmāra anusaraṇa karuna, āmi āpanāke saṭhika patha dekhāva.
19:43.latin_ascii: yakhana se tara pitake valala: ‘he amara pita! amara nikata eseche jnana ya apanara nikata aseni; sutaram amara anusarana karuna, ami apanake sathika patha dekhava.

19:44.latin_iast: he āmāra pitā, śaẏatānera ivādata karavena nā, niścaẏai śaẏatāna daẏālu āllāhara avādhya.
19:44.latin_ascii: he amara pita, sayatanera ivadata karavena na, niscayai sayatana dayalu allahara avadhya.

19:45.latin_iast: he āmāra pitā! āmi āśaṃkā kari ye, āpanāke daẏāmaẏera śāsti sparśa karave, takhana āpani haẏe par̤avena śaẏatānera vandhu.’
19:45.latin_ascii: he amara pita! ami asamka kari ye, apanake dayamayera sasti sparsa karave, takhana apani haye paravena sayatanera vandhu.’

19:46.latin_iast: pitā valala: ‘he ivrāhīma! tumi ki āmāra deva-devī hate vimukha? yadi tumi nivṛtta nā hao tave āmi prastarāghāte tomāra prāṇa nāśa karavai; tumi ciradinera janya āmāra nikaṭa hate dūra haẏe yāo.’
19:46.latin_ascii: pita valala: ‘he ivrahima! tumi ki amara deva-devi hate vimukhay yadi tumi nivrtta na hao tave ami prastaraghate tomara prana nasa karavai; tumi ciradinera janya amara nikata hate dura haye yao.’

19:47.latin_iast: ivrāhīma valala: ‘āpanāra prati sālāma. āmi āmāra pratipālakera nikaṭa āpanāra janya kṣamā prārthanā karava, niścaẏa tini āmāra prati atiśaẏa anugrahaśīla.
19:47.latin_ascii: ivrahima valala: ‘apanara prati salama. ami amara pratipalakera nikata apanara janya ksama prarthana karava, niscaya tini amara prati atisaya anugrahasila.

19:48.latin_iast: āmi āpanādera hate o āpanārā āllāha vyatīta yādera ivādata karena tādera hate pṛthaka hacchi; āmi āmāra pratipālakake āhvāna kari; āśā kari, āmāra pratipālakake āhvāna kare āmi vyarthakāma hava nā.’
19:48.latin_ascii: ami apanadera hate o apanara allaha vyatita yadera ivadata karena tadera hate prthaka hacchi; ami amara pratipalakake ahvana kari; asa kari, amara pratipalakake ahvana kare ami vyarthakama hava na.’

19:49.latin_iast: ataḥpara se yakhana tādera hate o tārā āllāha vyatīta yādera ivādata karata se sakala hate pṛthaka haẏe gela takhana āmi tāke dāna karalāma ishāka o iẏā‘kūva evaṃ pratyekake nāvī karalāma.
19:49.latin_ascii: atahpara se yakhana tadera hate o tara allaha vyatita yadera ivadata karata se sakala hate prthaka haye gela takhana ami take dana karalama ishaka o iya‘kuva evam pratyekake navi karalama.

19:50.latin_iast: evaṃ tāderake āmi dāna karalāma āmāra anugraha o tādera nāma-yaśa samucca karalāma.
19:50.latin_ascii: evam taderake ami dana karalama amara anugraha o tadera nama-yasa samucca karalama.

19:51.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara e kitāve mūsāra kathā, se chila viśeṣa manonīta evaṃ se chila rāsūla, nāvī.
19:51.latin_ascii: smarana kara e kitave musara katha, se chila visesa manonita evam se chila rasula, navi.

19:52.latin_iast: tāke āmi āhvāna karechilāma tūra parvatera dakṣiṇa dika hate evaṃ āmi gopana ālāpe tāke naikaṭya dāna karechilāma.
19:52.latin_ascii: take ami ahvana karechilama tura parvatera daksina dika hate evam ami gopana alape take naikatya dana karechilama.

19:53.latin_iast: āmi nija anugrahe tāke dilāma tāra bhrātā hārūnake nāvīrūpe.
19:53.latin_ascii: ami nija anugrahe take dilama tara bhrata harunake navirupe.

19:54.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara e kitāve isamāīlera kathā, se chila pratiśruti pālane satyāśraẏī evaṃ se chila rāsūla, nāvī;
19:54.latin_ascii: smarana kara e kitave isamailera katha, se chila pratisruti palane satyasrayi evam se chila rasula, navi;

19:55.latin_iast: se tāra parivāra-parijanavargake sālāta o yākātera nirdeśa dita evaṃ se chila tāra pratipālakera santeāṣabhājana.
19:55.latin_ascii: se tara parivara-parijanavargake salata o yakatera nirdesa dita evam se chila tara pratipalakera santeasabhajana.

19:56.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara e kitāve idarīsera kathā, se chila satyaniṣṭha, nāvī;
19:56.latin_ascii: smarana kara e kitave idarisera katha, se chila satyanistha, navi;

19:57.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tāke unnīta karechilāma ucca maryādāẏa.
19:57.latin_ascii: evam ami take unnita karechilama ucca maryadaya.

19:58.latin_iast: erāi tārā, nāvīdera madhye yāderake āllāha anugraha karechena, ādamera vaṃśa hate o yāderake āmi nūhera sāthe naukāẏa ārohaṇa kariẏechilāma evaṃ ivrāhīma o isamāīlera vaṃśodbhuta o yāderake āmi pathanirdeśa karechilāma o manonīta karechilāma; tādera nikaṭa daẏāmaẏera āẏāta telāoẏāta karā hale tārā sijdāẏa luṭiẏe par̤ata krandana karate karate.
19:58.latin_ascii: erai tara, navidera madhye yaderake allaha anugraha karechena, adamera vamsa hate o yaderake ami nuhera sathe naukaya arohana kariyechilama evam ivrahima o isamailera vamsodbhuta o yaderake ami pathanirdesa karechilama o manonita karechilama; tadera nikata dayamayera ayata telaoyata kara hale tara sijdaya lutiye parata krandana karate karate.

19:59.latin_iast: tādera pare āsala apadārtha paravartīgaṇa, tārā sālāta naṣṭa karala o lālasāparavaśa hala. sutarāṃ tārā acirei kukarmera śāsti pratyakṣa karave,
19:59.latin_ascii: tadera pare asala apadartha paravartigana, tara salata nasta karala o lalasaparavasa hala. sutaram tara acirei kukarmera sasti pratyaksa karave,

19:60.latin_iast: kintu tārā naẏa yārā tāovā kareche, īmāna eneche o sat karma kareche. tārā jānnāte praveśa karave. tādera prati kona juluma karā have nā.
19:60.latin_ascii: kintu tara naya yara taova kareche, imana eneche o sat karma kareche. tara jannate pravesa karave. tadera prati kona juluma kara have na.

19:61.latin_iast: eṭā sthāẏī jānnāta, ye adṛśya viṣaẏera pratiśruti daẏāmaẏa tā~ra vāndāderake diẏechena. tā~ra pratiśra“ta viṣaẏa avaśyambhāvī.
19:61.latin_ascii: eta sthayi jannata, ye adrsya visayera pratisruti dayamaya ta~ra vandaderake diyechena. ta~ra pratisra“ta visaya avasyambhavi.

19:62.latin_iast: sethāẏa tārā ‘śāntira sambhāṣaṇa vyatīta’ kona asāra vākya śunave nā evaṃ sethāẏa sakāla-sandhyā tādera janya thākave jīvanopakaraṇa.
19:62.latin_ascii: sethaya tara ‘santira sambhasana vyatita’ kona asara vakya sunave na evam sethaya sakala-sandhya tadera janya thakave jivanopakarana.

19:63.latin_iast: e sei jānnāta, yāra adhikārī vānāvo āmāra vāndādera madhye muttākīderake.
19:63.latin_ascii: e sei jannata, yara adhikari vanavo amara vandadera madhye muttakiderake.

19:64.latin_iast: āmarā āpanāra pratipālakera ādeśa vyatīta avataraṇa karava nā; yā āmādera sammukhe o paścāte āche o yā e du’-era antarvartī āche tā tā~rai evaṃ āpanāra pratipālaka bhule yāna nā.’
19:64.latin_ascii: amara apanara pratipalakera adesa vyatita avatarana karava na; ya amadera sammukhe o pascate ache o ya e du’-era antarvarti ache ta ta~rai evam apanara pratipalaka bhule yana na.’

19:65.latin_iast: tini ākāśamaṇḍalī, pṛthivī o tādera antarvartī yā kichu tāra pratipālaka. sutarāṃ tā~rai ivādata kara evaṃ tā~ra ivādate dhairyaśīla thāka. tumi ki tā~ra samaguṇasampanna kāuke jāna?
19:65.latin_ascii: tini akasamandali, prthivi o tadera antarvarti ya kichu tara pratipalaka. sutaram ta~rai ivadata kara evam ta~ra ivadate dhairyasila thaka. tumi ki ta~ra samagunasampanna kauke janay

19:66.latin_iast: mānuṣa vale: ‘āmāra mṛtyu hale āmi ki jīvita avasthāẏa utthita hava?’
19:66.latin_ascii: manusa vale: ‘amara mrtyu hale ami ki jivita avasthaya utthita havay’

19:67.latin_iast: mānuṣa ki smaraṇa kare nā ye, āmi tāke pūrve sṛṣṭi karechi yakhana se kichui chila nā?
19:67.latin_ascii: manusa ki smarana kare na ye, ami take purve srsti karechi yakhana se kichui chila nay

19:68.latin_iast: sutarāṃ śapatha tomāra pratipālakera! āmi tāderake evaṃ śaẏatānaderakesaha ekatre samaveta karavai o pare āmi tāderake natajānu avasthāẏa jāhānnāmera caturdike upasthita karavai.
19:68.latin_ascii: sutaram sapatha tomara pratipalakera! ami taderake evam sayatanaderakesaha ekatre samaveta karavai o pare ami taderake natajanu avasthaya jahannamera caturdike upasthita karavai.

19:69.latin_iast: ataḥpara pratyeka dalera madhye ye daẏāmaẏera prati sarvādhika avādhya āmi tāke ṭene vera karavai.
19:69.latin_ascii: atahpara pratyeka dalera madhye ye dayamayera prati sarvadhika avadhya ami take tene vera karavai.

19:70.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tādera madhye yārā jāhānnāme praveśera adhikatara yogya tādera viṣaẏa bhāla jāni.
19:70.latin_ascii: evam ami tadera madhye yara jahanname pravesera adhikatara yogya tadera visaya bhala jani.

19:71.latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera pratyekei tā (pulasirāta) atikrama karave; eṭā tomāra pratipālakera anivārya siddhānta.
19:71.latin_ascii: evam tomadera pratyekei ta (pulasirata) atikrama karave; eta tomara pratipalakera anivarya siddhanta.

19:72.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi muttākīderake rakṣā karava evaṃ jālimaderake sethāẏa natajānu avasthāẏa rekhe deva.
19:72.latin_ascii: atahpara ami muttakiderake raksa karava evam jalimaderake sethaya natajanu avasthaya rekhe deva.

19:73.latin_iast: yakhana tādera nikaṭa āmāra spaṣṭa āẏāta telāoẏāta karā haẏa kāphirarā mu’minaderake vale, ‘du’ dalera madhye konṭi maryādāẏa śreṣṭhatara o mājalisa hiseve uttama?’
19:73.latin_ascii: yakhana tadera nikata amara spasta ayata telaoyata kara haya kaphirara mu’minaderake vale, ‘du’ dalera madhye konti maryadaya sresthatara o majalisa hiseve uttamay’

19:74.latin_iast: tādera pūrve āmi kata mānavagoṣṭhīke vināśa karechi yārā tādera apekṣā sampada o vāhyadṛṣṭite śreṣṭha chila.
19:74.latin_ascii: tadera purve ami kata manavagosthike vinasa karechi yara tadera apeksa sampada o vahyadrstite srestha chila.

19:75.latin_iast: vala: ‘yārā vibhrāntite āche, daẏāmaẏa tāderake pracura ḍhila devena yatakṣaṇa nā, ye viṣaẏe tāderake satarka karā hacche tā pratyakṣa karave, seṭā śāsti hoka athavā kiẏāmatai hoka. ataḥpara tārā jānate pārave, ke maryādāẏa nikṛṣṭa o ke dalavale durvala.
19:75.latin_ascii: vala: ‘yara vibhrantite ache, dayamaya taderake pracura dhila devena yataksana na, ye visaye taderake satarka kara hacche ta pratyaksa karave, seta sasti hoka athava kiyamatai hoka. atahpara tara janate parave, ke maryadaya nikrsta o ke dalavale durvala.

19:76.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā sat pathe cale āllāha tāderake adhika hidāẏāta dāna karena; evaṃ sthāẏī sat karma tomāra pratipālakera puraskāra prāptira janya śreṣṭha evaṃ pratidāna hiseveo śreṣṭha.
19:76.latin_ascii: evam yara sat pathe cale allaha taderake adhika hidayata dana karena; evam sthayi sat karma tomara pratipalakera puraskara praptira janya srestha evam pratidana hiseveo srestha.

19:77.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya karecha se vyaktike, ye āmāra āẏātasamūha pratyākhyāna kareche evaṃ se vale, ‘āmāke dhana-sampada o santāna-santati deẏā havei.’
19:77.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya karecha se vyaktike, ye amara ayatasamuha pratyakhyana kareche evam se vale, ‘amake dhana-sampada o santana-santati deya havei.’

19:78.latin_iast: se ki adṛśya samvandhe avahita haẏeche athavā daẏāmaẏera nikaṭa hate pratiśruti lābha kareche?
19:78.latin_ascii: se ki adrsya samvandhe avahita hayeche athava dayamayera nikata hate pratisruti labha karechey

19:79.latin_iast: kakhanai naẏa, tārā yā vale āmi tā likhe rākhava evaṃ tādera śāsti vṛddhi karate thākava.
19:79.latin_ascii: kakhanai naya, tara ya vale ami ta likhe rakhava evam tadera sasti vrddhi karate thakava.

19:80.latin_iast: se ye viṣaẏera kathā vale tā thākave āmāra adhikāre evaṃ se āmāra nikaṭa āsave ekā.
19:80.latin_ascii: se ye visayera katha vale ta thakave amara adhikare evam se amara nikata asave eka.

19:81.latin_iast: tārā āllāha vyatīta anya aneka ilāh grahaṇa kareche ejanya yāte tārā tādera sahāẏa haẏa;
19:81.latin_ascii: tara allaha vyatita anya aneka ilah grahana kareche ejanya yate tara tadera sahaya haya;

19:82.latin_iast: kakhanai naẏa; tārā acirei tādera ivādata asvīkāra karave evaṃ tādera virodhī haẏe yāve.
19:82.latin_ascii: kakhanai naya; tara acirei tadera ivadata asvikara karave evam tadera virodhi haye yave.

19:83.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya karani ye, āmi kāphiradera janya śaẏatānaderake cher̤e rekhechi tāderake manda karme viśeṣabhāve praluvdha karāra janya?
19:83.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya karani ye, ami kaphiradera janya sayatanaderake chere rekhechi taderake manda karme visesabhave praluvdha karara janyay

19:84.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tādera viṣaẏe tumi tār̤ātār̤i kara nā. āmi gaṇanā karachi tādera nirdhārita kāla,
19:84.latin_ascii: sutaram tadera visaye tumi taratari kara na. ami ganana karachi tadera nirdharita kala,

19:85.latin_iast: yedina daẏāmaẏera nikaṭa muttākīderake sammānita mehamānarūpe samaveta karava,
19:85.latin_ascii: yedina dayamayera nikata muttakiderake sammanita mehamanarupe samaveta karava,

19:86.latin_iast: evaṃ aparādhīderake tṛṣṇātura avasthāẏa jāhānnāmera dike hā~kiẏe niẏe yāva.
19:86.latin_ascii: evam aparadhiderake trsnatura avasthaya jahannamera dike ha~kiye niye yava.

19:87.latin_iast: ye daẏāmaẏera nikaṭa pratiśruti grahaṇa kareche, se vyatīta anya kārao supāriśa karāra kṣamatā thākave nā.
19:87.latin_ascii: ye dayamayera nikata pratisruti grahana kareche, se vyatita anya karao suparisa karara ksamata thakave na.

19:89.latin_iast: tomarā emana eka vībhatsa viṣaẏera avatāraṇā karecha;
19:89.latin_ascii: tomara emana eka vibhatsa visayera avatarana karecha;

19:90.latin_iast: yāte ākāśamaṇḍalī vidīrṇa have, pṛthivī khaṇḍa-vikhaṇḍa have o parvatagulo cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haẏe patita have,
19:90.latin_ascii: yate akasamandali vidirna have, prthivi khanda-vikhanda have o parvatagulo curna-vicurna haye patita have,

19:91.latin_iast: yehetu tārā daẏāmaẏera prati santāna āropa kare.
19:91.latin_ascii: yehetu tara dayamayera prati santana aropa kare.

19:92.latin_iast: athaca santāna grahaṇa karā daẏāmaẏera janya śobhanīẏa naẏa!
19:92.latin_ascii: athaca santana grahana kara dayamayera janya sobhaniya naya!

19:93.latin_iast: ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte emana keu nei, ye daẏāmaẏera nikaṭa vāndārūpe upasthita have nā.
19:93.latin_ascii: akasamandali o prthivite emana keu nei, ye dayamayera nikata vandarupe upasthita have na.

19:94.latin_iast: tini tāderake pariveṣṭana kare rekhechena evaṃ tini tāderake viśeṣabhāve gaṇanā karechena,
19:94.latin_ascii: tini taderake parivestana kare rekhechena evam tini taderake visesabhave ganana karechena,

19:95.latin_iast: evaṃ kiẏāmatera divase tādera sakalei tā~ra nikaṭa āsave ekākī avasthāẏa.
19:95.latin_ascii: evam kiyamatera divase tadera sakalei ta~ra nikata asave ekaki avasthaya.

19:96.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare daẏāmaẏa avaśyai tādera prati (pārasparika) bhālavāsā dāna karavena.
19:96.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o sat karma kare dayamaya avasyai tadera prati (parasparika) bhalavasa dana karavena.

19:97.latin_iast: āmi to tomāra bhāṣāẏa kuraānake sahaja kare diẏechi yāte tumi tā dvārā muttākīderake susaṃvāda dite pāra evaṃ vitaṇḍāpravaṇa sampradāẏake tā dvārā satarka karate pāra.
19:97.latin_ascii: ami to tomara bhasaya kuraanake sahaja kare diyechi yate tumi ta dvara muttakiderake susamvada dite para evam vitandapravana sampradayake ta dvara satarka karate para.

19:98.latin_iast: tādera pūrve āmi kata mānavagoṣṭhīke vināśa karechi. tumi ki tādera kāuke dekhate pāo athavā kṣīṇatama śavda śunate pāo?
19:98.latin_ascii: tadera purve ami kata manavagosthike vinasa karechi. tumi ki tadera kauke dekhate pao athava ksinatama savda sunate paoy

20:2.latin_iast: tumi kaṣṭa pāo ejanya āmi tomāra prati kuraāna avatīrṇa karini,
20:2.latin_ascii: tumi kasta pao ejanya ami tomara prati kuraana avatirna karini,

20:3.latin_iast: varaṃ ye bhaẏa kare kevala tāra upadeśa lābhera janya,
20:3.latin_ascii: varam ye bhaya kare kevala tara upadesa labhera janya,

20:4.latin_iast: yini pṛthivī o su-ucca ākāśamaṇḍalī sṛṣṭi karechena tā~ra nikaṭa hate eṭā avatīrṇa,
20:4.latin_ascii: yini prthivi o su-ucca akasamandali srsti karechena ta~ra nikata hate eta avatirna,

20:6.latin_iast: yā āche ākāśamaṇḍalīte, pṛthivīte, e du’ẏera madhyavartī sthāne o bhū-garbhe tā tā~rai.
20:6.latin_ascii: ya ache akasamandalite, prthivite, e du’yera madhyavarti sthane o bhu-garbhe ta ta~rai.

20:7.latin_iast: yadi tumi uccakaṇṭhe kathā vala, tave (jene rekha) tini yā gupta o avyakta savai jānena.
20:7.latin_ascii: yadi tumi uccakanthe katha vala, tave (jene rekha) tini ya gupta o avyakta savai janena.

20:8.latin_iast: āllāha, tini vyatīta anya kona satya mā‘vūda nei, sundara nāma samūha tā~rai.
20:8.latin_ascii: allaha, tini vyatita anya kona satya ma‘vuda nei, sundara nama samuha ta~rai.

20:9.latin_iast: mūsāra vṛttānta tomāra nikaṭa pau~cheche ki?
20:9.latin_ascii: musara vrttanta tomara nikata pau~cheche kiy

20:10.latin_iast: se yakhana āguna dekhala takhana tāra parivāravargake valala: ‘tomarā ekhāne thāka āmi āguna dekhechi. sambhavata āmi tomādera janya tā hate kichu jvalanta aṅgāra ānate pārava athavā āmi āgunera nikaṭe kona pathanirdeśa pāva.’
20:10.latin_ascii: se yakhana aguna dekhala takhana tara parivaravargake valala: ‘tomara ekhane thaka ami aguna dekhechi. sambhavata ami tomadera janya ta hate kichu jvalanta angara anate parava athava ami agunera nikate kona pathanirdesa pava.’

20:11.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana se āgunera nikaṭa āsala takhana āhvāna kare valā hala: he mūsā!
20:11.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana se agunera nikata asala takhana ahvana kare vala hala: he musa!

20:12.latin_iast: āmii tomāra pratipālaka, ataeva tomāra pādukā khule phela, kāraṇa tumi pavitra ‘tuoẏā’ upatyakāẏa raẏeche.
20:12.latin_ascii: amii tomara pratipalaka, ataeva tomara paduka khule phela, karana tumi pavitra ‘tuoya’ upatyakaya rayeche.

20:13.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tomāke manonīta karechi. ataeva yā oẏāhī preraṇa karā hacche tumi tā manoyogera sāthe śravaṇa kara.
20:13.latin_ascii: evam ami tomake manonita karechi. ataeva ya oyahi prerana kara hacche tumi ta manoyogera sathe sravana kara.

20:14.latin_iast: āmii āllāha, āmi vyatīta satya kona mā‘vūda nei. ataeva āmāra ivādata kara evaṃ āmāra smaraṇārthe sālāta kāẏema kara.
20:14.latin_ascii: amii allaha, ami vyatita satya kona ma‘vuda nei. ataeva amara ivadata kara evam amara smaranarthe salata kayema kara.

20:15.latin_iast: kiẏāmata avaśyambhāvī, āmi eṭā gopana rākhate cāi yāte pratyekei nija karmānuyāẏī phala lābha karate pāre.
20:15.latin_ascii: kiyamata avasyambhavi, ami eta gopana rakhate cai yate pratyekei nija karmanuyayi phala labha karate pare.

20:16.latin_iast: sutarāṃ ye vyakti kiẏāmate viśvāsa kare nā o nija pravṛttira anusaraṇa kare, se yena tomāke tāte viśvāsa sthāpane vādhā nā deẏa.
20:16.latin_ascii: sutaram ye vyakti kiyamate visvasa kare na o nija pravrttira anusarana kare, se yena tomake tate visvasa sthapane vadha na deya.

20:17.latin_iast: he mūsā! tomāra dakṣiṇa haste eṭā kī?’
20:17.latin_ascii: he musa! tomara daksina haste eta kiy’

20:18.latin_iast: se valala: ‘eṭā āmāra lāṭhi; āmi ete bhara dei evaṃ eṭā dvārā āghāta kare āmi āmāra meṣapālera janya gāchera pātā phele thāki evaṃ eṭā āmāra anyānya kājeo lāge.’
20:18.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘eta amara lathi; ami ete bhara dei evam eta dvara aghata kare ami amara mesapalera janya gachera pata phele thaki evam eta amara anyanya kajeo lage.’

20:19.latin_iast: āllāha valalena: ‘he mūsā! tumi eṭā nikṣepa kara.’
20:19.latin_ascii: allaha valalena: ‘he musa! tumi eta niksepa kara.’

20:20.latin_iast: ataḥpara se tā nikṣepa karala, saṅge saṅge tā sāpa haẏe chuṭate lāgala,
20:20.latin_ascii: atahpara se ta niksepa karala, sange sange ta sapa haye chutate lagala,

20:21.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘tumi tāke dhara, bhaẏa kara nā, āmi tāke tāra pūrvarūpe phiriẏe deva.
20:21.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘tumi take dhara, bhaya kara na, ami take tara purvarupe phiriye deva.

20:22.latin_iast: evaṃ tomāra hāta tomāra vagale rākha, tā vera haẏe āsave nirmala ujjvala haẏe apara eka nidarśanarūpe.
20:22.latin_ascii: evam tomara hata tomara vagale rakha, ta vera haye asave nirmala ujjvala haye apara eka nidarsanarupe.

20:23.latin_iast: yāte āmi tomāke āmāra var̤a var̤a kichu nidarśana dekhāte pāri.
20:23.latin_ascii: yate ami tomake amara vara vara kichu nidarsana dekhate pari.

20:24.latin_iast: phira‘āunera nikaṭa yāo, se to sīmālaṅghana kareche.’
20:24.latin_ascii: phira‘aunera nikata yao, se to simalanghana kareche.’

20:25.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāra vakṣa praśasta kare dāo.
20:25.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! amara vaksa prasasta kare dao.

20:26.latin_iast: evaṃ āmāra karma sahaja kare dāo.
20:26.latin_ascii: evam amara karma sahaja kare dao.

20:27.latin_iast: āmāra jihvāra jar̤atā dūra kare dāo
20:27.latin_ascii: amara jihvara jarata dura kare dao

20:28.latin_iast: yāte tārā āmāra kathā vujhate pāre.
20:28.latin_ascii: yate tara amara katha vujhate pare.

20:29.latin_iast: ‘āmāra janya kare dāo ekajana sāhāyyakārī āmāra svajanavargera madhya hate;
20:29.latin_ascii: ‘amara janya kare dao ekajana sahayyakari amara svajanavargera madhya hate;

20:31.latin_iast: tāra dvārā āmāra śakti sudṛr̤ha kara,
20:31.latin_ascii: tara dvara amara sakti sudrrha kara,

20:32.latin_iast: evaṃ tāke āmāra karme aṃśīdāra kara,
20:32.latin_ascii: evam take amara karme amsidara kara,

20:33.latin_iast: yāte āmarā tomāra adhika pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karate pāri.
20:33.latin_ascii: yate amara tomara adhika pavitrata o mahima ghosana karate pari.

20:34.latin_iast: evaṃ tomāke adhika smaraṇa karate pāri.
20:34.latin_ascii: evam tomake adhika smarana karate pari.

20:36.latin_iast: tini valalena: he mūsā! tumi yā ceẏecha tā tomāke deẏā hala.
20:36.latin_ascii: tini valalena: he musa! tumi ya ceyecha ta tomake deya hala.

20:37.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tomāra prati ārao ekavāra anugraha karechilāma;
20:37.latin_ascii: evam ami tomara prati arao ekavara anugraha karechilama;

20:38.latin_iast: yakhana āmi tomāra mātāke jāniẏechilāma yā chila jānānora,
20:38.latin_ascii: yakhana ami tomara matake janiyechilama ya chila jananora,

20:39.latin_iast: (tā ei) ye, tumi tāke sindukera madhye rākha, ataḥpara sinduka dariẏāẏa bhāsiẏe dāo yāte dariẏā tāke tīre ṭhele deẏa, tāke āmāra śatra“ o tāra śatra“ niẏe yāve. āmi āmāra pakṣa theke tomāra opara bhālavāsā ḍhele diẏechilāma, yāte tumi āmāra cokhera sāmane (tattvāvadhāne) pratipālita hao.
20:39.latin_ascii: (ta ei) ye, tumi take sindukera madhye rakha, atahpara sinduka dariyaya bhasiye dao yate dariya take tire thele deya, take amara satra“ o tara satra“ niye yave. ami amara paksa theke tomara opara bhalavasa dhele diyechilama, yate tumi amara cokhera samane (tattvavadhane) pratipalita hao.

20:40.latin_iast: yakhana tomāra bhagnī ese valala: ‘āmi ki tomāderake vale deva ke ei śiśura pratipālanera bhāra neve? takhana āmi tomāke tomāra māẏera nikaṭa phiriẏe dilāma yāte tāra cakṣu jur̤āẏa evaṃ se duḥkha nā pāẏa; evaṃ tumi eka vyaktike hatyā karechile; ataḥpara āmi tomāke manaḥpīr̤ā hate mukti dei, āmi tomāke vahu parīkṣā karechi. ataḥpara tumi kaẏeka vatsara mādaiẏānavāsīdera madhye chile, he mūsā! erapare tumi nirdhārita samaẏe upasthita hale.
20:40.latin_ascii: yakhana tomara bhagni ese valala: ‘ami ki tomaderake vale deva ke ei sisura pratipalanera bhara nevey takhana ami tomake tomara mayera nikata phiriye dilama yate tara caksu juraya evam se duhkha na paya; evam tumi eka vyaktike hatya karechile; atahpara ami tomake manahpira hate mukti dei, ami tomake vahu pariksa karechi. atahpara tumi kayeka vatsara madaiyanavasidera madhye chile, he musa! erapare tumi nirdharita samaye upasthita hale.

20:41.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tomāke āmāra nijera janya prastuta kare niẏechi.
20:41.latin_ascii: evam ami tomake amara nijera janya prastuta kare niyechi.

20:42.latin_iast: tumi o tomāra bhrātā āmāra nidarśanasaha yātrā kara evaṃ āmāke smaraṇera vyāpāre śaithilya kara nā,
20:42.latin_ascii: tumi o tomara bhrata amara nidarsanasaha yatra kara evam amake smaranera vyapare saithilya kara na,

20:43.latin_iast: tomarā ubhaẏe phira‘āunera nikaṭa yāo, se sīmālaṃghana kareche.
20:43.latin_ascii: tomara ubhaye phira‘aunera nikata yao, se simalamghana kareche.

20:44.latin_iast: tomarā tāra sāthe namra kathā valave, haẏato se upadeśa grahaṇa karave athavā bhaẏa karave.
20:44.latin_ascii: tomara tara sathe namra katha valave, hayato se upadesa grahana karave athava bhaya karave.

20:45.latin_iast: tārā valala: he āmādera pratipālaka! āmarā āśaṃkā kari, se āmādera upara vār̤āvār̤i karave athavā anyāẏa ācaraṇe sīmālaṅghana karave.
20:45.latin_ascii: tara valala: he amadera pratipalaka! amara asamka kari, se amadera upara varavari karave athava anyaya acarane simalanghana karave.

20:46.latin_iast: tini valalena: ‘tomarā bhaẏa kara nā, āmi tomādera saṅge āchi, āmi śuni o āmi dekhi.’
20:46.latin_ascii: tini valalena: ‘tomara bhaya kara na, ami tomadera sange achi, ami suni o ami dekhi.’

20:47.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tomarā tāra nikaṭa yāo evaṃ vala: ‘āmarā tomāra pratipālakera rāsūla, sutarāṃ āmādera sāthe vānī isrāīlake yete dāo evaṃ tāderake kaṣṭa dio nā, āmarā tomāra nikaṭa enechi tomāra pratipālakera pakṣa theke nidarśana evaṃ śānti tādera prati yārā anusaraṇa kare sat patha.
20:47.latin_ascii: sutaram tomara tara nikata yao evam vala: ‘amara tomara pratipalakera rasula, sutaram amadera sathe vani israilake yete dao evam taderake kasta dio na, amara tomara nikata enechi tomara pratipalakera paksa theke nidarsana evam santi tadera prati yara anusarana kare sat patha.

20:48.latin_iast: āmādera prati oẏāhī preraṇa karā haẏeche ye, śāsti tāra janya, ye mithyā āropa kare o mukha phiriẏe neẏa.’
20:48.latin_ascii: amadera prati oyahi prerana kara hayeche ye, sasti tara janya, ye mithya aropa kare o mukha phiriye neya.’

20:49.latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala: ‘he mūsā! ke tomādera pratipālaka?’
20:49.latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala: ‘he musa! ke tomadera pratipalakay’

20:50.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘āmādera pratipālaka tini, yini pratyeka vastuke tāra ākṛti dāna karechena, ataḥpara pathanirdeśa karechena.’
20:50.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘amadera pratipalaka tini, yini pratyeka vastuke tara akrti dana karechena, atahpara pathanirdesa karechena.’

20:51.latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala: ‘tāhale atīta yugera lokadera avasthā kī?’
20:51.latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala: ‘tahale atita yugera lokadera avastha kiy’

20:52.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘tāra jñāna āmāra pratipālakera nikaṭa kitāve raẏeche, āmāra pratipālaka bhula karena nā evaṃ bhuleo yāna nā.’
20:52.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘tara jnana amara pratipalakera nikata kitave rayeche, amara pratipalaka bhula karena na evam bhuleo yana na.’

20:53.latin_iast: ‘yini tomādera janya pṛthivīke karechena vichānā evaṃ tāte kare diẏechena tomādera calāra patha, tini ākāśa hate vāri varṣaṇa karena.’ evaṃ āmi tā dvārā vibhinna prakārera udbhida utpanna kari.
20:53.latin_ascii: ‘yini tomadera janya prthivike karechena vichana evam tate kare diyechena tomadera calara patha, tini akasa hate vari varsana karena.’ evam ami ta dvara vibhinna prakarera udbhida utpanna kari.

20:54.latin_iast: tomarā āhāra kara o tomādera gavādi paśu carāo; avaśyai ete nidarśana āche vivekasampannadera janya.
20:54.latin_ascii: tomara ahara kara o tomadera gavadi pasu carao; avasyai ete nidarsana ache vivekasampannadera janya.

20:55.latin_iast: āmi mṛttikā hate tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechi, tātei tomāderake phiriẏe neva evaṃ tā hate punarāẏa tomāderake vera karava.
20:55.latin_ascii: ami mrttika hate tomaderake srsti karechi, tatei tomaderake phiriye neva evam ta hate punaraya tomaderake vera karava.

20:56.latin_iast: āmi tāke āmāra samasta nidarśana dekhiẏechilāma; kintu se mithyā āropa kareche o amānya kareche.
20:56.latin_ascii: ami take amara samasta nidarsana dekhiyechilama; kintu se mithya aropa kareche o amanya kareche.

20:57.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he mūsā! tumi ki āmādera nikaṭa tomāra jādu niẏe esecho tā dvārā āmāderake āmādera deśa hate vahiṣkāra karāra janya?
20:57.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he musa! tumi ki amadera nikata tomara jadu niye esecho ta dvara amaderake amadera desa hate vahiskara karara janyay

20:58.latin_iast: ‘āmarāo avaśyai tomāra nikaṭa upasthita karava tāra anurūpa jādu, sutarāṃ āmādera o tomāra milita haoẏāra janya ekaṭi madhyavartī sthāne nirdiṣṭa samaẏa nirdhāraṇa kara, yāra vyatikrama āmarāo karava nā evaṃ tumio karave nā.’
20:58.latin_ascii: ‘amarao avasyai tomara nikata upasthita karava tara anurupa jadu, sutaram amadera o tomara milita haoyara janya ekati madhyavarti sthane nirdista samaya nirdharana kara, yara vyatikrama amarao karava na evam tumio karave na.’

20:59.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘tomādera nirdhārita samaẏa utsavera dina evaṃ sedina pūrvāhe“ janagaṇake samaveta karā have.’
20:59.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘tomadera nirdharita samaya utsavera dina evam sedina purvahe“ janaganake samaveta kara have.’

20:60.latin_iast: ataḥpara phira‘āuna uṭhe gela evaṃ pare tāra kauśalasamūha ekatra karala, ataḥpara āsala.
20:60.latin_ascii: atahpara phira‘auna uthe gela evam pare tara kausalasamuha ekatra karala, atahpara asala.

20:61.latin_iast: mūsā tāderake valala: ‘durbheāga tomādera! tomarā āllāhara prati mithyā āropa kara nā. karale, tini tāderake śāsti dvārā samūle dhvaṃsa karavena. ye mithyā udbhāvana kareche se vyartha haẏeche.’
20:61.latin_ascii: musa taderake valala: ‘durbheaga tomadera! tomara allahara prati mithya aropa kara na. karale, tini taderake sasti dvara samule dhvamsa karavena. ye mithya udbhavana kareche se vyartha hayeche.’

20:62.latin_iast: tārā nijedera madhye nijedera karma samvandhe vitarka karala evaṃ tārā gopane parāmarśa karala.
20:62.latin_ascii: tara nijedera madhye nijedera karma samvandhe vitarka karala evam tara gopane paramarsa karala.

20:63.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘e du’jana avaśyai jādukara, tārā cāẏa tādera jādu dvārā tomāderake tomādera deśa hate vahiṣkāra karate evaṃ tomādera utkṛṣṭa jīvana-vyavasthā dhvaṃsa karate.
20:63.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘e du’jana avasyai jadukara, tara caya tadera jadu dvara tomaderake tomadera desa hate vahiskara karate evam tomadera utkrsta jivana-vyavastha dhvamsa karate.

20:64.latin_iast: ‘ataeva tomarā tomādera jādukriẏā saṃhata kara, ataḥpara sārivaddha haẏe upasthita hao evaṃ ye āja jaẏī have se saphala have.’
20:64.latin_ascii: ‘ataeva tomara tomadera jadukriya samhata kara, atahpara sarivaddha haye upasthita hao evam ye aja jayi have se saphala have.’

20:65.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he mūsā! haẏa tumi nikṣepa kara athavā prathame āmarāi nikṣepa kari.’
20:65.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he musa! haya tumi niksepa kara athava prathame amarai niksepa kari.’

20:66.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘varaṃ tomarāi nikṣepa kara.’ tādera jādu-prabhāve mūsāra mane hala tādera dar̤i o lāṭhigulo chuṭāchuṭi karache.
20:66.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘varam tomarai niksepa kara.’ tadera jadu-prabhave musara mane hala tadera dari o lathigulo chutachuti karache.

20:67.latin_iast: mūsā tāra antare kichu bhīti anubhava karala.
20:67.latin_ascii: musa tara antare kichu bhiti anubhava karala.

20:68.latin_iast: āmi valalāma, ‘bhaẏa kara nā, tumii vijaẏī.
20:68.latin_ascii: ami valalama, ‘bhaya kara na, tumii vijayi.

20:69.latin_iast: ‘tomāra ḍāna hāte yā āche tā nikṣepa kara, tārā yā karache eṭā tā grāsa kare phelave. tārā yā kareche tā kevala jādukarera kauśala. jādukara yekhānei āsuka, saphala have nā.’
20:69.latin_ascii: ‘tomara dana hate ya ache ta niksepa kara, tara ya karache eta ta grasa kare phelave. tara ya kareche ta kevala jadukarera kausala. jadukara yekhanei asuka, saphala have na.’

20:70.latin_iast: ataḥpara jādukarerā sijadāvanata hala o valala: ‘āmarā hārūna o mūsāra pratipālakera prati īmāna ānalāma.’
20:70.latin_ascii: atahpara jadukarera sijadavanata hala o valala: ‘amara haruna o musara pratipalakera prati imana analama.’

20:71.latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala: ‘kī? āmi tomāderake anumati deẏāra pūrvei tomarā mūsāra prati īmāna ānale? dekhachi, se to tomādera pradhāna, se tomāderake jādu śikṣā diẏeche. sutarāṃ āmi to tomādera hastapada viparīta dika hate kartana karavai evaṃ āmi tomāderake khejura vṛkṣera kāṇḍe śūlaviddha karavai evaṃ tomarā avaśyai jānate pārave āmādera madhye kāra śāsti kaṭhoratara o adhika sthāẏī.’
20:71.latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala: ‘kiy ami tomaderake anumati deyara purvei tomara musara prati imana analey dekhachi, se to tomadera pradhana, se tomaderake jadu siksa diyeche. sutaram ami to tomadera hastapada viparita dika hate kartana karavai evam ami tomaderake khejura vrksera kande sulaviddha karavai evam tomara avasyai janate parave amadera madhye kara sasti kathoratara o adhika sthayi.’

20:72.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āmādera nikaṭa ye spaṣṭa nidarśana eseche tāra opara evaṃ yini āmāderake sṛṣṭi karechena tā~ra opara tomāke āmarā kichutei prādhānya deva nā. sutarāṃ tumi kara yā tumi karate cāo. tumi kevala e pārthiva jīvanera opara kartṛtva karate pāra.’
20:72.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘amadera nikata ye spasta nidarsana eseche tara opara evam yini amaderake srsti karechena ta~ra opara tomake amara kichutei pradhanya deva na. sutaram tumi kara ya tumi karate cao. tumi kevala e parthiva jivanera opara kartrtva karate para.’

20:73.latin_iast: ‘āmarā niścaẏai āmādera pratipālakera prati īmāna enechi yāte tini kṣamā karena āmādera aparādha evaṃ tumi āmāderake ye jādu karate vādhya karecha tā. āra āllāha śreṣṭha o sthāẏī.’
20:73.latin_ascii: ‘amara niscayai amadera pratipalakera prati imana enechi yate tini ksama karena amadera aparadha evam tumi amaderake ye jadu karate vadhya karecha ta. ara allaha srestha o sthayi.’

20:74.latin_iast: ye tāra pratipālakera nikaṭa aparādhī haẏe upasthita have tāra janya āche jāhānnāma, sethāẏa se maraveo nā, vā~caveo nā.
20:74.latin_ascii: ye tara pratipalakera nikata aparadhi haye upasthita have tara janya ache jahannama, sethaya se maraveo na, va~caveo na.

20:75.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā tā~ra nikaṭa upasthita have mu’mina avasthāẏa sat karma kare, tādera janya āche su-ucca maryādā
20:75.latin_ascii: evam yara ta~ra nikata upasthita have mu’mina avasthaya sat karma kare, tadera janya ache su-ucca maryada

20:76.latin_iast: sthāẏī jānnāta, yāra pādadeśe nadīsamūha pravāhita, sethāẏa tārā cirakāla thākāve evaṃ e puraskāra tāderai, yārā (apavitratā o śirka theke) pavitra.

20:127.latin_iast: evaṃ ebhāvei āmi pratiphala dei tāke, ye vār̤āvār̤i kare o tāra pratipālakera nidarśane viśvāsa sthāpana kare nā. ākhirātera śāsti avaśyai kaṭhinatara o adhika sthāẏī.
20:127.latin_ascii: evam ebhavei ami pratiphala dei take, ye varavari kare o tara pratipalakera nidarsane visvasa sthapana kare na. akhiratera sasti avasyai kathinatara o adhika sthayi.

20:128.latin_iast: eṭāo ki tāderake sat patha dekhāla nā ye, āmi edera pūrve dhvaṃsa karechi kata mānavagoṣṭhī yādera vāsabhūmite erā vicaraṇa kare thāke? avaśyai ete vivekasampannadera janya āche nidarśana.
20:128.latin_ascii: etao ki taderake sat patha dekhala na ye, ami edera purve dhvamsa karechi kata manavagosthi yadera vasabhumite era vicarana kare thakey avasyai ete vivekasampannadera janya ache nidarsana.

20:129.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālakera pūrva siddhānta nā thākale tādera opara śāsti avaśyai ese par̤ata, kintu era janya āche ekaṭi nirdiṣṭa samaẏa.
20:129.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalakera purva siddhanta na thakale tadera opara sasti avasyai ese parata, kintu era janya ache ekati nirdista samaya.

20:130.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tārā yā vale, se viṣaẏe tumi dhairya dhāraṇa kara evaṃ sūryeādaẏera pūrve o sūryāstera pūrve tomāra pratipālakera sapraśaṃsa pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara evaṃ rātrikāle pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara, evaṃ divasera prāntasamūheo yāte tumi santuṣṭa hate pāra.
20:130.latin_ascii: sutaram tara ya vale, se visaye tumi dhairya dharana kara evam suryeadayera purve o suryastera purve tomara pratipalakera saprasamsa pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara evam ratrikale pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara, evam divasera prantasamuheo yate tumi santusta hate para.

20:131.latin_iast: tumi tomāra cakṣudvaẏa kakhanao prasārita kara nā tāra prati, yā āmi tādera vibhinna śreṇīke pārthiva jīvanera saundaryasvarūpa upabhogera upakaraṇa hiseve diẏechi, tāra dvārā tāderake parīkṣā karāra janya. tomāra pratipālaka pradatta jīvanopakaraṇa utkṛṣṭa o adhika sthāẏī.
20:131.latin_ascii: tumi tomara caksudvaya kakhanao prasarita kara na tara prati, ya ami tadera vibhinna srenike parthiva jivanera saundaryasvarupa upabhogera upakarana hiseve diyechi, tara dvara taderake pariksa karara janya. tomara pratipalaka pradatta jivanopakarana utkrsta o adhika sthayi.

20:132.latin_iast: evaṃ tomāra parivāravargake sālātera ādeśa dāo o tāte avicala thāka, āmi tomāra nikaṭa kona jīvanopakaraṇa cāi nā; āmii tomāke jīvanopakaraṇa dei evaṃ śubha pariṇāma to muttākīdera janya.
20:132.latin_ascii: evam tomara parivaravargake salatera adesa dao o tate avicala thaka, ami tomara nikata kona jivanopakarana cai na; amii tomake jivanopakarana dei evam subha parinama to muttakidera janya.

20:133.latin_iast: tārā vale, ‘se tāra pratipālakera pakṣa theke āmādera nikaṭa kona nidarśana ānaẏana kare nā kena?’ tādera nikaṭa ki āseni suspaṣṭa pramāṇa yā āche pūrvavartī granthasamūhe?
20:133.latin_ascii: tara vale, ‘se tara pratipalakera paksa theke amadera nikata kona nidarsana anayana kare na kenay’ tadera nikata ki aseni suspasta pramana ya ache purvavarti granthasamuhey

20:134.latin_iast: yadi āmi tāderake tāra pūrve śāsti dvārā dhvaṃsa karatāma tave tārā valata, ‘he āmādera pratipālaka! tumi āmādera nikaṭa ekajana rāsūla preraṇa karale nā kena? karale āmarā lāñchita o apamānita havāra pūrve tomāra nidarśana mene calatāma.’
20:134.latin_ascii: yadi ami taderake tara purve sasti dvara dhvamsa karatama tave tara valata, ‘he amadera pratipalaka! tumi amadera nikata ekajana rasula prerana karale na kenay karale amara lanchita o apamanita havara purve tomara nidarsana mene calatama.’

20:135.latin_iast: vala: ‘pratyekei pratīkṣā karache, sutarāṃ tomarāo pratīkṣā kara. acirei tomarā jānate pārave kārā raẏeche sarala pathe evaṃ kārā sat patha prāpta.’
20:135.latin_ascii: vala: ‘pratyekei pratiksa karache, sutaram tomarao pratiksa kara. acirei tomara janate parave kara rayeche sarala pathe evam kara sat patha prapta.’

21:1.latin_iast: mānuṣera hisāva-nikāśera samaẏa āsanna, kintu tārā udāsīnatāẏa mukha phiriẏe raẏeche.
21:1.latin_ascii: manusera hisava-nikasera samaya asanna, kintu tara udasinataya mukha phiriye rayeche.

21:2.latin_iast: yakhanai tādera nikaṭa tādera pratipālakera kona natuna upadeśa āse tārā tā śravaṇa kare kautukacchale,
21:2.latin_ascii: yakhanai tadera nikata tadera pratipalakera kona natuna upadesa ase tara ta sravana kare kautukacchale,

21:3.latin_iast: tādera antara thāke amanoyogī. yārā jālima tārā gopane parāmarśa kare ‘e to tomādera mata ekajana mānuṣai, tavuo ki tomarā dekhe śune jādura kavale par̤ave?’
21:3.latin_ascii: tadera antara thake amanoyogi. yara jalima tara gopane paramarsa kare ‘e to tomadera mata ekajana manusai, tavuo ki tomara dekhe sune jadura kavale paravey’

21:4.latin_iast: se valala: ‘ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra samasta kathāi āmāra pratipālaka avagata āchena evaṃ tinii sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.’
21:4.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘akasamandali o prthivira samasta kathai amara pratipalaka avagata achena evam tinii sarvasrota, sarvajna.’

21:5.latin_iast: tārā eṭāo vale, ‘e samasta alīka kalpanā, haẏa se seṭā udbhāvana kareche; nā haẏa se ekajana kavi. ataeva se niẏe āsuka āmādera nikaṭa eka nidarśana yerūpa nidarśanasaha prerita haẏechila pūrvavartīgaṇa.’
21:5.latin_ascii: tara etao vale, ‘e samasta alika kalpana, haya se seta udbhavana kareche; na haya se ekajana kavi. ataeva se niye asuka amadera nikata eka nidarsana yerupa nidarsanasaha prerita hayechila purvavartigana.’

21:6.latin_iast: edera pūrve yesava janapada āmi dhvaṃsa karechi tāra adhivāsīrā īmāna āneni; tave ki erā īmāna ānave?
21:6.latin_ascii: edera purve yesava janapada ami dhvamsa karechi tara adhivasira imana aneni; tave ki era imana anavey

21:7.latin_iast: tomāra pūrve rāsūla hiseve āmi puruṣa mānuṣai pāṭhiẏechilāma yādera kāche oẏāhī pāṭhātāma. tomarā yadi nā jāna, tāhale jñānīdera jijñesa kara.
21:7.latin_ascii: tomara purve rasula hiseve ami purusa manusai pathiyechilama yadera kache oyahi pathatama. tomara yadi na jana, tahale jnanidera jijnesa kara.

21:8.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tāderake emana dehaviśiṣṭa karini ye, tārā khādya grahaṇa karata nā; tārā cirasthāẏīo chila nā.
21:8.latin_ascii: evam ami taderake emana dehavisista karini ye, tara khadya grahana karata na; tara cirasthayio chila na.

21:9.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tādera prati āmāra pratiśruti satye pariṇata karalāma, phale tāderake o yāderake icchā rakṣā karechilāma evaṃ sīmā laṅghanakārīderake dhvaṃsa karechilāma.
21:9.latin_ascii: atahpara ami tadera prati amara pratisruti satye parinata karalama, phale taderake o yaderake iccha raksa karechilama evam sima langhanakariderake dhvamsa karechilama.

21:10.latin_iast: āmi tomādera prati avatīrṇa karechi kitāva yāte āche tomādera janya upadeśa, tavuo ki tomarā vujhave nā?
21:10.latin_ascii: ami tomadera prati avatirna karechi kitava yate ache tomadera janya upadesa, tavuo ki tomara vujhave nay

21:11.latin_iast: āmi dhvaṃsa karechi kata janapada, yāra adhivāsīrā chila jālima evaṃ tādera pare sṛṣṭi karechi apara jāti.
21:11.latin_ascii: ami dhvamsa karechi kata janapada, yara adhivasira chila jalima evam tadera pare srsti karechi apara jati.

21:12.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tārā āmāra śāsti pratyakṣa karala takhanai tārā janapada hate palāẏana karate lāgala.
21:12.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tara amara sasti pratyaksa karala takhanai tara janapada hate palayana karate lagala.

21:13.latin_iast: ‘palāẏana kara nā evaṃ phire eso tomādera bhoga-sambhārera nikaṭa o tomādera āvāsagṛhe, haẏata e viṣaẏe tomāderake jijñesa karā have.’
21:13.latin_ascii: ‘palayana kara na evam phire eso tomadera bhoga-sambharera nikata o tomadera avasagrhe, hayata e visaye tomaderake jijnesa kara have.’

21:14.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘hāẏa, durbheāga āmādera! āmarā to chilāma jālima.’
21:14.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘haya, durbheaga amadera! amara to chilama jalima.’

21:15.latin_iast: tādera e ārtanāda calate thāke āmi tāderake kartita śasya o nirvāpita agni sadṛśa nā karā paryanta.
21:15.latin_ascii: tadera e artanada calate thake ami taderake kartita sasya o nirvapita agni sadrsa na kara paryanta.

21:16.latin_iast: ākāśa o pṛthivī evaṃ tādera ubhaẏera mājhe yā kichu āche tā āmi krīr̤ācchale sṛṣṭi karini.
21:16.latin_ascii: akasa o prthivi evam tadera ubhayera majhe ya kichu ache ta ami kriracchale srsti karini.

21:17.latin_iast: āmi yadi krīr̤āra upakaraṇa hiseve grahaṇa karate cāitāma tave āmāra nikaṭa yā āche tā niẏei seṭā karatāma; tā karini.
21:17.latin_ascii: ami yadi krirara upakarana hiseve grahana karate caitama tave amara nikata ya ache ta niyei seta karatama; ta karini.

21:18.latin_iast: kintu āmi satya dvārā āghāta hāni mithyāra opara; phale tā mithyāke cūrṇa-vicūrṇa kare deẏa evaṃ tatkṣaṇāt mithyā niściha“ haẏe yāẏa. durbheāga tomādera! tomarā yā valacha tāra janya.
21:18.latin_ascii: kintu ami satya dvara aghata hani mithyara opara; phale ta mithyake curna-vicurna kare deya evam tatksanat mithya nisciha“ haye yaya. durbheaga tomadera! tomara ya valacha tara janya.

21:19.latin_iast: ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte yārā āche tārā tā~rai; tā~ra sānnidhye yārā āche tārā ahaṅkāravaśe tā~ra ivādata karā hate vimukha haẏa nā evaṃ klāntio vodha kare nā.
21:19.latin_ascii: akasamandali o prthivite yara ache tara ta~rai; ta~ra sannidhye yara ache tara ahankaravase ta~ra ivadata kara hate vimukha haya na evam klantio vodha kare na.

21:20.latin_iast: tārā rāta-dina tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare, tārā śaithilya kare nā.
21:20.latin_ascii: tara rata-dina ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare, tara saithilya kare na.

21:21.latin_iast: tārā māṭi hate tairi yesava devatā grahaṇa kareche segulo ki mṛtake jīvita karate sakṣama?
21:21.latin_ascii: tara mati hate tairi yesava devata grahana kareche segulo ki mrtake jivita karate saksamay

21:22.latin_iast: yadi āllāha vyatīta ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte vahu māvū‘da thākata, tave ubhaẏai dhvaṃsa haẏe yeta. ataeva tārā yā vale tā hate ‘āraśera adhipati āllāha pavitra, mahāna.
21:22.latin_ascii: yadi allaha vyatita akasamandali o prthivite vahu mavu‘da thakata, tave ubhayai dhvamsa haye yeta. ataeva tara ya vale ta hate ‘arasera adhipati allaha pavitra, mahana.

21:23.latin_iast: tini yā karena se viṣaẏe tā~ke praśna karā yāve nā; varaṃ tāderakei praśna karā have.
21:23.latin_ascii: tini ya karena se visaye ta~ke prasna kara yave na; varam taderakei prasna kara have.

21:24.latin_iast: tārā ki tā~ke vyatīta vahu ilāh grahaṇa kareche? vala: ‘tomarā tomādera pramāṇa upasthita kara. eṭāi āmāra saṅge yārā āche tādera janya upadeśa evaṃ eṭāi upadeśa chila āmāra pūrvavartīdera janya.’ varaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai prakṛta satya jāne nā, phale tārā mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
21:24.latin_ascii: tara ki ta~ke vyatita vahu ilah grahana karechey vala: ‘tomara tomadera pramana upasthita kara. etai amara sange yara ache tadera janya upadesa evam etai upadesa chila amara purvavartidera janya.’ varam tadera adhikamsai prakrta satya jane na, phale tara mukha phiriye neya.

21:25.latin_iast: āmi tomāra pūrve yakhana kona rāsūla preraṇa karechi tāra prati e oẏāhī karechi, ‘āmi vyatīta anya kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei; sutarāṃ āmārai ‘ivādata kara.’
21:25.latin_ascii: ami tomara purve yakhana kona rasula prerana karechi tara prati e oyahi karechi, ‘ami vyatita anya kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei; sutaram amarai ‘ivadata kara.’

21:26.latin_iast: tārā vale, ‘daẏāmaẏa āllāha santāna grahaṇa karechena.’ tini pavitra, mahāna! varaṃ tārā to tā~ra sammānita vāndā.
21:26.latin_ascii: tara vale, ‘dayamaya allaha santana grahana karechena.’ tini pavitra, mahana! varam tara to ta~ra sammanita vanda.

21:27.latin_iast: tārā āge ver̤e kathā vale nā; tārā to tā~ra ādeśa anusārei kāja kare thāke.
21:27.latin_ascii: tara age vere katha vale na; tara to ta~ra adesa anusarei kaja kare thake.

21:28.latin_iast: tādera sammukhe o paścāte yā kichu āche tā tini avagata. tārā supāriśa kare śudhumātra tādera janya yādera prati tini santuṣṭa evaṃ tārā tā~ra bhaẏe bhīta-santrasta.
21:28.latin_ascii: tadera sammukhe o pascate ya kichu ache ta tini avagata. tara suparisa kare sudhumatra tadera janya yadera prati tini santusta evam tara ta~ra bhaye bhita-santrasta.

21:29.latin_iast: tādera madhye ye valave, ‘āmii ilāh tini vyatīta’, tāke āmi pratiphala diva jāhānnāma; ebhāvei āmi jālimaderake śāsti diẏe thāki.
21:29.latin_ascii: tadera madhye ye valave, ‘amii ilah tini vyatita’, take ami pratiphala diva jahannama; ebhavei ami jalimaderake sasti diye thaki.

21:30.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kare tārā ki bheve dekhe nā ye, ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī ekatre miśe chila otaprotabhāve, ataḥpara āmi ubhaẏake pṛthaka kare dilāma; evaṃ samasta prāṇī sṛṣṭi karalāma pāni hate; tavuo ki tārā īmāna ānave nā?
21:30.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kare tara ki bheve dekhe na ye, akasamandali o prthivi ekatre mise chila otaprotabhave, atahpara ami ubhayake prthaka kare dilama; evam samasta prani srsti karalama pani hate; tavuo ki tara imana anave nay

21:31.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi pṛthivīte sṛṣṭi karechi sudṛr̤ha parvata, yāte pṛthivī tāderake niẏe edika-odika ḍhale nā yāẏa evaṃ āmi tāte kare diẏechi praśasta patha, yāte tārā gantavyasthale pau~chate pāre.
