21:31.latin_ascii: evam ami prthivite srsti karechi sudrrha parvata, yate prthivi taderake niye edika-odika dhale na yaya evam ami tate kare diyechi prasasta patha, yate tara gantavyasthale pau~chate pare.

21:32.latin_iast: evaṃ ākāśake karechi surakṣita chāda; kintu tārā ākāśasthita nidarśanāvalī hate mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
21:32.latin_ascii: evam akasake karechi suraksita chada; kintu tara akasasthita nidarsanavali hate mukha phiriye neya.

21:33.latin_iast: āllāhai sṛṣṭi karechena rāta o dina evaṃ sūrya o candra; pratyekei nija nija kakṣapathe vicaraṇa kare.
21:33.latin_ascii: allahai srsti karechena rata o dina evam surya o candra; pratyekei nija nija kaksapathe vicarana kare.

21:34.latin_iast: āmi tomāra pūrveo kona mānuṣake ananta jīvana dāna karini; sutarāṃ tomāra mṛtyu hale tārā ki cirajīvī haẏe thākave?
21:34.latin_ascii: ami tomara purveo kona manusake ananta jivana dana karini; sutaram tomara mrtyu hale tara ki cirajivi haye thakavey

21:35.latin_iast: jīvamātrai mṛtyura svāda grahaṇa karave; āmi tomāderake manda o bhāla dvārā viśeṣabhāve parīkṣā kare thāki evaṃ āmārai nikaṭa tomāderake phiriẏe ānā have.
21:35.latin_ascii: jivamatrai mrtyura svada grahana karave; ami tomaderake manda o bhala dvara visesabhave pariksa kare thaki evam amarai nikata tomaderake phiriye ana have.

21:36.latin_iast: kāphirarā yakhana tomāke dekhe takhana tārā tomāke kevala vidraƒpera pātrarūpei grahaṇa kare. tārā vale, ‘e-i ki se, ye tomādera deva-devīgulora samālocanā kare?’ athaca tārāi to ‘rāhmāna’-era ullekhera virodhitā kare.
21:36.latin_ascii: kaphirara yakhana tomake dekhe takhana tara tomake kevala vidraƒpera patrarupei grahana kare. tara vale, ‘e-i ki se, ye tomadera deva-devigulora samalocana karey’ athaca tarai to ‘rahmana’-era ullekhera virodhita kare.

21:37.latin_iast: mānuṣa sṛṣṭigatabhāve tvarāpravaṇa, śīghrai āmi tomāderake āmāra nidarśanāvalī dekhāva; sutarāṃ tomarā āmāke tār̤ātār̤i karate vala nā.
21:37.latin_ascii: manusa srstigatabhave tvarapravana, sighrai ami tomaderake amara nidarsanavali dekhava; sutaram tomara amake taratari karate vala na.

21:38.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā vale: ‘tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave vala, e pratiśruti kakhana vāstave pariṇata have?’
21:38.latin_ascii: evam tara vale: ‘tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave vala, e pratisruti kakhana vastave parinata havey’

21:39.latin_iast: yadi kāphirarā se samaẏera kathā jānata yakhana tārā tādera sammukha o paścāt hate agni pratirodha karate pārave nā evaṃ tāderake sāhāyya karāo have nā!
21:39.latin_ascii: yadi kaphirara se samayera katha janata yakhana tara tadera sammukha o pascat hate agni pratirodha karate parave na evam taderake sahayya karao have na!

21:40.latin_iast: vastuta seṭā tādera opara āsave atarkitabhāve evaṃ tāderake hatabhamva kare dive. phale tārā tā rodha karate pārave nā evaṃ tāderake avakāśao deẏā have nā.
21:40.latin_ascii: vastuta seta tadera opara asave atarkitabhave evam taderake hatabhamva kare dive. phale tara ta rodha karate parave na evam taderake avakasao deya have na.

21:41.latin_iast: tomāra pūrveo aneka rāsūlakei ṭhāṭṭā-vidraƒpa karā haẏechila; pariṇāme tārā yā niẏe ṭhāṭṭā-vidraƒpa karata tā vidraƒpakārīderake pariveṣṭana karechila.
21:41.latin_ascii: tomara purveo aneka rasulakei thatta-vidraƒpa kara hayechila; pariname tara ya niye thatta-vidraƒpa karata ta vidraƒpakariderake parivestana karechila.

21:42.latin_iast: vala: ‘rahamāna (era āyāva) hate ke tomāderake rakṣā karave rātrite o divase?’ tavuo tārā tādera pratipālakera smaraṇa hate mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
21:42.latin_ascii: vala: ‘rahamana (era ayava) hate ke tomaderake raksa karave ratrite o divasey’ tavuo tara tadera pratipalakera smarana hate mukha phiriye neya.

21:43.latin_iast: tave ki āmi vyatīta tādera emana ilāha āche yārā tāderake rakṣā karate pāre? erā to nijederakei sāhāyya karate pāre nā evaṃ āmāra viruddhe tādera kona sāthīo pāve nā.
21:43.latin_ascii: tave ki ami vyatita tadera emana ilaha ache yara taderake raksa karate parey era to nijederakei sahayya karate pare na evam amara viruddhe tadera kona sathio pave na.

21:44.latin_iast: vastuta āmii tāderake evaṃ tādera pitṛ-puruṣaderake bhoga-sambhāra diẏechilāma; adhikantu tādera āẏuṣkālao haẏechila dīrgha. tārā ki dekhache nā ye, āmi tādera deśake caturdika hate saṃkucita kare ānachi. tavuo ki tārā vijaẏī have?
21:44.latin_ascii: vastuta amii taderake evam tadera pitr-purusaderake bhoga-sambhara diyechilama; adhikantu tadera ayuskalao hayechila dirgha. tara ki dekhache na ye, ami tadera desake caturdika hate samkucita kare anachi. tavuo ki tara vijayi havey

21:45.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmi kevala oẏāhī dvārāi tomāderake satarka kari’, kintu yārā vadhira tāderake yakhana satarka karā haẏa takhana tārā satarkavāṇī śune nā.
21:45.latin_ascii: vala: ‘ami kevala oyahi dvarai tomaderake satarka kari’, kintu yara vadhira taderake yakhana satarka kara haya takhana tara satarkavani sune na.

21:46.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālakera śāstira kichumātrao tāderake sparśa karale tārā niścaẏa vale uṭhave, ‘hāẏa, durbheāga āmādera, āmarā to chilāma jālima!’
21:46.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalakera sastira kichumatrao taderake sparsa karale tara niscaya vale uthave, ‘haya, durbheaga amadera, amara to chilama jalima!’

21:47.latin_iast: evaṃ kviẏāmāta divase āmi sthāpana karava nyāẏavicārera mānadaṇḍa. sutarāṃ kāro prati kona avicāra karā have nā evaṃ karma yadi sariṣāra dānā parimāṇa ojanerao haẏa tavuo seṭā āmi upasthita karava; hiseva grahaṇakārīrūpe āmii yatheṣṭa.
21:47.latin_ascii: evam kviyamata divase ami sthapana karava nyayavicarera manadanda. sutaram karo prati kona avicara kara have na evam karma yadi sarisara dana parimana ojanerao haya tavuo seta ami upasthita karava; hiseva grahanakarirupe amii yathesta.

21:48.latin_iast: āmi mūsā o hārūnake diẏechilāma ‘phurakāna’, jyoti o upadeśa muttākīdera janya
21:48.latin_ascii: ami musa o harunake diyechilama ‘phurakana’, jyoti o upadesa muttakidera janya

21:49.latin_iast: yārā nā dekheo tādera pratipālakake bhaẏa kare evaṃ tārā kviẏāmāta samparke bhīta-santrasta.
21:49.latin_ascii: yara na dekheo tadera pratipalakake bhaya kare evam tara kviyamata samparke bhita-santrasta.

21:50.latin_iast: eṭā kalyāṇamaẏa upadeśa; āmi eṭā avatīrṇa karechi. tavuo ki tomarā eṭāke asvīkāra karave?
21:50.latin_ascii: eta kalyanamaya upadesa; ami eta avatirna karechi. tavuo ki tomara etake asvikara karavey

21:51.latin_iast: āmi to era pūrve ivrāhīmake sat pathera jñāna diẏechilāma evaṃ āmi tāra samvandhe chilāma samyaka parijñāta.
21:51.latin_ascii: ami to era purve ivrahimake sat pathera jnana diyechilama evam ami tara samvandhe chilama samyaka parijnata.

21:52.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, yakhana se tāra pitā o tāra sampradāẏake valala: ‘e mūrtigulo kī, yādera pūjāẏa tomarā rata raẏecha!’
21:52.latin_ascii: smarana kara, yakhana se tara pita o tara sampradayake valala: ‘e murtigulo ki, yadera pujaya tomara rata rayecha!’

21:53.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āmarā āmādera pitṛpuruṣake edera pūjā karate dekhechi.’
21:53.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘amara amadera pitrpurusake edera puja karate dekhechi.’

21:54.latin_iast: se valala: ‘tomarā nijerā evaṃ tomādera pitṛpuruṣarāo raẏeche spaṣṭa vibhrāntite.’
21:54.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘tomara nijera evam tomadera pitrpurusarao rayeche spasta vibhrantite.’

21:55.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘tumi ki āmādera nikaṭa satya enecha, nā tumi kautuka karacha?’
21:55.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘tumi ki amadera nikata satya enecha, na tumi kautuka karachay’

21:56.latin_iast: se valala: ‘varaṃ tomādera pratipālaka ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra pratipālaka, yini tādera sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ e viṣaẏe āmi anyatama sākṣī.’
21:56.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘varam tomadera pratipalaka akasamandali o prthivira pratipalaka, yini tadera srsti karechena evam e visaye ami anyatama saksi.’

21:57.latin_iast: ‘śapatha āllāhara! tomarā cale gele āmi tomādera mūrtigulo samvandhe avaśyai kauśala avalamvana karava.’
21:57.latin_ascii: ‘sapatha allahara! tomara cale gele ami tomadera murtigulo samvandhe avasyai kausala avalamvana karava.’

21:58.latin_iast: ataḥpara se cūrṇa-vicūrṇa kare dila mūrtiguloke, tādera pradhānaṭi vyatīta; yāte tārā tāra dike phire āse.
21:58.latin_ascii: atahpara se curna-vicurna kare dila murtiguloke, tadera pradhanati vyatita; yate tara tara dike phire ase.

21:59.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āmādera upāsyagulora sāthe erūpa karala ke? se niścaẏai sīmālaṅghanakārī.’
21:59.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘amadera upasyagulora sathe erupa karala key se niscayai simalanghanakari.’

21:60.latin_iast: keu keu valala: ‘eka yuvakake tādera samālocanā karate śunechi; tāke valā haẏa ivrāhīma.’
21:60.latin_ascii: keu keu valala: ‘eka yuvakake tadera samalocana karate sunechi; take vala haya ivrahima.’

21:61.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘tāke upasthita kara lokasammukhe, yāte tārā sākṣī dite pāre.’
21:61.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘take upasthita kara lokasammukhe, yate tara saksi dite pare.’

21:62.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘he ivrāhīma! tumii ki āmādera upāsyagulora sāthe erūpa karecha?’
21:62.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘he ivrahima! tumii ki amadera upasyagulora sathe erupa karechay’

21:63.latin_iast: se valala: ‘varaṃ edera pradhāna, se-i to eṭā kareche, ederake jijñesa kara yadi erā kathā valate pāre.’
21:63.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘varam edera pradhana, se-i to eta kareche, ederake jijnesa kara yadi era katha valate pare.’

21:64.latin_iast: takhana tārā mane mane cintā karala evaṃ eke aparake valate lāgala, ‘tomarāi to sīmālaṅghanakārī?’
21:64.latin_ascii: takhana tara mane mane cinta karala evam eke aparake valate lagala, ‘tomarai to simalanghanakariy’

21:65.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera mastaka avanata haẏe gela evaṃ tārā valala: ‘tumi to jānai ye, erā kathā valate pāre nā.’
21:65.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera mastaka avanata haye gela evam tara valala: ‘tumi to janai ye, era katha valate pare na.’

21:66.latin_iast: ivrāhīma valala: ‘tave ki tomarā āllāhara parivarte emana kichura ‘ivādata kara yā tomādera kona upakāra karate pāre nā, kṣatio karate pāre nā?
21:66.latin_ascii: ivrahima valala: ‘tave ki tomara allahara parivarte emana kichura ‘ivadata kara ya tomadera kona upakara karate pare na, ksatio karate pare nay

21:67.latin_iast: ‘dhik tomādera evaṃ āllāhara parivarte tomarā yādera ‘ivādata kara tādera janya! tavuo ki tomarā vujhave nā?’
21:67.latin_ascii: ‘dhik tomadera evam allahara parivarte tomara yadera ‘ivadata kara tadera janya! tavuo ki tomara vujhave nay’

21:68.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘tāke pur̤iẏe māra āra sāhāyya kara tomādera devatāguloke, tomarā yadi kichu karate cāo.’
21:68.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘take puriye mara ara sahayya kara tomadera devataguloke, tomara yadi kichu karate cao.’

21:69.latin_iast: āmi valalāma, ‘he agni! tumi ivrāhīmera janya śītala o nirāpada haẏe yāo.’
21:69.latin_ascii: ami valalama, ‘he agni! tumi ivrahimera janya sitala o nirapada haye yao.’

21:70.latin_iast: tārā tāra viruddhe cakrānta karate cāila. kintu āmi tāderake kare dilāma sarvādhika kṣatigrasta.
21:70.latin_ascii: tara tara viruddhe cakranta karate caila. kintu ami taderake kare dilama sarvadhika ksatigrasta.

21:71.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tāke o lūtake uddhāra kare niẏe gelāma se deśe, yethāẏa āmi kalyāṇa rekhechi viśvavāsīra janya.
21:71.latin_ascii: evam ami take o lutake uddhara kare niye gelama se dese, yethaya ami kalyana rekhechi visvavasira janya.

21:72.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi ivrāhīmake dāna karechilāma ishāka evaṃ atirikta (pautrarūpe) iẏā‘kūva; āra pratyekakei karechilāma sat karmaparāẏaṇa;
21:72.latin_ascii: evam ami ivrahimake dana karechilama ishaka evam atirikta (pautrarupe) iya‘kuva; ara pratyekakei karechilama sat karmaparayana;

21:73.latin_iast: evaṃ tāderake karechilāma netā; tārā āmāra nirdeśa anusāre mānuṣake patha pradarśana karata; tāderake oẏāhī preraṇa karechilāma sat karma karate, sālāta kāẏema karate evaṃ yākāta pradāna karate; tārā ekamātra āmārai ‘ivādata karata.
21:73.latin_ascii: evam taderake karechilama neta; tara amara nirdesa anusare manusake patha pradarsana karata; taderake oyahi prerana karechilama sat karma karate, salata kayema karate evam yakata pradana karate; tara ekamatra amarai ‘ivadata karata.

21:74.latin_iast: evaṃ lūtake diẏechilāma prajñā o jñāna evaṃ tāke uddhāra karechilāma emana eka janapada hate yāra adhivāsīrā lipta chila aślīla karme; tārā chila eka manda sampradāẏa, phāseka.
21:74.latin_ascii: evam lutake diyechilama prajna o jnana evam take uddhara karechilama emana eka janapada hate yara adhivasira lipta chila aslila karme; tara chila eka manda sampradaya, phaseka.

21:75.latin_iast: evaṃ tāke āmi āmāra anugrahabhājana karechilāma; se chila sat karmaparāẏaṇadera antarbhukta.
21:75.latin_ascii: evam take ami amara anugrahabhajana karechilama; se chila sat karmaparayanadera antarbhukta.

21:76.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara nūhke; pūrve se yakhana āhvāna karechila takhana āmi tāra āhvāne sār̤ā diẏechilāma evaṃ tāke o tāra parijanavargake mahāsaṃkaṭa hate uddhāra karechilāma,
21:76.latin_ascii: smarana kara nuhke; purve se yakhana ahvana karechila takhana ami tara ahvane sara diyechilama evam take o tara parijanavargake mahasamkata hate uddhara karechilama,

21:77.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi tāke sāhāyya karechilāma se sampradāẏera viruddhe yārā āmāra nidarśanāvalī asvīkāra karechila; niścaẏa tārā chila eka manda sampradāẏa. ejanya tādera sakalakei āmi nimajjita karechilāma.
21:77.latin_ascii: evam ami take sahayya karechilama se sampradayera viruddhe yara amara nidarsanavali asvikara karechila; niscaya tara chila eka manda sampradaya. ejanya tadera sakalakei ami nimajjita karechilama.

21:78.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa kara dāūda o sulāimānera kathā, yakhana tārā vicāra karachila śasyakṣetra samparke; tāte rātrikāle praveśa karechila kona sampradāẏera meṣa; āmi pratyakṣa karachilāma tādera vicāra.
21:78.latin_ascii: evam smarana kara dauda o sulaimanera katha, yakhana tara vicara karachila sasyaksetra samparke; tate ratrikale pravesa karechila kona sampradayera mesa; ami pratyaksa karachilama tadera vicara.

21:79.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi sulāimānake e viṣaẏera mīmāṃsā vujhiẏe diẏechilāma o tādera pratyekake āmi diẏechilāma prajñāsaha jñāna. āmi parvata o vihaṅgakulake adhīna kare diẏechilāma tārā dāūdera saṅge āmāra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karata; āmii chilāma e savakichura kartā.
21:79.latin_ascii: evam ami sulaimanake e visayera mimamsa vujhiye diyechilama o tadera pratyekake ami diyechilama prajnasaha jnana. ami parvata o vihangakulake adhina kare diyechilama tara daudera sange amara pavitrata o mahima ghosana karata; amii chilama e savakichura karta.

21:80.latin_iast: āra āmi tāke tomādera janya varma nirmāṇa śikṣā diẏechilāma, yāte tā tomādera yuddhe tomāderake rakṣā kare; sutarāṃ tomarā ki kṛtajña have nā?
21:80.latin_ascii: ara ami take tomadera janya varma nirmana siksa diyechilama, yate ta tomadera yuddhe tomaderake raksa kare; sutaram tomara ki krtajna have nay

21:81.latin_iast: evaṃ sulāimānera vaśībhūta kare diẏechilāma pracaṇḍa vāẏuke; se vāẏu tāra ādeśakrame pravāhita hata se deśera dike yekhāne āmi kalyāṇa rekhechi; pratyeka viṣaẏa samparke āmi samyaka avagata.
21:81.latin_ascii: evam sulaimanera vasibhuta kare diyechilama pracanda vayuke; se vayu tara adesakrame pravahita hata se desera dike yekhane ami kalyana rekhechi; pratyeka visaya samparke ami samyaka avagata.

21:82.latin_iast: evaṃ śaẏatānadera madhye kataka sulāimānera janya ḍuvurīra kāja karata, tā vyatīta anya kājao karata; āmi tādera rakṣākārī chilāma.
21:82.latin_ascii: evam sayatanadera madhye kataka sulaimanera janya duvurira kaja karata, ta vyatita anya kajao karata; ami tadera raksakari chilama.

21:83.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa kara āiẏūvera kathā, yakhana se tāra pratipālakake āhvāna kare valechila, ‘āmi duḥkha-kaṣṭe par̤echi, āra tumi to sarvaśreṣṭha daẏālu!’
21:83.latin_ascii: evam smarana kara aiyuvera katha, yakhana se tara pratipalakake ahvana kare valechila, ‘ami duhkha-kaste parechi, ara tumi to sarvasrestha dayalu!’

21:84.latin_iast: takhana āmi tāra ḍāke sār̤ā dilāma, tāra duḥkha-kaṣṭa dūrībhūta kare dilāma, tāke tāra parivāra-parijana phiriẏe dilāma evaṃ tādera saṅge tādera samaparimāṇa āro dilāma āmāra viśeṣa rahamatarūpe āra eṭā ‘ivādatakārīdera janya upadeśasvarūpa.
21:84.latin_ascii: takhana ami tara dake sara dilama, tara duhkha-kasta duribhuta kare dilama, take tara parivara-parijana phiriye dilama evam tadera sange tadera samaparimana aro dilama amara visesa rahamatarupe ara eta ‘ivadatakaridera janya upadesasvarupa.

21:85.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa kara isamāīla, idarīsa o yula-kiphla-era kathā, tādera pratyekei chila dhairyaśīla;
21:85.latin_ascii: evam smarana kara isamaila, idarisa o yula-kiphla-era katha, tadera pratyekei chila dhairyasila;

21:86.latin_iast: evaṃ tāderake āmi āmāra anugrahabhājana karechilāma; tārā chila sat karmaparāẏaṇa.
21:86.latin_ascii: evam taderake ami amara anugrahabhajana karechilama; tara chila sat karmaparayana.

21:87.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa kara yun-nūna (iunusa)-era kathā, yakhana se krodhabhare vera haẏe giẏechila evaṃ mane karechila āmi tāra prati saṃkīrṇatā karava nā. ataḥpara se andhakāra hate āhvāna karechila: ‘āpani vyatīta kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei; āpani pavitra, mahāna! āmi to sīmā laṅghanakārīdera antarbhukta.’
21:87.latin_ascii: evam smarana kara yun-nuna (iunusa)-era katha, yakhana se krodhabhare vera haye giyechila evam mane karechila ami tara prati samkirnata karava na. atahpara se andhakara hate ahvana karechila: ‘apani vyatita kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei; apani pavitra, mahana! ami to sima langhanakaridera antarbhukta.’

21:88.latin_iast: takhana āmi tāra ḍāke sār̤ā diẏechilāma evaṃ mukti diẏechilāma duścintā theke, āra ebhāvei āmi mu’minaderake uddhāra kare thāki.
21:88.latin_ascii: takhana ami tara dake sara diyechilama evam mukti diyechilama duscinta theke, ara ebhavei ami mu’minaderake uddhara kare thaki.

21:89.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa kara yākāriẏāra kathā, yakhana se tāra pratipālakake āhvāna kare valechila, ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke ekā rekha nā, tumi to śreṣṭha uttarādhikārī.’
21:89.latin_ascii: evam smarana kara yakariyara katha, yakhana se tara pratipalakake ahvana kare valechila, ‘he amara pratipalaka! amake eka rekha na, tumi to srestha uttaradhikari.’

21:90.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāra āhvāne sār̤ā diẏechilāma evaṃ tāke dāna karechilāma iẏāhaiẏā evaṃ tāra janya tāra strīke (garbhadhāraṇera) yogyatāsampanna karechilāma. tārā sat karme pratiyogitā karata, tārā āmāke ḍākata āśā o bhītira sāthe evaṃ tārā chila āmāra nikaṭa vinīta.
21:90.latin_ascii: atahpara ami tara ahvane sara diyechilama evam take dana karechilama iyahaiya evam tara janya tara strike (garbhadharanera) yogyatasampanna karechilama. tara sat karme pratiyogita karata, tara amake dakata asa o bhitira sathe evam tara chila amara nikata vinita.

21:91.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa kara se nārīke, ye nija satītvake rakṣā karechila, ataḥpara tāra madhye āmi āmāra rūha phu~ke diẏechilāma evaṃ tāke o tāra putrake karechilāma viśvavāsīra janya eka nidarśana.
21:91.latin_ascii: evam smarana kara se narike, ye nija satitvake raksa karechila, atahpara tara madhye ami amara ruha phu~ke diyechilama evam take o tara putrake karechilama visvavasira janya eka nidarsana.

21:92.latin_iast: niścaẏai erā tomādera jāti erā to ekai jāti evaṃ āmii tomādera pratipālaka, ataeva āmāra ‘ivādata kara.
21:92.latin_ascii: niscayai era tomadera jati era to ekai jati evam amii tomadera pratipalaka, ataeva amara ‘ivadata kara.

21:93.latin_iast: kintu tārā nijedera vyāpāre parasparera madhye bheda sṛṣṭi kareche. pratyekei āmāra nikaṭa pratyāvartanakārī.
21:93.latin_ascii: kintu tara nijedera vyapare parasparera madhye bheda srsti kareche. pratyekei amara nikata pratyavartanakari.

21:94.latin_iast: sutarāṃ yadi keu mu’mina haẏe sat karma kare tāra karmapraceṣṭā agrāhya have nā evaṃ āmi to tā likhe rākhi.
21:94.latin_ascii: sutaram yadi keu mu’mina haye sat karma kare tara karmapracesta agrahya have na evam ami to ta likhe rakhi.

21:95.latin_iast: ye janapadake āmi dhvaṃsa karechi tāra janya niṣiddha haẏeche ye, tāra adhivāsīvṛnda phire āsave nā,
21:95.latin_ascii: ye janapadake ami dhvamsa karechi tara janya nisiddha hayeche ye, tara adhivasivrnda phire asave na,

21:96.latin_iast: emanaki yakhana iẏā‘juja o mā‘jujake mukti deẏā have evaṃ tārā prati uccabhūmi hate chuṭe āsave.
21:96.latin_ascii: emanaki yakhana iya‘juja o ma‘jujake mukti deya have evam tara prati uccabhumi hate chute asave.

21:97.latin_iast: yakhana satya pratiśrutira samaẏa ghaniẏe āsave takhana akasmāt kāphiradera cakṣu sthira haẏe yāve, tārā valave: ‘hāẏa, durbheāga āmādera! āmarā to chilāma e viṣaẏe udāsīna; varaṃ āmarā jālima chilāma’
21:97.latin_ascii: yakhana satya pratisrutira samaya ghaniye asave takhana akasmat kaphiradera caksu sthira haye yave, tara valave: ‘haya, durbheaga amadera! amara to chilama e visaye udasina; varam amara jalima chilama’

21:98.latin_iast: tomarā evaṃ āllāhara parivarte tomarā yādera ‘ivādata kara segulo to jāhānnāmera indhana; tomarā sakale tāte praveśa karave.
21:98.latin_ascii: tomara evam allahara parivarte tomara yadera ‘ivadata kara segulo to jahannamera indhana; tomara sakale tate pravesa karave.

21:99.latin_iast: yadi tārā mā‘vūda hata tave tārā jāhānnāme praveśa karata nā; tādera sakalei tāte sthāẏī have,
21:99.latin_ascii: yadi tara ma‘vuda hata tave tara jahanname pravesa karata na; tadera sakalei tate sthayi have,

21:100.latin_iast: sethāẏa thākave tādera ārtanāda evaṃ sethāẏa tārā kichui śunate pāve nā;
21:100.latin_ascii: sethaya thakave tadera artanada evam sethaya tara kichui sunate pave na;

21:101.latin_iast: yādera janya āmāra pakṣa theke pūrva hate kalyāṇa nirdhārita raẏeche tāderake tā (jāhānnāma) hate dūre rākhā have.
21:101.latin_ascii: yadera janya amara paksa theke purva hate kalyana nirdharita rayeche taderake ta (jahannama) hate dure rakha have.

21:102.latin_iast: tārā tāra (jāhānnāmera) kṣīṇatama śavdao śunave nā evaṃ sethāẏa tārā tādera mana yā cāẏa cirakāla seṭā bhoga karave.
21:102.latin_ascii: tara tara (jahannamera) ksinatama savdao sunave na evam sethaya tara tadera mana ya caya cirakala seta bhoga karave.

21:103.latin_iast: mahābhīti tāderake cintāyukta karave nā evaṃ phereśatāgaṇa tāderake abhyarthanā jānāve ei vale, ‘e tomādera sedina yāra pratiśruti tomāderake deẏā haẏechila.’
21:103.latin_ascii: mahabhiti taderake cintayukta karave na evam pheresatagana taderake abhyarthana janave ei vale, ‘e tomadera sedina yara pratisruti tomaderake deya hayechila.’

21:104.latin_iast: sedina ākāśamaṇḍalīke guṭiẏe phelavo, yebhāve guṭāno haẏa likhita daphatara; yebhāve āmi prathama sṛṣṭira sūcanā karechilāma sebhāve punarāẏa sṛṣṭi karava; e āmāra kṛta oẏādā, āmi eṭā pālana karavai.
21:104.latin_ascii: sedina akasamandalike gutiye phelavo, yebhave gutano haya likhita daphatara; yebhave ami prathama srstira sucana karechilama sebhave punaraya srsti karava; e amara krta oyada, ami eta palana karavai.

21:105.latin_iast: āmi avaśyai lāohe māhaphuye yā likhāra tā lekhāra para nāyilakṛta āsamānī kitāve likhe diẏechi ye, āmāra sat karmaśīla vāndāgaṇa pṛthivīra adhikārī have.
21:105.latin_ascii: ami avasyai laohe mahaphuye ya likhara ta lekhara para nayilakrta asamani kitave likhe diyechi ye, amara sat karmasila vandagana prthivira adhikari have.

21:106.latin_iast: niścaẏai ete raẏeche vāṇī se sampradāẏera janya yārā ivādata kare.
21:106.latin_ascii: niscayai ete rayeche vani se sampradayera janya yara ivadata kare.

21:107.latin_iast: āmi to tomāke viśvajagatera prati kevala rahamatarūpei preraṇa karechi.
21:107.latin_ascii: ami to tomake visvajagatera prati kevala rahamatarupei prerana karechi.

21:108.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmāra prati oẏāhī haẏa ye, tomādera ilāh kevala ekai ilāh sutarāṃ tomarā ki ātmasamarpaṇakārī have?’
21:108.latin_ascii: vala: ‘amara prati oyahi haya ye, tomadera ilah kevala ekai ilah sutaram tomara ki atmasamarpanakari havey’

21:109.latin_iast: yadi tārā mukha phiriẏe neẏa tumi vala, ‘āmi tomāderake yathāyathabhāve jāniẏe diẏechi evaṃ tomāderake ye viṣaẏera pratiśruti deẏā haẏeche, āmi jāni nā, tā nikaṭavartī, nā dūravartī.
21:109.latin_ascii: yadi tara mukha phiriye neya tumi vala, ‘ami tomaderake yathayathabhave janiye diyechi evam tomaderake ye visayera pratisruti deya hayeche, ami jani na, ta nikatavarti, na duravarti.

21:110.latin_iast: tini jānena, ye kathā vyakta kara evaṃ yā tomarā gopana kara.
21:110.latin_ascii: tini janena, ye katha vyakta kara evam ya tomara gopana kara.

21:111.latin_iast: ‘āmi jāni nā haẏato eṭā tomādera janya eka parīkṣā evaṃ jīvanopabhoga kichu kālera janya.’
21:111.latin_ascii: ‘ami jani na hayato eta tomadera janya eka pariksa evam jivanopabhoga kichu kalera janya.’

21:112.latin_iast: rāsūla valechila, ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! tumi nyāẏera sāthe phāẏasālā kare dāo, āmādera pratipālaka to daẏāmaẏa, tomarā yā valacho se viṣaẏe ekamātra sahāẏasthala tinii.’
21:112.latin_ascii: rasula valechila, ‘he amara pratipalaka! tumi nyayera sathe phayasala kare dao, amadera pratipalaka to dayamaya, tomara ya valacho se visaye ekamatra sahayasthala tinii.’

22:1.latin_iast: he mānuṣa! bhaẏa kara tomādera pratipālakake; kiẏāmatera prakampana eka bhaẏaṃkara vyāpāra!
22:1.latin_ascii: he manusa! bhaya kara tomadera pratipalakake; kiyamatera prakampana eka bhayamkara vyapara!

22:2.latin_iast: yedina tomarā tā pratyakṣa karave se dina pratyeka stanyadātrī tāra dugdhapoṣya śiśuke bhule yāve evaṃ pratyeka garbhavatī tāra garbhapāta kare phelave; mānuṣake dekhave neśāgrasta avasthāẏa, athaca tārā neśāgrasta naẏa. vastuta āllāhara śāsti kaṭhina.
22:2.latin_ascii: yedina tomara ta pratyaksa karave se dina pratyeka stanyadatri tara dugdhaposya sisuke bhule yave evam pratyeka garbhavati tara garbhapata kare phelave; manusake dekhave nesagrasta avasthaya, athaca tara nesagrasta naya. vastuta allahara sasti kathina.

22:3.latin_iast: mānuṣera madhye kataka ajñānatāvaśata āllāha samvandhe vitaṇḍā kare evaṃ anusaraṇa kare pratyeka vidrohī śaẏatānera,
22:3.latin_ascii: manusera madhye kataka ajnanatavasata allaha samvandhe vitanda kare evam anusarana kare pratyeka vidrohi sayatanera,

22:4.latin_iast: tāra samvandhe e niẏama kare deẏā haẏeche ye, ye keu tāra sāthe vandhutva karave se tāke pathabhraṣṭa karave evaṃ tāke paricālita karave prajjvalita agnira śāstira dike.
22:4.latin_ascii: tara samvandhe e niyama kare deya hayeche ye, ye keu tara sathe vandhutva karave se take pathabhrasta karave evam take paricalita karave prajjvalita agnira sastira dike.

22:5.latin_iast: he mānuṣa! punarutthāna samvandhe yadi tomarā sandihāna hao tave bheve dekha, āmi tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechi mṛttikā hate, tāra para śukra hate, tāra para ‘ālāka’ (jamāṭa rakta) hate, tārapara pūrṇākṛti athavā apūrṇākṛti gośatapiṇḍa hatena tomādera nikaṭa vyakta karāra janya. āmi yā icchā kari tā eka nirdiṣṭakālera janya mātṛgarbhe sthira rākhi, tārapara āmi tomāderake śiśurūpe vera kari, pare (lālana-pālana kari) yāte tomarā pariṇata vaẏase upanīta hao. tomādera madhye kārao kārao mṛtyu ghaṭāno haẏa evaṃ tomādera madhye kāuke kāuke pratyāvṛtta karā haẏa hīnatama vaẏase, yāra phale tārā yā kichu jānata se samvandhe tārā sajñāna thāke nā. tumi bhūmike dekha śuṣka, ataḥpara tāte āmi vāri varṣaṇa karale seṭā śasya-śyāmala haẏe āndolita o sphīta haẏa evaṃ udgata kare sarvaprakāra naẏanābhirāma udbhida;
22:5.latin_ascii: he manusa! punarutthana samvandhe yadi tomara sandihana hao tave bheve dekha, ami tomaderake srsti karechi mrttika hate, tara para sukra hate, tara para ‘alaka’ (jamata rakta) hate, tarapara purnakrti athava apurnakrti gosatapinda hatena tomadera nikata vyakta karara janya. ami ya iccha kari ta eka nirdistakalera janya matrgarbhe sthira rakhi, tarapara ami tomaderake sisurupe vera kari, pare (lalana-palana kari) yate tomara parinata vayase upanita hao. tomadera madhye karao karao mrtyu ghatano haya evam tomadera madhye kauke kauke pratyavrtta kara haya hinatama vayase, yara phale tara ya kichu janata se samvandhe tara sajnana thake na. tumi bhumike dekha suska, atahpara tate ami vari varsana karale seta sasya-syamala haye andolita o sphita haya evam udgata kare sarvaprakara nayanabhirama udbhida;

22:6.latin_iast: eṭā e janya ye, niścaẏai āllāha satya evaṃ tini mṛtake jīvana dāna karena evaṃ tini sarvaviṣaẏe śaktimāna;
22:6.latin_ascii: eta e janya ye, niscayai allaha satya evam tini mrtake jivana dana karena evam tini sarvavisaye saktimana;

22:7.latin_iast: evaṃ kiẏāmata avaśyai āsave, ete kona sandeha nei evaṃ kvavare yārā āche tāderake niścaẏa āllāha utthita karavena.
22:7.latin_ascii: evam kiyamata avasyai asave, ete kona sandeha nei evam kvavare yara ache taderake niscaya allaha utthita karavena.

22:8.latin_iast: mānuṣera madhye keu keu āllāha samvandhe vitaṇḍā kare; tādera nā āche jñāna, nā āche pathanirdeśa, nā āche kona dīptimāna kitāva.
22:8.latin_ascii: manusera madhye keu keu allaha samvandhe vitanda kare; tadera na ache jnana, na ache pathanirdesa, na ache kona diptimana kitava.

22:9.latin_iast: (se vitaṇḍā kare) ghār̤a vā~kiẏe lokaderake āllāhara patha hate vibhrānta karāra janya. tāra janya lāñchanā āche duniẏāte evaṃ kiẏāmata divase āmi tāke āsvādana karāva dahana yantraṇā.
22:9.latin_ascii: (se vitanda kare) ghara va~kiye lokaderake allahara patha hate vibhranta karara janya. tara janya lanchana ache duniyate evam kiyamata divase ami take asvadana karava dahana yantrana.

22:10.latin_iast: (sedina tāke valā have) ‘eṭā tomāra kṛtakarmera phala, āllāha vāndādera prati juluma karena nā.’
22:10.latin_ascii: (sedina take vala have) ‘eta tomara krtakarmera phala, allaha vandadera prati juluma karena na.’

22:11.latin_iast: mānuṣera madhye keu keu āllāhara ivādata kare dvidhāra sāthe; tāra maṅgala hale tāte tāra mana praśānta haẏa evaṃ kona viparyaẏa ghaṭale se tāra pūrvāvasthāẏa phire yāẏa. se kṣatigrasta haẏa duniẏāte o ākhirāte; eṭā to suspaṣṭa kṣati.
22:11.latin_ascii: manusera madhye keu keu allahara ivadata kare dvidhara sathe; tara mangala hale tate tara mana prasanta haya evam kona viparyaya ghatale se tara purvavasthaya phire yaya. se ksatigrasta haya duniyate o akhirate; eta to suspasta ksati.

22:12.latin_iast: se āllāhara parivarte emana kichuke ḍāke yā tāra kona apakāra karate pāre nā, upakārao karate pāre nā; eṭā carama vibhrānti!
22:12.latin_ascii: se allahara parivarte emana kichuke dake ya tara kona apakara karate pare na, upakarao karate pare na; eta carama vibhranti!

22:13.latin_iast: se ḍāke emana kichuke yāra kṣati tāra upakāra apekṣā adhika nikaṭatara. katai nā nikṛṣṭa e abhibhāvaka evaṃ katai nā nikṛṣṭa e sahacara!
22:13.latin_ascii: se dake emana kichuke yara ksati tara upakara apeksa adhika nikatatara. katai na nikrsta e abhibhavaka evam katai na nikrsta e sahacara!

22:14.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare āllāha tāderake dākhila karavena jānnāte, yāra nimnadeśe nadīsamūha pravāhita; āllāha yā icchā tā-i karena.
22:14.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o sat karma kare allaha taderake dakhila karavena jannate, yara nimnadese nadisamuha pravahita; allaha ya iccha ta-i karena.

22:15.latin_iast: ye keu mane kare, āllāha tāke kakhanai duniẏā o ākhirāte sāhāyya karavena nā, se oparera dike ekaṭi raśite phā~sa diẏe jhuliẏe dika, pare tā vicchinna karuka; ataḥpara dekhuka tāra praceṣṭā tāra ākrośera kāraṇa dūra kare ki-nā.
22:15.latin_ascii: ye keu mane kare, allaha take kakhanai duniya o akhirate sahayya karavena na, se oparera dike ekati rasite pha~sa diye jhuliye dika, pare ta vicchinna karuka; atahpara dekhuka tara pracesta tara akrosera karana dura kare ki-na.

22:16.latin_iast: ebhāve āmi suspaṣṭa nidarśanarūpe kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi; āra āllāha yāke icchā sat patha pradarśana karena.
22:16.latin_ascii: ebhave ami suspasta nidarsanarupe kuraana avatirna karechi; ara allaha yake iccha sat patha pradarsana karena.

22:17.latin_iast: yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ yārā iẏāhūdī haẏeche, yārā sāviẏī, khṛṣṭāna o agnipūjaka evaṃ yārā muśarika haẏeche, kiẏāmatera dina āllāha tādera madhye phāẏasālā kare devena. āllāha samasta kichura samyaka pratyakṣakārī.
22:17.latin_ascii: yara imana eneche evam yara iyahudi hayeche, yara saviyi, khrstana o agnipujaka evam yara musarika hayeche, kiyamatera dina allaha tadera madhye phayasala kare devena. allaha samasta kichura samyaka pratyaksakari.

22:18.latin_iast: tumi ki dekha nā ye, āllāhake sājadāh kare yā kichu āche ākāśamaṇḍalīte o pṛthivīte, sūrya, candra, nakṣatrarāji, parvatamālā, vṛkṣalatā, jīvajantu evaṃ sājdāh kare mānuṣera madhye aneke? āvāra anekera prati avadhārita haẏeche śāsti. āllāha yāke lāñchita karena tāra sammānadātā keu nei; āllāha yā icchā tāi karena.
22:18.latin_ascii: tumi ki dekha na ye, allahake sajadah kare ya kichu ache akasamandalite o prthivite, surya, candra, naksatraraji, parvatamala, vrksalata, jivajantu evam sajdah kare manusera madhye anekey avara anekera prati avadharita hayeche sasti. allaha yake lanchita karena tara sammanadata keu nei; allaha ya iccha tai karena.

22:19.latin_iast: erā du’ṭi vivadamāna pakṣa, tārā tādera pratipālaka samvandhe vitarka kare; yārā kupharī kare tādera janya prastuta karā haẏeche āgunera pośāka, tādera māthāra opara ḍhele deẏā have phuṭanta pāni,
22:19.latin_ascii: era du’ti vivadamana paksa, tara tadera pratipalaka samvandhe vitarka kare; yara kuphari kare tadera janya prastuta kara hayeche agunera posaka, tadera mathara opara dhele deya have phutanta pani,

22:20.latin_iast: yā dvārā tādera udare yā āche tā evaṃ tādera carma vigalita karā have.
22:20.latin_ascii: ya dvara tadera udare ya ache ta evam tadera carma vigalita kara have.

22:21.latin_iast: evaṃ tādera janya thākave lauha nirmita hātur̤isamūha.
22:21.latin_ascii: evam tadera janya thakave lauha nirmita haturisamuha.

22:22.latin_iast: yakhanai tārā yantraṇākātara haẏe jāāhānnāma hate vera hate cāive takhana tāderake phiriẏe deẏā have tāte; (tāderake valā have) ‘āsvādana kara dahanayantraṇā.’
22:22.latin_ascii: yakhanai tara yantranakatara haye jaahannama hate vera hate caive takhana taderake phiriye deya have tate; (taderake vala have) ‘asvadana kara dahanayantrana.’

22:23.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare āllāha tāderake dākhila karāvena jānnāte yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita, sethāẏa tāderake alaṅkṛta karā have sonāra vālā o muktā dvārā evaṃ sethāẏa tādera pośāka-paricchada have reśamera.
22:23.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o sat karma kare allaha taderake dakhila karavena jannate yara padadese nadi pravahita, sethaya taderake alankrta kara have sonara vala o mukta dvara evam sethaya tadera posaka-paricchada have resamera.

22:24.latin_iast: tāderake pavitra vākyera anugāmī karā haẏechila phale tārā paricālita haẏechila parama praśaṃsābhājana āllāhara pathe.
22:24.latin_ascii: taderake pavitra vakyera anugami kara hayechila phale tara paricalita hayechila parama prasamsabhajana allahara pathe.

22:25.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kare evaṃ mānuṣake vādhā deẏa āllāhara patha hate o māsajidula hārāma hate, yā āmi karechi sthānīẏa o vahirāgata sakalera janya samāna, āra ye icchā kare sīmālaṃghana kare tāte pāpa kāryera, tāke āmi āsvādana karāva yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
22:25.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kare evam manusake vadha deya allahara patha hate o masajidula harama hate, ya ami karechi sthaniya o vahiragata sakalera janya samana, ara ye iccha kare simalamghana kare tate papa karyera, take ami asvadana karava yantranadayaka sasti.

22:26.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa kara, yakhana āmi ivrāhīmera janya nirdhāraṇa kare diẏechilāma se gṛhera sthāna, (takhana valechilāma) ‘āmāra sāthe kona kichuke śarīka sthira kara nā evaṃ āmāra gṛhake pavitra rākha tādera janya yārā tāoẏāpha kare evaṃ yārā sālāte dā~r̤āẏa, rukū‘ kare o sājdāh kare.
22:26.latin_ascii: evam smarana kara, yakhana ami ivrahimera janya nirdharana kare diyechilama se grhera sthana, (takhana valechilama) ‘amara sathe kona kichuke sarika sthira kara na evam amara grhake pavitra rakha tadera janya yara taoyapha kare evam yara salate da~raya, ruku‘ kare o sajdah kare.

22:27.latin_iast: evaṃ mānuṣera nikaṭa hajja-era ghoṣaṇā kare dāo, tārā tomāra nikaṭa āsave pāẏe he~ṭe o sarvaprakāra śīrṇa uṭhera piṭhe, erā āsave dūra-dūrāntera patha atikrama kare,
22:27.latin_ascii: evam manusera nikata hajja-era ghosana kare dao, tara tomara nikata asave paye he~te o sarvaprakara sirna uthera pithe, era asave dura-durantera patha atikrama kare,

22:28.latin_iast: yāte tārā tādera kalyāṇamaẏa sthānagulote upasthita hate pāre evaṃ tini tāderake catuṣpada jantu hate yā riyaka hiseve dāna karechena tāra opara nirdiṣṭa dinagulote āllāhara nāma uccāraṇa karate pāre. ataḥpara tomarā tā hate (āhāra kara) evaṃ duḥstha, abhāvagrastake āhāra karāo.
22:28.latin_ascii: yate tara tadera kalyanamaya sthanagulote upasthita hate pare evam tini taderake catuspada jantu hate ya riyaka hiseve dana karechena tara opara nirdista dinagulote allahara nama uccarana karate pare. atahpara tomara ta hate (ahara kara) evam duhstha, abhavagrastake ahara karao.

22:29.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā yena tādera aparicchannatā dūra kare evaṃ tādera mānata pūrṇa kare evaṃ tāoẏāpha kare prācīna gṛhera.
22:29.latin_ascii: atahpara tara yena tadera aparicchannata dura kare evam tadera manata purna kare evam taoyapha kare pracina grhera.

22:30.latin_iast: eṭāi vidhāna evaṃ keu āllāha kartṛka nirdhārita pavitra anuṣṭhānagulora sammāna karale tāra pratipālakera nikaṭa tāra janya eṭā uttama. tomādera janya hālāla karā haẏeche catuṣpada jantunaegulo vyatīta yā tomāderake śunāno haẏeche. sutarāṃ tomarā varjana kara mūrtipūjāra apavitratā evaṃ dūre thāka mithyākathana hate,
22:30.latin_ascii: etai vidhana evam keu allaha kartrka nirdharita pavitra anusthanagulora sammana karale tara pratipalakera nikata tara janya eta uttama. tomadera janya halala kara hayeche catuspada jantunaegulo vyatita ya tomaderake sunano hayeche. sutaram tomara varjana kara murtipujara apavitrata evam dure thaka mithyakathana hate,

22:31.latin_iast: āllāhara prati ekaniṣṭha haẏe evaṃ tā~ra sāthe kona kichuke śarīka nā kare; evaṃ ye keu āllāhara sāthe śarīka kare se yena ākāśa hate par̤ala, ataḥpara pākhī tāke cheā~ mere niẏe gela, kiṃvā vāẏu tāke ur̤iẏe niẏe giẏe eka dūravartī sthāne nikṣepa karala.
22:31.latin_ascii: allahara prati ekanistha haye evam ta~ra sathe kona kichuke sarika na kare; evam ye keu allahara sathe sarika kare se yena akasa hate parala, atahpara pakhi take chea~ mere niye gela, kimva vayu take uriye niye giye eka duravarti sthane niksepa karala.

22:32.latin_iast: eṭā āllāhara vidhāna evaṃ keu āllāhara nidarśanāvalīke sammāna karale niścaẏai eṭā tāra hṛdaẏera tākoẏāra paricaẏa.
22:32.latin_ascii: eta allahara vidhana evam keu allahara nidarsanavalike sammana karale niscayai eta tara hrdayera takoyara paricaya.

22:33.latin_iast: (e samasta gṛhapālita jantu) yāte tomādera janya nānāvidha upakāra raẏeche eka nirdiṣṭakālera janya; ataḥpara tādera kuravānīra sthāna prācīna gṛhera nikaṭa.
22:33.latin_ascii: (e samasta grhapalita jantu) yate tomadera janya nanavidha upakara rayeche eka nirdistakalera janya; atahpara tadera kuravanira sthana pracina grhera nikata.

22:34.latin_iast: āmi pratyeka sampradāẏera janya kuravānīra niẏama kare diẏechi; tini tāderake jīvanopakaraṇasvarūpa ye sakala catuṣpada jantu diẏechena, segulora opara yena tārā āllāhara nāma uccāraṇa kare. tomādera ilāh eka ilāh, sutarāṃ tā~rai nikaṭa ātmasamarpaṇa kara evaṃ susaṃvāda dāo vinītagaṇakena
22:34.latin_ascii: ami pratyeka sampradayera janya kuravanira niyama kare diyechi; tini taderake jivanopakaranasvarupa ye sakala catuspada jantu diyechena, segulora opara yena tara allahara nama uccarana kare. tomadera ilah eka ilah, sutaram ta~rai nikata atmasamarpana kara evam susamvada dao vinitaganakena

22:35.latin_iast: yādera hṛdaẏa bhaẏe kampita haẏa yakhana āllāhara nāma smaraṇa karā haẏa, yārā tādera vipada-āpade dhairya dhāraṇa kare, evaṃ sālāta kāẏema kare evaṃ āmi tāderake ye riyka diẏechi tā hate vyaẏa kare.
22:35.latin_ascii: yadera hrdaya bhaye kampita haya yakhana allahara nama smarana kara haya, yara tadera vipada-apade dhairya dharana kare, evam salata kayema kare evam ami taderake ye riyka diyechi ta hate vyaya kare.

22:36.latin_iast: evaṃ uṭake karechi āllāhara nidarśanagulora anyatama; tomādera janya tāte maṅgala raẏeche. sutarāṃ sārivaddhabhāve daṇḍāẏamāna avasthāẏa tādera opara tomarā āllāhara nāma uccāraṇa kara. yakhana tārā kāta haẏe par̤e yāẏa takhana tomarā tā hate āhāra kara evaṃ āhāra karāo dhairyaśīla abhāvagrastake o vinaẏera sāthe bhikṣākārīke; ebhāve āmi tāderake tomādera adhīna kare diẏechi yāte tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
22:36.latin_ascii: evam utake karechi allahara nidarsanagulora anyatama; tomadera janya tate mangala rayeche. sutaram sarivaddhabhave dandayamana avasthaya tadera opara tomara allahara nama uccarana kara. yakhana tara kata haye pare yaya takhana tomara ta hate ahara kara evam ahara karao dhairyasila abhavagrastake o vinayera sathe bhiksakarike; ebhave ami taderake tomadera adhina kare diyechi yate tomara krtajnata prakasa kara.

22:37.latin_iast: āllāhara nikaṭa pau~che nā tādera gośata evaṃ rakta, varaṃ pau~che tomādera tākvaoẏā. ebhāve tini ederake tomādera adhīna kare diẏechena yāte tomarā āllāhara śreṣṭhatva ghoṣaṇā kara ejanya ye, tini tomāderake pathapradarśana karechena; sutarāṃ tumi susaṃvāda dāo sat karmaparāẏaṇaderake.
22:37.latin_ascii: allahara nikata pau~che na tadera gosata evam rakta, varam pau~che tomadera takvaoya. ebhave tini ederake tomadera adhina kare diyechena yate tomara allahara sresthatva ghosana kara ejanya ye, tini tomaderake pathapradarsana karechena; sutaram tumi susamvada dao sat karmaparayanaderake.

22:38.latin_iast: āllāha rakṣā karena mu’minaderake, tini kona viśvāsaghātaka, akṛtajñake pachanda karena nā.
22:38.latin_ascii: allaha raksa karena mu’minaderake, tini kona visvasaghataka, akrtajnake pachanda karena na.

22:39.latin_iast: yuddhera anumati deẏā hala tāderake yārā ākrānta haẏeche; kāraṇa tādera prati atyācāra karā haẏeche. āllāha niścaẏa tāderake sāhāyya karate sakṣama;
22:39.latin_ascii: yuddhera anumati deya hala taderake yara akranta hayeche; karana tadera prati atyacara kara hayeche. allaha niscaya taderake sahayya karate saksama;

22:40.latin_iast: tāderake tādera ghara-vār̤ī hate anyāẏabhāve vahiṣkāra karā haẏeche śudhu e kāraṇe ye, tārā vale, ‘āmādera pratipālaka āllāha.’ āllāha yadi mānava jātira eka dalake anya dala dvārā pratihata nā karatena, tāhale vidhvasta haẏe yeta khṛṣṭāna saṃsāra virāgīdera upāsanālaẏa, girjā, iẏāhūdīdera upāsanālaẏa evaṃ māsajidasamūha yāte adhika smaraṇa karā haẏa āllāhara nāma. āllāha niścaẏai tāke sāhāyya karena ye tā~ke sāhāyya kare. āllāha niścaẏa śaktimāna, parākramaśālī.
22:40.latin_ascii: taderake tadera ghara-vari hate anyayabhave vahiskara kara hayeche sudhu e karane ye, tara vale, ‘amadera pratipalaka allaha.’ allaha yadi manava jatira eka dalake anya dala dvara pratihata na karatena, tahale vidhvasta haye yeta khrstana samsara viragidera upasanalaya, girja, iyahudidera upasanalaya evam masajidasamuha yate adhika smarana kara haya allahara nama. allaha niscayai take sahayya karena ye ta~ke sahayya kare. allaha niscaya saktimana, parakramasali.

22:41.latin_iast: āmi ederake pṛthivīte pratiṣṭhita karale erā sālāta kāẏema karave, yākāta dive evaṃ sat kāryera nirdeśa dive o asat kārye niṣedha karave; āra sakala karmera pariṇāma āllāhara ikhatiẏāre.
22:41.latin_ascii: ami ederake prthivite pratisthita karale era salata kayema karave, yakata dive evam sat karyera nirdesa dive o asat karye nisedha karave; ara sakala karmera parinama allahara ikhatiyare.

22:42.latin_iast: evaṃ lokerā yadi tomāke asvīkāra kare tave tādera pūrve avaśyai asvīkāra karechila nūh, ‘āda o sāmūda sampradāẏa,
22:42.latin_ascii: evam lokera yadi tomake asvikara kare tave tadera purve avasyai asvikara karechila nuh, ‘ada o samuda sampradaya,

22:44.latin_iast: evaṃ mādaiẏānavāsīrā āra asvīkāra karā haẏechila mūsākeo. āmi kāphiraderake avakāśa diẏechilāma, ataḥpara tāderake śāsti diẏechilāma. ataeva kemana chila śāsti!
22:44.latin_ascii: evam madaiyanavasira ara asvikara kara hayechila musakeo. ami kaphiraderake avakasa diyechilama, atahpara taderake sasti diyechilama. ataeva kemana chila sasti!

22:45.latin_iast: āmi dhvaṃsa karechi kata janapada yegulora vāsindā chila jālima. esava janapada tādera gharera chādasaha dhvaṃsastūpe pariṇata haẏechila evaṃ kata kūpa parityakta haẏechila o kata sūdṛr̤ha prāsāda!
22:45.latin_ascii: ami dhvamsa karechi kata janapada yegulora vasinda chila jalima. esava janapada tadera gharera chadasaha dhvamsastupe parinata hayechila evam kata kupa parityakta hayechila o kata sudrrha prasada!

22:46.latin_iast: tārā ki deśa bhramaṇa kareni? tāhale tārā jñāna-vuddhisampanna hṛdaẏa o śra“tiśaktisampanna śravaṇera adhikārī hate pārata. vastuta cakṣu to andha naẏa, varaṃ andha hacche vakṣasthita hṛdaẏa.
22:46.latin_ascii: tara ki desa bhramana kareniy tahale tara jnana-vuddhisampanna hrdaya o sra“tisaktisampanna sravanera adhikari hate parata. vastuta caksu to andha naya, varam andha hacche vaksasthita hrdaya.

22:47.latin_iast: tārā tomāke śāsti tvarānvita karate vale, athaca āllāha tā~ra pratiśra“ti kakhano bhaṅga karena nā. tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa ekadina tomādera gaṇanāra sahasra vatsarera samāna;
22:47.latin_ascii: tara tomake sasti tvaranvita karate vale, athaca allaha ta~ra pratisra“ti kakhano bhanga karena na. tomara pratipalakera nikata ekadina tomadera gananara sahasra vatsarera samana;

22:48.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi avakāśa diẏechi kata janapadake yakhana tārā chila yālima; ataḥpara tāderake śāsti diẏechi evaṃ pratyāvartana āmārai nikaṭa.
22:48.latin_ascii: evam ami avakasa diyechi kata janapadake yakhana tara chila yalima; atahpara taderake sasti diyechi evam pratyavartana amarai nikata.

22:49.latin_iast: vala: ‘he mānuṣa! niścaẏai āmi tomādera janya eka spaṣṭa satarkakārī;
22:49.latin_ascii: vala: ‘he manusa! niscayai ami tomadera janya eka spasta satarkakari;

22:50.latin_iast: sutarāṃ yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare tādera janya āche kṣamā o sammānajanaka jīvikā;
22:50.latin_ascii: sutaram yara imana ane o sat karma kare tadera janya ache ksama o sammanajanaka jivika;

22:51.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā āmāra āẏātake vyartha karāra ceṣṭā kare tārā have jāhānnāmera adhivāsī.
22:51.latin_ascii: evam yara amara ayatake vyartha karara cesta kare tara have jahannamera adhivasi.

22:52.latin_iast: āmi tomāra pūrve ye samasta rāsūla kiṃvā nāvī preraṇa karechi tādera keu yakhanai kichu ākāksakṣā kareche, takhanai śaẏatāna tāra ākāksakṣāẏa kichu prakṣipta kareche; śaẏatāna yā kichu nikṣepa kareche āllāha tā vidūrita kare dena. ataḥpara āllāha tā~ra āẏātasamūhake supratiṣṭhita karena evaṃ āllāha sarvajña, prajñāmaẏa;
22:52.latin_ascii: ami tomara purve ye samasta rasula kimva navi prerana karechi tadera keu yakhanai kichu akaksaksa kareche, takhanai sayatana tara akaksaksaya kichu praksipta kareche; sayatana ya kichu niksepa kareche allaha ta vidurita kare dena. atahpara allaha ta~ra ayatasamuhake supratisthita karena evam allaha sarvajna, prajnamaya;

22:53.latin_iast: eṭā ejanya ye, śaẏatāna yā nikṣepa kare tini tāke parīkṣāsvarūpa karena tādera janya yādera antare vyādhi raẏeche, yārā pāṣāṇa hṛdaẏera adhikārī. niścaẏai yālimarā carama matabhede raẏeche.
22:53.latin_ascii: eta ejanya ye, sayatana ya niksepa kare tini take pariksasvarupa karena tadera janya yadera antare vyadhi rayeche, yara pasana hrdayera adhikari. niscayai yalimara carama matabhede rayeche.

22:54.latin_iast: evaṃ ejanyao ye, yāderake jñāna deẏā haẏeche tārā yena jānate pāre ye, eṭā tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa hate prerita satya; ataḥpara tārā yena tāte viśvāsa sthāpana kare evaṃ tādera antara yena tāra prati anugata haẏa. yārā īmāna eneche tāderake avaśyai āllāha sarala pathe paricālita karena.
22:54.latin_ascii: evam ejanyao ye, yaderake jnana deya hayeche tara yena janate pare ye, eta tomara pratipalakera nikata hate prerita satya; atahpara tara yena tate visvasa sthapana kare evam tadera antara yena tara prati anugata haya. yara imana eneche taderake avasyai allaha sarala pathe paricalita karena.

22:55.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā tāte sandeha poṣaṇa karā hate virata have nā, yatakṣaṇa nā tādera nikaṭa kviẏāmāta ese par̤ave ākasmikabhāve, athavā ese par̤ave eka vandhyā dinera śāsti.
22:55.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara tate sandeha posana kara hate virata have na, yataksana na tadera nikata kviyamata ese parave akasmikabhave, athava ese parave eka vandhya dinera sasti.

22:56.latin_iast: sedina āllāharai ādhipatya; tinii tādera mājhe vicāra karavena. ataḥpara yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare tārā avasthāna karave jānnāte.
22:56.latin_ascii: sedina allaharai adhipatya; tinii tadera majhe vicara karavena. atahpara yara imana ane o sat karma kare tara avasthana karave jannate.

22:57.latin_iast: āra yārā kupharī kare o āmāra āẏātasamūhake asvīkāra kare tādera janyai raẏeche lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti.
22:57.latin_ascii: ara yara kuphari kare o amara ayatasamuhake asvikara kare tadera janyai rayeche lanchanadayaka sasti.

22:58.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā hijarata kareche āllāhara pathe, ataḥpara nihata haẏeche athavā mārā giẏeche tāderake āllāha avaśyai utkṛṣṭa jīvikā dāna karavena; āra niścaẏai āllāha, tini to sarveātkṛṣṭa riykadātā.
22:58.latin_ascii: evam yara hijarata kareche allahara pathe, atahpara nihata hayeche athava mara giyeche taderake allaha avasyai utkrsta jivika dana karavena; ara niscayai allaha, tini to sarveatkrsta riykadata.

22:59.latin_iast: tini tāderake avaśyai emana sthāne dākhila karāvena yā tārā pachanda karave evaṃ niścaẏai āllāha samyaka prajñāmaẏa, parama sahanaśīla.
22:59.latin_ascii: tini taderake avasyai emana sthane dakhila karavena ya tara pachanda karave evam niscayai allaha samyaka prajnamaya, parama sahanasila.

22:60.latin_iast: eṭāi hala tādera avasthā, kona vyakti nipīr̤ita haẏe samatulya pratiśodha grahaṇa karale o punarāẏa se atyācārita hale āllāha tāke avaśyai sāhāyya karavena; āllāha niścaẏai pāpa mocanakārī, kṣamāśīla.
22:60.latin_ascii: etai hala tadera avastha, kona vyakti nipirita haye samatulya pratisodha grahana karale o punaraya se atyacarita hale allaha take avasyai sahayya karavena; allaha niscayai papa mocanakari, ksamasila.

22:61.latin_iast: eṭā e janya ye, āllāha rātrike praviṣṭa karāna divasera madhye evaṃ divasake praviṣṭa karāna rātrira madhye evaṃ āllāha sarvaśrotā, samyaka draṣṭā;
22:61.latin_ascii: eta e janya ye, allaha ratrike pravista karana divasera madhye evam divasake pravista karana ratrira madhye evam allaha sarvasrota, samyaka drasta;

22:62.latin_iast: eṭā ejanyao ye, āllāha, tinii satya evaṃ tārā tā~ra parivarte yāke ḍāke tā asatya, evaṃ āllāha, tinii to sarveācca, mahāna.
22:62.latin_ascii: eta ejanyao ye, allaha, tinii satya evam tara ta~ra parivarte yake dake ta asatya, evam allaha, tinii to sarveacca, mahana.

22:63.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya kara nā ye, āllāha ākāśa hate vāri varṣaṇa karena yāra phale savuja śyāmala haẏe uṭhe pṛthivī, niścaẏai āllāha samyaka sūkṣmadarśī, parijñāta.
22:63.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya kara na ye, allaha akasa hate vari varsana karena yara phale savuja syamala haye uthe prthivi, niscayai allaha samyaka suksmadarsi, parijnata.

22:64.latin_iast: ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche tā tā~rai, evaṃ āllāha, niścaẏai tini abhāvamukta, praśaṃsārha.
22:64.latin_ascii: akasamandali o prthivite ya kichu ache ta ta~rai, evam allaha, niscayai tini abhavamukta, prasamsarha.

22:65.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya kara nā ye, āllāha tomādera kalyāṇe niẏojita karechena pṛthivīte yā kichu āche tatsamudaẏake evaṃ tā~ra nirdeśe samudre vicaraṇaśīla nauyānasamūhake? āra tinii ākāśake sthira rākhena yāte tā patita nā haẏa pṛthivīra opara tā~ra anumati vyatīta. āllāha niścaẏai mānuṣera prati daẏārdra, parama daẏālu.
22:65.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya kara na ye, allaha tomadera kalyane niyojita karechena prthivite ya kichu ache tatsamudayake evam ta~ra nirdese samudre vicaranasila nauyanasamuhakey ara tinii akasake sthira rakhena yate ta patita na haya prthivira opara ta~ra anumati vyatita. allaha niscayai manusera prati dayardra, parama dayalu.

22:66.latin_iast: evaṃ tinii tomāderake jīvana dāna karechena; ataḥpara tinii tomādera mṛtyu ghaṭāvena, punarāẏa tomāderake jīvana dāna karavena. mānuṣa to ati mātrāẏa akṛtajña.
22:66.latin_ascii: evam tinii tomaderake jivana dana karechena; atahpara tinii tomadera mrtyu ghatavena, punaraya tomaderake jivana dana karavena. manusa to ati matraya akrtajna.

22:67.latin_iast: āmi pratyeka sampradāẏera janya nirdhārita kare diẏechi ivādata paddhati yā tārā anusaraṇa kare. sutarāṃ tārā yena e vyāpāre tomāra sāthe vitarka nā kare. tumi tāderake tomāra pratipālakera dike āhvāna kara, tumi avaśyai sarala pathera opara pratiṣṭhita.
22:67.latin_ascii: ami pratyeka sampradayera janya nirdharita kare diyechi ivadata paddhati ya tara anusarana kare. sutaram tara yena e vyapare tomara sathe vitarka na kare. tumi taderake tomara pratipalakera dike ahvana kara, tumi avasyai sarala pathera opara pratisthita.

22:68.latin_iast: āra tārā yadi tomāra sāthe vitaṇḍā kare tave vala: ‘tomarā yā kara se samvandhe āllāha samyaka avahita.
22:68.latin_ascii: ara tara yadi tomara sathe vitanda kare tave vala: ‘tomara ya kara se samvandhe allaha samyaka avahita.

22:69.latin_iast: tomarā ye viṣaẏe matabheda karacha āllāha kiẏāmatera dina se viṣaẏe tomādera madhye vicāra-mīmāṃsā kare devena.’
22:69.latin_ascii: tomara ye visaye matabheda karacha allaha kiyamatera dina se visaye tomadera madhye vicara-mimamsa kare devena.’

22:70.latin_iast: tumi ki jāna nā ye, ākāśa o pṛthivīte yā kichu raẏeche niścaẏai āllāha tā jānena. e sakalai āche eka kitāve; niścaẏai eṭā āllāhara nikaṭa sahaja.
22:70.latin_ascii: tumi ki jana na ye, akasa o prthivite ya kichu rayeche niscayai allaha ta janena. e sakalai ache eka kitave; niscayai eta allahara nikata sahaja.

22:71.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā ivādata kare āllāhara parivarte emana kichura yāra samparke tini kona dalīla preraṇa karenani evaṃ yāra samvandhe tādera kona jñāna nei. āra yālimadera kona sāhāyyakārī nei.
22:71.latin_ascii: evam tara ivadata kare allahara parivarte emana kichura yara samparke tini kona dalila prerana karenani evam yara samvandhe tadera kona jnana nei. ara yalimadera kona sahayyakari nei.

22:72.latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tādera nikaṭa āmāra suspaṣṭa āẏātasamūha tilāoẏāta karā haẏa takhana tumi kāphiradera mukhamaṇḍale anīhā bhāva dekhate pāve. yārā tādera nikaṭa āmāra āẏāta telāoẏāta kare tāderake tārā ākramaṇa karate udyata haẏa. vala: ‘tave ki āmi tomāderake eṭā apekṣā manda kichura saṃvāda diva? naeṭā āguna. e viṣaẏe āllāha pratiśra“ti diẏechena kāphiraderake evaṃ eṭā katai nā nikṛṣṭa pratyāvartanasthala!’
22:72.latin_ascii: evam yakhana tadera nikata amara suspasta ayatasamuha tilaoyata kara haya takhana tumi kaphiradera mukhamandale aniha bhava dekhate pave. yara tadera nikata amara ayata telaoyata kare taderake tara akramana karate udyata haya. vala: ‘tave ki ami tomaderake eta apeksa manda kichura samvada divay naeta aguna. e visaye allaha pratisra“ti diyechena kaphiraderake evam eta katai na nikrsta pratyavartanasthala!’

22:73.latin_iast: he mānuṣa! ekaṭi upamā deẏā hacche, manoyoga sahakāre tā śravaṇa kara: tomarā āllāhara parivarte yāderake ḍāka tārā to kakhano ekaṭi māchio sṛṣṭi karate pārave nā, e uddeśye tārā sakale ekatrita haleo. evaṃ māchi yadi kichu chiniẏe niẏe yāẏa tādera nikaṭa hate, eṭāo tārā tāra nikaṭa hate uddhāra karate pārave nā. prārthanākārī āra yāra kāche prārthanā karā haẏa ubhaẏei durvala.
22:73.latin_ascii: he manusa! ekati upama deya hacche, manoyoga sahakare ta sravana kara: tomara allahara parivarte yaderake daka tara to kakhano ekati machio srsti karate parave na, e uddesye tara sakale ekatrita haleo. evam machi yadi kichu chiniye niye yaya tadera nikata hate, etao tara tara nikata hate uddhara karate parave na. prarthanakari ara yara kache prarthana kara haya ubhayei durvala.

22:74.latin_iast: tārā āllāhara yathocita maryādā upaladdhi kare nā, āllāha niścaẏai kṣamatāvāna, parākramaśālī.
22:74.latin_ascii: tara allahara yathocita maryada upaladdhi kare na, allaha niscayai ksamatavana, parakramasali.

22:75.latin_iast: āllāha phereśtādera madhya hate manonīta karena vāṇīvāhaka evaṃ mānuṣera madhya hateo; āllāha sarvaśrotā, samyaka draṣṭā.
22:75.latin_ascii: allaha pherestadera madhya hate manonita karena vanivahaka evam manusera madhya hateo; allaha sarvasrota, samyaka drasta.

22:76.latin_iast: tādera sammukhe o paścāte yā kichu āche tini tā jānena evaṃ samasta viṣaẏa āllāhara nikaṭa pratyāvartita have.
22:76.latin_ascii: tadera sammukhe o pascate ya kichu ache tini ta janena evam samasta visaya allahara nikata pratyavartita have.

22:77.latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā rukū‘ kara, sijdā kara evaṃ tomādera pratipālakera ivādata kara o sat karma kara, yāte tomarā saphalakāma hate pāra.
22:77.latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara ruku‘ kara, sijda kara evam tomadera pratipalakera ivadata kara o sat karma kara, yate tomara saphalakama hate para.

22:78.latin_iast: evaṃ jihāda kara āllāhara pathe yebhāve jihāda karā ucita, tini tomāderake manonīta karechena. tini dīnera vyāpāre tomādera opara kona kaṭhoratā āropa karenani. eṭāi tomādera pitā ivrāhīmera dharma. tini pūrve tomādera nāmakaraṇa karechena ‘musalima’ evaṃ e kitāveo; yāte rāsūla tomādera janya sākṣīsvarūpa haẏa evaṃ tomarāo sākṣī hao mānava jātira janya. sutarāṃ tomarā sālāta kāẏema kara, yākāta dāo evaṃ āllāhake ā~kar̤e dhara; tinii tomādera abhibhāvaka, kata uttama abhibhāvaka evaṃ katai nā uttama sāhāyyakārī tini!
22:78.latin_ascii: evam jihada kara allahara pathe yebhave jihada kara ucita, tini tomaderake manonita karechena. tini dinera vyapare tomadera opara kona kathorata aropa karenani. etai tomadera pita ivrahimera dharma. tini purve tomadera namakarana karechena ‘musalima’ evam e kitaveo; yate rasula tomadera janya saksisvarupa haya evam tomarao saksi hao manava jatira janya. sutaram tomara salata kayema kara, yakata dao evam allahake a~kare dhara; tinii tomadera abhibhavaka, kata uttama abhibhavaka evam katai na uttama sahayyakari tini!

23:2.latin_iast: yārā nijedera sālāte vinaẏa-namratā avalamvana kare,
23:2.latin_ascii: yara nijedera salate vinaya-namrata avalamvana kare,

23:3.latin_iast: yārā asāra kriẏākalāpa hate virata thāke,
23:3.latin_ascii: yara asara kriyakalapa hate virata thake,

23:6.latin_iast: nijedera strī athavā adhikārabhukta dāsīgaṇa vyatīta, kenanā ete tārā nindanīẏa have nā,
23:6.latin_ascii: nijedera stri athava adhikarabhukta dasigana vyatita, kenana ete tara nindaniya have na,

23:7.latin_iast: āra tāderake chār̤ā keu anyake kāmanā karale tārā have sīmālaṅghanakārī,
23:7.latin_ascii: ara taderake chara keu anyake kamana karale tara have simalanghanakari,

23:8.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā nijedera āmānata o pratiśra“ti rakṣā kare
23:8.latin_ascii: evam yara nijedera amanata o pratisra“ti raksa kare

23:9.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā nijedera sālāte yatnavāna thāke
23:9.latin_ascii: evam yara nijedera salate yatnavana thake

23:11.latin_iast: uttarādhikārī have phiradāusera yāte tārā cirakāla thākave.
23:11.latin_ascii: uttaradhikari have phiradausera yate tara cirakala thakave.

23:12.latin_iast: āmi mānuṣake sṛṣṭi karechi mṛttikāra mūla upādāna hate,
23:12.latin_ascii: ami manusake srsti karechi mrttikara mula upadana hate,

23:13.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāke śukravindurūpe sthāpana kari eka surakṣita sthāne.
23:13.latin_ascii: atahpara ami take sukravindurupe sthapana kari eka suraksita sthane.

23:14.latin_iast: erapare āmi śukravinduke pariṇata kari ‘raktapiṇḍe, ataḥpara ‘raktapiṇḍake pariṇata kari māṃsapiṇḍe evaṃ māṃsapiṇḍake pariṇata kari hār̤e; ataḥpara hār̤ake ḍheke dei gośta dvārā; avaśeṣe tāke gar̤e tuli anya eka sṛṣṭirūpe. ataeva sarveāttama sraṣṭā āllāha kata varakatamaẏa!
23:14.latin_ascii: erapare ami sukravinduke parinata kari ‘raktapinde, atahpara ‘raktapindake parinata kari mamsapinde evam mamsapindake parinata kari hare; atahpara harake dheke dei gosta dvara; avasese take gare tuli anya eka srstirupe. ataeva sarveattama srasta allaha kata varakatamaya!

23:16.latin_iast: ataḥpara kiẏāmatera dina tomāderake avaśyai punarutthita karā have.
23:16.latin_ascii: atahpara kiyamatera dina tomaderake avasyai punarutthita kara have.

23:17.latin_iast: āmi to tomādera ūrdhve sṛṣṭi karechi saptastara evaṃ āmi sṛṣṭi viṣaẏe asatarka nai,
23:17.latin_ascii: ami to tomadera urdhve srsti karechi saptastara evam ami srsti visaye asatarka nai,

23:18.latin_iast: āra āmi ākāśa hate vāri varṣaṇa kari parimāṇa mata; ataḥpara āmi tā jamine saṃrakṣaṇa kari; āmi tāke apasārita karateo sakṣama.
23:18.latin_ascii: ara ami akasa hate vari varsana kari parimana mata; atahpara ami ta jamine samraksana kari; ami take apasarita karateo saksama.

23:19.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tā dvārā tomādera janya khejura o āṅgurera vāgāna sṛṣṭi kari; ete tomādera janya āche pracura phala; āra tā hate tomarā āhāra kare thāka;
23:19.latin_ascii: atahpara ami ta dvara tomadera janya khejura o angurera vagana srsti kari; ete tomadera janya ache pracura phala; ara ta hate tomara ahara kare thaka;

23:20.latin_iast: evaṃ (pānira sāhāyye) sṛṣṭi kari eka vṛkṣa yā janmāẏa sināi parvate, ete utpanna haẏa taila evaṃ āhārakārīdera janya tarakārī.
23:20.latin_ascii: evam (panira sahayye) srsti kari eka vrksa ya janmaya sinai parvate, ete utpanna haya taila evam aharakaridera janya tarakari.

23:21.latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera janya avaśyai śikṣaṇīẏa viṣaẏa āche catuṣpada jantura madhye tomāderake āmi pāna karāi tādera udare yā āche tā hate evaṃ tāte tomādera janya raẏeche pracura upakāritā; tomarā tā hate āhāra kara,
23:21.latin_ascii: evam tomadera janya avasyai siksaniya visaya ache catuspada jantura madhye tomaderake ami pana karai tadera udare ya ache ta hate evam tate tomadera janya rayeche pracura upakarita; tomara ta hate ahara kara,

23:22.latin_iast: evaṃ tāra piṭhe o nauyāne tomāderake ārohaṇa karāno haẏa.
23:22.latin_ascii: evam tara pithe o nauyane tomaderake arohana karano haya.

23:23.latin_iast: āmi nūhake pāṭhiẏechilāma tāra sampradāẏera nikaṭa. se valechila: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! āllāhara ivādata kara, tini vyatīta tomādera anya kona satyikāra mā‘vūūda nei, tavuo ki tomarā sāvadhāna have nā?’
23:23.latin_ascii: ami nuhake pathiyechilama tara sampradayera nikata. se valechila: ‘he amara sampradaya! allahara ivadata kara, tini vyatita tomadera anya kona satyikara ma‘vuuda nei, tavuo ki tomara savadhana have nay’

23:24.latin_iast: tāra sampradāẏera pradhānagaṇa yārā kupharī karechila tārā valala: ‘e to tomādera mata ekajana mānuṣai, tomādera opara śreṣṭhatva lābha karate cācche, āllāha icchā karale phereśatāi pāṭhātena; āmādera pūrvapuruṣagaṇera madhye erūpa ghaṭeche, ekathā āmarā to śunini.
23:24.latin_ascii: tara sampradayera pradhanagana yara kuphari karechila tara valala: ‘e to tomadera mata ekajana manusai, tomadera opara sresthatva labha karate cacche, allaha iccha karale pheresatai pathatena; amadera purvapurusaganera madhye erupa ghateche, ekatha amara to sunini.

23:25.latin_iast: ‘e to emana loka yāke pāgalāmī peẏe vaseche; sutarāṃ tomarā tāra samparke kichu kāla apekṣā kara.’
23:25.latin_ascii: ‘e to emana loka yake pagalami peye vaseche; sutaram tomara tara samparke kichu kala apeksa kara.’

23:26.latin_iast: nūha valechila, ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke sāhāyya kara, kāraṇa tārā āmāke mithyāvādī valache.’
23:26.latin_ascii: nuha valechila, ‘he amara pratipalaka! amake sahayya kara, karana tara amake mithyavadi valache.’

23:27.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāra nikaṭa oẏāhī pāṭhālāma, ‘tumi āmāra cokhera sāmane o āmāra nirdeśa anuyāẏī nauyāna nirmāṇa kara, ataḥpara yakhana āmāra ādeśa āsave o culāra nica theke pāni uthaliẏe uṭhave takhana uṭhiẏe nio pratyeka jīvera eka eka jor̤ā evaṃ tomāra parivāra-parijanake, tāderake chār̤ā yādera viruddhe pūrve siddhānta haẏe geche. āra tādera samparke tumi āmāke kichu vala nā yārā juluma kareche. tārā to nimajjita havei.
23:27.latin_ascii: atahpara ami tara nikata oyahi pathalama, ‘tumi amara cokhera samane o amara nirdesa anuyayi nauyana nirmana kara, atahpara yakhana amara adesa asave o culara nica theke pani uthaliye uthave takhana uthiye nio pratyeka jivera eka eka jora evam tomara parivara-parijanake, taderake chara yadera viruddhe purve siddhanta haye geche. ara tadera samparke tumi amake kichu vala na yara juluma kareche. tara to nimajjita havei.

23:28.latin_iast: yakhana tumi o tomāra saṅgīrā nauyāne ārohaṇa karave takhana vala: ‘samasta praśaṃsā āllāharai, yini āmāderake rakṣā karechena jālima sampradāẏa hate.’
23:28.latin_ascii: yakhana tumi o tomara sangira nauyane arohana karave takhana vala: ‘samasta prasamsa allaharai, yini amaderake raksa karechena jalima sampradaya hate.’

23:29.latin_iast: āro vala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke emanabhāve avataraṇa karāo yā have kalyāṇakara; āra tumii śreṣṭha avataraṇakārī.’
23:29.latin_ascii: aro vala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! amake emanabhave avatarana karao ya have kalyanakara; ara tumii srestha avataranakari.’

23:30.latin_iast: ete avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche. āra āmi to tāderake parīkṣā karechilāma.
23:30.latin_ascii: ete avasyai nidarsana rayeche. ara ami to taderake pariksa karechilama.

23:31.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera pare anya eka sampradāẏa sṛṣṭi karechilāma;
23:31.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera pare anya eka sampradaya srsti karechilama;

23:32.latin_iast: evaṃ tāderai ekajanake tādera nikaṭa rāsūla kare pāṭhiẏechilāma! se valechila: ‘tomarā āllāhara ivādata kara, tini vyatīta tomādera anya kona satyikāra mā‘vūūda nei, tavuo ki tomarā sāvadhāna have nā?’
23:32.latin_ascii: evam taderai ekajanake tadera nikata rasula kare pathiyechilama! se valechila: ‘tomara allahara ivadata kara, tini vyatita tomadera anya kona satyikara ma‘vuuda nei, tavuo ki tomara savadhana have nay’

23:33.latin_iast: tāra sampradāẏera pradhānagaṇana yārā kupharī karechila o ākhirātera sākṣātake asvīkāra karechila evaṃ yāderake āmi diẏechilāma pārthiva jīvane pracura bhoga-sambhāra, tārā valechilana ‘e to tomādera matoi ekajana mānuṣa; tomarā yā āhāra kara, se tāi āhāra kare evaṃ tomarā yā pāna kara, seo tāi pāna kare;
23:33.latin_ascii: tara sampradayera pradhanaganana yara kuphari karechila o akhiratera saksatake asvikara karechila evam yaderake ami diyechilama parthiva jivane pracura bhoga-sambhara, tara valechilana ‘e to tomadera matoi ekajana manusa; tomara ya ahara kara, se tai ahara kare evam tomara ya pana kara, seo tai pana kare;

23:34.latin_iast: ‘yadi tomarā tomāderai mata ekajana mānuṣera ānugatya kara tave tomarā avaśyai kṣatigrasta have;
23:34.latin_ascii: ‘yadi tomara tomaderai mata ekajana manusera anugatya kara tave tomara avasyai ksatigrasta have;

23:35.latin_iast: ‘se ki tomāderake e pratiśra“tii deẏa ye, yakhana tomarā mṛtyuvaraṇa karave evaṃ tomarā māṭi o hār̤e pariṇata have takhana tomāderake utthita karā have?
23:35.latin_ascii: ‘se ki tomaderake e pratisra“tii deya ye, yakhana tomara mrtyuvarana karave evam tomara mati o hare parinata have takhana tomaderake utthita kara havey

23:36.latin_iast: ‘asambhava, tomāderake ye viṣaẏe pratiśra“ti deẏā haẏeche tā aneka dūra.
23:36.latin_ascii: ‘asambhava, tomaderake ye visaye pratisra“ti deya hayeche ta aneka dura.

23:37.latin_iast: ekamātra pārthiva jīvanai āmādera jīvana, āmarā mari-vā~ci ekhānei evaṃ āmarā utthita hava nā.
23:37.latin_ascii: ekamatra parthiva jivanai amadera jivana, amara mari-va~ci ekhanei evam amara utthita hava na.

23:38.latin_iast: se to emana vyakti ye āllāha tā‘ālā samvandhe mithyā udbhāvana kareche evaṃ āmarā tāke viśvāsa karāra nai.’
23:38.latin_ascii: se to emana vyakti ye allaha ta‘ala samvandhe mithya udbhavana kareche evam amara take visvasa karara nai.’

23:39.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke sāhāyya karuna; kāraṇa tārā āmāke mithyāvādī vale.’
23:39.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! amake sahayya karuna; karana tara amake mithyavadi vale.’

23:41.latin_iast: ataḥpara satya satyai eka vikaṭa āoẏāja tāderake āghāta karala evaṃ āmi tāderake taraṅga-tār̤ita āvarjanāsadṛśa kare dilāma. sutarāṃ dhvaṃsa jālima sampradāẏera (tārā āllāha tā‘ālāra rahamata hate aneka dūre).
23:41.latin_ascii: atahpara satya satyai eka vikata aoyaja taderake aghata karala evam ami taderake taranga-tarita avarjanasadrsa kare dilama. sutaram dhvamsa jalima sampradayera (tara allaha ta‘alara rahamata hate aneka dure).

23:42.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera pare āmi vahu jāti sṛṣṭi karechi.
23:42.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera pare ami vahu jati srsti karechi.

23:43.latin_iast: kona jātii tāra nirdhārita kālera āge yete pāre nā, vilamvitao karate pāre nā.
23:43.latin_ascii: kona jatii tara nirdharita kalera age yete pare na, vilamvitao karate pare na.

23:44.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi ekera para eka āmāra rāsūla preraṇa karechi. yakhanai kona jātira nikaṭa tāra rāsūla eseche takhanai tārā tāke mithyā pratipanna kareche. ataḥpara āmi tādera ekera para eka dhvaṃsa karalāma. āmi tāderake kāhinīra viṣaẏe pariṇata karechi. sutarāṃ dhvaṃsa se sampradāẏera! yārā īmāna āne nā (āllāha tā‘ālāra rahamata hate tārā aneka dūre)!
23:44.latin_ascii: atahpara ami ekera para eka amara rasula prerana karechi. yakhanai kona jatira nikata tara rasula eseche takhanai tara take mithya pratipanna kareche. atahpara ami tadera ekera para eka dhvamsa karalama. ami taderake kahinira visaye parinata karechi. sutaram dhvamsa se sampradayera! yara imana ane na (allaha ta‘alara rahamata hate tara aneka dure)!

23:45.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi āmāra nidarśana o suspaṣṭa pramāṇasaha mūsā o tāra bhrātā hārūnake pāṭhālāma
23:45.latin_ascii: atahpara ami amara nidarsana o suspasta pramanasaha musa o tara bhrata harunake pathalama

23:46.latin_iast: phira‘āuna o tāra pāriṣadavargera nikaṭa. kintu tārā ahaṃkāra karala; tārā chila uddhata sampradāẏa.
23:46.latin_ascii: phira‘auna o tara parisadavargera nikata. kintu tara ahamkara karala; tara chila uddhata sampradaya.

23:47.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āmarā ki emana du’ vyaktira opara īmāna ānava yārā āmāderai mata evaṃ yādera sampradāẏa āmādera dāsatva kare?’
