26:226.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā tāi vale yā tārā kare nā.
26:226.latin_ascii: evam tara tai vale ya tara kare na.

26:227.latin_iast: kintu tārā vyatīta yārā īmāna āne o satkārya kare evaṃ āllāha tā‘ālāke adhika smaraṇa kare o atyācārita haoẏāra para nijedera pratirakṣāra vyavasthā kare. atyācārīrā śīghrai jānave kon sthale tārā pratyāvartana karave.
26:227.latin_ascii: kintu tara vyatita yara imana ane o satkarya kare evam allaha ta‘alake adhika smarana kare o atyacarita haoyara para nijedera pratiraksara vyavastha kare. atyacarira sighrai janave kon sthale tara pratyavartana karave.

27:1.latin_iast: tvā-sīna; egulo kuraāna evaṃ suspaṣṭa kitāvera āẏāta;
27:1.latin_ascii: tva-sina; egulo kuraana evam suspasta kitavera ayata;

27:3.latin_iast: yārā sālāta kāẏema kare o yākāta deẏa āra tārāi ākhirāte niścita viśvāsī.
27:3.latin_ascii: yara salata kayema kare o yakata deya ara tarai akhirate niscita visvasi.

27:4.latin_iast: yārā ākhirāte viśvāsa kare nā tādera dṛṣṭite tādera karmake āmi suśobhita karechi, phale tārā vibhrāntite ghure ver̤āẏa;
27:4.latin_ascii: yara akhirate visvasa kare na tadera drstite tadera karmake ami susobhita karechi, phale tara vibhrantite ghure veraya;

27:5.latin_iast: erāi tārā yādera janya raẏeche kaṭhina śāsti evaṃ erāi ākhirāte sarvādhika kṣatigrasta.
27:5.latin_ascii: erai tara yadera janya rayeche kathina sasti evam erai akhirate sarvadhika ksatigrasta.

27:6.latin_iast: niścaẏai tomāke āla-kuraāna deẏā hacche prajñāmaẏa, sarvajñera nikaṭa hate.
27:6.latin_ascii: niscayai tomake ala-kuraana deya hacche prajnamaya, sarvajnera nikata hate.

27:7.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara se samaẏera kathā, yakhana mūsā tāra parivāravargake valechila, niścaẏai ‘āmi āguna dekhechi, śīghrai āmi sethā hate tomādera janya kona khavara ānavo athavā tomādera janya ānavo jvalanta aṅgāra, yāte tomarā āguna pohāte pāro.’
27:7.latin_ascii: smarana kara se samayera katha, yakhana musa tara parivaravargake valechila, niscayai ‘ami aguna dekhechi, sighrai ami setha hate tomadera janya kona khavara anavo athava tomadera janya anavo jvalanta angara, yate tomara aguna pohate paro.’

27:8.latin_iast: ataḥpara se yakhana tāra nikaṭa āsala, takhana ghoṣita hala ‘dhanya, yārā āche e ālora madhye evaṃ yārā āche era āśepāśe, jagatasamūhera pratipālaka āllāha pavitra o mahimānvita.
27:8.latin_ascii: atahpara se yakhana tara nikata asala, takhana ghosita hala ‘dhanya, yara ache e alora madhye evam yara ache era asepase, jagatasamuhera pratipalaka allaha pavitra o mahimanvita.

27:9.latin_iast: ‘he mūsā! āmi to āllāha, parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa,
27:9.latin_ascii: ‘he musa! ami to allaha, parakramasali, prajnamaya,

27:10.latin_iast: tumi tomāra lāṭhi nikṣepa kara.’ ataḥpara yakhana se tāke sarpera nyāẏa chuṭochuṭi karate dekhala takhana se pechanera dike chuṭate lāgala evaṃ phireo tākāla nā. valā hala, ‘he mūsā! bhīta haẏo nā, niścaẏai āmi emana, āmāra sānnidhye rāsūlagaṇa bhaẏa pāẏa nā;
27:10.latin_ascii: tumi tomara lathi niksepa kara.’ atahpara yakhana se take sarpera nyaya chutochuti karate dekhala takhana se pechanera dike chutate lagala evam phireo takala na. vala hala, ‘he musa! bhita hayo na, niscayai ami emana, amara sannidhye rasulagana bhaya paya na;

27:11.latin_iast: tave yārā juluma kare ataḥpara mandakarmera parivarte satkarma kare, tādera prati āmi kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
27:11.latin_ascii: tave yara juluma kare atahpara mandakarmera parivarte satkarma kare, tadera prati ami ksamasila, parama dayalu.

27:12.latin_iast: evaṃ tumi tomāra hāta tomāra vagale rākha, eṭā vera haẏe āsave śubhra nirmala avasthāẏa. egulo hala phira‘āuna o tāra sampradāẏera nikaṭa ānīta naẏaṭi nidarśanera antargata. niścaẏai tārā chila satyatyāgī sampradāẏa.’
27:12.latin_ascii: evam tumi tomara hata tomara vagale rakha, eta vera haye asave subhra nirmala avasthaya. egulo hala phira‘auna o tara sampradayera nikata anita nayati nidarsanera antargata. niscayai tara chila satyatyagi sampradaya.’

27:13.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tādera nikaṭa āmāra spaṣṭa nidarśana āsala, tārā valala: ‘eṭā suspaṣṭa jādu.’
27:13.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tadera nikata amara spasta nidarsana asala, tara valala: ‘eta suspasta jadu.’

27:14.latin_iast: tārā anyāẏa o uddhatabhāve nidarśanagulo pratyākhyāna karala, yadio tādera antara eguloke satya vale grahaṇa karechila. dekha, viparyaẏa sṛṣṭikārīdera pariṇāma kemana haẏechila.
27:14.latin_ascii: tara anyaya o uddhatabhave nidarsanagulo pratyakhyana karala, yadio tadera antara eguloke satya vale grahana karechila. dekha, viparyaya srstikaridera parinama kemana hayechila.

27:15.latin_iast: āmi avaśyai dāūda o sulāimānake jñāna dāna karechilāma evaṃ tārā ubhaẏe valechila, sakala praśaṃsā āllāha tā‘ālāra yini āmāderake tāra vahu mu’mina vāndādera opara śreṣṭhatva diẏechena.’
27:15.latin_ascii: ami avasyai dauda o sulaimanake jnana dana karechilama evam tara ubhaye valechila, sakala prasamsa allaha ta‘alara yini amaderake tara vahu mu’mina vandadera opara sresthatva diyechena.’

27:16.latin_iast: sulāimāna haẏechila dāūdera uttarādhikārī evaṃ se valechila, ‘he mānuṣa! āmāke vihaṅgakulera bhāṣā śikṣā deẏā haẏeche evaṃ āmāke sakala kichu deẏā haẏeche, eṭā avaśyai suspaṣṭa anugraha.’
27:16.latin_ascii: sulaimana hayechila daudera uttaradhikari evam se valechila, ‘he manusa! amake vihangakulera bhasa siksa deya hayeche evam amake sakala kichu deya hayeche, eta avasyai suspasta anugraha.’

27:17.latin_iast: sulāimānera sammukhe samaveta karā hala tāra vāhinīna jina, mānuṣa o vihaṅgakulake evaṃ tāderake vinyasta karā hala vibhinna dale.
27:17.latin_ascii: sulaimanera sammukhe samaveta kara hala tara vahinina jina, manusa o vihangakulake evam taderake vinyasta kara hala vibhinna dale.

27:18.latin_iast: yakhana tārā pipīlikā adhyuṣita upatyakāẏa pau~chala takhana eka pipīlikā valala: ‘he pipīlikā vāhinī! tomarā tomādera gṛhe praveśa kara, yena sulāimāna evaṃ tāra vāhinī tādera ajñātasāre tomāderake padatale piṣiẏe nā phele.’
27:18.latin_ascii: yakhana tara pipilika adhyusita upatyakaya pau~chala takhana eka pipilika valala: ‘he pipilika vahini! tomara tomadera grhe pravesa kara, yena sulaimana evam tara vahini tadera ajnatasare tomaderake padatale pisiye na phele.’

27:19.latin_iast: sulāimāna tāra uktite mṛdu hāsya karala evaṃ valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! tumi āmāke sāmarthya dāo yāte āmi tomāra prati kṛtajñatā prakāśa karate pāri, āmāra prati o āmāra pitā-mātāra prati tumi ye anugraha karecha tāra janya evaṃ yāte āmi satkārya karate pāri, yā tumi pachanda kara evaṃ tomāra anugrahe āmāke tomāra satkarmaparāẏaṇa vāndādera śāmila kara.’
27:19.latin_ascii: sulaimana tara uktite mrdu hasya karala evam valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! tumi amake samarthya dao yate ami tomara prati krtajnata prakasa karate pari, amara prati o amara pita-matara prati tumi ye anugraha karecha tara janya evam yate ami satkarya karate pari, ya tumi pachanda kara evam tomara anugrahe amake tomara satkarmaparayana vandadera samila kara.’

27:20.latin_iast: sulāimāna vihaṅgadalera sandhāna nila evaṃ valala: ‘vyāpāra ki, hudhuda ke dekhachi nā ye! se anupasthita nā-ki?
27:20.latin_ascii: sulaimana vihangadalera sandhana nila evam valala: ‘vyapara ki, hudhuda ke dekhachi na ye! se anupasthita na-kiy

27:21.latin_iast: se upayukta kāraṇa nā darśāle āmi avaśyai tāke kaṭhina śāsti deva athavā javeh karava.’
27:21.latin_ascii: se upayukta karana na darsale ami avasyai take kathina sasti deva athava javeh karava.’

27:22.latin_iast: anativilamve hudhud ese par̤ala evaṃ valala: ‘āpani yā avagata nana āmi tā avagata haẏechi evaṃ ‘sāvā’ hate suniścita saṃvāda niẏe esechi.
27:22.latin_ascii: anativilamve hudhud ese parala evam valala: ‘apani ya avagata nana ami ta avagata hayechi evam ‘sava’ hate suniscita samvada niye esechi.

27:23.latin_iast: āmi eka nārīke dekhalāma tādera opara rājatva karache. āra tāke sakala kichui deẏā haẏeche evaṃ tāra āche eka virāṭa siṃhāsana.
27:23.latin_ascii: ami eka narike dekhalama tadera opara rajatva karache. ara take sakala kichui deya hayeche evam tara ache eka virata simhasana.

27:24.latin_iast: āmi tāke o tāra sampradāẏake dekhalāma tārā āllāha tā‘ālāra parivarte sūryake sijdā karache. śaẏatāna tādera kāryāvalī tādera nikaṭa suśobhita kareche evaṃ tāderake satpatha hate vādhā diẏeche, phale tārā satpatha pāẏa nā;
27:24.latin_ascii: ami take o tara sampradayake dekhalama tara allaha ta‘alara parivarte suryake sijda karache. sayatana tadera karyavali tadera nikata susobhita kareche evam taderake satpatha hate vadha diyeche, phale tara satpatha paya na;

27:25.latin_iast: vādhā deẏa ejanya ye, tārā yena sijdā nā kare āllāha tā‘ālāke yini ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra lukkāẏita vastuke prakāśa karena, yini jānena, yā tomarā gopana kara evaṃ yā tomarā prakāśa kara.
27:25.latin_ascii: vadha deya ejanya ye, tara yena sijda na kare allaha ta‘alake yini akasamandali o prthivira lukkayita vastuke prakasa karena, yini janena, ya tomara gopana kara evam ya tomara prakasa kara.

27:26.latin_iast: āllāha tā‘ālā, tini vyatīta kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei, tini mahāāraśera adhipati.’
27:26.latin_ascii: allaha ta‘ala, tini vyatita kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei, tini mahaarasera adhipati.’

27:27.latin_iast: sulāimāna valala: ‘āmi dekhava tumi ki satya valecha, nā tumi mithyāvādī?
27:27.latin_ascii: sulaimana valala: ‘ami dekhava tumi ki satya valecha, na tumi mithyavadiy

27:28.latin_iast: tumi yāo āmāra e patra niẏe evaṃ eṭā tādera nikaṭa arpaṇa kara; ataḥpara tādera nikaṭa hate sare thāka evaṃ lakṣya kara tādera pratikriẏā kī?’
27:28.latin_ascii: tumi yao amara e patra niye evam eta tadera nikata arpana kara; atahpara tadera nikata hate sare thaka evam laksya kara tadera pratikriya kiy’

27:29.latin_iast: se nārī valala: ‘he pāriṣadavarga! niścaẏai āmāke eka sammānita patra deẏā haẏeche;
27:29.latin_ascii: se nari valala: ‘he parisadavarga! niscayai amake eka sammanita patra deya hayeche;

27:30.latin_iast: eṭā sulāimānera nikaṭa hate evaṃ eṭā daẏāmaẏa, parama daẏālu āllāha tā‘ālāra nāme,
27:30.latin_ascii: eta sulaimanera nikata hate evam eta dayamaya, parama dayalu allaha ta‘alara name,

27:31.latin_iast: ahamikāvaśe āmāke amānya kara nā, evaṃ ānugatya svīkāra kare āmāra nikaṭa upasthita hao.’
27:31.latin_ascii: ahamikavase amake amanya kara na, evam anugatya svikara kare amara nikata upasthita hao.’

27:32.latin_iast: se nārī valala: ‘he pāriṣadavarga! āmāra e samasyāẏa tomādera abhimata dāo. āmi kona vyāpāre cūr̤ānta siddhānta grahaṇa kari nā tomādera upasthiti vyatīta.
27:32.latin_ascii: se nari valala: ‘he parisadavarga! amara e samasyaya tomadera abhimata dao. ami kona vyapare curanta siddhanta grahana kari na tomadera upasthiti vyatita.

27:33.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘āmarā to śaktiśālī o kaṭhora yoddhā; tave siddhānta grahaṇera kṣamatā āpanārai, kī ādeśa karavena tā āpani bheve dekhuna.’
27:33.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘amara to saktisali o kathora yoddha; tave siddhanta grahanera ksamata apanarai, ki adesa karavena ta apani bheve dekhuna.’

27:34.latin_iast: se valala: ‘rājā-vādaśāhrā yakhana kona janapade praveśa kare takhana tāke viparyasta kare deẏa evaṃ tathākāra maryādāvāna vyaktiderake apadastha kare, erāo erūpai karave;
27:34.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘raja-vadasahra yakhana kona janapade pravesa kare takhana take viparyasta kare deya evam tathakara maryadavana vyaktiderake apadastha kare, erao erupai karave;

27:35.latin_iast: āmi tādera nikaṭa upaḍhaukana pāṭhācchi, ataḥpara dekhi, dūterā kī niẏe phire āse.’
27:35.latin_ascii: ami tadera nikata upadhaukana pathacchi, atahpara dekhi, dutera ki niye phire ase.’

27:36.latin_iast: dūta yakhana sulāimānera nikaṭa āsala takhana sulāimāna valala: ‘tomarā ki āmāke dhana-sampada diẏe sāhāyya karacha? āllāha tā‘ālā āmāke yā diẏechena, tā tomāderake yā diẏechena tā hate utkṛṣṭa varaṃ tomarāi tomādera upaḍhaukana niẏe utphulla vodha kara.
27:36.latin_ascii: duta yakhana sulaimanera nikata asala takhana sulaimana valala: ‘tomara ki amake dhana-sampada diye sahayya karachay allaha ta‘ala amake ya diyechena, ta tomaderake ya diyechena ta hate utkrsta varam tomarai tomadera upadhaukana niye utphulla vodha kara.

27:37.latin_iast: tādera nikaṭa phire yāo, āmi avaśyai tādera viruddhe niẏe āsava eka sainyavāhinī yāra mukāvilā karāra śakti tādera nei. āmi avaśyai tāderake tathā hate vahiṣkāra karava lāñchitabhāve evaṃ tārā have avanamita.’
27:37.latin_ascii: tadera nikata phire yao, ami avasyai tadera viruddhe niye asava eka sainyavahini yara mukavila karara sakti tadera nei. ami avasyai taderake tatha hate vahiskara karava lanchitabhave evam tara have avanamita.’

27:38.latin_iast: sulāimāna āro valala: ‘he āmāra pāriṣadavarga! tārā ātmasamarpaṇa kare āmāra nikaṭa āsāra pūrve tomādera madhye ke tāra siṃhāsana āmāra nikaṭa niẏe āsave?’
27:38.latin_ascii: sulaimana aro valala: ‘he amara parisadavarga! tara atmasamarpana kare amara nikata asara purve tomadera madhye ke tara simhasana amara nikata niye asavey’

27:39.latin_iast: eka dānavākṛtira jina valala: ‘āpani āpanāra sthāna hate oṭhāra pūrvei āmi tā ene deva evaṃ e vyāpāre āmi avaśyai kṣamatāvāna, viśvasta.’
27:39.latin_ascii: eka danavakrtira jina valala: ‘apani apanara sthana hate othara purvei ami ta ene deva evam e vyapare ami avasyai ksamatavana, visvasta.’

27:40.latin_iast: kitāvera jñāna yāra chila, se valala: ‘āpani cokhera palaka phelāra pūrvei āmi tā āpanāke ene deva.’ sulāimāna yakhana seṭā sammukhe rakṣita avasthāẏa dekhalo takhana se valala: ‘eṭā āmāra pratipālakera anugraha, yāte tini āmāke parīkṣā karate pārenana āmi kṛtajña nā akṛtajña. ye kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare, se to kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare nijerai kalyāṇera janya evaṃ ye akṛtajña, se jene rākhuka ye, āmāra pratipālaka abhāvamukta, mahānubhava.’
27:40.latin_ascii: kitavera jnana yara chila, se valala: ‘apani cokhera palaka phelara purvei ami ta apanake ene deva.’ sulaimana yakhana seta sammukhe raksita avasthaya dekhalo takhana se valala: ‘eta amara pratipalakera anugraha, yate tini amake pariksa karate parenana ami krtajna na akrtajna. ye krtajnata prakasa kare, se to krtajnata prakasa kare nijerai kalyanera janya evam ye akrtajna, se jene rakhuka ye, amara pratipalaka abhavamukta, mahanubhava.’

27:41.latin_iast: sulāimāna valala: ‘tāra siṃhāsanera ākṛti parivartana kare dāo; dekhi se saṭhika diśā pāẏa, nā se vibhrāntadera madhye śāmila haẏa;
27:41.latin_ascii: sulaimana valala: ‘tara simhasanera akrti parivartana kare dao; dekhi se sathika disa paya, na se vibhrantadera madhye samila haya;

27:42.latin_iast: se nārī yakhana āsala, takhana tāke jijñesa karā hala, ‘tomāra siṃhāsana ki erūpai?’ se valala: ‘eṭā to yena seṭāi.’ āmāderake itopūrvei prakṛta jñāna dāna karā haẏeche evaṃ āmarā ātmasamarpaṇao karechi.’
27:42.latin_ascii: se nari yakhana asala, takhana take jijnesa kara hala, ‘tomara simhasana ki erupaiy’ se valala: ‘eta to yena setai.’ amaderake itopurvei prakrta jnana dana kara hayeche evam amara atmasamarpanao karechi.’

27:43.latin_iast: āllāha tā‘ālāra parivarte ye yāra pūjo karata tāi tāke satya hate virata rekheche, se chila kāphira sampradāẏera antarbhukta.
27:43.latin_ascii: allaha ta‘alara parivarte ye yara pujo karata tai take satya hate virata rekheche, se chila kaphira sampradayera antarbhukta.

27:44.latin_iast: tāke valā hala, ‘e prāsāde praveśa kara.’ yakhana se tā dekhala takhana se tāke svaccha-pariskāra jalāśaẏa mane karala evaṃ se tāra hā~ṭu vā piṇḍalī paryanta kāpar̤a uṭhālo (yena bhije nā yāẏa). sulāimāna valala: ‘eṭā to svaccha sphaṭikamaṇḍita prāsāda.’ se nārī valala: ‘ he āmāra pratipālaka! āmi to nijera prati juluma karechilāma, āmi sulāimānera sāthe jagatasamūhera pratipālaka āllāha tā‘ālāra nikaṭa ātmasamarpaṇa karachi.’
27:44.latin_ascii: take vala hala, ‘e prasade pravesa kara.’ yakhana se ta dekhala takhana se take svaccha-pariskara jalasaya mane karala evam se tara ha~tu va pindali paryanta kapara uthalo (yena bhije na yaya). sulaimana valala: ‘eta to svaccha sphatikamandita prasada.’ se nari valala: ‘ he amara pratipalaka! ami to nijera prati juluma karechilama, ami sulaimanera sathe jagatasamuhera pratipalaka allaha ta‘alara nikata atmasamarpana karachi.’

27:45.latin_iast: āmi avaśyai sāmūda sampradāẏera nikaṭa tādera bhrātā sālehke pāṭhiẏechilāma e ādeśasaha: ‘tomarā āllāha tā‘ālāra ivādata kara’, kintu tārā du'bhāge vibhakta haẏe vitarke lipta hala.
27:45.latin_ascii: ami avasyai samuda sampradayera nikata tadera bhrata salehke pathiyechilama e adesasaha: ‘tomara allaha ta‘alara ivadata kara’, kintu tara du'bhage vibhakta haye vitarke lipta hala.

27:46.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā kena kalyāṇera pūrve akalyāṇa druta kāmanā karacha? kena tomarā āllāha tā‘ālāra nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā karacha nā, yāte tomarā anugrahabhājana hate pāra?’
27:46.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara kena kalyanera purve akalyana druta kamana karachay kena tomara allaha ta‘alara nikata ksama prarthana karacha na, yate tomara anugrahabhajana hate paray’

27:47.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘tomāke o tomāra saṅge yārā āche tāderake āmarā amaṅgalera kāraṇa mane kari.’ se valala: ‘tomādera akalyāṇa āllāha tā‘ālāra ekhatiẏāre, vastuta tomarā emana eka sampradāẏa yāderake parīkṣā karā hacche.’
27:47.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘tomake o tomara sange yara ache taderake amara amangalera karana mane kari.’ se valala: ‘tomadera akalyana allaha ta‘alara ekhatiyare, vastuta tomara emana eka sampradaya yaderake pariksa kara hacche.’

27:48.latin_iast: āra se śahare chila emana naẏa vyakti, yārā deśe viparyaẏa sṛṣṭi karata evaṃ satkarma karata nā.
27:48.latin_ascii: ara se sahare chila emana naya vyakti, yara dese viparyaya srsti karata evam satkarma karata na.

27:49.latin_iast: tārā valala: ‘tomarā āllāha tā‘ālāra nāme śapatha grahaṇa kara, ‘āmarā rātrikāle tāke o tāra parivāra-parijanake avaśyai ākramaṇa karava; ataḥpara tāra abhibhāvakake niścaẏai valava, ‘tāra parivāra-parijanera hatyā āmarā pratyakṣa karini; āmarā avaśyai satyavādī.’
27:49.latin_ascii: tara valala: ‘tomara allaha ta‘alara name sapatha grahana kara, ‘amara ratrikale take o tara parivara-parijanake avasyai akramana karava; atahpara tara abhibhavakake niscayai valava, ‘tara parivara-parijanera hatya amara pratyaksa karini; amara avasyai satyavadi.’

27:50.latin_iast: tārā eka cakrānta karechila evaṃ āmio eka kauśala avalamvana karalāma, kintu tārā vujhate pāreni.
27:50.latin_ascii: tara eka cakranta karechila evam amio eka kausala avalamvana karalama, kintu tara vujhate pareni.

27:51.latin_iast: ataeva dekha, tādera cakrāntera pariṇāma kī haẏechena āmi avaśyai tāderake o tādera sampradāẏera sakalake dhvaṃsa karechi.
27:51.latin_ascii: ataeva dekha, tadera cakrantera parinama ki hayechena ami avasyai taderake o tadera sampradayera sakalake dhvamsa karechi.

27:52.latin_iast: e to tādera gharavār̤ina sīmālaṃghanahetu yā janaśūnya avasthāẏa par̤e āche; ete jñānī sampradāẏera janya avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche.
27:52.latin_ascii: e to tadera gharavarina simalamghanahetu ya janasunya avasthaya pare ache; ete jnani sampradayera janya avasyai nidarsana rayeche.

27:53.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā mu’mina o muttākī chila tāderake āmi rakṣā karechilāma.
27:53.latin_ascii: evam yara mu’mina o muttaki chila taderake ami raksa karechilama.

27:54.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara lūtera kathā, se tāra sampradāẏake valechila, ‘tomarā jene-śune kena aślīla kāja karacha,
27:54.latin_ascii: smarana kara lutera katha, se tara sampradayake valechila, ‘tomara jene-sune kena aslila kaja karacha,

27:55.latin_iast: tomarā ki kāmatṛptira janya nārīke cher̤e puruṣadera nikaṭa gamana kara? tomarā to eka ajña sampradāẏa.’
27:55.latin_ascii: tomara ki kamatrptira janya narike chere purusadera nikata gamana karay tomara to eka ajna sampradaya.’

27:56.latin_iast: uttare tāra sampradāẏera ekathā valā chār̤ā āra kona kathā chila nā ye, ‘lūta-parivārake tomādera janapada hate vahiṣkāra kare dāo, erā to emana loka yārā pavitra thākate cāẏa.’
27:56.latin_ascii: uttare tara sampradayera ekatha vala chara ara kona katha chila na ye, ‘luta-parivarake tomadera janapada hate vahiskara kare dao, era to emana loka yara pavitra thakate caya.’

27:57.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāke o tāra parijanake rakṣā karalāma, tāra strī vyatīta, tāke karechilāma dhvaṃsaprāptadera antarbhukta.
27:57.latin_ascii: atahpara ami take o tara parijanake raksa karalama, tara stri vyatita, take karechilama dhvamsapraptadera antarbhukta.

27:58.latin_iast: tādera opara bhaẏaṃkara vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karechilāma, bhīti pradarśitadera janya e varṣaṇa chila katai nā nikṛṣṭa.
27:58.latin_ascii: tadera opara bhayamkara vrsti varsana karechilama, bhiti pradarsitadera janya e varsana chila katai na nikrsta.

27:59.latin_iast: vala: ‘sakala praśaṃsā āllāharai evaṃ śānti tā~ra manonīta vāndādera prati!’ śreṣṭha ki āllāha, nā tārā yāderake śarīka kare tārā?
27:59.latin_ascii: vala: ‘sakala prasamsa allaharai evam santi ta~ra manonita vandadera prati!’ srestha ki allaha, na tara yaderake sarika kare taray

27:60.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini sṛṣṭi karechena ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī evaṃ ākāśa hate tomādera janya varṣaṇa karena vṛṣṭi; ataḥpara āmi tā dvārā manorama udyāna sṛṣṭi kari, tāra vṛkṣādi udgata karāra kṣamatā tomādera nei. āllāhara saṅge anya kona mā‘vūda āche ki? varaṃ tārā emana eka sampradāẏa yārā satyavicyuta.
27:60.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini srsti karechena akasamandali o prthivi evam akasa hate tomadera janya varsana karena vrsti; atahpara ami ta dvara manorama udyana srsti kari, tara vrksadi udgata karara ksamata tomadera nei. allahara sange anya kona ma‘vuda ache kiy varam tara emana eka sampradaya yara satyavicyuta.

27:61.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini pṛthivīke karechena vāsopayogī evaṃ tāra mājhe mājhe pravāhita karechena nadīnālā evaṃ tāte sthāpana karechena sudṛr̤ha parvata o dui dariẏāra madhye sṛṣṭi karechena antarāla; āllāhara saṅge anya kona mā‘vūda āche ki? varaṃ tādera anekei jāne nā.
27:61.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini prthivike karechena vasopayogi evam tara majhe majhe pravahita karechena nadinala evam tate sthapana karechena sudrrha parvata o dui dariyara madhye srsti karechena antarala; allahara sange anya kona ma‘vuda ache kiy varam tadera anekei jane na.

27:62.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini vipadagrasta vyaktira āhvāne sār̤ā dena, yakhana se tā~ke ḍāke evaṃ vipada-āpada dūrībhūta karena evaṃ tomāderake pṛthivīte pratinidhi karena. āllāhara saṅge anya kona mā‘vūda āche ki? tomarā ati sāmānyai upadeśa grahaṇa kare thāka.
27:62.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini vipadagrasta vyaktira ahvane sara dena, yakhana se ta~ke dake evam vipada-apada duribhuta karena evam tomaderake prthivite pratinidhi karena. allahara sange anya kona ma‘vuda ache kiy tomara ati samanyai upadesa grahana kare thaka.

27:63.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini tomāderake sthalera o jalera andhakāre patha pradarśana karena evaṃ yini svīẏa anugrahera prākkāle susaṃvādavāhī vāẏu preraṇa karena. āllāhara saṅge anya kona ilāha āche ki? tārā yāke śarīka kare āllāha tā hate aneka ūrdhve.
27:63.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini tomaderake sthalera o jalera andhakare patha pradarsana karena evam yini sviya anugrahera prakkale susamvadavahi vayu prerana karena. allahara sange anya kona ilaha ache kiy tara yake sarika kare allaha ta hate aneka urdhve.

27:64.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini ādite sṛṣṭira sūcanā karavena, ataḥpara tāra punarāvṛtti karavena evaṃ yini tomāderake ākāśa o pṛthivī hate jīvanopakaraṇa dāna karena. āllāhara saṅge anya kona mā‘vūda āche ki? vala: ‘tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave tomādera pramāṇa peśa kara.’
27:64.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini adite srstira sucana karavena, atahpara tara punaravrtti karavena evam yini tomaderake akasa o prthivi hate jivanopakarana dana karena. allahara sange anya kona ma‘vuda ache kiy vala: ‘tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave tomadera pramana pesa kara.’

27:65.latin_iast: vala ‘āllāha tā‘ālā vyatīta ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte keu adṛśya viṣaẏera jñāna rākhe nā evaṃ tārā jāne nā tārā kakhana utthita have.’
27:65.latin_ascii: vala ‘allaha ta‘ala vyatita akasamandali o prthivite keu adrsya visayera jnana rakhe na evam tara jane na tara kakhana utthita have.’

27:66.latin_iast: varaṃ ākhirāta samparke tādera jñāna to niḥśeṣa haẏe geche; tārā to e viṣaẏe sandihāna, varaṃ e viṣaẏe tārā andha.
27:66.latin_ascii: varam akhirata samparke tadera jnana to nihsesa haye geche; tara to e visaye sandihana, varam e visaye tara andha.

27:67.latin_iast: kāphirarā vale: ‘āmarā o āmādera pitṛpuruṣerā māṭite miśe geleo ki āmāderake utthita karā have?
27:67.latin_ascii: kaphirara vale: ‘amara o amadera pitrpurusera matite mise geleo ki amaderake utthita kara havey

27:68.latin_iast: e viṣaẏe to āmāderake evaṃ pūrve āmādera pūrvapuruṣaderake bhīti pradarśana karā haẏechila. eṭā to pūrvavartīdera kalpakathā vyatīta āra kichui naẏa.’
27:68.latin_ascii: e visaye to amaderake evam purve amadera purvapurusaderake bhiti pradarsana kara hayechila. eta to purvavartidera kalpakatha vyatita ara kichui naya.’

27:69.latin_iast: vala: ‘pṛthivīte paribhramaṇa kara evaṃ dekha aparādhīdera pariṇāma kī rakama haẏechila.’
27:69.latin_ascii: vala: ‘prthivite paribhramana kara evam dekha aparadhidera parinama ki rakama hayechila.’

27:70.latin_iast: tādera samparke tumi duḥkha kara nā evaṃ tādera ṣar̤ayantre mana khārāpa kara nā.
27:70.latin_ascii: tadera samparke tumi duhkha kara na evam tadera sarayantre mana kharapa kara na.

27:71.latin_iast: tārā vale: ‘tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave vala: kakhana e pratiśra“ti pūrṇa have?’
27:71.latin_ascii: tara vale: ‘tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave vala: kakhana e pratisra“ti purna havey’

27:72.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā ye viṣaẏa tār̤ātār̤i cāccha sambhavata tāra kichu tomādera nikaṭavartī haẏeche.’
27:72.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara ye visaya taratari caccha sambhavata tara kichu tomadera nikatavarti hayeche.’

27:73.latin_iast: niścaẏai tomāra pratipālaka mānuṣera prati anugrahaśīla, kintu tādera adhikāṃśai akṛtajña.
27:73.latin_ascii: niscayai tomara pratipalaka manusera prati anugrahasila, kintu tadera adhikamsai akrtajna.

27:74.latin_iast: tādera antara yā gopana kare evaṃ yā prakāśa kare tā tomāra pratipālaka avaśyai jānena.
27:74.latin_ascii: tadera antara ya gopana kare evam ya prakasa kare ta tomara pratipalaka avasyai janena.

27:75.latin_iast: ākāśe o pṛthivīte emana kona gopana rahasya nei, yā suspaṣṭa kitāve nei.
27:75.latin_ascii: akase o prthivite emana kona gopana rahasya nei, ya suspasta kitave nei.

27:76.latin_iast: vānī isarāīla ye samasta viṣaẏe matabheda karechila, e kuraāna tāra adhikāṃśa tādera nikaṭa varṇanā kare.
27:76.latin_ascii: vani isaraila ye samasta visaye matabheda karechila, e kuraana tara adhikamsa tadera nikata varnana kare.

27:77.latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai eṭā mu’minadera janya hidāẏāta o rahamata.
27:77.latin_ascii: evam niscayai eta mu’minadera janya hidayata o rahamata.

27:78.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālaka tā~ra vidhāna anuyāẏī tādera madhye phāẏasālā kare devena. tini parākramaśālī, sarvajña.
27:78.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalaka ta~ra vidhana anuyayi tadera madhye phayasala kare devena. tini parakramasali, sarvajna.

27:79.latin_iast: ataeva āllāha tā‘ālāra opara nirbhara kara; tumi to spaṣṭa satyera opara pratiṣṭhita.
27:79.latin_ascii: ataeva allaha ta‘alara opara nirbhara kara; tumi to spasta satyera opara pratisthita.

27:80.latin_iast: mṛtake tumi kathā śonāte pārave nā, vadhirakeo pārave nā āhvāna śonāte yakhana tārā piṭha phiriẏe cale yāẏa.
27:80.latin_ascii: mrtake tumi katha sonate parave na, vadhirakeo parave na ahvana sonate yakhana tara pitha phiriye cale yaya.

27:81.latin_iast: āra tumi andhaderake tādera pathabhraṣṭatā hate saṭhika pathe ānate pārave nā. tumi śonāte pārave kevala tāderake yārā āmāra nidarśanāvalīte viśvāsa kare. āra tārāi ātmasamarpaṇakārī.
27:81.latin_ascii: ara tumi andhaderake tadera pathabhrastata hate sathika pathe anate parave na. tumi sonate parave kevala taderake yara amara nidarsanavalite visvasa kare. ara tarai atmasamarpanakari.

27:82.latin_iast: yakhana ghoṣita śāsti tādera nikaṭa āsave takhana āmi māṭira bhetara hate vera karava eka jīva, yā tādera saṅge kathā valave, ejanya ye, mānuṣa āmāra nidarśane aviśvāsī.
27:82.latin_ascii: yakhana ghosita sasti tadera nikata asave takhana ami matira bhetara hate vera karava eka jiva, ya tadera sange katha valave, ejanya ye, manusa amara nidarsane avisvasi.

27:83.latin_iast: yedina āmi pratyekaṭi sampradāẏa hate ekaṭi dalake samaveta karava yārā āmāra nidarśanāvalīke asvīkāra karechila, ataḥpara tāderake sārivaddha karā have.
27:83.latin_ascii: yedina ami pratyekati sampradaya hate ekati dalake samaveta karava yara amara nidarsanavalike asvikara karechila, atahpara taderake sarivaddha kara have.

27:84.latin_iast: yakhana tārā samāgata have takhana āllāha tāderake valavena, ‘tomarā ki āmāra nidarśana pratyākhyāna karechile, yadio tā tomarā jñānāẏatta karate pārani? nāki tomarā anya kichu karachile?’
27:84.latin_ascii: yakhana tara samagata have takhana allaha taderake valavena, ‘tomara ki amara nidarsana pratyakhyana karechile, yadio ta tomara jnanayatta karate paraniy naki tomara anya kichu karachiley’

27:85.latin_iast: sīmālaṅghana karāẏa tādera opara ghoṣita śāsti ese par̤ave; phale tārā kichui valate pārave nā.
27:85.latin_ascii: simalanghana karaya tadera opara ghosita sasti ese parave; phale tara kichui valate parave na.

27:86.latin_iast: tārā ki anudhāvana kare nā ye, āmi rāta sṛṣṭi karechi tādera viśrāmera janya evaṃ divasake karechi ālokaprada. tāte mu’mina sampradāẏera janya avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche.
27:86.latin_ascii: tara ki anudhavana kare na ye, ami rata srsti karechi tadera visramera janya evam divasake karechi alokaprada. tate mu’mina sampradayera janya avasyai nidarsana rayeche.

27:87.latin_iast: evaṃ sedina śiṅgāẏa phu~tkāra deẏā have, sedina ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīra sakalei bhīta-vihvala haẏe par̤ave, tave āllāha yāderake cāivena tārā vyatīta evaṃ sakalei tāra nikaṭa āsave vinīta avasthāẏa.
27:87.latin_ascii: evam sedina singaya phu~tkara deya have, sedina akasamandali o prthivira sakalei bhita-vihvala haye parave, tave allaha yaderake caivena tara vyatita evam sakalei tara nikata asave vinita avasthaya.

27:88.latin_iast: tumi parvatamālā dekhacha, mane karacha tā acala, athaca tārā have meghapuñjera mata calamāna. eṭā āllāharai sṛṣṭi naipuṇya, yini samasta kichuke karechena suṣama. tomarā yā kara se samvandhe tini khuva avagata.
27:88.latin_ascii: tumi parvatamala dekhacha, mane karacha ta acala, athaca tara have meghapunjera mata calamana. eta allaharai srsti naipunya, yini samasta kichuke karechena susama. tomara ya kara se samvandhe tini khuva avagata.

27:89.latin_iast: ye keu satkarma niẏe āsave, se tā hate uttama pratiphala pāve evaṃ sedina tārā bhaẏa hate nirāpada thākave.
27:89.latin_ascii: ye keu satkarma niye asave, se ta hate uttama pratiphala pave evam sedina tara bhaya hate nirapada thakave.

27:90.latin_iast: ye keu asatkarma niẏe āsave, tāke adhomukhe nikṣepa karā have jāhānnāme (evaṃ tāderake valā have) ‘tomarā yā karate tārai pratiphala tomāderake deẏā hacche.’
27:90.latin_ascii: ye keu asatkarma niye asave, take adhomukhe niksepa kara have jahanname (evam taderake vala have) ‘tomara ya karate tarai pratiphala tomaderake deya hacche.’

27:91.latin_iast: āmi to ādiṣṭa haẏechi e nagarīra pratipālakera ‘ivādata karate yini tāke karechena sammānita. samasta kichu tā~rai. āmi āro ādiṣṭa haẏechi yena, āmi ātmasamarpaṇakārīdera antarbhukta hai.
27:91.latin_ascii: ami to adista hayechi e nagarira pratipalakera ‘ivadata karate yini take karechena sammanita. samasta kichu ta~rai. ami aro adista hayechi yena, ami atmasamarpanakaridera antarbhukta hai.

27:92.latin_iast: āmi āro ādiṣṭa haẏechi, kuraāna telāoẏāta karate, ataeva ye vyakti satpatha anusaraṇa kare, se satpatha anusaraṇa kare nijerai kalyāṇera janya. āra keu bhrānta patha avalamvana karale tumi vala: ‘āmi to kevala satarkakārīdera madhye ekajana.’
27:92.latin_ascii: ami aro adista hayechi, kuraana telaoyata karate, ataeva ye vyakti satpatha anusarana kare, se satpatha anusarana kare nijerai kalyanera janya. ara keu bhranta patha avalamvana karale tumi vala: ‘ami to kevala satarkakaridera madhye ekajana.’

27:93.latin_iast: āra vala: ‘sakala praśaṃsā āllāha tā‘ālārai tini tomāderake śīghrai dekhāvena tā~ra nidarśana; takhana tomarā tā cinate pārave.’ tomarā yā kara se samvandhe tomāra pratipālaka gāphila nana.
27:93.latin_ascii: ara vala: ‘sakala prasamsa allaha ta‘alarai tini tomaderake sighrai dekhavena ta~ra nidarsana; takhana tomara ta cinate parave.’ tomara ya kara se samvandhe tomara pratipalaka gaphila nana.

28:3.latin_iast: āmi tomāra nikaṭa mūsā o phira‘āunera kichu vṛttānta yathāyathabhāve varṇanā karachi, mu’mina sampradāẏera janya.
28:3.latin_ascii: ami tomara nikata musa o phira‘aunera kichu vrttanta yathayathabhave varnana karachi, mu’mina sampradayera janya.

28:4.latin_iast: niścaẏai phira‘āuna deśe (auddhata) haẏechila evaṃ sekhānakāra adhivāsīke vibhinna śreṇite vibhakta kare tādera ekaṭi śreṇike se hīnavala karechila; tādera putraderake se hatyā karata evaṃ nārīderake jīvita rākhata. niścaẏai se chila viparyaẏa sṛṣṭikārī.
28:4.latin_ascii: niscayai phira‘auna dese (auddhata) hayechila evam sekhanakara adhivasike vibhinna srenite vibhakta kare tadera ekati srenike se hinavala karechila; tadera putraderake se hatya karata evam nariderake jivita rakhata. niscayai se chila viparyaya srstikari.

28:5.latin_iast: āmi icchā karalāma, se deśe yāderake hīnavala karā haẏechila, tādera prati anugraha karate, tāderake netṛtva dāna karate o uttarādhikārī karate;
28:5.latin_ascii: ami iccha karalama, se dese yaderake hinavala kara hayechila, tadera prati anugraha karate, taderake netrtva dana karate o uttaradhikari karate;

28:6.latin_iast: evaṃ tāderake deśe kṣamatāẏa pratiṣṭhita karate, āra phira‘āuna, hāmāna o tādera vāhinīke tā dekhiẏe dite yā tādera nikaṭa tārā āśaṅkā karata.
28:6.latin_ascii: evam taderake dese ksamataya pratisthita karate, ara phira‘auna, hamana o tadera vahinike ta dekhiye dite ya tadera nikata tara asanka karata.

28:7.latin_iast: mūsāra māẏera mane āmi iṅgite nirdeśa karalāma, ‘śiśuṭike stanya dāna karate thāka. yakhana tumi tāra samparke kona āśaṅkā karave takhana tāke dariẏāẏa nikṣepa kara evaṃ bhaẏa kara nā, duḥkhao kara nā. āmi avaśyai tāke tomāra nikaṭa phiriẏe deva evaṃ tāke rāsūladera ekajana karava.’
28:7.latin_ascii: musara mayera mane ami ingite nirdesa karalama, ‘sisutike stanya dana karate thaka. yakhana tumi tara samparke kona asanka karave takhana take dariyaya niksepa kara evam bhaya kara na, duhkhao kara na. ami avasyai take tomara nikata phiriye deva evam take rasuladera ekajana karava.’

28:8.latin_iast: ataḥpara phira‘āunera lokajana tāke uṭhiẏe nila. era pariṇāma ei chila ye, se tādera śatra“ o duḥkhera kāraṇa have. avaśyai phira‘āuna, hāmāna o tādera vāhinī chila aparādhī.
28:8.latin_ascii: atahpara phira‘aunera lokajana take uthiye nila. era parinama ei chila ye, se tadera satra“ o duhkhera karana have. avasyai phira‘auna, hamana o tadera vahini chila aparadhi.

28:9.latin_iast: ataḥpara phira‘āunera strī valala: ‘e śiśu āmāra o tomāra cukṣa śītalakārī, tāke hatyā kara nā, se āmādera upakāre āsate pāre athavā āmarā tāke santāna hiseveo grahaṇa karate pāri.’ prakṛtapakṣe tārā era pariṇāma vujhate pāreni.
28:9.latin_ascii: atahpara phira‘aunera stri valala: ‘e sisu amara o tomara cuksa sitalakari, take hatya kara na, se amadera upakare asate pare athava amara take santana hiseveo grahana karate pari.’ prakrtapakse tara era parinama vujhate pareni.

28:10.latin_iast: mūsāra māẏera mana asthira haẏe giẏechila. yāte se āsthāśīla haẏa tāra janya āmi tāra manake dṛr̤ha kare nā dile se tāra paricaẏa to prakāśa karei dita.
28:10.latin_ascii: musara mayera mana asthira haye giyechila. yate se asthasila haya tara janya ami tara manake drrha kare na dile se tara paricaya to prakasa karei dita.

28:11.latin_iast: se mūsāra vonake valala: ‘era pechane pechane yāo.’ se tādera ajñātasāre dūra hate tāke dekhachila.
28:11.latin_ascii: se musara vonake valala: ‘era pechane pechane yao.’ se tadera ajnatasare dura hate take dekhachila.

28:12.latin_iast: āge thekei āmi dhātrī-stanyapāne tāke virata rākhachilāma. mūsāra vona valala: tomāderake ki āmi emana eka parivārera sandhāna deva yārā tomādera haẏe eke lālana-pālana karave evaṃ tāra maṅgalakāmī have?
28:12.latin_ascii: age thekei ami dhatri-stanyapane take virata rakhachilama. musara vona valala: tomaderake ki ami emana eka parivarera sandhana deva yara tomadera haye eke lalana-palana karave evam tara mangalakami havey

28:13.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāke phiriẏe dilāma tāra māẏera kāche yāte tāra cokha jur̤āẏa, se duḥkha nā kare evaṃ vujhate pāre ye, āllāhara pratiśra“ti niścaẏai satya; kintu tādera adhikāṃśai tā jāne nā.
28:13.latin_ascii: atahpara ami take phiriye dilama tara mayera kache yate tara cokha juraya, se duhkha na kare evam vujhate pare ye, allahara pratisra“ti niscayai satya; kintu tadera adhikamsai ta jane na.

28:14.latin_iast: yakhana mūsā pūrṇa yauvane o pariṇata vaẏase upanīta hala takhana āmi tāke hikamata o jñāna dāna karalāma; ebhāvei āmi sat karmaparāẏaṇaderake puraskāra pradāna kare thāki.
28:14.latin_ascii: yakhana musa purna yauvane o parinata vayase upanita hala takhana ami take hikamata o jnana dana karalama; ebhavei ami sat karmaparayanaderake puraskara pradana kare thaki.

28:15.latin_iast: se nagarīte praveśa karala, yakhana era adhivāsīrā chila asatarka. sekhāne se duiṭi lokake saṃgharṣe lipta dekhala, ekajana tāra nija dalera evaṃ apara jana tāra śatra“dalera. mūsāra dalera lokaṭi tāra śatra“ra viruddhe tāra sāhāyya prārthanā karala, takhana mūsā tāke ghuṣi mārala; ebhāve se tāke hatyā kare vasala. mūsā valala: ‘eṭā śaẏatānera kāja. se to prakāśya śatra“ o vibhrāntakārī.’
28:15.latin_ascii: se nagarite pravesa karala, yakhana era adhivasira chila asatarka. sekhane se duiti lokake samgharse lipta dekhala, ekajana tara nija dalera evam apara jana tara satra“dalera. musara dalera lokati tara satra“ra viruddhe tara sahayya prarthana karala, takhana musa take ghusi marala; ebhave se take hatya kare vasala. musa valala: ‘eta sayatanera kaja. se to prakasya satra“ o vibhrantakari.’

28:16.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! niścaẏai āmi āmāra nijera prati juluma karechi; sutarāṃ āmāke kṣamā karuna.’ ataḥpara tini tāke kṣamā karalena. tini to kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
28:16.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! niscayai ami amara nijera prati juluma karechi; sutaram amake ksama karuna.’ atahpara tini take ksama karalena. tini to ksamasila, parama dayalu.

28:17.latin_iast: se āro valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āpani yehetu āmāra prati anugraha karechena, āmi kakhanao aparādhīdera sāhāyyakārī hava nā.’
28:17.latin_ascii: se aro valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! apani yehetu amara prati anugraha karechena, ami kakhanao aparadhidera sahayyakari hava na.’

28:18.latin_iast: ataḥpara bhīta-santrasta avasthāẏa se nagarīte tāra prabhāta hala. haṭhāt se śunate pela āgera dine ye vyakti tāra sāhāyya ceẏechila, se tāra sāhāyyera janya citkāra karache. mūsā tāke valala: ‘tumi to spaṣṭai ekajana vibhrānta vyakti.’
28:18.latin_ascii: atahpara bhita-santrasta avasthaya se nagarite tara prabhata hala. hathat se sunate pela agera dine ye vyakti tara sahayya ceyechila, se tara sahayyera janya citkara karache. musa take valala: ‘tumi to spastai ekajana vibhranta vyakti.’

28:19.latin_iast: ataḥpara mūsā yakhana ubhaẏera śatra“ke dharate udyata hala, takhana se vyakti vale uṭhala, ‘he mūsā! tumi yemana gatakāla eka vyaktike hatyā karecha, sebhāve āmākeo ki hatyā karate cāo? tumi to pṛthivīte svecchācārī hate cāccha, śānti sthāpanakārī hate cāo nā.’
28:19.latin_ascii: atahpara musa yakhana ubhayera satra“ke dharate udyata hala, takhana se vyakti vale uthala, ‘he musa! tumi yemana gatakala eka vyaktike hatya karecha, sebhave amakeo ki hatya karate caoy tumi to prthivite svecchacari hate caccha, santi sthapanakari hate cao na.’

28:20.latin_iast: nagarīra dūra prānta hate eka vyakti chuṭe ese valala: ‘he mūsā! pāriṣadavarga tomāke hatyā karāra parāmarśa karache. sutarāṃ tumi vāire cale yāo, niścaẏai āmi tomāra maṅgalakāmī.’
28:20.latin_ascii: nagarira dura pranta hate eka vyakti chute ese valala: ‘he musa! parisadavarga tomake hatya karara paramarsa karache. sutaram tumi vaire cale yao, niscayai ami tomara mangalakami.’

28:21.latin_iast: bhīta santrasta avasthāẏa se sekhāna theke vera haẏe par̤ala evaṃ valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āpani jālima sampradāẏa hate āmāke rakṣā karuna.’
28:21.latin_ascii: bhita santrasta avasthaya se sekhana theke vera haye parala evam valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! apani jalima sampradaya hate amake raksa karuna.’

28:22.latin_iast: yakhana mūsā mādaiẏāna abhimukhe yātrā karala takhana valala: ‘āśā kari āmāra pratipālaka āmāke sarala patha pradarśana karavena.’
28:22.latin_ascii: yakhana musa madaiyana abhimukhe yatra karala takhana valala: ‘asa kari amara pratipalaka amake sarala patha pradarsana karavena.’

28:23.latin_iast: yakhana se mādaiẏānera kūpera nikaṭa pau~chala, dekhala, ekadala loka tādera paśuguloke pāni pāna karācche evaṃ tādera pechane du’jana nārī tādera paśuguloke āgalācche. mūsā valala: ‘tomādera kī vyāpāra?’ tārā valala: āmarā āmādera paśuguloke pāni pāna karāte pāri nā, yatakṣaṇa rākhālerā tādera paśuguloke niẏe sare nā yāẏa. āra āmādera pitā ati vṛddha.’
28:23.latin_ascii: yakhana se madaiyanera kupera nikata pau~chala, dekhala, ekadala loka tadera pasuguloke pani pana karacche evam tadera pechane du’jana nari tadera pasuguloke agalacche. musa valala: ‘tomadera ki vyaparay’ tara valala: amara amadera pasuguloke pani pana karate pari na, yataksana rakhalera tadera pasuguloke niye sare na yaya. ara amadera pita ati vrddha.’

28:24.latin_iast: mūsā takhana tādera pakṣe paśuguloke pāni pāna karāla. tārapara se chāẏāra nice āśraẏa grahaṇa kare valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! āpani āmāra prati ye anugraha karavena āmi to tāra kāṅgāla.’
28:24.latin_ascii: musa takhana tadera pakse pasuguloke pani pana karala. tarapara se chayara nice asraya grahana kare valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! apani amara prati ye anugraha karavena ami to tara kangala.’

28:25.latin_iast: takhana nārīdvaẏera ekajana śarama-jar̤ita pāẏe tāra nikaṭa āsala evaṃ valala: ‘āmāra pitā tomāke āmantraṇa kareche, āmādera paśuguloke pāni pāna karānora pāriśramika deẏāra janya.’ ataḥpara mūsā tāra nikaṭa ese samasta ghaṭanā varṇanā karale se valala: bhaẏa kara nā, tumi jālima sampradāẏera kavala theke ve~ce gecha.
28:25.latin_ascii: takhana naridvayera ekajana sarama-jarita paye tara nikata asala evam valala: ‘amara pita tomake amantrana kareche, amadera pasuguloke pani pana karanora parisramika deyara janya.’ atahpara musa tara nikata ese samasta ghatana varnana karale se valala: bhaya kara na, tumi jalima sampradayera kavala theke ve~ce gecha.

28:26.latin_iast: tādera ekajana valala: ‘he pitā! āpani tāke majura niyukta karuna, kāraṇa āpanāra majura hiseve uttama have se vyakti, ye śaktiśālī, viśvasta.’
28:26.latin_ascii: tadera ekajana valala: ‘he pita! apani take majura niyukta karuna, karana apanara majura hiseve uttama have se vyakti, ye saktisali, visvasta.’

28:27.latin_iast: se mūsāke valala: ‘āmi āmāra e kanyādvaẏera ekajanake tomāra saṅge vivāha dite cāi, e śarte ye, tumi āṭa vatsara āmāra kāja karave, yadi tumi daśa vatsara pūrṇa kara, se tomāra icchā. āmi tomāke kaṣṭa dite cāi nā. āllāha icchā karale tumi āmāke sat karmaparāẏaṇa pāve.’
28:27.latin_ascii: se musake valala: ‘ami amara e kanyadvayera ekajanake tomara sange vivaha dite cai, e sarte ye, tumi ata vatsara amara kaja karave, yadi tumi dasa vatsara purna kara, se tomara iccha. ami tomake kasta dite cai na. allaha iccha karale tumi amake sat karmaparayana pave.’

28:28.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘āmāra o āpanāra madhye e cuktii raila. e dui meẏādera kona ekaṭi āmi pūrṇa karale āmāra viruddhe kona abhiyoga thākave nā. āmarā ye viṣaẏe kathā valachi āllāha tāra sākṣī.’
28:28.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘amara o apanara madhye e cuktii raila. e dui meyadera kona ekati ami purna karale amara viruddhe kona abhiyoga thakave na. amara ye visaye katha valachi allaha tara saksi.’

28:29.latin_iast: mūsā yakhana tāra meẏāda pūrṇa karāra para parivāra niẏe yātrā karala, takhana se tūra parvatera dike āguna dekhate pela. se tāra parivārake valala: ‘tomarā apekṣā kara, āmi āguna dekhachi sambhavata āmi sekhāna hate tomādera janya khavara ānate pāri athavā ekakhaṇḍa jvalanta kāṭha ānate pāri yāte tomarā āguna pohāte pāra.’
28:29.latin_ascii: musa yakhana tara meyada purna karara para parivara niye yatra karala, takhana se tura parvatera dike aguna dekhate pela. se tara parivarake valala: ‘tomara apeksa kara, ami aguna dekhachi sambhavata ami sekhana hate tomadera janya khavara anate pari athava ekakhanda jvalanta katha anate pari yate tomara aguna pohate para.’

28:30.latin_iast: yakhana mūsā āgunera nikaṭa pau~chala takhana upatyakāra dakṣiṇa pārśve pavitra bhūmisthita eka vṛkṣera dika hate tāke āhvāna kare valā hala, ‘he mūsā! āmii āllāha, jagatasamūhera pratipālaka;
28:30.latin_ascii: yakhana musa agunera nikata pau~chala takhana upatyakara daksina parsve pavitra bhumisthita eka vrksera dika hate take ahvana kare vala hala, ‘he musa! amii allaha, jagatasamuhera pratipalaka;

28:31.latin_iast: (ārao valā hala) ‘tumi tomāra lāṭhi nikṣepa kara.’ ataḥpara se yakhana tāke chuṭochuṭi karate dekhala yena oṭā ekaṭā sāpa takhana pechanera dike chuṭate lāgala evaṃ phire tākāla nā. (tāke valā hala) ‘he mūsā! sammukhe āsa, bhaẏa kara nā; tumi niścaẏai nirāpada.
28:31.latin_ascii: (arao vala hala) ‘tumi tomara lathi niksepa kara.’ atahpara se yakhana take chutochuti karate dekhala yena ota ekata sapa takhana pechanera dike chutate lagala evam phire takala na. (take vala hala) ‘he musa! sammukhe asa, bhaya kara na; tumi niscayai nirapada.

28:32.latin_iast: ‘tomāra hāta tomāra vagale rākha, eṭā vera haẏe āsave śubhra-samujjvala nirdeāṣa haẏe. bhaẏa dūra karāra janya tomāra hastadvaẏa nijera dike cepe dhara. e duṭi tomāra pratipālakera pradatta pramāṇa, phira‘āuna o tāra pāriṣadavargera janya. niścaẏai tārā satyatyāgī sampradāẏa.
28:32.latin_ascii: ‘tomara hata tomara vagale rakha, eta vera haye asave subhra-samujjvala nirdeasa haye. bhaya dura karara janya tomara hastadvaya nijera dike cepe dhara. e duti tomara pratipalakera pradatta pramana, phira‘auna o tara parisadavargera janya. niscayai tara satyatyagi sampradaya.

28:33.latin_iast: mūsā valala: he āmāra pratipālaka āmi to tādera ekajanake hatyā karechi. phale āmi āśaṅkā karachi tārā āmāke hatyā karave.
28:33.latin_ascii: musa valala: he amara pratipalaka ami to tadera ekajanake hatya karechi. phale ami asanka karachi tara amake hatya karave.

28:34.latin_iast: ‘āmāra bhāi hārūna āmāra theke vāgmī; ataeva tāke āmāra sāhāyyakārīrūpe preraṇa karuna, se āmāke samarthana karave. āmi āśaṅkā karachi tārā āmāke mithyāvādī valave.’
28:34.latin_ascii: ‘amara bhai haruna amara theke vagmi; ataeva take amara sahayyakarirupe prerana karuna, se amake samarthana karave. ami asanka karachi tara amake mithyavadi valave.’

28:35.latin_iast: āllāha valalena: ‘āmi tomāra bhāiẏera dvārā tomāra vāhu śaktiśālī karava evaṃ tomādera ubhaẏake pramāṇapuñji dāna karava. tārā tomādera nikaṭa pau~chāte pārave nā. tomarā evaṃ tomādera anusārīrā āmāra nidarśanavale tādera opara vijaẏī have.’
28:35.latin_ascii: allaha valalena: ‘ami tomara bhaiyera dvara tomara vahu saktisali karava evam tomadera ubhayake pramanapunji dana karava. tara tomadera nikata pau~chate parave na. tomara evam tomadera anusarira amara nidarsanavale tadera opara vijayi have.’

28:36.latin_iast: mūsā yakhana tādera nikaṭa āmāra suspaṣṭa nidarśanagulo niẏe āsala, tārā valala: ‘eṭā to suspaṣṭa jādu mātra. āmādera pūrvapuruṣera samaẏa kakhanao erūpa kathā śunini.’
28:36.latin_ascii: musa yakhana tadera nikata amara suspasta nidarsanagulo niye asala, tara valala: ‘eta to suspasta jadu matra. amadera purvapurusera samaya kakhanao erupa katha sunini.’

28:37.latin_iast: mūsā valala: ‘āmāra pratipālaka samyaka avagata, ke tā~ra nikaṭa hate pathanirdeśa niẏe eseche evaṃ ākhirāte kāra pariṇāma śubha have. jālimarā kakhano saphalakāma have nā.’
28:37.latin_ascii: musa valala: ‘amara pratipalaka samyaka avagata, ke ta~ra nikata hate pathanirdesa niye eseche evam akhirate kara parinama subha have. jalimara kakhano saphalakama have na.’

28:38.latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala: ‘he pāriṣadavarga. āmi vyatīta tomādera anya kona ilāha āche vale āmi jāni nā. he hāmāna! tumi āmāra janya iṭa por̤āo evaṃ ekaṭi suucca prāsāda tairi kara; haẏata āmi tāte uṭhe mūsāra ilāhake dekhate pāva. tave āmi avaśyai mane kari se mithyāvadī.’
28:38.latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala: ‘he parisadavarga. ami vyatita tomadera anya kona ilaha ache vale ami jani na. he hamana! tumi amara janya ita porao evam ekati suucca prasada tairi kara; hayata ami tate uthe musara ilahake dekhate pava. tave ami avasyai mane kari se mithyavadi.’

28:39.latin_iast: phira‘āuna o tāra vāhinī anyāẏabhāve pṛthivīte ahaṅkāra karechila evaṃ tārā mane karechila ye, tārā āmāra nikaṭa pratyāvartita have nā.
28:39.latin_ascii: phira‘auna o tara vahini anyayabhave prthivite ahankara karechila evam tara mane karechila ye, tara amara nikata pratyavartita have na.

28:40.latin_iast: ataeva āmi tāke o tāra vāhinīke pākar̤āo karalāma evaṃ tāderake samudre nikṣepa karalāma. dekha, jālimadera pariṇāma kemana chila.
28:40.latin_ascii: ataeva ami take o tara vahinike pakarao karalama evam taderake samudre niksepa karalama. dekha, jalimadera parinama kemana chila.

28:41.latin_iast: tāderake āmi netā karechilāma; tārā lokaderake jāhānnāmera dike āhvāna karata; kiẏāmatera dina tāderake sāhāyya karā have nā.
28:41.latin_ascii: taderake ami neta karechilama; tara lokaderake jahannamera dike ahvana karata; kiyamatera dina taderake sahayya kara have na.

28:42.latin_iast: e pṛthivīte āmi tādera opara lāgiẏe diẏechi abhisampāta evaṃ kiẏāmatera dina tārā have ghṛṇita.
28:42.latin_ascii: e prthivite ami tadera opara lagiye diyechi abhisampata evam kiyamatera dina tara have ghrnita.

28:82.latin_ascii: gatakala yara tara mata havara kamana karachila, tara valate lagala: ‘dekhale to, allaha tara vandadera madhye yara janya iccha tara riyika vardhita karena evam yara janya iccha hrasa karena. yadi allaha amadera prati sadaya na hatena tave amaderakeo tini bhugarbhe prothita karatena. dekhale to! kaphirara saphalakama haya na.’

28:83.latin_iast: eṭā ākhirātera se āvāsa yā āmi nirdhārita karechi tādera janya yārā e pṛthivīte auddhatya prakāśa karate o viparyaẏa sṛṣṭi karate cāẏa nā. āra śubha pariṇāma muttākīdera janya.
28:83.latin_ascii: eta akhiratera se avasa ya ami nirdharita karechi tadera janya yara e prthivite auddhatya prakasa karate o viparyaya srsti karate caya na. ara subha parinama muttakidera janya.

28:84.latin_iast: ye keu sat karma niẏe upasthita have tāra janya raẏeche tā apekṣā uttama pratidāna, āra ye mandakarma niẏe upasthita have tāderake tārā yā kareche tārai śāsti deẏā have.
28:84.latin_ascii: ye keu sat karma niye upasthita have tara janya rayeche ta apeksa uttama pratidana, ara ye mandakarma niye upasthita have taderake tara ya kareche tarai sasti deya have.

28:85.latin_iast: yini tomāra janya kuraānake karechena vidhāna tini tomāke avaśyai phiriẏe ānavena janmabhūmite. vala: ‘āmāra pratipālaka bhāla jānena ke sat pathera nirdeśa niẏe eseche evaṃ ke spaṣṭa vibhrāntite āche.’
28:85.latin_ascii: yini tomara janya kuraanake karechena vidhana tini tomake avasyai phiriye anavena janmabhumite. vala: ‘amara pratipalaka bhala janena ke sat pathera nirdesa niye eseche evam ke spasta vibhrantite ache.’

28:86.latin_iast: tumi āśā karani ye, tomāra prati kitāva avatīrṇa karā have. eṭā kevala tomāra pratipālakera anugraha. sutarāṃ tumi kakhanao kāphiradera sahāẏa haẏo nā.
28:86.latin_ascii: tumi asa karani ye, tomara prati kitava avatirna kara have. eta kevala tomara pratipalakera anugraha. sutaram tumi kakhanao kaphiradera sahaya hayo na.

28:87.latin_iast: tomāra prati āllāhara āẏāta avatīrṇa haoẏāra para tārā yena tomāke kichutei segulo hate vimukha karate nā pāre. tumi tomāra pratipālakera dike āhvāna kara evaṃ kichutei muśarikadera antarbhukta haẏo nā.
28:87.latin_ascii: tomara prati allahara ayata avatirna haoyara para tara yena tomake kichutei segulo hate vimukha karate na pare. tumi tomara pratipalakera dike ahvana kara evam kichutei musarikadera antarbhukta hayo na.

28:88.latin_iast: tumi āllāhara sāthe anya ilāhake ḍeka nā, tini vyatīta anya kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei. tā~ra cehārā vyatīta samasta kichui dhvaṃsaśīla. vidhāna tā~rai evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa tomarā pratyāvartita have.
28:88.latin_ascii: tumi allahara sathe anya ilahake deka na, tini vyatita anya kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei. ta~ra cehara vyatita samasta kichui dhvamsasila. vidhana ta~rai evam ta~rai nikata tomara pratyavartita have.

29:2.latin_iast: mānuṣa ki mane kare ye, ‘āmarā īmāna enechi e kathā valalei tāderake parīkṣā nā kare avyāhati diẏe deẏā have?
29:2.latin_ascii: manusa ki mane kare ye, ‘amara imana enechi e katha valalei taderake pariksa na kare avyahati diye deya havey

29:3.latin_iast: āmi to edera pūrvavartīderakeo parīkṣā karechilāma; āllāha avaśyai prakāśa kare devena kārā satyavādī evaṃ tini avaśyai prakāśa kare devena kārā mithyāvādī.
29:3.latin_ascii: ami to edera purvavartiderakeo pariksa karechilama; allaha avasyai prakasa kare devena kara satyavadi evam tini avasyai prakasa kare devena kara mithyavadi.

29:4.latin_iast: ve ki yārā manda kāja kare tārā mane kare ye, tārā āmāra āẏattera vāire cale yāve? tādera siddhānta katai nā manda!
29:4.latin_ascii: ve ki yara manda kaja kare tara mane kare ye, tara amara ayattera vaire cale yavey tadera siddhanta katai na manda!

29:5.latin_iast: ye āllāhara sākṣāta kāmanā kare se jene rākhuka, āllāhara nirdhārita kāla āsavei. tini sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
29:5.latin_ascii: ye allahara saksata kamana kare se jene rakhuka, allahara nirdharita kala asavei. tini sarvasrota, sarvajna.

29:6.latin_iast: ye keu (āllāhara pathe) sarvātmaka praceṣṭā kare, se tāra nijera kalyāṇera janyai praceṣṭā kare; niścaẏai āllāha viśvajagata hate amukhāpekṣī.
29:6.latin_ascii: ye keu (allahara pathe) sarvatmaka pracesta kare, se tara nijera kalyanera janyai pracesta kare; niscayai allaha visvajagata hate amukhapeksi.

29:7.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare niścaẏai āmi tādera hate tādera manda karmagulo miṭiẏe deva evaṃ avaśyai āmi tāderake pratidāna deva tārā ye uttama kāja karata tāra.
29:7.latin_ascii: evam yara imana ane o sat karma kare niscayai ami tadera hate tadera manda karmagulo mitiye deva evam avasyai ami taderake pratidana deva tara ye uttama kaja karata tara.

29:8.latin_iast: āmi mānuṣake nirdeśa diẏechi tāra pitā-mātāra prati sadvyavahāra karate. tave tārā yadi tomāra opara vala praẏoga kare āmāra sāthe emana kichuke śarīka karāra janya yāra samparke tomāra kona jñāna nei, tumi tāderake anusaraṇa kara nā. āmārai nikaṭa tomādera pratyāvartana. ataḥpara āmi tomāderake jāniẏe deva tomarā kī āmala karachile.
29:8.latin_ascii: ami manusake nirdesa diyechi tara pita-matara prati sadvyavahara karate. tave tara yadi tomara opara vala prayoga kare amara sathe emana kichuke sarika karara janya yara samparke tomara kona jnana nei, tumi taderake anusarana kara na. amarai nikata tomadera pratyavartana. atahpara ami tomaderake janiye deva tomara ki amala karachile.

29:9.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare āmi avaśyai tāderake satkarmaparāẏaṇadera antarbhukta karava.
29:9.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o sat karma kare ami avasyai taderake satkarmaparayanadera antarbhukta karava.

29:10.latin_iast: mānuṣera madhye keu keu vale: ‘āmarā āllāhate viśvāsa kari, kintu āllāhara pathe yakhana tārā kaṣṭaprāpta haẏa, takhana tārā mānuṣera pīr̤anake āllāhara śāstira mata gaṇya kare evaṃ tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa hate kona sāhāyya āsale tārā valate thāke, ‘āmarā to tomādera saṅgei chilāma.’ viśvavāsīra antare yā āche āllāha ki tā samyaka avagata nana?
29:10.latin_ascii: manusera madhye keu keu vale: ‘amara allahate visvasa kari, kintu allahara pathe yakhana tara kastaprapta haya, takhana tara manusera piranake allahara sastira mata ganya kare evam tomara pratipalakera nikata hate kona sahayya asale tara valate thake, ‘amara to tomadera sangei chilama.’ visvavasira antare ya ache allaha ki ta samyaka avagata nanay

29:11.latin_iast: āllāha avaśyai prakāśa kare devena kārā īmāna eneche evaṃ avaśyai prakāśa kare devena kārā munāphika.
29:11.latin_ascii: allaha avasyai prakasa kare devena kara imana eneche evam avasyai prakasa kare devena kara munaphika.

29:12.latin_iast: kāphirarā mu’minaderake vale: ‘āmādera patha anusaraṇa kara tāhale āmarā tomādera pāpabhāra vahana karava.’ kintu tārā to tādera pāpabhārera kichui vahana karave nā. tārā avaśyai mithyāvādī.
29:12.latin_ascii: kaphirara mu’minaderake vale: ‘amadera patha anusarana kara tahale amara tomadera papabhara vahana karava.’ kintu tara to tadera papabharera kichui vahana karave na. tara avasyai mithyavadi.

29:13.latin_iast: tārā avaśyai nijedera pāpera bhāra vahana karave evaṃ nijedera vojhāra sāthe ārao kichu vojhā; āra tārā ye mithyā udbhāvana karata se samparke kiẏāmata divase avaśyai tāderake praśna karā have.
29:13.latin_ascii: tara avasyai nijedera papera bhara vahana karave evam nijedera vojhara sathe arao kichu vojha; ara tara ye mithya udbhavana karata se samparke kiyamata divase avasyai taderake prasna kara have.

29:14.latin_iast: āmi to nūhake tāra sampradāẏera nikaṭa preraṇa karechilāma. se tādera madhye avasthāna karechila pañcāśa vachara kama hājāra vachara. ataḥpara plāvana tāderake grāsa karala; kāraṇa tārā chila sīmālaṅghanakārī.
29:14.latin_ascii: ami to nuhake tara sampradayera nikata prerana karechilama. se tadera madhye avasthana karechila pancasa vachara kama hajara vachara. atahpara plavana taderake grasa karala; karana tara chila simalanghanakari.

29:15.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāke evaṃ yārā taraṇīte ārohaṇa karechila tāderake rakṣā karalāma evaṃ viśvagajatera janya tāke karalāma ekaṭi nidarśana.
29:15.latin_ascii: atahpara ami take evam yara taranite arohana karechila taderake raksa karalama evam visvagajatera janya take karalama ekati nidarsana.

29:16.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! ivarāhīmera kathā, yakhana se tāra sampradāẏake valechila, tomarā āllāhara ivādata kara evaṃ tā~ke bhaẏa kara; eṭā tomādera janya uttama yadi tomarā jānate!
29:16.latin_ascii: smarana kara! ivarahimera katha, yakhana se tara sampradayake valechila, tomara allahara ivadata kara evam ta~ke bhaya kara; eta tomadera janya uttama yadi tomara janate!

29:17.latin_iast: tomarā to āllāha vyatīta kevala mūrtipūjo karacha evaṃ mithyā udbhāvana karacha. tomarā āllāha vyatīta yādera pūjo kara tārā tomādera jīvanopakaraṇera kṣamatā rākhe nā, tomarā riyika kāmanā kara āllāhara nikaṭa evaṃ tā~rai ivādata kara o tā~ra prati kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara. tomarā tā~rai nikaṭa pratyāvartita have.
29:17.latin_ascii: tomara to allaha vyatita kevala murtipujo karacha evam mithya udbhavana karacha. tomara allaha vyatita yadera pujo kara tara tomadera jivanopakaranera ksamata rakhe na, tomara riyika kamana kara allahara nikata evam ta~rai ivadata kara o ta~ra prati krtajnata prakasa kara. tomara ta~rai nikata pratyavartita have.

29:18.latin_iast: tomarā yadi asvīkāra kara tave to tomādera pūrvavartīgaṇao asvīkāra karechila. suspaṣṭabhāve pracāra kare deẏā vyatīta rāsūlera āra kona dāẏitva nei.
29:18.latin_ascii: tomara yadi asvikara kara tave to tomadera purvavartiganao asvikara karechila. suspastabhave pracara kare deya vyatita rasulera ara kona dayitva nei.

29:19.latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya kare nā, kibhāve āllāha sṛṣṭira sūcanā karena, ataḥpara tā punarāẏa sṛṣṭi karena? eṭā āllāhara janya sahaja.
29:19.latin_ascii: tara ki laksya kare na, kibhave allaha srstira sucana karena, atahpara ta punaraya srsti karenay eta allahara janya sahaja.

29:20.latin_iast: vala: ‘tomarā pṛthivīte paribhramaṇa kara evaṃ anudhāvana kara, kibhāve tini sṛṣṭi ārambha karechena? ataḥpara āllāha sṛṣṭi karavena paravartī sṛṣṭi. niścaẏai āllāha sarva viṣaẏe sarvaśaktimāna.
29:20.latin_ascii: vala: ‘tomara prthivite paribhramana kara evam anudhavana kara, kibhave tini srsti arambha karechenay atahpara allaha srsti karavena paravarti srsti. niscayai allaha sarva visaye sarvasaktimana.

29:21.latin_iast: tini yāke icchā śāsti dena evaṃ yāra prati icchā anugraha karena. āra tomarā tā~rai nikaṭa pratyāvartita have.
29:21.latin_ascii: tini yake iccha sasti dena evam yara prati iccha anugraha karena. ara tomara ta~rai nikata pratyavartita have.

29:22.latin_iast: tomarā āllāhake vyartha karate pārave nā pṛthivīte, āra nā ākāśe evaṃ āllāha vyatīta tomādera kona abhibhāvaka nei, sāhāyyakārīo nei.
29:22.latin_ascii: tomara allahake vyartha karate parave na prthivite, ara na akase evam allaha vyatita tomadera kona abhibhavaka nei, sahayyakario nei.

29:23.latin_iast: yārā āllāhara nidarśana o tā~ra sākṣāta asvīkāra kare, tārāi āmāra anugraha hate nirāśa haẏa. āra tādera janya raẏeche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
29:23.latin_ascii: yara allahara nidarsana o ta~ra saksata asvikara kare, tarai amara anugraha hate nirasa haya. ara tadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

29:24.latin_iast: ataḥpara tāra sampradāẏera e kathā valā chār̤ā kona uttara chila nā ye, ‘eke hatyā kara athavā agnidagdha kara.’ kintu āllāha tāke agni hate rakṣā karalena. ete avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche mu’mina sampradāẏera janya.
29:24.latin_ascii: atahpara tara sampradayera e katha vala chara kona uttara chila na ye, ‘eke hatya kara athava agnidagdha kara.’ kintu allaha take agni hate raksa karalena. ete avasyai nidarsana rayeche mu’mina sampradayera janya.

29:25.latin_iast: se valala: ‘tomarā to āllāhara parivarte mūrtiguloke upāsyarūpe grahaṇa karecha, pārthiva jīvane tomādera pārasparika vandhutvera khātire. pare kiẏāmatera dina tomarā eke aparake asvīkāra karave evaṃ paraspara parasparake abhiśāpa deve. tomādera āvāsa have jāhānnāma evaṃ tomādera kona sāhāyyakārī thākave nā.’
29:25.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘tomara to allahara parivarte murtiguloke upasyarupe grahana karecha, parthiva jivane tomadera parasparika vandhutvera khatire. pare kiyamatera dina tomara eke aparake asvikara karave evam paraspara parasparake abhisapa deve. tomadera avasa have jahannama evam tomadera kona sahayyakari thakave na.’

29:26.latin_iast: lūta tā~ra prati viśvāsa sthāpana karala. ivarāhīma valala: ‘āmi āmāra pratipālakera uddeśye deśa tyāga karachi, tini parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa.’
29:26.latin_ascii: luta ta~ra prati visvasa sthapana karala. ivarahima valala: ‘ami amara pratipalakera uddesye desa tyaga karachi, tini parakramasali, prajnamaya.’

29:27.latin_iast: āmi tāke dāna karalāma isahāka o iẏākūva evaṃ tāra vaṃśadharadera janya sthira karalāma navuoẏāta o kitāva evaṃ āmi tāke duniẏāẏa puraskṛta karechilāma; evaṃ ākhirāteo se niścaẏai sat karmaparāẏaṇadera anyatama have.
29:27.latin_ascii: ami take dana karalama isahaka o iyakuva evam tara vamsadharadera janya sthira karalama navuoyata o kitava evam ami take duniyaya puraskrta karechilama; evam akhirateo se niscayai sat karmaparayanadera anyatama have.

29:28.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara lūtera kathā, yakhana se tāra sampradāẏake valechila, tomarā to emana aślīla karma karacha, yā tomādera pūrve viśvajagate keu kareni.
29:28.latin_ascii: smarana kara lutera katha, yakhana se tara sampradayake valechila, tomara to emana aslila karma karacha, ya tomadera purve visvajagate keu kareni.

29:29.latin_iast: tomarāi to puruṣe upagata haccha, tomarāi to rāhājāni kare thāka evaṃ tomarāi to nijedera majalise prakāśye ghṛṇya karma kare thāka.’ uttare tāra sampradāẏa śudhu e kathāi valala ye, ‘āmādera opara āllāhara śāsti ānaẏana kara yadi tumi satyavādī hao.’
29:29.latin_ascii: tomarai to puruse upagata haccha, tomarai to rahajani kare thaka evam tomarai to nijedera majalise prakasye ghrnya karma kare thaka.’ uttare tara sampradaya sudhu e kathai valala ye, ‘amadera opara allahara sasti anayana kara yadi tumi satyavadi hao.’

29:30.latin_iast: se valala: ‘he āmāra pratipālaka! viparyaẏa sṛṣṭikārī sampradāẏera viruddhe āmāke sāhāyya kara.’
29:30.latin_ascii: se valala: ‘he amara pratipalaka! viparyaya srstikari sampradayera viruddhe amake sahayya kara.’

29:31.latin_iast: yakhana āmāra prerita phereśatāgaṇa susaṃvādasaha ivarāhīmera nikaṭa āsala, tārā valechila, ‘āmarā e janapadavāsīderake dhvaṃsa karava, era adhivāsīrā to jālima.’
29:31.latin_ascii: yakhana amara prerita pheresatagana susamvadasaha ivarahimera nikata asala, tara valechila, ‘amara e janapadavasiderake dhvamsa karava, era adhivasira to jalima.’

29:32.latin_iast: ivarāhīma valala: ‘e janapade to lūta raẏeche.’ tārā valala: ‘sethāẏa kārā āche, tā āmarā bhāla karei jāni, āmarā lūtake o tāra parijanake avaśyai rakṣā karava, tāra strīke chār̤ā; se to paścāte avasthānakārīdera antarbhukta.’
29:32.latin_ascii: ivarahima valala: ‘e janapade to luta rayeche.’ tara valala: ‘sethaya kara ache, ta amara bhala karei jani, amara lutake o tara parijanake avasyai raksa karava, tara strike chara; se to pascate avasthanakaridera antarbhukta.’

29:33.latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana āmāra prerita phereśatāgaṇa lūtera nikaṭa āsala, takhana tādera viṣaẏe se viṣaṇaœ haẏe par̤ala evaṃ tādera rakṣāẏa nijake asamartha mane karala. tārā valala: ‘bhaẏa kara nā, duḥkhao kara nā; āmarā tomāke o tomāra parijanake rakṣā karava, tomāra strī vyatīta, se to paścāte avasthānakārīdera antarbhukta;
29:33.latin_ascii: evam yakhana amara prerita pheresatagana lutera nikata asala, takhana tadera visaye se visanaœ haye parala evam tadera raksaya nijake asamartha mane karala. tara valala: ‘bhaya kara na, duhkhao kara na; amara tomake o tomara parijanake raksa karava, tomara stri vyatita, se to pascate avasthanakaridera antarbhukta;

29:34.latin_iast: āmarā e janapadavāsīra opara ākāśa hate śāsti nāyila karava, kāraṇa tārā pāpācāra karata.’
29:34.latin_ascii: amara e janapadavasira opara akasa hate sasti nayila karava, karana tara papacara karata.’

29:35.latin_iast: āmi vodhaśaktisampanna sampradāẏera janya tāte ekaṭi spaṣṭa nidarśana rekhe diẏechi.
29:35.latin_ascii: ami vodhasaktisampanna sampradayera janya tate ekati spasta nidarsana rekhe diyechi.

29:36.latin_iast: āmi mādaiẏānavāsīra prati tādera bhāi śu‘āivake pāṭhiẏechilāma. se valechila: ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā āllāhara ‘ivādata kara, śeṣa divasake bhaẏa kara evaṃ pṛthivīte viparyaẏa sṛṣṭi kara nā.’
29:36.latin_ascii: ami madaiyanavasira prati tadera bhai su‘aivake pathiyechilama. se valechila: ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara allahara ‘ivadata kara, sesa divasake bhaya kara evam prthivite viparyaya srsti kara na.’

29:37.latin_iast: kintu tārā tāra prati mithyā āropa karala, ataḥpara tārā bhūmikampa dvārā ākrānta hala; phale tārā nija gṛhe natajānu avasthāẏa śeṣa haẏe gela.
29:37.latin_ascii: kintu tara tara prati mithya aropa karala, atahpara tara bhumikampa dvara akranta hala; phale tara nija grhe natajanu avasthaya sesa haye gela.

29:38.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi ‘āda o sāmūdake dhvaṃsa karechilāma; tādera vār̤igharai tomādera janya era suspaṣṭa pramāṇa, śaẏatāna tādera kājake tādera dṛṣṭite suśobhita karechila evaṃ tāderake sat patha avalamvane vādhā diẏechila, yadio tārā chila vicakṣaṇa.
29:38.latin_ascii: evam ami ‘ada o samudake dhvamsa karechilama; tadera varigharai tomadera janya era suspasta pramana, sayatana tadera kajake tadera drstite susobhita karechila evam taderake sat patha avalamvane vadha diyechila, yadio tara chila vicaksana.

29:39.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi saṃhāra karechilāma kārūna, phira‘āuna o hāmānake. mūsā tādera nikaṭa suspaṣṭa nidarśanasaha esechila; takhana tārā deśe dambha karata; kintu tārā āmāra śāsti er̤āte pāreni.
29:39.latin_ascii: evam ami samhara karechilama karuna, phira‘auna o hamanake. musa tadera nikata suspasta nidarsanasaha esechila; takhana tara dese dambha karata; kintu tara amara sasti erate pareni.

29:40.latin_iast: tādera pratyekakei āmi tāra aparādhera janya śāsti diẏechilāma: tādera kāro prati preraṇa karechi prastarasaha pravala vātāsa, tādera kāuke āghāta karechila vikaṭa śavda, kāuke āmi prothita karechilāma bhūgarbhe evaṃ kāuke diẏechilāma ḍuviẏe. āllāha tā‘ālā tādera prati kona juluma karenani; tārā nijerāi nijedera prati juluma karechila.
29:40.latin_ascii: tadera pratyekakei ami tara aparadhera janya sasti diyechilama: tadera karo prati prerana karechi prastarasaha pravala vatasa, tadera kauke aghata karechila vikata savda, kauke ami prothita karechilama bhugarbhe evam kauke diyechilama duviye. allaha ta‘ala tadera prati kona juluma karenani; tara nijerai nijedera prati juluma karechila.

29:41.latin_iast: yārā āllāha tā‘ālāra parivarte aparake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa kare tādera dṛṣṭānta mākar̤asāra nyāẏa, ye nijera janya ghara vānāẏa evaṃ gharera madhye mākar̤asāra gharai savaceẏe durvala, yadi tārā jānata.
29:41.latin_ascii: yara allaha ta‘alara parivarte aparake abhibhavakarupe grahana kare tadera drstanta makarasara nyaya, ye nijera janya ghara vanaya evam gharera madhye makarasara gharai savaceye durvala, yadi tara janata.

29:42.latin_iast: tārā āllāha tā‘ālāra parivarte yā kichuke āhvāna kare, āllāha tā‘ālā to tā jānena evaṃ tini parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa.
29:42.latin_ascii: tara allaha ta‘alara parivarte ya kichuke ahvana kare, allaha ta‘ala to ta janena evam tini parakramasali, prajnamaya.

29:43.latin_iast: e sakala dṛṣṭānta āmi mānuṣera janya varṇanā kari; kintu kevala jñānī vyaktirāi eṭā vujhe.
29:43.latin_ascii: e sakala drstanta ami manusera janya varnana kari; kintu kevala jnani vyaktirai eta vujhe.

29:44.latin_iast: āllāha tā‘ālā yathāyathabhāve ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena; ete avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche mu’minadera janya.
29:44.latin_ascii: allaha ta‘ala yathayathabhave akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena; ete avasyai nidarsana rayeche mu’minadera janya.

29:45.latin_iast: tumi pāṭha kara kitāva hate yā tomāra prati oẏāhī karā haẏeche evaṃ sālāta kāẏema kara. sālāta avaśyai virata rākhe aślīla o manda kāja hate āra āllāha tā‘ālāra smaraṇai to sarvaśreṣṭha. tomarā yā kara āllāha tā‘ālā tā jānena.
29:45.latin_ascii: tumi patha kara kitava hate ya tomara prati oyahi kara hayeche evam salata kayema kara. salata avasyai virata rakhe aslila o manda kaja hate ara allaha ta‘alara smaranai to sarvasrestha. tomara ya kara allaha ta‘ala ta janena.

29:46.latin_iast: tomarā uttama panthā vyatīta kitāvīdera sāthe vitarka kara nā, tave tādera sāthe karate pāra, yārā tādera madhye sīmālaṅghanakārī evaṃ vala: ‘āmādera prati o tomādera prati yā avatīrṇa karā haẏeche, tāte āmarā īmāna enechi evaṃ āmādera mā‘vūda o tomādera mā‘vūda to ekai evaṃ āmarā tā~rai kāche ātmasamarpaṇakārī.’
29:46.latin_ascii: tomara uttama pantha vyatita kitavidera sathe vitarka kara na, tave tadera sathe karate para, yara tadera madhye simalanghanakari evam vala: ‘amadera prati o tomadera prati ya avatirna kara hayeche, tate amara imana enechi evam amadera ma‘vuda o tomadera ma‘vuda to ekai evam amara ta~rai kache atmasamarpanakari.’

29:47.latin_iast: ebhāvei āmi tomāra prati kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi evaṃ yāderake āmi kitāva diẏechilāma tārā tāte viśvāsa kare. āra ederao keu keu ete viśvāsa kare. kāphira vyatīta keu āmāra nidarśanāvalī asvīkāra kare nā.
29:47.latin_ascii: ebhavei ami tomara prati kuraana avatirna karechi evam yaderake ami kitava diyechilama tara tate visvasa kare. ara ederao keu keu ete visvasa kare. kaphira vyatita keu amara nidarsanavali asvikara kare na.

29:48.latin_iast: tumi to pūrve kona kitāva pāṭha karani evaṃ svahaste kona kitāvao lipivaddha karani ye, mithyācārīrā sandeha poṣaṇa karave.
29:48.latin_ascii: tumi to purve kona kitava patha karani evam svahaste kona kitavao lipivaddha karani ye, mithyacarira sandeha posana karave.

29:49.latin_iast: varaṃ yāderake jñāna deẏā haẏeche vastuta tādera antare eṭā spaṣṭa nidarśana. kevala jālimarāi āmāra nidarśana asvīkāra kare.
29:49.latin_ascii: varam yaderake jnana deya hayeche vastuta tadera antare eta spasta nidarsana. kevala jalimarai amara nidarsana asvikara kare.

29:50.latin_iast: āra tārā vale: ‘tāra pratipālakera nikaṭa hate tāra nikaṭa nidarśana prerita haẏa nā kena?’ vala: nidarśana āllāha tā‘ālārai ikhatiẏāre. āmi to ekajana prakāśya satarkakārī mātra.
29:50.latin_ascii: ara tara vale: ‘tara pratipalakera nikata hate tara nikata nidarsana prerita haya na kenay’ vala: nidarsana allaha ta‘alarai ikhatiyare. ami to ekajana prakasya satarkakari matra.

29:51.latin_iast: eṭā ki tādera janya yatheṣṭa naẏa ye, āmi tomāra prati kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi, yā tādera nikaṭa pāṭha karā haẏa. tāte avaśyai anugraha o upadeśa raẏeche se kaomera janya yārā īmāna āne.
29:51.latin_ascii: eta ki tadera janya yathesta naya ye, ami tomara prati kuraana avatirna karechi, ya tadera nikata patha kara haya. tate avasyai anugraha o upadesa rayeche se kaomera janya yara imana ane.

29:52.latin_iast: vala: ‘āmāra o tomādera madhye sākṣī hiseve āllāha tā‘ālāi yatheṣṭa. ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivīte yā āche tā tini jānena evaṃ yārā asatye viśvāsa kare o āllāha tā‘ālāke asvīkāra kare tārāi to kṣatigrasta.’
29:52.latin_ascii: vala: ‘amara o tomadera madhye saksi hiseve allaha ta‘alai yathesta. akasamandali o prthivite ya ache ta tini janena evam yara asatye visvasa kare o allaha ta‘alake asvikara kare tarai to ksatigrasta.’

29:53.latin_iast: tārā tomāke śāsti tvarānvita karate vale. yadi nirdhārita kāla nā thākata tave śāsti tādera opara avaśyai āsata. niścaẏai tādera opara śāsti āsave ākasmikabhāve, tārā ṭerao pāve nā.
29:53.latin_ascii: tara tomake sasti tvaranvita karate vale. yadi nirdharita kala na thakata tave sasti tadera opara avasyai asata. niscayai tadera opara sasti asave akasmikabhave, tara terao pave na.

29:54.latin_iast: tārā tomāke śāsti tvarānvita karate vale, jāhānnāma to kāphiraderake pariveṣṭana karavei.
29:54.latin_ascii: tara tomake sasti tvaranvita karate vale, jahannama to kaphiraderake parivestana karavei.

29:55.latin_iast: sedina śāsti tāderake ācchanna karave ūrdhva o adhaḥdeśa hate evaṃ tini valavena: ‘tomarā yā karate tāra svāda āsvādana kara.’
29:55.latin_ascii: sedina sasti taderake acchanna karave urdhva o adhahdesa hate evam tini valavena: ‘tomara ya karate tara svada asvadana kara.’

29:56.latin_iast: he āmāra mu’mina vāndāgaṇa! niścaẏa āmāra pṛthivī praśasta; sutarāṃ tomarā āmārai ‘ivādata kara.
29:56.latin_ascii: he amara mu’mina vandagana! niscaya amara prthivi prasasta; sutaram tomara amarai ‘ivadata kara.

29:57.latin_iast: pratiṭi prāṇa mātrai mṛtyura svāda grahaṇa karave; ataḥpara tomarā āmārai dike pratyāvartita have.
29:57.latin_ascii: pratiti prana matrai mrtyura svada grahana karave; atahpara tomara amarai dike pratyavartita have.

29:58.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o sat kāja kare āmi avaśyai tādera vasavāsera janya suucca prāsāda dāna karava jānnāte, yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita, sekhāne tārā sthāẏī have, katai nā uttama pratidānasamūha se sakala karmaśīladera janya,
29:58.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o sat kaja kare ami avasyai tadera vasavasera janya suucca prasada dana karava jannate, yara padadese nadi pravahita, sekhane tara sthayi have, katai na uttama pratidanasamuha se sakala karmasiladera janya,

29:59.latin_iast: yārā dhairya dhāraṇa kare evaṃ tādera pratipālakera opara nirbhara kare.
29:59.latin_ascii: yara dhairya dharana kare evam tadera pratipalakera opara nirbhara kare.

29:60.latin_iast: emana kata jīvajantu āche yārā nijedera khādya majuda rākhe nā. āllāhai riyika dāna karena tāderake o tomāderake; evaṃ tini sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
29:60.latin_ascii: emana kata jivajantu ache yara nijedera khadya majuda rakhe na. allahai riyika dana karena taderake o tomaderake; evam tini sarvasrota, sarvajna.

29:61.latin_iast: yadi tumi tāderake jijñesa kara, ‘ke ākāśamaṇḍalī o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ cā~da o sūryake niẏantraṇa karachena?’ tārā avaśyai valave, ‘āllāha’. tāhale, tārā kothāẏa phire yācche!
29:61.latin_ascii: yadi tumi taderake jijnesa kara, ‘ke akasamandali o prthivi srsti karechena evam ca~da o suryake niyantrana karachenay’ tara avasyai valave, ‘allaha’. tahale, tara kothaya phire yacche!

29:62.latin_iast: āllāha tā~ra vāndādera madhye yāra janya icchā tāra riyika vardhita karena evaṃ yāra janya icchā tā sīmita karena. niścaẏa āllāha sarvaviṣaẏe samyaka avahita.
29:62.latin_ascii: allaha ta~ra vandadera madhye yara janya iccha tara riyika vardhita karena evam yara janya iccha ta simita karena. niscaya allaha sarvavisaye samyaka avahita.

29:63.latin_iast: yadi tumi tāderake jijñesa kara, ākāśa hate pāni varṣaṇa kare ke bhūmike sañjīvita karena tāra mṛtyura para? tārā avaśyai valave, ‘āllāha’. vala: samasta praśaṃsā āllāharai. kintu tādera adhikāṃśai tā anudhāvana kare nā.
29:63.latin_ascii: yadi tumi taderake jijnesa kara, akasa hate pani varsana kare ke bhumike sanjivita karena tara mrtyura paray tara avasyai valave, ‘allaha’. vala: samasta prasamsa allaharai. kintu tadera adhikamsai ta anudhavana kare na.

29:64.latin_iast: e pārthiva jīvana to krīr̤ā-kautuka vyatīta kichui naẏa. pāralaukika jīvanai to prakṛta jīvana, yadi tārā jānata!
29:64.latin_ascii: e parthiva jivana to krira-kautuka vyatita kichui naya. paralaukika jivanai to prakrta jivana, yadi tara janata!

29:65.latin_iast: tārā yakhana nauyāne ārohana kare takhana tārā viśuddhacitta haẏe ekaniṣṭhabhāve āllāhake ḍāke. ataḥpara tini yakhana sthale bhir̤iẏe tāderake rakṣā karena, takhana tārā śirake lipta haẏa,
29:65.latin_ascii: tara yakhana nauyane arohana kare takhana tara visuddhacitta haye ekanisthabhave allahake dake. atahpara tini yakhana sthale bhiriye taderake raksa karena, takhana tara sirake lipta haya,

29:66.latin_iast: yāra phale tādera prati āmāra dānake tārā asvīkāra kare evaṃ bhoga-vilāse matta thāke; acirei tārā jānate pārave!
29:66.latin_ascii: yara phale tadera prati amara danake tara asvikara kare evam bhoga-vilase matta thake; acirei tara janate parave!

29:67.latin_iast: tārā ki dekhe nā āmi ‘hārāma'ke nirāpada sthāna karechi, athaca tāra catuṣpārśve yesava mānuṣa āche, tāderake chiniẏe neẏā haẏa (hāmalā karā haẏa), tave ki tārā asatyei viśvāsa karave evaṃ āllāhara anugraha asvīkāra karave?
29:67.latin_ascii: tara ki dekhe na ami ‘harama'ke nirapada sthana karechi, athaca tara catusparsve yesava manusa ache, taderake chiniye neya haya (hamala kara haya), tave ki tara asatyei visvasa karave evam allahara anugraha asvikara karavey

29:68.latin_iast: ye vyakti āllāha samvandhe mithyā racanā kare athavā tā~ra nikaṭa hate āgata satyake asvīkāra kare tāra apekṣā adhika jālima āra ke? jāhānnāmai ki kāphiradera āvāsasthala naẏa?
29:68.latin_ascii: ye vyakti allaha samvandhe mithya racana kare athava ta~ra nikata hate agata satyake asvikara kare tara apeksa adhika jalima ara key jahannamai ki kaphiradera avasasthala nayay

29:69.latin_iast: yārā āmāra uddeśye saṃgrāma kare āmi tāderake avaśyai āmāra pathe paricālita karava. āllāha avaśyai sat karmaparāẏaṇadera saṅge thākena.
29:69.latin_ascii: yara amara uddesye samgrama kare ami taderake avasyai amara pathe paricalita karava. allaha avasyai sat karmaparayanadera sange thakena.

30:3.latin_iast: eka nikaṭavartī sthāne evaṃ tārā tādera e parājaẏera para śīghrai jaẏalābha karave.
30:3.latin_ascii: eka nikatavarti sthane evam tara tadera e parajayera para sighrai jayalabha karave.

30:4.latin_iast: tina theke naẏa vacharera madhye. pūrvera o parera siddhānta āllāharai (hāte). āra sedina mu’minarā ānandita have,
30:4.latin_ascii: tina theke naya vacharera madhye. purvera o parera siddhanta allaharai (hate). ara sedina mu’minara anandita have,

30:5.latin_iast: (se vijaẏa arjita have) āllāhara sāhāyye. tini yāke icchā sāhāyya karena evaṃ tini pratāpaśālī, atyanta daẏālu.
30:5.latin_ascii: (se vijaya arjita have) allahara sahayye. tini yake iccha sahayya karena evam tini pratapasali, atyanta dayalu.

30:6.latin_iast: eṭā āllāhara oẏādā. āllāha tā~ra oẏādā khelāpha karena nā. kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa jāne nā.
30:6.latin_ascii: eta allahara oyada. allaha ta~ra oyada khelapha karena na. kintu adhikamsa manusa jane na.

30:7.latin_iast: tārā pārthiva jīvanera vāhyika avasthāṭukui jāne āra tārā parakāla samparke sampūrṇa gāphila.
30:7.latin_ascii: tara parthiva jivanera vahyika avasthatukui jane ara tara parakala samparke sampurna gaphila.
