30:8.latin_iast: tārā ki nijedera antare bheve dekhe nā ye, āllāha āsamāna, jamina evaṃ etodubhaẏera madhyavartī yā kichu āche savai sṛṣṭi karechena yathāyathabhāve o eka nirdiṣṭa samaẏera janya. kintu aneka mānuṣai tādera pratipālakera sāthe sākṣātke aviśvāsa kare.
30:8.latin_ascii: tara ki nijedera antare bheve dekhe na ye, allaha asamana, jamina evam etodubhayera madhyavarti ya kichu ache savai srsti karechena yathayathabhave o eka nirdista samayera janya. kintu aneka manusai tadera pratipalakera sathe saksatke avisvasa kare.

30:9.latin_iast: tārā ki duniẏāte bhramaṇa kare nā? karale dekhata ye, tādera pūrvavartīdera pariṇāma kemana bhaẏāvaha haẏechila. tārā kṣamatāẏa chila edera ceẏe pravala: tārā jamina cāṣa karata evaṃ tārā jaminake āvāda karata, erā ye parimāṇa āvāda kare tāra ceẏe adhika. tādera kāche tādera rāsūlagaṇa prakāśya dṛṣṭānta niẏe esechila. āllāha to emana nana ye, tādera opara atyācāra karavena, varaṃ tārā nijerāi nijedera opara atyācāra karechila.
30:9.latin_ascii: tara ki duniyate bhramana kare nay karale dekhata ye, tadera purvavartidera parinama kemana bhayavaha hayechila. tara ksamataya chila edera ceye pravala: tara jamina casa karata evam tara jaminake avada karata, era ye parimana avada kare tara ceye adhika. tadera kache tadera rasulagana prakasya drstanta niye esechila. allaha to emana nana ye, tadera opara atyacara karavena, varam tara nijerai nijedera opara atyacara karechila.

30:10.latin_iast: ataḥpara yārā khārāpa kāja karata tādera pariṇati khārāpa haẏeche, kenanā tārā āllāhara āẏātasamūke asvīkāra karata evaṃ tā niẏe tārā ṭhāṭṭā-vidraƒpa karata.
30:10.latin_ascii: atahpara yara kharapa kaja karata tadera parinati kharapa hayeche, kenana tara allahara ayatasamuke asvikara karata evam ta niye tara thatta-vidraƒpa karata.

30:11.latin_iast: āllāhai sṛṣṭira sūcanā karena, ataḥpara tini tā punarāvṛtti karavena, tārapara tomāderake tā~rai kāche phiriẏe neẏā have.
30:11.latin_ascii: allahai srstira sucana karena, atahpara tini ta punaravrtti karavena, tarapara tomaderake ta~rai kache phiriye neya have.

30:12.latin_iast: āra yedina kiẏāmata anuṣṭhita have, sedina pāpīrā hatāśa haẏe par̤ave.
30:12.latin_ascii: ara yedina kiyamata anusthita have, sedina papira hatasa haye parave.

30:13.latin_iast: āra tādera devatādera madhya theke tādera janya kona anurodhakārī have nā evaṃ tārāi nijedera devatādera asvīkāra karave.
30:13.latin_ascii: ara tadera devatadera madhya theke tadera janya kona anurodhakari have na evam tarai nijedera devatadera asvikara karave.

30:14.latin_iast: āra yedina kiẏāmata anuṣṭhita have, sedina mānuṣa ālādā ālādā haẏe yāve.
30:14.latin_ascii: ara yedina kiyamata anusthita have, sedina manusa alada alada haye yave.

30:15.latin_iast: sutarāṃ yārā īmāna ene bhāla kāja karechila, tārā to jānnāte ānande thākave.
30:15.latin_ascii: sutaram yara imana ene bhala kaja karechila, tara to jannate anande thakave.

30:16.latin_iast: āra yārā kupharī kare evaṃ āmāra āẏātasamūhake o ākhirātera sākṣātake aviśvāsa kare, tāderakei ‘āyāvera madhye upasthita karā have.
30:16.latin_ascii: ara yara kuphari kare evam amara ayatasamuhake o akhiratera saksatake avisvasa kare, taderakei ‘ayavera madhye upasthita kara have.

30:17.latin_iast: ataḥpara tomarā āllāhara pavitratā o guṇagāna ghoṣaṇā kara sandhyāẏa o pratyuṣe.
30:17.latin_ascii: atahpara tomara allahara pavitrata o gunagana ghosana kara sandhyaya o pratyuse.

30:18.latin_iast: evaṃ aparāehna o yoharera samaẏa; āra āsamāne o jamine sakala praśaṃsā to tā~rai.
30:18.latin_ascii: evam aparaehna o yoharera samaya; ara asamane o jamine sakala prasamsa to ta~rai.

30:19.latin_iast: tini vera kare ānena mṛta theke jīvitake evaṃ tini vera kare ānena jīvita theke mṛtake, āra tinii jaminake tāra mṛtyura para punarāẏa jīvita karena. ebhāvei tomāderake (mṛtyura para punarāẏa) vera kare ānā have.
30:19.latin_ascii: tini vera kare anena mrta theke jivitake evam tini vera kare anena jivita theke mrtake, ara tinii jaminake tara mrtyura para punaraya jivita karena. ebhavei tomaderake (mrtyura para punaraya) vera kare ana have.

30:20.latin_iast: āra tā~ra dṛṣṭāntagulora madhye (anyatama) ei ye, tini tomāderake māṭi theke sṛṣṭi karechena ataḥpara ekhana tomarā mānuṣa sava jāẏagāẏa vistāra lābha karecha.
30:20.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra drstantagulora madhye (anyatama) ei ye, tini tomaderake mati theke srsti karechena atahpara ekhana tomara manusa sava jayagaya vistara labha karecha.

30:21.latin_iast: āra tā~ra dṛṣṭāntagulora madhye ekaṭi ei ye, tini tomādera janya tomādera nijedera madhya theke strīderake sṛṣṭi karechena, yāte tomarā tādera kāche śānti lābha kara evaṃ tini sṛṣṭi karechena tomādera madhye bhālavāsā o daẏā. niścaẏai ete aisava lokera janya nidarśana raẏeche, yārā gabhīrabhāve cintā kare.
30:21.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra drstantagulora madhye ekati ei ye, tini tomadera janya tomadera nijedera madhya theke striderake srsti karechena, yate tomara tadera kache santi labha kara evam tini srsti karechena tomadera madhye bhalavasa o daya. niscayai ete aisava lokera janya nidarsana rayeche, yara gabhirabhave cinta kare.

30:22.latin_iast: āra tā~ra nidarśanāvalīra madhye raẏeche āsamānasamūha o jaminera sṛṣṭi evaṃ tomādera bhāṣā o varṇera vibhinnatā. niścaẏai ete raẏeche jñānīdera janya nidarśana .
30:22.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra nidarsanavalira madhye rayeche asamanasamuha o jaminera srsti evam tomadera bhasa o varnera vibhinnata. niscayai ete rayeche jnanidera janya nidarsana .

30:23.latin_iast: āra tā~ra dṛṣṭāntagulora madhye raẏeche rāta o dine tomādera nidrā evaṃ tā~rai anugraha tomādera ānusandhāna karā ucita. avaśyai ete nidarśana raẏeche aisava lokadera janya yārā (āntarikabhāve) śravaṇa kare.
30:23.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra drstantagulora madhye rayeche rata o dine tomadera nidra evam ta~rai anugraha tomadera anusandhana kara ucita. avasyai ete nidarsana rayeche aisava lokadera janya yara (antarikabhave) sravana kare.

30:24.latin_iast: āra tā~ra nidarśanagulora madhye raẏeche: tini tomāderake dekhāna vidyutera camaka, yāte bhaẏao thāke evaṃ āśāo thāke; āra tini ākāśa theke pāni varṣaṇa karena, tārapara tā diẏe jaminake mṛtyura para āvāra jīvita karena. niścaẏai ete raẏeche nidarśana ai lokadera janya yārā vuuddhimāna.
30:24.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra nidarsanagulora madhye rayeche: tini tomaderake dekhana vidyutera camaka, yate bhayao thake evam asao thake; ara tini akasa theke pani varsana karena, tarapara ta diye jaminake mrtyura para avara jivita karena. niscayai ete rayeche nidarsana ai lokadera janya yara vuuddhimana.

30:25.latin_iast: āra tā~ra nidarśanagulora madhye raẏeche ye, tā~rai ādeśe āsamāna o jamina sthira āche; āvāra yakhana tini tomāderake jamina theke (vera haẏe āsāra janya) āhvāna karavena, takhana tomarā saṅge saṅge vera haẏe āsave.
30:25.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra nidarsanagulora madhye rayeche ye, ta~rai adese asamana o jamina sthira ache; avara yakhana tini tomaderake jamina theke (vera haye asara janya) ahvana karavena, takhana tomara sange sange vera haye asave.

30:26.latin_iast: āsamāna o jamine yā kichu āche savai tā~ra. sakalai tā~ra anugata.
30:26.latin_ascii: asamana o jamine ya kichu ache savai ta~ra. sakalai ta~ra anugata.

30:27.latin_iast: tini sṛṣṭira sūcanā karena, tārapara tinii āvāra tā punarāvṛtti karavena, eṭā tā~ra janya khuvai sahaja. āsamāna o jamine sarvocca varṇanā tā~rai. āra tinii pratāpaśālī mahāvijña.
30:27.latin_ascii: tini srstira sucana karena, tarapara tinii avara ta punaravrtti karavena, eta ta~ra janya khuvai sahaja. asamana o jamine sarvocca varnana ta~rai. ara tinii pratapasali mahavijna.

30:28.latin_iast: āllāha tomādera janya tomādera nijedera madhya thekei ekaṭi dṛṣṭānta varṇanā karechena: āmi tomāderake ye riyika dāna karechi, tomādera adhikārabhukta dāsa-dāsīdera keu ki tāte aṃśīdāra, yāra phale tomarā o tārā samāna? tomarā ki tāderake serūpa bhaẏa kara? yerūpa tomarā nijedera lokake bhaẏa kara? ebhāvei āmi vuddhimāna sampradāẏera janya nidarśanasamūha vistāritabhāve varṇanā kari.
30:28.latin_ascii: allaha tomadera janya tomadera nijedera madhya thekei ekati drstanta varnana karechena: ami tomaderake ye riyika dana karechi, tomadera adhikarabhukta dasa-dasidera keu ki tate amsidara, yara phale tomara o tara samanay tomara ki taderake serupa bhaya karay yerupa tomara nijedera lokake bhaya karay ebhavei ami vuddhimana sampradayera janya nidarsanasamuha vistaritabhave varnana kari.

30:29.latin_iast: varaṃ jālimarā ajñatāvaśata nijedera pravṛttira ānugatya kare thāke. ataeva tāke ke satpatha dekhāve yāke āllāha pathabhraṣṭa karechena? āra tādera janya kona sāhāyyakārī nei.
30:29.latin_ascii: varam jalimara ajnatavasata nijedera pravrttira anugatya kare thake. ataeva take ke satpatha dekhave yake allaha pathabhrasta karechenay ara tadera janya kona sahayyakari nei.

30:30.latin_iast: ataeva tumi ekaniṣṭhabhāve nijeke dīnera opara pratiṣṭhita rākha; eṭāi āllāhara phitarāta (prakṛti) yāra opara tini mānava sṛṣṭi karechena. āllāhara sṛṣṭira kona parivartana nei. eṭāi sarala-saṭhika dīna kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa jāne nā.
30:30.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi ekanisthabhave nijeke dinera opara pratisthita rakha; etai allahara phitarata (prakrti) yara opara tini manava srsti karechena. allahara srstira kona parivartana nei. etai sarala-sathika dina kintu adhikamsa manusa jane na.

30:31.latin_iast: (nijeke dīne pratiṣṭhita rākha) viśuddhacitte āllāha abhimukhī haẏe evaṃ tā~ke bhaẏa kara, sālāta kaẏema kara evaṃ muśarikadera (dale) śāmila haẏo nā.
30:31.latin_ascii: (nijeke dine pratisthita rakha) visuddhacitte allaha abhimukhi haye evam ta~ke bhaya kara, salata kayema kara evam musarikadera (dale) samila hayo na.

30:32.latin_iast: yārā tādera dīnake khaṇḍa-vikhaṇḍa kare niẏeche evaṃ bhinna bhinna dale vibhakta haẏe par̤eche. pratyeka dalai nija nija anusṛta niẏama niẏe ānandita.
30:32.latin_ascii: yara tadera dinake khanda-vikhanda kare niyeche evam bhinna bhinna dale vibhakta haye pareche. pratyeka dalai nija nija anusrta niyama niye anandita.

30:33.latin_iast: āra yakhana mānuṣake duḥkha-kaṣṭa sparśa kare, takhana tārā tādera pratipālakake tā~ra abhimukhī haẏe āhvāna kare. tārapara yakhana tini nijera pakṣa theke tāderake kichu rahamatera svāda bhoga karāna, takhanai tādera ekadala tādera pratipālakera aṃśīdāritva sāvyasta kare.
30:33.latin_ascii: ara yakhana manusake duhkha-kasta sparsa kare, takhana tara tadera pratipalakake ta~ra abhimukhi haye ahvana kare. tarapara yakhana tini nijera paksa theke taderake kichu rahamatera svada bhoga karana, takhanai tadera ekadala tadera pratipalakera amsidaritva savyasta kare.

30:34.latin_iast: yāte āmi tāderake yā kichu dāna karechi tāra akṛtajñatā prakāśa kare. sutarāṃ āro kichu samaẏa bhoga kare nāo, ataḥpara śīghrai tomarā avagata have.
30:34.latin_ascii: yate ami taderake ya kichu dana karechi tara akrtajnata prakasa kare. sutaram aro kichu samaya bhoga kare nao, atahpara sighrai tomara avagata have.

30:35.latin_iast: āmi ki tādera kāche emana kona pramāṇa avatīrṇa karechi, yā (tāderake) vale tāra sāthe tārā ye aṃśī sthira kare se kathā?
30:35.latin_ascii: ami ki tadera kache emana kona pramana avatirna karechi, ya (taderake) vale tara sathe tara ye amsi sthira kare se kathay

30:36.latin_iast: āra yakhana mānuṣake rahamatera svāda bhoga karāi, takhana tārā tāte ānandita haẏa, āra yadi tādera kāja-karmera daruna tādera opara kona vipada āse, tave takhanai tārā nirāśa haẏe par̤e.
30:36.latin_ascii: ara yakhana manusake rahamatera svada bhoga karai, takhana tara tate anandita haya, ara yadi tadera kaja-karmera daruna tadera opara kona vipada ase, tave takhanai tara nirasa haye pare.

30:37.latin_iast: tārā ki dekhe nā ye, āllāha yāke icchā pracura riyika dena evaṃ yāke icchā riyika saṅkucita kare dena. niścaẏai ete dṛṣṭānta raẏeche ai lokadera janya yārā viśvāsa kare.
30:37.latin_ascii: tara ki dekhe na ye, allaha yake iccha pracura riyika dena evam yake iccha riyika sankucita kare dena. niscayai ete drstanta rayeche ai lokadera janya yara visvasa kare.

30:38.latin_iast: ataeva ātmīẏa-svajanake tādera haka diẏe dāo evaṃ misakina o musāphiraderakeo. eṭā tādera janya uttama, yārā āllāhara santuṣṭi kāmanā kare, āra tārāi hala saphalakāma.
30:38.latin_ascii: ataeva atmiya-svajanake tadera haka diye dao evam misakina o musaphiraderakeo. eta tadera janya uttama, yara allahara santusti kamana kare, ara tarai hala saphalakama.

30:39.latin_iast: mānuṣera dhana-sampade tomādera sampadavṛddhi pāve, e āśāẏa yā kichu tomarā sude diẏe thāka, āllāhara kāche tā vṛddhi pāẏa nā. pakṣāntare āllāhara santuṣṭi lābhera janya yā kichu tomarā yākātarūpe diẏe thāka, tave erūpa lokerāi (tādera pradatta vastuke) āllāhara samīpe vṛddhi karate thākave.
30:39.latin_ascii: manusera dhana-sampade tomadera sampadavrddhi pave, e asaya ya kichu tomara sude diye thaka, allahara kache ta vrddhi paya na. paksantare allahara santusti labhera janya ya kichu tomara yakatarupe diye thaka, tave erupa lokerai (tadera pradatta vastuke) allahara samipe vrddhi karate thakave.

30:40.latin_iast: āllāha sei mahāna sattā, yini tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena, ataḥpara tomāderake riyika diẏechena. erapara tomādera mṛtyu devena, ataḥpara tomāderake āvāra jīvita karavena. tomādera aṃśīdera madhye keu āche ki, ye esava kājera madhya theke kona ekaṭio karate pāre? tārā ye śarīka kare, āllāha tā theke ati pavitra o mahāna.
30:40.latin_ascii: allaha sei mahana satta, yini tomaderake srsti karechena, atahpara tomaderake riyika diyechena. erapara tomadera mrtyu devena, atahpara tomaderake avara jivita karavena. tomadera amsidera madhye keu ache ki, ye esava kajera madhya theke kona ekatio karate parey tara ye sarika kare, allaha ta theke ati pavitra o mahana.

30:41.latin_iast: sthalabhāge o jalabhāge mānuṣera kāja-karmera phalasvarūpa aśānti char̤iẏe par̤eche, yāra phale āllāha tāderake tādera kichu kichu kājera śāsti bhoga karāna, yāte tārā phire āse.
30:41.latin_ascii: sthalabhage o jalabhage manusera kaja-karmera phalasvarupa asanti chariye pareche, yara phale allaha taderake tadera kichu kichu kajera sasti bhoga karana, yate tara phire ase.

30:42.latin_iast: tumi vala: tomarā duniẏāte bhramaṇa kara evaṃ dekha pūrvavartīdera pariṇāma kemana haẏechila. tādera adhikāṃśai chila muśarika.
30:42.latin_ascii: tumi vala: tomara duniyate bhramana kara evam dekha purvavartidera parinama kemana hayechila. tadera adhikamsai chila musarika.

30:43.latin_iast: ataeva tumi tomāke sarala satya dīne dṛr̤habhāve pratiṣṭhita rākha emana dina āsāra pūrve , yedina āllāhara nikaṭa theke pālāvāra jāẏagā nei, sedina mānuṣa vibhakta haẏe par̤ave.
30:43.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi tomake sarala satya dine drrhabhave pratisthita rakha emana dina asara purve , yedina allahara nikata theke palavara jayaga nei, sedina manusa vibhakta haye parave.

30:44.latin_iast: ye vyakti kupharī kare, tārai opara par̤ave tāra kupharīra phala. āra ye vyakti neka kāja kare, tārā nijederai janya sukhera ṭhikānā kare nicche.
30:44.latin_ascii: ye vyakti kuphari kare, tarai opara parave tara kupharira phala. ara ye vyakti neka kaja kare, tara nijederai janya sukhera thikana kare nicche.

30:45.latin_iast: yāte āllāha svīẏa anugrahe tāderake puraṣkṛta karena, yārā īmāna āne o sat kāja kare. niścaẏai tini to kāphiradera bhālovāsena nā.
30:45.latin_ascii: yate allaha sviya anugrahe taderake puraskrta karena, yara imana ane o sat kaja kare. niscayai tini to kaphiradera bhalovasena na.

30:46.latin_iast: āra tā~ra nidarśanagulora madhye ekaṭi ei ye, tini vātāsa pāṭhāna sukhavara dānakārīrūpe evaṃ yena tomāderake tā~ra anugrahera svāda bhoga karāna evaṃ yena nauyānasamūha tāra nirdeśe calācala kare, yāte tomarā tā~ra anugraha anveṣaṇa karate pāra evaṃ yena tomarā tā~ra kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
30:46.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra nidarsanagulora madhye ekati ei ye, tini vatasa pathana sukhavara danakarirupe evam yena tomaderake ta~ra anugrahera svada bhoga karana evam yena nauyanasamuha tara nirdese calacala kare, yate tomara ta~ra anugraha anvesana karate para evam yena tomara ta~ra krtajnata prakasa kara.

30:47.latin_iast: āmi to preraṇa karechilāma tomāra pūrve vahu rāsūla tādera nija nija sampradāẏera nikaṭa, tārā tādera kāche suspaṣṭa dṛṣṭānta niẏe esechila. ataḥpara āmi tādera theke pratiśodha niẏechilāma, yārā pāpa kāja karechila. āra mu’minadera sāhāyya karā āmāra kartavya.
30:47.latin_ascii: ami to prerana karechilama tomara purve vahu rasula tadera nija nija sampradayera nikata, tara tadera kache suspasta drstanta niye esechila. atahpara ami tadera theke pratisodha niyechilama, yara papa kaja karechila. ara mu’minadera sahayya kara amara kartavya.

30:48.latin_iast: āllāha emana sattā ye, tini vātāsa pāṭhāna, ataḥpara vātāsa meghamālāke sañcālita kare; tārapara tini megharāśike yemana icchā ākāśe char̤iẏe dena evaṃ kakhanao tā khaṇḍa-vikhaṇḍa kare dena; ataḥpara tumi dekhate pāo tāra madhya theke vera haẏe āse vṛṣṭidhārā. tini yakhana tā~ra vāndādera madhye yāderake icchā tā pau~che dena, takhana tārā ānanda karate thāke.
30:48.latin_ascii: allaha emana satta ye, tini vatasa pathana, atahpara vatasa meghamalake sancalita kare; tarapara tini megharasike yemana iccha akase chariye dena evam kakhanao ta khanda-vikhanda kare dena; atahpara tumi dekhate pao tara madhya theke vera haye ase vrstidhara. tini yakhana ta~ra vandadera madhye yaderake iccha ta pau~che dena, takhana tara ananda karate thake.

30:49.latin_iast: yadio tārā tādera opara vṛṣṭi varṣita haoẏāra pūrve hatāśa chila.
30:49.latin_ascii: yadio tara tadera opara vrsti varsita haoyara purve hatasa chila.

30:50.latin_iast: ataeva āllāhara rahamatera phala samparke cintā kara; kibhāve tini jaminake jīvita karena tāra mṛtyura para. niścaẏai tinii mṛtake jīvanadānakārī evaṃ tini sava kichura oparai sarvaśaktimāna.
30:50.latin_ascii: ataeva allahara rahamatera phala samparke cinta kara; kibhave tini jaminake jivita karena tara mrtyura para. niscayai tinii mrtake jivanadanakari evam tini sava kichura oparai sarvasaktimana.

30:51.latin_iast: āra yadi āmi emana vātāsa preraṇa kari, yāra phale tārā śasyake halade dekhate pāẏa, tave takhana tārā avaśyai akṛtajñatā prakāśa kare.
30:51.latin_ascii: ara yadi ami emana vatasa prerana kari, yara phale tara sasyake halade dekhate paya, tave takhana tara avasyai akrtajnata prakasa kare.

30:52.latin_iast: ataeva tumi mṛtaderake śunāte pārave nā evaṃ vadhirakeo āhvāna śonāte pārave nā, yakhana tārā pṛṣṭhapradarśana kare cale yāẏa.
30:52.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi mrtaderake sunate parave na evam vadhirakeo ahvana sonate parave na, yakhana tara prsthapradarsana kare cale yaya.

30:53.latin_iast: āra tumi andhaderakeo tādera bhraṣṭatā theke sarala saṭhika pathe ānate pārave nā. tumi kevala tāderakei śunāte pārave yārā āmāra āẏātake viśvāsa kare, ataḥpara āmāra ānugatya kare.
30:53.latin_ascii: ara tumi andhaderakeo tadera bhrastata theke sarala sathika pathe anate parave na. tumi kevala taderakei sunate parave yara amara ayatake visvasa kare, atahpara amara anugatya kare.

30:54.latin_iast: āllāha tini, yini tomāderake sṛṣṭi karena durvala avasthāẏa, ataḥpara tini durvalatāra para śakti diẏechena, tārapara śaktira para punarāẏa diẏechena durvalatā o vārdhakya. tini yā icchā sṛṣṭi karena evaṃ tinii sarvajña, sarvaśaktimāna.
30:54.latin_ascii: allaha tini, yini tomaderake srsti karena durvala avasthaya, atahpara tini durvalatara para sakti diyechena, tarapara saktira para punaraya diyechena durvalata o vardhakya. tini ya iccha srsti karena evam tinii sarvajna, sarvasaktimana.

30:55.latin_iast: yedina kiẏāmata anuṣṭhita have, sedina pāpīrā śapatha kare valave ye, tārā muhūrtakālera veśi avasthāna kareni. ebhāvei tāderake ulṭo dike paricālita karā hata.
30:55.latin_ascii: yedina kiyamata anusthita have, sedina papira sapatha kare valave ye, tara muhurtakalera vesi avasthana kareni. ebhavei taderake ulto dike paricalita kara hata.

30:56.latin_iast: kintu yāderake jñāna o īmāna deẏā haẏeche, tārā valave: tomarā to āllāhara vidhāne punarutthāna paryanta avasthāna karecha eṭāi hala punarutthāna divasa, kintu tomarā jānate nā.
30:56.latin_ascii: kintu yaderake jnana o imana deya hayeche, tara valave: tomara to allahara vidhane punarutthana paryanta avasthana karecha etai hala punarutthana divasa, kintu tomara janate na.

30:57.latin_iast: sedina jālimadera ojara-āpatti tādera kona upakāre āsave nā evaṃ tāovā kare āllāhara santuṣṭi lābhera suyogao tāderake deẏā have nā.
30:57.latin_ascii: sedina jalimadera ojara-apatti tadera kona upakare asave na evam taova kare allahara santusti labhera suyogao taderake deya have na.

30:58.latin_iast: āmi varṇanā karechi e kuraāne mānuṣera janya pratyeka prakārera udāharaṇa. tumi yadi tādera kāche kona dṛṣṭānta niẏe āsa, tavuo yārā kupharī kareche tārā avaśyai valave: tomarā savāi vātilapanthī chār̤ā āra kichui nao.
30:58.latin_ascii: ami varnana karechi e kuraane manusera janya pratyeka prakarera udaharana. tumi yadi tadera kache kona drstanta niye asa, tavuo yara kuphari kareche tara avasyai valave: tomara savai vatilapanthi chara ara kichui nao.

30:59.latin_iast: ebhāvei āllāha mohara mere thākena tādera antare yārā jāne nā.
30:59.latin_ascii: ebhavei allaha mohara mere thakena tadera antare yara jane na.

30:60.latin_iast: ataeva tumi dhairyadhāraṇa kara. niścaẏai āllāhara oẏādā satya. yārā dṛr̤ha viśvāsī naẏa tārā yena tomāke asthira karate nā pāre.
30:60.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi dhairyadharana kara. niscayai allahara oyada satya. yara drrha visvasi naya tara yena tomake asthira karate na pare.

31:3.latin_iast: yā pathanirdeśa o rahamata sat lokadera janya,
31:3.latin_ascii: ya pathanirdesa o rahamata sat lokadera janya,

31:4.latin_iast: yārā sālāta kāẏema kare, yākāta deẏa evaṃ parakālera prati dṛr̤ha viśvāsa rākhe;
31:4.latin_ascii: yara salata kayema kare, yakata deya evam parakalera prati drrha visvasa rakhe;

31:5.latin_iast: tārāi svīẏa pratipālakera pakṣa theke āgata hidāẏātera opara āche evaṃ tārāi prakṛta saphalakāma.
31:5.latin_ascii: tarai sviya pratipalakera paksa theke agata hidayatera opara ache evam tarai prakrta saphalakama.

31:6.latin_iast: mānuṣera madhye emana lokao āche ye, lokaderake āllāhara patha theke vicyuta karāra janya ajñatāvaśata amūlaka kathāvārtā kraẏa kare neẏa evaṃ āllāhara dekhāno pathake ṭhāṭṭā-vidraƒpera vastu vānāẏa. ederai janya raẏeche apamānajanaka śāsti.
31:6.latin_ascii: manusera madhye emana lokao ache ye, lokaderake allahara patha theke vicyuta karara janya ajnatavasata amulaka kathavarta kraya kare neya evam allahara dekhano pathake thatta-vidraƒpera vastu vanaya. ederai janya rayeche apamanajanaka sasti.

31:7.latin_iast: yakhana tāra kāche āmāra āẏāta telāoẏāta karā haẏa, takhana se ahaṅkāravaśata emanabhāve mukha phiriẏe neẏa yena se tā śunatei pāẏani, yena tāra karṇadvaẏera madhye vadhiratā raẏe che. ataeva tāke susaṃvāda dāo yantraṇādāẏaka śāstira.
31:7.latin_ascii: yakhana tara kache amara ayata telaoyata kara haya, takhana se ahankaravasata emanabhave mukha phiriye neya yena se ta sunatei payani, yena tara karnadvayera madhye vadhirata raye che. ataeva take susamvada dao yantranadayaka sastira.

31:8.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ sat kāja kareche, tādera janya raẏeche ni‘āmatapūrṇa jānnāta,
31:8.latin_ascii: niscayai yara imana eneche evam sat kaja kareche, tadera janya rayeche ni‘amatapurna jannata,

31:9.latin_iast: tārā sekhāne cirakāla thākave. āllāhara oẏādā satya. tini pratāpaśālī, mahā prajñāmaẏa.
31:9.latin_ascii: tara sekhane cirakala thakave. allahara oyada satya. tini pratapasali, maha prajnamaya.

31:10.latin_iast: tini āsamāna sṛṣṭi karechena stambha vyatireke, tomarā tā dekhacha. tini pṛthivīte suucca parvatamālā sthāpana karechena, yāte pṛthivī tomāderake niẏe ḍhale nā par̤e evaṃ ekhāne sava dharanera jīva-jantu char̤iẏe diẏechena. āra āmi ākāśa theke pāni varṣaṇa kari, ataḥpara pṛthivīte utpanna kari sarvaprakāra uttama udbhida.
31:10.latin_ascii: tini asamana srsti karechena stambha vyatireke, tomara ta dekhacha. tini prthivite suucca parvatamala sthapana karechena, yate prthivi tomaderake niye dhale na pare evam ekhane sava dharanera jiva-jantu chariye diyechena. ara ami akasa theke pani varsana kari, atahpara prthivite utpanna kari sarvaprakara uttama udbhida.

31:11.latin_iast: egulo āllāhara sṛṣṭi. tomarā āmāke dekhāo, tini chār̤ā anyerā kī sṛṣṭi kareche. varaṃ jālimarā raẏeche prakāśya pathabhraṣṭatāẏa.
31:11.latin_ascii: egulo allahara srsti. tomara amake dekhao, tini chara anyera ki srsti kareche. varam jalimara rayeche prakasya pathabhrastataya.

31:12.latin_iast: āra āmi lukamānake hikamāta dāna karechilāma. e marme ādeśa karechilāma ye, tumi āllāhara kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara. vastuta ye kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare se tā nijerai kalyāṇera janya kare; āra ye akṛtajña haẏa (se nijerai kṣati sādhana kare) kenanā āllāha to abhāvamukta, praśaṃsita.
31:12.latin_ascii: ara ami lukamanake hikamata dana karechilama. e marme adesa karechilama ye, tumi allahara krtajnata prakasa kara. vastuta ye krtajnata prakasa kare se ta nijerai kalyanera janya kare; ara ye akrtajna haya (se nijerai ksati sadhana kare) kenana allaha to abhavamukta, prasamsita.

31:13.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! yakhana lukamāna svīẏa cheleke upadeśa pradānakāle valalena: he āmāra chele! āllāhara sāthe kāuke śarīka kara nā. niścaẏai śirka mahā juluma.
31:13.latin_ascii: smarana kara! yakhana lukamana sviya cheleke upadesa pradanakale valalena: he amara chele! allahara sathe kauke sarika kara na. niscayai sirka maha juluma.

31:14.latin_iast: āra āmi mānuṣake tāra vāvā-mā samparke ādeśa diẏechi (tādera sāthe bhāla vyavahāra karate). tāra mā kaṣṭera para kaṣṭa sahya kare tāke garbhe dhāraṇa kareche evaṃ du’vachare tāra stana pāna chār̤āno haẏa. sutarāṃ āmāra kṛtajña hao evaṃ tomāra mātā-pitāra. avaśeṣe āmārai kāche phire āsate have.
31:14.latin_ascii: ara ami manusake tara vava-ma samparke adesa diyechi (tadera sathe bhala vyavahara karate). tara ma kastera para kasta sahya kare take garbhe dharana kareche evam du’vachare tara stana pana charano haya. sutaram amara krtajna hao evam tomara mata-pitara. avasese amarai kache phire asate have.

31:15.latin_iast: āra yadi tomāra pitā-mātā tomāke cāpa deẏa ye, tumi āmāra sāthe emana kichu śirka kara, ye samparke tomāra kona jñāna nei, takhana tumi tādera kathā mānave nā kintu duniẏāte tādera sāthe sadbhāve vasavāsa kara. āra ye āmāra abhimukhī haẏeche tāra patha anusaraṇa karave. avaśeṣe āmārai dike tomādera phire āsate have evaṃ āmi tomāderake avahita karava yā tomarā karate.
31:15.latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara pita-mata tomake capa deya ye, tumi amara sathe emana kichu sirka kara, ye samparke tomara kona jnana nei, takhana tumi tadera katha manave na kintu duniyate tadera sathe sadbhave vasavasa kara. ara ye amara abhimukhi hayeche tara patha anusarana karave. avasese amarai dike tomadera phire asate have evam ami tomaderake avahita karava ya tomara karate.

31:16.latin_iast: he āmāra chele! kona kichu yadi sariṣāra dānāra parimāṇao haẏa evaṃ tā yadi pātharera bhitare thāke athavā āsamāne kiṃvā bhū-garbhe, tathāpi tāo āllāha upasthita karavena. niścaẏai āllāha sūkṣmadarśī, samyaka avahita.
31:16.latin_ascii: he amara chele! kona kichu yadi sarisara danara parimanao haya evam ta yadi patharera bhitare thake athava asamane kimva bhu-garbhe, tathapi tao allaha upasthita karavena. niscayai allaha suksmadarsi, samyaka avahita.

31:17.latin_iast: he āmāra chele! sālāta kāẏema kara, sat kājera ādeśa dāo, manda kāja karate niṣedha kara evaṃ tomāra opara ye vipada āse tāte dhairyadhāraṇa kara. niścaẏai e hala dṛr̤ha saṃkalpera kāja.
31:17.latin_ascii: he amara chele! salata kayema kara, sat kajera adesa dao, manda kaja karate nisedha kara evam tomara opara ye vipada ase tate dhairyadharana kara. niscayai e hala drrha samkalpera kaja.

31:18.latin_iast: āra tumi ahaṃkāravaśe mānuṣake avahelā kara nā evaṃ pṛthivīte garvabhare vicaraṇa kara nā. niścaẏai āllāha kona dāmbhika, ahaṃṅkārakārīke bhalovāsena nā.
31:18.latin_ascii: ara tumi ahamkaravase manusake avahela kara na evam prthivite garvabhare vicarana kara na. niscayai allaha kona dambhika, ahamnkarakarike bhalovasena na.

31:19.latin_iast: āra tumi tomāra calāpherāẏa madhyama panthā avalamvana kara evaṃ tomāra kanṭhasvara nīcu rākha, niḥsandehe svarera madhye gādhāra svarai sarvāpekṣā adhika apachandanīẏa.
31:19.latin_ascii: ara tumi tomara calapheraya madhyama pantha avalamvana kara evam tomara kanthasvara nicu rakha, nihsandehe svarera madhye gadhara svarai sarvapeksa adhika apachandaniya.

31:20.latin_iast: tomarā ki dekha nā ye, āllāhai tomādera kāje niẏojita rekhechena yā kichu āche āsamāne o yā kichu āche jamine evaṃ tinii pūrṇa kare diẏechena tomādera prati tāra prakāśya o aprakāśya neẏāmata? mānuṣera madhye kataka erūpao āche, yārā āllāha samparke vāka-vitanḍā kare kona jñāna, kona pathanirdeśa o kona ujjvala grantha chār̤āi.
31:20.latin_ascii: tomara ki dekha na ye, allahai tomadera kaje niyojita rekhechena ya kichu ache asamane o ya kichu ache jamine evam tinii purna kare diyechena tomadera prati tara prakasya o aprakasya neyamatay manusera madhye kataka erupao ache, yara allaha samparke vaka-vitanda kare kona jnana, kona pathanirdesa o kona ujjvala grantha charai.

31:21.latin_iast: āra yakhana tāderake valā haẏa, tomarā tāra anusaraṇa kara yā āllāha avatīrṇa karechena, takhana tārā vale, varaṃ āmarā tāra anusaraṇa karava, yāra opara āmarā āmādera vāpa-dādādera peẏechi. yadio śaẏatāna tāderake jāhānnāmera śāstira dike āhvāna karate thāke tavuo ki?
31:21.latin_ascii: ara yakhana taderake vala haya, tomara tara anusarana kara ya allaha avatirna karechena, takhana tara vale, varam amara tara anusarana karava, yara opara amara amadera vapa-dadadera peyechi. yadio sayatana taderake jahannamera sastira dike ahvana karate thake tavuo kiy

31:22.latin_iast: ye vyakti sat karmaparāẏaṇa haẏe nijeke niṣṭhāra sāthe āllāha abhimukhī kare, se dṛr̤habhāve eka majavuta hātala dhāraṇa karala. sakala kājera pariṇāma āllāharai nikaṭa pau~chave.
31:22.latin_ascii: ye vyakti sat karmaparayana haye nijeke nisthara sathe allaha abhimukhi kare, se drrhabhave eka majavuta hatala dharana karala. sakala kajera parinama allaharai nikata pau~chave.

31:23.latin_iast: āra keu kupharī karale tāra kupharī yena āpanāke cintita nā kare. āmārai kāche tādera phire āsate have. takhana āmi tāderake avahita karava yā kichu tārā karata. niścaẏai āllāha hṛdaẏe yā kichu āche se samparke saviśeṣa avahita āchena.
31:23.latin_ascii: ara keu kuphari karale tara kuphari yena apanake cintita na kare. amarai kache tadera phire asate have. takhana ami taderake avahita karava ya kichu tara karata. niscayai allaha hrdaye ya kichu ache se samparke savisesa avahita achena.

31:24.latin_iast: āmi alpa samaẏera janya tāderake sukha-sambhoga deva, punarāẏa tāderake vādhya karava kaṭhina śāsti bhoga karate.
31:24.latin_ascii: ami alpa samayera janya taderake sukha-sambhoga deva, punaraya taderake vadhya karava kathina sasti bhoga karate.

31:25.latin_iast: āra tumi yadi tāderake jijñesa kara, āsamāna o jamina ke sṛṣṭi karechena? tave tārā avaśyai valave, “āllāha”. tumi vala: sakala praśaṃsā āllāharai. kintu tādera adhikāṃśai jāne nā.
31:25.latin_ascii: ara tumi yadi taderake jijnesa kara, asamana o jamina ke srsti karechenay tave tara avasyai valave, “allaha”. tumi vala: sakala prasamsa allaharai. kintu tadera adhikamsai jane na.

31:26.latin_iast: āsamāne o jamine yā kichu āche tā savai āllāhara. niścaẏai ekamātra āllāha amukhāpekṣī evaṃ praśaṃsita.
31:26.latin_ascii: asamane o jamine ya kichu ache ta savai allahara. niscayai ekamatra allaha amukhapeksi evam prasamsita.

31:27.latin_iast: āra samagra pṛthivīte yata gācha āche tā savai yadi kalama haẏa evaṃ ye samudra raẏeche tāra sāthe yadi ārao sātaṭi samudra śāmila haẏe kāli haẏa tavuo āllāhara vāṇī śeṣa have nā. niścaẏai āllāha pratāpaśālī, mahā prajñāmaẏa.
31:27.latin_ascii: ara samagra prthivite yata gacha ache ta savai yadi kalama haya evam ye samudra rayeche tara sathe yadi arao satati samudra samila haye kali haya tavuo allahara vani sesa have na. niscayai allaha pratapasali, maha prajnamaya.

31:28.latin_iast: tomādera sṛṣṭi o punarutthāna ekaṭi mātra prāṇīra sṛṣṭi o punarutthānera nyāẏa. niścaẏa āllāha sava śonena, sava dekhena.
31:28.latin_ascii: tomadera srsti o punarutthana ekati matra pranira srsti o punarutthanera nyaya. niscaya allaha sava sonena, sava dekhena.

31:29.latin_iast: tumi ki dekha nā ye, āllāha rātake dinera madhye praveśa karāna evaṃ dinake rātera madhye praveśa karāna? āra tinii kāje niẏojita rekhechena sūryake o candrake, pratyekei calate thākave nirdhārita samaẏa paryanta. tomarā yā kara āllāha avaśyai tā samyaka avahita.
31:29.latin_ascii: tumi ki dekha na ye, allaha ratake dinera madhye pravesa karana evam dinake ratera madhye pravesa karanay ara tinii kaje niyojita rekhechena suryake o candrake, pratyekei calate thakave nirdharita samaya paryanta. tomara ya kara allaha avasyai ta samyaka avahita.

31:30.latin_iast: esava pramāṇa kare ye, āllāhai satya evaṃ tārā āllāha vyatīta yāke āhvāna kare segulo bhittihīna, niścaẏai āllāha ati ucca maryādāśīla, ati mahāna.
31:30.latin_ascii: esava pramana kare ye, allahai satya evam tara allaha vyatita yake ahvana kare segulo bhittihina, niscayai allaha ati ucca maryadasila, ati mahana.

31:31.latin_iast: tumi ki dekha nā ye, nauyānasamūha āllāhara anugrahe samudre calācala kare, yena tini tomāderake tāra nidarśanāvalīra kichu dekhāna? niścaẏai ete raẏeche nidarśana pratyeka emana vyaktira janya ye khuva dhairyadhāraṇa kare o kṛtajña haẏa.
31:31.latin_ascii: tumi ki dekha na ye, nauyanasamuha allahara anugrahe samudre calacala kare, yena tini tomaderake tara nidarsanavalira kichu dekhanay niscayai ete rayeche nidarsana pratyeka emana vyaktira janya ye khuva dhairyadharana kare o krtajna haya.

31:32.latin_iast: āra yakhana (sāgare) parvatera nyāẏa ḍheugulo tāderake ghire phele takhana tārā khā~ṭi mane āllāhake āhvāna karate thāke. kintu yakhana tini tāderake rakṣā kare sthalabhāgera dike ānena, takhana tādera madhye kichu loka satpathe thāke. āra kevala aṅgīkāra bhaṅgakārī, akṛtajña vyaktii āmāra nidarśanāvalī asvīkāra kare.
31:32.latin_ascii: ara yakhana (sagare) parvatera nyaya dheugulo taderake ghire phele takhana tara kha~ti mane allahake ahvana karate thake. kintu yakhana tini taderake raksa kare sthalabhagera dike anena, takhana tadera madhye kichu loka satpathe thake. ara kevala angikara bhangakari, akrtajna vyaktii amara nidarsanavali asvikara kare.

31:33.latin_iast: he mānuṣa! tomarā bhaẏa kara tomādera pratipālakake evaṃ bhaẏa kara sedinake, yedina pitā santānera kona upakāre āsave nā, āra nā santāna pitāra upakāre āsave, niścaẏa āllāhara oẏādā satya. sutarāṃ duniẏāra jīvana yena kichutei tomāderake dheā~kā nā deẏa evaṃ pratāraka śaẏatānao yena kichutei tomāderake āllāha samparke pratārita nā kare.
31:33.latin_ascii: he manusa! tomara bhaya kara tomadera pratipalakake evam bhaya kara sedinake, yedina pita santanera kona upakare asave na, ara na santana pitara upakare asave, niscaya allahara oyada satya. sutaram duniyara jivana yena kichutei tomaderake dhea~ka na deya evam prataraka sayatanao yena kichutei tomaderake allaha samparke pratarita na kare.

31:34.latin_iast: niścaẏa āllāharai kāche raẏeche kiẏāmata samparke jñāna evaṃ tinii vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karena, āra tinii jānena yā kichu āche garbhādhāre. keu jāne nā āgāmīkālya se kī āẏa karave evaṃ keu jāne nā kona sthāne se mṛtyuvaraṇa karave. niścaẏa āllāha savakichu jānena, sava khavara rākhena.
31:34.latin_ascii: niscaya allaharai kache rayeche kiyamata samparke jnana evam tinii vrsti varsana karena, ara tinii janena ya kichu ache garbhadhare. keu jane na agamikalya se ki aya karave evam keu jane na kona sthane se mrtyuvarana karave. niscaya allaha savakichu janena, sava khavara rakhena.

32:2.latin_iast: e kitāva viśvajagatera pratipālakera pakṣa theke avatīrṇa, ete kona sandeha nei.
32:2.latin_ascii: e kitava visvajagatera pratipalakera paksa theke avatirna, ete kona sandeha nei.

32:3.latin_iast: tave tārā ki vale ye, eṭā to se nije racanā kare niẏeche? varaṃ eṭā to āpanāra pratipālakera pakṣa theke āgata satya, yena tumi emana lokaderake sāvadhāna karate pāra, yādera kāche tomāra pūrve kona satarkakārī āseni. haẏato tārā sarala saṭhika patha lābha karave.
32:3.latin_ascii: tave tara ki vale ye, eta to se nije racana kare niyechey varam eta to apanara pratipalakera paksa theke agata satya, yena tumi emana lokaderake savadhana karate para, yadera kache tomara purve kona satarkakari aseni. hayato tara sarala sathika patha labha karave.

32:4.latin_iast: āllāha sei sattā, yini sṛṣṭi karechena āsamāna, jamina evaṃ e duẏera madhyavartī sava kichu chaẏa dine, ataḥpara tini ‘āraśera opara samunnata haẏechena. tini chār̤ā tomādera kona abhibhāvaka nei evaṃ kona supāriśakārīo nei, tavuo ki tomarā upadeśa grahaṇa karave nā?
32:4.latin_ascii: allaha sei satta, yini srsti karechena asamana, jamina evam e duyera madhyavarti sava kichu chaya dine, atahpara tini ‘arasera opara samunnata hayechena. tini chara tomadera kona abhibhavaka nei evam kona suparisakario nei, tavuo ki tomara upadesa grahana karave nay

32:5.latin_iast: tini āsamāna theke jamina paryanta yāvatīẏa viṣaẏa niẏantraṇa karena, avaśeṣe tā tā~ra nikaṭe emana ekadine pau~chave, yāra parimāṇa have tomādera gaṇanāẏa hājāra vacharera samāna.
32:5.latin_ascii: tini asamana theke jamina paryanta yavatiya visaya niyantrana karena, avasese ta ta~ra nikate emana ekadine pau~chave, yara parimana have tomadera gananaya hajara vacharera samana.

32:6.latin_iast: tini aprakāśya o prakāśyera viṣaẏādi parijñāta, pratāpaśālī, parama daẏālu.
32:6.latin_ascii: tini aprakasya o prakasyera visayadi parijnata, pratapasali, parama dayalu.

32:7.latin_iast: yini ati sundararūpe tā~ra pratyekaṭi sṛṣṭike sṛjana karechena evaṃ mānava sṛṣṭira sūcanā karechena kādāmāṭi diẏe.
32:7.latin_ascii: yini ati sundararupe ta~ra pratyekati srstike srjana karechena evam manava srstira sucana karechena kadamati diye.

32:8.latin_iast: tārapara tāra vaṃśadharake sṛṣṭi karechena nagaṇya pānira sārāṃśa theke.
32:8.latin_ascii: tarapara tara vamsadharake srsti karechena naganya panira saramsa theke.

32:9.latin_iast: ataḥpara tini tāke sugaṭhita karechena evaṃ tāte nijera pakṣa theke rūha phu~ke diẏechena, āra tomāderake dāna karechena karṇa, cakṣu o antaḥkaraṇa. kintu tomarā khuva kamai kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
32:9.latin_ascii: atahpara tini take sugathita karechena evam tate nijera paksa theke ruha phu~ke diyechena, ara tomaderake dana karechena karna, caksu o antahkarana. kintu tomara khuva kamai krtajnata prakasa kara.

32:10.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, āmarā yakhana māṭite miśe śeṣa haẏe yāva, takhana ki āvāra āmāderake natuna kare sṛṣṭi karā have? vastuta tārā tādera pratipālakera sākṣātake asvīkāra kare.
32:10.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, amara yakhana matite mise sesa haye yava, takhana ki avara amaderake natuna kare srsti kara havey vastuta tara tadera pratipalakera saksatake asvikara kare.

32:11.latin_iast: tumi vale dāo, tomādera jīvana haraṇera dāẏitve niẏojita mālākula māuta (mṛtyura phereśatā) tomādera jīvana haraṇa karave, tārapara tomāderake tomādera pratipālakera nikaṭa phiriẏe neẏā have.
32:11.latin_ascii: tumi vale dao, tomadera jivana haranera dayitve niyojita malakula mauta (mrtyura pheresata) tomadera jivana harana karave, tarapara tomaderake tomadera pratipalakera nikata phiriye neya have.

32:12.latin_iast: āra yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana pāpīrā tādera pratipālakera sāmane svīẏa māthā nīcu kare valave, he āmādera pratipālaka! āmarā dekhalāma o śravaṇa karalāma, (ekhana) tumi āmāderake punarāẏa (pṛthivīte) preraṇa kara; āmarā neka kāja karava. āmarā to dṛr̤ha viśvāsī haẏechi.
32:12.latin_ascii: ara yadi tumi dekhate, yakhana papira tadera pratipalakera samane sviya matha nicu kare valave, he amadera pratipalaka! amara dekhalama o sravana karalama, (ekhana) tumi amaderake punaraya (prthivite) prerana kara; amara neka kaja karava. amara to drrha visvasi hayechi.

32:13.latin_iast: āmi yadi icchā karatāma, tave pratyeka vyaktike sarala saṭhika patha dāna karatāma, kintu āmāra e vāṇī nirdhārita haẏe raẏeche ye, āmi avaśyai jina o mānuṣa ubhaẏake diẏei jāhānnāma paripūrṇa karava.
32:13.latin_ascii: ami yadi iccha karatama, tave pratyeka vyaktike sarala sathika patha dana karatama, kintu amara e vani nirdharita haye rayeche ye, ami avasyai jina o manusa ubhayake diyei jahannama paripurna karava.

32:14.latin_iast: ataeva ājakera e dinera sākṣāt lābhera kathā tomādera bhule thākāra kāraṇe tomarā śāsti bhoga kara, āmio tomāderake bhule gelāma. āra tomarā yā karate, tāra janya cirasthāẏī śāsti bhoga karate thāka.
32:14.latin_ascii: ataeva ajakera e dinera saksat labhera katha tomadera bhule thakara karane tomara sasti bhoga kara, amio tomaderake bhule gelama. ara tomara ya karate, tara janya cirasthayi sasti bhoga karate thaka.

32:15.latin_iast: kevala tārāi āmāra nidarśanagulora prati īmāna rākhe, yāderake āmāra āẏātasamūha yakhana smaraṇa kariẏe deẏā haẏa takhanai tārā sijadāẏa luṭiẏe par̤e evaṃ svīẏa pratipālakera praśaṃsā, pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare, āra tārā ahaṅkāra kare nā.
32:15.latin_ascii: kevala tarai amara nidarsanagulora prati imana rakhe, yaderake amara ayatasamuha yakhana smarana kariye deya haya takhanai tara sijadaya lutiye pare evam sviya pratipalakera prasamsa, pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare, ara tara ahankara kare na.

32:16.latin_iast: tādera dehapārśa vichānā theke ālādā haẏe yāẏa ye, tārā tādera pratipālakake āhvāna karate thāke bhaẏe o āśāẏa evaṃ āmi tāderake ye riyika diẏechi tā theke tārā vyaẏa kare.
32:16.latin_ascii: tadera dehaparsa vichana theke alada haye yaya ye, tara tadera pratipalakake ahvana karate thake bhaye o asaya evam ami taderake ye riyika diyechi ta theke tara vyaya kare.

32:17.latin_iast: keui jāne nā tādera janya naẏana jur̤ono kī kī sāmagrī lukiẏe rākhā haẏeche tādera kṛtakarmera pratidāna svarūpa?
32:17.latin_ascii: keui jane na tadera janya nayana jurono ki ki samagri lukiye rakha hayeche tadera krtakarmera pratidana svarupay

32:18.latin_iast: tave ki ye vyakti īmānadāra se ai vyaktira samatulya ye pāpācārī? kakhanai tārā samāna hate pāre nā.
32:18.latin_ascii: tave ki ye vyakti imanadara se ai vyaktira samatulya ye papacariy kakhanai tara samana hate pare na.

32:19.latin_iast: ataeva yārā viśvāsa kareche evaṃ sat kāja kareche, tādera janya raẏeche tādera kājakarmera pratidāne āpyāẏanasvarūpa cirakālera vāsasthāna jānnāta.
32:19.latin_ascii: ataeva yara visvasa kareche evam sat kaja kareche, tadera janya rayeche tadera kajakarmera pratidane apyayanasvarupa cirakalera vasasthana jannata.

32:20.latin_iast: āra yārā pāpa kāja kareche tādera vāsasthāna have jāhānnāma. yakhanai tārā sekhāna theke vera hate cāive, takhanai tāderake sethāẏa phiriẏe deẏā have evaṃ tāderake valā have, āgunera svāda grahaṇa (śāsti bhoga) kara yā tomarā mithyā pratipanna karate .
32:20.latin_ascii: ara yara papa kaja kareche tadera vasasthana have jahannama. yakhanai tara sekhana theke vera hate caive, takhanai taderake sethaya phiriye deya have evam taderake vala have, agunera svada grahana (sasti bhoga) kara ya tomara mithya pratipanna karate .

32:21.latin_iast: niścaẏai āmi tāderake sāmānya śāsti bhoga karāva mahāśāstira pūrve, yāte tārā phire āse.
32:21.latin_ascii: niscayai ami taderake samanya sasti bhoga karava mahasastira purve, yate tara phire ase.

32:22.latin_iast: ai vyaktira cāite adhika atyācārī ke yāke tāra pratipālakera āẏātasamūha smaraṇa kariẏe deẏā haẏa, kintu se tā theke vimukha haẏa? āmi avaśyai pāpīdera theke pratiśodha neva.
32:22.latin_ascii: ai vyaktira caite adhika atyacari ke yake tara pratipalakera ayatasamuha smarana kariye deya haya, kintu se ta theke vimukha hayay ami avasyai papidera theke pratisodha neva.

32:23.latin_iast: āmi mūsāke kitāva diẏechi. ataeva tumi tā~ra sākṣāta samparke kona sandeha karave nā. āra āmi tāke vāṇī isarāīlera janya pathapradarśanakārī karechilāma.
32:23.latin_ascii: ami musake kitava diyechi. ataeva tumi ta~ra saksata samparke kona sandeha karave na. ara ami take vani isarailera janya pathapradarsanakari karechilama.

32:24.latin_iast: āra āmi tādera madhya theke netā nirvācana karechilāma, yārā āmāra ādeśa anuyāẏī dika-nirdeśanā dita yatadina tārā dhairyadhāraṇa karechila. āra tārā āmāra āẏātasamūhe dṛr̤habhāve viśvāsa karata.
32:24.latin_ascii: ara ami tadera madhya theke neta nirvacana karechilama, yara amara adesa anuyayi dika-nirdesana dita yatadina tara dhairyadharana karechila. ara tara amara ayatasamuhe drrhabhave visvasa karata.

32:25.latin_iast: tārā ye viṣaẏe parasparera madhye matabheda karata, avaśyai āpanāra pratipālaka kiẏāmatera dina se viṣaẏe tādera madhye phaẏasālā kare devena.
32:25.latin_ascii: tara ye visaye parasparera madhye matabheda karata, avasyai apanara pratipalaka kiyamatera dina se visaye tadera madhye phayasala kare devena.

32:26.latin_iast: eṭāo ki tāderake patha dekhālo nā ye, āmi tādera āge kata mānava sampradāẏake dhvaṃsa karechi, yādera vāsasthānasamūhera madhye erā yātāẏāta kare thāke? niścaẏa ete raẏeche spaṣṭa nidarśana. tavuo ki tārā śunave nā?
32:26.latin_ascii: etao ki taderake patha dekhalo na ye, ami tadera age kata manava sampradayake dhvamsa karechi, yadera vasasthanasamuhera madhye era yatayata kare thakey niscaya ete rayeche spasta nidarsana. tavuo ki tara sunave nay

32:27.latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya kare nā ye, āmi śuṣka jamine pāni pravāhita kari, tārapara tāra sāhāyye śasya utpādana kari, tā theke khāẏa tādera catuṣpada janturā (cāra pāviśiṣṭa paśu) evaṃ tārā nijerāo? tavuo ki tārā dekhe nā?
32:27.latin_ascii: tara ki laksya kare na ye, ami suska jamine pani pravahita kari, tarapara tara sahayye sasya utpadana kari, ta theke khaya tadera catuspada jantura (cara pavisista pasu) evam tara nijeraoy tavuo ki tara dekhe nay

32:28.latin_iast: āra tārā vale: yadi tomarā satyavādī hao tāhale vala, e phaẏasālā kakhana have?
32:28.latin_ascii: ara tara vale: yadi tomara satyavadi hao tahale vala, e phayasala kakhana havey

32:29.latin_iast: tumi vale dāo, sei phāẏasālāra dine kāphiradera īmāna tādera kona kāje āsave nā evaṃ tāderake kona avakāśao deẏā have nā.
32:29.latin_ascii: tumi vale dao, sei phayasalara dine kaphiradera imana tadera kona kaje asave na evam taderake kona avakasao deya have na.

32:30.latin_iast: ataeva tumi tādera hate mukha phiriẏe nāo evaṃ apekṣāẏa thāka, tārāo apekṣāẏa raẏeche.
32:30.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi tadera hate mukha phiriye nao evam apeksaya thaka, tarao apeksaya rayeche.

33:1.latin_iast: he nāvī! āllāhake bhaẏa kara evaṃ kāphiradera o munāphikadera anusaraṇa karave nā. niścaẏai āllāha mahājñānī, prajñāmaẏa.
33:1.latin_ascii: he navi! allahake bhaya kara evam kaphiradera o munaphikadera anusarana karave na. niscayai allaha mahajnani, prajnamaya.

33:2.latin_iast: āra tumi anusaraṇa kara yā tomāra pratipālakera pakṣa hate tomāra prati oẏāhī karā haẏeche. niścaẏai tomarā yā kara āllāha se samparke samyaka avahita āchena.
33:2.latin_ascii: ara tumi anusarana kara ya tomara pratipalakera paksa hate tomara prati oyahi kara hayeche. niscayai tomara ya kara allaha se samparke samyaka avahita achena.

33:3.latin_iast: tumi āllāhara opara nirbhara kara. vastuta tattvāvadhāẏaka hiseve āllāhai yatheṣṭa.
33:3.latin_ascii: tumi allahara opara nirbhara kara. vastuta tattvavadhayaka hiseve allahai yathesta.

33:4.latin_iast: āllāha kona mānuṣera janya tāra vakṣera madhye du’ṭi hṛdaẏa sṛṣṭi karenani; evaṃ tomādera strīdera madhya hate yādera sāthe tomarā ‘yihāra’ kara tāderake tomādera jananī karenani, āra tomādera pālaka putraderakeo tomādera chele karenani. ogulo tomādera mukhera kathā mātra. vastuta āllāhai valena satya kathā evaṃ tinii sarala saṭhika patha pradarśana karena.
33:4.latin_ascii: allaha kona manusera janya tara vaksera madhye du’ti hrdaya srsti karenani; evam tomadera stridera madhya hate yadera sathe tomara ‘yihara’ kara taderake tomadera janani karenani, ara tomadera palaka putraderakeo tomadera chele karenani. ogulo tomadera mukhera katha matra. vastuta allahai valena satya katha evam tinii sarala sathika patha pradarsana karena.

33:5.latin_iast: tomarā tāderake āhvāna kara tādera prakṛta pitṛ paricaẏe, eṭāi āllāhra kāche adhika inasāphapūrṇa. yadi tomarā tādera prakṛta pitṛ-paricaẏa nā jāna, tave tārā tomādera dīni bhāi evaṃ vandhurūpe gaṇya have. e vyāpāre tomarā ye bhūla-tra“ṭi kare phelecha tāte tomādera kona gunāha have nā, kintu antare icchā thākale gunāh have. āra āllāha parama kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
33:5.latin_ascii: tomara taderake ahvana kara tadera prakrta pitr paricaye, etai allahra kache adhika inasaphapurna. yadi tomara tadera prakrta pitr-paricaya na jana, tave tara tomadera dini bhai evam vandhurupe ganya have. e vyapare tomara ye bhula-tra“ti kare phelecha tate tomadera kona gunaha have na, kintu antare iccha thakale gunah have. ara allaha parama ksamasila, parama dayalu.

33:6.latin_iast: nāvī mu’minadera kāche tādera nijedera ceẏeo adhika ghaniṣṭha evaṃ tāra strīgaṇa tādera mātā āra ātmīẏa-svajana āllāhara vidhāne paraspara uttarādhikārī haoẏāra vyāpāre anyānya mu’mina o muhājiradera ceẏe adhika ghaniṣṭha. tave yadi tomarā tomādera nijedera vandhu-vāndhavadera sāthe kichu anugraha karate cāo karate pāra. eṭā kitāve lipivaddha āche.
33:6.latin_ascii: navi mu’minadera kache tadera nijedera ceyeo adhika ghanistha evam tara strigana tadera mata ara atmiya-svajana allahara vidhane paraspara uttaradhikari haoyara vyapare anyanya mu’mina o muhajiradera ceye adhika ghanistha. tave yadi tomara tomadera nijedera vandhu-vandhavadera sathe kichu anugraha karate cao karate para. eta kitave lipivaddha ache.

33:7.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara! yakhana āmi śapatha grahaṇa karechilāma nāvīdera kācha theke evaṃ tomāra kācha theke, nūha, ivarāhīma o ‘īsā ivanu māraiẏāmera kācha theke evaṃ tādera kācha theke grahaṇa karechilāma ati dṛr̤ha pratiśra“ti.
33:7.latin_ascii: ara smarana kara! yakhana ami sapatha grahana karechilama navidera kacha theke evam tomara kacha theke, nuha, ivarahima o ‘isa ivanu maraiyamera kacha theke evam tadera kacha theke grahana karechilama ati drrha pratisra“ti.

33:8.latin_iast: yena tini satyavādīderake tādera satyavādītā samparke jijñesa karena; āra tini kāphiradera janya prastuta kare rekhechena yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
33:8.latin_ascii: yena tini satyavadiderake tadera satyavadita samparke jijnesa karena; ara tini kaphiradera janya prastuta kare rekhechena yantranadayaka sasti.

33:9.latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa, tomarā smaraṇa kara! tomādera prati āllāhra anugrahake yakhana śatra“ vāhinī tomādera opara ākramaṇa karechila, takhana āmi tādera opara preraṇa karechilāma eka pracanḍa vāẏu evaṃ emana eka sainyadala yāderake tomarā dekhate pāoni. tomarā yā kara āllāha tā dekhena.
33:9.latin_ascii: he mu’minagana, tomara smarana kara! tomadera prati allahra anugrahake yakhana satra“ vahini tomadera opara akramana karechila, takhana ami tadera opara prerana karechilama eka pracanda vayu evam emana eka sainyadala yaderake tomara dekhate paoni. tomara ya kara allaha ta dekhena.

33:10.latin_iast: yakhana tārā tomādera opara dika theke evaṃ tomādera nimna dika theke tomādera opara ākramaṇa karechila, evaṃ yakhana tomādera cakṣu visphorita haẏechila, prāṇa vera haoẏāra upakrama haẏe par̤echila āra tomarā āllāha samparke nānā rakama dhāraṇā karate śuru karechile.
33:10.latin_ascii: yakhana tara tomadera opara dika theke evam tomadera nimna dika theke tomadera opara akramana karechila, evam yakhana tomadera caksu visphorita hayechila, prana vera haoyara upakrama haye parechila ara tomara allaha samparke nana rakama dharana karate suru karechile.

33:11.latin_iast: takhana mu’minaderake parīkṣā karā haẏechila evaṃ tārā bhīṣaṇabhāve prakampita haẏechila.
33:11.latin_ascii: takhana mu’minaderake pariksa kara hayechila evam tara bhisanabhave prakampita hayechila.

33:12.latin_iast: āra yakhana munāphikarā evaṃ yādera antare roga raẏeche tārā valechila: āllāha o tā~ra rāsūla āmāderake ye pratiśra“ti diẏechena, tā pratāraṇā chār̤ā āra kichui naẏa.
33:12.latin_ascii: ara yakhana munaphikara evam yadera antare roga rayeche tara valechila: allaha o ta~ra rasula amaderake ye pratisra“ti diyechena, ta pratarana chara ara kichui naya.

33:13.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara! yakhana tādera madhya theke eka dala valechila: he iẏāsrivavāsī! ekhāne tomādera kona sthāna nei, ataeva tomarā phire yāo āra tādera madhye eka dala nāvīra kāche avyāhati ceẏe valechila: āmādera vār̤i-ghara arakṣita. prakṛtapakṣe tā arakṣita chila nā. varaṃ tādera pālāvārai icchā chila.
33:13.latin_ascii: ara smarana kara! yakhana tadera madhya theke eka dala valechila: he iyasrivavasi! ekhane tomadera kona sthana nei, ataeva tomara phire yao ara tadera madhye eka dala navira kache avyahati ceye valechila: amadera vari-ghara araksita. prakrtapakse ta araksita chila na. varam tadera palavarai iccha chila.

33:14.latin_iast: āra yadi śatra“rā nagarīra cāradika theke praveśa kare kupharīra janya tāderake prarocita karata, tave tārā tatkṣaṇāt tāi karata; evaṃ tārā sethāẏa khuva alpai vilamva karata.
33:14.latin_ascii: ara yadi satra“ra nagarira caradika theke pravesa kare kupharira janya taderake prarocita karata, tave tara tatksanat tai karata; evam tara sethaya khuva alpai vilamva karata.

33:15.latin_iast: athaca erāi pūrve āllāhra sāthe śapatha karechila ye, tārā pichu haṭe phire yāve nā āra āllāhra sāthe kṛta aṅgīkārera javāvadihi karatei have.
33:15.latin_ascii: athaca erai purve allahra sathe sapatha karechila ye, tara pichu hate phire yave na ara allahra sathe krta angikarera javavadihi karatei have.

33:16.latin_iast: tumi vale dāo, tomarā yadi mṛtyu athavā hatyāra bhaẏe pālāẏana kara, tave palāẏana tomādera konai upakāre āsave nā evaṃ takhana tomāderake alpai bhoga karate deẏā have.
33:16.latin_ascii: tumi vale dao, tomara yadi mrtyu athava hatyara bhaye palayana kara, tave palayana tomadera konai upakare asave na evam takhana tomaderake alpai bhoga karate deya have.

33:17.latin_iast: vala: se ke, ye tomāderake āllāhara (śāsti) theke rakṣā karate pāre, yadi tini icchā karena tomādera kona kṣati karate? athavā (se ke, ye rodha karate pāre tā~ra anugrahake,) yadi tini tomādera prati anugraha karate icchā karena? āra tārā āllāha vyatīta nijedera janya kona vandhu o kona sāhāyyakārī pāve nā.
33:17.latin_ascii: vala: se ke, ye tomaderake allahara (sasti) theke raksa karate pare, yadi tini iccha karena tomadera kona ksati karatey athava (se ke, ye rodha karate pare ta~ra anugrahake,) yadi tini tomadera prati anugraha karate iccha karenay ara tara allaha vyatita nijedera janya kona vandhu o kona sahayyakari pave na.

33:18.latin_iast: āllāha khuva bhāla karei jānena tomādera madhye kārā yuddhe aṃśagrahaṇa karate vādhā deẏa evaṃ kārā tādera bhāiderake vale, “āmādera kāche esa” tārā khuva kamai yuddhe aṃśagrahaṇa kare,
33:18.latin_ascii: allaha khuva bhala karei janena tomadera madhye kara yuddhe amsagrahana karate vadha deya evam kara tadera bhaiderake vale, “amadera kache esa” tara khuva kamai yuddhe amsagrahana kare,

33:19.latin_iast: tomādera prati kārpaṇya kare. āra yakhana kona bhaẏera kāraṇa sāmane āse, takhana tumi tāderake dekhate pāve ye, tārā mṛtyubhaẏe acetana vyaktira nyāẏa cokha ulṭiẏe tomāra dike tākāẏa. ataḥpara yakhana se bhaẏa cale yāẏa, takhana tārā dhana-sampadera lobhe tīvra bhāṣāẏa tomāderake ākramaṇa kare. tārā īmāna āneni. ataeva āllāha tādera kāryasamūha vyartha kare diẏechena. āra erūpa karā āllāhra janya khuvai sahaja.
33:19.latin_ascii: tomadera prati karpanya kare. ara yakhana kona bhayera karana samane ase, takhana tumi taderake dekhate pave ye, tara mrtyubhaye acetana vyaktira nyaya cokha ultiye tomara dike takaya. atahpara yakhana se bhaya cale yaya, takhana tara dhana-sampadera lobhe tivra bhasaya tomaderake akramana kare. tara imana aneni. ataeva allaha tadera karyasamuha vyartha kare diyechena. ara erupa kara allahra janya khuvai sahaja.

33:20.latin_iast: tārā dhāraṇā kare ye, ekhanao sammilita śatra“vāhinī cale yāẏani. āra yadi se vāhinī punarāẏa ese par̤e, tave tārā kāmanā karave ye, kata bhāla hata yadi tārā maruvāsīdera madhya theke tomādera saṃvāda jene nita! tārā yadi tomādera sāthe thekeo yeta, tavuo tārā khuva sāmānyai yuddha karata.
33:20.latin_ascii: tara dharana kare ye, ekhanao sammilita satra“vahini cale yayani. ara yadi se vahini punaraya ese pare, tave tara kamana karave ye, kata bhala hata yadi tara maruvasidera madhya theke tomadera samvada jene nita! tara yadi tomadera sathe thekeo yeta, tavuo tara khuva samanyai yuddha karata.

33:21.latin_iast: tomādera madhye yārā āllāha o kiẏāmatera dinera āśā kare evaṃ āllāhke veśi veśi smaraṇa kare, tādera janya avaśyai uttama ādarśa raẏeche rāsūlullāha era madhye.
33:21.latin_ascii: tomadera madhye yara allaha o kiyamatera dinera asa kare evam allahke vesi vesi smarana kare, tadera janya avasyai uttama adarsa rayeche rasulullaha era madhye.

33:22.latin_iast: āra yakhana mu’minarā sammilita śatra“vāhinīke dekhate pela, takhana tārā vale uṭhala, “āllāha o tā~ra rāsūla erai pratiśra“ti āmāderake diẏechilena evaṃ āllāha o tā~ra rāsūla satyai valechena.” ete tādera īmāna o ānugatya āro vṛddhi pela.
33:22.latin_ascii: ara yakhana mu’minara sammilita satra“vahinike dekhate pela, takhana tara vale uthala, “allaha o ta~ra rasula erai pratisra“ti amaderake diyechilena evam allaha o ta~ra rasula satyai valechena.” ete tadera imana o anugatya aro vrddhi pela.

33:23.latin_iast: mu’minadera madhye kataka loka emanao āche yārā āllāhra sāthe tādera kṛta aṅgīkāra pūrṇa kareche; tādera madhye keu keu śāhādāta varaṇa kareche evaṃ keu keu apekṣāẏa raẏeche. tārā svīẏa saṃkalpa ekaṭuo parivartana kareni.
33:23.latin_ascii: mu’minadera madhye kataka loka emanao ache yara allahra sathe tadera krta angikara purna kareche; tadera madhye keu keu sahadata varana kareche evam keu keu apeksaya rayeche. tara sviya samkalpa ekatuo parivartana kareni.

33:24.latin_iast: eṭā ejanya yāte āllāha satyavādīderake tādera satyavādītāra janya pratidāna dena evaṃ icchā karale munāphikvadera śāsti dena athavā tāderake tāovā karāra suyoga dena. niḥsandehe āllāha atyanta kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
33:24.latin_ascii: eta ejanya yate allaha satyavadiderake tadera satyavaditara janya pratidana dena evam iccha karale munaphikvadera sasti dena athava taderake taova karara suyoga dena. nihsandehe allaha atyanta ksamasila, parama dayalu.

33:25.latin_iast: āllāha kāphiraderake tādera krodha sahakāre phiriẏe diẏechena, tārā kona kalyāṇa arjana kareni. āra yuddha kṣetre mu’minadera janya āllāhi yatheṣṭa. āllāha mahā kṣamatāvāna, pravala pratāpaśālī.
33:25.latin_ascii: allaha kaphiraderake tadera krodha sahakare phiriye diyechena, tara kona kalyana arjana kareni. ara yuddha ksetre mu’minadera janya allahi yathesta. allaha maha ksamatavana, pravala pratapasali.

33:26.latin_iast: āhle kitāvera madhya theke yārā muśarikadera sāhāyya karechila, tāderake āllāha tādera dūrgasamūha theke nāmiẏe dilena evaṃ tādera antare bhīti sañcāra karalena, phale tomarā tādera eka dalake hatyā karecha evaṃ ekadalake vandī karecha.
33:26.latin_ascii: ahle kitavera madhya theke yara musarikadera sahayya karechila, taderake allaha tadera durgasamuha theke namiye dilena evam tadera antare bhiti sancara karalena, phale tomara tadera eka dalake hatya karecha evam ekadalake vandi karecha.

33:27.latin_iast: āra tini tomāderake uttarādhikārī kare dilena tādera jaminera, tādera vār̤i-gharasamūhera, tādera dhana-sampadera evaṃ emana jaminerao yāra opara tomarā ekhanao padārpaṇa karani. āra āllāha sarvaviṣaẏe sarvaśaktimāna.
33:27.latin_ascii: ara tini tomaderake uttaradhikari kare dilena tadera jaminera, tadera vari-gharasamuhera, tadera dhana-sampadera evam emana jaminerao yara opara tomara ekhanao padarpana karani. ara allaha sarvavisaye sarvasaktimana.

33:28.latin_iast: he nāvī! tumi tomāra strīderake vala: yadi tomarā pārthiva jīvana o tāra saundarya cāo, tave eso āmi tomādera bhogera vyavasthā kare dei evaṃ sammānera sāthe tomāderake vidāẏa dei.
33:28.latin_ascii: he navi! tumi tomara striderake vala: yadi tomara parthiva jivana o tara saundarya cao, tave eso ami tomadera bhogera vyavastha kare dei evam sammanera sathe tomaderake vidaya dei.

33:29.latin_iast: āra yadi tomarā āllāh, tā~ra rāsūla (sāllāllāhu ‘ālāihi oẏā sāllāma) o parakāla cāo, tave tomādera madhye yārā sat guṇasampanna, niścaẏai āllāha tādera janya uttama puraskāra prastuta kare rekhechena.
33:29.latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara allah, ta~ra rasula (sallallahu ‘alaihi oya sallama) o parakala cao, tave tomadera madhye yara sat gunasampanna, niscayai allaha tadera janya uttama puraskara prastuta kare rekhechena.

33:30.latin_iast: he nāvīra strīgaṇa! tomādera madhya theke ye keu prakāśye aślīla kāja karave, tāke dviguṇa śāsti deẏā have evaṃ eṭā āllāhara pakṣe khuvai sahaja.
33:30.latin_ascii: he navira strigana! tomadera madhya theke ye keu prakasye aslila kaja karave, take dviguna sasti deya have evam eta allahara pakse khuvai sahaja.

33:31.latin_iast: āra tomādera madhye ye keu āllāhara evaṃ tā~ra rāsūlera ānugatya karave o sat kāja karave, tāke āmi dviguṇa puraskāra deva, āra tāra janya āmi prastuta rekhechi sammānajanaka jīvikā.
33:31.latin_ascii: ara tomadera madhye ye keu allahara evam ta~ra rasulera anugatya karave o sat kaja karave, take ami dviguna puraskara deva, ara tara janya ami prastuta rekhechi sammanajanaka jivika.

33:32.latin_iast: he nāvīra strīgaṇa! tomarā kona sādhāraṇa strīlokera mata nao; yadi tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara tave (parapuruṣera sāthe) kathā valāra samaẏa emanabhave komala kanṭhe kathā vala nā yāte antare yāra (kupravṛttira) roga raẏechena se lālāẏita haẏa. āra tomarā nyāẏasaṅgata kathā valave.
33:32.latin_ascii: he navira strigana! tomara kona sadharana strilokera mata nao; yadi tomara allahake bhaya kara tave (parapurusera sathe) katha valara samaya emanabhave komala kanthe katha vala na yate antare yara (kupravrttira) roga rayechena se lalayita haya. ara tomara nyayasangata katha valave.

33:33.latin_iast: āra tomarā nijedera ghare avasthāna kara evaṃ prāthamika jāhilī yugera nyāẏa nijederake pradarśana kare ver̤āve nā; tomarā sālāta ādāẏa karave, yākāta pradāna karave evaṃ āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlera ādeśa pālana karave. he nāvīra parivāra! āllāha tomādera theke apavitratā dūra karate cāna evaṃ tomāderake sarvatobhāve pavitra rākhate cāna.
33:33.latin_ascii: ara tomara nijedera ghare avasthana kara evam prathamika jahili yugera nyaya nijederake pradarsana kare verave na; tomara salata adaya karave, yakata pradana karave evam allaha o ta~ra rasulera adesa palana karave. he navira parivara! allaha tomadera theke apavitrata dura karate cana evam tomaderake sarvatobhave pavitra rakhate cana.

33:34.latin_iast: āra tomādera vār̤ite āllāhara āẏātasamūha o jñānera kathā yā pāṭha karā haẏa tā tomarā smaraṇa kara. niścaẏai āllāha khuva sūkṣmadarśī, sarvajña.
33:34.latin_ascii: ara tomadera varite allahara ayatasamuha o jnanera katha ya patha kara haya ta tomara smarana kara. niscayai allaha khuva suksmadarsi, sarvajna.

33:35.latin_iast: niścaẏai musalima puruṣa o musalima nārī, mu’mina puruṣa o mu’mina nārī, satyavādī puruṣa o satyavādī nārī, dhairyaśīla puruṣa o dhairyaśīla nārī, vinaẏī puruṣa o vinaẏī nārī, dānaśīla puruṣa o dānaśīla nārī, royādāra puruṣa o royādāra nārī, svīẏa lajjāsthāna hiphāyatakārī puruṣa o svīẏa lajjāsthāna hiphāyatakāriṇī nārī evaṃ āllāhake adhika smaraṇakārī puruṣa o adhika smaraṇakāriṇī nārīna edera janya āllāha prastuta rekhechena kṣamā o virāṭa pratidāna.
33:35.latin_ascii: niscayai musalima purusa o musalima nari, mu’mina purusa o mu’mina nari, satyavadi purusa o satyavadi nari, dhairyasila purusa o dhairyasila nari, vinayi purusa o vinayi nari, danasila purusa o danasila nari, royadara purusa o royadara nari, sviya lajjasthana hiphayatakari purusa o sviya lajjasthana hiphayatakarini nari evam allahake adhika smaranakari purusa o adhika smaranakarini narina edera janya allaha prastuta rekhechena ksama o virata pratidana.

33:36.latin_iast: kona mu’mina puruṣa kiṃvā mu’mina nārīra janya e avakāśa nei ye, āllāha o tā~ra rāsūla (sāllāllāhu ‘ālāihi oẏā sāllāma) yakhana kona kājera nirdeśa dena, takhana se kāje tādera kona nijasva siddhāntera adhikāra thākave. keu āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlake amānya karale se to prakāśya pathabhraṣṭatāẏa nipatita haẏa.
33:36.latin_ascii: kona mu’mina purusa kimva mu’mina narira janya e avakasa nei ye, allaha o ta~ra rasula (sallallahu ‘alaihi oya sallama) yakhana kona kajera nirdesa dena, takhana se kaje tadera kona nijasva siddhantera adhikara thakave. keu allaha o ta~ra rasulake amanya karale se to prakasya pathabhrastataya nipatita haya.

33:37.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa kara! āllāha yāke anugraha karechena evaṃ tumio yāke anugraha karecha, tumi tāke valechile, “tumi tomāra strīke svīẏa vivāhādhīne thākate dāo evaṃ āllāhake bhaẏa kara.” lokera bhaẏe tumi tomāra antare emana viṣaẏa gopana karechile yā āllāha prakāśa kare devena, athaca āllāhkei bhaẏa karā tomāra janya adhikatara ucita chila. tārapara yāẏeda yakhana yāẏanāvera sāthe vivāha samparka chinna karala, takhana āmi tāke tomāra sāthe vivāha vandhane āvaddha karalāma. yāte mu’minadera kona samasyā nā thāke. āllāhara nirdeśa kāryakarī haẏei thāke.
33:37.latin_ascii: ara smarana kara! allaha yake anugraha karechena evam tumio yake anugraha karecha, tumi take valechile, “tumi tomara strike sviya vivahadhine thakate dao evam allahake bhaya kara.” lokera bhaye tumi tomara antare emana visaya gopana karechile ya allaha prakasa kare devena, athaca allahkei bhaya kara tomara janya adhikatara ucita chila. tarapara yayeda yakhana yayanavera sathe vivaha samparka chinna karala, takhana ami take tomara sathe vivaha vandhane avaddha karalama. yate mu’minadera kona samasya na thake. allahara nirdesa karyakari hayei thake.

33:38.latin_iast: nāvīra janya tā karate kona vādhā nei yā āllāha tā~ra janya vidhisammata karechena. pūrve yesava nāvī gata haẏe geche, tādera kṣetreo eṭāi chila āllāhara vidhāna. āra āllāhara hukuma to pūrva thekei nirdhārita haẏe āche.
33:38.latin_ascii: navira janya ta karate kona vadha nei ya allaha ta~ra janya vidhisammata karechena. purve yesava navi gata haye geche, tadera ksetreo etai chila allahara vidhana. ara allahara hukuma to purva thekei nirdharita haye ache.

33:39.latin_iast: tārā (nāvīgaṇa) āllāhara vāṇī pracāra karata evaṃ tā~ke bhaẏa karata, āra tā~rā āllāha vyatīta anya kāuke bhaẏa karata nā. hisāva grahaṇakārī hiseve āllāhai yatheṣṭa.
33:39.latin_ascii: tara (navigana) allahara vani pracara karata evam ta~ke bhaya karata, ara ta~ra allaha vyatita anya kauke bhaya karata na. hisava grahanakari hiseve allahai yathesta.

33:40.latin_iast: muhāmmāda tomādera madhyakāra kona puruṣera pitā naẏa, varaṃ tini āllahara rāsūla evaṃ sarvaśeṣa nāvī. āllāha sakala viṣaẏe sarvajña.
33:40.latin_ascii: muhammada tomadera madhyakara kona purusera pita naya, varam tini allahara rasula evam sarvasesa navi. allaha sakala visaye sarvajna.

33:41.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! tomarā veśi veśi āllāhake smaraṇa kara.
33:41.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! tomara vesi vesi allahake smarana kara.

33:42.latin_iast: evaṃ sakāle o sandhyāẏa tā~ra pavitratā varṇanā kara.
33:42.latin_ascii: evam sakale o sandhyaya ta~ra pavitrata varnana kara.

33:43.latin_iast: tinii tomādera prati rahamata varṣaṇa karena evaṃ tā~ra phereśatārāo tomādera janya rahamata prārthanā kare. yena āllāha tomāderake andhakāra theke vera kare ālote ānena. āra tini mu’minadera prati atyanta anugrahaśīla.
33:43.latin_ascii: tinii tomadera prati rahamata varsana karena evam ta~ra pheresatarao tomadera janya rahamata prarthana kare. yena allaha tomaderake andhakara theke vera kare alote anena. ara tini mu’minadera prati atyanta anugrahasila.

33:44.latin_iast: yedina tārā āllāhara sāthe sākṣāt karave, sedina tādera abhivādana have ‘sālāma’. āra tini tādera janya prastuta kare rekhechena sammānajanaka pratidāna.
33:44.latin_ascii: yedina tara allahara sathe saksat karave, sedina tadera abhivadana have ‘salama’. ara tini tadera janya prastuta kare rekhechena sammanajanaka pratidana.

33:45.latin_iast: he nāvī! āmi tomāke preraṇa karechi sākṣīrūpe, (mu’minadera janya) susaṃvādadātārūpe o (kāphiradera janya) satarkakārīrūpe.
33:45.latin_ascii: he navi! ami tomake prerana karechi saksirupe, (mu’minadera janya) susamvadadatarupe o (kaphiradera janya) satarkakarirupe.

33:46.latin_iast: evaṃ āllāhara nirdeśe tā~ra dike āhvānakārīrūpe o ujjvala pradīparūpe.
33:46.latin_ascii: evam allahara nirdese ta~ra dike ahvanakarirupe o ujjvala pradiparupe.

33:47.latin_iast: āra tumi mu’minaderake susaṃvāda dāo ye, tādera janya raẏeche āllāhara pakṣa theke mahā anugraha.
33:47.latin_ascii: ara tumi mu’minaderake susamvada dao ye, tadera janya rayeche allahara paksa theke maha anugraha.

33:48.latin_iast: āra tumi kāphiradera o munāphikadera anusaraṇa kara nā evaṃ niryātanake upekṣā kara o āllāhara opara bharasā kara. tattvāvadhāẏakarūpe āllāhai yatheṣṭa.
33:48.latin_ascii: ara tumi kaphiradera o munaphikadera anusarana kara na evam niryatanake upeksa kara o allahara opara bharasa kara. tattvavadhayakarupe allahai yathesta.

33:49.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! yakhana tomarā mu’mina nārīderake vivāha kara, tārapara tāderake sparśa karāra pūrve tālāka diẏe dāo, takhana tomādera janya tādera opara kona iddāta nei yā tomarā gaṇanā karave. ataeva tomarā tāderake kichu bhogera sāmagrī dāo evaṃ sammānajanakabhāve tāderake vidāẏa kare dāo.
33:49.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! yakhana tomara mu’mina nariderake vivaha kara, tarapara taderake sparsa karara purve talaka diye dao, takhana tomadera janya tadera opara kona iddata nei ya tomara ganana karave. ataeva tomara taderake kichu bhogera samagri dao evam sammanajanakabhave taderake vidaya kare dao.

33:50.latin_iast: he nāvī! āmi tomāra janya tomāra sei strīderake hālāla karechi yādera māhara tumi pradāna karecha. sei nārīderakeo yāderake āllāha tomāra mālikānādhīna karechena ganimatarūpe evaṃ vivāhera janya hālāla karechi tomāra cācāra kanyā, tomāra phuphura kanyāke, tomāra māmāra kanyāke, tomāra khālāra kanyāke yārā tomāra sāthe hijarata kareche. āra kona mu’mina nārī yadi nāvīra kāche nijeke samarpaṇa kare evaṃ nāvī yadi tāke vivāha karate cāẏa, tave seo hālāla. e ādeśa śudhu tomārai janya, anya mu’minadera janya naẏa, yāte tomāra kona samasyā nā haẏa). mu’minadera strī o tādera mālikānādhīna dāsīra vyāpāre yā nirdhāraṇa karechi, tā āmāra jānā āche. āllāha atyanta kṣamāśīla o karuṇāmaẏa.
33:50.latin_ascii: he navi! ami tomara janya tomara sei striderake halala karechi yadera mahara tumi pradana karecha. sei nariderakeo yaderake allaha tomara malikanadhina karechena ganimatarupe evam vivahera janya halala karechi tomara cacara kanya, tomara phuphura kanyake, tomara mamara kanyake, tomara khalara kanyake yara tomara sathe hijarata kareche. ara kona mu’mina nari yadi navira kache nijeke samarpana kare evam navi yadi take vivaha karate caya, tave seo halala. e adesa sudhu tomarai janya, anya mu’minadera janya naya, yate tomara kona samasya na haya). mu’minadera stri o tadera malikanadhina dasira vyapare ya nirdharana karechi, ta amara jana ache. allaha atyanta ksamasila o karunamaya.

33:51.latin_iast: tumi tomāra strīdera madhye yāke icchā pṛthaka rākhate pāra evaṃ yāke icchā kāche rākhate pāra; āra tumi yāke pṛthaka rekhecha, tāke āvāra cāile tāte tomāra kona gunāha nei. ete adhika āśā karā yāẏa ye, tādera cakṣu śītala thākave, tārā kaṣṭa pāve nā evaṃ tumi yā deve tāte tārā savāi santuṣṭa thākave. tomādera antare yā āche āllāha tā jānena. āllāha mahājñānī o sahanaśīla.
33:51.latin_ascii: tumi tomara stridera madhye yake iccha prthaka rakhate para evam yake iccha kache rakhate para; ara tumi yake prthaka rekhecha, take avara caile tate tomara kona gunaha nei. ete adhika asa kara yaya ye, tadera caksu sitala thakave, tara kasta pave na evam tumi ya deve tate tara savai santusta thakave. tomadera antare ya ache allaha ta janena. allaha mahajnani o sahanasila.

33:52.latin_iast: erapara tomāra janya āra kona nārī hālāla naẏa evaṃ tomāra strīdera parivarte anya strī grahaṇa karāo hālāla naẏa yadio tādera saundarya tomāke mugdha kare, tave tomāra adhikārabhukta dāsīdera vyāpāra svatantra. āllāha sarva viṣaẏera opara sajāga najara rākhena.
33:52.latin_ascii: erapara tomara janya ara kona nari halala naya evam tomara stridera parivarte anya stri grahana karao halala naya yadio tadera saundarya tomake mugdha kare, tave tomara adhikarabhukta dasidera vyapara svatantra. allaha sarva visayera opara sajaga najara rakhena.

33:53.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! tomarā khāoẏāra janya khāvāra prastutira apekṣāẏa nāvīra ghare tomāderake anumati nā deẏā paryanta praveśa kara nā; tave tomāderake ḍākā hale tomarā praveśa kara evaṃ khāoẏā śeṣa hale nijerāi cale yāo, kathāvārtāẏa maśagula haẏe par̤a nā. tomādera e ācaraṇa avaśyai nāvīke kaṣṭa deẏa. tini tomāderake uṭhiẏe dite saṅkocavodha karena. kintu āllāha satya valate saṅkocavodha karena nā. tomarā yakhana tāra strīdera kācha theke kona kichu cāo, takhana pardāra ār̤āla theke cāo. eṭā tomādera antarera janya evaṃ tādera antarera janya adhikatara pavitra upāẏa. āllāhara rāsūlake kaṣṭa deẏā evaṃ tā~ra mṛtyura para tā~ra strīderake vivāha karā tomādera kāro pakṣe vaidha naẏa. eṭā āllāhara kāche gurutara aparādha.
33:53.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! tomara khaoyara janya khavara prastutira apeksaya navira ghare tomaderake anumati na deya paryanta pravesa kara na; tave tomaderake daka hale tomara pravesa kara evam khaoya sesa hale nijerai cale yao, kathavartaya masagula haye para na. tomadera e acarana avasyai navike kasta deya. tini tomaderake uthiye dite sankocavodha karena. kintu allaha satya valate sankocavodha karena na. tomara yakhana tara stridera kacha theke kona kichu cao, takhana pardara arala theke cao. eta tomadera antarera janya evam tadera antarera janya adhikatara pavitra upaya. allahara rasulake kasta deya evam ta~ra mrtyura para ta~ra striderake vivaha kara tomadera karo pakse vaidha naya. eta allahara kache gurutara aparadha.

33:54.latin_iast: yadi tomarā kona viṣaẏa prakāśa kara kiṃvā tā gopana rākha, tave niścaẏai āllāha pratyeka viṣaẏe saviśeṣa avagata āchena.
33:54.latin_ascii: yadi tomara kona visaya prakasa kara kimva ta gopana rakha, tave niscayai allaha pratyeka visaye savisesa avagata achena.

33:55.latin_iast: nāvīra strīdera janya kona gunāha nei tādera nija pitā, putra, bhrātā, bhrātusputra, bhagnīputra sva-dharmāvalamviṇī nārī evaṃ svīẏa adhikārabhukta dāsadāsīdera sāmane (pardā pālana nā karāẏa). (he nāvī strīgaṇa!) tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara. niścaẏai āllāha sarvaviṣaẏe lakṣya karena.
33:55.latin_ascii: navira stridera janya kona gunaha nei tadera nija pita, putra, bhrata, bhratusputra, bhagniputra sva-dharmavalamvini nari evam sviya adhikarabhukta dasadasidera samane (parda palana na karaya). (he navi strigana!) tomara allahake bhaya kara. niscayai allaha sarvavisaye laksya karena.

33:56.latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha rahamata preraṇa karena nāvīra prati evaṃ tā~ra phereśatārāo nāvīra janya rahamata prārthanā kare. he īmānadāragaṇa! tomarāo nāvīra janya rahamata prārthanā kara evaṃ tāra prati pracura parimāṇe sālāma preraṇa kara.
33:56.latin_ascii: niscayai allaha rahamata prerana karena navira prati evam ta~ra pheresatarao navira janya rahamata prarthana kare. he imanadaragana! tomarao navira janya rahamata prarthana kara evam tara prati pracura parimane salama prerana kara.

33:57.latin_iast: yārā āllāhake o tā~ra rāsūlake kaṣṭa deẏa, āllāha avaśyai tāderake duniẏā o ākhirāte abhisampāta karena evaṃ tini tādera janya prastuta kare rekhechena avamānanākara śāsti.
33:57.latin_ascii: yara allahake o ta~ra rasulake kasta deya, allaha avasyai taderake duniya o akhirate abhisampata karena evam tini tadera janya prastuta kare rekhechena avamananakara sasti.

33:58.latin_iast: āra yārā aparādhavihīna mu’mina puruṣa mu’minā nārīke kaṣṭa deẏa tārā to vahana kare mithyā apavāda o prakāśya pāpera vojhā.
33:58.latin_ascii: ara yara aparadhavihina mu’mina purusa mu’mina narike kasta deya tara to vahana kare mithya apavada o prakasya papera vojha.

33:59.latin_iast: he nāvī! tumi tomāra strīderake, tomāra kanyāderake evaṃ mu’minadera nārīderake vale dāo, tārā yena tādera cādara nijedera opara jhuliẏe deẏa; ete sahajei tādera paricaẏa pāoẏā yāve, phale tārā lāñchitā have nā. āra āllāha atyanta kṣamāśīla o karuṇāmaẏa.
33:59.latin_ascii: he navi! tumi tomara striderake, tomara kanyaderake evam mu’minadera nariderake vale dao, tara yena tadera cadara nijedera opara jhuliye deya; ete sahajei tadera paricaya paoya yave, phale tara lanchita have na. ara allaha atyanta ksamasila o karunamaya.

33:60.latin_iast: yadi virata nā haẏa munāphikarā o yādera antare roga āche tārā evaṃ madīnāẏa gujava raṭanākārīrā, tave āmi avaśyai tomāke tādera viruddhe prabhāvaśālī kare deva phale tārā prativeśīrūpe sāmānya samaẏa chār̤ā avasthāna karate pārave nā.
33:60.latin_ascii: yadi virata na haya munaphikara o yadera antare roga ache tara evam madinaya gujava ratanakarira, tave ami avasyai tomake tadera viruddhe prabhavasali kare deva phale tara prativesirupe samanya samaya chara avasthana karate parave na.

33:61.latin_iast: tāo abhiśapta avasthāẏa; tāderake yekhānei pāoẏā yāve dhara, pākar̤āo kara evaṃ pravalabhāve hatyā kara.
33:61.latin_ascii: tao abhisapta avasthaya; taderake yekhanei paoya yave dhara, pakarao kara evam pravalabhave hatya kara.

33:62.latin_iast: eṭāi chila āllāhara vidhāna tādera vyāpāre yārā pūrve gata haẏeche. āra tumi kakhano āllāhara rītite kona parivartana pāvena nā.
33:62.latin_ascii: etai chila allahara vidhana tadera vyapare yara purve gata hayeche. ara tumi kakhano allahara ritite kona parivartana pavena na.

33:63.latin_iast: lokerā tomāke kiẏāmata samparke praśna kare. tumi vale dāona era jñāna śudhu āllāharai kāche āche. tumi ki kare jānave ye, haẏata kiẏāmata śīghrai saṃghaṭita have.
33:63.latin_ascii: lokera tomake kiyamata samparke prasna kare. tumi vale daona era jnana sudhu allaharai kache ache. tumi ki kare janave ye, hayata kiyamata sighrai samghatita have.

33:64.latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha lā‘nata karechena kāphiraderake evaṃ tādera janya tairī kare rekhechena jvalanta āguna.
33:64.latin_ascii: niscayai allaha la‘nata karechena kaphiraderake evam tadera janya tairi kare rekhechena jvalanta aguna.

33:65.latin_iast: tārā sekhāne cirakāla thākave; tārā sekhāne pāve nā kona vandhu āra nā kona sāhāyyakārī.
33:65.latin_ascii: tara sekhane cirakala thakave; tara sekhane pave na kona vandhu ara na kona sahayyakari.

33:66.latin_iast: yedina tādera ceherā doyakhera āgunera madhye ulaṭa-pālaṭa karā have sedina tārā valavena hāẏa! āmarā yadi āllāhara o rāsūlera ādeśa pālana karatāma!
33:66.latin_ascii: yedina tadera cehera doyakhera agunera madhye ulata-palata kara have sedina tara valavena haya! amara yadi allahara o rasulera adesa palana karatama!

33:67.latin_iast: tārā āro valavena he āmādera pratipālaka! āmarā to anusaraṇa karechilāma āmādera netādera evaṃ āmādera pradhānadera. ataeva tārāi āmāderake pathabhraṣṭa karechila.
33:67.latin_ascii: tara aro valavena he amadera pratipalaka! amara to anusarana karechilama amadera netadera evam amadera pradhanadera. ataeva tarai amaderake pathabhrasta karechila.

33:68.latin_iast: he āmādera pratipālaka! tāderake dviguṇa śāsti dina evaṃ mahā abhiśāpa dina.
33:68.latin_ascii: he amadera pratipalaka! taderake dviguna sasti dina evam maha abhisapa dina.

33:69.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! tomarā tādera mata haẏo nā yārā mūsāke kaṣṭa diẏechila; āllāha mūsāke nirdoṣa pramāṇita karalena se apavāda theke yā tārā āropa karechila. āra se chila āllāhara kāche khuvai sammānita nāvī.
33:69.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! tomara tadera mata hayo na yara musake kasta diyechila; allaha musake nirdosa pramanita karalena se apavada theke ya tara aropa karechila. ara se chila allahara kache khuvai sammanita navi.

33:70.latin_iast: ohe īmānadāragaṇa! tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara evaṃ saṭhika kathā vala.
33:70.latin_ascii: ohe imanadaragana! tomara allahake bhaya kara evam sathika katha vala.

33:71.latin_iast: āllāha tomādera āmalaguloke saṃśodhana karavena evaṃ tomādera gunāha kṣamā karavena. āra ye vyakti āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlera ānugatya kare, se mahā sāphalya lābha karala.
