37:91.latin_iast: tārapara se tādera mūrtigulora ati nikaṭe gela evaṃ valala tomarā khāccha nā kena?
37:91.latin_ascii: tarapara se tadera murtigulora ati nikate gela evam valala tomara khaccha na kenay

37:92.latin_iast: tomādera kī hala, tomarā kathā valacha nā kena?
37:92.latin_ascii: tomadera ki hala, tomara katha valacha na kenay

37:93.latin_iast: ataḥpara se tādera opara sajore ḍāna hāta diẏe āghāta karala.
37:93.latin_ascii: atahpara se tadera opara sajore dana hata diye aghata karala.

37:94.latin_iast: takhana tārā tāra dike druta daur̤e elo.
37:94.latin_ascii: takhana tara tara dike druta daure elo.

37:95.latin_iast: se (ivarāhīma) valala : tomarā ki tāderai upāsanā kara, yāderake tomarā nijerā nirmāṇa kara?
37:95.latin_ascii: se (ivarahima) valala : tomara ki taderai upasana kara, yaderake tomara nijera nirmana karay

37:96.latin_iast: athaca āllāhai sṛṣṭi karechena tomāderake evaṃ tomarā yā kara tā-o.
37:96.latin_ascii: athaca allahai srsti karechena tomaderake evam tomara ya kara ta-o.

37:97.latin_iast: tārā valala : era janya ekaṭi agnikunḍa nirmāṇa kara evaṃ tāke sei jvalanta agnikunḍe nikṣepa kara.
37:97.latin_ascii: tara valala : era janya ekati agnikunda nirmana kara evam take sei jvalanta agnikunde niksepa kara.

37:98.latin_iast: vastuta tārā tāra viruddhe virāṭa cakrāntera saṃkalpa karechila, kintu āmi tāderake parājita kare dilāma.
37:98.latin_ascii: vastuta tara tara viruddhe virata cakrantera samkalpa karechila, kintu ami taderake parajita kare dilama.

37:99.latin_iast: āra se (ivarāhīma) valala : āmi āmāra pratipālakera dike calalāma, tinii āmāke sat pathe paricālita karavena.
37:99.latin_ascii: ara se (ivarahima) valala : ami amara pratipalakera dike calalama, tinii amake sat pathe paricalita karavena.

37:100.latin_iast: he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke ekaṭi susantāna dāna karuna.
37:100.latin_ascii: he amara pratipalaka! amake ekati susantana dana karuna.

37:101.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāke ekaṭi dhairyaśīla putrera susaṃvāda dilāma.
37:101.latin_ascii: atahpara ami take ekati dhairyasila putrera susamvada dilama.

37:102.latin_iast: tārapara se yakhana tāra pitāra sāthe calāpherā karāra vaẏase upanīta hala takhana (ivrāhīma (āḥ)) valalena : he vatsa! āmi svapne dekhechi ye, āmi tomāke javeha karachi; ekhana tumi vala : tomāra mata kī? se valala : he āmāra pitā! āpanāke ye ādeśa karā haẏeche tā pūrṇa karuna. inśāāllāha, āpani āmāke dhairyaśīladera antarbhukta pāvena.
37:102.latin_ascii: tarapara se yakhana tara pitara sathe calaphera karara vayase upanita hala takhana (ivrahima (ah)) valalena : he vatsa! ami svapne dekhechi ye, ami tomake javeha karachi; ekhana tumi vala : tomara mata kiy se valala : he amara pita! apanake ye adesa kara hayeche ta purna karuna. insaallaha, apani amake dhairyasiladera antarbhukta pavena.

37:103.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tārā ubhaẏe ānugatya prakāśa karala evaṃ pitā putrake kāta kare śoẏālena,
37:103.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tara ubhaye anugatya prakasa karala evam pita putrake kata kare soyalena,

37:104.latin_iast: takhana āmi tāke ḍeke valāmaḥ he ivrāhīma!
37:104.latin_ascii: takhana ami take deke valamah he ivrahima!

37:105.latin_iast: tumi to svapnake satye pramāṇa karale. āmi erūpei khā~ṭi vāndāderake puraskāra diẏe thāki.
37:105.latin_ascii: tumi to svapnake satye pramana karale. ami erupei kha~ti vandaderake puraskara diye thaki.

37:106.latin_iast: niścaẏai eṭā chila eka suspaṣṭa parīkṣā.
37:106.latin_ascii: niscayai eta chila eka suspasta pariksa.

37:107.latin_iast: āra āmi tāke mukta karalāma eka mahāna javehara vinimaẏe.
37:107.latin_ascii: ara ami take mukta karalama eka mahana javehara vinimaye.

37:108.latin_iast: āra āmi tāra e viṣaẏaṭi bhaviṣyat vaṃśadharadera madhye kāẏema rākhalāma.
37:108.latin_ascii: ara ami tara e visayati bhavisyat vamsadharadera madhye kayema rakhalama.

37:110.latin_iast: ebhāvei āmi ekaniṣṭha vāndāderake pratidāna diẏe thāki.
37:110.latin_ascii: ebhavei ami ekanistha vandaderake pratidana diye thaki.

37:111.latin_iast: niścaẏai se chila āmāra mu’mina vāndādera ekajana.
37:111.latin_ascii: niscayai se chila amara mu’mina vandadera ekajana.

37:112.latin_iast: āra āmi tā~ke susaṃvāda diẏechilāma isahākera, se sat lokadera madhya theke anyatama nāvī.
37:112.latin_ascii: ara ami ta~ke susamvada diyechilama isahakera, se sat lokadera madhya theke anyatama navi.

37:113.latin_iast: āra āmi tā~ke varakata dāna karechilāma evaṃ isahākakeo. tādera vaṃśadharadera madhye kataka chila sat loka evaṃ kataka nijedera opara prakāśya atyācārī.
37:113.latin_ascii: ara ami ta~ke varakata dana karechilama evam isahakakeo. tadera vamsadharadera madhye kataka chila sat loka evam kataka nijedera opara prakasya atyacari.

37:114.latin_iast: āra āmi anugraha karechilāma mūsā o hārūnera pratio.
37:114.latin_ascii: ara ami anugraha karechilama musa o harunera pratio.

37:115.latin_iast: evaṃ rakṣā karechilāma tādera ubhaẏake o tādera sampradāẏake mahāvipada theke.
37:115.latin_ascii: evam raksa karechilama tadera ubhayake o tadera sampradayake mahavipada theke.

37:116.latin_iast: āra āmi tādera sāhāyya karechilāma, phale tārāi jaẏa lābha karechila.
37:116.latin_ascii: ara ami tadera sahayya karechilama, phale tarai jaya labha karechila.

37:117.latin_iast: āmi tādera ubhaẏake diẏechilāma suspaṣṭa kitāva.
37:117.latin_ascii: ami tadera ubhayake diyechilama suspasta kitava.

37:118.latin_iast: tādera ubhaẏake āmi sarala-saṭhika pathe paricālita karechilāma.
37:118.latin_ascii: tadera ubhayake ami sarala-sathika pathe paricalita karechilama.

37:119.latin_iast: āra āmi tādera ubhaẏera sukhyāti paravartīdera madhye vahāla rekhechi.
37:119.latin_ascii: ara ami tadera ubhayera sukhyati paravartidera madhye vahala rekhechi.

37:120.latin_iast: sālāma varṣita hoka mūsā o hārūnera opara.
37:120.latin_ascii: salama varsita hoka musa o harunera opara.

37:121.latin_iast: ebhāvei āmi sat karmaśīladera pratidāna diẏe thāki.
37:121.latin_ascii: ebhavei ami sat karmasiladera pratidana diye thaki.

37:122.latin_iast: niścaẏai tārā ubhaẏe chila āmāra mu’mina vāndādera antarbhukta.
37:122.latin_ascii: niscayai tara ubhaye chila amara mu’mina vandadera antarbhukta.

37:123.latin_iast: āra niḥsandehe iliẏāsao chilena rāsūladera madhye anyatama.
37:123.latin_ascii: ara nihsandehe iliyasao chilena rasuladera madhye anyatama.

37:124.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! se tā~ra sampradāẏake valechila, tomarā ki āllāhake bhaẏa kara nā?
37:124.latin_ascii: smarana kara! se ta~ra sampradayake valechila, tomara ki allahake bhaya kara nay

37:125.latin_iast: tomarā ki vā‘āla devatāra pūjā karave āra sarvaśreṣṭa sṛṣṭikartāke parityāga karave?
37:125.latin_ascii: tomara ki va‘ala devatara puja karave ara sarvasresta srstikartake parityaga karavey

37:126.latin_iast: āllāha, tomādera pratipālaka evaṃ tomādera pūrvapuruṣaderao pratipālaka?
37:126.latin_ascii: allaha, tomadera pratipalaka evam tomadera purvapurusaderao pratipalakay

37:127.latin_iast: avaśeṣe tārā tā~ke asvīkāra karala. sutarāṃ tāderake avaśyai (śāstira janya) upasthita karā have.
37:127.latin_ascii: avasese tara ta~ke asvikara karala. sutaram taderake avasyai (sastira janya) upasthita kara have.

37:128.latin_iast: tave yārā āllāhara ekaniṣṭha khā~ṭi vāndā tārā naẏa.
37:128.latin_ascii: tave yara allahara ekanistha kha~ti vanda tara naya.

37:129.latin_iast: āra āmi tā~ra sukhyātira viṣaẏaṭi paravartīdera madhye vahāla rekhechi,
37:129.latin_ascii: ara ami ta~ra sukhyatira visayati paravartidera madhye vahala rekhechi,

37:131.latin_iast: āmi ebhāvei sat lokaderake pratidāna diẏe thāki.
37:131.latin_ascii: ami ebhavei sat lokaderake pratidana diye thaki.

37:132.latin_iast: niścaẏai se chila āmāra mu’mina vāndādera ekajana.
37:132.latin_ascii: niscayai se chila amara mu’mina vandadera ekajana.

37:133.latin_iast: āra avaśyai lūtao chila rāsūladera madhye anyatama ekajana.
37:133.latin_ascii: ara avasyai lutao chila rasuladera madhye anyatama ekajana.

37:134.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! yakhana āmi rakṣā karechilāma tāke o tāra parivārera savāike.
37:134.latin_ascii: smarana kara! yakhana ami raksa karechilama take o tara parivarera savaike.

37:135.latin_iast: eka vṛddhāke (lūtera strī) chār̤ā, se pechane avasthānakārīdera sāthe theke giẏechila.
37:135.latin_ascii: eka vrddhake (lutera stri) chara, se pechane avasthanakaridera sathe theke giyechila.

37:136.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi anyānyaderake sampūrṇarūpe dhvaṃsa karechilāma.
37:136.latin_ascii: atahpara ami anyanyaderake sampurnarupe dhvamsa karechilama.

37:137.latin_iast: āra tomarā to tādera dhvaṃsaprāpta vār̤i-gharera opara diẏe yātāẏāta kara bhora velāẏa.
37:137.latin_ascii: ara tomara to tadera dhvamsaprapta vari-gharera opara diye yatayata kara bhora velaya.

37:138.latin_iast: evaṃ rātrikāleo; tavuo ki tomarā vujha nā?
37:138.latin_ascii: evam ratrikaleo; tavuo ki tomara vujha nay

37:139.latin_iast: āra iunusao chilena rāsūladera madhye ekajana.
37:139.latin_ascii: ara iunusao chilena rasuladera madhye ekajana.

37:140.latin_iast: yakhana se pāliẏe vojhāi nauyāne giẏe pau~chala,
37:140.latin_ascii: yakhana se paliye vojhai nauyane giye pau~chala,

37:141.latin_iast: ataḥpara se laṭārīte śarīka hala evaṃ aparādhī sāvyasta hala.
37:141.latin_ascii: atahpara se latarite sarika hala evam aparadhi savyasta hala.

37:142.latin_iast: tārapara ekaṭi mācha tāke gile phelala, takhana se nijeke tiraskāra karate lāgalo.
37:142.latin_ascii: tarapara ekati macha take gile phelala, takhana se nijeke tiraskara karate lagalo.

37:143.latin_iast: sutarāṃ yadi se āllāhara tāsavīha pāṭhakārī nā hata,
37:143.latin_ascii: sutaram yadi se allahara tasaviha pathakari na hata,

37:144.latin_iast: tave se avaśyai theke yeta māchera peṭe kiẏāmata divasa paryanta.
37:144.latin_ascii: tave se avasyai theke yeta machera pete kiyamata divasa paryanta.

37:145.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāke nikṣepa karalāma eka tṛṇahīna maẏadāne evaṃ se asustha chila.
37:145.latin_ascii: atahpara ami take niksepa karalama eka trnahina mayadane evam se asustha chila.

37:146.latin_iast: āra āmi utpanna karalāma tāra opara eka lāu gācha.
37:146.latin_ascii: ara ami utpanna karalama tara opara eka lau gacha.

37:147.latin_iast: āmi tāke rāsūla kare preraṇa karechilāma eka lakṣa vā tāra ceẏe veśi lokera prati.
37:147.latin_ascii: ami take rasula kare prerana karechilama eka laksa va tara ceye vesi lokera prati.

37:148.latin_iast: tārā īmāna enechila, phale āmi tāderake eka nirdiṣṭakāla paryanta jīvanopabhoga karate diẏechilāma.
37:148.latin_ascii: tara imana enechila, phale ami taderake eka nirdistakala paryanta jivanopabhoga karate diyechilama.

37:149.latin_iast: tumi tādera jijñāsā kara : tomāra pratipālakera janya ki kanyā santāna raẏeche, āra tādera janya putra santāna?
37:149.latin_ascii: tumi tadera jijnasa kara : tomara pratipalakera janya ki kanya santana rayeche, ara tadera janya putra santanay

37:150.latin_iast: athavā āmi ki phereśatāderake nārīrūpe sṛṣṭi karechi evaṃ tārā tā dekhachila?
37:150.latin_ascii: athava ami ki pheresataderake narirupe srsti karechi evam tara ta dekhachilay

37:151.latin_iast: sāvadhāna! tārā to nijedera managar̤ā kathā vale ye,
37:151.latin_ascii: savadhana! tara to nijedera managara katha vale ye,

37:152.latin_iast: āllāha santāna janma diẏechena. niścaẏai tārā to mithyāvādī.
37:152.latin_ascii: allaha santana janma diyechena. niscayai tara to mithyavadi.

37:153.latin_iast: tini ki adhika pachanda karechena putra santānera parivarte kanyā santānake?
37:153.latin_ascii: tini ki adhika pachanda karechena putra santanera parivarte kanya santanakey

37:154.latin_iast: tomādera kī hala? tomarā kemana siddhānta diccha?
37:154.latin_ascii: tomadera ki halay tomara kemana siddhanta dicchay

37:155.latin_iast: tave ki tomarā upadeśa grahaṇa karave nā?
37:155.latin_ascii: tave ki tomara upadesa grahana karave nay

37:156.latin_iast: athavā tomādera kāche ki kona spaṣṭa pramāṇa āche?
37:156.latin_ascii: athava tomadera kache ki kona spasta pramana achey

37:157.latin_iast: tomarā satyavādī hale tomādera kitāva upasthāpana kara.
37:157.latin_ascii: tomara satyavadi hale tomadera kitava upasthapana kara.

37:158.latin_iast: āra tārā āllāha o jinadera madhye vaṃśagata samparka sthāpana kareche. athaca jinerā jāne ye, tārāo avaśyai śāstira janya upasthāpita have.
37:158.latin_ascii: ara tara allaha o jinadera madhye vamsagata samparka sthapana kareche. athaca jinera jane ye, tarao avasyai sastira janya upasthapita have.

37:159.latin_iast: tārā yā vale tā theke āllāha pavitra.
37:159.latin_ascii: tara ya vale ta theke allaha pavitra.

37:160.latin_iast: tave yārā āllāhara ekaniṣṭha vāndā, tārā vyatīta.
37:160.latin_ascii: tave yara allahara ekanistha vanda, tara vyatita.

37:162.latin_iast: savāi milita haẏeo āllāha samparke vibhrānta karate pārave nā.
37:162.latin_ascii: savai milita hayeo allaha samparke vibhranta karate parave na.

37:163.latin_iast: kevala tāke chār̤ā ye jāhānnāme praveśa karave.
37:163.latin_ascii: kevala take chara ye jahanname pravesa karave.

37:164.latin_iast: (phereśatārā vale) āmādera pratyekera janyai raẏeche eka nirdiṣṭa sthāna.
37:164.latin_ascii: (pheresatara vale) amadera pratyekera janyai rayeche eka nirdista sthana.

37:166.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā tāsavīha pāṭhe niẏojita āchi.
37:166.latin_ascii: evam amara tasaviha pathe niyojita achi.

37:168.latin_iast: yadi pūrvavartīdera kitāvera nyāẏa āmādera kācheo kona kitāva thākata,
37:168.latin_ascii: yadi purvavartidera kitavera nyaya amadera kacheo kona kitava thakata,

37:169.latin_iast: tave āmarāo avaśyai āllāhara ekaniṣṭha vāndā hatāma.
37:169.latin_ascii: tave amarao avasyai allahara ekanistha vanda hatama.

37:170.latin_iast: kintu tārā tā (kuraāna) pratyākhyāna kareche, tārā drutai (tādera pariṇati) jānate pārave.
37:170.latin_ascii: kintu tara ta (kuraana) pratyakhyana kareche, tara drutai (tadera parinati) janate parave.

37:171.latin_iast: āmāra vāndādera madhye rāsūladera samparke āmāra e kathā āgei nirdhārita haẏeche ye,
37:171.latin_ascii: amara vandadera madhye rasuladera samparke amara e katha agei nirdharita hayeche ye,

37:173.latin_iast: evaṃ āmāra vāhinī, avaśyai tārā jaẏī have.
37:173.latin_ascii: evam amara vahini, avasyai tara jayi have.

37:174.latin_iast: ataeva tumi kichu kālera janya tāderake upekṣā kara.
37:174.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi kichu kalera janya taderake upeksa kara.

37:175.latin_iast: evaṃ tādera prati lakṣya rākha, tārāo śīghrai dekhate pāve.
37:175.latin_ascii: evam tadera prati laksya rakha, tarao sighrai dekhate pave.

37:177.latin_iast: yakhana tādera āṅgināẏa ‘āyāva ese par̤ave, takhana satarkakṛtadera sakāla have ati manda!
37:177.latin_ascii: yakhana tadera anginaya ‘ayava ese parave, takhana satarkakrtadera sakala have ati manda!

37:178.latin_iast: ataeva tumi kichukālera janya tāderake upekṣā kara.
37:178.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi kichukalera janya taderake upeksa kara.

37:179.latin_iast: evaṃ tumi lakṣya rākha, tārāo śīghrai dekhate pāve.
37:179.latin_ascii: evam tumi laksya rakha, tarao sighrai dekhate pave.

37:180.latin_iast: tārā yā vale thāke tā theke tomāra pratipālaka pavitra mahimānvita sakala kṣamatāra adhikārī.
37:180.latin_ascii: tara ya vale thake ta theke tomara pratipalaka pavitra mahimanvita sakala ksamatara adhikari.

37:182.latin_iast: āra sakala praśaṃsā ekamātra āllāhara, yini sārāviśvera pratipālaka.
37:182.latin_ascii: ara sakala prasamsa ekamatra allahara, yini saravisvera pratipalaka.

38:1.latin_iast: soẏāda, śapatha kuraānera yā upadeśe paripūrṇa.
38:1.latin_ascii: soyada, sapatha kuraanera ya upadese paripurna.

38:2.latin_iast: varaṃ kāphirarā ahaṅkāra o virodhitāẏa lipta.
38:2.latin_ascii: varam kaphirara ahankara o virodhitaya lipta.

38:3.latin_iast: tādera pūrve āmi vahu sampradāẏake dhvaṃsa karechi; takhana tārā ārtanāda karechila, kintu takhana lābhera kona samaẏa chila nā.
38:3.latin_ascii: tadera purve ami vahu sampradayake dhvamsa karechi; takhana tara artanada karechila, kintu takhana labhera kona samaya chila na.

38:4.latin_iast: tārā ete āścarya hala ye, tādera kāche eseche tāderai madhya theke eka satarkakārī. āra kāphirarā valate lāgala : ei vyakti to eka jādukara, mithyāvādī.
38:4.latin_ascii: tara ete ascarya hala ye, tadera kache eseche taderai madhya theke eka satarkakari. ara kaphirara valate lagala : ei vyakti to eka jadukara, mithyavadi.

38:5.latin_iast: se ki vahu upāsyera sthāne ekajana mātra upāsya sāvyasta kare? vastuta eṭā eka āścarya vyāpāra.
38:5.latin_ascii: se ki vahu upasyera sthane ekajana matra upasya savyasta karey vastuta eta eka ascarya vyapara.

38:6.latin_iast: āra tādera netārā e kathā vale cale yāẏa ye, tomarā tomādera dīnera opara avicala thāka evaṃ nijedera upāsyadera vyāpāre dhairyadhāraṇa kara, niścaẏai e eka uddeśyamūlaka vyāpāra.
38:6.latin_ascii: ara tadera netara e katha vale cale yaya ye, tomara tomadera dinera opara avicala thaka evam nijedera upasyadera vyapare dhairyadharana kara, niscayai e eka uddesyamulaka vyapara.

38:7.latin_iast: erūpa kathā to āmarā pūrvavartī dharme śunini. eṭā managar̤ā ukti chār̤ā āra kichui naẏa.
38:7.latin_ascii: erupa katha to amara purvavarti dharme sunini. eta managara ukti chara ara kichui naya.

38:8.latin_iast: āmādera madhya theke kevala e vyaktira oparai ki āllāhara kuraāna nāyila karā hala? āsale tārā to āmāra kuraāna samvandhe sandehera madhye raẏeche. varaṃ tārā ekhana paryanta āmāra ‘āyāvera svāda grahaṇa kareni.
38:8.latin_ascii: amadera madhya theke kevala e vyaktira oparai ki allahara kuraana nayila kara halay asale tara to amara kuraana samvandhe sandehera madhye rayeche. varam tara ekhana paryanta amara ‘ayavera svada grahana kareni.

38:9.latin_iast: tādera nikaṭa ki tomāra mahāpratāpaśālī, mahāna dānaśīla pratipālakera anugrahera bhānḍārasamūha āche?
38:9.latin_ascii: tadera nikata ki tomara mahapratapasali, mahana danasila pratipalakera anugrahera bhandarasamuha achey

38:10.latin_iast: athavā tādera ki ādhipatta āche āsamāna o jamina evaṃ ubhaẏera madhye avasthita savakichura opara? tāhale tārā si~r̤i veẏe ākāśe ārohaṇa karuka.
38:10.latin_ascii: athava tadera ki adhipatta ache asamana o jamina evam ubhayera madhye avasthita savakichura oparay tahale tara si~ri veye akase arohana karuka.

38:11.latin_iast: vahu vāhinīra madhye oderao eka vāhinī āche, yā parājita have.
38:11.latin_ascii: vahu vahinira madhye oderao eka vahini ache, ya parajita have.

38:12.latin_iast: edera pūrveo rāsūladerake asvīkāra karechila nūhera sampradāẏa, ‘āda evaṃ vahu perekera mālika phira‘āuna.
38:12.latin_ascii: edera purveo rasuladerake asvikara karechila nuhera sampradaya, ‘ada evam vahu perekera malika phira‘auna.

38:13.latin_iast: evaṃ sāmūda, lūtera sampradāẏa o āikāra adhivāsīrā. erā chila viśāla vāhinī.
38:13.latin_ascii: evam samuda, lutera sampradaya o aikara adhivasira. era chila visala vahini.

38:14.latin_iast: erā pratyekei rāsūladerake asvīkāra karechila. sutarāṃ āmāra śāsti (tādera opara) vāstavāẏana haẏechila.
38:14.latin_ascii: era pratyekei rasuladerake asvikara karechila. sutaram amara sasti (tadera opara) vastavayana hayechila.

38:15.latin_iast: erā to kevala ekaṭi pracaṇḍa garjanera apekṣā karache, yāte kona virāma thākave nā.
38:15.latin_ascii: era to kevala ekati pracanda garjanera apeksa karache, yate kona virama thakave na.

38:16.latin_iast: tārā vale : he āmādera pratipālaka! vicārera dinera pūrrvei āmādera prāpya aṃśa āmāderake śīghrai diẏe dina.
38:16.latin_ascii: tara vale : he amadera pratipalaka! vicarera dinera purrvei amadera prapya amsa amaderake sighrai diye dina.

38:17.latin_iast: tārā yā kichu vale tāte tumi dhairya dhāraṇa kara evaṃ smaraṇa kara āmāra vāndā dāūdera kathā, ye chila khuva śaktiśālī evaṃ se chila atiśaẏa āllāha abhimukhī.
38:17.latin_ascii: tara ya kichu vale tate tumi dhairya dharana kara evam smarana kara amara vanda daudera katha, ye chila khuva saktisali evam se chila atisaya allaha abhimukhi.

38:18.latin_iast: āmi pāhār̤aguloke anugata kare diẏechilāma, tāra sāthe tārā sakāla-sandhyāẏa āmāra tāsavīha pāṭha karata.
38:18.latin_ascii: ami paharaguloke anugata kare diyechilama, tara sathe tara sakala-sandhyaya amara tasaviha patha karata.

38:19.latin_iast: evaṃ pākhiderakeo, yārā tāra kāche ekatrita hata. sakalei chila tā~ra abhimukhī.
38:19.latin_ascii: evam pakhiderakeo, yara tara kache ekatrita hata. sakalei chila ta~ra abhimukhi.

38:20.latin_iast: āra āmi tāra rājatvake sudṛr̤ha karechilāma evaṃ tāke diẏechilāma hikamata o vicāra phāẏasālāẏa tīkṣmavuddhi.
38:20.latin_ascii: ara ami tara rajatvake sudrrha karechilama evam take diyechilama hikamata o vicara phayasalaya tiksmavuddhi.

38:21.latin_iast: tomāra kāche jhagar̤ākārī lokadera saṃvāda pau~cheche ki? yakhana tārā ivādatakhānāra deẏāla ṭapakāla.
38:21.latin_ascii: tomara kache jhagarakari lokadera samvada pau~cheche kiy yakhana tara ivadatakhanara deyala tapakala.

38:22.latin_iast: yakhana tārā dāūdera kāche pau~chala, takhana tini tāderake dekhe bhīta haẏe par̤alena. tārā valala : āpani bhaẏa pāvena nā. (āmarā) vivadamāna du‘ṭi pakṣa, āmarā eke aparera prati vār̤āvār̤i karechi. ataeva āmādera madhye nyāẏabhāve vicāra kare dina, avicāra karavena nā evaṃ āmāderake saṭhika patha vale dina.
38:22.latin_ascii: yakhana tara daudera kache pau~chala, takhana tini taderake dekhe bhita haye paralena. tara valala : apani bhaya pavena na. (amara) vivadamana du‘ti paksa, amara eke aparera prati varavari karechi. ataeva amadera madhye nyayabhave vicara kare dina, avicara karavena na evam amaderake sathika patha vale dina.

38:23.latin_iast: e lokaṭi āmāra bhāi; era āche nirānavvaiṭi strī āra āmāra āche ekaṭi strī. eraparao se vale eṭāo āmāke diẏe dāo evaṃ kathāẏa se āmāra opara kaṭhoratā pradarśana kare.
38:23.latin_ascii: e lokati amara bhai; era ache niranavvaiti stri ara amara ache ekati stri. eraparao se vale etao amake diye dao evam kathaya se amara opara kathorata pradarsana kare.

38:24.latin_iast: (dāūda) valala : e vyakti tomāra strīṭike tāra strīgulora sāthe saṃyukta karate ceẏe tomāra prati avaśyai atyācāra kareche. āra adhikāṃśa śarīkei eke anyera opara anyāẏa ācaraṇa kare thāke, tave yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ sat kāja kare thāke tārā naẏa, avaśya erūpa loka khuvai virala. āra dāūda vujhate pāralena ye, āmi tāke parīkṣā karechi. ataeva tini tāra pratipālakera nikaṭa māpha cāilena evaṃ sijadāẏa luṭiẏe par̤alena o tā~ra abhimukhī halena. (sijadāha)
38:24.latin_ascii: (dauda) valala : e vyakti tomara stritike tara strigulora sathe samyukta karate ceye tomara prati avasyai atyacara kareche. ara adhikamsa sarikei eke anyera opara anyaya acarana kare thake, tave yara imana eneche evam sat kaja kare thake tara naya, avasya erupa loka khuvai virala. ara dauda vujhate paralena ye, ami take pariksa karechi. ataeva tini tara pratipalakera nikata mapha cailena evam sijadaya lutiye paralena o ta~ra abhimukhi halena. (sijadaha)

38:25.latin_iast: āmi tāra tra“ṭi kṣamā kare dilāma. āra tāra janya raẏeche āmāra kāche naikaṭyapūrṇa maryādā evaṃ uttama pariṇāma.
38:25.latin_ascii: ami tara tra“ti ksama kare dilama. ara tara janya rayeche amara kache naikatyapurna maryada evam uttama parinama.

38:26.latin_iast: he dāūda! āmi tomāke pṛthivīte pratinidhi karechi. ataeva tumi mānuṣera madhye nyāẏabhāve vicāra-mīmāṃsā karate thāka evaṃ pravṛttira anusaraṇa kara nā. kenanā tāhale tā tomāke āllāhara patha theke vicyuta kare deve. niścaẏai yārā āllāhara patha theke vicyuta haẏa tādera janya raẏeche bhīṣaṇa śāsti, hisāvera dina bhule yāvāra kāraṇe.
38:26.latin_ascii: he dauda! ami tomake prthivite pratinidhi karechi. ataeva tumi manusera madhye nyayabhave vicara-mimamsa karate thaka evam pravrttira anusarana kara na. kenana tahale ta tomake allahara patha theke vicyuta kare deve. niscayai yara allahara patha theke vicyuta haya tadera janya rayeche bhisana sasti, hisavera dina bhule yavara karane.

38:27.latin_iast: āra āmi āsamāna, jamina evaṃ ubhaẏera madhye avasthita kona kichui anarthaka sṛṣṭi karini; erūpa dhāraṇā to tādera yārā kāphira. sutarāṃ kāphiradera janya raẏeche jāhānnāmera durbheāga.
38:27.latin_ascii: ara ami asamana, jamina evam ubhayera madhye avasthita kona kichui anarthaka srsti karini; erupa dharana to tadera yara kaphira. sutaram kaphiradera janya rayeche jahannamera durbheaga.

38:28.latin_iast: yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ sat kāja kareche āmi ki tāderake aisava lokera samāna kare deva, yārā pṛthivīte phāsāda sṛṣṭi kare ver̤āẏa? athavā āmi ki muttākvīderake gunāhagāradera samāna kare deva?
38:28.latin_ascii: yara imana eneche evam sat kaja kareche ami ki taderake aisava lokera samana kare deva, yara prthivite phasada srsti kare verayay athava ami ki muttakviderake gunahagaradera samana kare devay

38:29.latin_iast: (e kuraāna) ekaṭi varakatamaẏa kitāva, āmi tā tomāra prati nāyila karechi yena mānuṣa era āẏātasamūha anudhāvana kare evaṃ jñānavāna lokerā upadeśa grahaṇa kare.
38:29.latin_ascii: (e kuraana) ekati varakatamaya kitava, ami ta tomara prati nayila karechi yena manusa era ayatasamuha anudhavana kare evam jnanavana lokera upadesa grahana kare.

38:30.latin_iast: āra āmi dāūdake dāna karechi sulāimāna. se ati uttama vāndā. se to chila atyanta āllāha abhimukhī.
38:30.latin_ascii: ara ami daudake dana karechi sulaimana. se ati uttama vanda. se to chila atyanta allaha abhimukhi.

38:31.latin_iast: yakhana sandhyāra samaẏa tāra sāmane peśa karā hala utkṛṣṭa ghor̤āra pāla.
38:31.latin_ascii: yakhana sandhyara samaya tara samane pesa kara hala utkrsta ghorara pala.

38:32.latin_iast: takhana se valala : āmi to āmāra pratipālakera smaraṇa theke udāsīna haẏe sampadera mohe maśagula haẏe par̤echi, emanaki sūrya pardāra ār̤āle cale geche.
38:32.latin_ascii: takhana se valala : ami to amara pratipalakera smarana theke udasina haye sampadera mohe masagula haye parechi, emanaki surya pardara arale cale geche.

38:33.latin_iast: eguloke āvāra āmāra sāmane āna. tārapara se segulora pā o galadeśa keṭe phelate lāgala.
38:33.latin_ascii: eguloke avara amara samane ana. tarapara se segulora pa o galadesa kete phelate lagala.

38:34.latin_iast: āra āmi to sulāimānake parīkṣā karechilāma evaṃ tāra siṃhāsanera opara ekaṭi deha rekhe diẏechilāma. ataḥpara se āllāha abhimukhī hala.
38:34.latin_ascii: ara ami to sulaimanake pariksa karechilama evam tara simhasanera opara ekati deha rekhe diyechilama. atahpara se allaha abhimukhi hala.

38:35.latin_iast: se valala : he āmāra pratipālaka! āmāke kṣamā kara evaṃ āmāke emana rājya dāna kara, yā āmāra pare āra keu adhikārī have nā. niścaẏai tumi mahāna dātā.
38:35.latin_ascii: se valala : he amara pratipalaka! amake ksama kara evam amake emana rajya dana kara, ya amara pare ara keu adhikari have na. niscayai tumi mahana data.

38:36.latin_iast: takhana āmi vātāsake tāra adhīna kare dilāma, yā tāra nirdeśe mṛdu gatite pravāhita hata yethāẏa se icche karata sethāẏa.
38:36.latin_ascii: takhana ami vatasake tara adhina kare dilama, ya tara nirdese mrdu gatite pravahita hata yethaya se icche karata sethaya.

38:37.latin_iast: evaṃ adhīna karechilāma śaẏatānaderakeo, yārā chila imārata nirmāṇakārī o ḍuvurī.
38:37.latin_ascii: evam adhina karechilama sayatanaderakeo, yara chila imarata nirmanakari o duvuri.

38:38.latin_iast: evaṃ ārao anekake, yārā śṛṅkhale āvaddha thākata.
38:38.latin_ascii: evam arao anekake, yara srnkhale avaddha thakata.

38:39.latin_iast: egulo āmāra anugraha, ataeva tumi (tā theke) kāuke dāna kara kiṃvā nijera janya rekhe dāo, tajjanye tomāke javāvadihi karate have nā.
38:39.latin_ascii: egulo amara anugraha, ataeva tumi (ta theke) kauke dana kara kimva nijera janya rekhe dao, tajjanye tomake javavadihi karate have na.

38:40.latin_iast: āra āmāra kāche raẏeche tāra janya naikaṭyapūrṇa maryādā o uttama ṭhikānā.
38:40.latin_ascii: ara amara kache rayeche tara janya naikatyapurna maryada o uttama thikana.

38:41.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! āmāra vāndā āiẏūvera kathā, yakhana se tāra pratipālakake āhvāna kare valechila : śaẏatāna to āmāke yantraṇā o kaṣṭe pheleche.
38:41.latin_ascii: smarana kara! amara vanda aiyuvera katha, yakhana se tara pratipalakake ahvana kare valechila : sayatana to amake yantrana o kaste pheleche.

38:42.latin_iast: (ādeśa karalāma) tomāra pā diẏe māṭite āghāta kara. (āghāta karatei ekaṭi jharaṇā utpanna hala) e hala suśītala gosalera pāni evaṃ pānāīẏa.
38:42.latin_ascii: (adesa karalama) tomara pa diye matite aghata kara. (aghata karatei ekati jharana utpanna hala) e hala susitala gosalera pani evam panaiya.

38:43.latin_iast: āra āmi tāke dāna karalāma tāra parivāra-parijanake evaṃ tatsaṅge tādera samāna parimāṇa ārao āmāra pakṣa theke rahamata evaṃ jñānīdera janya upadeśa svarūpa.
38:43.latin_ascii: ara ami take dana karalama tara parivara-parijanake evam tatsange tadera samana parimana arao amara paksa theke rahamata evam jnanidera janya upadesa svarupa.

38:44.latin_iast: eka muṭho tṛṇaśalā hāte nāo, tārapara tā diẏe āghāta kara evaṃ śapatha bhaṅga kara nā. āmi tāke avaśyai dhairyaśīla peẏechi. se chila kata uttama vāndā! se chila āllāha abhimukhī.
38:44.latin_ascii: eka mutho trnasala hate nao, tarapara ta diye aghata kara evam sapatha bhanga kara na. ami take avasyai dhairyasila peyechi. se chila kata uttama vanda! se chila allaha abhimukhi.

38:45.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! āmāra vāndā ivrāhīma, isahākva o iẏā‘kuvera kathā, tārā chila śaktiśālī o jñānaśaktisampanna.
38:45.latin_ascii: smarana kara! amara vanda ivrahima, isahakva o iya‘kuvera katha, tara chila saktisali o jnanasaktisampanna.

38:46.latin_iast: āmi to tāderake vaiśiṣṭyamanḍita karechilāma eka viśeṣa guṇe, tā hala ākhirātera smaraṇa.
38:46.latin_ascii: ami to taderake vaisistyamandita karechilama eka visesa gune, ta hala akhiratera smarana.

38:47.latin_iast: āra tārā āmāra kāche nirvācita o sarveāttama vāndādera antarbhukta.
38:47.latin_ascii: ara tara amara kache nirvacita o sarveattama vandadera antarbhukta.

38:48.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara isamāīla, āla-iẏāsā‘ o yula-kiphalera kathā, tārāo pratyekei śreṣṭha vāndādera antarbhukta.
38:48.latin_ascii: smarana kara isamaila, ala-iyasa‘ o yula-kiphalera katha, tarao pratyekei srestha vandadera antarbhukta.

38:49.latin_iast: eto eka smaraṇīẏa varṇanā. niścaẏai muttākvīdera janya raẏeche uttama vāsasthāna.
38:49.latin_ascii: eto eka smaraniya varnana. niscayai muttakvidera janya rayeche uttama vasasthana.

38:50.latin_iast: cirasthāẏī jānnāta, yāra darajāsamūha tādera janya unmukta.
38:50.latin_ascii: cirasthayi jannata, yara darajasamuha tadera janya unmukta.

38:51.latin_iast: sekhāne tārā helāna diẏe vasave. tārā sekhāne vibhinna prakāra phalamūla o pānīẏa cāive.
38:51.latin_ascii: sekhane tara helana diye vasave. tara sekhane vibhinna prakara phalamula o paniya caive.

38:52.latin_iast: tādera pāśe thākave ānata naẏanā samavaẏaskā ramaṇīgaṇa.
38:52.latin_ascii: tadera pase thakave anata nayana samavayaska ramanigana.

38:53.latin_iast: esava tomāderake vicāra dinera janya deẏā pratiśruti.
38:53.latin_ascii: esava tomaderake vicara dinera janya deya pratisruti.

38:54.latin_iast: niścaẏai eṭā hala āmāra deẏā riyki, yā śeṣa have nā.
38:54.latin_ascii: niscayai eta hala amara deya riyki, ya sesa have na.

38:55.latin_iast: esava to (muttākvīdera janya) āra avādhya lokadera janya raẏeche nikṛṣṭa vāsasthāna.
38:55.latin_ascii: esava to (muttakvidera janya) ara avadhya lokadera janya rayeche nikrsta vasasthana.

38:56.latin_iast: jāhānnāma. sethāẏa tārā praveśa karave, tā katai nā nikṛṣṭa āvāsasthala!
38:56.latin_ascii: jahannama. sethaya tara pravesa karave, ta katai na nikrsta avasasthala!

38:57.latin_iast: (sīmālaṅghanakārīdera janya) sutarāṃ tārā āsvādana karuka phuṭanta pāni o pu~ja.
38:57.latin_ascii: (simalanghanakaridera janya) sutaram tara asvadana karuka phutanta pani o pu~ja.

38:58.latin_iast: evaṃ erūpa ārao āche vibhinna dharanera śāsti.
38:58.latin_ascii: evam erupa arao ache vibhinna dharanera sasti.

38:59.latin_iast: ei to ekadala, tomādera sāthe praveśakārī. tādera janya kona abhinandana nei. tārā jāhānnāme praveśa karave.
38:59.latin_ascii: ei to ekadala, tomadera sathe pravesakari. tadera janya kona abhinandana nei. tara jahanname pravesa karave.

38:60.latin_iast: anugāmīrā valave : varaṃ tomarāo. tomādera janyao kona abhinandana nei. tomarāi to e vipada āmādera sāmane enecha. vastuta ati jaghanya e sthāna!
38:60.latin_ascii: anugamira valave : varam tomarao. tomadera janyao kona abhinandana nei. tomarai to e vipada amadera samane enecha. vastuta ati jaghanya e sthana!

38:61.latin_iast: tārā valave : he āmāra pratipālaka! ye vyakti e vipadake āmādera sammukhīna kareche, tāke jāhānnāmera śāsti dviguṇa kare dina.
38:61.latin_ascii: tara valave : he amara pratipalaka! ye vyakti e vipadake amadera sammukhina kareche, take jahannamera sasti dviguna kare dina.

38:62.latin_iast: tārā ārao valave : āmādera kī hala? āmarā yesava lokake khārāpa vale gaṇya karatāma, tāderake dekhate pācchi nā!
38:62.latin_ascii: tara arao valave : amadera ki halay amara yesava lokake kharapa vale ganya karatama, taderake dekhate pacchi na!

38:63.latin_iast: tave ki āmarā tāderake ayathā ṭhāṭṭā-vidrūpa karatāma, nā tādera vyāpāre āmādera dṛṣṭibhrama ghaṭeche.
38:63.latin_ascii: tave ki amara taderake ayatha thatta-vidrupa karatama, na tadera vyapare amadera drstibhrama ghateche.

38:64.latin_iast: avaśyai eṭā niścita, jāhānnāmīdera madhyakāra e jhagar̤ā-vitarka.
38:64.latin_ascii: avasyai eta niscita, jahannamidera madhyakara e jhagara-vitarka.

38:65.latin_iast: tumi vala : āmi to ekajana satarkakārī mātra, satyikāra kona mā‘vūda nei āllāha vyatīta, yini eka, pravala pratāpaśālī.
38:65.latin_ascii: tumi vala : ami to ekajana satarkakari matra, satyikara kona ma‘vuda nei allaha vyatita, yini eka, pravala pratapasali.

38:66.latin_iast: yini āsamāna, jamina evaṃ ubhaẏera madhye avasthita savakichura pratipālaka, yini mahāpratāpaśālī, atyanta kṣamāśīla.
38:66.latin_ascii: yini asamana, jamina evam ubhayera madhye avasthita savakichura pratipalaka, yini mahapratapasali, atyanta ksamasila.

38:68.latin_iast: athaca tomarā tā theke mukha phiriẏe niccha.
38:68.latin_ascii: athaca tomara ta theke mukha phiriye niccha.

38:69.latin_iast: ūrdhva jagatera kona jñāna āmāra chila nā, yakhana phereśatārā paraspara vitarka karachila.
38:69.latin_ascii: urdhva jagatera kona jnana amara chila na, yakhana pheresatara paraspara vitarka karachila.

38:70.latin_iast: āmāra kāche to śudhu e oẏāhīi āse ye, āmi ekajana prakāśya sāvadhānakārī.
38:70.latin_ascii: amara kache to sudhu e oyahii ase ye, ami ekajana prakasya savadhanakari.

38:71.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara! yakhana tomāra pratipālaka phereśatāderake valechilena : āmi māṭi diẏe mānuṣa sṛṣṭi karava.
38:71.latin_ascii: smarana kara! yakhana tomara pratipalaka pheresataderake valechilena : ami mati diye manusa srsti karava.

38:72.latin_iast: yakhana āmi tāra sṛṣṭikārya sampūrṇa karava evaṃ tāra madhye āmāra rūha phu~ke deva, takhana tomarā tāra sāmane sijadāha karave.
38:72.latin_ascii: yakhana ami tara srstikarya sampurna karava evam tara madhye amara ruha phu~ke deva, takhana tomara tara samane sijadaha karave.

38:73.latin_iast: ataeva sakala phereśatāi ekatre sijadāha karala.
38:73.latin_ascii: ataeva sakala pheresatai ekatre sijadaha karala.

38:74.latin_iast: kevala ivalīsa vyatīta. se ahaṅkāra karala evaṃ kāphiradera dalabhukta haẏe gela.
38:74.latin_ascii: kevala ivalisa vyatita. se ahankara karala evam kaphiradera dalabhukta haye gela.

38:75.latin_iast: tini (āllāha) valalena : he ivalīsa! āmi yāke nijera du’hāte sṛṣṭi karechi, tāke sijadāha karate tomāke kise vādhā dila? tumi ki ahaṅkāra karale, nā tumi śreṣṭha maryādāsampannadera ekajana?
38:75.latin_ascii: tini (allaha) valalena : he ivalisa! ami yake nijera du’hate srsti karechi, take sijadaha karate tomake kise vadha dilay tumi ki ahankara karale, na tumi srestha maryadasampannadera ekajanay

38:76.latin_iast: se valala : āmi tāra ceẏe śreṣṭha. āpani āmāke sṛṣṭi karechena āguna theke evaṃ tāke sṛṣṭi karechena māṭi theke.
38:76.latin_ascii: se valala : ami tara ceye srestha. apani amake srsti karechena aguna theke evam take srsti karechena mati theke.

38:77.latin_iast: tini (āllāha) valalena : tumi ekhāna theke vera haẏe yāo, niścaẏai tumi vitār̤ita.
38:77.latin_ascii: tini (allaha) valalena : tumi ekhana theke vera haye yao, niscayai tumi vitarita.

38:78.latin_iast: evaṃ tomāra prati āmāra abhiśāpa kiẏāmata divasa paryanta.
38:78.latin_ascii: evam tomara prati amara abhisapa kiyamata divasa paryanta.

38:79.latin_iast: se valala : he āmāra pratipālaka! āpani āmāke avakāśa dina kiẏāmata divasa paryanta.
38:79.latin_ascii: se valala : he amara pratipalaka! apani amake avakasa dina kiyamata divasa paryanta.

38:80.latin_iast: tini (āllāha) valalena : tomāke avakāśa deẏā gela.
38:80.latin_ascii: tini (allaha) valalena : tomake avakasa deya gela.

38:81.latin_iast: nirdiṣṭa samaẏa upasthita haoẏāra dina paryanta.
38:81.latin_ascii: nirdista samaya upasthita haoyara dina paryanta.

38:82.latin_iast: se valala : tomāra iyayatera śapatha! āmi tādera savāike pathabhraṣṭa karavai.
38:82.latin_ascii: se valala : tomara iyayatera sapatha! ami tadera savaike pathabhrasta karavai.

38:83.latin_iast: kintu tādera madhye yārā tomāra ekaniṣṭha vāndā, tādera chār̤ā.
38:83.latin_ascii: kintu tadera madhye yara tomara ekanistha vanda, tadera chara.

38:84.latin_iast: tini (āllāha) valalena : tave tāi ṭhika, āra āmi satya kathāi vale thāki.
38:84.latin_ascii: tini (allaha) valalena : tave tai thika, ara ami satya kathai vale thaki.

38:85.latin_iast: avaśyai āmi jāhānnāma pūrṇa karava tomāke diẏe evaṃ tādera madhye yārā tomāra anusaraṇa karave tādera savāike diẏe.
38:85.latin_ascii: avasyai ami jahannama purna karava tomake diye evam tadera madhye yara tomara anusarana karave tadera savaike diye.

38:86.latin_iast: vala : āmi tomādera kāche era janya kona pratidāna cāi nā evaṃ yārā mithyā racanā kare āmi tādera antarbhukta nai.
38:86.latin_ascii: vala : ami tomadera kache era janya kona pratidana cai na evam yara mithya racana kare ami tadera antarbhukta nai.

38:87.latin_iast: e kuraāna to sārā jāhānera janya eka upadeśa mātra.
38:87.latin_ascii: e kuraana to sara jahanera janya eka upadesa matra.

38:88.latin_iast: era saṃvāda tomarā avaśyai jānave kichukāla pare.
38:88.latin_ascii: era samvada tomara avasyai janave kichukala pare.

39:1.latin_iast: e kitāva nāyila haẏeche pratāpaśālī mahāvijña āllāhara pakṣa theke.
39:1.latin_ascii: e kitava nayila hayeche pratapasali mahavijna allahara paksa theke.

39:2.latin_iast: āmi tomāra prati e kitāva satyasaha nāyila karechi. ataeva tumi pavitra antare, niṣṭhāra sāthe āllāhara ivādata kara.
39:2.latin_ascii: ami tomara prati e kitava satyasaha nayila karechi. ataeva tumi pavitra antare, nisthara sathe allahara ivadata kara.

39:3.latin_iast: jene rekha, dṛr̤ha āsthāra sāthe viśuddha ivādata ekamātra āllāharai janya. āra yārā āllāhake cher̤e aparake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa kareche evaṃ vale ye, āmarā to edera upāsanā e janya kari, yena tārā āmāderake āllāhara naikaṭye pau~che deẏa. niścaẏai āllāha tādera madhye phāẏasālā kare devena se viṣaẏe, ye viṣaẏe tārā nijedera madhye dvimata kareche. āllāha to tāke satpathe paricālita karena nā, ye mithyāvādī kāphira.
39:3.latin_ascii: jene rekha, drrha asthara sathe visuddha ivadata ekamatra allaharai janya. ara yara allahake chere aparake abhibhavakarupe grahana kareche evam vale ye, amara to edera upasana e janya kari, yena tara amaderake allahara naikatye pau~che deya. niscayai allaha tadera madhye phayasala kare devena se visaye, ye visaye tara nijedera madhye dvimata kareche. allaha to take satpathe paricalita karena na, ye mithyavadi kaphira.

39:4.latin_iast: yadi āllāha santāna grahaṇa karate cāitena tave tini avaśyai veche nitena nijera sṛṣṭira madhya theke yāke icchā, tini pavitra-mahāna. tini āllāha, eka, pravala pratāpaśālī.
39:4.latin_ascii: yadi allaha santana grahana karate caitena tave tini avasyai veche nitena nijera srstira madhya theke yake iccha, tini pavitra-mahana. tini allaha, eka, pravala pratapasali.

39:5.latin_iast: tini āsamāna o jamina sṛṣṭi karechena yathāyathabhāve. tini rāta diẏe dinake ācchādita karena evaṃ dina diẏe rātake ācchādita karena. tini niẏamādhīna karechena sūrya o candrake. pratyekei nirdhārita samaẏa paryanta calate thākave. jene rekha, tini parākramaśālī, parama kṣamāśīla.
39:5.latin_ascii: tini asamana o jamina srsti karechena yathayathabhave. tini rata diye dinake acchadita karena evam dina diye ratake acchadita karena. tini niyamadhina karechena surya o candrake. pratyekei nirdharita samaya paryanta calate thakave. jene rekha, tini parakramasali, parama ksamasila.

39:6.latin_iast: tini tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena ekai vyakti theke. tārapara tā thekei tāra saṅgiṇī sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tomāderake diẏechena āṭa prakāra catuṣpada jantu. tini tomāderake sṛṣṭi karena tomādera mātṛgarbhe eka avasthāra para anya avasthāẏa tina starera andhakārera madhye. tinii āllāha, tomādera pratipālaka, sarvamaẏa kartṛtva tā~rai. tini vyatīta kona satyikāra mā‘vūda nei. ataeva tomāderake kothāẏa phiriẏe neẏā hacche?
39:6.latin_ascii: tini tomaderake srsti karechena ekai vyakti theke. tarapara ta thekei tara sangini srsti karechena evam tomaderake diyechena ata prakara catuspada jantu. tini tomaderake srsti karena tomadera matrgarbhe eka avasthara para anya avasthaya tina starera andhakarera madhye. tinii allaha, tomadera pratipalaka, sarvamaya kartrtva ta~rai. tini vyatita kona satyikara ma‘vuda nei. ataeva tomaderake kothaya phiriye neya hacchey

39:7.latin_iast: yadi tomarā kupharī kara tave niścaẏai āllāha tomādera mukhāpekṣī nana. āra tini tā~ra vāndādera janya akṛtajñatā pachanda karena nā. āra yadi tomarā kṛtajña hao tave tini tā tomādera janya pachanda karena. kona vojhā (pāpa) vahanakārī aparera vojhā vahana karave nā. avaśeṣe tomādera pratipālakera kāche tomādera phire yete have, takhana tini tomāderake jāniẏe devena tomarā yā karate. niścaẏai tini samyaka avagata se viṣaẏe yā āche antare.
39:7.latin_ascii: yadi tomara kuphari kara tave niscayai allaha tomadera mukhapeksi nana. ara tini ta~ra vandadera janya akrtajnata pachanda karena na. ara yadi tomara krtajna hao tave tini ta tomadera janya pachanda karena. kona vojha (papa) vahanakari aparera vojha vahana karave na. avasese tomadera pratipalakera kache tomadera phire yete have, takhana tini tomaderake janiye devena tomara ya karate. niscayai tini samyaka avagata se visaye ya ache antare.

39:8.latin_iast: āra yakhana mānuṣera opara kona vipada ese par̤e takhana se tāra pratipālakake āhvāna karate thāke ekāgracitte tā~ra abhimukhī haẏe. pare yakhana tini tāke nijera pakṣa theke neẏāmata dāna karena takhana se bhule yāẏa se kathā, yāra janya pūrve tā~ke āhvāna karechila evaṃ āllāhara aṃśī sthāpana kare, yāte aparake āllāhara patha theke gumarāha karate pāre. tumi vala! kuphara avasthāẏa tumi kichukāla upabhoga kare nāo, niścaẏai tumi to jāhānnāmīdera antarbhukta.
39:8.latin_ascii: ara yakhana manusera opara kona vipada ese pare takhana se tara pratipalakake ahvana karate thake ekagracitte ta~ra abhimukhi haye. pare yakhana tini take nijera paksa theke neyamata dana karena takhana se bhule yaya se katha, yara janya purve ta~ke ahvana karechila evam allahara amsi sthapana kare, yate aparake allahara patha theke gumaraha karate pare. tumi vala! kuphara avasthaya tumi kichukala upabhoga kare nao, niscayai tumi to jahannamidera antarbhukta.

39:9.latin_iast: tārā ki ai vyaktira samāna, ye vyakti rāte sijadārata avasthāẏa athavā dā~r̤iẏe ivādata kare, ākhirātake bhaẏa kare evaṃ tāra pratipālakera rahamata pratyāśā kare? tumi vala! yārā jāne āra yārā jāne nā, tārā ki samāna hate pāre? jñānavāna lokerāi śudhu upadeśa grahaṇa kare.
39:9.latin_ascii: tara ki ai vyaktira samana, ye vyakti rate sijadarata avasthaya athava da~riye ivadata kare, akhiratake bhaya kare evam tara pratipalakera rahamata pratyasa karey tumi vala! yara jane ara yara jane na, tara ki samana hate parey jnanavana lokerai sudhu upadesa grahana kare.

39:10.latin_iast: tumi vala : he īmānadāra vāndārā! tomarā tomādera pratipālakake bhaẏa kara. yārā e duniẏāẏa bhāla kāja kare tādera janya raẏeche uttama vinimaẏa. āra āllāhara jamina to praśasta. dhairyaśīladerake vehisāva puraskāra deẏā have.
39:10.latin_ascii: tumi vala : he imanadara vandara! tomara tomadera pratipalakake bhaya kara. yara e duniyaya bhala kaja kare tadera janya rayeche uttama vinimaya. ara allahara jamina to prasasta. dhairyasiladerake vehisava puraskara deya have.

39:11.latin_iast: vala : avaśyai āmāke ādeśa deẏā haẏeche āllāhara ivādata karate tā~rai uddeśye ekaniṣṭhabhāve.
39:11.latin_ascii: vala : avasyai amake adesa deya hayeche allahara ivadata karate ta~rai uddesye ekanisthabhave.

39:12.latin_iast: evaṃ āmāke āro ādeśa deẏā haẏeche, yena āmii sarvaprathama ātmasamarpaṇakārī hai.
39:12.latin_ascii: evam amake aro adesa deya hayeche, yena amii sarvaprathama atmasamarpanakari hai.

39:13.latin_iast: vala : āmi yadi āmāra pratipālakera avādhya hai tave āmi bhaẏa kari mahā divasera śāstira.
39:13.latin_ascii: vala : ami yadi amara pratipalakera avadhya hai tave ami bhaya kari maha divasera sastira.

39:14.latin_iast: vala : āmi ekamātra āllāhara ivādata kari tā~ra prati ekaniṣṭha haẏe.
39:14.latin_ascii: vala : ami ekamatra allahara ivadata kari ta~ra prati ekanistha haye.

39:15.latin_iast: ataeva tomarā tā~ke cher̤e yāra icchā tāra ivādata kara. vala : niścaẏai tārāi kiẏāmatera dina kṣatigrasta have, yārā kṣati kareche nijedera evaṃ nijedera parivāravargera. jene rekha, eṭāi prakāśya kṣati.
39:15.latin_ascii: ataeva tomara ta~ke chere yara iccha tara ivadata kara. vala : niscayai tarai kiyamatera dina ksatigrasta have, yara ksati kareche nijedera evam nijedera parivaravargera. jene rekha, etai prakasya ksati.

39:16.latin_iast: tādera janya tādera opara dika theke ghire dharave āgunera śikhā evaṃ tādera nīcera dika thekeo ghire dharave āgunera śikhā. e sei śāsti, yāra bhaẏa āllāha tā~ra vāndāderake dekhāna. he āmāra vāndāgaṇa! tomarā āmākei bhaẏa kara.
39:16.latin_ascii: tadera janya tadera opara dika theke ghire dharave agunera sikha evam tadera nicera dika thekeo ghire dharave agunera sikha. e sei sasti, yara bhaya allaha ta~ra vandaderake dekhana. he amara vandagana! tomara amakei bhaya kara.

39:17.latin_iast: āra yārā virata thāke tāgutera pūjā theke evaṃ āllāha abhimukhī haẏa tādera janya raẏeche susaṃvāda. ataeva susaṃvāda dina āmāra vāndāderake.
39:17.latin_ascii: ara yara virata thake tagutera puja theke evam allaha abhimukhi haya tadera janya rayeche susamvada. ataeva susamvada dina amara vandaderake.

39:18.latin_iast: yārā manayogasahakāre kathā śone, ataḥpara tāra madhye yā uttama tāra anusaraṇa kare. erāi tārā yāderake āllāha sat pathe paricālita karechena evaṃ erāi jñānera adhikārī.
39:18.latin_ascii: yara manayogasahakare katha sone, atahpara tara madhye ya uttama tara anusarana kare. erai tara yaderake allaha sat pathe paricalita karechena evam erai jnanera adhikari.

39:19.latin_iast: ye vyaktira opara ‘āyāvera ādeśa nirdhārita haẏe geche, tumi ki jāhānnāmīke rakṣā karate pārave?
39:19.latin_ascii: ye vyaktira opara ‘ayavera adesa nirdharita haye geche, tumi ki jahannamike raksa karate paravey

39:20.latin_iast: kintu yārā tādera pratipālakake bhaẏa kare, tādera janya jānnāte emana sava prāsāda raẏeche yāra opara ārao prāsāda nirmita āche, yāra nīca diẏe pravāhita haẏa nadīsamūha. āllāha e oẏādā diẏechena; āllāha kakhanao oẏādā bhaṅga karena nā.
39:20.latin_ascii: kintu yara tadera pratipalakake bhaya kare, tadera janya jannate emana sava prasada rayeche yara opara arao prasada nirmita ache, yara nica diye pravahita haya nadisamuha. allaha e oyada diyechena; allaha kakhanao oyada bhanga karena na.

39:21.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya karani! āllāha ākāśa theke pāni varṣaṇa karena, tārapara tini tā praveśa karāna jaminera jharaṇāsamūhera madhye, ataḥpara tā diẏe vibhinna varṇera śasya utpanna karena, tārapara tā śukiẏe yāẏa, phale takhana tumi tā haluda varṇera dekhate pāo, avaśeṣe tini cūrṇa-vicūrṇa kare khar̤a-kuṭāẏa pariṇata karena? avaśya ete raẏeche upadeśa jñānīdera janya.
39:21.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya karani! allaha akasa theke pani varsana karena, tarapara tini ta pravesa karana jaminera jharanasamuhera madhye, atahpara ta diye vibhinna varnera sasya utpanna karena, tarapara ta sukiye yaya, phale takhana tumi ta haluda varnera dekhate pao, avasese tini curna-vicurna kare khara-kutaya parinata karenay avasya ete rayeche upadesa jnanidera janya.

39:22.latin_iast: āllāha yāra vakṣake isalāmera janya unmukta karechena evaṃ se tāra pratipālakera pakṣa theke āgata ālote raẏeche, (se ki tāra samāna ye erūpa naẏa?) durbhoga tādera janya yādera kaṭhora hṛdaẏa āllāhara smaraṇa hate vimukha. tārā raẏeche prakāśya gumarāhīte.
39:22.latin_ascii: allaha yara vaksake isalamera janya unmukta karechena evam se tara pratipalakera paksa theke agata alote rayeche, (se ki tara samana ye erupa nayay) durbhoga tadera janya yadera kathora hrdaya allahara smarana hate vimukha. tara rayeche prakasya gumarahite.

39:23.latin_iast: āllāha ati uttama vāṇī nāyila karechena, tā emana kitāva yā susāmañjasya, vāra vāra telāoẏāta karā haẏa. ete tādera deha romāñcita haẏa yārā tādera pratipālakake bhaẏa kare, ataḥpara tādera deha o tādera antara vinamra haẏe āllāhara smaraṇe jhu~ke par̤e. eṭāi āllāhara hidāẏāta, era dvārā tini yāke icchā hidāẏāta dāna karena, āra āllāha yāke pathabhraṣṭa karena tāra kona pathapradarśaka nei.
39:23.latin_ascii: allaha ati uttama vani nayila karechena, ta emana kitava ya susamanjasya, vara vara telaoyata kara haya. ete tadera deha romancita haya yara tadera pratipalakake bhaya kare, atahpara tadera deha o tadera antara vinamra haye allahara smarane jhu~ke pare. etai allahara hidayata, era dvara tini yake iccha hidayata dana karena, ara allaha yake pathabhrasta karena tara kona pathapradarsaka nei.

39:24.latin_iast: ye vyakti kiẏāmatera dina nijera mukhamaṇḍala diẏe kaṭhina ‘āyāva ṭhekāte cāive, (se ki tāra mata ye erūpa naẏa?) āra erūpa jālimaderake valā have : svāda grahaṇa kara (tāra śāsti), yā tomarā karate.
39:24.latin_ascii: ye vyakti kiyamatera dina nijera mukhamandala diye kathina ‘ayava thekate caive, (se ki tara mata ye erupa nayay) ara erupa jalimaderake vala have : svada grahana kara (tara sasti), ya tomara karate.

39:25.latin_iast: tādera pūrvavartīrāo asvīkāra karechila, phale tādera opara ‘āyāva emanabhāve esechila ye, tārā bhāvate pāreni.
39:25.latin_ascii: tadera purvavartirao asvikara karechila, phale tadera opara ‘ayava emanabhave esechila ye, tara bhavate pareni.

39:26.latin_iast: ataḥpara āllāha tāderake pārthiva jīvanei apamānera svāda bhoga karālena, āra parakālera śāsti to ārao bhīṣaṇa. (katai nā bhāla hata) yadi tārā jānata!
39:26.latin_ascii: atahpara allaha taderake parthiva jivanei apamanera svada bhoga karalena, ara parakalera sasti to arao bhisana. (katai na bhala hata) yadi tara janata!

39:27.latin_iast: āra āmi to e kuraāne mānuṣera janya sakala prakāra dṛṣṭānta varṇanā karechi, yāte tārā upadeśa grahaṇa kare.
39:27.latin_ascii: ara ami to e kuraane manusera janya sakala prakara drstanta varnana karechi, yate tara upadesa grahana kare.

39:28.latin_iast: e kuraāna āravi bhāṣāẏa, ete vindumātrao vakratā nei, yāte tārā sāvadhānatā avalamvana kare.
39:28.latin_ascii: e kuraana aravi bhasaya, ete vindumatrao vakrata nei, yate tara savadhanata avalamvana kare.

39:29.latin_iast: āllāha ekaṭi dṛṣṭānta varṇanā karechena : eka vyakti āche yāra raẏeche paraspara viruddhabhāvāpanna kaẏekajana mālika, āreka vyakti yāra āche kevala ekajana mālika, edera ubhaẏera avasthā ki samāna hate pāre? sakala praśaṃsā āllāhara; varaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai jāne nā.
39:29.latin_ascii: allaha ekati drstanta varnana karechena : eka vyakti ache yara rayeche paraspara viruddhabhavapanna kayekajana malika, areka vyakti yara ache kevala ekajana malika, edera ubhayera avastha ki samana hate parey sakala prasamsa allahara; varam tadera adhikamsai jane na.

39:30.latin_iast: niścaẏai tumio mṛtyuvaraṇa karave āra tārāo mṛtyuvaraṇa karave.
39:30.latin_ascii: niscayai tumio mrtyuvarana karave ara tarao mrtyuvarana karave.

39:31.latin_iast: ataḥpara kiẏāmatera dine tomarā svīẏa pratipālakera sāmane vitarka karave.
39:31.latin_ascii: atahpara kiyamatera dine tomara sviya pratipalakera samane vitarka karave.

39:32.latin_iast: ye vyakti āllāha samvandhe mithyā vale evaṃ tāra nikaṭa yakhana satya āse takhana pratyākhyāna kare tāra apekṣā adhika jālima āra ke? kāphiradera āvāsasthala ki jāhānnāma naẏa?
39:32.latin_ascii: ye vyakti allaha samvandhe mithya vale evam tara nikata yakhana satya ase takhana pratyakhyana kare tara apeksa adhika jalima ara key kaphiradera avasasthala ki jahannama nayay

39:33.latin_iast: ye satyasaha upasthita haẏeche evaṃ tāke satya vale meneche tārāi to muttākī.
39:33.latin_ascii: ye satyasaha upasthita hayeche evam take satya vale meneche tarai to muttaki.

39:34.latin_iast: tārā yā cāive sava kichui āche tādera pratipālakera nikaṭa. eṭāi sat karmaśīladera pratidāna.
39:34.latin_ascii: tara ya caive sava kichui ache tadera pratipalakera nikata. etai sat karmasiladera pratidana.

39:35.latin_iast: yāte tārā ye-sava apakarma karechila āllāha tā kṣamā karena evaṃ tāderake tādera sat karmera janya pruṣkṛta karena.
39:35.latin_ascii: yate tara ye-sava apakarma karechila allaha ta ksama karena evam taderake tadera sat karmera janya pruskrta karena.

39:36.latin_iast: āllāha ki tā~ra vāndāra janya yatheṣṭa nana? athaca tārā tomāke āllāhara parivarte aparera bhaẏa dekhāẏa. āllāha yāke pathabhraṣṭa karena tāra janya kona patha prardaśaka nei.
39:36.latin_ascii: allaha ki ta~ra vandara janya yathesta nanay athaca tara tomake allahara parivarte aparera bhaya dekhaya. allaha yake pathabhrasta karena tara janya kona patha prardasaka nei.

39:37.latin_iast: āra yāke āllāha hidāẏāta dāna karena tāra janya kona pathabhraṣṭakārī nei, āllaha ki parākramaśālī, pratiśodha grahaṇakārī nana?
39:37.latin_ascii: ara yake allaha hidayata dana karena tara janya kona pathabhrastakari nei, allaha ki parakramasali, pratisodha grahanakari nanay

39:38.latin_iast: tumi yadi tāderake jijñāsā kara, ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivī ke sṛṣṭi karechena? tārā avaśyai valave, āllāha. vala : tomarā ki bheve dekhacha ye, āllāha āmāra aniṣṭa cāile tomarā āllāhara parivarte yāderake ḍāka tārā ki sei aniṣṭa dūra karate pārave? athavā tini āmāra prati anugraha karate cāile tārā ki se anugrahake vādhāgrasta karate pārave? vala : āmāra janya āllāhai yatheṣṭa. nirbharakārīrā tāra oparai nirbhara kare.
39:38.latin_ascii: tumi yadi taderake jijnasa kara, akasamandali o prthivi ke srsti karechenay tara avasyai valave, allaha. vala : tomara ki bheve dekhacha ye, allaha amara anista caile tomara allahara parivarte yaderake daka tara ki sei anista dura karate paravey athava tini amara prati anugraha karate caile tara ki se anugrahake vadhagrasta karate paravey vala : amara janya allahai yathesta. nirbharakarira tara oparai nirbhara kare.

39:39.latin_iast: vala, he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā sva sva avasthāne āmala karate thāko, avaśya āmio āmala karachi. tomarā śīghrai (prakṛta satya) jānate pārave.
39:39.latin_ascii: vala, he amara sampradaya! tomara sva sva avasthane amala karate thako, avasya amio amala karachi. tomara sighrai (prakrta satya) janate parave.

39:40.latin_iast: ke se yāra prati āsave lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti evaṃ tāra opara patita have sthāẏī śāsti.
39:40.latin_ascii: ke se yara prati asave lanchanadayaka sasti evam tara opara patita have sthayi sasti.

39:41.latin_iast: āmi tomāra prati satyasaha kitāva avatīrṇa karechi mānuṣera janya evaṃ ye pathabhraṣṭa haẏa se to pathabhraṣṭa haẏa nijerai dhvaṃsera janya evaṃ tumi tādera jimmādāra nao.
39:41.latin_ascii: ami tomara prati satyasaha kitava avatirna karechi manusera janya evam ye pathabhrasta haya se to pathabhrasta haya nijerai dhvamsera janya evam tumi tadera jimmadara nao.

39:42.latin_iast: āllāhai jīvasamūhera mṛtyu pradāna karena tādera mṛtyura samaẏa evaṃ yādera mṛtyu āseni tāderao ghumera samaẏa. ataḥpara yāra janya mṛtyura siddhānta karena tāra prāṇa tini rekhe dena evaṃ aparagulo phiriẏe dena eka nirdiṣṭa samaẏera janya. avaśyai ete nidarśana raẏeche cintāśīla sampradāẏera janya.
39:42.latin_ascii: allahai jivasamuhera mrtyu pradana karena tadera mrtyura samaya evam yadera mrtyu aseni taderao ghumera samaya. atahpara yara janya mrtyura siddhanta karena tara prana tini rekhe dena evam aparagulo phiriye dena eka nirdista samayera janya. avasyai ete nidarsana rayeche cintasila sampradayera janya.

39:43.latin_iast: tārā ki āllāha chār̤ā aparake śāphāẏātakārī grahaṇa kareche? vala : yadio tārā kona kṣamatā rākhe nā evaṃ tārā vujhe nā?
39:43.latin_ascii: tara ki allaha chara aparake saphayatakari grahana karechey vala : yadio tara kona ksamata rakhe na evam tara vujhe nay

39:44.latin_iast: vala : yāvatīẏa śāphāẏāta āllāharai ekhatiẏāre, ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīra sārvabhaumatva āllāharai ataḥpara tā~rai nikaṭa tomarā pratyāvartita have.
39:44.latin_ascii: vala : yavatiya saphayata allaharai ekhatiyare, akasamandali o prthivira sarvabhaumatva allaharai atahpara ta~rai nikata tomara pratyavartita have.

39:45.latin_iast: eka āllāhara kathā valā hale yārā ākhirātake viśvāsa kare nā tādera antara ghṛṇāẏa bhare yāẏa evaṃ āllāhara parivarte (tādera devatāgulora) ullekha karā hale tārā ānandita haẏe yāẏa.
39:45.latin_ascii: eka allahara katha vala hale yara akhiratake visvasa kare na tadera antara ghrnaya bhare yaya evam allahara parivarte (tadera devatagulora) ullekha kara hale tara anandita haye yaya.

40:56.latin_iast: yārā nijedera nikaṭa kona dalīla nā thākaleo āllāhara nidarśana samparke vitarke lipta haẏa, tādera antare āche śudhu ahaṃkāra, yā saphala havāra naẏa. ataeva āllāhara śaraṇāpanna hao, tini to sarvaśrotā, sarvadraṣṭā.
40:56.latin_ascii: yara nijedera nikata kona dalila na thakaleo allahara nidarsana samparke vitarke lipta haya, tadera antare ache sudhu ahamkara, ya saphala havara naya. ataeva allahara saranapanna hao, tini to sarvasrota, sarvadrasta.

40:57.latin_iast: mānava sṛjana apekṣā ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīra sṛṣṭi avaśyai aneka var̤a kāja; kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa eṭā jāne nā.
40:57.latin_ascii: manava srjana apeksa akasamandali o prthivira srsti avasyai aneka vara kaja; kintu adhikamsa manusa eta jane na.

40:58.latin_iast: samāna naẏa andha o dṛṣṭiśaktisampanna evaṃ yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare āra yārā gunāhagāra. tomarā alpai upadeśa grahaṇa kare thāko.
40:58.latin_ascii: samana naya andha o drstisaktisampanna evam yara imana ane o sat karma kare ara yara gunahagara. tomara alpai upadesa grahana kare thako.

40:59.latin_iast: kiẏāmata avaśyambhāvī, ete kona sandeha nei; kintu adhikāṃśa loka viśvāsa kare nā.
40:59.latin_ascii: kiyamata avasyambhavi, ete kona sandeha nei; kintu adhikamsa loka visvasa kare na.

40:60.latin_iast: tomādera pratipālaka valena : tomarā āmāke ḍāko, āmi tomādera ḍāke sār̤ā deva. yārā ahaṃkāre āmāra ivādata hate vimukha, tārā avaśyai jāhānnāme praveśa karave lāñchita avasthāẏa.
40:60.latin_ascii: tomadera pratipalaka valena : tomara amake dako, ami tomadera dake sara deva. yara ahamkare amara ivadata hate vimukha, tara avasyai jahanname pravesa karave lanchita avasthaya.

40:61.latin_iast: āllāhai tomādera viśrrāmera janya sṛṣṭi karechena rātri evaṃ ālokojjvala karechena divasake. āllāha to mānuṣera prati anugrahaśīla; kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣa kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare nā.
40:61.latin_ascii: allahai tomadera visrramera janya srsti karechena ratri evam alokojjvala karechena divasake. allaha to manusera prati anugrahasila; kintu adhikamsa manusa krtajnata prakasa kare na.

40:62.latin_iast: tini āllāha, tomādera pratipālaka, sava kichura sraṣṭā; tini vyatīta (satya) kona mā‘vūda nei, sutarāṃ tomarā kothāẏa pathabhraṣṭa haẏe ghuracha?
40:62.latin_ascii: tini allaha, tomadera pratipalaka, sava kichura srasta; tini vyatita (satya) kona ma‘vuda nei, sutaram tomara kothaya pathabhrasta haye ghurachay

40:63.latin_iast: ebhāvei pathabhraṣṭa haẏe tārā ghure, yārā āllāhara nidarśanāvalīke asvīkāra kare.
40:63.latin_ascii: ebhavei pathabhrasta haye tara ghure, yara allahara nidarsanavalike asvikara kare.

40:64.latin_iast: āllāhai tomādera janya pṛthivīke karechena vāsopayogī, ākāśake karechena chāda, tomādera ākṛti karechena utkṛṣṭa evaṃ tomāderake dāna karechena utkṛṣṭa riyika. e āllāha to, tomādera pratipālaka. jagatasamūhera pratipālaka āllāha katainā varakatamaẏa!
40:64.latin_ascii: allahai tomadera janya prthivike karechena vasopayogi, akasake karechena chada, tomadera akrti karechena utkrsta evam tomaderake dana karechena utkrsta riyika. e allaha to, tomadera pratipalaka. jagatasamuhera pratipalaka allaha kataina varakatamaya!

40:65.latin_iast: tini cirañjīva, tini vyatīta (satya) kona mā‘vūda nei; sutarāṃ tomarā tā~kei ḍāko tā~ra ivādate ekaniṣṭha haẏe. yāvatīẏa praśaṃsā jagatamūhera pratipālaka āllāharai prāpya.
40:65.latin_ascii: tini ciranjiva, tini vyatita (satya) kona ma‘vuda nei; sutaram tomara ta~kei dako ta~ra ivadate ekanistha haye. yavatiya prasamsa jagatamuhera pratipalaka allaharai prapya.

40:66.latin_iast: vala : āmāra pratipālakera nikaṭa hate āmāra nikaṭa nidarśana āsāra pareo tomarā āllāha vyatīta yāderake āhvāna kara, tādera ivādata karate āmāke niṣedha karā haẏeche evaṃ āmi ādiṣṭa haẏechi jagatasamūhera pratipālakera nikaṭa ātmasamarpaṇa karate.
40:66.latin_ascii: vala : amara pratipalakera nikata hate amara nikata nidarsana asara pareo tomara allaha vyatita yaderake ahvana kara, tadera ivadata karate amake nisedha kara hayeche evam ami adista hayechi jagatasamuhera pratipalakera nikata atmasamarpana karate.

40:67.latin_iast: tinii tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena māṭi hate, pare śukravindu hate, tārapara vera karena śiśurūpe, ataḥpara yena tomarā upanīta hao yauvane, tārapara hao vṛddha. tomādera madhye kāro era pūrvei mṛtyu ghaṭe evaṃ eṭā ejanya ye, tomarā nirdhārita kāle pau~che yāo evaṃ yāte tomarā anudhāvana karate pāra.
40:67.latin_ascii: tinii tomaderake srsti karechena mati hate, pare sukravindu hate, tarapara vera karena sisurupe, atahpara yena tomara upanita hao yauvane, tarapara hao vrddha. tomadera madhye karo era purvei mrtyu ghate evam eta ejanya ye, tomara nirdharita kale pau~che yao evam yate tomara anudhavana karate para.

40:68.latin_iast: tinii jīvana dāna karena o mṛtyu ghaṭāna evaṃ yakhana tini kichu karāra siddhānta nena takhana tini valena : hao evaṃ tā haẏe yāẏa.
40:68.latin_ascii: tinii jivana dana karena o mrtyu ghatana evam yakhana tini kichu karara siddhanta nena takhana tini valena : hao evam ta haye yaya.

40:69.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya kara nā tādera prati yārā āllāhara nidarśanasamūha samparke paraspara vitarka kare? kibhāve tāderake paricālita karā hacche?
40:69.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya kara na tadera prati yara allahara nidarsanasamuha samparke paraspara vitarka karey kibhave taderake paricalita kara hacchey

40:70.latin_iast: yārā asvīkāra kare kitāva o yā-saha āmi rāsūladerake preraṇa karechilāma tā, śīghrai tārā jānate pārave.
40:70.latin_ascii: yara asvikara kare kitava o ya-saha ami rasuladerake prerana karechilama ta, sighrai tara janate parave.

40:71.latin_iast: yakhana tādera galadeśe ver̤i o śṛṅkhala thākave, tāderake ṭene niẏe yāoẏā have.
40:71.latin_ascii: yakhana tadera galadese veri o srnkhala thakave, taderake tene niye yaoya have.

40:72.latin_iast: phuṭanta pānite, ataḥpara tāderake dagdha karā have agnite.
40:72.latin_ascii: phutanta panite, atahpara taderake dagdha kara have agnite.

40:73.latin_iast: pare tāderake valā have : kothāẏa tārā yāderake tomarā (tā~ra) śarīka karate;
40:73.latin_ascii: pare taderake vala have : kothaya tara yaderake tomara (ta~ra) sarika karate;

40:74.latin_iast: āllāha vyatīta? tārā valave : tārā to āmādera nikaṭa hate adṛśya haẏeche; vantuta pūrve āmarā emana kichukei āhvāna karini. ebhāve āllāha kāphiraderake vibhrānta karena.
40:74.latin_ascii: allaha vyatitay tara valave : tara to amadera nikata hate adrsya hayeche; vantuta purve amara emana kichukei ahvana karini. ebhave allaha kaphiraderake vibhranta karena.

40:75.latin_iast: eṭā ei kāraṇe ye, tomarā pṛthivīte ayathā ullāsa karate evaṃ ei kāraṇe ye, tomarā dambha karate.
40:75.latin_ascii: eta ei karane ye, tomara prthivite ayatha ullasa karate evam ei karane ye, tomara dambha karate.

40:76.latin_iast: tomarā jāhānnāmera dvārasamūhe praveśa kara tāte sthāẏībhāve avasthānera janya, āra katai nā nikṛṣṭa ahaṃkārīdera āvāsasthala!
40:76.latin_ascii: tomara jahannamera dvarasamuhe pravesa kara tate sthayibhave avasthanera janya, ara katai na nikrsta ahamkaridera avasasthala!

40:77.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi dhairyadhāraṇa kara. āllāhara aṅgīkāra satya. āmi tāderake ye aṅgīkāra pradāna kari tāra kichu yadi dekhiẏei dii athavā tomāra mṛtyu ghaṭāi- tādera pratyāvartana to āmārai nikaṭa.
40:77.latin_ascii: sutaram tumi dhairyadharana kara. allahara angikara satya. ami taderake ye angikara pradana kari tara kichu yadi dekhiyei dii athava tomara mrtyu ghatai- tadera pratyavartana to amarai nikata.

40:78.latin_iast: āmi to tomāra pūrve aneka rāsūla preraṇa karechilāma; tādera kāro kathā tomāra nikaṭa varṇanā karechi evaṃ kāro kathā tomāra nikaṭa varṇanā karini. āllāhara anumati chār̤ā kona nidarśana upasthita karā kona rāsūlera kāja naẏa. āllāhara ādeśa āsale nyāẏasaṅgatabhāve phāẏasālā haẏe yāve. takhana vātila panthīrā kṣatigrasta have.
40:78.latin_ascii: ami to tomara purve aneka rasula prerana karechilama; tadera karo katha tomara nikata varnana karechi evam karo katha tomara nikata varnana karini. allahara anumati chara kona nidarsana upasthita kara kona rasulera kaja naya. allahara adesa asale nyayasangatabhave phayasala haye yave. takhana vatila panthira ksatigrasta have.

40:79.latin_iast: āllāhai tomādera janya catuṣpada jantu sṛṣṭi karechena, tāra kichute tomarā ārohaṇa kare thāko evaṃ kichu tomarā āhārao kare thāko.
40:79.latin_ascii: allahai tomadera janya catuspada jantu srsti karechena, tara kichute tomara arohana kare thako evam kichu tomara aharao kare thako.

40:80.latin_iast: ete tomādera janya raẏeche aneka upakāra, tomarā yā praẏojana vodha kara, eṭā dvārā tā pūūrṇa kare thāko, evaṃ edera opara o nauyānera opara tomāderake vahana karāno haẏa.
40:80.latin_ascii: ete tomadera janya rayeche aneka upakara, tomara ya prayojana vodha kara, eta dvara ta puurna kare thako, evam edera opara o nauyanera opara tomaderake vahana karano haya.

40:81.latin_iast: tini tomāderake tā~ra nidarśanāvalī dekhiẏe thākena. sutarāṃ tomarā āllāhara nidarśanasamūhera konṭi asvīkāra karave.
40:81.latin_ascii: tini tomaderake ta~ra nidarsanavali dekhiye thakena. sutaram tomara allahara nidarsanasamuhera konti asvikara karave.

40:82.latin_iast: tārā ki pṛthivīte bhramaṇa kareni o dekheni tādera pūrvavartīdera kī pariṇāma haẏechila? pṛthivīte tārā chila edera apekṣā saṃkhyāẏa adhika evaṃ śaktite o kīrtite adhika pravala. tārā yā karata tā tādera kona kāje āseni.
40:82.latin_ascii: tara ki prthivite bhramana kareni o dekheni tadera purvavartidera ki parinama hayechilay prthivite tara chila edera apeksa samkhyaya adhika evam saktite o kirtite adhika pravala. tara ya karata ta tadera kona kaje aseni.

40:83.latin_iast: tādera nikaṭa yakhana nidarśanāvalīsaha tādera rāsūlagaṇa āsato takhana tārā nijedera jñānera dambha karata. tārā yā niẏe ṭhāṭṭā-vidrūpa karata tā tāderake veṣṭana karala.
40:83.latin_ascii: tadera nikata yakhana nidarsanavalisaha tadera rasulagana asato takhana tara nijedera jnanera dambha karata. tara ya niye thatta-vidrupa karata ta taderake vestana karala.

40:84.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tārā āmāra śāsti pratyakṣa karala takhana valalo : āmarā eka āllāhatei īmāna ānalāma evaṃ āmarā tā~ra sāthe yāderake śarīka karatāma tāderake pratyākhyāna karalāma.
40:84.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tara amara sasti pratyaksa karala takhana valalo : amara eka allahatei imana analama evam amara ta~ra sathe yaderake sarika karatama taderake pratyakhyana karalama.

40:85.latin_iast: tārā yakhana āmāra śāsti pratyakṣa karala takhana tādera īmāna tādera kona upakāre āsala nā. āllāhara ei vidhāna pūrva hatei tā~ra vāndādera madhye cale āsache evaṃ se kṣetre kāphirarā kṣatigrasta haẏa.
40:85.latin_ascii: tara yakhana amara sasti pratyaksa karala takhana tadera imana tadera kona upakare asala na. allahara ei vidhana purva hatei ta~ra vandadera madhye cale asache evam se ksetre kaphirara ksatigrasta haya.

41:2.latin_iast: eṭā daẏāmaẏa, parama daẏālura nikaṭa hate avatīrṇa.
41:2.latin_ascii: eta dayamaya, parama dayalura nikata hate avatirna.

41:3.latin_iast: eṭā (emana) eka kitāva yāra āẏātasamūha viśadabhāve varṇanā karā haẏeche, jñānī sampradāẏera janya āravī bhāṣāẏa kuraānarūpe.
41:3.latin_ascii: eta (emana) eka kitava yara ayatasamuha visadabhave varnana kara hayeche, jnani sampradayera janya aravi bhasaya kuraanarupe.

41:4.latin_iast: susaṃvādadātā o satarkakārīrūpe; kintu tādera adhikāṃśai vimukha haẏeche. sutarāṃ tārā śunave nā.
41:4.latin_ascii: susamvadadata o satarkakarirupe; kintu tadera adhikamsai vimukha hayeche. sutaram tara sunave na.

41:5.latin_iast: tārā vale : tumi yāra prati āmāderake āhvāna karacha se viṣaẏe āmādera antara āvaraṇe ācchādita, karṇe āche vadhiratā evaṃ tomāra o āmādera madhye āche antarāẏa; sutarāṃ tumi tomāra kāja kara evaṃ āmarā āmādera kāja kari.
41:5.latin_ascii: tara vale : tumi yara prati amaderake ahvana karacha se visaye amadera antara avarane acchadita, karne ache vadhirata evam tomara o amadera madhye ache antaraya; sutaram tumi tomara kaja kara evam amara amadera kaja kari.

41:6.latin_iast: vala : āmi tomādera matai ekajana mānuṣa, āmāra prati oẏāhī haẏa ye, tomādera mā’vūda ekamātra mā‘vūda. ataeva tā~rai patha dṛr̤habhāve avalamvana kara evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa kṣamā prārthanā kara. durbheāga aṃśīvādīdera janya-
41:6.latin_ascii: vala : ami tomadera matai ekajana manusa, amara prati oyahi haya ye, tomadera ma’vuda ekamatra ma‘vuda. ataeva ta~rai patha drrhabhave avalamvana kara evam ta~rai nikata ksama prarthana kara. durbheaga amsivadidera janya-

41:7.latin_iast: yārā yākāta pradāna kare nā evaṃ tārā ākhirāteo aviśvāsī.
41:7.latin_ascii: yara yakata pradana kare na evam tara akhirateo avisvasi.

41:8.latin_iast: yārā īmāna āne o sat karma kare tādera janya raẏeche niravicchinna puraskāra.
41:8.latin_ascii: yara imana ane o sat karma kare tadera janya rayeche niravicchinna puraskara.

41:9.latin_iast: vala : tomarā ki tā~ke asvīkāra karavei yini pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena du dine āra tomarā tā~ra samakakṣa dā~r̤a karāte cāo? tini to jagatasamūhera pratipālaka.
41:9.latin_ascii: vala : tomara ki ta~ke asvikara karavei yini prthivi srsti karechena du dine ara tomara ta~ra samakaksa da~ra karate caoy tini to jagatasamuhera pratipalaka.

41:10.latin_iast: cāra dine tini bhū-pṛṣṭhe sthāpana karechena (sudṛr̤ha) parvatamālā, tāte rekhechena varakata evaṃ ete vyavasthā karechena khādyera, samabhāve- jijñāsudera janya.
41:10.latin_ascii: cara dine tini bhu-prsthe sthapana karechena (sudrrha) parvatamala, tate rekhechena varakata evam ete vyavastha karechena khadyera, samabhave- jijnasudera janya.

41:11.latin_iast: ataḥpara tini ākāśera dike manoniveśa karena yā chila dhumra viśeṣa. anantara tini ākāśa o pṛthivīke valalena : tomarā ubhaẏe eso icchā athavā anicchāẏa. tārā valala : āmarā āsalāma anugata haẏe.
41:11.latin_ascii: atahpara tini akasera dike manonivesa karena ya chila dhumra visesa. anantara tini akasa o prthivike valalena : tomara ubhaye eso iccha athava anicchaya. tara valala : amara asalama anugata haye.

41:12.latin_iast: ataḥpara tini tāke dui dine saptākāśe pariṇata karalena evaṃ pratyeka ākāśe tāra vidhāna vyakta karalena evaṃ āmi duniẏāra ākāśake karalāma suśobhita o surakṣita. eṭā parākramaśālī sarvajña āllāhara vyavasthāpanā.
41:12.latin_ascii: atahpara tini take dui dine saptakase parinata karalena evam pratyeka akase tara vidhana vyakta karalena evam ami duniyara akasake karalama susobhita o suraksita. eta parakramasali sarvajna allahara vyavasthapana.

41:13.latin_iast: tārā yadi vimukha haẏa tave vala : āmi tomāderake satarka karachi eka (āyāvera) vajrera; ‘āda o sāmūdera (upara āghāta halo) vajrera anurūpa.
41:13.latin_ascii: tara yadi vimukha haya tave vala : ami tomaderake satarka karachi eka (ayavera) vajrera; ‘ada o samudera (upara aghata halo) vajrera anurupa.

41:14.latin_iast: yakhana tādera nikaṭa rāsūlagaṇa esechila tādera sammukha o paścāt hate (evaṃ valechila) tomarā āllāha vyatīta kāro ivādata kara nā. takhana tārā valechila : āmādera pratipālakera erūpa icchā hale tini avaśyai phereśatā avatīrṇa karatena. ataeva, tumi yesava viṣaẏasaha prerita haẏecha, āmarā tā pratyākhāna karachi.
41:14.latin_ascii: yakhana tadera nikata rasulagana esechila tadera sammukha o pascat hate (evam valechila) tomara allaha vyatita karo ivadata kara na. takhana tara valechila : amadera pratipalakera erupa iccha hale tini avasyai pheresata avatirna karatena. ataeva, tumi yesava visayasaha prerita hayecha, amara ta pratyakhana karachi.

41:15.latin_iast: āra ‘āda sampradāẏera vyāpāra ei ye, tārā pṛthivīte ayathā dambha karata evaṃ valata : āmādera apekṣā adhika śaktiśālī ke āche? tārā ki tave lakṣya kareni ye, āllāha, yini tāderake sṛṣṭi karechena, tini tādera apekṣā śaktiśālī. athaca tārā āmāra nidarśanāvalīke asvīkāra karata.
41:15.latin_ascii: ara ‘ada sampradayera vyapara ei ye, tara prthivite ayatha dambha karata evam valata : amadera apeksa adhika saktisali ke achey tara ki tave laksya kareni ye, allaha, yini taderake srsti karechena, tini tadera apeksa saktisali. athaca tara amara nidarsanavalike asvikara karata.

41:16.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāderake pārthiva jīvane apamānajanaka śāsti āsvādana karāvāra janya tādera viruddhe aśubha dine preraṇa karechilāma pracanḍa ghūrṇijhar̤a. ākhirātera śāsti to adhikatara lāñchanādāẏaka evaṃ tādera sāhāyyao karā have nā.
41:16.latin_ascii: atahpara ami taderake parthiva jivane apamanajanaka sasti asvadana karavara janya tadera viruddhe asubha dine prerana karechilama pracanda ghurnijhara. akhiratera sasti to adhikatara lanchanadayaka evam tadera sahayyao kara have na.

41:17.latin_iast: āra sāmūda sampradāẏera vyāpāra ei ye, āmi tāderake patha nirdeśa karechilāma; kintu tārā sat pathera parivarte andhatva (bhrānta patha) avalamvana karechila. ataḥpara tādera kṛtakarmera pariṇāmasvarūpa lāñchanādāẏaka vajra śāsti āghāta hānala.
41:17.latin_ascii: ara samuda sampradayera vyapara ei ye, ami taderake patha nirdesa karechilama; kintu tara sat pathera parivarte andhatva (bhranta patha) avalamvana karechila. atahpara tadera krtakarmera parinamasvarupa lanchanadayaka vajra sasti aghata hanala.

41:18.latin_iast: āmi tāderake rakṣā karalāma yārā īmāna enechila evaṃ yārā tākaoẏā avalamvana karata.
41:18.latin_ascii: ami taderake raksa karalama yara imana enechila evam yara takaoya avalamvana karata.

41:19.latin_iast: yedina āllāhara śatra“derake jāhānnāma abhimukhe samaveta karā have sedina tāderake vinyasta karā have vibhinna dale.
41:19.latin_ascii: yedina allahara satra“derake jahannama abhimukhe samaveta kara have sedina taderake vinyasta kara have vibhinna dale.

41:20.latin_iast: pariśeṣe yakhana tārā jāhānnāmera sannikaṭe pau~chave takhana tādera karṇa, cakṣu o tvaka (cāmar̤ā) tādera kṛtakarmera viruddhe sākṣya deve.
41:20.latin_ascii: parisese yakhana tara jahannamera sannikate pau~chave takhana tadera karna, caksu o tvaka (camara) tadera krtakarmera viruddhe saksya deve.

41:21.latin_iast: jāhānnāmīrā tādera cāmar̤āke jijñāsā karaveḥ tomarā āmādera viruddhe sākṣya diccha kena? uttare tārā valave : āllāha, yini savakichuke vākaśakti diẏechena tini āmāderakeo vākaśakti diẏechena. tini tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena prathama vāra evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa tomarā pratyāvartita have.
41:21.latin_ascii: jahannamira tadera camarake jijnasa karaveh tomara amadera viruddhe saksya diccha kenay uttare tara valave : allaha, yini savakichuke vakasakti diyechena tini amaderakeo vakasakti diyechena. tini tomaderake srsti karechena prathama vara evam ta~rai nikata tomara pratyavartita have.

41:22.latin_iast: tomarā aneka kichu gopana karate nā e viśvāse ye, tomādera karṇa, cakṣu evaṃ tvaka tomādera viruddhe sākṣya deve nā- uparantu tomarā mane karate ye, tomarā yā karacho tāra aneka kichui āllāha jānena nā.
41:22.latin_ascii: tomara aneka kichu gopana karate na e visvase ye, tomadera karna, caksu evam tvaka tomadera viruddhe saksya deve na- uparantu tomara mane karate ye, tomara ya karacho tara aneka kichui allaha janena na.

41:23.latin_iast: tomādera pratipālaka samvandhe tomādera ei dhāraṇāi tomādera dhvaṃsa kareche. phale tomarā haẏecha kṣatigrasta.
41:23.latin_ascii: tomadera pratipalaka samvandhe tomadera ei dharanai tomadera dhvamsa kareche. phale tomara hayecha ksatigrasta.

41:24.latin_iast: ekhana tārā dhairyadhāraṇa karaleo jāhānnāmai have tādera āvāsa evaṃ tārā anugraha cāileo tārā anugrahaprāpta have nā.
41:24.latin_ascii: ekhana tara dhairyadharana karaleo jahannamai have tadera avasa evam tara anugraha caileo tara anugrahaprapta have na.

41:25.latin_iast: āmi tādera janya nirdhāraṇa kare diẏechilāma sahacara yārā tādera sammukhe o paścāte yā āche tā tādera dṛṣṭite śobhana kare dekhiẏechila evaṃ tādera vyāpāreo tādera pūrvavartī jina o mānavadera nyāẏa śāstira kathā vāstavāẏita haẏeche. tārā to chila kṣatigrasta.
41:25.latin_ascii: ami tadera janya nirdharana kare diyechilama sahacara yara tadera sammukhe o pascate ya ache ta tadera drstite sobhana kare dekhiyechila evam tadera vyapareo tadera purvavarti jina o manavadera nyaya sastira katha vastavayita hayeche. tara to chila ksatigrasta.

41:26.latin_iast: kāphirarā vale : tomarā ei kuraāna śravaṇa kara nā evaṃ tā tilāoẏātakāle śoragola sṛṣṭi kara yāte tomarā jaẏī hate pāra.
41:26.latin_ascii: kaphirara vale : tomara ei kuraana sravana kara na evam ta tilaoyatakale soragola srsti kara yate tomara jayi hate para.

41:27.latin_iast: āmi avaśyai kāphiraderake kaṭhina śāsti āsvādana karāva evaṃ niścaẏai āmi tāderake nikṛṣṭa kāryakalāpera vinimaẏa deva.
41:27.latin_ascii: ami avasyai kaphiraderake kathina sasti asvadana karava evam niscayai ami taderake nikrsta karyakalapera vinimaya deva.

41:28.latin_iast: jāhānnāma, eṭāi āllāhara śatra“dera pariṇāma; sekhāne tādera janya raẏeche sthāẏī āvāsa āmāra nidarśanāvalī asvīkṛtira pratiphala svarūpa.
41:28.latin_ascii: jahannama, etai allahara satra“dera parinama; sekhane tadera janya rayeche sthayi avasa amara nidarsanavali asvikrtira pratiphala svarupa.

41:29.latin_iast: kāphirarā valave : he āmādera pratipālaka! yesava jina o mānava āmāderake pathabhraṣṭa karechila tādera ubhaẏake dekhiẏe dina, āmarā ubhaẏake padadalita karava, yāte tārā nimna śreṇira antarbhukta haẏa.
41:29.latin_ascii: kaphirara valave : he amadera pratipalaka! yesava jina o manava amaderake pathabhrasta karechila tadera ubhayake dekhiye dina, amara ubhayake padadalita karava, yate tara nimna srenira antarbhukta haya.

41:30.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā vale : āmādera pratipālaka āllāha, ataḥpara avicala thāke, tādera nikaṭa avatīrṇa haẏa phereśatā evaṃ vale : tomarā bhīta haẏo nā, cintita haẏo nā evaṃ tomāderake ye jānnātera pratiśruti deẏā haẏechila tāra susaṃvāda peẏe ānandita hao.
41:30.latin_ascii: niscayai yara vale : amadera pratipalaka allaha, atahpara avicala thake, tadera nikata avatirna haya pheresata evam vale : tomara bhita hayo na, cintita hayo na evam tomaderake ye jannatera pratisruti deya hayechila tara susamvada peye anandita hao.

41:31.latin_iast: āmarāi tomādera vandhu duniẏāra jīvane o ākhirāte; sekhāne tomādera janya raẏeche yā kichu tomādera mana cāẏa evaṃ sekhāne tomādera janya raẏeche yā tomarā cāive.
41:31.latin_ascii: amarai tomadera vandhu duniyara jivane o akhirate; sekhane tomadera janya rayeche ya kichu tomadera mana caya evam sekhane tomadera janya rayeche ya tomara caive.

41:32.latin_iast: eṭā hala kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu āllāhara pakṣa hate āpyāẏana.
41:32.latin_ascii: eta hala ksamasila, parama dayalu allahara paksa hate apyayana.

41:33.latin_iast: ai vyakti apekṣā kathāẏa ke uttama ye āllāhara dike mānuuṣake āhvāna kare, sat karma kare evaṃ vale : āmi to ātmasamarpaṇakārīdera antarbhukta.
41:33.latin_ascii: ai vyakti apeksa kathaya ke uttama ye allahara dike manuusake ahvana kare, sat karma kare evam vale : ami to atmasamarpanakaridera antarbhukta.
