41:34.latin_iast: bhāla evaṃ manda samāna hate pāre nā. manda pratihata kara utkṛṣṭa dvārā; phale, tomāra sāthe yāra śatra“tā āche, se haẏe yāve antaraṅga vandhura mata.
41:34.latin_ascii: bhala evam manda samana hate pare na. manda pratihata kara utkrsta dvara; phale, tomara sathe yara satra“ta ache, se haye yave antaranga vandhura mata.

41:35.latin_iast: e guṇera adhikārī karā haẏa śudhu tāderakei yārā dhairyaśīla, e guṇera adhikārī karā haẏa śudhu tāderake yārā mahā bhāgyavāna.
41:35.latin_ascii: e gunera adhikari kara haya sudhu taderakei yara dhairyasila, e gunera adhikari kara haya sudhu taderake yara maha bhagyavana.

41:36.latin_iast: yadi śaẏatānera kumantraṇā tomāke prarocita kare tave āllāhara āśraẏa prārthanā kara. tini sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
41:36.latin_ascii: yadi sayatanera kumantrana tomake prarocita kare tave allahara asraya prarthana kara. tini sarvasrota, sarvajna.

41:37.latin_iast: tā~ra nidarśanāvalīra madhye raẏeche rajanī o divasa, sūrya o candra. tomarā sūryake sijadā kara nā, candrakeo nā; sijadā kara āllāhake, yini egulo sṛṣṭi karechena, yadi tomarā tā~rai ivādata kara.
41:37.latin_ascii: ta~ra nidarsanavalira madhye rayeche rajani o divasa, surya o candra. tomara suryake sijada kara na, candrakeo na; sijada kara allahake, yini egulo srsti karechena, yadi tomara ta~rai ivadata kara.

41:38.latin_iast: tārā ahaṅkāra karaleo yārā tomāra pratipālakera sānnidhye raẏeche (phereśatāgaṇa) tārā to divasa o rajanīte tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare evaṃ tārā klāntio vodha kare nā.
41:38.latin_ascii: tara ahankara karaleo yara tomara pratipalakera sannidhye rayeche (pheresatagana) tara to divasa o rajanite ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare evam tara klantio vodha kare na.

41:39.latin_iast: āra tā~ra ekaṭi nidarśana ei ye, tumi bhūmike dekhate pāo śuṣka, ataḥpara āmi tāte vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karale tā āndolita o ṣphīta haẏa; yini bhūmike jīvita karena tinii mṛtera jīvana dānakārī. niścaẏai tini tomādera sarvaviṣaẏe sarvaśaktimāna.
41:39.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra ekati nidarsana ei ye, tumi bhumike dekhate pao suska, atahpara ami tate vrsti varsana karale ta andolita o sphita haya; yini bhumike jivita karena tinii mrtera jivana danakari. niscayai tini tomadera sarvavisaye sarvasaktimana.

41:40.latin_iast: yārā āmāra āẏātasamūhake vikṛta kare tārā āmāra agocare naẏa. śreṣṭha ke? ye vyakti jāhānnāme nikṣipta have se, nā ye kiẏāmatera dina nirāpada haẏe upasthita have se! tomādera yā icchā kara; tomarā yā kara tini tāra draṣṭā.
41:40.latin_ascii: yara amara ayatasamuhake vikrta kare tara amara agocare naya. srestha key ye vyakti jahanname niksipta have se, na ye kiyamatera dina nirapada haye upasthita have se! tomadera ya iccha kara; tomara ya kara tini tara drasta.

41:41.latin_iast: yārā tādera nikaṭa kuraāna āsāra para tā pratyākhyāna kare (tāderake kaṭhina śāsti deẏā have;) evaṃ eṭā avaśyai eka mahimāmaẏa grantha.
41:41.latin_ascii: yara tadera nikata kuraana asara para ta pratyakhyana kare (taderake kathina sasti deya have;) evam eta avasyai eka mahimamaya grantha.

41:42.latin_iast: kona mithyā ete anupraveśa karave nā- agra hateo naẏa, paścāt hateo naẏa. eṭā prajñāvāna, praśaṃsanīẏa āllāhara nikaṭa hate avatīrṇa.
41:42.latin_ascii: kona mithya ete anupravesa karave na- agra hateo naya, pascat hateo naya. eta prajnavana, prasamsaniya allahara nikata hate avatirna.

41:43.latin_iast: tomāra samvandhe to tāi valā haẏa yā valā hata tomāra pūrvavartī rāsūladera samparrke. tomāra pratipālaka avaśyai kṣamāśīla evaṃ yantraṇādāẏaka śāstidātā.
41:43.latin_ascii: tomara samvandhe to tai vala haya ya vala hata tomara purvavarti rasuladera samparrke. tomara pratipalaka avasyai ksamasila evam yantranadayaka sastidata.

41:44.latin_iast: āmi yadi anāravadera bhāṣāẏa kuraāna avatīrṇa karatāma tave tārā avaśyai valata : era āẏātagulo viśadabhāve varṇanā karā haẏani kena? kī āścarya ye, era bhāṣā anāravīẏa, athaca rāsūla āravīẏa. vala : mu’minadera janya eṭā patha-nirdeśa o vyādhira pratikāra; kintu yārā aviśvāsī tādera karṇe raẏeche vadhiratā evaṃ kuraāna have tādera janya andhatva. tārā emana ye, yena tāderake āhvāna karā haẏa vahu dūra hate.
41:44.latin_ascii: ami yadi anaravadera bhasaya kuraana avatirna karatama tave tara avasyai valata : era ayatagulo visadabhave varnana kara hayani kenay ki ascarya ye, era bhasa anaraviya, athaca rasula araviya. vala : mu’minadera janya eta patha-nirdesa o vyadhira pratikara; kintu yara avisvasi tadera karne rayeche vadhirata evam kuraana have tadera janya andhatva. tara emana ye, yena taderake ahvana kara haya vahu dura hate.

41:45.latin_iast: āmi mūsāke kitāva diẏechilāma, ataḥpara ete matabheda karā haẏechila. tomāra pratipālakera pakṣa hate pūrva siddhānta nā thākale tādera mīmāṃsā haẏe yeta. tārā avaśyai era samvandhe vibhrāntikara sandehe raẏeche.
41:45.latin_ascii: ami musake kitava diyechilama, atahpara ete matabheda kara hayechila. tomara pratipalakera paksa hate purva siddhanta na thakale tadera mimamsa haye yeta. tara avasyai era samvandhe vibhrantikara sandehe rayeche.

41:46.latin_iast: ye sat āmala kare se nijera kalyāṇera janyai tā kare evaṃ keu manda āmala karale tāra pratiphala sei bhoga karave. tomāra pratipālaka tā~ra vāndādera prati kona juluma karena nā.
41:46.latin_ascii: ye sat amala kare se nijera kalyanera janyai ta kare evam keu manda amala karale tara pratiphala sei bhoga karave. tomara pratipalaka ta~ra vandadera prati kona juluma karena na.

41:47.latin_iast: kiẏāmatera jñāna āllāhara dikei pratyāvartita, tā~ra ajñātasāre kona phala āvaraṇī hate vera haẏa nā, kona nārī garbhadhāraṇa kare nā evaṃ santānao prasava kare nā, yedina āllāha tāderake (muśarikaderake) ḍeke valavena : āmāra śarīkarā kothāẏa? takhana tārā valave : āmarā āpanāke vale diẏechi ye, e vyāpāre āmādera madhye keu sākṣī nei.
41:47.latin_ascii: kiyamatera jnana allahara dikei pratyavartita, ta~ra ajnatasare kona phala avarani hate vera haya na, kona nari garbhadharana kare na evam santanao prasava kare na, yedina allaha taderake (musarikaderake) deke valavena : amara sarikara kothayay takhana tara valave : amara apanake vale diyechi ye, e vyapare amadera madhye keu saksi nei.

41:48.latin_iast: pūrve tārā yāderake āhvāna karata tārā adṛśya haẏe yāve evaṃ aṃśīvādīrā upalavdhi karave ye, tādera muktira kona upāẏa nei.
41:48.latin_ascii: purve tara yaderake ahvana karata tara adrsya haye yave evam amsivadira upalavdhi karave ye, tadera muktira kona upaya nei.

41:49.latin_iast: mānuṣa kalyāṇa (dhana-sampada) prārthanāẏa kona klāntivodha kare nā; kintu yakhana tāke duḥkha-kaṣṭa sparśa kare takhana se atyanta nirāśa o hatāśa haẏe par̤e.
41:49.latin_ascii: manusa kalyana (dhana-sampada) prarthanaya kona klantivodha kare na; kintu yakhana take duhkha-kasta sparsa kare takhana se atyanta nirasa o hatasa haye pare.

41:50.latin_iast: duḥkha-kaṣṭa sparśa karāvāra para yadi tāke āmi anugraha āsvādana karāi takhana se valei thāke : eṭā āmāra prāpya evaṃ āmi mane kari nā ye, kiẏāmata saṃghaṭita have, āra āmi yadi āmāra pratipālakera nikaṭa pratyāvartita haio tave tā~ra nikaṭa to āmāra janya kalyāṇai thākave. āmi kāphiraderake tādera kṛtakarma samvandhe avaśyai avahita karava evaṃ tāderake āsvādāna karāva kaṭhora śāsti.
41:50.latin_ascii: duhkha-kasta sparsa karavara para yadi take ami anugraha asvadana karai takhana se valei thake : eta amara prapya evam ami mane kari na ye, kiyamata samghatita have, ara ami yadi amara pratipalakera nikata pratyavartita haio tave ta~ra nikata to amara janya kalyanai thakave. ami kaphiraderake tadera krtakarma samvandhe avasyai avahita karava evam taderake asvadana karava kathora sasti.

41:51.latin_iast: yakhana āmi mānuṣake neẏāmata pradāna kari takhana se ahaṅkāravaśata mukha phiriẏe neẏa o pāśa keṭe dūre sare yāẏa evaṃ tāke aniṣṭa sparśa karale se takhana dīrgha prārthanāẏa rata haẏe yāẏa.
41:51.latin_ascii: yakhana ami manusake neyamata pradana kari takhana se ahankaravasata mukha phiriye neya o pasa kete dure sare yaya evam take anista sparsa karale se takhana dirgha prarthanaya rata haye yaya.

41:52.latin_iast: vala : tomādera abhimata kī, yadi (ei kuraāna) āllāhara nikaṭa hate avatīrṇa haẏe thāke evaṃ tomarā eṭā pratyākhyāna kara tave ye vyakti ghora virodhitāẏa lipta āche, tāra apekṣā adhika pathabhraṣṭa ke?
41:52.latin_ascii: vala : tomadera abhimata ki, yadi (ei kuraana) allahara nikata hate avatirna haye thake evam tomara eta pratyakhyana kara tave ye vyakti ghora virodhitaya lipta ache, tara apeksa adhika pathabhrasta key

41:53.latin_iast: āmi tāderake atisattvara āmāra nidarśanāvalī dekhāva viśvajagate evaṃ tādera nijedera madhye; phale tādera nikaṭa suspaṣṭa haẏe uṭhave ye, eṭāi satya; eṭā ki yatheṣṭa naẏa ye, tomāra pratipālaka sarvaviṣaẏe avahita?
41:53.latin_ascii: ami taderake atisattvara amara nidarsanavali dekhava visvajagate evam tadera nijedera madhye; phale tadera nikata suspasta haye uthave ye, etai satya; eta ki yathesta naya ye, tomara pratipalaka sarvavisaye avahitay

41:54.latin_iast: jene rekha! tārā tādera pratipālakera sāthe sākṣāte sandihāna; jene rekha; savakichukei āllāha pariveṣṭana kare raẏechena.
41:54.latin_ascii: jene rekha! tara tadera pratipalakera sathe saksate sandihana; jene rekha; savakichukei allaha parivestana kare rayechena.

42:3.latin_iast: parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa āllāha ebhāvei tomāra prati evaṃ tomāra pūrvavartīdera prati oẏāhī karena.
42:3.latin_ascii: parakramasali, prajnamaya allaha ebhavei tomara prati evam tomara purvavartidera prati oyahi karena.

42:4.latin_iast: ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche savakichui tā~ra. tini sarveācca, mahāna.
42:4.latin_ascii: akasasamuha o prthivite ya kichu ache savakichui ta~ra. tini sarveacca, mahana.

42:5.latin_iast: ākāśamanḍalī tāra ūrdhvadeśa hate pheṭe (bheṅge) par̤āra upakrama haẏa evaṃ phereśatārā tādera pratipālakera praśaṃsāsaha pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare evaṃ viśvavāsīra janya kṣamā prārthanā kare. sāvadhāna! niścaẏai āllāha, tini ati kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
42:5.latin_ascii: akasamandali tara urdhvadesa hate phete (bhenge) parara upakrama haya evam pheresatara tadera pratipalakera prasamsasaha pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare evam visvavasira janya ksama prarthana kare. savadhana! niscayai allaha, tini ati ksamasila, parama dayalu.

42:6.latin_iast: yārā āllāhara parivarte aparake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa kare, āllāha tādera prati kaṭhora dṛṣṭi rākhena. tumi tādera tattvāvadhāẏaka nao.
42:6.latin_ascii: yara allahara parivarte aparake abhibhavakarupe grahana kare, allaha tadera prati kathora drsti rakhena. tumi tadera tattvavadhayaka nao.

42:7.latin_iast: ebhāve āmi tomāra prati kuraāna avatīrṇa karechi āravī bhāṣāẏa, yāte tumi satarka karate pāra makkā evaṃ tāra caturdikera janagaṇake evaṃ satarka karate pāra hāśara (kiẏāmata) divasa samparke yāte kona sandeha nei; (sedina) eka dala jānnāte praveśa karave evaṃ ekadala jāhānnāme praveśa karave.
42:7.latin_ascii: ebhave ami tomara prati kuraana avatirna karechi aravi bhasaya, yate tumi satarka karate para makka evam tara caturdikera janaganake evam satarka karate para hasara (kiyamata) divasa samparke yate kona sandeha nei; (sedina) eka dala jannate pravesa karave evam ekadala jahanname pravesa karave.

42:8.latin_iast: āllāha icchā karale mānuṣake ekai ummata karate pāratena; vastuta tini yāke icchā tāke svīẏa rahamatera adhikārī karena; jālimadera kona abhibhāvaka nei, kona sāhāyyakārīo nei.
42:8.latin_ascii: allaha iccha karale manusake ekai ummata karate paratena; vastuta tini yake iccha take sviya rahamatera adhikari karena; jalimadera kona abhibhavaka nei, kona sahayyakario nei.

42:9.latin_iast: tārā ki āllāhara parivarte aparake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa kareche? āllāhai to ekamātra abhibhāvaka evaṃ tini mṛtake jīvita karena. tini sarvaviṣaẏe sarvaśaktimāna.
42:9.latin_ascii: tara ki allahara parivarte aparake abhibhavakarupe grahana karechey allahai to ekamatra abhibhavaka evam tini mrtake jivita karena. tini sarvavisaye sarvasaktimana.

42:10.latin_iast: tomarā ye viṣaẏei matabheda kara nā kena, tāra phāẏasālā to āllāharai nikaṭa. (vala : ) tinii āllāha, āmāra pratipālaka. āmi bharasā kari tā~ra opara evaṃ āmi tā~rai abhimukhī hai.
42:10.latin_ascii: tomara ye visayei matabheda kara na kena, tara phayasala to allaharai nikata. (vala : ) tinii allaha, amara pratipalaka. ami bharasa kari ta~ra opara evam ami ta~rai abhimukhi hai.

42:11.latin_iast: tini ākāśamanḍalī o pṛthivīra sṛṛṣṭikartā, tini tomādera madhya hate tomādera jor̤ā sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ catuspada jantugulora madhya hate (tādera) jor̤ā; (sṛṣṭi karechena) ebhāve tini tāte tomādera vaṃśa vistāra karena; kona kichui tā~ra sadṛśa naẏa, tini sarvaśrotā, sarvadraṣṭā
42:11.latin_ascii: tini akasamandali o prthivira srrstikarta, tini tomadera madhya hate tomadera jora srsti karechena evam catuspada jantugulora madhya hate (tadera) jora; (srsti karechena) ebhave tini tate tomadera vamsa vistara karena; kona kichui ta~ra sadrsa naya, tini sarvasrota, sarvadrasta

42:12.latin_iast: ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra cāvisamūha tā~rai nikaṭa. tini yāra prati icchā tāra riyika vardhita karena o saṅkucita karena. niścaẏai tini sarvaviṣaẏe sarvajña.
42:12.latin_ascii: akasasamuha o prthivira cavisamuha ta~rai nikata. tini yara prati iccha tara riyika vardhita karena o sankucita karena. niscayai tini sarvavisaye sarvajna.

42:13.latin_iast: tini tomādera janya nirdhāraṇa karechena dīna yāra nirdeśa tini nūhake diẏechilena āra yā āmi oẏāhī karechilāma tomāke evaṃ yāra nirdeśa diẏechilāma ivarāhīma, mūsā o īsāke, ei vale ye, tomarā e dīnake (tāohīdake) pratiṣṭhā kara evaṃ tāte matabheda kara nā. tumi yāra dike āhvāna karacha tā muśarikadera nikaṭa kaṭhina mane haẏa. āllāha yāke icchā karena tā~ra pathe veche nena, āra tini tā~ra pathe tāke paricālita karena, ye tāra abhimukhī haẏa.
42:13.latin_ascii: tini tomadera janya nirdharana karechena dina yara nirdesa tini nuhake diyechilena ara ya ami oyahi karechilama tomake evam yara nirdesa diyechilama ivarahima, musa o isake, ei vale ye, tomara e dinake (taohidake) pratistha kara evam tate matabheda kara na. tumi yara dike ahvana karacha ta musarikadera nikata kathina mane haya. allaha yake iccha karena ta~ra pathe veche nena, ara tini ta~ra pathe take paricalita karena, ye tara abhimukhi haya.

42:14.latin_iast: tādera nikaṭa tāohīdera jñāna āsāra parao śudhumātra pārasparika vār̤āvār̤ira kāraṇe tārā nijedera madhye matabheda kareche; eka nirdhārita kāla paryanta avakāśa samparke tomāra pratipālakera pūrva siddhānta nā thākale tādera viṣaẏa phāẏasālā haẏe yeta. tādera para yārā kitāvera uttarādhikārī haẏeche tārā vibhrāntikara sandehe raẏeche.
42:14.latin_ascii: tadera nikata taohidera jnana asara parao sudhumatra parasparika varavarira karane tara nijedera madhye matabheda kareche; eka nirdharita kala paryanta avakasa samparke tomara pratipalakera purva siddhanta na thakale tadera visaya phayasala haye yeta. tadera para yara kitavera uttaradhikari hayeche tara vibhrantikara sandehe rayeche.

42:15.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi tā~ra dike (savāike) āhvāna kara evaṃ etei dṛr̤habhāve pratiṣṭita thāka yebhāve tumi ādiṣṭa haẏecha evaṃ tādera pravṛttira anusaraṇa kara nā. vala : āllāha ye kitāva avatīrṇa karechena āmi tāte viśvāsa kari evaṃ tomādera madhye inasāpha karāra janya ādiṣṭa haẏechi. āllāhai āmādera pratipālaka evaṃ tomādera pratipālaka. āmādera āmala āmādera evaṃ tomādera āmala tomādera; āmādera o tomādera mājhe kona jhagar̤ā-vivāda nei. āllāhai āmādera ekatrita karavena evaṃ pratyāvartana tā~rai nikaṭa.
42:15.latin_ascii: sutaram tumi ta~ra dike (savaike) ahvana kara evam etei drrhabhave pratistita thaka yebhave tumi adista hayecha evam tadera pravrttira anusarana kara na. vala : allaha ye kitava avatirna karechena ami tate visvasa kari evam tomadera madhye inasapha karara janya adista hayechi. allahai amadera pratipalaka evam tomadera pratipalaka. amadera amala amadera evam tomadera amala tomadera; amadera o tomadera majhe kona jhagara-vivada nei. allahai amadera ekatrita karavena evam pratyavartana ta~rai nikata.

42:16.latin_iast: yārā āllāhara ḍāke sār̤ā deẏāra para āllāha samparke vitarka kare tādera yukti-tarka tādera pratipālakera dṛṣṭite vātila evaṃ tādera prati raẏeche (āllāhara) krodha evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche kaṭhina śāsti.
42:16.latin_ascii: yara allahara dake sara deyara para allaha samparke vitarka kare tadera yukti-tarka tadera pratipalakera drstite vatila evam tadera prati rayeche (allahara) krodha evam tadera janya rayeche kathina sasti.

42:17.latin_iast: āllāha tinii avatīrṇa karechena satyasaha kitāva evaṃ dā~r̤ipāllā. tumi ki jāna, sambhavata kiẏāmata nikaṭavartī?
42:17.latin_ascii: allaha tinii avatirna karechena satyasaha kitava evam da~ripalla. tumi ki jana, sambhavata kiyamata nikatavartiy

42:18.latin_iast: yārā era prati viśvāsa kare nā tārāi eṭāra (kiẏāmata) janya tar̤ighar̤i kare. āra yārā viśvāsī tārā eke bhaẏa kare evaṃ jāne ye, eṭā satya. sāvadhāna! kiẏāmata samparke yārā tarka-vitarka kare tārā gabhīra vibhrāntite raẏeche.
42:18.latin_ascii: yara era prati visvasa kare na tarai etara (kiyamata) janya tarighari kare. ara yara visvasi tara eke bhaya kare evam jane ye, eta satya. savadhana! kiyamata samparke yara tarka-vitarka kare tara gabhira vibhrantite rayeche.

42:19.latin_iast: āllāha tā~ra vāndādera prati ati daẏālu; tini yāke icchā riyika dāna karena. tini pravala śaktiśālī, parākramaśālī.
42:19.latin_ascii: allaha ta~ra vandadera prati ati dayalu; tini yake iccha riyika dana karena. tini pravala saktisali, parakramasali.

42:20.latin_iast: ye ākhirāte phasala kāmanā kare tāra janya āmi tāra phasala vardhita kare dei evaṃ ye duniẏāra phasala kāmanā kare āmi tāke erai kichu dei, ākhirāte tāra janya kichui thākave nā.
42:20.latin_ascii: ye akhirate phasala kamana kare tara janya ami tara phasala vardhita kare dei evam ye duniyara phasala kamana kare ami take erai kichu dei, akhirate tara janya kichui thakave na.

42:21.latin_iast: tādera ki emana katakagulo śarīka āche yārā tādera janya dīnera emana vidhāna pravartana kareche yāra anumati āllāha denani? phāẏasālāra ghoṣaṇā nā thākale tādera viṣaẏe to siddhānta haẏei yeta. niścaẏai jālimadera janya raẏeche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
42:21.latin_ascii: tadera ki emana katakagulo sarika ache yara tadera janya dinera emana vidhana pravartana kareche yara anumati allaha denaniy phayasalara ghosana na thakale tadera visaye to siddhanta hayei yeta. niscayai jalimadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

42:22.latin_iast: tumi jālimaderake tādera kṛtakarmera janya bhīta-santrasta dekhave āra eṭāi patita have tādera opara. yārā īmāna āne o sat āmala kare tārā thākave jānnātera vāgānasamuhe. tārā yā cāive tādera pratipālakera nikaṭa tā-i pāve. eṭāi to mahā anugraha.
42:22.latin_ascii: tumi jalimaderake tadera krtakarmera janya bhita-santrasta dekhave ara etai patita have tadera opara. yara imana ane o sat amala kare tara thakave jannatera vaganasamuhe. tara ya caive tadera pratipalakera nikata ta-i pave. etai to maha anugraha.

42:23.latin_iast: āllāha ei susaṃvāda dena tā~ra sei vāndāderake yārā īmāna āne o sat āmala kare. vala : āmi era vinimaẏe tomādera nikaṭa hate ātmīẏatāra bhālavāsā vyatīta anya kona vinimaẏa cāi nā. ye uttama kāja kare āmi tāra janya ete kalyāṇa vardhita kari. niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla, guṇagrāhī.
42:23.latin_ascii: allaha ei susamvada dena ta~ra sei vandaderake yara imana ane o sat amala kare. vala : ami era vinimaye tomadera nikata hate atmiyatara bhalavasa vyatita anya kona vinimaya cai na. ye uttama kaja kare ami tara janya ete kalyana vardhita kari. niscayai allaha ksamasila, gunagrahi.

42:24.latin_iast: tārā ki vale ye, se (muhāmmāda) āllāha samparke mithyā vale, sutarāṃ yadi āllāha icchā karena tave tomāra hṛdaẏe mohara mere devena. āllāha mithyāke muche dena evaṃ nija vāṇī dvārā satyake pratiṣṭhita karena. niścaẏai antare yā āche se viṣaẏe tini saviśeṣa avahita.
42:24.latin_ascii: tara ki vale ye, se (muhammada) allaha samparke mithya vale, sutaram yadi allaha iccha karena tave tomara hrdaye mohara mere devena. allaha mithyake muche dena evam nija vani dvara satyake pratisthita karena. niscayai antare ya ache se visaye tini savisesa avahita.

42:25.latin_iast: tinii tā~ra vāndādera tāovā kavūla karena evaṃ pāpa mocana karena evaṃ tomarā yā kara tini tā jānena.
42:25.latin_ascii: tinii ta~ra vandadera taova kavula karena evam papa mocana karena evam tomara ya kara tini ta janena.

42:26.latin_iast: tini mu’mina o sat āmalakārīdera āhvāne sār̤ā dena evaṃ tādera prati tā~ra anugraha vardhita karena; kāphiradera janya raẏeche kaṭhina śāsti.
42:26.latin_ascii: tini mu’mina o sat amalakaridera ahvane sara dena evam tadera prati ta~ra anugraha vardhita karena; kaphiradera janya rayeche kathina sasti.

42:27.latin_iast: āllāha tā~ra (sakala) vāndādera ruyī vār̤iẏe dile tārā pṛthivīte avaśyai sīmālaṅghana karata; kintu tini ye parimāṇa deẏāra icchā karena tāi diẏe thākena. tini tā~ra vāndādera samparke samyaka jānena o dekhena.
42:27.latin_ascii: allaha ta~ra (sakala) vandadera ruyi variye dile tara prthivite avasyai simalanghana karata; kintu tini ye parimana deyara iccha karena tai diye thakena. tini ta~ra vandadera samparke samyaka janena o dekhena.

42:28.latin_iast: tārā yakhana nirāśa haẏe par̤e takhanai tini vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karena evaṃ tā~ra karuṇā vistāra karena. tinii to abhibhāvaka, sarvapraśaṃsita.
42:28.latin_ascii: tara yakhana nirasa haye pare takhanai tini vrsti varsana karena evam ta~ra karuna vistara karena. tinii to abhibhavaka, sarvaprasamsita.

42:29.latin_iast: tā~ra mahā nidarśanera antarbhukta hala ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra sṛṣṭi evaṃ etodubhaẏera madhye tini yesava jīvajantu char̤iẏe diẏechena segulo; tini yakhana icchā takhanai tāderake samaveta karate sakṣama.
42:29.latin_ascii: ta~ra maha nidarsanera antarbhukta hala akasasamuha o prthivira srsti evam etodubhayera madhye tini yesava jivajantu chariye diyechena segulo; tini yakhana iccha takhanai taderake samaveta karate saksama.

42:30.latin_iast: tomādera ye vipada-āpada ghaṭe tā to tomāderai hātera kāmāiẏera phala evaṃ tomādera aneka aparādha tini kṣamā kare dena.
42:30.latin_ascii: tomadera ye vipada-apada ghate ta to tomaderai hatera kamaiyera phala evam tomadera aneka aparadha tini ksama kare dena.

42:31.latin_iast: tomarā pṛthivīte (āllāhake) vyartha karate pārave nā evaṃ āllāha vyatīta tomādera kona abhibhāvaka nei.
42:31.latin_ascii: tomara prthivite (allahake) vyartha karate parave na evam allaha vyatita tomadera kona abhibhavaka nei.

42:32.latin_iast: tā~ra mahā nidarśanera antarbhukta hala parvata sadṛśa samudre calamāna nauyānasamūha.
42:32.latin_ascii: ta~ra maha nidarsanera antarbhukta hala parvata sadrsa samudre calamana nauyanasamuha.

42:33.latin_iast: tini icchā karale vāẏuke stavdha kare dite pārena; phale nauyānasamūha acala haẏe par̤ave samudra pṛṣṭhe. niścaẏai ete nidarśana raẏeche dhairyaśīla o kṛtajña vyaktira janya.
42:33.latin_ascii: tini iccha karale vayuke stavdha kare dite parena; phale nauyanasamuha acala haye parave samudra prsthe. niscayai ete nidarsana rayeche dhairyasila o krtajna vyaktira janya.

42:34.latin_iast: athavā tini tādera kṛtakarmera phale seguloke dhvaṃsa kare dite pārena evaṃ anekake tini kṣamāo karena.
42:34.latin_ascii: athava tini tadera krtakarmera phale seguloke dhvamsa kare dite parena evam anekake tini ksamao karena.

42:35.latin_iast: āra āmāra nidarśanāvalī samparke yārā tarke lipta haẏa tārā yena avahita thāke ye, tādera (āyāva hate) kona mukti nei.
42:35.latin_ascii: ara amara nidarsanavali samparke yara tarke lipta haya tara yena avahita thake ye, tadera (ayava hate) kona mukti nei.

42:36.latin_iast: vastutaḥ tomarā yā pradatta haẏecha tā pārthiva jīvanera bhoga; kintu āllāhara nikaṭa yā āche tā uttama o sthāẏī, (egulo) tādera janya yārā īmāna āne o tādera pratipālakera opara nirbhara kare.
42:36.latin_ascii: vastutah tomara ya pradatta hayecha ta parthiva jivanera bhoga; kintu allahara nikata ya ache ta uttama o sthayi, (egulo) tadera janya yara imana ane o tadera pratipalakera opara nirbhara kare.

42:37.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā kavīrā gonāhasamūha o aślīla karma hate ve~ce thāke evaṃ yakhana tārā krodhānvita haẏa takhana tārā kṣamā kare deẏa.
42:37.latin_ascii: evam yara kavira gonahasamuha o aslila karma hate ve~ce thake evam yakhana tara krodhanvita haya takhana tara ksama kare deya.

42:38.latin_iast: (egulo tādera janya) yārā tādera pratipālakera āhvāne sār̤ā deẏa, sālāta kāẏema kare, nijedera madhye parāmarśera mādhyame tādera karma sampādana kare evaṃ tāderake āmi ye riyika diẏechi tā hate vyaẏa kare.
42:38.latin_ascii: (egulo tadera janya) yara tadera pratipalakera ahvane sara deya, salata kayema kare, nijedera madhye paramarsera madhyame tadera karma sampadana kare evam taderake ami ye riyika diyechi ta hate vyaya kare.

42:39.latin_iast: evaṃ tādera janyao yārā atyācārita hale nije pratirakṣāra vyavasthā grahaṇa kare.
42:39.latin_ascii: evam tadera janyao yara atyacarita hale nije pratiraksara vyavastha grahana kare.

42:40.latin_iast: mandera pratiphala anurūpa manda evaṃ ye kṣamā kare deẏa o saṃśodhana kare neẏa, tāra vinimaẏa āllāhara nikaṭa āche. niścaẏai āllāha jālimaderake pachanda karena nā.
42:40.latin_ascii: mandera pratiphala anurupa manda evam ye ksama kare deya o samsodhana kare neya, tara vinimaya allahara nikata ache. niscayai allaha jalimaderake pachanda karena na.

42:41.latin_iast: tave atyācārita havāra para ye pratiśodha neẏa, tāra viruddhe doṣāropera kona suyoga nei.
42:41.latin_ascii: tave atyacarita havara para ye pratisodha neya, tara viruddhe dosaropera kona suyoga nei.

42:42.latin_iast: śudhu tādera viruddhe doṣāropa karā have yārā mānuṣera opara atyācāra kare evaṃ pṛthivīte anyāẏabhāve vidrohācaraṇa kare ver̤āẏa, tādera janya raẏeche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
42:42.latin_ascii: sudhu tadera viruddhe dosaropa kara have yara manusera opara atyacara kare evam prthivite anyayabhave vidrohacarana kare veraya, tadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

42:43.latin_iast: ye dhairyadhāraṇa kare evaṃ kṣamā kare deẏa tā have avaśyai dṛr̤ha sāhasikatāpūrṇa karmasamūhera antarbhukta.
42:43.latin_ascii: ye dhairyadharana kare evam ksama kare deya ta have avasyai drrha sahasikatapurna karmasamuhera antarbhukta.

42:44.latin_iast: āllāha yāke pathabhraṣṭa karena tāra janya tini vyatīta kona abhibhāvaka nei. jālimarā yakhana āyāva pratyakṣa karave takhana tumi tāderake valate śunaveḥ pratyāvartanera kona upāẏa āche ki?
42:44.latin_ascii: allaha yake pathabhrasta karena tara janya tini vyatita kona abhibhavaka nei. jalimara yakhana ayava pratyaksa karave takhana tumi taderake valate sunaveh pratyavartanera kona upaya ache kiy

42:45.latin_iast: tumi tāderake dekhate pāve ye, tāderake jāhānnāmera sāmane upasthita karā have, tārā apamāne avanata avasthāẏa gopane pārśva cokhe tākāve. mu’minarā (kiẏāmatera dina) valave : prakṛta kṣatigrasta tārāi yārā kiẏāmatera dina nijedera o tādera parijanera kṣati sādhana kareche. jene rākha ye, jālimarā bhoga karave sthāẏī āyāva.
42:45.latin_ascii: tumi taderake dekhate pave ye, taderake jahannamera samane upasthita kara have, tara apamane avanata avasthaya gopane parsva cokhe takave. mu’minara (kiyamatera dina) valave : prakrta ksatigrasta tarai yara kiyamatera dina nijedera o tadera parijanera ksati sadhana kareche. jene rakha ye, jalimara bhoga karave sthayi ayava.

42:46.latin_iast: āllāha vyatīta tāderake sāhāyya karāra janya tādera kona abhibhāvaka thākave nā evaṃ āllāha yāke pathabhraṣṭa karena tāra (ātmarakṣāra) kona patha nei.
42:46.latin_ascii: allaha vyatita taderake sahayya karara janya tadera kona abhibhavaka thakave na evam allaha yake pathabhrasta karena tara (atmaraksara) kona patha nei.

42:47.latin_iast: tomarā tomādera pratipālakera āhvāne sār̤ā dāo sei divasa āsāra pūrve yā āllāhara vidhāne apratiroddha, yedina tomādera kona āśraẏasthala thākave nā evaṃ tomādera janya tā pratirodhakārī keu thākave nā.
42:47.latin_ascii: tomara tomadera pratipalakera ahvane sara dao sei divasa asara purve ya allahara vidhane apratiroddha, yedina tomadera kona asrayasthala thakave na evam tomadera janya ta pratirodhakari keu thakave na.

42:48.latin_iast: tārā yadi mukha phiriẏe neẏa, tave tomāke to āmi tādera rakṣaka kare pāṭhāini. tomāra dāẏitva śudhu pracāra karā. āmi mānuṣake yakhana āmāra rahamata āsvādana karāi takhana se ete utphulla haẏa evaṃ yakhana tādera kṛtakarmera janya tādera vipada-āpada ghaṭe takhana mānuṣa haẏe yāẏa akṛtajña.
42:48.latin_ascii: tara yadi mukha phiriye neya, tave tomake to ami tadera raksaka kare pathaini. tomara dayitva sudhu pracara kara. ami manusake yakhana amara rahamata asvadana karai takhana se ete utphulla haya evam yakhana tadera krtakarmera janya tadera vipada-apada ghate takhana manusa haye yaya akrtajna.

42:49.latin_iast: ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra kartṛtva āllāharai. tini yā icchā tā-i sṛṣṭi karena. tini yāke icchā kanyā santāna dāna karena evaṃ yāke icchā putra santāna dāna karena.
42:49.latin_ascii: akasasamuha o prthivira kartrtva allaharai. tini ya iccha ta-i srsti karena. tini yake iccha kanya santana dana karena evam yake iccha putra santana dana karena.

42:50.latin_iast: athavā tāderake dāna karena putra o kanyā ubhaẏai evaṃ yāke icchā tāke vandhyā kare dena, tini sarvajña, sarvaśaktimāna.
42:50.latin_ascii: athava taderake dana karena putra o kanya ubhayai evam yake iccha take vandhya kare dena, tini sarvajna, sarvasaktimana.

42:51.latin_iast: mānuṣera janya asambhava ye, āllāha tāra sāthe kathā valavena oẏāhīra mādhyama chār̤ā, athavā pardāra antarāla chār̤ā athavā emana dūta preraṇa chār̤ā, ye dūta tā~ra anumatikrame tini yā cāna tā vyakta kare, tini samunnata, prajñāvāna.
42:51.latin_ascii: manusera janya asambhava ye, allaha tara sathe katha valavena oyahira madhyama chara, athava pardara antarala chara athava emana duta prerana chara, ye duta ta~ra anumatikrame tini ya cana ta vyakta kare, tini samunnata, prajnavana.

42:52.latin_iast: āra ebhāvei āmi tomāra prati oẏāhī karechi rūha (kuraāna) āmāra nirdeśe; tumi to jānate nā kitāva ki o īmāna ki pakṣāntare āmi eke karechi ālo yā dvārā āmi āmāra vāndādera madhye yāke icchā saṭhika pathanirdeśa kari; tumi avaśyai pradarśana kara sarala patha-
42:52.latin_ascii: ara ebhavei ami tomara prati oyahi karechi ruha (kuraana) amara nirdese; tumi to janate na kitava ki o imana ki paksantare ami eke karechi alo ya dvara ami amara vandadera madhye yake iccha sathika pathanirdesa kari; tumi avasyai pradarsana kara sarala patha-

42:53.latin_iast: ai āllāhara patha, yā~ra adhipatve raẏeche ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche. sāvadhāna! sakala viṣaẏa āllāharai dike pratyāvartana kare.
42:53.latin_ascii: ai allahara patha, ya~ra adhipatve rayeche akasasamuha o prthivite ya kichu ache. savadhana! sakala visaya allaharai dike pratyavartana kare.

43:3.latin_iast: niścaẏai āmi eṭā (avatīrṇa) karechi āravī bhāṣāẏa kuraānarūpe, yāte tomarā vujhate pāra.
43:3.latin_ascii: niscayai ami eta (avatirna) karechi aravi bhasaya kuraanarupe, yate tomara vujhate para.

43:4.latin_iast: niścaẏai eṭā raẏeche āmāra nikaṭa ummula kitāve (lāohe māhaphūje) eṭā uccamaryādāsampanna prajñāmaẏa.
43:4.latin_ascii: niscayai eta rayeche amara nikata ummula kitave (laohe mahaphuje) eta uccamaryadasampanna prajnamaya.

43:5.latin_iast: āmi ki tomādera hate e upadeśa vāṇī (kuraāna) sampūrṇarūpe pratyāhāra kare neva ei kāraṇe ye, tomarā sīmālaṅghanakārī sampradāẏa?
43:5.latin_ascii: ami ki tomadera hate e upadesa vani (kuraana) sampurnarupe pratyahara kare neva ei karane ye, tomara simalanghanakari sampradayay

43:6.latin_iast: pūrvavartīdera nikaṭa āmi kata nāvī preraṇa karechilāma!
43:6.latin_ascii: purvavartidera nikata ami kata navi prerana karechilama!

43:7.latin_iast: evaṃ yakhanai tādera nikaṭa kona nāvī eseche tārā tāke ṭhāṭṭā-vidrūpa kareche.
43:7.latin_ascii: evam yakhanai tadera nikata kona navi eseche tara take thatta-vidrupa kareche.

43:8.latin_iast: tādera madhye yārā edera apekṣā śaktite pravala chila tāderake āmi dhvaṃsa karechilāma; āra ebhāve cale āsache pūrvavartīdera anurūpa dṛṣṭānta.
43:8.latin_ascii: tadera madhye yara edera apeksa saktite pravala chila taderake ami dhvamsa karechilama; ara ebhave cale asache purvavartidera anurupa drstanta.

43:9.latin_iast: tumi yadi tāderake jijñāsā kara : ke ākāśasamūha o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi kareche? tārā avaśyai valave : egulo to sṛṣṭi karechena parākramaśālī, sarvajña āllāha.
43:9.latin_ascii: tumi yadi taderake jijnasa kara : ke akasasamuha o prthivi srsti karechey tara avasyai valave : egulo to srsti karechena parakramasali, sarvajna allaha.

43:10.latin_iast: yini tomādera janya pṛthivīke karechena vichānāsvarūpa evaṃ tāte karechena tomādera calāra patha yāte tomarā saṭhika patha pete pāra;
43:10.latin_ascii: yini tomadera janya prthivike karechena vichanasvarupa evam tate karechena tomadera calara patha yate tomara sathika patha pete para;

43:11.latin_iast: evaṃ yini ākāśa hate pāni varṣaṇa karena parimitabhāve evaṃ āmi tāra dvārā jīvita kari nirjīva bhū-khanḍake. ebhāvei tomāderake punarutthita karā have.
43:11.latin_ascii: evam yini akasa hate pani varsana karena parimitabhave evam ami tara dvara jivita kari nirjiva bhu-khandake. ebhavei tomaderake punarutthita kara have.

43:12.latin_iast: evaṃ yini jor̤āsamūhera pratyekake sṛṣṭi karena evaṃ yini tomādera janya sṛṣṭi karena emana nauyāna o catuṣpada jantu yāte tomarā ārohaṇa kara.
43:12.latin_ascii: evam yini jorasamuhera pratyekake srsti karena evam yini tomadera janya srsti karena emana nauyana o catuspada jantu yate tomara arohana kara.

43:13.latin_iast: yāte tomarā tādera pṛṣṭhe sthira haẏe vasate pāra, tārapara tomādera pratipālakera neẏāmata smaraṇa kara yakhana tomarā tāra opara sthira haẏe vasa; evaṃ vala : pavitra o mahāna tini, yini ederake āmādera vaśībhūta kare diẏechena, yadio āmarā samartha chilāma nā ederake vaśībhūta karate.
43:13.latin_ascii: yate tomara tadera prsthe sthira haye vasate para, tarapara tomadera pratipalakera neyamata smarana kara yakhana tomara tara opara sthira haye vasa; evam vala : pavitra o mahana tini, yini ederake amadera vasibhuta kare diyechena, yadio amara samartha chilama na ederake vasibhuta karate.

43:14.latin_iast: āmarā āmādera pratipālakera nikaṭa avaśyai pratyāvartana karava.
43:14.latin_ascii: amara amadera pratipalakera nikata avasyai pratyavartana karava.

43:15.latin_iast: tārā tā~ra (āllāhara) vāndādera madhya hate tā~ra aṃśa sāvyasta kareche. mānuṣa to spaṣṭai akṛtajña.
43:15.latin_ascii: tara ta~ra (allahara) vandadera madhya hate ta~ra amsa savyasta kareche. manusa to spastai akrtajna.

43:16.latin_iast: tini ki tā~ra sṛṣṭi hate nijera janya kanyā santāna grahaṇa karechena evaṃ tomādera janya caẏana karechena putra santāna?
43:16.latin_ascii: tini ki ta~ra srsti hate nijera janya kanya santana grahana karechena evam tomadera janya cayana karechena putra santanay

43:17.latin_iast: daẏāmaẏa āllāhara prati tārā yā āropa kare yakhana tādera kāuke sei (kanyā santānera) saṃvāda deẏā haẏa takhana tāra mukhamaṇḍala kālo haẏe yāẏa evaṃ se duḥkhe bhārākrānta haẏe par̤e.
43:17.latin_ascii: dayamaya allahara prati tara ya aropa kare yakhana tadera kauke sei (kanya santanera) samvada deya haya takhana tara mukhamandala kalo haye yaya evam se duhkhe bharakranta haye pare.

43:18.latin_iast: tārā ki āllāhara prati āropa kare emana santāna, ye alaṃkāre manḍita haẏe lālita-pālita haẏa evaṃ tarka-vitarkakāle spaṣṭa vaktavye asamarrtha?
43:18.latin_ascii: tara ki allahara prati aropa kare emana santana, ye alamkare mandita haye lalita-palita haya evam tarka-vitarkakale spasta vaktavye asamarrthay

43:19.latin_iast: tārā daẏāmaẏa āllāhara vāndā phereśatāderake nārī gaṇya kare; edera sṛṣṭira samaẏa ki tārā upasthita chila? acirei tādera sākṣya lipivaddha karā have evaṃ tāderake jijñāsā karā have.
43:19.latin_ascii: tara dayamaya allahara vanda pheresataderake nari ganya kare; edera srstira samaya ki tara upasthita chilay acirei tadera saksya lipivaddha kara have evam taderake jijnasa kara have.

43:20.latin_iast: tārā vale, daẏāmaẏa āllāha icchā karale āmarā edera pūjā karatāma nā. e viṣaẏe tādera kona jñāna nei; tārā to śudhu anumānabhittika kathā vale.
43:20.latin_ascii: tara vale, dayamaya allaha iccha karale amara edera puja karatama na. e visaye tadera kona jnana nei; tara to sudhu anumanabhittika katha vale.

43:21.latin_iast: āmi ki tāderake era (kuraānera) pūrve kona kitāva dāna karechi yā tārā dṛr̤habhāve dhāraṇa kare āche?
43:21.latin_ascii: ami ki taderake era (kuraanera) purve kona kitava dana karechi ya tara drrhabhave dharana kare achey

43:22.latin_iast: varaṃ tārā vale : āmarā āmādera pūrvapuruṣadera peẏechi eka matādarśera opara evaṃ āmarā tāderai padāṅka anusaraṇa kare hedāẏetaprāpta.
43:22.latin_ascii: varam tara vale : amara amadera purvapurusadera peyechi eka matadarsera opara evam amara taderai padanka anusarana kare hedayetaprapta.

43:23.latin_iast: anurūpabhāve tomāra pūrve kona janapade yakhanai kona satarkakārī preraṇa karechi takhana tāra samṛddhaśālī vyaktirā valata : āmarā to āmādera pūrvapuruṣaderake peẏechi eka matādarśera opara evaṃ āmarā tāderai padāṅka anusaraṇa karachi.
43:23.latin_ascii: anurupabhave tomara purve kona janapade yakhanai kona satarkakari prerana karechi takhana tara samrddhasali vyaktira valata : amara to amadera purvapurusaderake peyechi eka matadarsera opara evam amara taderai padanka anusarana karachi.

43:24.latin_iast: se (satarkakārī) vale : tomarā tomādera pūrvapuruṣaderake ye pathe peẏecha, āmi yadi tomādera janya tadapekṣā utkṛṣṭa patha-nirdeśa ānaẏana kari tavuo ki? (tomarā tādera padāṅka anusaraṇa karave?) tārā valala : tomarā yā niẏe prerita haẏecha āmarā tā pratyākhāna kari.
43:24.latin_ascii: se (satarkakari) vale : tomara tomadera purvapurusaderake ye pathe peyecha, ami yadi tomadera janya tadapeksa utkrsta patha-nirdesa anayana kari tavuo kiy (tomara tadera padanka anusarana karavey) tara valala : tomara ya niye prerita hayecha amara ta pratyakhana kari.

43:25.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tādera theke pratiśodha grahaṇa karalāma; dekha, mithyācārīdera pariṇāma kī haẏeche!
43:25.latin_ascii: atahpara ami tadera theke pratisodha grahana karalama; dekha, mithyacaridera parinama ki hayeche!

43:26.latin_iast: (smaraṇa kara) yakhana ivarāhīma tā~ra pitā evaṃ sampradāẏake valechila : tomarā yādera pūjā kara tādera sāthe āmāra kona samparka nei.
43:26.latin_ascii: (smarana kara) yakhana ivarahima ta~ra pita evam sampradayake valechila : tomara yadera puja kara tadera sathe amara kona samparka nei.

43:27.latin_iast: samparka āche śudhu tā~rai sāthe) yini āmāke sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ niścaẏai tini āmāke hedāẏeta devena.
43:27.latin_ascii: samparka ache sudhu ta~rai sathe) yini amake srsti karechena evam niscayai tini amake hedayeta devena.

43:28.latin_iast: ei (tāoẏāhīdera) ghoṣaṇāke se sthāẏī kālemārūpe rekhe geche tāra paravartīdera janya yāte tārā (rśika theke) pratyāvartana kare.
43:28.latin_ascii: ei (taoyahidera) ghosanake se sthayi kalemarupe rekhe geche tara paravartidera janya yate tara (rsika theke) pratyavartana kare.

43:29.latin_iast: varaṃ āmii tāderake evaṃ tādera pūrvapuruṣaderake suyoga diẏechilāma bhogera, avaśeṣe tādera nikaṭa satya o spaṣṭa (pracāraka) rāsūla āgamana karala.
43:29.latin_ascii: varam amii taderake evam tadera purvapurusaderake suyoga diyechilama bhogera, avasese tadera nikata satya o spasta (pracaraka) rasula agamana karala.

43:30.latin_iast: yakhana tādera nikaṭa satya āsala takhana tārā valalo- eṭā to jādu evaṃ āmarā avaśyai era prati asvīkṛti jñāpana kari.
43:30.latin_ascii: yakhana tadera nikata satya asala takhana tara valalo- eta to jadu evam amara avasyai era prati asvikrti jnapana kari.

43:31.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā vale : ei kuraāna kena avatīrṇa karā hala nā dui janapadera kona pratipattiśālī vyaktira opara?
43:31.latin_ascii: evam tara vale : ei kuraana kena avatirna kara hala na dui janapadera kona pratipattisali vyaktira oparay

43:32.latin_iast: tārā ki tomāra pratipālakera rahamata vanṭana kare? āmii tādera madhye jīvikā vanṭana kari tādera pārthiva jīvane evaṃ ekajanake aparera opara maryādāẏa unnīta kari yāte eke aparera dvārā khedamata lābha karate pāre evaṃ tārā yā jamā kare tā hate tomāra pratipālakera rahamata utkṛṣṭatara.
43:32.latin_ascii: tara ki tomara pratipalakera rahamata vantana karey amii tadera madhye jivika vantana kari tadera parthiva jivane evam ekajanake aparera opara maryadaya unnita kari yate eke aparera dvara khedamata labha karate pare evam tara ya jama kare ta hate tomara pratipalakera rahamata utkrstatara.

43:33.latin_iast: yadi (satya asvīkāre) mānuṣa eka ummate pariṇata haẏe par̤ave, ei āśaṅkā nā thākato daẏāmaẏa āllāhake yārā asvīkāra kare, tāderake āmi ditāma tādera gṛhera janya raupya nirmita chāda o si~r̤i yāte tārā ārohaṇa kare.
43:33.latin_ascii: yadi (satya asvikare) manusa eka ummate parinata haye parave, ei asanka na thakato dayamaya allahake yara asvikara kare, taderake ami ditama tadera grhera janya raupya nirmita chada o si~ri yate tara arohana kare.

43:34.latin_iast: evaṃ tādera gṛhera janya ditāma darajā, (viśrāmera janya) pālaṅka, yāte tārā helāna diẏe vasata.
43:34.latin_ascii: evam tadera grhera janya ditama daraja, (visramera janya) palanka, yate tara helana diye vasata.

43:35.latin_iast: evaṃ svarṇera nirmitao. āra e savai to śudhu pārthiva jīvanera bhoga sambhāra. muttākīdera janya tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa raẏeche ākherāta (era kalyāṇa).
43:35.latin_ascii: evam svarnera nirmitao. ara e savai to sudhu parthiva jivanera bhoga sambhara. muttakidera janya tomara pratipalakera nikata rayeche akherata (era kalyana).

43:36.latin_iast: ye vyakti daẏāmaẏa āllāhara smaraṇe vimukha haẏa āmi tāra janya niẏojita kari eka śaẏatāna, ataḥpara se haẏa tāra sahacara.
43:36.latin_ascii: ye vyakti dayamaya allahara smarane vimukha haya ami tara janya niyojita kari eka sayatana, atahpara se haya tara sahacara.

43:37.latin_iast: tārāi (śaẏatānarā) mānuṣake satpatha hate virata rākhe, athaca mānuṣa mane kare ye tārā hidāẏātera raopara paricālita hacche.
43:37.latin_ascii: tarai (sayatanara) manusake satpatha hate virata rakhe, athaca manusa mane kare ye tara hidayatera raopara paricalita hacche.

43:38.latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana se āmāra nikaṭa upasthita have, takhana se (śaẏatānake) valave : hāẏa! āmāra o tomāra madhye yadi pūrva o paścimera vyavadhāna thākata! katai nā nikṛṣṭa sahacara se!
43:38.latin_ascii: avasese yakhana se amara nikata upasthita have, takhana se (sayatanake) valave : haya! amara o tomara madhye yadi purva o pascimera vyavadhana thakata! katai na nikrsta sahacara se!

43:39.latin_iast: āra āja tomādera (ei anuutāpa) tomādera avaśyai kona upakāre āsave nā, yehetu tomarā juluma karechile. niścaẏai tomarā to savāi śāstite śarīka.
43:39.latin_ascii: ara aja tomadera (ei anuutapa) tomadera avasyai kona upakare asave na, yehetu tomara juluma karechile. niscayai tomara to savai sastite sarika.

43:40.latin_iast: tumi ki śunāte pārave vadhirake? athavā ye andha o ye vyakti spaṣṭa vibhrāntite āche, tāke ki pārave sat pathe paricālita karate?
43:40.latin_ascii: tumi ki sunate parave vadhirakey athava ye andha o ye vyakti spasta vibhrantite ache, take ki parave sat pathe paricalita karatey

43:41.latin_iast: āmi yadio tomāra mṛtyu ghaṭāi, tavu āmi tādera pratiśodha neva!
43:41.latin_ascii: ami yadio tomara mrtyu ghatai, tavu ami tadera pratisodha neva!

43:42.latin_iast: athavā āmi tāderake ye āyāvera oẏādā karechi yadi āmi tomāke tā pratyakṣa karāi, tave tādera opara āmāra avaśyai pūrṇa kṣamatā raẏeche.
43:42.latin_ascii: athava ami taderake ye ayavera oyada karechi yadi ami tomake ta pratyaksa karai, tave tadera opara amara avasyai purna ksamata rayeche.

43:43.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tomāra prati yā oẏāhī karā haẏeche tā dṛr̤habhāve avalamvana kara. niścaẏai tumi sarala pathei raẏecha.
43:43.latin_ascii: sutaram tomara prati ya oyahi kara hayeche ta drrhabhave avalamvana kara. niscayai tumi sarala pathei rayecha.

43:44.latin_iast: (kuraāna) tomāra o tomāra sampradāẏera janya upadeśa vāṇī; tomāderake avaśyai e viṣaẏe praśna karā have.
43:44.latin_ascii: (kuraana) tomara o tomara sampradayera janya upadesa vani; tomaderake avasyai e visaye prasna kara have.

43:45.latin_iast: tomāra pūrve āmi yesava rāsūla preraṇa karechilāma tāderake tumi jijñāsā kara, āmi ki daẏāmaẏa āllāha vyatīta kona mā‘vūda sthira karechilāma yādera ivādata karā yāẏa.
43:45.latin_ascii: tomara purve ami yesava rasula prerana karechilama taderake tumi jijnasa kara, ami ki dayamaya allaha vyatita kona ma‘vuda sthira karechilama yadera ivadata kara yaya.

43:46.latin_iast: avaśyai āmi mūsāke āmāra nidarśanāvalīsaha phiraā‘una o tāra pariṣadavargera nikaṭa pāṭhiẏechilāma; se valechila : āmi avaśyai jagatasamūhera pratipālakera prerita rāsūla.
43:46.latin_ascii: avasyai ami musake amara nidarsanavalisaha phiraa‘una o tara parisadavargera nikata pathiyechilama; se valechila : ami avasyai jagatasamuhera pratipalakera prerita rasula.

43:47.latin_iast: se (mūsā) tādera nikaṭa āmāra nidarśanāvalīsaha yāoẏā mātra tārā tāke niẏe hāsi-ṭhāṭṭā karate lāgala.
43:47.latin_ascii: se (musa) tadera nikata amara nidarsanavalisaha yaoya matra tara take niye hasi-thatta karate lagala.

43:48.latin_iast: āmi tāderake emana kona nidarśana dekhāini yā tāra anurūpa nidarrśana apekṣā śreṣṭha naẏa. āmi tāderake śāsti dilāma yāte tārā pratyāvartana kare.
43:48.latin_ascii: ami taderake emana kona nidarsana dekhaini ya tara anurupa nidarrsana apeksa srestha naya. ami taderake sasti dilama yate tara pratyavartana kare.

43:49.latin_iast: tārā valechila : he jādukara! tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa tumi āmādera janya tā prārthanā kara yā tini tomāra sāthe aṅgīkāra karechena; tāhale āmarā avaśyai hidāẏātaprāpta (hava).
43:49.latin_ascii: tara valechila : he jadukara! tomara pratipalakera nikata tumi amadera janya ta prarthana kara ya tini tomara sathe angikara karechena; tahale amara avasyai hidayataprapta (hava).

43:50.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana āmi tādera opara hate śāsti dūra karalāma takhanai tārā aṅgīkāra bhaṅga kare vasala.
43:50.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana ami tadera opara hate sasti dura karalama takhanai tara angikara bhanga kare vasala.

43:51.latin_iast: phiraā‘una tāra sampradāẏera madhye e vale ghoṣaṇā karala : he āmāra sampradāẏa! misarera vādaśāhī ki āmāra naẏa? ei nadīgulo āmāra pādadeśe pravāhita, tomarā ki dekha nā?
43:51.latin_ascii: phiraa‘una tara sampradayera madhye e vale ghosana karala : he amara sampradaya! misarera vadasahi ki amara nayay ei nadigulo amara padadese pravahita, tomara ki dekha nay

43:52.latin_iast: varaṃ āmi ki śreṣṭha nai ai vyakti hate ye hīna evaṃ spaṣṭa kathā valateo akṣama.
43:52.latin_ascii: varam ami ki srestha nai ai vyakti hate ye hina evam spasta katha valateo aksama.

43:53.latin_iast: (tini yadi nāvī hatena tave) mūsāke kena deẏā hala nā svarṇa vālā artha vā tāra sāthe kena āsala nā phereśatārā dalavaddhabhāve.
43:53.latin_ascii: (tini yadi navi hatena tave) musake kena deya hala na svarna vala artha va tara sathe kena asala na pheresatara dalavaddhabhave.

43:54.latin_iast: ebhāve se tāra sampradāẏake hatavuddhi kare dila, phale tārā tāra kathā mene nila. niścaẏai tārā chila eka avādhya sampradāẏa.
43:54.latin_ascii: ebhave se tara sampradayake hatavuddhi kare dila, phale tara tara katha mene nila. niscayai tara chila eka avadhya sampradaya.

43:55.latin_iast: yakhana tārā āmāke krodhānvita karala takhana āmi tāderake śāsti dilāma evaṃ nimajjita karalāma tādera savāike.
43:55.latin_ascii: yakhana tara amake krodhanvita karala takhana ami taderake sasti dilama evam nimajjita karalama tadera savaike.

43:56.latin_iast: tatpara paravartīdera janya āmi tāderake kare rākhalāma atīta itihāsa o paravartīdera janya dṛṣṭānta.
43:56.latin_ascii: tatpara paravartidera janya ami taderake kare rakhalama atita itihasa o paravartidera janya drstanta.

43:57.latin_iast: yakhana māraiẏāma putrera dṛṣṭānta upasthita karā haẏa, takhanai tomāra sampradāẏa (ānande) śoragola śuru kare deẏa.
43:57.latin_ascii: yakhana maraiyama putrera drstanta upasthita kara haya, takhanai tomara sampradaya (anande) soragola suru kare deya.

43:58.latin_iast: evaṃ vale : āmādera devatāgulo śreṣṭha, nā īsā? tārā śudhu jhagar̤ā-vivādera uddeśyei tomāke e kathā vale. vastuta tārā śudhu jhagar̤ā-vivādakārī sampradāẏa.
43:58.latin_ascii: evam vale : amadera devatagulo srestha, na isay tara sudhu jhagara-vivadera uddesyei tomake e katha vale. vastuta tara sudhu jhagara-vivadakari sampradaya.

43:59.latin_iast: se to chila śudhumātra āmāra eka vāndā, yāra prati āmi anugraha karechilāma evaṃ yāke karechilāma vānī isarāīlera janya dṛṣṭānta.
43:59.latin_ascii: se to chila sudhumatra amara eka vanda, yara prati ami anugraha karechilama evam yake karechilama vani isarailera janya drstanta.

43:60.latin_iast: āmi icchā karale tomādera parivarte phereśatā sṛṣṭi karate pāratāma, yārā pṛthivīte (paraspara) pratinidhitva karata.
43:60.latin_ascii: ami iccha karale tomadera parivarte pheresata srsti karate paratama, yara prthivite (paraspara) pratinidhitva karata.

43:61.latin_iast: niścaẏai se (īsā) kiẏāmatera nidarśana; sutarāṃ tomarā kiẏāmate sandeha poṣaṇa kara nā evaṃ āmāke anusaraṇa kara. eṭāi sarala patha.
43:61.latin_ascii: niscayai se (isa) kiyamatera nidarsana; sutaram tomara kiyamate sandeha posana kara na evam amake anusarana kara. etai sarala patha.

43:62.latin_iast: śaẏatāna yena tomāderake kichutei vādhā nā deẏa, se niścaẏai tomādera prakāśya śatra“.
43:62.latin_ascii: sayatana yena tomaderake kichutei vadha na deya, se niscayai tomadera prakasya satra“.

43:63.latin_iast: īsā yakhana spaṣṭa nidarśanāvalīsaha āsala, takhana se valala : āmi to tomādera nikaṭa esechi prajñāsaha evaṃ tomarā ye viṣaẏe matabheda karacha, tā spaṣṭa kare deẏāra janya. sutarāṃ tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara evaṃ āmāra anusaraṇa kara.
43:63.latin_ascii: isa yakhana spasta nidarsanavalisaha asala, takhana se valala : ami to tomadera nikata esechi prajnasaha evam tomara ye visaye matabheda karacha, ta spasta kare deyara janya. sutaram tomara allahake bhaya kara evam amara anusarana kara.

43:64.latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha āmāra pratipālaka evaṃ tomāderao pratipālaka, ataeva tā~ra ivādata kara; eṭāi sarala patha.
43:64.latin_ascii: niscayai allaha amara pratipalaka evam tomaderao pratipalaka, ataeva ta~ra ivadata kara; etai sarala patha.

43:65.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera katipaẏa dala matānaikya sṛṣṭi karala; sutarāṃ jālimadera janya durbheāga yantraṇādāẏaka dinera śāstira.
43:65.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera katipaya dala matanaikya srsti karala; sutaram jalimadera janya durbheaga yantranadayaka dinera sastira.

43:66.latin_iast: tārā ki tādera opara ākasmikabhāve kiẏāmata āsāra apekṣā karache. āra tārā tā upalavdhi karate pārave nā.
43:66.latin_ascii: tara ki tadera opara akasmikabhave kiyamata asara apeksa karache. ara tara ta upalavdhi karate parave na.

43:67.latin_iast: vandhurā sedina haẏe yāve eke aparera śatra“, tave muttākīrā vyatīta.
43:67.latin_ascii: vandhura sedina haye yave eke aparera satra“, tave muttakira vyatita.

43:68.latin_iast: he āmāra vāndāgaṇa! āja tomādera kona bhaẏa nei evaṃ tomarā cintitao have nā-
43:68.latin_ascii: he amara vandagana! aja tomadera kona bhaya nei evam tomara cintitao have na-

43:69.latin_iast: yārā āmāra āẏātasamūhe viśvāsa karechila evaṃ ātmasamarpaṇa karechila.
43:69.latin_ascii: yara amara ayatasamuhe visvasa karechila evam atmasamarpana karechila.

43:70.latin_iast: tomarā evaṃ tomādera sahadharmiṇīgaṇa jānnāte praveśa kara, tomāderake santuṣṭa karā have.
43:70.latin_ascii: tomara evam tomadera sahadharminigana jannate pravesa kara, tomaderake santusta kara have.

43:71.latin_iast: svarṇera vālā o pānapātra niẏe tāderake pradakṣiṇa karā have; mana yā cāẏa evaṃ naẏana yāte tṛpta haẏa sekhāne tāi raẏeche evaṃ sekhāne tomarā sthāẏī have.
43:71.latin_ascii: svarnera vala o panapatra niye taderake pradaksina kara have; mana ya caya evam nayana yate trpta haya sekhane tai rayeche evam sekhane tomara sthayi have.

43:72.latin_iast: eṭāi jānnāta, tomāderake yāra adhikārī karā haẏeche, tomādera karmera phalasvarūpa.
43:72.latin_ascii: etai jannata, tomaderake yara adhikari kara hayeche, tomadera karmera phalasvarupa.

43:73.latin_iast: sekhāne tomādera janya raẏeche pracura phala-mūla, tomarā tā hate āhāra karave.
43:73.latin_ascii: sekhane tomadera janya rayeche pracura phala-mula, tomara ta hate ahara karave.

43:74.latin_iast: niścaẏai aparādhīrā jāhānnāmera śāstite thākave cirakāla-
43:74.latin_ascii: niscayai aparadhira jahannamera sastite thakave cirakala-

43:75.latin_iast: tādera śāsti lāghava karā have nā evaṃ tārā hatāśa haẏe par̤ave.
43:75.latin_ascii: tadera sasti laghava kara have na evam tara hatasa haye parave.

43:76.latin_iast: āmi tādera prati juluma karini, varaṃ tārā nijerāi chila jālima.
43:76.latin_ascii: ami tadera prati juluma karini, varam tara nijerai chila jalima.

43:77.latin_iast: tārā citkāra kare valave : he mālika (jāhānnāmera adhikartā) tomāra pratipālaka āmāderake yena niḥśeṣa kare dena. se valave : tomarā to ekhānei avasthāna karave.
43:77.latin_ascii: tara citkara kare valave : he malika (jahannamera adhikarta) tomara pratipalaka amaderake yena nihsesa kare dena. se valave : tomara to ekhanei avasthana karave.

43:78.latin_iast: (āllāha valavena : ) avaśyai āmi tomādera nikaṭa satya pau~chiẏechilāma; kintu tomādera adhikāṃśai chila satyake apachandakārī.
43:78.latin_ascii: (allaha valavena : ) avasyai ami tomadera nikata satya pau~chiyechilama; kintu tomadera adhikamsai chila satyake apachandakari.

43:79.latin_iast: tārā ki kona vyāpāre cūr̤ānta siddhānta grahaṇa kareche? niścaẏai āmi cūr̤ānta siddhānta grahaṇakārī.
43:79.latin_ascii: tara ki kona vyapare curanta siddhanta grahana karechey niscayai ami curanta siddhanta grahanakari.

43:80.latin_iast: tārā ki mane kare ye, āmi tādera gopana viṣaẏa o tārā paraspare cupe cupe yā vale tāra khavara rākhi nā? avaśyai rākhi, āmāra phereśatārā to tādera nikaṭa theke savakichu lipivaddha kare.
43:80.latin_ascii: tara ki mane kare ye, ami tadera gopana visaya o tara paraspare cupe cupe ya vale tara khavara rakhi nay avasyai rakhi, amara pheresatara to tadera nikata theke savakichu lipivaddha kare.

43:81.latin_iast: vala : daẏāmaẏa āllāhara kona santāna thākale āmii hatāma tāra upāsakagaṇera sarvaprathama.
43:81.latin_ascii: vala : dayamaya allahara kona santana thakale amii hatama tara upasakaganera sarvaprathama.

43:82.latin_iast: tārā yā āropa kare tā hate tini pavitra o tini mahāna ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra adhipati evaṃ āraśera adhipati.
43:82.latin_ascii: tara ya aropa kare ta hate tini pavitra o tini mahana akasasamuha o prthivira adhipati evam arasera adhipati.

43:83.latin_iast: ataeva tāderake ye divasera kathā valā haẏeche tāra sammukhīna haoẏāra pūrva paryanta tāderake tarka-vitarka o krīr̤ā-kautuka karate dāo.
43:83.latin_ascii: ataeva taderake ye divasera katha vala hayeche tara sammukhina haoyara purva paryanta taderake tarka-vitarka o krira-kautuka karate dao.

43:84.latin_iast: tinii mā‘vūda ākāśasamūhe, tinii mā‘vūda pṛthivīte evaṃ tini prajñāvāna, sarvajña.
43:84.latin_ascii: tinii ma‘vuda akasasamuhe, tinii ma‘vuda prthivite evam tini prajnavana, sarvajna.

43:85.latin_iast: kata varakatamaẏa tini yini ākāśasamūha o pṛthivī evaṃ egulora madhyavartī savakichurai sārvabhauma adhipati! kiẏāmatera jñāna śudhu tā~rai āche evaṃ tā~rai nikaṭa tomarā pratyāvartita have.
43:85.latin_ascii: kata varakatamaya tini yini akasasamuha o prthivi evam egulora madhyavarti savakichurai sarvabhauma adhipati! kiyamatera jnana sudhu ta~rai ache evam ta~rai nikata tomara pratyavartita have.

43:86.latin_iast: āllāhara parivarte tārā yāderake ḍāke, śāphāẏātera kṣamatā tādera nei, tave yārā satya upalavdhi kare tāra sākṣya deẏa tārā vyatīta.
43:86.latin_ascii: allahara parivarte tara yaderake dake, saphayatera ksamata tadera nei, tave yara satya upalavdhi kare tara saksya deya tara vyatita.

43:87.latin_iast: yadi tumi tāderake jijñāsā kara ke tāderake sṛṣṭi kareche; tave tārā avaśyai valave : āllāha. tavuo tārā kothāẏa phire yācche.
43:87.latin_ascii: yadi tumi taderake jijnasa kara ke taderake srsti kareche; tave tara avasyai valave : allaha. tavuo tara kothaya phire yacche.

43:88.latin_iast: tā~ra (muhāmmādera) e ukti- he āmāra pratipālaka! ei sampradāẏa to īmāna ānave nā.
43:88.latin_ascii: ta~ra (muhammadera) e ukti- he amara pratipalaka! ei sampradaya to imana anave na.

43:89.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi tāderake upekṣā kara evaṃ vala sālāma; tārā śīghrai jānate pārave.
43:89.latin_ascii: sutaram tumi taderake upeksa kara evam vala salama; tara sighrai janate parave.

44:3.latin_iast: āmi eṭā avatīrṇa karechi eka varakatamaẏa rajanīte; niścaẏai āmi to satarkakārī.
44:3.latin_ascii: ami eta avatirna karechi eka varakatamaya rajanite; niscayai ami to satarkakari.

44:4.latin_iast: e rāte pratyeka prajñāpūrṇa viṣaẏe phaẏasālā haẏa.
44:4.latin_ascii: e rate pratyeka prajnapurna visaye phayasala haya.

44:5.latin_iast: āmāra ādeśakrame, āmii to rāsūla preraṇa kare thāki.
44:5.latin_ascii: amara adesakrame, amii to rasula prerana kare thaki.

44:6.latin_iast: tomāra pratipālakera anugrahasvarūpa; tini to sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
44:6.latin_ascii: tomara pratipalakera anugrahasvarupa; tini to sarvasrota, sarvajna.

44:7.latin_iast: yini ākāśasamūha, pṛthivī o ogulora madhyasthita savakichura pratipālaka- yadi tomarā niścita viśvāsī hao.
44:7.latin_ascii: yini akasasamuha, prthivi o ogulora madhyasthita savakichura pratipalaka- yadi tomara niscita visvasi hao.

44:8.latin_iast: tini vyatīta satyikāra kona mā‘vūda nei, tini jīvana dāna karena evaṃ tinii mṛtyu ghaṭāna; tini tomādera pratipālaka evaṃ tomādera pūrvapuruṣaderao pratipālaka.
44:8.latin_ascii: tini vyatita satyikara kona ma‘vuda nei, tini jivana dana karena evam tinii mrtyu ghatana; tini tomadera pratipalaka evam tomadera purvapurusaderao pratipalaka.

44:9.latin_iast: varaṃ tārā sandehera vaśavartī haẏe khela-tāmāśā karache.
44:9.latin_ascii: varam tara sandehera vasavarti haye khela-tamasa karache.

44:10.latin_iast: ataeva tumi apekṣā kara sei dinera yedina ākāśa spaṣṭa dhumrācchanna have,
44:10.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi apeksa kara sei dinera yedina akasa spasta dhumracchanna have,

44:11.latin_iast: evaṃ tā āvṛta kare phelave mānava jātike. eṭā have yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
44:11.latin_ascii: evam ta avrta kare phelave manava jatike. eta have yantranadayaka sasti.

44:12.latin_iast: (takhana tārā valave : ) he āmādera pratipālaka! āmāderake e śāsti hate mukti dina, āmarā īmāna ānava.
44:12.latin_ascii: (takhana tara valave : ) he amadera pratipalaka! amaderake e sasti hate mukti dina, amara imana anava.

44:13.latin_iast: (ekhana) tārā kemana kare āra upadeśa grahaṇa karave? (athaca) tādera nikaṭa esechilena spaṣṭa vyākhyā pradānakārī ekajana rāsūla;
44:13.latin_ascii: (ekhana) tara kemana kare ara upadesa grahana karavey (athaca) tadera nikata esechilena spasta vyakhya pradanakari ekajana rasula;

44:14.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā tāke pṛṣṭhapradarśana kare vale : se to śekhāno (vuli valache,) se to eka pāgala.
44:14.latin_ascii: atahpara tara take prsthapradarsana kare vale : se to sekhano (vuli valache,) se to eka pagala.

44:15.latin_iast: āmi (yadi) tomādera śāsti kichukālera janya sariẏe dei tomarā to punarāẏa tā-i karave.
44:15.latin_ascii: ami (yadi) tomadera sasti kichukalera janya sariye dei tomara to punaraya ta-i karave.

44:16.latin_iast: yedina āmi tomāderake pravalabhāve pākar̤āo karava, sedina āmi pratiśodha nevai.
44:16.latin_ascii: yedina ami tomaderake pravalabhave pakarao karava, sedina ami pratisodha nevai.
