(yuddha e janya vandha karā haẏeche) yāte āllāha yāke icchā tāke tā~ra rahamate śāmila kare nena. ai mu’minarā yadi (kāphiradera theke) ālādā avasthāẏa thākata tāhale (makkāẏa) yārā kāphira chila tāderake āmi avaśyai kaṭhina śāsti ditāma.
48:25.latin_ascii: tarai ai sakala loka, yara kuphari kareche o tomaderake masajidula harama theke phiriye rekheche evam kuravanira utaguloke nirdista jayagaya pau~chate deyani. yadi (makkaya) emana mu’mina nara o nari na thakata yadera katha tomara jana na ara ajnatavasata tomara taderake padadalita kare phelave evam ete tomadera opara tadera paksa theke kasta pau~chate (e asanka na thakale yuddha vandha kara hato na). (yuddha e janya vandha kara hayeche) yate allaha yake iccha take ta~ra rahamate samila kare nena. ai mu’minara yadi (kaphiradera theke) alada avasthaya thakata tahale (makkaya) yara kaphira chila taderake ami avasyai kathina sasti ditama.

48:26.latin_iast: yakhana kāphirarā tādera antare jāhelī vidveṣa poṣaṇa karala, takhana āllāha tā~ra rāsūla o mu’minadera opara praśānti nāyila karalena evaṃ tāderake tākaoẏāra kathāte sudṛr̤ha karalena. āra tārāi chila savaceẏe veśi hakadāra o upayukta. āllāha sava viṣaẏe parijñāta.
48:26.latin_ascii: yakhana kaphirara tadera antare jaheli vidvesa posana karala, takhana allaha ta~ra rasula o mu’minadera opara prasanti nayila karalena evam taderake takaoyara kathate sudrrha karalena. ara tarai chila savaceye vesi hakadara o upayukta. allaha sava visaye parijnata.

48:27.latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha tā~ra rāsūlera svapna vāstavāẏana karechena. inaśāāllāha tomarā niścaẏai māsajidula hārāme sampūrṇa nirāpade praveśa karave- (keu keu) māthā kāmāve, (keu keu) cula kāṭave evaṃ tomādera kona bhaẏa thākave nā. tini jānena tomarā yā jāna nā. āra tini tomāderake echār̤āo nikaṭavartī vijaẏa dāna karechena.
48:27.latin_ascii: niscayai allaha ta~ra rasulera svapna vastavayana karechena. inasaallaha tomara niscayai masajidula harame sampurna nirapade pravesa karave- (keu keu) matha kamave, (keu keu) cula katave evam tomadera kona bhaya thakave na. tini janena tomara ya jana na. ara tini tomaderake echarao nikatavarti vijaya dana karechena.

48:28.latin_iast: tinii tā~ra rāsūlake hidāẏāta o satya dīnasaha pāṭhiẏechena, yāte ai dīnake anya sava dīnera opara vijaẏī karena. āra āllāhai sākṣī hiseve yatheṣṭa.
48:28.latin_ascii: tinii ta~ra rasulake hidayata o satya dinasaha pathiyechena, yate ai dinake anya sava dinera opara vijayi karena. ara allahai saksi hiseve yathesta.

48:29.latin_iast: muhāmmāda āllāhara rāsūla. yārā tā~ra sāthe āche tārā kāphiradera opara kaṭhora evaṃ nijedera madhye sahānubhūtiśīla, komala. tumi tāderake dekhave rukū-sijadārata avasthāẏa āllāhara meheravānī o santuṣṭira tālāśe magna. tādera cehārāẏa sijadāra ālāmata raẏeche, tādera emana udāharaṇa tāorāte āche o tādera udāharaṇa āche inañjile. yemana ekaṭi śasyakṣeta, yāra cārāgāchagulo aṅkurita haẏa pare segulo śakta o puṣṭa haẏa, pare tā kāṇḍera opara dā~r̤āẏa dṛr̤habhāve yā cāṣīke ānandita kare. ebhāve āllāha mu’minadera samṛddhi dvārā kāphiradera antarjvālā sṛṣṭi karena. yārā īmāna āne o sat kāja kare āllāha tāderake kṣamā o mahā puraskārera pratiśruti diẏechena.
48:29.latin_ascii: muhammada allahara rasula. yara ta~ra sathe ache tara kaphiradera opara kathora evam nijedera madhye sahanubhutisila, komala. tumi taderake dekhave ruku-sijadarata avasthaya allahara meheravani o santustira talase magna. tadera ceharaya sijadara alamata rayeche, tadera emana udaharana taorate ache o tadera udaharana ache inanjile. yemana ekati sasyakseta, yara caragachagulo ankurita haya pare segulo sakta o pusta haya, pare ta kandera opara da~raya drrhabhave ya casike anandita kare. ebhave allaha mu’minadera samrddhi dvara kaphiradera antarjvala srsti karena. yara imana ane o sat kaja kare allaha taderake ksama o maha puraskarera pratisruti diyechena.

49:1.latin_iast: ohe yārā īmāna enecha! tomarā āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlera sāmane kona viṣaẏe agragāmī haẏo nā. āra āllāhake bhaẏa kara. niścaẏai āllāha sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
49:1.latin_ascii: ohe yara imana enecha! tomara allaha o ta~ra rasulera samane kona visaye agragami hayo na. ara allahake bhaya kara. niscayai allaha sarvasrota, sarvajna.

49:2.latin_iast: ohe yārā īmāna enecha! tomādera āoẏāja nāvīra āoẏājera ceẏe u~cu kara nā evaṃ tomarā nāvīra sāthe se rakama u~cu āoẏāje kathā valave nā, yebhāve eke aparera sāthe vale thāka. emana karale tomādera āmala varavāda haẏe yāve athaca tomarā ṭerao pāve nā.
49:2.latin_ascii: ohe yara imana enecha! tomadera aoyaja navira aoyajera ceye u~cu kara na evam tomara navira sathe se rakama u~cu aoyaje katha valave na, yebhave eke aparera sathe vale thaka. emana karale tomadera amala varavada haye yave athaca tomara terao pave na.

49:3.latin_iast: yārā āllāhara rāsūlera sāmane nijedera āoẏāja nicu kare tārā āsale aisava loka, āllāha tādera antarake parīkṣā karataḥ tākaoẏāra janya vāchāi kare niẏechena. tādera janya raẏeche māgaphirāta o mahā puraskāra.
49:3.latin_ascii: yara allahara rasulera samane nijedera aoyaja nicu kare tara asale aisava loka, allaha tadera antarake pariksa karatah takaoyara janya vachai kare niyechena. tadera janya rayeche magaphirata o maha puraskara.

49:4.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā tomāke hujarāra vāire theke uccasvare ḍāke tādera veśira bhāga lokai vujhe nā.
49:4.latin_ascii: niscayai yara tomake hujarara vaire theke uccasvare dake tadera vesira bhaga lokai vujhe na.

49:5.latin_iast: yadi tomāra vera haoẏā paryanta tārā dhairyadhāraṇa karata tāhale tāi tāderai janya bhālo hato. āllāha kṣamāśīla o parama daẏālu.
49:5.latin_ascii: yadi tomara vera haoya paryanta tara dhairyadharana karata tahale tai taderai janya bhalo hato. allaha ksamasila o parama dayalu.

49:6.latin_iast: ohe yārā īmāna enecha! yadi kona phāsika loka tomādera kāche kona khavara niẏe āse tāhale era satyatā yācāi kare nāo. tā nā hale ajñatāvaśata kona sampradāẏera kṣati kare phelave ataḥpara tomarā yā karecha sejanya lajjita hate have.
49:6.latin_ascii: ohe yara imana enecha! yadi kona phasika loka tomadera kache kona khavara niye ase tahale era satyata yacai kare nao. ta na hale ajnatavasata kona sampradayera ksati kare phelave atahpara tomara ya karecha sejanya lajjita hate have.

49:7.latin_iast: jene rekha! tomādera madhye āllāhara rāsūla vidyamāna āchena. yadi tini veśira bhāga viṣaẏe tomādera kathā mene nena tāhale tomarā nijerāi muśakile par̤e yāve; kintu āllāha tomādera nikaṭa īmānake priẏa kare diẏechena evaṃ tomādera janya hṛdaẏagrāhīo karechena āra kupharī, phāsekī o nāpharamānīra prati tomādera antare ghṛṇā sṛṣṭi karechena. erāi satpathaprāpta.
49:7.latin_ascii: jene rekha! tomadera madhye allahara rasula vidyamana achena. yadi tini vesira bhaga visaye tomadera katha mene nena tahale tomara nijerai musakile pare yave; kintu allaha tomadera nikata imanake priya kare diyechena evam tomadera janya hrdayagrahio karechena ara kuphari, phaseki o napharamanira prati tomadera antare ghrna srsti karechena. erai satpathaprapta.

49:8.latin_iast: esava āllāhara karuṇā o anugraha. āllāha sarvajña, prajñāvāna.
49:8.latin_ascii: esava allahara karuna o anugraha. allaha sarvajna, prajnavana.

49:9.latin_iast: yadi īmānadāradera dudala eke aparera sāthe lar̤āi kare tāhale tādera madhye āpoṣa kare dāo. erapara yadi ekadala apara dalera sāthe vār̤āvār̤i kare tādera viruddhe tomarā lar̤āi kara; yatakṣaṇa nā se dalaṭi āllāhara hukumera dike phire āse. ataḥpara yadi (se dalaṭi) phire āse tāhale ubhaẏa dalera madhye inasāphera sāthe phāẏasālā kare dāo. āra suvicāra kara; niścaẏai āllāha nyāẏa vicārakārīderake bhālovāsena.
49:9.latin_ascii: yadi imanadaradera dudala eke aparera sathe larai kare tahale tadera madhye aposa kare dao. erapara yadi ekadala apara dalera sathe varavari kare tadera viruddhe tomara larai kara; yataksana na se dalati allahara hukumera dike phire ase. atahpara yadi (se dalati) phire ase tahale ubhaya dalera madhye inasaphera sathe phayasala kare dao. ara suvicara kara; niscayai allaha nyaya vicarakariderake bhalovasena.

49:10.latin_iast: mu’minarā paraspara bhāi bhāi. tāi tomādera bhāidera madhye mīmāṃsā kare dāo. āllāhake bhaẏa kara. yāte tomarā anugrahaprāpta hao.
49:10.latin_ascii: mu’minara paraspara bhai bhai. tai tomadera bhaidera madhye mimamsa kare dao. allahake bhaya kara. yate tomara anugrahaprapta hao.

49:11.latin_iast: ohe yārā īmāna enecha! kona ekadala puruṣa yena apara puruṣake ṭhāṭṭā nā kare, hate pāre ye tārā edera ceẏe bhāla. kona mahilāo yena apara mahilāke ṭhāṭṭā nā kare, hate pāre tārā edera ceẏe bhāla. āra tomarā eke aparera prati doṣāropa kara nā evaṃ eke aparake khārāpa nāma niẏe ḍeko nā. īmāna ānāra para manda nāme ḍākā jaghanya kāja. yārā e dharaṇera ācaraṇa theke phire nā tārāi jālima.
49:11.latin_ascii: ohe yara imana enecha! kona ekadala purusa yena apara purusake thatta na kare, hate pare ye tara edera ceye bhala. kona mahilao yena apara mahilake thatta na kare, hate pare tara edera ceye bhala. ara tomara eke aparera prati dosaropa kara na evam eke aparake kharapa nama niye deko na. imana anara para manda name daka jaghanya kaja. yara e dharanera acarana theke phire na tarai jalima.

49:12.latin_iast: ohe yārā īmāna enecha! tomarā veśi veśi anumāna karā theke virata thāka. kāraṇa, kona kona anumāna gunāhera kāja. āra tomarā eke aparera gopana viṣaẏa tālāśa kara nā. tomādera madhye keu yena kāro gīvata nā kare. tomādera madhye ki emana keu āche ye, tāra mṛta bhāiẏera gośata khāoẏā pachanda kare? vastuta tomarā tā ghṛṇā kare thāka. āllāhake bhaẏa kara. niścaẏai āllāha var̤ai tāovā kavulakārī o parama daẏālu.
49:12.latin_ascii: ohe yara imana enecha! tomara vesi vesi anumana kara theke virata thaka. karana, kona kona anumana gunahera kaja. ara tomara eke aparera gopana visaya talasa kara na. tomadera madhye keu yena karo givata na kare. tomadera madhye ki emana keu ache ye, tara mrta bhaiyera gosata khaoya pachanda karey vastuta tomara ta ghrna kare thaka. allahake bhaya kara. niscayai allaha varai taova kavulakari o parama dayalu.

49:13.latin_iast: he mānuṣa! āmi tomāderake ekajana puruṣa o ekajana nārī theke sṛṣṭi karechi. tārapara tomāderake vibhinna jāti o gotre vibhakta karechi, yāte tomarā eke aparake cinate pāra. āllāhara kāche tomādera madhye se-vyakti adhika sammānita, yevyakti tomādera madhye veśi parahejagāra. niścaẏai āllāha sava kichu jānena, sava kichura khavara rākhena.
49:13.latin_ascii: he manusa! ami tomaderake ekajana purusa o ekajana nari theke srsti karechi. tarapara tomaderake vibhinna jati o gotre vibhakta karechi, yate tomara eke aparake cinate para. allahara kache tomadera madhye se-vyakti adhika sammanita, yevyakti tomadera madhye vesi parahejagara. niscayai allaha sava kichu janena, sava kichura khavara rakhena.

49:14.latin_iast: maruvāsīrā vale ye, āmarā īmāna enechi. tumi vala : tomarā īmāna ānani; varaṃ tomarā vala ye, āmarā isalāma grahaṇa karechi. tomādera antare ekhano īmāna praveśa kareni. tomarā yadi āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlera kathā mene cala, tāhale āllāha tomādera āmalera pratidāna kama devena nā. niścaẏai āllāha kṣamāśīla o parama daẏālu.
49:14.latin_ascii: maruvasira vale ye, amara imana enechi. tumi vala : tomara imana anani; varam tomara vala ye, amara isalama grahana karechi. tomadera antare ekhano imana pravesa kareni. tomara yadi allaha o ta~ra rasulera katha mene cala, tahale allaha tomadera amalera pratidana kama devena na. niscayai allaha ksamasila o parama dayalu.

49:15.latin_iast: tārāi prakṛta mu’mina, yārā āllāha o rāsūlera opara īmāna eneche, erapara ete kono sandeha kareni evaṃ āllāhara pathe tādera jāna o māla diẏe jihāda kareche. erāi satyavādī.
49:15.latin_ascii: tarai prakrta mu’mina, yara allaha o rasulera opara imana eneche, erapara ete kono sandeha kareni evam allahara pathe tadera jana o mala diye jihada kareche. erai satyavadi.

49:16.latin_iast: vala : tomarā ki tomādera dīnera khavara āllāhake jānāccha? athaca āllāha ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra pratiṭi jinisakei jānena. āra tini sava jinisa samparke jñānī.
49:16.latin_ascii: vala : tomara ki tomadera dinera khavara allahake janacchay athaca allaha akasasamuha o prthivira pratiti jinisakei janena. ara tini sava jinisa samparke jnani.

49:17.latin_iast: erā (mane kare ye) isalāma kavūla kare tomāra opara daẏā kareche. vala : tomādera isalāma dvārā āmāke dhanya karani. tomarā yadi īmānera dāvite satyavādī haẏe thāka tāhale āllāhai īmānera dike patha dekhiẏe tomāderake dhanya karechena.
49:17.latin_ascii: era (mane kare ye) isalama kavula kare tomara opara daya kareche. vala : tomadera isalama dvara amake dhanya karani. tomara yadi imanera davite satyavadi haye thaka tahale allahai imanera dike patha dekhiye tomaderake dhanya karechena.

49:18.latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra gāẏevera viṣaẏa samparke avagata āchena. āra tomarā yā kichu kara āllāha tā dekhena.
49:18.latin_ascii: niscayai allaha akasasamuha o prthivira gayevera visaya samparke avagata achena. ara tomara ya kichu kara allaha ta dekhena.

50:2.latin_iast: varaṃ kāphirarā tādera madhya hate ekajana satarkakārī āvirbhūta hate dekhe āścarya vodha kare o vale : eṭā to eka āścaryya vyāpāra.
50:2.latin_ascii: varam kaphirara tadera madhya hate ekajana satarkakari avirbhuta hate dekhe ascarya vodha kare o vale : eta to eka ascaryya vyapara.

50:3.latin_iast: āmarā yakhana mārā yāva evaṃ māṭi haẏe yāva (ataḥpara āmarā ki punarujjīvita hava?) se pratyāvartana to sudūra parāhata!
50:3.latin_ascii: amara yakhana mara yava evam mati haye yava (atahpara amara ki punarujjivita havay) se pratyavartana to sudura parahata!

50:4.latin_iast: āmi to jāni māṭi tādera kataṭuku kṣaẏa kare evaṃ āmāra nikaṭa āche saṃrakṣita ekaṭi kitāva.
50:4.latin_ascii: ami to jani mati tadera katatuku ksaya kare evam amara nikata ache samraksita ekati kitava.

50:5.latin_iast: varaṃ tādera nikaṭa satya āsāra para tārā tā pratyākhyāna kareche. phale tārā saṃśaẏe par̤e āche.
50:5.latin_ascii: varam tadera nikata satya asara para tara ta pratyakhyana kareche. phale tara samsaye pare ache.

50:6.latin_iast: tārā ki kakhanao tādera oparera ākāśera dike tākiẏe dekhe nā kibhāve āmi tā tairi karechi o tāke suśobhita karechi? āra tāte kona (sūkṣmatama) phāṭalao nei.
50:6.latin_ascii: tara ki kakhanao tadera oparera akasera dike takiye dekhe na kibhave ami ta tairi karechi o take susobhita karechiy ara tate kona (suksmatama) phatalao nei.

50:7.latin_iast: āmi bhūmike vistṛta karechi o tāte parvatamālā sthāpana karechi, āra tāte utpanna karechi cokha jur̤āno sarvaprakāra udbhida.
50:7.latin_ascii: ami bhumike vistrta karechi o tate parvatamala sthapana karechi, ara tate utpanna karechi cokha jurano sarvaprakara udbhida.

50:8.latin_iast: pratyeka āllāha abhimukhī vyaktira janya jñāna āharaṇa o upadeśa svarūpa.
50:8.latin_ascii: pratyeka allaha abhimukhi vyaktira janya jnana aharana o upadesa svarupa.

50:9.latin_iast: āmi ākāśa hate kalyāṇakara vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa kari evaṃ tadadvārā āmi sṛṣṭi kari udyāna o kṛṣijāta śasya.
50:9.latin_ascii: ami akasa hate kalyanakara vrsti varsana kari evam tadadvara ami srsti kari udyana o krsijata sasya.

50:10.latin_iast: o u~cu u~cu khejura vṛkṣa yāte āche guccha guccha khejura.
50:10.latin_ascii: o u~cu u~cu khejura vrksa yate ache guccha guccha khejura.

50:11.latin_iast: vāndādera jīvikāsvarūpa; āmi vṛṣṭi dvārā jīvita kari mṛta jaminake; ebhāvei punarutthāna ghaṭave.
50:11.latin_ascii: vandadera jivikasvarupa; ami vrsti dvara jivita kari mrta jaminake; ebhavei punarutthana ghatave.

50:12.latin_iast: tādera pūrveo satya pratyākhyāna karechila nūha-era sampradāẏa, rāsasera adhivāsī o sāmūda sampradāẏa,
50:12.latin_ascii: tadera purveo satya pratyakhyana karechila nuha-era sampradaya, rasasera adhivasi o samuda sampradaya,

50:14.latin_iast: evaṃ āẏakāra adhivāsī o tuvvā sampradāẏa; tārā sakale rāsūladerake mithyā pratipanna karechila, phale tādera opara āmāra śāsti kāryakara haẏeche.
50:14.latin_ascii: evam ayakara adhivasi o tuvva sampradaya; tara sakale rasuladerake mithya pratipanna karechila, phale tadera opara amara sasti karyakara hayeche.

50:15.latin_iast: āmi ki prathamavāra sṛṣṭi karei klānta haẏe par̤echi varaṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭi viṣaẏe tārā sandeha poṣaṇa kare!
50:15.latin_ascii: ami ki prathamavara srsti karei klanta haye parechi varam punah srsti visaye tara sandeha posana kare!

50:16.latin_iast: āmii mānuṣake sṛṣṭi karechi evaṃ tāra antara tāke ye kumantraṇā deẏa tā āmi jāni. āmi tāra ghār̤era śāha raga apekṣāo nikaṭatara.
50:16.latin_ascii: amii manusake srsti karechi evam tara antara take ye kumantrana deya ta ami jani. ami tara gharera saha raga apeksao nikatatara.

50:17.latin_iast: yakhana dui grahaṇakārī (phereśatā) tāra ḍāne o vāme vase tāra karma lipivaddha kare.
50:17.latin_ascii: yakhana dui grahanakari (pheresata) tara dane o vame vase tara karma lipivaddha kare.

50:18.latin_iast: mānuṣa ye kathāi uccāraṇa kare tā lipivaddha karāra janya tatpara praharī tāra nikaṭei raẏeche.
50:18.latin_ascii: manusa ye kathai uccarana kare ta lipivaddha karara janya tatpara prahari tara nikatei rayeche.

50:19.latin_iast: mṛtyu yantraṇā satyai āsavei; eṭā se jinisa yā hate tomarā dūre thākate cāite.
50:19.latin_ascii: mrtyu yantrana satyai asavei; eta se jinisa ya hate tomara dure thakate caite.

50:20.latin_iast: āra śiṃgāẏa phu~tkāra deẏā have, eṭāi (āyāvera dina) yāra bhaẏa tomāderake dekhāna hata.
50:20.latin_ascii: ara simgaya phu~tkara deya have, etai (ayavera dina) yara bhaya tomaderake dekhana hata.

50:21.latin_iast: sedina pratyeka vyakti upasthita have, tāra sāthe thākave cālaka o sākṣī.
50:21.latin_ascii: sedina pratyeka vyakti upasthita have, tara sathe thakave calaka o saksi.

50:22.latin_iast: tumi ei divasa samvandhe ajña chile, ekhana tomāra sammukha hate āvaraṇa sariẏechi, āja tomāra dṛṣṭi prakhara.
50:22.latin_ascii: tumi ei divasa samvandhe ajna chile, ekhana tomara sammukha hate avarana sariyechi, aja tomara drsti prakhara.

50:23.latin_iast: tāra saṅgī (phereśatā) valave : ei to āmāra nikaṭa (āmalanāmā) prastuta.
50:23.latin_ascii: tara sangi (pheresata) valave : ei to amara nikata (amalanama) prastuta.

50:24.latin_iast: (ādeśa karā have :) tomarā ubhaẏe nikṣepa kara jāhānnāme pratyeka avādhya kāphirake-
50:24.latin_ascii: (adesa kara have :) tomara ubhaye niksepa kara jahanname pratyeka avadhya kaphirake-

50:25.latin_iast: kalyāṇakara kāje pravala vādhā dānakārī, sīmālaṅghanakārī o sandeha poṣaṇakārīke.
50:25.latin_ascii: kalyanakara kaje pravala vadha danakari, simalanghanakari o sandeha posanakarike.

50:26.latin_iast: ye vyākti āllāhara sāthe anya mā‘vūda grahaṇa karata tāke kaṭhina śāstite nikṣepa kara.
50:26.latin_ascii: ye vyakti allahara sathe anya ma‘vuda grahana karata take kathina sastite niksepa kara.

50:27.latin_iast: tāra sahacara (śaẏatāna) valave : he āmādera pratipālaka! āmi tāke pathabhraṣṭa karini. varaṃ se nijei chila dūravartī bhraṣṭatāẏa .
50:27.latin_ascii: tara sahacara (sayatana) valave : he amadera pratipalaka! ami take pathabhrasta karini. varam se nijei chila duravarti bhrastataya .

50:28.latin_iast: (āllāha valavena :) āmāra sāmane jhagar̤ā kara nā; tomāderake āmi to pūrvei satarka karechi.
50:28.latin_ascii: (allaha valavena :) amara samane jhagara kara na; tomaderake ami to purvei satarka karechi.

50:29.latin_iast: āmāra kathāra rada-vadala haẏa nā evaṃ āmi āmāra vāndādera prati jālima nai.
50:29.latin_ascii: amara kathara rada-vadala haya na evam ami amara vandadera prati jalima nai.

50:30.latin_iast: sedina āmi jāhānnāmake jijñāsā karava : tumi pūrṇa haẏe gecha? (jāhānnāma) valave : āro āche ki?
50:30.latin_ascii: sedina ami jahannamake jijnasa karava : tumi purna haye gechay (jahannama) valave : aro ache kiy

50:31.latin_iast: āra jānnātake nikaṭastha karā have muttākīdera, kona dūrutva thākave nā.
50:31.latin_ascii: ara jannatake nikatastha kara have muttakidera, kona durutva thakave na.

50:32.latin_iast: erai pratiśruti tomāderake deẏā haẏechila, pratyeka āllāha abhimukhī, hiphāyatakārīra janya.
50:32.latin_ascii: erai pratisruti tomaderake deya hayechila, pratyeka allaha abhimukhi, hiphayatakarira janya.

50:33.latin_iast: yārā nā dekhe daẏāmaẏa āllāhake bhaẏa kare evaṃ anurakta hṛdaẏe upasthita haẏa-
50:33.latin_ascii: yara na dekhe dayamaya allahake bhaya kare evam anurakta hrdaye upasthita haya-

50:34.latin_iast: śāntipūrṇabhāve tomarā tāte praveśa kara; eṭā ananta jīvanera dina.
50:34.latin_ascii: santipurnabhave tomara tate pravesa kara; eta ananta jivanera dina.

50:35.latin_iast: sekhāne tārā yā kāmanā karave tāi pāve evaṃ āmāra nikaṭa raẏeche tārao adhika (āllāhara darśana).
50:35.latin_ascii: sekhane tara ya kamana karave tai pave evam amara nikata rayeche tarao adhika (allahara darsana).

50:36.latin_iast: āmi tādera pūrve āro vahu jāti dhvaṃsa karechi yārā chila tādera apekṣā śaktite pravala : tārā deśe-videśe bhramaṇa kare phirata; pare tādera janya kona pālānora sthāna chila ki?
50:36.latin_ascii: ami tadera purve aro vahu jati dhvamsa karechi yara chila tadera apeksa saktite pravala : tara dese-videse bhramana kare phirata; pare tadera janya kona palanora sthana chila kiy

50:37.latin_iast: niścaẏai ete upadeśa raẏeche tāra janya yāra āche antaḥkaraṇa athavā ye śravaṇa kare ekāgra citte.
50:37.latin_ascii: niscayai ete upadesa rayeche tara janya yara ache antahkarana athava ye sravana kare ekagra citte.

50:38.latin_iast: āmi ākāśasamūha o pṛthivī evaṃ egulora madhyasthita sava kichu sṛṣṭi karechi chaẏa dine; āmāke kona klānti sparśa kareni.
50:38.latin_ascii: ami akasasamuha o prthivi evam egulora madhyasthita sava kichu srsti karechi chaya dine; amake kona klanti sparsa kareni.

50:39.latin_iast: ataeva tārā yā vale tāte tumi dhairyadhāraṇa kara evaṃ tomāra pratipālakera praśaṃsā sahakāre pavitratā varṇanā kara sūryeādaẏa o sūryāstera pūrve.
50:39.latin_ascii: ataeva tara ya vale tate tumi dhairyadharana kara evam tomara pratipalakera prasamsa sahakare pavitrata varnana kara suryeadaya o suryastera purve.

50:40.latin_iast: tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara rātrira ekāṃśe evaṃ sālātera pareo.
50:40.latin_ascii: ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara ratrira ekamse evam salatera pareo.

50:41.latin_iast: āra śravaṇa kara, yedina eka āhvānakārī nikaṭavartī sthāna hate āhvāna karave,
50:41.latin_ascii: ara sravana kara, yedina eka ahvanakari nikatavarti sthana hate ahvana karave,

50:42.latin_iast: yedina (mānuṣa) avaśyai śravaṇa karave eka vikaṭa āoẏāja, sedinai (kavara hate mṛtadera) vera havāra dina.
50:42.latin_ascii: yedina (manusa) avasyai sravana karave eka vikata aoyaja, sedinai (kavara hate mrtadera) vera havara dina.

50:43.latin_iast: āmii jīvita kari, āra mṛtyuo ghaṭāi evaṃ sakalei phire āsave āmārai dike.
50:43.latin_ascii: amii jivita kari, ara mrtyuo ghatai evam sakalei phire asave amarai dike.

50:44.latin_iast: yedina pṛthivī vidīrṇa have evaṃ lokerā vera haẏe āsave drutavege, ei hāśara ghaṭāno āmāra janya sahaja.
50:44.latin_ascii: yedina prthivi vidirna have evam lokera vera haye asave drutavege, ei hasara ghatano amara janya sahaja.

50:45.latin_iast: tārā yā vale, tā āmi jāni, tumi tādera opara javaradastikārī nao; sutarāṃ ye śāstike bhaẏa kare tāke upadeśa dāna kara kuraānera sāhāyye.
50:45.latin_ascii: tara ya vale, ta ami jani, tumi tadera opara javaradastikari nao; sutaram ye sastike bhaya kare take upadesa dana kara kuraanera sahayye.

51:1.latin_iast: śapatha jhar̤o hāoẏāra, yā dhūlā-vālike ur̤iẏe niẏe yāẏa.
51:1.latin_ascii: sapatha jharo haoyara, ya dhula-valike uriye niye yaya.

51:3.latin_iast: śapatha dhīra gatite vaẏe yāoẏā nauyānera.
51:3.latin_ascii: sapatha dhira gatite vaye yaoya nauyanera.

51:8.latin_iast: niścaẏai tomarā paraspara virodhī kathāẏa lipta.
51:8.latin_ascii: niscayai tomara paraspara virodhi kathaya lipta.

51:9.latin_iast: ye vyakti satyabhraṣṭa se tā parityāga kare
51:9.latin_ascii: ye vyakti satyabhrasta se ta parityaga kare

51:12.latin_iast: tārā jijñāsā kare : karmaphala divasa kave have?
51:12.latin_ascii: tara jijnasa kare : karmaphala divasa kave havey

51:13.latin_iast: (vala) yedina tāderake śāsti deẏā have agnite,
51:13.latin_ascii: (vala) yedina taderake sasti deya have agnite,

51:14.latin_iast: (evaṃ valā have :) tomarā tomādera śāsti āsvādana kara, tomarā ei śāstira janya tar̤ighar̤i karachile.
51:14.latin_ascii: (evam vala have :) tomara tomadera sasti asvadana kara, tomara ei sastira janya tarighari karachile.

51:15.latin_iast: niścaẏai muttākīrā jānnāta o jharṇādhārāra madhye thākave.
51:15.latin_ascii: niscayai muttakira jannata o jharnadharara madhye thakave.

51:16.latin_iast: yā tādera pratipālaka tāderake pradāna karavena; tā tārā grahaṇa karave. niścaẏai tārā itopūrve satkarmaparāẏaṇa chila.
51:16.latin_ascii: ya tadera pratipalaka taderake pradana karavena; ta tara grahana karave. niscayai tara itopurve satkarmaparayana chila.

51:17.latin_iast: tārā rātrira sāmānya aṃśai nidrāvasthāẏa ativāhita karata.
51:17.latin_ascii: tara ratrira samanya amsai nidravasthaya ativahita karata.

51:18.latin_iast: rātrira śeṣa prahare tārā kṣamā prārthanā karata.
51:18.latin_ascii: ratrira sesa prahare tara ksama prarthana karata.

51:19.latin_iast: evaṃ tādera dhana-sampade raẏeche abhāvagrasta o vañcitera hakva.
51:19.latin_ascii: evam tadera dhana-sampade rayeche abhavagrasta o vancitera hakva.

51:20.latin_iast: pṛthivīte viśvāsīdera janya aneka nidarśana raẏeche.
51:20.latin_ascii: prthivite visvasidera janya aneka nidarsana rayeche.

51:21.latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera madhyeo! tomarā ki lakṣya kara nā?
51:21.latin_ascii: evam tomadera madhyeo! tomara ki laksya kara nay

51:22.latin_iast: ākāśe raẏeche tomādera riyika āra yā kichura pratiśra“ti tomādera deẏā haẏeche.
51:22.latin_ascii: akase rayeche tomadera riyika ara ya kichura pratisra“ti tomadera deya hayeche.

51:23.latin_iast: ākāśa o pṛthivīra pratipālakera śapatha! avaśyai ekathā tomādera kathopakathanera matai satya.
51:23.latin_ascii: akasa o prthivira pratipalakera sapatha! avasyai ekatha tomadera kathopakathanera matai satya.

51:24.latin_iast: (he nāvī!) tomāra nikaṭa ivarāhīmera sammānita mehamānadera khavara eseche ki?
51:24.latin_ascii: (he navi!) tomara nikata ivarahimera sammanita mehamanadera khavara eseche kiy

51:25.latin_iast: yakhana tārā tāra nikaṭa upasthita haẏe valala : (tomāra prati) sālāma. uttare se valala : (tomāderakeo) sālāma. erā to aparicita loka.
51:25.latin_ascii: yakhana tara tara nikata upasthita haye valala : (tomara prati) salama. uttare se valala : (tomaderakeo) salama. era to aparicita loka.

51:26.latin_iast: ataḥpara ivarāhīma tā~ra strīra nikaṭa gela evaṃ ekaṭi garura vāchura bhājā gośata niẏe āsala.
51:26.latin_ascii: atahpara ivarahima ta~ra strira nikata gela evam ekati garura vachura bhaja gosata niye asala.

51:27.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera sāmane rākhala evaṃ valala : tomārā khāccha nā kena?
51:27.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera samane rakhala evam valala : tomara khaccha na kenay

51:28.latin_iast: ete se tādera samparke mane mane bhaẏa pela. tārā valala : bhaẏa kara nā. ataḥpara tārā tāke eka jñānī putra santānera susaṃvāda dila.
51:28.latin_ascii: ete se tadera samparke mane mane bhaya pela. tara valala : bhaya kara na. atahpara tara take eka jnani putra santanera susamvada dila.

51:29.latin_iast: ekathā śune tāra strī cītkāra karate karate sāmane āsala evaṃ mukha cāpar̤iẏe valala : āmi to vṛddhā, vandhyā.
51:29.latin_ascii: ekatha sune tara stri citkara karate karate samane asala evam mukha capariye valala : ami to vrddha, vandhya.

51:30.latin_iast: tārā valala : tomāra pratipālaka erūpai valechena. tini prajñāvāna, sarvajña.
51:30.latin_ascii: tara valala : tomara pratipalaka erupai valechena. tini prajnavana, sarvajna.

51:31.latin_iast: se (ivarāhīma) valala : he preritarā (phereśatāgaṇa!) tomādera viśeṣa kāja kī?
51:31.latin_ascii: se (ivarahima) valala : he preritara (pheresatagana!) tomadera visesa kaja kiy

51:32.latin_iast: tā~rā valala : āmāderake eka aparādhī sampradāẏera (lūta jātira ) nikaṭa pāṭhāno haẏeche.
51:32.latin_ascii: ta~ra valala : amaderake eka aparadhi sampradayera (luta jatira ) nikata pathano hayeche.

51:33.latin_iast: tādera opara māṭira śakta kaṅkara nikṣepa karāra janya,
51:33.latin_ascii: tadera opara matira sakta kankara niksepa karara janya,

51:34.latin_iast: yā cihnita tomāra pratipālakera nikaṭa hate sīmā laṅghanakārīdera janya.
51:34.latin_ascii: ya cihnita tomara pratipalakera nikata hate sima langhanakaridera janya.

51:35.latin_iast: sekhāne yesava mu’mina chila āmi tādera vera kare nilāma.
51:35.latin_ascii: sekhane yesava mu’mina chila ami tadera vera kare nilama.

51:36.latin_iast: evaṃ sekhāne ekaṭi parivāra (lūta era parivāra) vyatīta kona musalima āmi pāini.
51:36.latin_ascii: evam sekhane ekati parivara (luta era parivara) vyatita kona musalima ami paini.

51:37.latin_iast: āmi tāte ekaṭi nidarśana rekhechi tādera janya, yārā yantraṇādāẏaka āyāvake bhaẏa kare.
51:37.latin_ascii: ami tate ekati nidarsana rekhechi tadera janya, yara yantranadayaka ayavake bhaya kare.

51:38.latin_iast: evaṃ (nidarśana rekhechi) mūsāra kāhinīteo, yakhana āmi tāke spaṣṭa pramāṇasaha phira‘āunera kāche pāṭhālāma.
51:38.latin_ascii: evam (nidarsana rekhechi) musara kahiniteo, yakhana ami take spasta pramanasaha phira‘aunera kache pathalama.

51:39.latin_iast: takhana se kṣamatāra dambhe mukha phiriẏe nila evaṃ valala (ei vyakti) eka jādukara athavā ummāda.
51:39.latin_ascii: takhana se ksamatara dambhe mukha phiriye nila evam valala (ei vyakti) eka jadukara athava ummada.

51:40.latin_iast: sutarāṃ āmi tāke o tāra sainyavāhinīke pākar̤āo karalāma evaṃ tāderake samudre nikṣepa karalāma evaṃ se tiraskṛta hala.
51:40.latin_ascii: sutaram ami take o tara sainyavahinike pakarao karalama evam taderake samudre niksepa karalama evam se tiraskrta hala.

51:41.latin_iast: evaṃ (nidarśana raẏeche) ‘ādera ghaṭanāẏa, yakhana āmi tādera viruddhe preraṇa karechilāma akalyāṇakara vātāsa.
51:41.latin_ascii: evam (nidarsana rayeche) ‘adera ghatanaya, yakhana ami tadera viruddhe prerana karechilama akalyanakara vatasa.

51:42.latin_iast: tā yā kichura opara diẏe vaẏe giẏechila tākei jarājīrṇa kare diẏechila.
51:42.latin_ascii: ta ya kichura opara diye vaye giyechila takei jarajirna kare diyechila.

51:43.latin_iast: āro (nidarśana raẏeche) sāmūdera kāhinīte, yakhana tāderake valā hala : tomarā bhoga kare nāo kichukāla.
51:43.latin_ascii: aro (nidarsana rayeche) samudera kahinite, yakhana taderake vala hala : tomara bhoga kare nao kichukala.

51:44.latin_iast: kintu tārā tādera pratipālakera ādeśa amānya karala; phale tādera prati vajrāghāta hala, ematāvasthāẏa tārā tā dekhachila.
51:44.latin_ascii: kintu tara tadera pratipalakera adesa amanya karala; phale tadera prati vajraghata hala, ematavasthaya tara ta dekhachila.

51:45.latin_iast: tārā uṭhe dā~r̤āte pārala nā, evaṃ tā pratirodha karateo pārala nā.
51:45.latin_ascii: tara uthe da~rate parala na, evam ta pratirodha karateo parala na.

51:46.latin_iast: (dhvaṃsa karechilāma) itopūrve nūha era sampradāẏake, tārā chila phāseka sampradāẏa.
51:46.latin_ascii: (dhvamsa karechilama) itopurve nuha era sampradayake, tara chila phaseka sampradaya.

51:47.latin_iast: āmi ākāśa nirmāṇa karechi āmāra (nija) hāte evaṃ āmi avaśyai mahā samprasāraṇakārī.
51:47.latin_ascii: ami akasa nirmana karechi amara (nija) hate evam ami avasyai maha samprasaranakari.

51:48.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi pṛthivīke vichiẏe diẏechi, sutarāṃ āmi kata sundarabhāve vichiẏechi.
51:48.latin_ascii: evam ami prthivike vichiye diyechi, sutaram ami kata sundarabhave vichiyechi.

51:49.latin_iast: āmi pratyeka vastu sṛṣṭi karechi jor̤āẏa-jor̤āẏa, yāte tomarā upadeśa grahaṇa kara.
51:49.latin_ascii: ami pratyeka vastu srsti karechi joraya-joraya, yate tomara upadesa grahana kara.

51:50.latin_iast: āllāhara dike dhāvita hao; āmi tomādera janya tā~ra pakṣa hate spaṣṭa satarkakārī.
51:50.latin_ascii: allahara dike dhavita hao; ami tomadera janya ta~ra paksa hate spasta satarkakari.

51:51.latin_iast: tomarā āllāhara sāthe anya kona mā‘vūda sthira kara nā; niścaẏai āmi tomādera janya tā~ra pakṣa hate spaṣṭa satarkakārī.
51:51.latin_ascii: tomara allahara sathe anya kona ma‘vuda sthira kara na; niscayai ami tomadera janya ta~ra paksa hate spasta satarkakari.

51:52.latin_iast: ebhāve, tādera pūrvavartīdera nikaṭa yakhanai kona rāsūla eseche, tārā valeche : tumi to eka jādukara athavā ummāda.
51:52.latin_ascii: ebhave, tadera purvavartidera nikata yakhanai kona rasula eseche, tara valeche : tumi to eka jadukara athava ummada.

51:53.latin_iast: tārā ki eke aparake ei upadeśai diẏe eseche? vastuta tārā eka sīmālaṅghanakārī sampradāẏa.
51:53.latin_ascii: tara ki eke aparake ei upadesai diye esechey vastuta tara eka simalanghanakari sampradaya.

51:54.latin_iast: ataeva, tumi tādera dika hate mukha phiriẏe nāo, ete tumi tiraskṛta have nā.
51:54.latin_ascii: ataeva, tumi tadera dika hate mukha phiriye nao, ete tumi tiraskrta have na.

51:55.latin_iast: evaṃ tumi upadeśa dāo, niścaẏai upadeśa mu’minadera upakāre āsave.
51:55.latin_ascii: evam tumi upadesa dao, niscayai upadesa mu’minadera upakare asave.

51:56.latin_iast: āmi sṛṣṭi karechi jina o mānuṣake ejanya ye, tārā ekamātra āmārai ivādata karave.
51:56.latin_ascii: ami srsti karechi jina o manusake ejanya ye, tara ekamatra amarai ivadata karave.

51:57.latin_iast: āmi tādera nikaṭa hate kona riyika cāi nā evaṃ eo cāi nā ye, tārā āmāke khāoẏāve.
51:57.latin_ascii: ami tadera nikata hate kona riyika cai na evam eo cai na ye, tara amake khaoyave.

51:58.latin_iast: niścaẏai āllāha riyika dānakārī evaṃ tini atyanta parākramaśālī.
51:58.latin_ascii: niscayai allaha riyika danakari evam tini atyanta parakramasali.

51:59.latin_iast: niścaẏai yālimadera prāpya tāi yā tādera (pūrvera dhvaṃsaprāpta saṅgīrā) bhoga kareche. sutarāṃ tārā yena āmāra nikaṭa tar̤ighar̤i nā kare.
51:59.latin_ascii: niscayai yalimadera prapya tai ya tadera (purvera dhvamsaprapta sangira) bhoga kareche. sutaram tara yena amara nikata tarighari na kare.

51:60.latin_iast: kāphiradera janya durbheāga tādera ai dinera, ye dinera bhaẏa tāderake dekhāno haẏeche.
51:60.latin_ascii: kaphiradera janya durbheaga tadera ai dinera, ye dinera bhaya taderake dekhano hayeche.

52:12.latin_iast: yārā khela-tāmāśācchale asāra kāryakalāpe lipta thāke.
52:12.latin_ascii: yara khela-tamasacchale asara karyakalape lipta thake.

52:13.latin_iast: sedina tāderake caramabhāve dhākkā mārate mārate niẏe yāoẏā have jāhānnāmera agnira dike,
52:13.latin_ascii: sedina taderake caramabhave dhakka marate marate niye yaoya have jahannamera agnira dike,

52:14.latin_iast: e-to sei agni yāke tomarā mithyā mane karate.
52:14.latin_ascii: e-to sei agni yake tomara mithya mane karate.

52:15.latin_iast: eṭā ki jādu? nāki tomarā dekhacha nā?
52:15.latin_ascii: eta ki jaduy naki tomara dekhacha nay

52:16.latin_iast: tomarā ete praveśa kara, ataḥpara tomarā dhairyadhāraṇa kara āra nā-i kara, ubhaẏai tomādera janya samāna. niścaẏai tomāderake tārai pratiphala deẏā hacche yā tomarā karate.
52:16.latin_ascii: tomara ete pravesa kara, atahpara tomara dhairyadharana kara ara na-i kara, ubhayai tomadera janya samana. niscayai tomaderake tarai pratiphala deya hacche ya tomara karate.

52:17.latin_iast: niścaẏai muttākīrā thākave jānnāte o bhoga-vilāse,
52:17.latin_ascii: niscayai muttakira thakave jannate o bhoga-vilase,

52:18.latin_iast: tādera pratipālaka tāderake yā devena tārā tā upabhoga karave evaṃ tini tāderake rakṣā karavena jāhānnāmera āyāva hate,
52:18.latin_ascii: tadera pratipalaka taderake ya devena tara ta upabhoga karave evam tini taderake raksa karavena jahannamera ayava hate,

52:19.latin_iast: tomarā tṛptira sāthe pānāhāra kara, tomarā yā karate tāra pratidānasvarūpa.
52:19.latin_ascii: tomara trptira sathe panahara kara, tomara ya karate tara pratidanasvarupa.

52:20.latin_iast: tārā śreṇīvaddhabhāve sajjita āsane helāna diẏe vasave; āmi tādera viẏe deva sunaẏanā (var̤a var̤a cakṣuviśiṣṭa) hūrera saṅge.
52:20.latin_ascii: tara srenivaddhabhave sajjita asane helana diye vasave; ami tadera viye deva sunayana (vara vara caksuvisista) hurera sange.

52:21.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā īmāna āne āra tādera santāna-santatio īmāne tādera anusārī haẏa, tādera sāthe tādera santāna-santatike milita karava evaṃ āmi tādera karmaphalera ghāṭati karava nā, pratyeka vyakti nija kṛtakarmera janya dāẏī.
52:21.latin_ascii: evam yara imana ane ara tadera santana-santatio imane tadera anusari haya, tadera sathe tadera santana-santatike milita karava evam ami tadera karmaphalera ghatati karava na, pratyeka vyakti nija krtakarmera janya dayi.

52:22.latin_iast: āmi tāderake aneka aneka phala-mūla evaṃ gośata deva yā tārā pachanda kare.
52:22.latin_ascii: ami taderake aneka aneka phala-mula evam gosata deva ya tara pachanda kare.

52:23.latin_iast: sekhāne tārā eke aparera nikaṭa hate grahaṇa karave emana pāna-pātra, yāra phale keu anarthaka kathā valave nā evaṃ pāpa karmeo lipta have nā.
52:23.latin_ascii: sekhane tara eke aparera nikata hate grahana karave emana pana-patra, yara phale keu anarthaka katha valave na evam papa karmeo lipta have na.

52:24.latin_iast: tādera sevāra janya niẏojita thākave kiśorerā yena tārā surakṣita muktā sadṛśa.
52:24.latin_ascii: tadera sevara janya niyojita thakave kisorera yena tara suraksita mukta sadrsa.

52:25.latin_iast: tārā eke aparera dike phire jijñāsā karave,
52:25.latin_ascii: tara eke aparera dike phire jijnasa karave,

52:26.latin_iast: evaṃ valave : pūrve āmarā āmādera parivāra-parijanera madhye bhaẏe bhīta chilāma.
52:26.latin_ascii: evam valave : purve amara amadera parivara-parijanera madhye bhaye bhita chilama.

52:27.latin_iast: ataḥpara āllāha āmādera prati anugraha karechena evaṃ dagdhakārī āyāva hate āmāderake rakṣā karechena.
52:27.latin_ascii: atahpara allaha amadera prati anugraha karechena evam dagdhakari ayava hate amaderake raksa karechena.

52:28.latin_iast: niścaẏai āmarā era āge āllāhake ḍākatāma, tini to var̤ai upakārakārī, parama daẏālu.
52:28.latin_ascii: niscayai amara era age allahake dakatama, tini to varai upakarakari, parama dayalu.

52:29.latin_iast: ataeva tumi upadeśa dāo, tomāra prabhura anugrahe tumi gaṇaka nao, unmādao nao.
52:29.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi upadesa dao, tomara prabhura anugrahe tumi ganaka nao, unmadao nao.

52:30.latin_iast: tārā ki valate cāẏa ye, se ekajana kavi? āmarā tāra janya kālera viparyaẏera (mṛtyura) apekṣā karachi.
52:30.latin_ascii: tara ki valate caya ye, se ekajana kaviy amara tara janya kalera viparyayera (mrtyura) apeksa karachi.

52:31.latin_iast: vala : tomarā apekṣā kara, avaśya āmio tomādera sāthe apekṣākārīdera antarbhukta.
52:31.latin_ascii: vala : tomara apeksa kara, avasya amio tomadera sathe apeksakaridera antarbhukta.

52:32.latin_iast: tave ki tādera viveka-vuddhi tāderake e viṣaẏe prarocita kare, nā tārā eka sīmālaṅghanakārī sampradāẏa?
52:32.latin_ascii: tave ki tadera viveka-vuddhi taderake e visaye prarocita kare, na tara eka simalanghanakari sampradayay

52:33.latin_iast: tārā ki vale : e kuraāna tā~ra nijera vānāno? varaṃ tārā viśvāsa karate cāẏa nā.
52:33.latin_ascii: tara ki vale : e kuraana ta~ra nijera vananoy varam tara visvasa karate caya na.

52:34.latin_iast: tārā yadi satyavādī haẏa tave tārā yena era sadṛśa vānāno kichu upasthita kare.
52:34.latin_ascii: tara yadi satyavadi haya tave tara yena era sadrsa vanano kichu upasthita kare.

52:35.latin_iast: tārā ki kona kichu vyatītai sṛṣṭa haẏeche, nā tārā nijerāi (nijedera) sraṣṭā?
52:35.latin_ascii: tara ki kona kichu vyatitai srsta hayeche, na tara nijerai (nijedera) srastay

52:36.latin_iast: nā ki tārā ākāśasamūha o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi kareche? varaṃ tārā to viśvāsa kare nā.
52:36.latin_ascii: na ki tara akasasamuha o prthivi srsti karechey varam tara to visvasa kare na.

52:37.latin_iast: tādera nikaṭa ki tomāra pratipālakera bhāṇḍāra raẏeche, nā tārā e samudaẏera niẏantraka?
52:37.latin_ascii: tadera nikata ki tomara pratipalakera bhandara rayeche, na tara e samudayera niyantrakay

52:38.latin_iast: nā ki tādera kona si~r̤i āche yāte ārohaṇa kare tārā śravaṇa kare? tave tādera sei śrotā suspaṣṭa pramāṇa upasthita karuka!
52:38.latin_ascii: na ki tadera kona si~ri ache yate arohana kare tara sravana karey tave tadera sei srota suspasta pramana upasthita karuka!

52:39.latin_iast: tave ki tā~ra janya kanyā-santāna evaṃ putra-santāna tomādera janya?
52:39.latin_ascii: tave ki ta~ra janya kanya-santana evam putra-santana tomadera janyay

52:40.latin_iast: tave ki tumi tādera nikaṭa pāriśramika cāccha, ye tārā eke ekaṭi kaṭhina vojhā mane kare?
52:40.latin_ascii: tave ki tumi tadera nikata parisramika caccha, ye tara eke ekati kathina vojha mane karey

52:41.latin_iast: nā ki adṛśya viṣaẏe tādera kona jñāna āche ye, tārā tā likhache?
52:41.latin_ascii: na ki adrsya visaye tadera kona jnana ache ye, tara ta likhachey

52:42.latin_iast: athavā tārā ki kona ṣar̤ayantra karate cāẏa? kāphirarāi have ṣar̤ayantrera śikāra.
52:42.latin_ascii: athava tara ki kona sarayantra karate cayay kaphirarai have sarayantrera sikara.

52:43.latin_iast: nā ki āllāha vyatīta tādera anya kona (satya) mā‘vūda āche? tārā yāke śarīka sthira kare āllāha tā hate pavitra.
52:43.latin_ascii: na ki allaha vyatita tadera anya kona (satya) ma‘vuda achey tara yake sarika sthira kare allaha ta hate pavitra.

52:44.latin_iast: yadi tārā ākāśera kona khanḍa bheṅge par̤ate dekhe takhana vale : eṭā to eka puñjībhūta megha.
52:44.latin_ascii: yadi tara akasera kona khanda bhenge parate dekhe takhana vale : eta to eka punjibhuta megha.

52:45.latin_iast: tāderake upekṣā kare cala sedina paryanta, yedina tārā dhvaṃsera sammukhīna have.
52:45.latin_ascii: taderake upeksa kare cala sedina paryanta, yedina tara dhvamsera sammukhina have.

52:46.latin_iast: sedina tādera ṣar̤ayantra kona kāje āsave nā evaṃ tārā sāhāyyaprāptao have nā.
52:46.latin_ascii: sedina tadera sarayantra kona kaje asave na evam tara sahayyapraptao have na.

52:47.latin_iast: niścaẏai jālimadera janya e chār̤ā āro śāsti raẏeche; kintu tādera adhikāṃśai tā jāne nā.
52:47.latin_ascii: niscayai jalimadera janya e chara aro sasti rayeche; kintu tadera adhikamsai ta jane na.

52:48.latin_iast: tumi tomāra pratipālakera nirdeśera apekṣāẏa dhairyadhāraṇa kara; tumi āmāra cokhera sāmanei raẏecho. tumi tomāra pratipālakera sapraśaṃsa pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara yakhana tumi śayyā tyāga kara.
52:48.latin_ascii: tumi tomara pratipalakera nirdesera apeksaya dhairyadharana kara; tumi amara cokhera samanei rayecho. tumi tomara pratipalakera saprasamsa pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara yakhana tumi sayya tyaga kara.

52:49.latin_iast: evaṃ tā~ra pavitratā ghoṣaṇā kara rātrikāle o tārakāra asta gamaṇera para.
52:49.latin_ascii: evam ta~ra pavitrata ghosana kara ratrikale o tarakara asta gamanera para.

53:1.latin_iast: śapatha tārakārājira, yakhana tā astamita haẏa,
53:1.latin_ascii: sapatha tarakarajira, yakhana ta astamita haya,

53:2.latin_iast: tomādera saṅgī pathabhraṣṭa naẏa, vibhrāntao naẏa,
53:2.latin_ascii: tomadera sangi pathabhrasta naya, vibhrantao naya,

53:3.latin_iast: evaṃ se pravṛtti hateo kona kathā vale nā.
53:3.latin_ascii: evam se pravrtti hateo kona katha vale na.

53:4.latin_iast: eṭā to eka oẏāhī, yā tā~ra prati pratyādeśa karā haẏa.
53:4.latin_ascii: eta to eka oyahi, ya ta~ra prati pratyadesa kara haya.

53:5.latin_iast: tā~ke śikṣā dāna kare mahā śaktiśālī (phereśatā),
53:5.latin_ascii: ta~ke siksa dana kare maha saktisali (pheresata),

53:6.latin_iast: mahā śaktidhara, se (jivarīla nija ākṛtite) sthira haẏechila,
53:6.latin_ascii: maha saktidhara, se (jivarila nija akrtite) sthira hayechila,

53:8.latin_iast: ataḥpara se tāra (rāsūla era) nikaṭavartī hala, ati nikaṭavartī.
53:8.latin_ascii: atahpara se tara (rasula era) nikatavarti hala, ati nikatavarti.

53:9.latin_iast: phale se dui dhanuka athavā tārao kama vyavadhānera haẏe gela.
53:9.latin_ascii: phale se dui dhanuka athava tarao kama vyavadhanera haye gela.

53:10.latin_iast: takhana āllāha tā~ra vāndāra prati yā oẏāhī karāra tā oẏāhī karalena.
53:10.latin_ascii: takhana allaha ta~ra vandara prati ya oyahi karara ta oyahi karalena.

53:11.latin_iast: yā se dekheche antaḥkaraṇa tā asvīkāra kareni.
53:11.latin_ascii: ya se dekheche antahkarana ta asvikara kareni.

53:12.latin_iast: se yā dekheche tomarā ki se viṣaẏe tā~ra saṅge vitarka karave?
53:12.latin_ascii: se ya dekheche tomara ki se visaye ta~ra sange vitarka karavey

53:13.latin_iast: niścaẏai se tā~ke āreka vāra dekhechila.
53:13.latin_ascii: niscayai se ta~ke areka vara dekhechila.

53:16.latin_iast: takhana varai vṛkṣaṭi, yāra dvārā ācchādita havāra tāra dvārā ācchādita haẏechila,
53:16.latin_ascii: takhana varai vrksati, yara dvara acchadita havara tara dvara acchadita hayechila,

53:17.latin_iast: (tāra) dṛṣṭi bhraṣṭa haẏani evaṃ dṛṣṭi sīmālaṅghanao kareni.
53:17.latin_ascii: (tara) drsti bhrasta hayani evam drsti simalanghanao kareni.

53:18.latin_iast: avaśyai se tā~ra pratipālakera var̤a var̤a nidarśanāvalī dekhechila.
53:18.latin_ascii: avasyai se ta~ra pratipalakera vara vara nidarsanavali dekhechila.

53:19.latin_iast: tomarā ki bheve dekheche ‘lāta’ o ‘uyyā’ samvandhe.
53:19.latin_ascii: tomara ki bheve dekheche ‘lata’ o ‘uyya’ samvandhe.

53:21.latin_iast: tave ki tomādera janya putra, āra tā~ra janya kanyā santāna?
53:21.latin_ascii: tave ki tomadera janya putra, ara ta~ra janya kanya santanay

53:23.latin_iast: egulo kataka nāma mātra, yā tomādera pūrvapuruṣarā o tomarā rekhecha, era samarthane āllāha kona dalīla preraṇa karenani. tārā śudhu anumāna evaṃ tādera pravṛtti yā cāẏa tārai anusaraṇa kare, athaca tādera nikaṭa tādera pratipālakera pakṣa theke hidāẏāta eseche.
53:23.latin_ascii: egulo kataka nama matra, ya tomadera purvapurusara o tomara rekhecha, era samarthane allaha kona dalila prerana karenani. tara sudhu anumana evam tadera pravrtti ya caya tarai anusarana kare, athaca tadera nikata tadera pratipalakera paksa theke hidayata eseche.

53:24.latin_iast: mānuṣa yā cāẏa tāi ki se pāẏa?
53:24.latin_ascii: manusa ya caya tai ki se payay

53:25.latin_iast: vastuta śeṣa o prathama jagatera adhipati āllāhai.
53:25.latin_ascii: vastuta sesa o prathama jagatera adhipati allahai.

53:26.latin_iast: ākāśasamūhe kata phereśatā raẏeche! tādera kona supāriśa kāje āsave nā yatakṣaṇa āllāha yāke icchā evaṃ yāra prati santuṣṭa tāke anumati nā dena.
53:26.latin_ascii: akasasamuhe kata pheresata rayeche! tadera kona suparisa kaje asave na yataksana allaha yake iccha evam yara prati santusta take anumati na dena.

53:27.latin_iast: yārā ākhirāte viśvāsa kare nā tārāi phereśatāderake nārīvācaka nāma diẏe thāke.
53:27.latin_ascii: yara akhirate visvasa kare na tarai pheresataderake narivacaka nama diye thake.

53:28.latin_iast: athaca e viṣaẏe tādera kona jñāna nei, tārā śudhu anumānera anusaraṇa kare; satyera mukāvilāẏa anumānera kona mūlya nei.
53:28.latin_ascii: athaca e visaye tadera kona jnana nei, tara sudhu anumanera anusarana kare; satyera mukavilaya anumanera kona mulya nei.

53:29.latin_iast: ataeva tāke upekṣā kare cala ye āmāra smaraṇa hate vimukha; se to śudhu pārthiva jīvanai kāmanā kare.
53:29.latin_ascii: ataeva take upeksa kare cala ye amara smarana hate vimukha; se to sudhu parthiva jivanai kamana kare.

53:30.latin_iast: tādera jñānera daur̤a ei paryanta. tomāra pratipālakai bhāla jānena ke tā~ra patha hate vicyuta, tinii bhāla jānena ke hedāẏetaprāpta.
53:30.latin_ascii: tadera jnanera daura ei paryanta. tomara pratipalakai bhala janena ke ta~ra patha hate vicyuta, tinii bhala janena ke hedayetaprapta.

53:31.latin_iast: ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche tā āllāharai. yāte kare yārā manda āmala kare tāderake tini dena manda phala evaṃ yārā sat āmala kare tāderake tini dena uttama pratidāna.
53:31.latin_ascii: akasasamuha o prthivite ya kichu ache ta allaharai. yate kare yara manda amala kare taderake tini dena manda phala evam yara sat amala kare taderake tini dena uttama pratidana.

53:32.latin_iast: yārā virata thāke var̤a pāpa o aślīla karma hate, choṭa-khāṭa aparādha vyatīta. niścaẏai tomāra pratipālakera kṣamā aparisīma; tini tomādera samparke samyaka avagata- yakhana tini tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechilena māṭi hate evaṃ yakhana tomarā mātṛgarbhe bhruṇarūpe chile. ataeva tomarā nijederake khuva pavitra mane kara nā, tinii bhāla jānena muttākī ke.
53:32.latin_ascii: yara virata thake vara papa o aslila karma hate, chota-khata aparadha vyatita. niscayai tomara pratipalakera ksama aparisima; tini tomadera samparke samyaka avagata- yakhana tini tomaderake srsti karechilena mati hate evam yakhana tomara matrgarbhe bhrunarupe chile. ataeva tomara nijederake khuva pavitra mane kara na, tinii bhala janena muttaki ke.

53:33.latin_iast: tumi ki dekhecha se vyaktike ye mukha phiriẏe neẏa;
53:33.latin_ascii: tumi ki dekhecha se vyaktike ye mukha phiriye neya;

53:34.latin_iast: evaṃ sāmānya dāna karei kṣānta haẏe yāẏa?
53:34.latin_ascii: evam samanya dana karei ksanta haye yayay

53:35.latin_iast: tāra nikaṭe ki gāẏevera jñāna āche ye, se sava kichu dekhe?
53:35.latin_ascii: tara nikate ki gayevera jnana ache ye, se sava kichu dekhey

53:36.latin_iast: tāke ki avagata karā haẏani yā mūsāra kitāve āche,
53:36.latin_ascii: take ki avagata kara hayani ya musara kitave ache,

53:37.latin_iast: evaṃ ivarāhīmera kitāve, yini pūrṇa karechilena (svīẏa) aṅgīkāra?
53:37.latin_ascii: evam ivarahimera kitave, yini purna karechilena (sviya) angikaray

53:38.latin_iast: tā ei ye, avaśyai kona vahanakārī aparera (pāpera) vojhā vahana karave nā,
53:38.latin_ascii: ta ei ye, avasyai kona vahanakari aparera (papera) vojha vahana karave na,

56:64.latin_iast: tomarā ki oke aṅkurita kara, nā āmi aṅkurita kari?
56:64.latin_ascii: tomara ki oke ankurita kara, na ami ankurita kariy

56:65.latin_iast: āmi icchā karale eke khar̤akuṭoẏa pariṇata karate pāri, takhana tomarā hatavuddhi haẏe par̤ave,
56:65.latin_ascii: ami iccha karale eke kharakutoya parinata karate pari, takhana tomara hatavuddhi haye parave,

56:68.latin_iast: tomarā ye pāni pāna kara se viṣaẏe tomarā cintā karacha ki?
56:68.latin_ascii: tomara ye pani pana kara se visaye tomara cinta karacha kiy

56:69.latin_iast: tomarāi ki tā megha hate varṣaṇa kara, nā āmi varṣaṇa kari.
56:69.latin_ascii: tomarai ki ta megha hate varsana kara, na ami varsana kari.

56:70.latin_iast: āmi icchā karale tāke lavaṇākta vānāte pāri. tavuo tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa karave nā kena?
56:70.latin_ascii: ami iccha karale take lavanakta vanate pari. tavuo tomara krtajnata prakasa karave na kenay

56:71.latin_iast: tomarā ye āguna jvālāo tā lakṣya kare dekhecha ki?
56:71.latin_ascii: tomara ye aguna jvalao ta laksya kare dekhecha kiy

56:72.latin_iast: tomarāi ki ora vṛkṣa sṛṣṭi kara, nā āmi sṛṣṭi kari?
56:72.latin_ascii: tomarai ki ora vrksa srsti kara, na ami srsti kariy

56:73.latin_iast: āmi eke karechi ekaṭi nidarśanasvarūpa evaṃ musāphiradera janya upakārī.
56:73.latin_ascii: ami eke karechi ekati nidarsanasvarupa evam musaphiradera janya upakari.

56:74.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi tomāra mahāna pratipālakera nāmera pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara.
56:74.latin_ascii: sutaram tumi tomara mahana pratipalakera namera pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara.

56:75.latin_iast: āmi śapatha karachi nakṣatra rājira astācalera,
56:75.latin_ascii: ami sapatha karachi naksatra rajira astacalera,

56:76.latin_iast: avaśyai eṭā eka mahā śapatha, yadi tomarā jānate-
56:76.latin_ascii: avasyai eta eka maha sapatha, yadi tomara janate-

56:79.latin_iast: pūta-pavitragaṇa vyatīta anya keu tā sparśa kare nā.
56:79.latin_ascii: puta-pavitragana vyatita anya keu ta sparsa kare na.

56:80.latin_iast: eṭā jagatasamūhera pratipālakera nikaṭa hate avatīrṇa.
56:80.latin_ascii: eta jagatasamuhera pratipalakera nikata hate avatirna.

56:81.latin_iast: tavuo ki tomarā ei hādīsake (kuraānake) tuccha gaṇya karave?
56:81.latin_ascii: tavuo ki tomara ei hadisake (kuraanake) tuccha ganya karavey

56:82.latin_iast: evaṃ (āllāhara neẏāmatake) mithyā pratipanna karākei tomādera riyika vāniẏe niẏecha.
56:82.latin_ascii: evam (allahara neyamatake) mithya pratipanna karakei tomadera riyika vaniye niyecha.

56:83.latin_iast: tave kena naẏa- prāṇa yakhana kaṇṭhāgata haẏa.
56:83.latin_ascii: tave kena naya- prana yakhana kanthagata haya.

56:85.latin_iast: āra āmi tomādera apekṣā (jānāra dika diẏe) tāra nikaṭatara; kintu tomarā dekhate pāo nā.
56:85.latin_ascii: ara ami tomadera apeksa (janara dika diye) tara nikatatara; kintu tomara dekhate pao na.

56:86.latin_iast: tave kena naẏa, yadi tomādera hiseva nā neẏā haẏa,
56:86.latin_ascii: tave kena naya, yadi tomadera hiseva na neya haya,

56:87.latin_iast: tave tomarā kena prāṇake phiriẏe āna nā? yadi tomarā satyavādī hao.
56:87.latin_ascii: tave tomara kena pranake phiriye ana nay yadi tomara satyavadi hao.

56:88.latin_iast: yadi se naikaṭyaprāptadera madhya theke haẏa,
56:88.latin_ascii: yadi se naikatyapraptadera madhya theke haya,

56:89.latin_iast: tāra janya raẏeche ārāma, uttama riyika o neẏāmatamaẏa jānnāta;
56:89.latin_ascii: tara janya rayeche arama, uttama riyika o neyamatamaya jannata;

56:90.latin_iast: āra yadi se ḍāna dikera ekajana haẏa,
56:90.latin_ascii: ara yadi se dana dikera ekajana haya,

56:91.latin_iast: (tāke valā have:) he ḍāna dikera loka! tomāra janya nirāpattā.
56:91.latin_ascii: (take vala have:) he dana dikera loka! tomara janya nirapatta.

56:92.latin_iast: kintu se yadi mithyā pratipannakārī o vibhrāntadera anyatama haẏa,
56:92.latin_ascii: kintu se yadi mithya pratipannakari o vibhrantadera anyatama haya,

56:93.latin_iast: tave tāra āpyāẏana have ṭagavage phuṭanta pāni dvārā,
56:93.latin_ascii: tave tara apyayana have tagavage phutanta pani dvara,

56:96.latin_iast: ataeva, tumi tomāra mahāna pratipālakera nāmera pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara.
56:96.latin_ascii: ataeva, tumi tomara mahana pratipalakera namera pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara.

57:1.latin_iast: āllāhara pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīte yā kichu āche savai. tini parākramaśālī, prajñāvāna.
57:1.latin_ascii: allahara pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare akasasamuha o prthivite ya kichu ache savai. tini parakramasali, prajnavana.

57:2.latin_iast: ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra kartṛtva ekamātra tā~rai; tini jīvana dāna karena o mṛtyu ghaṭāna; tini sarvaviṣaẏe sarvaśaktimāna.
57:2.latin_ascii: akasasamuha o prthivira kartrtva ekamatra ta~rai; tini jivana dana karena o mrtyu ghatana; tini sarvavisaye sarvasaktimana.

57:3.latin_iast: tinii ādi, tinii anta, tinii jāhera, tinii vātena evaṃ tini sarvaviṣaẏe adhika avahita.
57:3.latin_ascii: tinii adi, tinii anta, tinii jahera, tinii vatena evam tini sarvavisaye adhika avahita.

57:4.latin_iast: tinii chaẏa dine ākāśasamūha o pṛthivī sṛṣṭi karechena, ataḥpara āraśe samunnīta haẏechena. tini jānena yā kichu bhūmite praveśa kare o yā kichu tā hate vera haẏa evaṃ ākāśa hate yā kichu nāme o ākāśe yā kichu uṭhe yāẏa. tomarā yekhānei thāka nā kena tini tomādera saṅge āchena, tomarā yā kichu kara āllāha tā dekhena.
57:4.latin_ascii: tinii chaya dine akasasamuha o prthivi srsti karechena, atahpara arase samunnita hayechena. tini janena ya kichu bhumite pravesa kare o ya kichu ta hate vera haya evam akasa hate ya kichu name o akase ya kichu uthe yaya. tomara yekhanei thaka na kena tini tomadera sange achena, tomara ya kichu kara allaha ta dekhena.

57:5.latin_iast: ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra kartṛtva ekamātra tā~rai, āra āllāharai dike sava viṣaẏa pratyāvarrtita have.
57:5.latin_ascii: akasasamuha o prthivira kartrtva ekamatra ta~rai, ara allaharai dike sava visaya pratyavarrtita have.

57:6.latin_iast: tinii rātake praveśa karāna dine evaṃ dinake praveśa karāna rāte evaṃ tini hṛdaẏasamūhera gopana rahasyao jānena.
57:6.latin_ascii: tinii ratake pravesa karana dine evam dinake pravesa karana rate evam tini hrdayasamuhera gopana rahasyao janena.

57:7.latin_iast: āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlera prati īmāna āna evaṃ tomāderake yā kichura uttarādhikārī tini karechena tā hate vyaẏa kara. tomādera madhye yārā īmāna āne o vyaẏa kare, tādera janya āche mahā puraskāra.
57:7.latin_ascii: allaha o ta~ra rasulera prati imana ana evam tomaderake ya kichura uttaradhikari tini karechena ta hate vyaya kara. tomadera madhye yara imana ane o vyaya kare, tadera janya ache maha puraskara.

57:8.latin_iast: tomādera kī hala ye, tomarā āllāhate īmāna ānacha nā? athaca rāsūla tomāderake tomādera pratipālakera prati īmāna ānate āhvāna karache evaṃ tini (āllāha) tomādera nikaṭa hate aṅgīkāra grahaṇa karechena, tomarā yadi viśvāsa karate.
57:8.latin_ascii: tomadera ki hala ye, tomara allahate imana anacha nay athaca rasula tomaderake tomadera pratipalakera prati imana anate ahvana karache evam tini (allaha) tomadera nikata hate angikara grahana karechena, tomara yadi visvasa karate.

57:9.latin_iast: tinii tā~ra vāndāra prati suspaṣṭa āẏātasamūha avatīrṇa karena, tomāderake sakala prakāra andhakāra hate ālora dike ānāra janya; niścaẏai āllāha tomādera prati karuṇāmaẏa, parama daẏālu.
57:9.latin_ascii: tinii ta~ra vandara prati suspasta ayatasamuha avatirna karena, tomaderake sakala prakara andhakara hate alora dike anara janya; niscayai allaha tomadera prati karunamaya, parama dayalu.

57:10.latin_iast: tomādera kī haẏeche ye, tomarā āllāhara pathe vyaẏa karacha nā? athaca ākāśasamūha o pṛthivīra mālikānā āllāharai. tomādera madhye yārā (makkā) vijaẏera pūrve vyaẏa kareche o saṃgrāma kareche, ubhaẏe samāna naẏa; tārā maryādāẏa śreṣṭha tādera apekṣā yārā paravartīkāle vyaẏa kareche o saṃgrāma kareche. tave āllāha ubhaẏera kalyāṇera pratiśruti diẏechena. tomarā yā kara āllāha tā saviśeṣa avahita.
57:10.latin_ascii: tomadera ki hayeche ye, tomara allahara pathe vyaya karacha nay athaca akasasamuha o prthivira malikana allaharai. tomadera madhye yara (makka) vijayera purve vyaya kareche o samgrama kareche, ubhaye samana naya; tara maryadaya srestha tadera apeksa yara paravartikale vyaya kareche o samgrama kareche. tave allaha ubhayera kalyanera pratisruti diyechena. tomara ya kara allaha ta savisesa avahita.

57:11.latin_iast: ke āche ye āllāhake uttama ṛṇa deve? tāhale tini tā vahuguṇe tāra janya vṛddhi karavena evaṃ tāra janya uttama puraskāra raẏeche.
57:11.latin_ascii: ke ache ye allahake uttama rna devey tahale tini ta vahugune tara janya vrddhi karavena evam tara janya uttama puraskara rayeche.

57:12.latin_iast: sedina (kiẏāmatera dina) tumi dekhave mu’mina nara-nārīderake tādera sammukha bhāge o ḍāna pārśve tādera jyoti chuṭochuṭi karave. (valā have : ) āja tomādera janya susaṃvāda emana jānnātera yāra pādadeśe nadīsamūha pravāhita haẏa, sekhāne tomarā sthāẏī have, eṭāi mahāsāphalya.
57:12.latin_ascii: sedina (kiyamatera dina) tumi dekhave mu’mina nara-nariderake tadera sammukha bhage o dana parsve tadera jyoti chutochuti karave. (vala have : ) aja tomadera janya susamvada emana jannatera yara padadese nadisamuha pravahita haya, sekhane tomara sthayi have, etai mahasaphalya.

57:13.latin_iast: sedina munāphika puruṣa o munāphika nārī mu’minaderake valave : tomarā āmādera janya ekaṭu apekṣā kara, yāte āmarā tomādera nūra hate kichu grahaṇa karate pāri. valā have : tomarā tomādera pechane phire yāo o ālora sandhāna kara. ataḥpara ubhaẏera mājhāmājhi sthāpita have ekaṭi prācīra sekhāne ekaṭi darajā thākave, yāra abhyantare rahamata evaṃ vahirbhāge āyāva.
57:13.latin_ascii: sedina munaphika purusa o munaphika nari mu’minaderake valave : tomara amadera janya ekatu apeksa kara, yate amara tomadera nura hate kichu grahana karate pari. vala have : tomara tomadera pechane phire yao o alora sandhana kara. atahpara ubhayera majhamajhi sthapita have ekati pracira sekhane ekati daraja thakave, yara abhyantare rahamata evam vahirbhage ayava.

57:14.latin_iast: tārā tāderake ḍeke jijñāsā karave : āmarā ki tomādera saṅge chilāma nā? tārā valave : hyā~, kintu tomarā nijerāi nijederake vipadagrasta karecha, tomarā pratīkṣā karechile, sandeha poṣaṇa karechile evaṃ mithyā āśā-ākāksakṣā tomāderake pratārita kareche, avaśeṣe āllāhara hukuma (mṛtyu) eseche; āra mahāpratāraka (śaẏatāna) tomāderake āllāha samparke pratārita karechila.
57:14.latin_ascii: tara taderake deke jijnasa karave : amara ki tomadera sange chilama nay tara valave : hya~, kintu tomara nijerai nijederake vipadagrasta karecha, tomara pratiksa karechile, sandeha posana karechile evam mithya asa-akaksaksa tomaderake pratarita kareche, avasese allahara hukuma (mrtyu) eseche; ara mahaprataraka (sayatana) tomaderake allaha samparke pratarita karechila.

57:15.latin_iast: āja tomādera nikaṭa hate kona muktipaṇa neẏā have nā evaṃ kāphiradera nikaṭa hateo naẏa. jāhānnāmai tomādera āvāsasthala, eṭāi tomādera cirasaṅgī, katai nā nikṛṣṭa e pariṇāma.
57:15.latin_ascii: aja tomadera nikata hate kona muktipana neya have na evam kaphiradera nikata hateo naya. jahannamai tomadera avasasthala, etai tomadera cirasangi, katai na nikrsta e parinama.

57:16.latin_iast: mu’minadera janya ekhanao ki samaẏa āseni ye, āllāhara smaraṇa evaṃ ye satya avatīrṇa haẏeche tāra sammukhe hṛdaẏa bhīta santrasta have? evaṃ pūrve yāderake kitāva deoẏā haẏechila tādera mata yena tārā nā haẏa, vahukāla atikrānta haẏe gele yādera hṛdaẏa kaṭhina haẏe par̤echila. tādera adhikāṃśai phāseka.
57:16.latin_ascii: mu’minadera janya ekhanao ki samaya aseni ye, allahara smarana evam ye satya avatirna hayeche tara sammukhe hrdaya bhita santrasta havey evam purve yaderake kitava deoya hayechila tadera mata yena tara na haya, vahukala atikranta haye gele yadera hrdaya kathina haye parechila. tadera adhikamsai phaseka.

57:17.latin_iast: jene rekha ye, āllāhai pṛthivīke tāra mṛtyura para jīvana dāna karena. āmi nidarśanagulo tomādera janya viśadabhāve vyakta karechi yāte tomarā vujhate pāra.
57:17.latin_ascii: jene rekha ye, allahai prthivike tara mrtyura para jivana dana karena. ami nidarsanagulo tomadera janya visadabhave vyakta karechi yate tomara vujhate para.

57:18.latin_iast: dānaśīla puruṣa o dānaśīla nārī evaṃ yārā āllāhake uttama ṛṇa dāna kare tāderake deoẏā have vahaguṇa veśi evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche sammānajanaka vinimaẏa.
57:18.latin_ascii: danasila purusa o danasila nari evam yara allahake uttama rna dana kare taderake deoya have vahaguna vesi evam tadera janya rayeche sammanajanaka vinimaya.

57:19.latin_iast: yārā āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlagaṇera prati īmāna āne, tārāi tādera pratipālakera nikaṭa siddika o śahīda. tādera janya raẏeche tādera pratipālakera kāche tādera prāpya puraskāra o jyoti evaṃ yārā kupharī kareche o āmāra nidarśanāvalī asvīkāra kareche, tārā jāhānnāmera adhivāsī have.
57:19.latin_ascii: yara allaha o ta~ra rasulaganera prati imana ane, tarai tadera pratipalakera nikata siddika o sahida. tadera janya rayeche tadera pratipalakera kache tadera prapya puraskara o jyoti evam yara kuphari kareche o amara nidarsanavali asvikara kareche, tara jahannamera adhivasi have.

57:20.latin_iast: tomarā jene rekha, duniẏāra jīvana to khela-tāmāśā, jā~kajamaka, pārasparika ahaṃkāra prakāśa, dhana-sampada o santāna-santatira prācurya lābhera pratiyogitā vyatīta āra kichui naẏa; era upamā vṛṣṭi, yāra dvārā utpanna śasya-sambhāra kṛṣakaderake camatkṛta kare, ataḥpara oṭā śukiẏe yāẏa, phale tumi oṭā haluda varṇa dekhate pāo, avaśeṣe tā khar̤a kuṭoẏa pariṇata haẏa. ākhirāte raẏeche kaṭhina śāsti evaṃ āllāhara kṣamā o santuṣṭi. duniẏāra jīvana chalanāmaẏa dheā~kā vyatīta kichui naẏa.
57:20.latin_ascii: tomara jene rekha, duniyara jivana to khela-tamasa, ja~kajamaka, parasparika ahamkara prakasa, dhana-sampada o santana-santatira pracurya labhera pratiyogita vyatita ara kichui naya; era upama vrsti, yara dvara utpanna sasya-sambhara krsakaderake camatkrta kare, atahpara ota sukiye yaya, phale tumi ota haluda varna dekhate pao, avasese ta khara kutoya parinata haya. akhirate rayeche kathina sasti evam allahara ksama o santusti. duniyara jivana chalanamaya dhea~ka vyatita kichui naya.

57:21.latin_iast: tomarā agragāmī hao tomādera pratipālakera kṣamā o sei jānnāta lābhera āśāẏa yā praśastatāẏa ākāśa o pṛthivīra mata, yā prastuta karā haẏeche āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlagaṇe viśvāsīdera janya. eṭā āllāhara anugraha, yāke icchā tini eṭā dāna karena; āllāha mahā anugrahaśīla.
57:21.latin_ascii: tomara agragami hao tomadera pratipalakera ksama o sei jannata labhera asaya ya prasastataya akasa o prthivira mata, ya prastuta kara hayeche allaha o ta~ra rasulagane visvasidera janya. eta allahara anugraha, yake iccha tini eta dana karena; allaha maha anugrahasila.

57:22.latin_iast: pṛthivīte evaṃ tomādera (vyaktira) opara ye kona vipada āse tā saṃghaṭita karāra pūrvei āmi tā kitāve lipivaddha kare rekhechi. niścaẏai āllāhara pakṣe eṭā khuvai sahaja.
57:22.latin_ascii: prthivite evam tomadera (vyaktira) opara ye kona vipada ase ta samghatita karara purvei ami ta kitave lipivaddha kare rekhechi. niscayai allahara pakse eta khuvai sahaja.

57:23.latin_iast: eṭā ejanya ye, tomarā yā hāriẏecha tāte yena tomarā hatāśāgrasta nā hao evaṃ yā tini tomāderake diẏechena tāra janya ānande ātmahārā nā hao. āllāha uddhata o ahaṅkārīderake pachanda karena nā.
57:23.latin_ascii: eta ejanya ye, tomara ya hariyecha tate yena tomara hatasagrasta na hao evam ya tini tomaderake diyechena tara janya anande atmahara na hao. allaha uddhata o ahankariderake pachanda karena na.

57:24.latin_iast: yārā kṛpaṇatā kare evaṃ mānuṣake kṛpaṇatāra nirdeśa deẏa evaṃ ye mukha phiriẏe neẏa (se jene rākhuka ye,) āllāha to abhāvamukta, praśaṃsita.
57:24.latin_ascii: yara krpanata kare evam manusake krpanatara nirdesa deya evam ye mukha phiriye neya (se jene rakhuka ye,) allaha to abhavamukta, prasamsita.

57:25.latin_iast: niścaẏai āmi āmāra rāsūladerake preraṇa karechi spaṣṭa pramāṇasaha evaṃ tādera saṅge diẏechi kitāva o mānadaṇḍa yāte mānuṣa suvicāra pratiṣṭhā kare evaṃ āmi lauha avatīrṇa karechi yāte raẏeche pracaṇḍa śakti o raẏeche mānuṣera janya vahuvidha kalyāṇa; eṭā e janya ye, āllāha prakāśa kare devena ke pratyakṣa nā kareo tā~ke o tā~ra rāsūladerake sāhāyya kare. āllāha śaktimāna, parākramaśālī.
57:25.latin_ascii: niscayai ami amara rasuladerake prerana karechi spasta pramanasaha evam tadera sange diyechi kitava o manadanda yate manusa suvicara pratistha kare evam ami lauha avatirna karechi yate rayeche pracanda sakti o rayeche manusera janya vahuvidha kalyana; eta e janya ye, allaha prakasa kare devena ke pratyaksa na kareo ta~ke o ta~ra rasuladerake sahayya kare. allaha saktimana, parakramasali.

57:26.latin_iast: āmi nūha o ivarāhīmake (rāsūlarūpe) preraṇa karechilāma evaṃ āmi tādera du’janera vaṃśe navuoẏāta o kitāva pradāna karechi kintu tādera alpai satpatha avalamvana karechila evaṃ adhikāṃśai chila phāseka.
57:26.latin_ascii: ami nuha o ivarahimake (rasularupe) prerana karechilama evam ami tadera du’janera vamse navuoyata o kitava pradana karechi kintu tadera alpai satpatha avalamvana karechila evam adhikamsai chila phaseka.

57:27.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi ekera para eka āmāra rāsūlagaṇa pāṭhiẏechi evaṃ māraiẏāma putra īsāke pāṭhiẏechi. āra tāke diẏechilāma iñjīla evaṃ tāra anusārīdera antare diẏechilāma karuṇā o daẏā; kintu sannyāsīvāda (saṃsāra tyāgī) eṭā to tārā nijerāi āllāhara santuṣṭi lābhera janya pravartana karechila; āmi tāderake era vidhāna deini athaca eṭāo tārā yathāyathabhāve pālana kareni. tādera madhye yārā īmāna enechila, tāderake āmi puraskāra diẏechilāma evaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai phāsika.
57:27.latin_ascii: atahpara ami ekera para eka amara rasulagana pathiyechi evam maraiyama putra isake pathiyechi. ara take diyechilama injila evam tara anusaridera antare diyechilama karuna o daya; kintu sannyasivada (samsara tyagi) eta to tara nijerai allahara santusti labhera janya pravartana karechila; ami taderake era vidhana deini athaca etao tara yathayathabhave palana kareni. tadera madhye yara imana enechila, taderake ami puraskara diyechilama evam tadera adhikamsai phasika.

57:28.latin_iast: he mu’minagaṇa! tomarā āllāhake bhaẏa kara evaṃ tā~ra rāsūlera prati īmāna āna, tini tā~ra anugrahe tomāderake dviguṇa puraskāra devena evaṃ tini tomāderake devena ālo, yāra sāhāyye tomarā calave evaṃ tini tomāderake kṣamā karavena. āllāha kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
57:28.latin_ascii: he mu’minagana! tomara allahake bhaya kara evam ta~ra rasulera prati imana ana, tini ta~ra anugrahe tomaderake dviguna puraskara devena evam tini tomaderake devena alo, yara sahayye tomara calave evam tini tomaderake ksama karavena. allaha ksamasila, parama dayalu.

57:29.latin_iast: eṭā ejanya ye, kitāvīgaṇa yena jānate pāre, āllāhara sāmānyatama anugrahera oparao tādera kona adhikāra nei, anugraha āllāharai hāte, yāke icchā tā dāna karena evaṃ āllāha mahā anugrahaśīla.
57:29.latin_ascii: eta ejanya ye, kitavigana yena janate pare, allahara samanyatama anugrahera oparao tadera kona adhikara nei, anugraha allaharai hate, yake iccha ta dana karena evam allaha maha anugrahasila.

58:1.latin_iast: āllāha avaśyai sei nārīra kathā śunechena, ye tāra svāmīra vyāpāre tomāra sāthe vitarka karachila, āra āllāhara daravāreo abhiyoga kareche. āra āllāha tomādera ubhaẏera kathā-vārtā śunena. niścaẏai āllāha sarvaśrotā, sarvadraṣṭā.
58:1.latin_ascii: allaha avasyai sei narira katha sunechena, ye tara svamira vyapare tomara sathe vitarka karachila, ara allahara daravareo abhiyoga kareche. ara allaha tomadera ubhayera katha-varta sunena. niscayai allaha sarvasrota, sarvadrasta.

58:2.latin_iast: tomādera madhye yārā svīẏa strīdera sāthe yihāra kare (tārā jene rākhuka), tādera strīgaṇa tādera mātā naẏa. tādera mātā to kevala tārāi yārā tāderake janmadāna karechena. tārā to ekaṭi asaṅgata o mithyā kathāi valache. niścaẏai āllāha gunāha mocanakārī, parama kṣamāśīla.
58:2.latin_ascii: tomadera madhye yara sviya stridera sathe yihara kare (tara jene rakhuka), tadera strigana tadera mata naya. tadera mata to kevala tarai yara taderake janmadana karechena. tara to ekati asangata o mithya kathai valache. niscayai allaha gunaha mocanakari, parama ksamasila.

58:3.latin_iast: āra yārā nijedera strīdera sāthe yihāra kare, pare tārā phire āse yā tārā valeche, tāhale tārā eke aparake sparśa karāra pūrve ekaṭi golāma mukta karave. e ādeśa diẏe tomāderake nasīhata karā yācche. tomarā yā kara, āllāha tā saviśeṣa avahita.
58:3.latin_ascii: ara yara nijedera stridera sathe yihara kare, pare tara phire ase ya tara valeche, tahale tara eke aparake sparsa karara purve ekati golama mukta karave. e adesa diye tomaderake nasihata kara yacche. tomara ya kara, allaha ta savisesa avahita.

58:4.latin_iast: tave yāra e sāmarthya nei, se eke aparake sparśa karāra pūrve dhārāvāhikabhāve du’māsa royā rākhave. āra ye vyakti eteo asamartha, se ṣāṭajana misakīnake khāoẏāve. e nirdeśa ejanya ye, tomarā yena īmāna ānaẏana kara āllāhara prati o tā~ra rāsūlera prati. āra egulo āllāhara nirdhārita sīmārekhā. āra kāphiradera janya raẏeche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
58:4.latin_ascii: tave yara e samarthya nei, se eke aparake sparsa karara purve dharavahikabhave du’masa roya rakhave. ara ye vyakti eteo asamartha, se satajana misakinake khaoyave. e nirdesa ejanya ye, tomara yena imana anayana kara allahara prati o ta~ra rasulera prati. ara egulo allahara nirdharita simarekha. ara kaphiradera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

58:5.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā virodhitā kare āllāhara evaṃ tā~ra rāsūlera tāderake lāñchita karā have yemana lāñchita karā haẏeche tādera pūrvavartīderake. āra āmi to suspaṣṭa āẏātasamūha nāyila karechi. āra kāphiradera janya raẏeche apamānajanaka
58:5.latin_ascii: niscayai yara virodhita kare allahara evam ta~ra rasulera taderake lanchita kara have yemana lanchita kara hayeche tadera purvavartiderake. ara ami to suspasta ayatasamuha nayila karechi. ara kaphiradera janya rayeche apamanajanaka

58:6.latin_iast: sedina, yedina āllāha punarutthita karavena tādera sakalake, ataḥpara tāderake jāniẏe devena yā tārā karata. āllāha tā saṃrakṣita rekhechena, athaca tārā tā bhule geche. āllāha sarvaviṣaẏe samyaka draṣṭā.
58:6.latin_ascii: sedina, yedina allaha punarutthita karavena tadera sakalake, atahpara taderake janiye devena ya tara karata. allaha ta samraksita rekhechena, athaca tara ta bhule geche. allaha sarvavisaye samyaka drasta.

58:7.latin_iast: tumi ki lakṣya karani ye, āllāha jānena yā kichu āche āsamāne o yā kichu āche jamine? tina janera emana kona parāmarśa haẏa nā, yāte tini tādera caturthajana nā hana; āra pā~ca janerao emana kona parāmarśa haẏanā, yāte tini tādera ṣaṣṭhajana nā hana. yekhānei thākuka nā kena, tini tādera sāthe āchena. ataḥpara tāderake tini jāniẏe devena kiẏāmatera dina, tārā yā kare. niścaẏai āllāha sarvaviṣaẏe samyaka avagata.
58:7.latin_ascii: tumi ki laksya karani ye, allaha janena ya kichu ache asamane o ya kichu ache jaminey tina janera emana kona paramarsa haya na, yate tini tadera caturthajana na hana; ara pa~ca janerao emana kona paramarsa hayana, yate tini tadera sasthajana na hana. yekhanei thakuka na kena, tini tadera sathe achena. atahpara taderake tini janiye devena kiyamatera dina, tara ya kare. niscayai allaha sarvavisaye samyaka avagata.

58:8.latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karani, yāderake gopana parāmarśa karate niṣedha karā haẏechila? ataḥpara tāderake yā niṣedha karā haẏechila tārai punarāvṛtti kare evaṃ kānāghuṣā kare pāpakārye, sīmālaṅghane o rāsūlera avādhyācaraṇe. āra tārā yakhana tomāra kāche āse takhana tārā tomāke emana śavde abhivādana kare, yāra dvārā āllāha tomāke abhivādana karenani. āra tārā mane mane vale : kena āllāha āmādera śāsti dena nā, āmarā yā vali tāra kāraṇe. tādera janya jāhānnāmai yatheṣṭa. sethāẏa tārā praveśa karave. vastuta tā katai nā nikṛṣṭa pratyāvartanasthala!
58:8.latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karani, yaderake gopana paramarsa karate nisedha kara hayechilay atahpara taderake ya nisedha kara hayechila tarai punaravrtti kare evam kanaghusa kare papakarye, simalanghane o rasulera avadhyacarane. ara tara yakhana tomara kache ase takhana tara tomake emana savde abhivadana kare, yara dvara allaha tomake abhivadana karenani. ara tara mane mane vale : kena allaha amadera sasti dena na, amara ya vali tara karane. tadera janya jahannamai yathesta. sethaya tara pravesa karave. vastuta ta katai na nikrsta pratyavartanasthala!

58:9.latin_iast: ohe yārā īmāna enecha! tomarā yakhana gopana parāmarśa kara takhana pāpakārya, sīmālaṅghana o rāsūlera avādhyācaraṇera viṣaẏe gopana parāmarśa kara nā. varaṃ satkāja o tākvaoẏāha samparke gopana parāmarśa kara. āra tomarā bhaẏa kara āllāhake yāra kāche tomādera ekatrita karā have.
58:9.latin_ascii: ohe yara imana enecha! tomara yakhana gopana paramarsa kara takhana papakarya, simalanghana o rasulera avadhyacaranera visaye gopana paramarsa kara na. varam satkaja o takvaoyaha samparke gopana paramarsa kara. ara tomara bhaya kara allahake yara kache tomadera ekatrita kara have.

58:10.latin_iast: e gopana parāmarśa to kevala śaẏatānera pakṣa theke haẏe thāke, mu’minaderake duḥkha deoẏāra janya. tave śaẏatāna āllāhara icchā vyatireke tādera kona kṣati karate pārave nā. āra ekamātra āllāhara oparai yena mu’minarā bharasā kare.
58:10.latin_ascii: e gopana paramarsa to kevala sayatanera paksa theke haye thake, mu’minaderake duhkha deoyara janya. tave sayatana allahara iccha vyatireke tadera kona ksati karate parave na. ara ekamatra allahara oparai yena mu’minara bharasa kare.

58:11.latin_iast: ohe yārā īmāna enecha! yakhana tomāderake valā haẏa : majalisera madhye sthāna praśasta kare dāo; takhana tomarā sthāna praśasta kare dio. āllāha tomādera janya sthāna praśasta kare devena. āra yakhana valā haẏa : tomarā uṭhe yāo, takhana uṭhe yeẏo. tomādera madhye yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ yāderake jñāna dāna karā haẏeche, āllāha tādera maryādā ārao unnata kare devena. tomarā yā kichu kara, se samparke āllāha saviśeṣa avahita.
58:11.latin_ascii: ohe yara imana enecha! yakhana tomaderake vala haya : majalisera madhye sthana prasasta kare dao; takhana tomara sthana prasasta kare dio. allaha tomadera janya sthana prasasta kare devena. ara yakhana vala haya : tomara uthe yao, takhana uthe yeyo. tomadera madhye yara imana eneche evam yaderake jnana dana kara hayeche, allaha tadera maryada arao unnata kare devena. tomara ya kichu kara, se samparke allaha savisesa avahita.

58:12.latin_iast: ohe yārā īmāna enecha! tomarā yakhana rāsūlera sāthe cupe cupe kathā valate yāve takhana tomarā kathā valāra pūrrve kichu sadakāha pradāna karave. eṭā tomādera janya śreẏa evaṃ ati pavitra. tave yadi tomarā tāte asamartha hao, tāhale āllāha to niścaẏai kṣamāśīla, asīma daẏālu.
58:12.latin_ascii: ohe yara imana enecha! tomara yakhana rasulera sathe cupe cupe katha valate yave takhana tomara katha valara purrve kichu sadakaha pradana karave. eta tomadera janya sreya evam ati pavitra. tave yadi tomara tate asamartha hao, tahale allaha to niscayai ksamasila, asima dayalu.

58:13.latin_iast: tomarā ki bhaẏa peẏecha cupe cupe kathā valāra pūrve sadakāha pradāna karate? ataeva yakhana tomarā sadakāha dite pārale nā āra āllāha tomāderake kṣamā kare dilena, takhana tomarā yathārīti sālāta kāẏima kara, yākāta dāo evaṃ ānugatya kara āllāhara o tā~ra rāsūlera. āra tomarā yā kara, se viṣaẏe āllāha saviśeṣa avahita.
58:13.latin_ascii: tomara ki bhaya peyecha cupe cupe katha valara purve sadakaha pradana karatey ataeva yakhana tomara sadakaha dite parale na ara allaha tomaderake ksama kare dilena, takhana tomara yathariti salata kayima kara, yakata dao evam anugatya kara allahara o ta~ra rasulera. ara tomara ya kara, se visaye allaha savisesa avahita.

58:14.latin_iast: tumi ki tādera prati lakṣya karani, yārā vandhutva kare emana lokadera sāthe, yādera opara āllāha rāgānvita haẏechena? tārā tomāra dalabhukta naẏa evaṃ tāderao dalabhukta naẏa. tārā jeneśune mithyā śapatha kare.
58:14.latin_ascii: tumi ki tadera prati laksya karani, yara vandhutva kare emana lokadera sathe, yadera opara allaha raganvita hayechenay tara tomara dalabhukta naya evam taderao dalabhukta naya. tara jenesune mithya sapatha kare.

58:15.latin_iast: āllāha tādera janya kaṭhora śāsti prastuta kare rekhechena. niścaẏai tārā yā karata tā katai nā khārāpa.
58:15.latin_ascii: allaha tadera janya kathora sasti prastuta kare rekhechena. niscayai tara ya karata ta katai na kharapa.

58:16.latin_iast: tārā tādera śapathake ḍhālasvarūpa vyavahāra kare, ebhāve tārā āllāhara patha theke virata rākhe. tādera janya raẏeche apamānajanaka śāsti.
58:16.latin_ascii: tara tadera sapathake dhalasvarupa vyavahara kare, ebhave tara allahara patha theke virata rakhe. tadera janya rayeche apamanajanaka sasti.

58:17.latin_iast: tādera dhana-sampada o santāna-santati tādera kona kāje āsave nā āllāhara śāstira mokāvelāẏa. tārāi jāhānnāmera adhivāsī, tārā sethāẏa cirakāla thākave.
58:17.latin_ascii: tadera dhana-sampada o santana-santati tadera kona kaje asave na allahara sastira mokavelaya. tarai jahannamera adhivasi, tara sethaya cirakala thakave.

58:18.latin_iast: yedina āllāha tādera savāike punarutthita karavena, takhana tārā āllāhara sāmane śapatha karave, yemana tomādera sāmane śapatha kare thāke evaṃ tārā erūpa dhāraṇā kare ye, tārā saṭhika bhittira opara pratiṣṭhita āche. śune rākha, tārā to var̤ai mithyāvādī.
58:18.latin_ascii: yedina allaha tadera savaike punarutthita karavena, takhana tara allahara samane sapatha karave, yemana tomadera samane sapatha kare thake evam tara erupa dharana kare ye, tara sathika bhittira opara pratisthita ache. sune rakha, tara to varai mithyavadi.

58:19.latin_iast: śaẏatāna tādera opara paripūrṇa ādhipatya vistāra kare niẏeche āra se tāderake āllāhara smaraṇake bhuliẏe diẏeche. tārā to śaẏatānera dala. jene rekha, śaẏatānera dala niścaẏai kṣatigrasta have.
58:19.latin_ascii: sayatana tadera opara paripurna adhipatya vistara kare niyeche ara se taderake allahara smaranake bhuliye diyeche. tara to sayatanera dala. jene rekha, sayatanera dala niscayai ksatigrasta have.

58:20.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā virodhitā kare āllāhara o tā~ra rāsūlera tārāi have lāñchitadera antarbhukta.
58:20.latin_ascii: niscayai yara virodhita kare allahara o ta~ra rasulera tarai have lanchitadera antarbhukta.

58:21.latin_iast: āllāha likhe rekhechena : āmi evaṃ āmāra rāsūlagaṇa niścaẏai jaẏa lābha karava. niścaẏai āllāha śaktiśālī, mahāpratāpaśālī.
58:21.latin_ascii: allaha likhe rekhechena : ami evam amara rasulagana niscayai jaya labha karava. niscayai allaha saktisali, mahapratapasali.
