69:14.latin_iast: āra pṛthivī o parvatamālāke uttolana karā have evaṃ ekai dhākkāẏa cūrṇa-vicūrṇa kare deoẏā have.
69:14.latin_ascii: ara prthivi o parvatamalake uttolana kara have evam ekai dhakkaya curna-vicurna kare deoya have.

69:15.latin_iast: sedina yā saṃghaṭita haoẏāra tā arthāt kiẏāmata saṃghaṭita haẏe yāve.
69:15.latin_ascii: sedina ya samghatita haoyara ta arthat kiyamata samghatita haye yave.

69:16.latin_iast: evaṃ ākāśa cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haẏe nisteja avasthāẏa vikṣipta haẏe par̤ave.
69:16.latin_ascii: evam akasa curna-vicurna haye nisteja avasthaya viksipta haye parave.

69:17.latin_iast: āra phereśatāgaṇa tāra pārśve thākave evaṃ sedina āṭajana phereśatā tomāra pratipālakera āraśake tādera opare vahana karave.
69:17.latin_ascii: ara pheresatagana tara parsve thakave evam sedina atajana pheresata tomara pratipalakera arasake tadera opare vahana karave.

69:18.latin_iast: sedina tomāderake upasthita karā have evaṃ tomādera kichui gopana thākave nā.
69:18.latin_ascii: sedina tomaderake upasthita kara have evam tomadera kichui gopana thakave na.

69:19.latin_iast: ataḥpara yāra āmalanāmā tāra ḍāna hāte deoẏā have, se valave : nāo, āmāra āmalanāmā par̤e dekho;
69:19.latin_ascii: atahpara yara amalanama tara dana hate deoya have, se valave : nao, amara amalanama pare dekho;

69:20.latin_iast: āmi jānatāma ye, āmāke avaśyai hisāvera sammukhīna hate have.
69:20.latin_ascii: ami janatama ye, amake avasyai hisavera sammukhina hate have.

69:21.latin_iast: sutarāṃ se santoṣajanaka jīvana yāpana karave;
69:21.latin_ascii: sutaram se santosajanaka jivana yapana karave;

69:23.latin_iast: yāra phala-phalādi ati nikaṭe nāgālera madhye thākave.
69:23.latin_ascii: yara phala-phaladi ati nikate nagalera madhye thakave.

69:24.latin_iast: tomarā khāo evaṃ pāna kara tṛptira sāthe, tomādera atīta dinasamūhe yā karechile tāra vinimaẏe.
69:24.latin_ascii: tomara khao evam pana kara trptira sathe, tomadera atita dinasamuhe ya karechile tara vinimaye.

69:25.latin_iast: kintu yāra āmalanāmā tāra vāma hāte deoẏā have, se valave : hāẏa! āmāke yadi āmāra āmalanāmā nā deoẏā hata.
69:25.latin_ascii: kintu yara amalanama tara vama hate deoya have, se valave : haya! amake yadi amara amalanama na deoya hata.

69:26.latin_iast: evaṃ āmi yadi hisāva kī tā nā jānatāma!
69:26.latin_ascii: evam ami yadi hisava ki ta na janatama!

69:27.latin_iast: hāẏa! āmāra mṛtyui yadi āmāra śeṣa hata!
69:27.latin_ascii: haya! amara mrtyui yadi amara sesa hata!

69:28.latin_iast: āmāra dhana-sampada āmāra kona kājei āsala nā.
69:28.latin_ascii: amara dhana-sampada amara kona kajei asala na.

69:30.latin_iast: (phereśatāke valā have) tāke dhara, ataḥpara tāra galāẏa ver̤ī pariẏe dāo.
69:30.latin_ascii: (pheresatake vala have) take dhara, atahpara tara galaya veri pariye dao.

69:32.latin_iast: punarāẏa tāke ve~dhe phelo emana śikala dvārā yāra māpa sattara hāta lamvā.
69:32.latin_ascii: punaraya take ve~dhe phelo emana sikala dvara yara mapa sattara hata lamva.

69:33.latin_iast: se mahāna āllāhara prati viśvāsī chila nā,
69:33.latin_ascii: se mahana allahara prati visvasi chila na,

69:34.latin_iast: evaṃ abhāvagrastake khādya dāne utsāhita karata nā
69:34.latin_ascii: evam abhavagrastake khadya dane utsahita karata na

69:35.latin_iast: ataeva ājakera dina ekhāne tāra kona antaraṅga vandhu thākave nā,
69:35.latin_ascii: ataeva ajakera dina ekhane tara kona antaranga vandhu thakave na,

69:36.latin_iast: āra kṣata niḥsṛta rakta-pu~ja vyatīta kona khādya thākave nā.
69:36.latin_ascii: ara ksata nihsrta rakta-pu~ja vyatita kona khadya thakave na.

69:38.latin_iast: āmi śapatha kari tāra yā tomarā dekhate pāo,
69:38.latin_ascii: ami sapatha kari tara ya tomara dekhate pao,

69:39.latin_iast: evaṃ yā tomarā dekhate pāo nā.
69:39.latin_ascii: evam ya tomara dekhate pao na.

69:40.latin_iast: niścaẏai eṭā (kuraāna) eka sammānita rāsūlera (vahana karā) vāṇī;
69:40.latin_ascii: niscayai eta (kuraana) eka sammanita rasulera (vahana kara) vani;

69:41.latin_iast: eṭā kona kavira kathā naẏa; tomarā alpai viśvāsa kara,
69:41.latin_ascii: eta kona kavira katha naya; tomara alpai visvasa kara,

69:42.latin_iast: eṭā kona gaṇakera kathāo naẏa, tomarā alpai upadeśa grahaṇa kara.
69:42.latin_ascii: eta kona ganakera kathao naya, tomara alpai upadesa grahana kara.

69:43.latin_iast: eṭā jagatasamūhera pratipālakera pakṣa theke avatīrṇa.
69:43.latin_ascii: eta jagatasamuhera pratipalakera paksa theke avatirna.

69:44.latin_iast: yadi se nije kona kathā vāniẏe āmāra kathā vale cāliẏe dita,
69:44.latin_ascii: yadi se nije kona katha vaniye amara katha vale caliye dita,

69:45.latin_iast: tave avaśyai āmi tāra ḍāna hāta dhare phelatāma,
69:45.latin_ascii: tave avasyai ami tara dana hata dhare phelatama,

69:46.latin_iast: evaṃ keṭe ditāma tāra hṛtpiṇḍera śirā.
69:46.latin_ascii: evam kete ditama tara hrtpindera sira.

69:47.latin_iast: ataḥpara tomādera madhye emana keu thākata nā, ye tāra theke āmāke virata rākhate pāre.
69:47.latin_ascii: atahpara tomadera madhye emana keu thakata na, ye tara theke amake virata rakhate pare.

69:48.latin_iast: eṭā (kuraāna) muttākīdera janya avaśyai eka upadeśa.
69:48.latin_ascii: eta (kuraana) muttakidera janya avasyai eka upadesa.

69:49.latin_iast: āmi avaśyai jāni ye, tomādera madhye mithyā pratipannakārīo raẏeche.
69:49.latin_ascii: ami avasyai jani ye, tomadera madhye mithya pratipannakario rayeche.

69:50.latin_iast: evaṃ ei (kuraāna) niścaẏai kāphiradera anuśocanāra kāraṇa have,
69:50.latin_ascii: evam ei (kuraana) niscayai kaphiradera anusocanara karana have,

69:52.latin_iast: ataeva tumi tomāra mahāna pratipālakera nāmera mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara.
69:52.latin_ascii: ataeva tumi tomara mahana pratipalakera namera mahima ghosana kara.

70:1.latin_iast: avaśyambhāvī āyāvera vyāpāre ekajana jijñāsākārī jijñāsā karala
70:1.latin_ascii: avasyambhavi ayavera vyapare ekajana jijnasakari jijnasa karala

70:2.latin_iast: (vale dāo) kāphiradera hate tā pratirodha karāra keu nei.
70:2.latin_ascii: (vale dao) kaphiradera hate ta pratirodha karara keu nei.

70:3.latin_iast: āllāhara nikaṭa hate yini ūrdhvārohaṇera vāhanasamūhera adhikārī.
70:3.latin_ascii: allahara nikata hate yini urdhvarohanera vahanasamuhera adhikari.

70:4.latin_iast: phereśatā evaṃ rūha (jivarīla) tā~ra dike ūrdhvagāmī have emana eka dine yāra paridhi pañcāśa hājāra vacharera samāna.
70:4.latin_ascii: pheresata evam ruha (jivarila) ta~ra dike urdhvagami have emana eka dine yara paridhi pancasa hajara vacharera samana.

70:6.latin_iast: niścaẏai tārā ai dinake aneka dūre mane kare,
70:6.latin_ascii: niscayai tara ai dinake aneka dure mane kare,

70:8.latin_iast: sedina ākāśa have galita rūpāra mata,
70:8.latin_ascii: sedina akasa have galita rupara mata,

70:9.latin_iast: evaṃ parvatasamūha have dhūnita raṅgīna paśamera mata,
70:9.latin_ascii: evam parvatasamuha have dhunita rangina pasamera mata,

70:10.latin_iast: āra kona antaraṅga vandhu kona antaraṅga vandhura kheā~ja neve nā,
70:10.latin_ascii: ara kona antaranga vandhu kona antaranga vandhura khea~ja neve na,

70:11.latin_iast: tāderake sāmanā-sāmani karā have. aparādhī sei dinera āyāva theke vā~cāra vinimaẏe dite cāive santāna-santatike,
70:11.latin_ascii: taderake samana-samani kara have. aparadhi sei dinera ayava theke va~cara vinimaye dite caive santana-santatike,

70:13.latin_iast: āra tāra goṣṭhīke, yārā tāke āśraẏa dita.
70:13.latin_ascii: ara tara gosthike, yara take asraya dita.

70:14.latin_iast: evaṃ pṛthivīra sakalake, yāte esava kichu tāke mukti dite pāre.
70:14.latin_ascii: evam prthivira sakalake, yate esava kichu take mukti dite pare.

70:15.latin_iast: nā, kakṣano naẏa, niścaẏai eṭā lelihāna agni śikhā,
70:15.latin_ascii: na, kaksano naya, niscayai eta lelihana agni sikha,

70:16.latin_iast: yā (māthā o śarīra hate) cāmar̤ā khasiẏe deve.
70:16.latin_ascii: ya (matha o sarira hate) camara khasiye deve.

70:17.latin_iast: jāhānnāma ai vyaktike ḍākave, ye (satyera prati) pṛṣṭha pradarśana karechila o mukha phiriẏe niẏechila.
70:17.latin_ascii: jahannama ai vyaktike dakave, ye (satyera prati) prstha pradarsana karechila o mukha phiriye niyechila.

70:18.latin_iast: se sampada jamā kareche evaṃ saṃrakṣita kare rekheche.
70:18.latin_ascii: se sampada jama kareche evam samraksita kare rekheche.

70:19.latin_iast: niścaẏai mānuṣake sṛṣṭi karā haẏeche asthira manārūpe;
70:19.latin_ascii: niscayai manusake srsti kara hayeche asthira manarupe;

70:20.latin_iast: yakhana tāke vipada sparśa kare takhana se haẏa hā-hutāśakārī.
70:20.latin_ascii: yakhana take vipada sparsa kare takhana se haya ha-hutasakari.

70:21.latin_iast: āra yakhana kalyāṇa tāke sparśa kare takhana se haẏa ati kṛpaṇa;
70:21.latin_ascii: ara yakhana kalyana take sparsa kare takhana se haya ati krpana;

70:23.latin_iast: yārā tādera nāmāye sadā niẏamānuvartitā avalamvanakārī,
70:23.latin_ascii: yara tadera namaye sada niyamanuvartita avalamvanakari,

70:24.latin_iast: āra (yārā mane kare) tādera sampade nirdhārita haka raẏeche.
70:24.latin_ascii: ara (yara mane kare) tadera sampade nirdharita haka rayeche.

70:26.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā vicāra divasake satya vale māne.
70:26.latin_ascii: evam yara vicara divasake satya vale mane.

70:27.latin_iast: āra yārā tādera pratipālakera āyāva samparke bhīta-santrasta
70:27.latin_ascii: ara yara tadera pratipalakera ayava samparke bhita-santrasta

70:28.latin_iast: niścaẏai tādera pratipālakera āyāva hate nirbhaẏa thākā yāẏa nā,
70:28.latin_ascii: niscayai tadera pratipalakera ayava hate nirbhaya thaka yaya na,

70:29.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā nijedera lajjāsthānake hephāyata kare,
70:29.latin_ascii: evam yara nijedera lajjasthanake hephayata kare,

70:30.latin_iast: tādera strī athavā adhikārabhukta dāsīdera kṣetra vyatīta, ete tārā nindanīẏa have nā.
70:30.latin_ascii: tadera stri athava adhikarabhukta dasidera ksetra vyatita, ete tara nindaniya have na.

70:31.latin_iast: tave keu ederake chār̤ā anyake kāmanā karale tārā have sīmā laṅghanakārī,
70:31.latin_ascii: tave keu ederake chara anyake kamana karale tara have sima langhanakari,

70:32.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā tādera āmānata rakṣā kare o oẏādā pūrṇa kare,
70:32.latin_ascii: evam yara tadera amanata raksa kare o oyada purna kare,

70:33.latin_iast: āra yārā tādera sākṣya dāne (satatāra opara) aṭala,
70:33.latin_ascii: ara yara tadera saksya dane (satatara opara) atala,

70:34.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā nijedera sālāta ādāẏe yatnavāna-
70:34.latin_ascii: evam yara nijedera salata adaye yatnavana-

70:36.latin_iast: kāphiradera kī hala ye, tārā tomāra dike chuṭe āsache?
70:36.latin_ascii: kaphiradera ki hala ye, tara tomara dike chute asachey

70:37.latin_iast: ḍāna o vāma dika hate, dale dale,
70:37.latin_ascii: dana o vama dika hate, dale dale,

70:38.latin_iast: tādera savāi ki e āśā kare ye, tāke neẏāmatapūrṇa jānnāte praveśa karāna have?
70:38.latin_ascii: tadera savai ki e asa kare ye, take neyamatapurna jannate pravesa karana havey

70:39.latin_iast: kakṣano nā, āmi tāderake yā hate sṛṣṭi karechi tā tārā jāne.
70:39.latin_ascii: kaksano na, ami taderake ya hate srsti karechi ta tara jane.

70:40.latin_iast: āmi śapatha karachi udaẏācala o astācalera pratipālakera- niścaẏai āmi sakṣama-
70:40.latin_ascii: ami sapatha karachi udayacala o astacalera pratipalakera- niscayai ami saksama-

70:41.latin_iast: tādera apekṣā uttama mānavagoṣṭhīke tādera sthalābhiṣikta karate evaṃ e kāje āmāke pechane phele yāoẏāra mata keu nei.
70:41.latin_ascii: tadera apeksa uttama manavagosthike tadera sthalabhisikta karate evam e kaje amake pechane phele yaoyara mata keu nei.

70:42.latin_iast: sutarāṃ yedina samparke tāderake pratiśra“ti deoẏā haẏeche tāra sammukhīna haoẏāra āga paryanta tāderake vāje kathā o khela-tāmāśāẏa lipta thākate dāo.
70:42.latin_ascii: sutaram yedina samparke taderake pratisra“ti deoya hayeche tara sammukhina haoyara aga paryanta taderake vaje katha o khela-tamasaya lipta thakate dao.

70:43.latin_iast: sedina tārā kavara hate vera have druta vege, mane have ye, tārā kona ekaṭi āstānāra dike chuṭe āsache.
70:43.latin_ascii: sedina tara kavara hate vera have druta vege, mane have ye, tara kona ekati astanara dike chute asache.

70:44.latin_iast: (sedina) tādera dṛṣṭi avanata have; lāñchanā tāderake ācchanna karave; eṭāi sedina, yāra pratiśra“ti tāderake deoẏā haẏechila.
70:44.latin_ascii: (sedina) tadera drsti avanata have; lanchana taderake acchanna karave; etai sedina, yara pratisra“ti taderake deoya hayechila.

71:1.latin_iast: nūhake āmi preraṇa karechilāma tā~ra jātira kāche (e nirdeśasaha) ye, tumi tomāra jātira lokaderake satarka kara tādera prati āyāva āsāra pūrvei.
71:1.latin_ascii: nuhake ami prerana karechilama ta~ra jatira kache (e nirdesasaha) ye, tumi tomara jatira lokaderake satarka kara tadera prati ayava asara purvei.

71:2.latin_iast: se valechila : he āmāra jāti! āmi to tomādera janya spaṣṭa satarkakārī-
71:2.latin_ascii: se valechila : he amara jati! ami to tomadera janya spasta satarkakari-

71:3.latin_iast: tomarā āllāhara ivādata kara o tā~ke bhaẏa kara evaṃ āmāra ānugatya kara;
71:3.latin_ascii: tomara allahara ivadata kara o ta~ke bhaya kara evam amara anugatya kara;

71:4.latin_iast: tini tomādera aparādha kṣamā karavena evaṃ tini tomāderake avakāśa devena eka nirdiṣṭa kāla paryanta. niścaẏai āllāha kartṛka nirdhārita samaẏa upasthita hale tā vilamvita haẏa nā, yadi tomarā eṭā jānate!
71:4.latin_ascii: tini tomadera aparadha ksama karavena evam tini tomaderake avakasa devena eka nirdista kala paryanta. niscayai allaha kartrka nirdharita samaya upasthita hale ta vilamvita haya na, yadi tomara eta janate!

71:5.latin_iast: se valechila : he āmāra pratipālaka! āmi to āmāra sampradāẏake dina-rāta ḍekechi,
71:5.latin_ascii: se valechila : he amara pratipalaka! ami to amara sampradayake dina-rata dekechi,

71:6.latin_iast: kintu āmāra āhvāna tādera dūre sare thākāra pravaṇatākei vṛddhi kareche.
71:6.latin_ascii: kintu amara ahvana tadera dure sare thakara pravanatakei vrddhi kareche.

71:7.latin_iast: āmi yakhanai tāderake āhvāna kari yāte tumi tāderake kṣamā karo, takhanai tārā kāne āṅgula ḍhukiẏe diẏeche, āra nijederake vastrāvṛta kare o jida evaṃ atiśaẏa ahaṅkāra prakāśa kare svīẏa aparādhe aṭala thekeche.
71:7.latin_ascii: ami yakhanai taderake ahvana kari yate tumi taderake ksama karo, takhanai tara kane angula dhukiye diyeche, ara nijederake vastravrta kare o jida evam atisaya ahankara prakasa kare sviya aparadhe atala thekeche.

71:8.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmi tāderake āhvāna karechi suucca svare,
71:8.latin_ascii: atahpara ami taderake ahvana karechi suucca svare,

71:9.latin_iast: erapare āmi tādera kāche prakāśye pracāra karechi evaṃ ati gopaneo vujhiẏechi.
71:9.latin_ascii: erapare ami tadera kache prakasye pracara karechi evam ati gopaneo vujhiyechi.

71:10.latin_iast: āmi valechi : tomarā tomādera pratipālakera kṣamā prārthanā kara, tini to atiśaẏa kṣamāśīla;
71:10.latin_ascii: ami valechi : tomara tomadera pratipalakera ksama prarthana kara, tini to atisaya ksamasila;

71:11.latin_iast: tini tomādera janya ākāśa hate pracura vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karavena,
71:11.latin_ascii: tini tomadera janya akasa hate pracura vrsti varsana karavena,

71:12.latin_iast: tini tomāderake samṛddha karavena dhana-sampada o santāna-santatite evaṃ tomādera janya vāgānasamūha sṛṣṭi karavena o pravāhita karavena nadī-nālā.
71:12.latin_ascii: tini tomaderake samrddha karavena dhana-sampada o santana-santatite evam tomadera janya vaganasamuha srsti karavena o pravahita karavena nadi-nala.

71:13.latin_iast: tomādera kī haẏeche ye, tomarā āllāhara śreṣṭhatva svīkāra karate cāccha nā?
71:13.latin_ascii: tomadera ki hayeche ye, tomara allahara sresthatva svikara karate caccha nay

71:14.latin_iast: athaca tinii tomāderake paryāẏakrame sṛṣṭi karechena,
71:14.latin_ascii: athaca tinii tomaderake paryayakrame srsti karechena,

71:15.latin_iast: tomarā ki lakṣya karani? āllāha kibhāve sāta āsamānake stare stare sṛṣṭi karechena?
71:15.latin_ascii: tomara ki laksya karaniy allaha kibhave sata asamanake stare stare srsti karechenay

71:16.latin_iast: evaṃ sekhāne cā~dake ālo o sūryake pradīparūpe sthāpana karechena?
71:16.latin_ascii: evam sekhane ca~dake alo o suryake pradiparupe sthapana karechenay

71:17.latin_iast: āra āllāha udbhida utpannera nyāẏa tomāderake utgata karechena māṭi hate.
71:17.latin_ascii: ara allaha udbhida utpannera nyaya tomaderake utgata karechena mati hate.

71:18.latin_iast: ataḥpara tini tomāderake tāte phiriẏe nevena evaṃ pare punarutthita karavena,
71:18.latin_ascii: atahpara tini tomaderake tate phiriye nevena evam pare punarutthita karavena,

71:19.latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha tomādera janya bhūmike karechena vistṛta-
71:19.latin_ascii: evam allaha tomadera janya bhumike karechena vistrta-

71:20.latin_iast: yāte tomarā era praśasta pathe calāpherā karate pāra.
71:20.latin_ascii: yate tomara era prasasta pathe calaphera karate para.

71:21.latin_iast: nūha valechila : he āmāra pratipālaka! tārā to āmāke amānya kareche evaṃ anusaraṇa kareche emana lokera yāra dhana-sampada o santāna-santati tāra kṣati vyatīta āra kichui vṛddhi kareni.
71:21.latin_ascii: nuha valechila : he amara pratipalaka! tara to amake amanya kareche evam anusarana kareche emana lokera yara dhana-sampada o santana-santati tara ksati vyatita ara kichui vrddhi kareni.

71:23.latin_iast: evaṃ eke aparake valeche tomarā kakhanao tomādera upāsyaguloke evaṃ oẏāda, suoẏā‘ā, iẏāgusa, iẏāuka o nāsarakeo parityāga kara nā.
71:23.latin_ascii: evam eke aparake valeche tomara kakhanao tomadera upasyaguloke evam oyada, suoya‘a, iyagusa, iyauka o nasarakeo parityaga kara na.

71:24.latin_iast: tārā anekake vibhrānta kareche evaṃ jālimadera vibhrānti vyatīta āra kichui vṛddhi karave nā.
71:24.latin_ascii: tara anekake vibhranta kareche evam jalimadera vibhranti vyatita ara kichui vrddhi karave na.

71:25.latin_iast: tādera aparādhera janya tāderake nimajjita karā haẏeche evaṃ pare tāderake praveśa karāno haẏeche jāhānnāme, ataḥpara tārā kāukeo āllāhara mukāvilāẏa sāhāyyakārī pāẏani.
71:25.latin_ascii: tadera aparadhera janya taderake nimajjita kara hayeche evam pare taderake pravesa karano hayeche jahanname, atahpara tara kaukeo allahara mukavilaya sahayyakari payani.

71:26.latin_iast: nūha āro valechila : he āmāra pratipālaka! pṛthivīte kāphiradera madhya hate kona gṛhavāsīke cher̤e dio nā.
71:26.latin_ascii: nuha aro valechila : he amara pratipalaka! prthivite kaphiradera madhya hate kona grhavasike chere dio na.

71:27.latin_iast: tumi yadi tāderake cher̤e dāo tārā tomāra vāndāderake vibhrānta karave evaṃ yārā janma lābha karave tārā have duṣkṛtakārī o kāphira.
71:27.latin_ascii: tumi yadi taderake chere dao tara tomara vandaderake vibhranta karave evam yara janma labha karave tara have duskrtakari o kaphira.

71:28.latin_iast: he āmāra pratipālaka! tumi āmāke, āmāra pitā-mātāke evaṃ yārā mu’mina haẏe āmāra ghare praveśa kareche tāderake evaṃ mu’mina puruṣa o mu’mina nārīderake kṣamā kara, āra jālimadera janya dhvaṃsa chār̤ā anya kichu vṛddhi karave nā.
71:28.latin_ascii: he amara pratipalaka! tumi amake, amara pita-matake evam yara mu’mina haye amara ghare pravesa kareche taderake evam mu’mina purusa o mu’mina nariderake ksama kara, ara jalimadera janya dhvamsa chara anya kichu vrddhi karave na.

72:1.latin_iast: vala : āmāra prati oẏāhī prerita haẏeche ye, jinadera ekaṭi dala manoyogasahakāre śravaṇa kareche evaṃ valeche : āmarā to eka vismaẏakara kuraāna śravaṇa karechi.
72:1.latin_ascii: vala : amara prati oyahi prerita hayeche ye, jinadera ekati dala manoyogasahakare sravana kareche evam valeche : amara to eka vismayakara kuraana sravana karechi.

72:2.latin_iast: yā saṭhika patha-nirdeśa kare; se kāraṇe āmarā ete īmāna ānaẏana karechi evaṃ āmarā kakhanao āmādera pratipālakera sāthe kona śarīka sthāpana karava nā.
72:2.latin_ascii: ya sathika patha-nirdesa kare; se karane amara ete imana anayana karechi evam amara kakhanao amadera pratipalakera sathe kona sarika sthapana karava na.

72:3.latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai āmādera pratipālakera maryādā samucca; tini kona strī evaṃ kona santāna grahaṇa karena ni.
72:3.latin_ascii: evam niscayai amadera pratipalakera maryada samucca; tini kona stri evam kona santana grahana karena ni.

72:4.latin_iast: evaṃ āmādera madhyakāra nirveādharā āllāha samvandhe ati mithyā ukti karata.
72:4.latin_ascii: evam amadera madhyakara nirveadhara allaha samvandhe ati mithya ukti karata.

72:5.latin_iast: athaca āmarā mane karatāma ye, mānuṣa evaṃ jina āllāha samvandhe kakhano mithyā valave nā.
72:5.latin_ascii: athaca amara mane karatama ye, manusa evam jina allaha samvandhe kakhano mithya valave na.

72:6.latin_iast: āra katipaẏa mānuṣa kataka jinera āśraẏa prārthanā karata, phale tārā nijedera sīmālaṅghana āro vār̤iẏe diẏeche.
72:6.latin_ascii: ara katipaya manusa kataka jinera asraya prarthana karata, phale tara nijedera simalanghana aro variye diyeche.

72:7.latin_iast: tomādera mata tārāo (mānuṣa) mane karechila ye, āllāha kāukeo punarutthita karavena nā.
72:7.latin_ascii: tomadera mata tarao (manusa) mane karechila ye, allaha kaukeo punarutthita karavena na.

72:8.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā ākāśasamūhake sparśa (paryavekṣaṇa) karechi āra āmarā seṭā peẏechi kaṭhora praharī o ulkāpiṇḍa dvārā paripūrṇa.
72:8.latin_ascii: evam amara akasasamuhake sparsa (paryaveksana) karechi ara amara seta peyechi kathora prahari o ulkapinda dvara paripurna.

72:9.latin_iast: āra pūrve āmarā ākāśera vibhinna ghā~ṭite (saṃvāda) śunāra janya vasatāma; kintu ekhana keu saṃvāda śunate cāile se prastuta jvalanta ulkāpiṇḍera sammukhīna haẏa.
72:9.latin_ascii: ara purve amara akasera vibhinna gha~tite (samvada) sunara janya vasatama; kintu ekhana keu samvada sunate caile se prastuta jvalanta ulkapindera sammukhina haya.

72:10.latin_iast: āmarā jāni nā ye, pṛthivīvāsīra sāthe kona khārāpa ācaraṇera icchā karā haẏeche nā ki tādera pratipālaka tādera hedāẏeta cāna.
72:10.latin_ascii: amara jani na ye, prthivivasira sathe kona kharapa acaranera iccha kara hayeche na ki tadera pratipalaka tadera hedayeta cana.

72:11.latin_iast: evaṃ āmādera kataka satkarmaparāẏaṇa evaṃ kataka era vyatikrama, āmarā chilāma vibhinna pathera anusārī.
72:11.latin_ascii: evam amadera kataka satkarmaparayana evam kataka era vyatikrama, amara chilama vibhinna pathera anusari.

72:12.latin_iast: āra āmādera ekānta viśvāsa haẏe geche ye, āmarā pṛthivīte āllāhake konakrame parābhūta karate pāravo nā evaṃ palāẏana kareo tā~ke vyartha karate pārava nā.
72:12.latin_ascii: ara amadera ekanta visvasa haye geche ye, amara prthivite allahake konakrame parabhuta karate paravo na evam palayana kareo ta~ke vyartha karate parava na.

72:13.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā yakhana hedāẏetera vāṇī śunalāma takhana tāte āmarā viśvāsa sthāpana karalāma. ye vyakti tāra pratipālakera opara viśvāsa sthāpana kare tāra kona kṣati o kona anyāẏera bhaẏa thākave nā.
72:13.latin_ascii: evam amara yakhana hedayetera vani sunalama takhana tate amara visvasa sthapana karalama. ye vyakti tara pratipalakera opara visvasa sthapana kare tara kona ksati o kona anyayera bhaya thakave na.

72:14.latin_iast: āmādera kataka musalima evaṃ kataka atyācārī, yārā isalāma grahaṇa kare tārā muktira patha khu~je peẏeche.
72:14.latin_ascii: amadera kataka musalima evam kataka atyacari, yara isalama grahana kare tara muktira patha khu~je peyeche.

72:15.latin_iast: āra yārā atyācārī tārā to jāhānnāmerai indhana.
72:15.latin_ascii: ara yara atyacari tara to jahannamerai indhana.

72:16.latin_iast: tārā yadi satyapathe pratiṣṭhita thākato tave tāderake āmi avaśyai pracura vāri varṣaṇera mādhyame samṛddha karatāma.
72:16.latin_ascii: tara yadi satyapathe pratisthita thakato tave taderake ami avasyai pracura vari varsanera madhyame samrddha karatama.

72:17.latin_iast: yāra dvārā āmi tāderake parīkṣā karava. ye vyakti tāra pratipālakera smaraṇa hate vimūkha haẏa tini tāke kaṭhina āyāve praveśa karāvena.
72:17.latin_ascii: yara dvara ami taderake pariksa karava. ye vyakti tara pratipalakera smarana hate vimukha haya tini take kathina ayave pravesa karavena.

72:18.latin_iast: evaṃ niścaẏai sijadāra sthānasamūha (samasta ivādata) ekamātra āllāhara janya. sutarāṃ āllāhara sāthe tomarā anya kāukeo ḍeko nā.
72:18.latin_ascii: evam niscayai sijadara sthanasamuha (samasta ivadata) ekamatra allahara janya. sutaram allahara sathe tomara anya kaukeo deko na.

72:19.latin_iast: āra yakhana āllāhara vāndā tā~ke ḍākāra janya dā~r̤āẏa takhana tārā tāra nikaṭa bhir̤a jamāẏa.
72:19.latin_ascii: ara yakhana allahara vanda ta~ke dakara janya da~raya takhana tara tara nikata bhira jamaya.

72:20.latin_iast: vala : niścaẏai āmi āmāra pratipālakakei ḍāki evaṃ tā~ra sāthe kāukeo śarīka kari nā.
72:20.latin_ascii: vala : niscayai ami amara pratipalakakei daki evam ta~ra sathe kaukeo sarika kari na.

72:21.latin_iast: vala : āmi tomādera aniṣṭera o patha pradarśanera kṣamatā rākhi nā.
72:21.latin_ascii: vala : ami tomadera anistera o patha pradarsanera ksamata rakhi na.

72:22.latin_iast: vala : āllāhara śāsti hate keui āmāke rakṣā karate pārave nā evaṃ āllāha vyatīta āmi kona āśraẏao pāvo nā.
72:22.latin_ascii: vala : allahara sasti hate keui amake raksa karate parave na evam allaha vyatita ami kona asrayao pavo na.

72:23.latin_iast: śudhu āllāhara pakṣa hate pracāra karā evaṃ tā~ra risālāta pau~chāna āmāra kāja. ye āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlake amānya kare niścaẏai tāra janya raẏeche jāhānnāmera āguna, sekhāne tārā cirasthāẏī have.
72:23.latin_ascii: sudhu allahara paksa hate pracara kara evam ta~ra risalata pau~chana amara kaja. ye allaha o ta~ra rasulake amanya kare niscayai tara janya rayeche jahannamera aguna, sekhane tara cirasthayi have.

72:24.latin_iast: yakhana tārā pratiśra“ta śāsti dekhave, takhana tārā vujhate pārave, sāhāyyakārī hisāve ke adhika durvala evaṃ ke saṃkhyāẏa svalpa.
72:24.latin_ascii: yakhana tara pratisra“ta sasti dekhave, takhana tara vujhate parave, sahayyakari hisave ke adhika durvala evam ke samkhyaya svalpa.

72:25.latin_iast: vala : āmi jāni nā yāra pratiśra“ti tomāderake deoẏā hacche tā ki nikaṭe, nā āmāra pratipālaka tāra janya kona dīrgha meẏāda sthira karavena?
72:25.latin_ascii: vala : ami jani na yara pratisra“ti tomaderake deoya hacche ta ki nikate, na amara pratipalaka tara janya kona dirgha meyada sthira karavenay

72:26.latin_iast: tini adṛśya jñānera adhikārī, tini tā~ra adṛśyera jñāna kāro nikaṭa prakāśa karena nā.
72:26.latin_ascii: tini adrsya jnanera adhikari, tini ta~ra adrsyera jnana karo nikata prakasa karena na.

72:27.latin_iast: tā~ra manonīta rāsūla vyatīta. niścaẏai tini tāra sāmane evaṃ pechane praharī niẏojita karena.
72:27.latin_ascii: ta~ra manonita rasula vyatita. niscayai tini tara samane evam pechane prahari niyojita karena.

72:28.latin_iast: tā~rā tādera pratipālakera risālāta pau~che diẏeche ki nā tā jānāra janya; rāsūladera nikaṭa yā āche tā tini veṣṭana kare rekhechena evaṃ tini savakichura vistārita hisāva rākhena.
72:28.latin_ascii: ta~ra tadera pratipalakera risalata pau~che diyeche ki na ta janara janya; rasuladera nikata ya ache ta tini vestana kare rekhechena evam tini savakichura vistarita hisava rakhena.

73:2.latin_iast: rātri jāgaraṇa (sālāta ādāẏa) kara, kichu aṃśa.
73:2.latin_ascii: ratri jagarana (salata adaya) kara, kichu amsa.

73:3.latin_iast: tāra ardheka kiṃvā tadapekṣā kichu kama.
73:3.latin_ascii: tara ardheka kimva tadapeksa kichu kama.

73:4.latin_iast: athavā tadapekṣā veśi. āra kuraāna pāṭha kara dhīre dhīre, (theme theme sundarabhāve)
73:4.latin_ascii: athava tadapeksa vesi. ara kuraana patha kara dhire dhire, (theme theme sundarabhave)

73:5.latin_iast: āmi acirei tomāra prati avatīrṇa karava bhāvatvapūrṇa vāṇī.
73:5.latin_ascii: ami acirei tomara prati avatirna karava bhavatvapurna vani.

73:6.latin_iast: niścaẏai rātri jāgaraṇa pravṛtti damane adhika sahāẏaka evaṃ uttama vākya praẏoge adhika anukūla.
73:6.latin_ascii: niscayai ratri jagarana pravrtti damane adhika sahayaka evam uttama vakya prayoge adhika anukula.

73:7.latin_iast: niścaẏai dine tomāra janya raẏeche dīrgha karmavyastatā.
73:7.latin_ascii: niscayai dine tomara janya rayeche dirgha karmavyastata.

73:8.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tumi tomāra pratipālakera nāma smaraṇa kara evaṃ (anya vyastatā chinna kare) ekaniṣṭhabhāve tāte magna hao.
73:8.latin_ascii: sutaram tumi tomara pratipalakera nama smarana kara evam (anya vyastata chinna kare) ekanisthabhave tate magna hao.

73:9.latin_iast: tini pūrva o paścimera prabhu, tini vyatīta kona (satya) mā‘vūda nei. ataeva tā~kei karmavidhāẏakarūpe grahaṇa kara.
73:9.latin_ascii: tini purva o pascimera prabhu, tini vyatita kona (satya) ma‘vuda nei. ataeva ta~kei karmavidhayakarupe grahana kara.

73:10.latin_iast: lokerā yā vale : tāte tumi dhairyadhāraṇa kara evaṃ uttama panthāẏa tāderake parihāra kare cala.
73:10.latin_ascii: lokera ya vale : tate tumi dhairyadharana kara evam uttama panthaya taderake parihara kare cala.

73:11.latin_iast: cher̤e dāo āmāke evaṃ prācuryavāna mithyā pratipannakārīdera; āra kichukālera janya tāderake avakāśa dāo.
73:11.latin_ascii: chere dao amake evam pracuryavana mithya pratipannakaridera; ara kichukalera janya taderake avakasa dao.

73:12.latin_iast: niścaẏai āmāra nikaṭa āche śakta ver̤ī o jvalanta āguna,
73:12.latin_ascii: niscayai amara nikata ache sakta veri o jvalanta aguna,

73:13.latin_iast: āra āche galāẏa āṭake yāẏa emana khādya evaṃ yantraṇādāẏaka āyāva.
73:13.latin_ascii: ara ache galaya atake yaya emana khadya evam yantranadayaka ayava.

73:14.latin_iast: (esava have) sedina yedina pṛthivī o parvatamālā prakampita have evaṃ parvatasamūha vahamāna vālukārāśira nyāẏa have.
73:14.latin_ascii: (esava have) sedina yedina prthivi o parvatamala prakampita have evam parvatasamuha vahamana valukarasira nyaya have.

73:15.latin_iast: āmi tomādera nikaṭa ekajana rāsūla pāṭhiẏechi tomādera janya sākṣīsvarūpa yemana phira‘āunera nikaṭa ekajana rāsūla pāṭhiẏechilāma,
73:15.latin_ascii: ami tomadera nikata ekajana rasula pathiyechi tomadera janya saksisvarupa yemana phira‘aunera nikata ekajana rasula pathiyechilama,

73:16.latin_iast: kintu phira‘āuna sei rāsūlake amānya karechila, phale āmi tāke kaṭhorabhāve pākar̤āo karechilāma.
73:16.latin_ascii: kintu phira‘auna sei rasulake amanya karechila, phale ami take kathorabhave pakarao karechilama.

73:17.latin_iast: ataeva kibhāve tomarā vā~cate pārave yadi tomarā kupharī kara sei dinera prati, yedina kiśorake vṛddha vāniẏe dive;
73:17.latin_ascii: ataeva kibhave tomara va~cate parave yadi tomara kuphari kara sei dinera prati, yedina kisorake vrddha vaniye dive;

73:18.latin_iast: yedinera kaṭhoratāẏa ākāśa pheṭe yāve; tā~ra pratiśra“ti avaśyai vāstavāẏita have.
73:18.latin_ascii: yedinera kathorataya akasa phete yave; ta~ra pratisra“ti avasyai vastavayita have.

73:19.latin_iast: niścaẏai eṭi upadeśa, ataeva yāra icchā se tāra pratipālakera patha avalamvana karuka.
73:19.latin_ascii: niscayai eti upadesa, ataeva yara iccha se tara pratipalakera patha avalamvana karuka.

73:20.latin_iast: niścaẏai tomāra pratipālaka jānena ye, tumi jāgaraṇa kara kakhano rātrira prāẏa dui tṛtīẏāṃśa, kakhano ardhāṃśa evaṃ kakhano eka tṛtīẏāṃśa evaṃ tomāra sāthe yārā āche tādera ekaṭi dalao jāge evaṃ āllāhai rāta o dinera parimāṇa nirdhāraṇa karena. tini jānena ye, tomarā kakhanao era saṭhika hisāva rākhate pārave nā, ataeva āllāha tomādera prati anugraha karechena. kājei kuraānera yataṭuku pāṭha karā tomādera janya sahaja, tataṭuku pāṭha kara, tini (āllāha) jānena ye, tomādera madhye keu keu asustha haẏe par̤ave, anyānyarā āllāhara anugraha sandhāne deśa bhramaṇa karave āvāra keu āllāhara pathe saṃgrāme lipta have. kājei kuraāna hate yataṭuku sahajasādhya tā-i pāṭha kara evaṃ sālāta kāẏema kara, yākāta pradāna kara evaṃ āllāhake dāo uttama ṛṇa. tomarā tomādera ātmāra maṅgalera janya bhāla yā kichu agrima preraṇa karave tomarā tā āllāhara nikaṭa pāve. oṭā adhika bhāla evaṃ puraskāra hisāve aneka var̤a. āra tomarā kṣamā prārthanā kara āllāhara nikaṭa, niścaẏai āllāha parama kṣamāśīla, daẏālu.
73:20.latin_ascii: niscayai tomara pratipalaka janena ye, tumi jagarana kara kakhano ratrira praya dui trtiyamsa, kakhano ardhamsa evam kakhano eka trtiyamsa evam tomara sathe yara ache tadera ekati dalao jage evam allahai rata o dinera parimana nirdharana karena. tini janena ye, tomara kakhanao era sathika hisava rakhate parave na, ataeva allaha tomadera prati anugraha karechena. kajei kuraanera yatatuku patha kara tomadera janya sahaja, tatatuku patha kara, tini (allaha) janena ye, tomadera madhye keu keu asustha haye parave, anyanyara allahara anugraha sandhane desa bhramana karave avara keu allahara pathe samgrame lipta have. kajei kuraana hate yatatuku sahajasadhya ta-i patha kara evam salata kayema kara, yakata pradana kara evam allahake dao uttama rna. tomara tomadera atmara mangalera janya bhala ya kichu agrima prerana karave tomara ta allahara nikata pave. ota adhika bhala evam puraskara hisave aneka vara. ara tomara ksama prarthana kara allahara nikata, niscayai allaha parama ksamasila, dayalu.

74:3.latin_iast: evaṃ tomāra ravera śreṣṭhatva ghoṣaṇā kara.
74:3.latin_ascii: evam tomara ravera sresthatva ghosana kara.

74:6.latin_iast: adhika lābhera āśāẏa dāna (ihsāna) kara nā.
74:6.latin_ascii: adhika labhera asaya dana (ihsana) kara na.

74:7.latin_iast: evaṃ tomāra pratipālakera uddeśye dhairyadhāraṇa kara.
74:7.latin_ascii: evam tomara pratipalakera uddesye dhairyadharana kara.

74:11.latin_iast: āmāke cher̤e dāo evaṃ tāke yāke āmi sṛṣṭi karechi ekāi.
74:11.latin_ascii: amake chere dao evam take yake ami srsti karechi ekai.

74:14.latin_iast: evaṃ tāke diẏechi svācchanda jīvanera vahu upakaraṇa,
74:14.latin_ascii: evam take diyechi svacchanda jivanera vahu upakarana,

74:15.latin_iast: eraparao se kāmanā kare, yena āmi tāke āro adhika dei.
74:15.latin_ascii: eraparao se kamana kare, yena ami take aro adhika dei.

74:16.latin_iast: tā kakhanao naẏa, se to āmāra nidarśanasamūhera hiṃsā o viruddhācārī.
74:16.latin_ascii: ta kakhanao naya, se to amara nidarsanasamuhera himsa o viruddhacari.

74:17.latin_iast: āmi acirei tāke kaṭhina sthāne uṭhāva.
74:17.latin_ascii: ami acirei take kathina sthane uthava.

74:18.latin_iast: se to cintā karala evaṃ siddhānta grahaṇa karala.
74:18.latin_ascii: se to cinta karala evam siddhanta grahana karala.

74:19.latin_iast: dhvaṃsa hoka se! kemana kare se ei siddhānta nila!
74:19.latin_ascii: dhvamsa hoka se! kemana kare se ei siddhanta nila!

74:20.latin_iast: āro dhvaṃsa hoka tāra! kemana kare se ei siddhānte upanīta hala!
74:20.latin_ascii: aro dhvamsa hoka tara! kemana kare se ei siddhante upanita hala!

74:22.latin_iast: ataḥpara se bhrukuñcita o mukha vikṛta karala.
74:22.latin_ascii: atahpara se bhrukuncita o mukha vikrta karala.

74:23.latin_iast: ataḥpara se pechane phirala evaṃ dambha prakāśa karala.
74:23.latin_ascii: atahpara se pechane phirala evam dambha prakasa karala.

74:24.latin_iast: evaṃ valala : eṭā cirācarita jādu chār̤ā āra kichu naẏa,
74:24.latin_ascii: evam valala : eta ciracarita jadu chara ara kichu naya,

74:26.latin_iast: śīghrai āmi tāke jāhānnāme nikṣepa karava,
74:26.latin_ascii: sighrai ami take jahanname niksepa karava,

74:28.latin_iast: oṭā tāderake (jīvita avasthāẏa) rākhaveo nā evaṃ (mṛta avasthāẏa) cher̤eo deve nā,
74:28.latin_ascii: ota taderake (jivita avasthaya) rakhaveo na evam (mrta avasthaya) chereo deve na,

74:31.latin_iast: āmi phereśtāderake jāhānnāmera praharī karechi, kāphiradera parīkṣāra janya āmi tādera ei saṃkhyā ullekha karechi yāte āhale kitāvera dṛr̤ha viśvāsa janme, īmānadāradera īmāna vardhita haẏa āra viśvāsīgaṇa āra āhale kitāva yena sandeha poṣaṇa nā kare. era phale yādera antare vyādhi āche tārā o kāphirarā valave : āllāh e varṇanā dvārā kī vujhāte ceẏechena? eibhāve āllāh yāke icchā pathabhraṣṭa karena evaṃ yāke icchā hidāẏāta dāna karena. tomāra pratipālakera vāhinī samparke ekamātra tinii jānena. (jāhānnāmera) ei varṇanā to samasta mānuṣera janya nichaka upadeśa.
74:31.latin_ascii: ami pherestaderake jahannamera prahari karechi, kaphiradera pariksara janya ami tadera ei samkhya ullekha karechi yate ahale kitavera drrha visvasa janme, imanadaradera imana vardhita haya ara visvasigana ara ahale kitava yena sandeha posana na kare. era phale yadera antare vyadhi ache tara o kaphirara valave : allah e varnana dvara ki vujhate ceyechenay eibhave allah yake iccha pathabhrasta karena evam yake iccha hidayata dana karena. tomara pratipalakera vahini samparke ekamatra tinii janena. (jahannamera) ei varnana to samasta manusera janya nichaka upadesa.

74:33.latin_iast: śapatha rātrira, yakhana tāra avasāna ghaṭe,
74:33.latin_ascii: sapatha ratrira, yakhana tara avasana ghate,

74:34.latin_iast: śapatha prabhātakālera, yakhana tā haẏa ālokojjvala-
74:34.latin_ascii: sapatha prabhatakalera, yakhana ta haya alokojjvala-

74:37.latin_iast: tomādera madhye ye agrasara hate cāẏa kiṃvā ye pichiẏe par̤e, tāra janya
74:37.latin_ascii: tomadera madhye ye agrasara hate caya kimva ye pichiye pare, tara janya

74:38.latin_iast: pratyeka vyakti nija kṛtakarmera kāche dāẏavaddha,
74:38.latin_ascii: pratyeka vyakti nija krtakarmera kache dayavaddha,

74:39.latin_iast: tave dakṣiṇapārśvastha vyaktirā (ḍāna hāte āmalanāmā prāptagaṇa) naẏa,
74:39.latin_ascii: tave daksinaparsvastha vyaktira (dana hate amalanama praptagana) naya,

74:40.latin_iast: tārā jānnāte thākave evaṃ tārā paraspara parasparake jijñāsā karave.
74:40.latin_ascii: tara jannate thakave evam tara paraspara parasparake jijnasa karave.

74:43.latin_iast: tārā valave : āmarā nāmāyīdera antarbhukta chilāma nā.
74:43.latin_ascii: tara valave : amara namayidera antarbhukta chilama na.

74:45.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā samālocanākārīdera sāthe samālocanāẏa magna thākatāma.

112:3.latin_ascii: tini kauke janma denani evam ta~keo janma deya hayani.

113:1.latin_iast: vala : āmi ujjvala prabhātera pratipālakera nikaṭa āśraẏa cāi.
113:1.latin_ascii: vala : ami ujjvala prabhatera pratipalakera nikata asraya cai.

113:2.latin_iast: tini yā sṛṣṭi karechena tāra aniṣṭa theke.
113:2.latin_ascii: tini ya srsti karechena tara anista theke.

113:3.latin_iast: āra andhakāra rātera yakhana tā ācchanna haẏa.
113:3.latin_ascii: ara andhakara ratera yakhana ta acchanna haya.

113:4.latin_iast: evaṃ (āmi āśraẏa cāi) girāẏa phu~ka diẏe jāduṭonākāriṇīdera aniṣṭa theke.
113:4.latin_ascii: evam (ami asraya cai) giraya phu~ka diye jadutonakarinidera anista theke.

113:5.latin_iast: hiṃsuka vyaktira (sava dharanera hiṃsāra) aniṣṭa thekeo (āmi āśraẏa cāi) yakhana se hiṃsā kare.
113:5.latin_ascii: himsuka vyaktira (sava dharanera himsara) anista thekeo (ami asraya cai) yakhana se himsa kare.

114:1.latin_iast: vala : āmi āśraẏa cāi mānuṣera mālikera nikaṭa.
114:1.latin_ascii: vala : ami asraya cai manusera malikera nikata.

114:4.latin_iast: (āmi āśraẏa cāi) ātmagopanakārī kumantraṇā dātāra aniṣṭa theke,
114:4.latin_ascii: (ami asraya cai) atmagopanakari kumantrana datara anista theke,

114:6.latin_iast: jinadera madhya theke hoka vā mānuṣera madhya theke hoka (tādera aniṣṭa theke āmi āllāhara kāche āśraẏa cāi.)
114:6.latin_ascii: jinadera madhya theke hoka va manusera madhya theke hoka (tadera anista theke ami allahara kache asraya cai.)
